summary: A team-based multiplayer shooter set in the WWII European theatre, where players take on infantry, sniper, or machine-gunner classes with historical weapons. Squads work together to complete mission-specific objectives based on key historical operations as Axis and Allied forces clash.

Players take the role of scientist Gordon Freeman on an alien-infested Earth, fighting through a first-person shooter campaign with physics-driven combat and immersive world-building to save humanity from the wrong he unleashed.

Players navigate the mysterious Aperture Science Laboratories, solving physical puzzles by opening portals to move objects and themselves through space. The single-player game challenges players to manipulate and reconsider the possibilities of each environment.

Players join online team-based shooter matches as one of nine distinct classes, each with different tactical abilities and personalities. Modes include Capture the Flag, Control Point, Payload, and King of the Hill, with hundreds of weapons and hats to collect, craft, buy, and trade.

Up to four players cooperate to survive swarming zombie hordes and mutant monsters across four movie-style campaigns set right after a zombie apocalypse, with an AI director dynamically adjusting enemy attacks and versus and survival modes.

Four survivors fight through zombie-infested cities, swamps, and cemeteries of the Deep South across five campaigns, using firearms and melee weapons against Special Infected while an AI Director procedurally reshapes weather, paths, and enemy populations for co-op, Versus, and Survival modes.

Players choose from over a hundred heroes and battle in team-based matches, with all heroes free and regular updates keeping the game evolving. The focus is on competitive balance, diverse abilities and items, and learning through co-op versus bots or matchmaking.

Players solve physics-based portal puzzles through devious test chambers in the Aperture Science Labs, guided by the occasionally murderous computer GLaDOS. A separate two-player co-op campaign demands cooperative thinking, with new characters, story, and puzzle elements.

Players join 5v5 objective-based tactical shooter matches, alternating attack and defense with realistic weapons, grenades, and map control. Built on the Source 2 engine, it modernizes the classic competitive formula with ranked Premier mode, leaderboards, and overhauled maps.

A realistic WWII multiplayer first-person shooter set on the Eastern Front, where players fight as infantry or crew historically modeled tanks, using authentic weapons, ballistics, and artillery across large combined-arms battles.

Set in devastated English cities after failed military cloning experiments, the player and up to five friends fight waves of monstrous specimens as military survivors, choosing perks and weapons while welding doors and using slow-motion to survive the horde.

As John Blade, commander of HardCorps, the player fights through Freeport City against the scientist Elexis Sinclaire and her SiNTEK empire, battling mutants and soldiers in a first-person shooter with interactive environments and adaptive difficulty.

Colonel John Blade of a private security agency fights the bio-chemist Elexis Sinclaire, who is flooding the streets with a DNA-altering drug and building an army of mutants. This restored 1998 first-person shooter follows Blade through Freeport as he takes down her corporate empire.

As a hacker inside a digital theme park, the player saves evolving AI creatures called Darwinians from a spreading virus, commanding programs with gesture-drawn shapes to fight enemies, herd the creatures, and solve puzzles across a retro polygon world.

Play as a freelance hacker taking contracts to infiltrate secure systems, steal data, sabotage rivals, and frame others, upgrading software and hardware while choosing to side with factions or stay independent, with choices shaping the story.

A Cold War-era strategy game simulating global thermonuclear war, where the player positions submarines, silos and air defenses to annihilate enemy populations while protecting their own. Fragile alliances, betrayals and real-time death tolls emphasize that in Armageddon everyone loses, and the goal is to lose least.

A fast-paced retro-inspired RTS where players lead armies of Multiwinians in multiplayer battles across 50 maps. Modes like Domination and King of the Hill reward quick thinking, while random events such as power-up crates and monstrous surprises keep matches unpredictable, with simple controls for commanding large forces.

A grand strategy 4X game set in space where the player researches technology, designs new ships, wages tactical war, suppresses rebellions and meets new species while expanding an empire, with included level and campaign tools supporting a modding community.

Players command one of five fantasy races, including the Elven Alliance, in turn-based strategy campaigns and skirmish maps, choosing between Noble or Wild Elves on a tech tree and battling opponents via LAN, internet, or hot-seat multiplayer.

A compilation of the dark fantasy strategy RPG Disciples II and its two expansions, letting the player lead the Empire, Mountain Clans, Undead Hordes, or Legions of the Damned through campaigns and skirmish maps. It includes a random map generator, auto-resolve combat, and improved AI and editor tools.

The player expands, explores, exploits, and exterminates across a large procedurally generated galaxy, designing ships and vehicles, researching a huge tech tree, and watching real-time 3D tactical space battles between customizable empires.

A first-person fantasy RPG set in the underground world of Arx, shrouded in eternal darkness after the sun vanished, where the player builds a customizable hero, draws runes to cast spells, and quests to defeat the God of Destruction Akbaa.

Set after Earth's destruction in 2150, players command one of four factions—the Eurasian Dynasty, Lunar Corporation, UCS machines or awakened Aliens—fighting for survival on Mars. The real-time strategy game offers four campaigns, skirmish and multiplayer modes, base building and faction-specific technologies.

A bounty hunter and mercenary searches for his missing sister Kyra, whose disappearance is tied to a family relict and a dark Brotherhood. In the fantasy land of Antaloor, the player takes sides among guilds, fights on foot or horseback, and crafts potions while pursuing an epic quest.

Set in the Might & Magic universe, players fight through a dark fantasy world using swords, stealth, and sorcery in a first-person melee combat system. Across twelve levels they master over thirty weapons and spells, evolving skills freely, while a multiplayer Crusade mode pits humans against undead in online campaigns.

A fast-paced arena first-person shooter in which warriors summoned by an alien race battle across gothic and sci-fi arenas. Players wield varied weapons and power-ups in single-player bot matches and multiplayer modes like deathmatch and capture the flag.

As Marine Corporal Matthew Kane of Rhino Squad, spearhead Earth's invasion of the alien Strogg homeworld in this narrative-driven sci-fi first-person shooter. Battle the Strogg army with advanced weaponry, mechanized walkers, and hover tanks, and compete in arena-style online multiplayer modes.

As Allied agent B.J. Blazkowicz, the player escapes Castle Wolfenstein and fights through Nazi soldiers, mutants, and scientists to stop Operation Eisenfaust. The first-person shooter spans six episodes of running, gunning, and maze navigation, with the Spear of Destiny expansion included.

A combined enhanced release of the classic first-person shooters DOOM and DOOM II, including their expansions and new episodes, where the player battles demons through dozens of maps, with added online co-op and deathmatch, mod support and modern visual and accessibility options.

Players take the role of Ranger, fighting corrupted knights, ogres and twisted creatures across four dark dimensions of military bases, castles and cathedrals to collect four magic runes and defeat an ancient evil, with online and local co-op and competitive multiplayer.

Players fight through fortified Strogg military installations as a surviving marine, battling an alien war machine to save humanity. The enhanced edition includes the original campaign, both mission packs, a new expansion, Quake II 64, and online or local multiplayer with crossplay.

Cast in a slasher film by Director X, the player competes against seven other hopefuls to win the lead role, maiming rivals with wacky weapons across Hollywood-style sets. The first-person multiplayer shooter stages zany, comedic mayhem for up to eight players online.

Players become a vampire in modern-day Los Angeles, developing powers, interacting with other characters, and undertaking story-driven quests while battling mortals and fellow vampires. The RPG blends traditional character progression with first-person action combat and an array of vampire abilities and weapons.

Players follow Colton White across the lawless American West on a quest for vengeful justice, riding horseback, sneaking, shooting, and using explosives through missions against outlaws, corrupt lawmen, and warring tribes while upgrading weapons and skills.

Players fight through 24 missions across four interconnected World War II campaigns, seeing the conflict through American, British and Russian soldiers. Squadmates lay covering fire and pull wounded to safety as players tackle sabotage, assaults, stealth, vehicle combat and rescue objectives with authentic weapons and locations.

Players fight through WWII campaigns as ordinary Allied soldiers across North Africa, Normandy and Russia, relying on squadmates and choosing mission order. The shooter emphasizes cinematic battles, tanks and large-scale combat, with team-based Axis versus Allies multiplayer.

A World War II first-person shooter expansion in which the player takes the roles of American, British, and Russian soldiers through climactic battles, fighting in tanks, jeeps, and a bomber while using new weapons and squad tactics.

The player commands counterterrorist Task Force TALON in a real-time strategy campaign against a shadowy global conspiracy, deploying modern military units in urban combat, rescuing hostages, and conducting spy missions, with multiplayer battles for up to eight players.

As Julian Gardna, the player pilots over sixty ships through more than 130 space sectors, mining asteroids, trading, building factories, upgrading weapons, and defending the universe from the Xenon and Khaak fleets.

A space trading and combat sequel set in an evolving universe where the player builds factories, trades, fights pirates, and shapes the economy. Players command ships, construct a headquarters, and undertake new missions across expanded sectors in a living simulated galaxy.

Set in the year 2938, players pilot ships through the largest X Universe yet, trading and fighting as the Terran faction from Earth clashes with other races and cultures. The game offers non-linear missions, over 100 new spaceships, and fleet management tools.

A pilot named Kyle Brennan tests an experimental jump-capable ship, malfunctions, and is stranded among alien sectors while hunted and in debt. The player trades goods, fights pirates and Xenon, and builds stations across many sectors to find a way home.

An expansion to a space trading and combat game that removes the linear plot, letting players buy and pilot fighters and transports, capture pirate ships, and expand an empire across over forty new sectors. Players trade goods, build stations, and defend against the hostile Xenon while exploring a universe of alien races.

A young adventurer and his female ally travel a battered ship through a detailed future galaxy, trading in a simulated economy, fighting space battles, building stations and factories, and shaping the fate of the universe amid rising enemies.

Players command a submarine in a detailed simulation, mastering sonar, fire control, helm, and target motion analysis across over a dozen stations. They train, run single missions and a campaign based on real-world political analysis, manage crew and weapons, and fight up to eight players online.

Players command fleets of frigates, aircraft, and nuclear submarines in real-time naval warfare, deploying task forces to control international waterways. Campaigns and scenarios drawn from current headlines are played through intuitive point-and-click controls in a rotating, zoomable 3D environment with detailed weather and sea effects.

Players command three modern submarines, the Seawolf, 688(I) and Akula, across two campaigns, using sonar, radar and target motion analysis to locate and destroy enemies and deliver Tomahawk missiles to inland targets. An accessible interface with automated crewmen supports diving, surfacing and polar ice-cap operations.

Players race and wreck cars across destructible tracks, smashing through thousands of objects and watching drivers catapult through windscreens in spectacular crashes. A career mode, numerous vehicles, rag-doll mini-games, and online multiplayer rounds out this chaotic demolition racing experience.

The player drives rally cars through photorealistic scenery in career time trials and head-to-head Rally Cross events, starting with a junk car and earning money for upgrades and repairs. Weather, time of day, and damage affect handling, and editing tools allow custom tracks and cars.

An epic western first-person shooter in which the player alternates between Billy, a sneaking fugitive, and his hunter Reverend Ray, experiencing revolver duels, horseback riding, mounted combat and stealth across locations styled after Western movies, with physics-driven fire, liquids and smoke.

A rally racing game featuring dangerous technical tracks based on the world's hardest special stages, with moguls, jumps, and hairpins. Players earn funds to buy faster cars, mechanically tune them, and race AI or online opponents in championship and single-race modes.

A real-time strategy and direct-control combat game following Soviet Naval Infantry through 23 missions of World War II's Black Sea campaigns, commanding troops, vehicles, and naval and air support across historical battlefields.

As Princess Amelie, the player explores the hand-crafted world of Teana in real time, then fights turn-based tactical battles with armies and a growing pet dragon, seeking the legendary knight Bill Gilbert while facing monstrous bosses and the Lizard race.

A fast-paced first-person shooter prequel in which players battle hordes of twisted demons from Hell across sixteen new levels, wielding six new demonic weapons and reshuffled tarot powers against colossal end bosses, with single-player and multiplayer action.

A casual aquarium management game where the player feeds and tends fish to earn coins and jewels, spends the money on tank upgrades and egg parts that hatch pets with special powers, and defends the tank against invading aliens.

An action-puzzle game set in hidden jungle temples, where the player fires magical balls from a stone frog idol to match three or more and clear a deadly chain before it reaches the golden skull, exploring over twenty temples across Adventure and Gauntlet modes.

An arcade shoot-'em-up where players pilot a heavily armed vehicle and blast enemy tanks and planes across 19 missions. Two modes, Mission and Survival, offer straightforward action with enhanced sound effects and an original soundtrack.

Players run a pizza delivery empire from a bird's-eye view of the city, matching incoming orders to kitchens and clicking quickly to deliver pies before customers lose patience. Fast reflexes and pattern matching are needed to avoid missed orders and game over.

An arcade puzzle game where the player aims and shoots balls to clear orange pegs across 55 whimsical levels, wielding ten Magic Powers, taking on 75 challenges and dueling friends or the computer in a cheerful, bouncy experience.

Playing the world-famous Mystery P.I., the player retraces Grandma Rose's steps across 20 city locations to recover her missing $488 million lottery ticket, finding hidden objects and solving puzzles against a 12-hour deadline while ranking up investigation skills.

An adventure seeker hunts for the Lost Tomb of Egypt under a museum's direction, finding hidden objects and solving puzzle traps across over 100 levels and 22 Egyptian locations. Players can race the clock or use a relaxed mode with no time limits.

Hired by a casino, the player must find and return stolen money before a grand opening in 16 hours. They search over 2300 hidden objects across 25 Vegas locations, play mini-games, and collect keys and poker chips to unlock a bonus unlimited seek-and-find mode.

Under a museum's direction, the player travels to exotic locations worldwide to find hidden objects and recover pieces of an ancient tablet and the World Diamond. Over 100 levels and mini-game puzzles are played against the clock or in a relaxed mode.

Players aim and shoot balls to clear orange pegs across 60 dream-themed levels, meeting Peggle Masters and unlocking magic powers. Challenge mode, Duel mode against friends or the computer, a Trophy Room, and clickable replays extend the bouncing, fever-fueled puzzle play.

A match-three puzzle game where the player rotates gems on a board to line up matches, clears obstacles like Locks and Bombs, and creates Flame and Lightning power gems across Classic, Zen, Challenge and Blitz modes.

As the world-famous Mystery P.I., the player searches 25 New York locations for over 2100 hidden objects to locate a billionaire's hidden will within 17 hours, with unlimited seek-and-find modes and mini-games.

The player searches for a vanished wizard by using his magic pen to uncover and guess hidden images across hundreds of workbook pages, earning scores, potions, and challenges. Mini-games and sketchbooks add variety to this seek-and-find adventure.

Defend a home from invading zombies by planting an arsenal of zombie-zapping plants like peashooters and cherry bombs, thinking fast across day, night, fog, pool, and rooftop levels, with five game modes including a stress-free Zen Garden.

Shipwrecked by a storm on a mysterious private island, the player searches for over 2100 hidden objects across 25 locations and solves five kinds of mini-game puzzles to collect items and find a way to escape Rosecliff Island.

A seek-and-find game where the player, as a famous private investigator, hunts for a missing blockbuster movie across 25 Los Angeles locations before the Hollywood premiere. Players find over 2100 hidden objects, play mini-games, and unlock unlimited bonus modes.

Players control a frog on a jungle island, firing stone spheres to destroy streams of approaching balls across over 60 levels. They slide and hop for smarter shots, collect power-ups, and battle six tiki bosses across several game modes and challenges.

As World War II ends, the player controls a lone American OSS sniper disguised as a German in war-torn Berlin, working behind enemy lines to stop Soviet forces from seizing Germany's nuclear secrets across 28 missions with realistic ballistics.

As Judge Dredd in Mega-City One, players patrol the streets dispensing instant justice, choosing to shoot to kill or disarm and arrest while investigating a predicted plague tied to vampires and the Dark Judges. The game includes a story campaign plus cooperative and competitive multiplayer modes.

Players act as an evil mastermind building a secret underground lair, training minions, and developing super-weapons and traps to achieve global domination. They recruit henchmen, dispatch government agents, and complete outrageous missions while managing resources and a growing criminal empire.

A remastered 2000 first-person shooter where players choose a Colonial Marine, Alien, or Predator and fight through starships, space stations, and colony bases. Each species has unique abilities and weapons, with three campaigns, a skirmish mode against alien hordes, and multiplayer.
Humanity is hunted across the galaxy by the Seekers, who see humans as a threat to be eradicated, and the player is drawn into an intergalactic saga about the advent of humanity.

Players guide young psychic Razputin through a platforming adventure at a psychic summer camp, using telekinesis, levitation, and mind-projection powers to fight mental demons, uncover hidden memories, and rescue campers whose brains were stolen by a mysterious villain.

Players guide a civilization from its beginnings, expanding cities, managing resources and diplomacy, and pursuing multiple paths to victory across a detailed 3D world, with mod tools and multiplayer options for competing against others.

A turn-based strategy game where the player guides a civilization from early discovery through history, exploring the map, expanding cities, employing strategies and pursuing multiple paths to victory. The complete edition bundles expansions adding civilizations, scenarios and LAN multiplayer.

Players build, nurture and manage great cities of the Roman Empire across dozens of missions, culminating in Rome itself. Research trees, production, culture and citizen happiness are managed while following a Roman family's fortunes and peering inside villas, forums and baths.

This expansion to Civilization IV adds a Warlord great-person type, vassal states, new civilizations, leaders, units, and wonders, plus eight scenarios themed around history's great military commanders. Players expand their civilization's military power toward world domination.

Players spawn and weld objects together in a physics sandbox with no predefined goals, building contraptions like cars, rockets, or catapults alone or online. Community-made modes and Workshop content add murder mysteries, prop hunts, and countless other playful experiments.

Players control Blitz, a multi-talented robot who must activate an aging Space Cannon to save his world from space pirates. Across 19 levels in seven environments, the player solves physics-driven puzzles and fights enemies with inventive gizmos and weapons.

In the fantasy kingdom of Nelwë, technology and nature clash as cyber-organic creatures and steam automatons appear. The player customizes a hero from four races, chooses technological or spiritual paths, and explores a vast world to oppose the Order of Nothingness, with multiplayer co-op and PvP.

Players act as architect, mayor and business mogul, constructing and managing a 21st-century city in 3D, balancing residential and financial districts, citizen needs, pollution and traffic while keeping the six subcultures from descending into conflict or riots.

Players act as a squad leader commanding two infantry fire teams through urban combat, applying authentic U.S. Army doctrine in real time. The tactical action game, originally a military training aid, emphasizes angles, teamwork, and danger around every corner, with two-player co-op and bonus levels.

Command the Blood Ravens and other factions in squad-based real-time battles across the grim 41st millennium, customizing armies and fighting through story campaigns and multiplayer matches in this classic Warhammer 40,000 strategy collection.

Players command armies and manage medieval empires across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, directing massive real-time battles of up to 10,000 troops while building cities, recruiting armies, and wielding diplomacy. The Kingdoms expansion adds four campaigns spanning the British Isles, Northern Europe, the Middle East and the Americas.

Heroes of Annihilated Empires is a fantasy RTS-RPG hybrid set on the elven island of Atlans. Players control heroes who lead thousands-strong armies or fight alone with spells, upgrading abilities, finding artifacts, and taking quests across a campaign and multiplayer battles.

Players command one of twenty European nations in real-time strategy battles set between the 16th and 18th centuries, fielding armies of up to 8,000 units. The stand-alone add-on offers 100 missions, two new nations and infinite AI skirmishes on randomly generated maps.

A historical real-time strategy game set in 16th to 18th century Europe, where the player commands one of sixteen nations, managing economy and technology while waging large-scale battles, sieges, ambushes, and naval warfare across land and sea.

Players command armies of France, Britain, Austria, Russia, Prussia, Egypt, and other nations in mass-scale Napoleonic battles with thousands of units. Formations, troop morale, provisions, physics-based ballistics, and diplomacy shape the historically inspired real-time strategy combat.

A first-person shooter and real-time strategy hybrid pitting marines against alien Kharaa, with each team led by a commander who places structures, researches technology, and issues orders while players fight on foot, evolve into alien lifeforms, or pilot exosuits.

As leader of an elite squad of Republic Commandos, the player infiltrates enemy territory, issues squad commands, and fights through missions in the Star Wars galaxy, with a single-player campaign and online multiplayer modes for up to sixteen players.

Set in 1939 on the eve of World War II, players guide Indiana Jones through a point-and-click adventure to stop Nazi agents from seizing a secret more dangerous than the atom bomb. They explore over 200 locations, solve puzzles, fight, and choose among three paths to defeat the Reich.

Players enroll as a new student at Luke Skywalker's Jedi Academy, customizing their character and constructing a lightsaber while training in the Force. They choose missions across classic Star Wars locations and decide between the light and dark sides, with six multiplayer modes and 23 arenas.

As New Republic agent Kyle Katarn, the player wields a lightsaber and over eight Force powers across 24 first-person missions, fighting a new evil with 13 weapons and interacting with legendary Star Wars characters, plus online multiplayer matches for up to 32 players or AI bots.

A NASA veteran and two companions investigate an Earth-bound asteroid, accidentally trigger it into a crystal spacecraft, and are hurled to a desolate alien world where they must solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of a vanished civilization to return home.

Players build and customize outrageous roller coasters in a theme park, ride their own creations, chat with guests, and complete over 100 missions across 15 themed areas while playing dozens of multiplayer minigames. The tone is playful and family-friendly, focused on creative park management and social interaction.

Players command ghosts, banshees and gremlins to haunt the town of Gravenville and frighten its citizens. Combining strategy, adventure and resource management, they solve puzzles and unlock mysteries across branching scenarios, viewing the action from human or ghost perspectives in macabre horror-inspired locations.

Players race against seven rivals across destructible tracks, smashing through fences and wrecking cars while performing stunts that fling the driver through the windshield. They upgrade sixteen customizable vehicles and compete in demolition arenas and physics-driven minigames such as high jump, bowling and darts.

Players follow three characters across a futuristic Earth, a magical fantasy realm, and a mysterious winter world, exploring and choosing whether to sneak, fight, or talk through challenges. The mature thriller storyline mixes the fantastic and spiritual with murder, deceit, and conspiracy, told through a point-and-click adventure interface.

A graphical point-and-click adventure following April Ryan as she travels between parallel universes, exploring over 150 locations, solving puzzles, meeting dozens of characters, and facing monsters across a long cinematic journey of discovery.

Players pick from over twenty bloodlines with unique weapons and abilities and fight fast-paced team battles of up to five versus five, earning experience and upgrades while matchmaking pits them against others in skill-focused competitive play.

Command frontline forces in twenty real-time strategy missions across Middle Eastern, Central Asian, and Balkan war zones, combining infantry, tanks, artillery, reconnaissance, and helicopters while managing media, civilians, and veteran heroes across five campaigns and multiplayer modes.

In the 22nd century, mega-corporations monopolize the solar system until a discovery near Jupiter sparks conflict. The player commands up to a dozen customizable battleships in real-time tactical missions across 26 campaign episodes, facing aliens, espionage, stealth, and rescue objectives.

On the frozen wasteland of EDN III, humanity fights for survival against gargantuan alien Akrid and treacherous Snow Pirates. Players battle on foot and in heavily armored Vital Suits across vast icy environments, in a fast-paced third-person shooter with multiplayer action.

Players command a small squad of six elite troopers behind enemy lines in World War II, studying enemy movements, planning carefully, and synchronizing attacks across twenty missions in Europe and Northern Africa. Each commando has a unique skill set, and a co-op multiplayer mode is included.

A tactical stealth game where the player leads an elite unit through eight missions deep in enemy territory, using distraction, kidnapping, sabotage, and long-range elimination, with new characters, vehicles, and two difficulty levels.

Players command an elite group of nine WWII commandos through mission-based objectives deep in enemy territory, using stealth, disguises, and combined expertise across authentic locations. They interact with environments by climbing, swimming, and driving vehicles, with a rotatable 3D camera and cooperative multiplayer.

A retired assassin is forced back into action by treason, traveling to Sicily, St. Petersburg, Japan, Malaysia and India to stalk and eliminate targets in a non-linear world, balancing stealth and aggression with sniper rifles, explosives, chloroform and poison darts across first- and third-person perspectives.

Agent 47 travels to America to uncover who is eliminating his agency, carrying out assassinations in interactive locations. Cleaner hits earn more money for bribes, weapon customization, and equipment, while stealth, disguises, and accidents shape each mission.

An action game recreating the Pacific naval battles of World War II, from Pearl Harbor to Midway. The player commands fleets and takes direct third-person control of planes, warships, and submarines, switching between dozens of units across air, sea, and undersea battlefields in large campaigns.

A US-backed operative is sent to the rogue South American island state of San Esperito to overthrow its corrupt government, exploring over 250,000 acres of mountains, jungles, beaches and cities by land, sea and air while inciting rebellion among factions and cartels.

As a wealthy contract assassin haunted by a troubled past, the player plans each hit carefully, using stealth, black-market gadgets and multiple routes to enter, execute and exit assignments with minimal attention across five chapters of a mature story.

In a near-future conspiracy setting, the player takes a first-person role-playing journey through realistic locations populated by people rather than monsters. Skills, augmentations, and dialogue choices let players talk, fight, or use abilities to solve problems in varied ways.

A first-person action-adventure set two decades after a worldwide depression, where the player uses biotech modifications and stealth to navigate a non-linear story of factions competing to reshape global government, with multiple solutions and non-lethal options.

An action stealth game where the player is Garrett, a master thief sneaking through a dark, corrupt city of nobles and magic, picking locks, hiding in shadows, ambushing guards and breaking into any building while spending loot and earning reputation.

Players control Lara Croft as she travels the globe seeking a powerful ancient artifact tied to her mysterious past. She explores treacherous tombs and lost realms, solving puzzles, avoiding deadly traps, and fighting enemies with guns and athletic agility.

A first-person action shooter set in Hong Kong in 2065, where an augmented super-soldier fights a renegade regime across missions mixing chaotic battlefield combat with tactical stealth, using experimental weapons and abilities, plus online multiplayer modes.

A lone genetically engineered soldier fights across the poisoned battlefields of Nu Earth, seeking revenge against those who betrayed his unit. The player shoots through enemy platoons in third-person combat, using sentient biochips in his equipment to craft ammo and gain tactical advantages.

An action-RPG where the player becomes an aspiring martial-arts master and chooses between the open palm or closed fist, exploring mysterious lands, meeting characters, and fighting in real-time combat to decide the fate of the Jade Empire.

A car racing game with a large single-player campaign of 420 progressively difficult tracks across four modes, seven vehicle types and environments, plus solo and team multiplayer, track and vehicle editors, and a virtual currency earned through medals and trading.

A New York student on the run from Mafia gangsters teams up with a mysterious dancer and meets strange characters across roughly 100 settings, navigating a point-and-click adventure of murder, money, santeria rituals, and deception where nobody is who they seem.

An anime-style hack-and-slash in which the treasure hunter Ayumi fights hordes of darkness with gunblades and magic across roughly forty fantasy levels. Experience points unlock new skills and spells, and actions lead to alternative endings.

A rescued prisoner journeys across the fantasy land of Antaloor to uncover the Dark Lord Gandohar's past and save his sister, fighting enemies with an active combat system, magic, and alchemy while completing main and side quests in a classic open RPG.

Players build and manage a railroad empire, laying tracks, running trains, and moving cargo while competing against rival tycoons and robber barons. Set in a vibrant 3D world, the streamlined simulation and strategy gameplay is easy to learn but challenging to master as players grow their bottom line.

Players build and manage a global railroad empire across 25 historical scenarios, laying track, choosing locomotives, hauling cargo in a dynamic economy, and trading on the stock market, all viewed through a scalable 3D camera from continent-wide overview to close-up detail.

Players build and manage a railroad empire spanning from 1804 to 2000 and across the globe, growing from penniless laborer to multi-millionaire while competing against AI opponents based on real historical figures on maps drawn from real satellite data.

A sequel to X-COM: UFO Defense, players command Earth's forces against awakened alien sea creatures in undersea combat, managing bases and technology across a geoscape while fighting tactical battles in ocean depths and buildings.

As X-COM Commander in a besieged future city, players battle alien invasion fleets in real time, fight tactical missions in real time or turn-based mode, research alien technology, and root out infiltration while facing gangs, sects, and police.

A first-person shooter set in the underwater art deco city of Rapture, where the player wields an arsenal of weapons and genetically modifying plasmids, hacking devices and turning the environment itself into a weapon against hostile inhabitants.

Players command X-COM, an international organization fighting an alien invasion. They shoot down UFOs, lead squads of armed soldiers through crash sites in turn-based battles, research and manufacture alien technology, and manage funding and politics as governments waver under alien pressure.

Set in 1959 in the retro-futuristic city of Punchbowl, players control a zombie who eats brains, possesses residents with his severed hand, converts enemies into an undead horde, and leads an assault on the living, with optional couch co-op.

Players fight as a U.S. Marine and British SAS soldier through a globe-spanning campaign against a rogue enemy group, using modern weapons, air support, and coordinated assaults, alongside customizable online multiplayer with persistent progression.

Lara Croft travels the globe in third-person pursuit of the legendary Scion artifact, exploring lost cities and pyramids, leaping across environmental gaps, gunning down beasts and enemies with dual pistols, and solving the machinery of ancient designers whose traps punish failure.

As Lara Croft, players explore exotic locations such as Thailand, the Arctic, and Mexico, using acrobatic climbing, a grapple, and a sonar map to solve elaborate multi-stage environmental puzzles and fight or pacify enemies in an exploration-focused action adventure.

As agent Rico Rodriguez, the player is dropped on the island paradise of Panau and must cause maximum chaos by land, sea and air to shift the balance of power, using a grapple and parachute combo to perform stunts and hijack vehicles across a vast open world.

Players pilot a geometric ship trapped in a grid world, shooting waves of enemies while avoiding them and building score multipliers. Smart bombs clear the screen, and the goal is to survive as long as possible and set a high score in this old-school arcade shooter.

Players enter a vast player-driven galaxy of thousands of star systems, where they mine, trade, manufacture, explore wormholes, customize starships, and join massive fleet battles, building corporations, alliances, and reputations alongside other real players.

A racing simulation featuring the full 2007 FIA WTCC season plus support classes, with over 300 cars across nine classes on 32 real-world tracks and city circuits, including detailed damage and multiple race formats.

An expansion to a turn-based strategy game focused on the post-gunpowder era, adding civilizations, leaders, units, corporations, espionage, random events, and new wonders. Players expand their civilization and pursue domination or other victory conditions across eleven new scenarios.

Roughly a decade after the first BioShock, the player becomes a Big Daddy traversing the ruined undersea city of Rapture, dual-wielding weapons and Plasmids against new enemies while chasing an unseen foe and uncovering more of the city's dark history.

A hired gun named Booker DeWitt must rescue a mysterious girl from Columbia, a flying city in 1912 that hides a dark secret. Players fight through the city using weapons, supernatural Vigors, and time tears that reshape the battlefield, with an unlockable hardcore mode for experienced players.

An evil alien race uses Energy X to give super-powers to Earth's worst criminals, and players command a squad of comic book heroes to defend Patriot City. They choose from over a dozen heroes or create their own, fighting through more than 20 missions in an interactive 3D world with LAN multiplayer.

Players command Minute Man and his superhero team, traveling back in time to World War II to defeat the villain Blitzkrieg and his henchmen. The game blends comic-book storytelling with fast-paced tactical role-playing combat across battlefields and other dimensions, with LAN multiplayer support.

Players lead a civilization from the dawn of man into the space age, waging war, conducting diplomacy, discovering technologies, and competing against historical leaders to build the most powerful empire, on a hex-based grid with multiplayer and mod support.

A first-person shooter reboot of the Wolfenstein series set in World War II, where US Ranger B.J. Blazkowicz undertakes a solo mission against the SS Paranormal Division, fighting Nazis, undead and mutant soldiers with WW2 and sci-fi weapons, plus team-based online multiplayer.

A dark fantasy first-person shooter and RPG in which players choose among four classes and fight through four demon-infested worlds themed on medieval Europe, ancient Egypt, Mesoamerica and Greco-Rome, earning experience and levels while battling the Serpent Riders' legions, with co-op and deathmatch support.

An eight-year-old genius named Billy Blaze becomes Commander Keen, donning a football helmet and flying his homemade spaceship to defend Earth. Across multiple episodes he uses a pogo stick and neural stunner to battle hazards and creatures through side-scrolling levels.

After an asteroid devastates Earth, a survivor emerges from an underground ark into a wasteland of bandit gangs, mutants and an oppressive Authority, fighting through first-person gunplay, vehicle combat and open-world exploration while uncovering a story of humanity rebuilding.

Players command the British 2nd Army during the WWII liberation of Caen and the German Panzer Elite repelling the airborne invasion in Operation Market Garden. Two campaigns and new multiplayer options deliver real-time strategy battles with dynamic weather and enhanced vehicle tactics.

Three opposing factions have fought the Infinite War for a thousand years over a once-peaceful galaxy. As a strategic commander, the player leads one faction's forces in a battle for supremacy, aiming to elevate their race to domination or face defeat and extinction.

Two years after the Infinite War, humanity's ruined factions unite against a new quantum-technology enemy and its zealots, with players commanding armies across land, sea and air in a strategic RTS campaign and multiplayer battles featuring new units and factions.

In a world ravaged by energy crisis and environmental decay, players fight as an elite Western Coalition soldier against the Red Star Alliance for the last oil reserves, using an open-world frontline combat system, over 60 futuristic vehicles and weapons, and customizable loadouts.

Saints Row 2 is an open-world game set years after the original, where the player rebuilds the Saints in Stilwater and takes vengeance on those who wronged them, with fully customizable characters and vehicles, co-op campaign, competitive multiplayer, and over 40 story missions.

Players control Gish, a ball of tar, descending into the sewers of a forgotten city to rescue his kidnapped girlfriend. The game uses physics-driven movement, destructible environments, and combat against strange creatures across story and collection levels.

Players command up to six heroes, including bounty hunter John Cooper, through a Western story of dusty canyons, ghost towns, forts and Indian villages. They switch between isometric and third-person views for real-time tactical shoot-outs, duels and stealthy infiltration.

As Brigadier General Jason Richter, players command an elite anti-terrorist task force through a modern military real-time strategy campaign, deploying near-future weapons, naval forces, and mercenaries across global hotspots to stop a shadowy conspiracy threatening world governments.

A real-time strategy game set in an alternate Cold War where the Tempelhof Incident sparks war between NATO and the Soviet bloc. The player commands customizable squads across an 18-mission campaign, using destructible buildings, weather effects, and unit upgrades to fight for control of Europe.

An online superhero game where players create a unique hero with extensive costume and power customization, write an origin story, and design a personal arch-nemesis. Heroes explore diverse realms, mix powers, and team up with other players in a living comic-book multiverse.

A free-to-play Star Trek MMO set decades after Nemesis, as the galaxy fractures into warring factions. Players customize a captain, ship and crew, explore strange worlds on away missions, and fight epic space battles across over 160 episodes alongside original-series characters.

Players control Kit Ballard, a cat-girl bounty hunter, through 13 levels of a lawless frontier planetoid, fighting enemies and using feline abilities to traverse environments and find hidden areas and collectibles. The collection includes an expansion and a comic.

Players fight through gritty WWII battles on the European and Pacific fronts as a U.S. Marine and Russian conscript, facing kamikaze attacks and ambushes in a four-player co-op campaign and class-based competitive multiplayer with vehicles, perks, and customizable loadouts.

This collection gathers seven classic point-and-click adventure games following Sir Graham and his family in the fantasy land of Daventry, as they quest for the crown, rescue loved ones and outwit wizards and villains through puzzles and exploration.

This collection gathers the classic Space Quest point-and-click adventures following janitor Roger Wilco as he escapes space pirates, thwarts villains, and bumbles through comedic sci-fi escapades across multiple games.

Armed with an experimental suit, the player pursues Dr. Aiden Krone through a bleak alternate reality, using the ability to slow, stop and reverse time to fight enemies across 24 combat missions. Multiplayer supports up to 16 players with time grenades across 14 maps.

Players putt through 36 holes of 3D minigolf across carnival, Old West and outer space courses, using power-ups and avoiding traps, with up to four animated characters in local multiplayer and a course editor for building custom layouts.

Players control Alex Mercer, an amnesiac shapeshifter with body-morphing combat powers, hunting those responsible for a conspiracy across an open-world New York City. He can consume people to take their appearance, memories and abilities while moving with fluid parkour.
A first-person military shooter campaign pits players against a new global threat, alongside online multiplayer with customizable classes and killstreaks, and two-player co-op Special Ops missions.

The Postal Dude and his pitbull move to Catharsis, a city gripped by economic collapse and absurd extremism, where the player chooses between base instincts and civic duty across branching story paths and parody-filled environments.

In a war-torn fantasy world abandoned by the Almighty, players command one of four powerful races through a lengthy campaign of missions and side quests, fighting turn-based battles with a revised combat and magic system while managing totems, flags and neutral units.

Players command eighteenth-century armies and fleets across a turn-based campaign map, fighting real-time land and naval battles with muskets and cannon. Trade, diplomacy, and espionage systems support conquest of Europe, India, and America, with the Warpath Campaign adding Native American factions defending their lands.

Players take on three single-player campaigns as a Marine, Predator or Alien in a first-person shooter set in deadly jungles and swamps around a colony, each species offering distinct hunting and combat styles, plus three-way online multiplayer battles.

Players become Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson investigating a challenge from French burglar Arséne Lupin across faithfully recreated 19th-century London, interviewing over 40 characters and combining objects and clues to close the case in a real-time 3D adventure.

Players take the role of Professor Van Helsing hunting Dracula across London, Egypt, Austria and Carpathian Europe to stop him from finding a manuscript that raises damned souls. This gothic point-and-click adventure combines object puzzles with a romantic, faithful take on Bram Stoker's universe.

Players take the role of Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson investigating strange disappearances tied to a secret sect, moving from London to Switzerland, Louisiana and Scotland while confronting Lovecraftian Cthulhu myth in a rational-versus-supernatural adventure.

Players assume the role of Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson investigating a baffling murder at a Victorian London reception, questioning over 40 witnesses, uncovering 200 clues, and exploring a faithfully reproduced 3D London across five murders and 25 hours of mystery.

Set in 1896 London, players join Sherlock Holmes and Watson investigating the murder of a young painter found rolled in a Persian carpet, searching crime scenes for hidden objects, analyzing clues and police reports, questioning suspects, and tracking progress on a deduction board.

In 1888 Whitechapel, Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson investigate the grisly murders of Jack the Ripper, gathering clues and combining objects across a dark London. Players switch between the two characters and between third- and first-person views in this point-and-click adventure.

On Jupiter's moon Ganymede, the last surviving humans battle an alien onslaught across a campaign and survival mode, playing three characters with RPG-like weapon upgrades, turrets, mechs, and physics-driven destruction in snow and colony environments.

In quick, hectic first-person shooter rounds, players control penguins battling rival tribes across iceberg battlefields with five weapons and bonuses. Reincarnation and ghost abilities let characters keep influencing matches after death, and the story frames the conflict as the penguin goddess Sedna's judgment amid global warming.

As the Overlord, players command a horde of mischievous minions to smash, destroy, and intimidate across a twisted fantasy world, forging loot into weapons and armor and wielding dark powers while conquering the land and defeating seven fallen heroes.

A psychological thriller where John Vattic wakes from a coma with psychic powers and must escape a medical facility and unravel his past. Players mix stealth, gunplay, and abilities like telekinesis and possession across a dual-timeline story.

James Earl Cash wakes in Carcer City, a run-down rust-belt town, where he is forced to become the prey in a brutal blood sport. Players must run, hide, and fight to survive long enough to learn who is hunting him.

Players control Max Payne, back in the NYPD, as he investigates a murder and reunites with Mona Sax while battling underworld thugs through stylish slow-motion gunplay in a dark, tragic film-noir story set in New York City.

Players guide mischievous 15-year-old Jimmy Hopkins through adolescence at the fictional Bullworth Academy boarding school. He beats jocks at dodgeball, pranks preppies, saves nerds, kisses girls, and navigates the school's social hierarchy in a comedic open-world setting.

Three protagonists—Niko Bellic, Johnny Klebitz and Luis Lopez—pursue escape, gang turf and nightclub loyalties in the money-worshipping Liberty City, where their crossing paths bring devastating consequences in a city torn by violence and corruption.

An action RPG set in the fantasy kingdom of Ancaria, where the player picks one of eight heroes and battles orcs, demons and dragons across a large open world with hundreds of quests, loot and combat arts.

Players pilot the upgradable ship Darkstar One through a vast simulated galaxy, following story missions to new races and technologies while hunting artifacts. Credits are earned through combat, piracy, smuggling, trading, and escort work, with over two hundred weapons and equipment items to configure.

Players race and wreck cars across deserts, storm drains and city streets, using a physics engine with deformable vehicles and destructible objects. Carnage modes and ragdoll mini-games add mayhem, while three classes and real-time visual detail round out the aggressive driving experience.

Players compete as one of Ma Jackson's four children to earn the most money trucking through Hick State County in 60 days and inherit the company. They drive open roads, race between five cities, dodge bikers and corrupt police, and crash rivals for bonuses.

A 17th-century Caribbean trading simulation where players build production facilities, run convoys between 60 towns, and take missions from merchants and diplomats. Escort ships fend off pirates, and players can hunt pirates, capture military vessels, and found their own towns.

A match-3 puzzle RPG where players battle opponents by matching crystals to build spells, damage foes with skull tiles, and progress through over 150 quests to save the Kingdom of Etheria, while building a hero, capturing cities, and buying equipment.

The player runs an independent trucking business across North America, bidding on jobs, hauling over 45 cargo types through 48 states, Canada and Mexico, managing fuel and truck maintenance, and growing a fleet of up to 37 rigs to outbid competitors.

Players stalk and shoot big game across eight hunting regions, from North American ranges to Africa, using scouting, positioning, and a bullet camera, with challenge missions, free hunt mode, a target range, and custom mission design.

Players lead a party of up to four adventurers through a huge fantasy campaign built on The Dark Eye pen-and-paper rules, using tactical combat with a pause function, varied magic, talent-based dialogue and deep character creation across numerous main and side quests.

A twisted fantasy action adventure in which the player becomes the Overlord, commanding a horde of minions to conquer kingdoms, and descends into hellish abyss levels to defeat fallen heroes and reclaim the underworld thrones.

An action game where the player commands chaotic minions as a new Dark Master, smashing a Glorious Empire through combat, domination or destruction, with minion mounts, war machines and mistresses to woo.

Players ride their own music tracks, racing down a highway and clustering same-colored blocks for points while competing on online scoreboards. The puzzle racer adapts shape, speed and mood to each chosen song.

A collection of martial arts reflex challenges where the player throws stars, wields katanas and nunchucks, and tests reaction times to the millisecond, progressing from White Belt to Black Belt while competing in local multiplayer battles and unlocking achievements.

Hunted by the immortal Dahaka, the Prince travels to a cursed island stronghold to defy his foretold death. The player fights through brutal enemies with a free-form combat system, manipulates time, and explores a dark underworld across multiple endings.

A first-person action shooter set on a tropical island where freelance mariner Jack Carver is stranded after mercenaries destroy his boat and a reporter goes missing. He fights through lush jungle against intelligent mercenary units using long-range gunplay, stealth, and vehicles while uncovering a sinister agenda.

A seasoned prince returns to war-torn Babylon, is possessed by a Dark Prince, and fights through rooftops and streets using two combat styles, time-manipulation powers, stealth kills, and agility puzzles to reclaim his kingdom in a story-driven action adventure.

Rainbow operatives deploy to the chaotic streets of Las Vegas to stop an escalating terrorist siege threatening global security. Players plan and execute tactical first-person assaults with squadmates, using high-tech gear, multiple entry paths, and real-time tactical suggestions across recognizable casino and Strip locations.

As a covert operative, the player infiltrates secure locations worldwide, gathering intelligence and uncovering a conspiracy to avert global catastrophe. Missions support lethal or non-lethal stealth approaches across interactive environments with dynamic lighting and sound.

Players control Sam Fisher, an elite operative, on a globe-trotting espionage mission from a Pacific cargo ship to a Tokyo bathhouse. The game emphasizes stealth, high-tech gadgets, fluid takedowns, and open-ended levels where reactive enemies remember past events, all wrapped in a tense spy thriller tone.

A young prince unleashes a deadly evil with a magic dagger and, aided by a princess and the Sands of Time, uses acrobatics, fighting skills, and time-bending powers to reclaim cursed palace chambers and restore peace to ancient Persia.

Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Desert Siege is a tactical shooter expansion set in East Africa in 2009, where an elite U.S. Army Green Beret team deploys to stop Ethiopia's invasion of Eritrea, featuring eight new single-player missions and new multiplayer modes.

A tactical shooter expansion in which an elite team of U.S. Army Green Berets is deployed to Cuba in 2009 to defeat rebel forces and mercenary leaders and secure free elections, across new single-player missions and multiplayer maps.

Lead Rainbow operatives against independent terrorist threats linked by the Legion virus, making split-second decisions in tense close-quarters combat. The game offers class-based multiplayer, new weapons like lock fusers and virus grenades, and classic maps with atmospheric sound design.

Rayman is enslaved by crazed bunnies and must win his freedom by completing over 70 gladiator-style trials: racing animals, arena fights, dancing, and plunger shooting, with up to four players competing in quirky multiplayer minigames.

Players control Altair, an assassin in the Holy Land during the Third Crusade of 1191, planning and executing kills against both sides of the conflict. They stalk targets through open, historically styled cities, scaling buildings, riding horses and blending into crowds to strike and escape.

Rainbow Six returns to Las Vegas to stop a terrorist siege, with the player leading tactical first-person firefights through changing times of day. Improved enemy AI, new weapons and armor, and customization support the campaign against the escalating threat.

Players raise horses from birth on a ranch, feeding, cleaning and caring for them while earning money through competitions to buy new horses and accessories. Choices made during ranch life lead to different story endings, blending horse care with adventure and competition.

A turn-based fantasy strategy game in the Might & Magic universe where the player raises heroes, assembles armies, manages cities and conquers territories across campaigns and missions, with tactical battles and multiplayer modes.

Set during the historic Normandy airdrop of WWII, the player commands Sgt. Matt Baker and his squad of 101st Airborne paratroopers through an eight-day campaign, using squad tactics and authentic battlefields while weighing mission success against the lives of his men.

Players command U.S. submarines and crews in the Pacific theater of WWII, hunting and hiding from enemy ships in a detailed naval warfare simulation with crew evolution, dynamic campaigns, and scalable difficulty, though online modes are no longer supported.

Players command a WWII U-boat in a realistic submarine simulation, hunting Allied convoys and warships while managing crew, torpedoes, and stealth. A dynamic non-linear campaign and adjustable realism settings let players of varying skill levels experience tense, historically grounded naval warfare.

A submarine simulation add-on where players captain German U-boats in the Indian Ocean during World War II, hunting British supply lines, rising in rank, commanding new submarine types, and deploying recon aircraft and battle groups in a historically based campaign.

Players command an elite squad of Green Berets in a 2008 Eastern European conflict, fighting through 23 missions with realistic weapons and tactics to hold back a war before it escalates, with online or LAN multiplayer for up to 36 players. The tone is tense military realism.

A combat flight simulation anthology spanning the IL-2 series, letting players fly 229 aircraft across historical and alternate-history WWII campaigns, from jet bombers over occupied Europe to intercepting B-29s over Iwo Jima, with new maps and nearly 200 missions.

Playing as the Orc faction, the player recruits heroes, builds armies and manages cities while exploring and conquering legendary lands, using tactics, skills and magic to outsmart fantasy armies and uncover a dark plot threatening Ashan.

This expansion to Heroes of Might & Magic V adds a Dwarves faction of warriors and rune magic adepts, 15 new missions, new heroes, spells, artifacts, and maps. Caravans, a random map generator, and simultaneous turns smooth and speed up play.

As squad leader Matt Baker of the 101st Airborne, players fight through Operation Market Garden in World War II, spotting enemies, setting ambushes, and commanding machine gun, bazooka, and mortar teams in squad-based tactical shooter combat.

Players BASE jump through a floating city, using quick reflexes and quick thinking to create their own stunts, delight fans, annoy protesters, and score points from judges while threading between girders and billboards.

A platforming adventure where Abe, a floor-waxer at a meat-packing plant, escapes after learning his species will be turned into snacks, then returns to rescue fellow Mudokons and destroy the slaughterhouse using stealth, puzzles, and the power of the Shrykull.

Abe is drawn from retirement by a vision and sets out to stop the Magog Cartel from mining a sacred city of the dead to brew an addictive drink. He frees spirits, gains powers like healing and invisibility, and infiltrates depots and breweries.

Players guide Abe the Mudokon and his aquatic partner Munch through Oddworld's third adventure, using psychic possession powers, power-ups and cooperative character abilities to reclaim the last gabbit eggs from enemies in a 3D platforming world.

An action-adventure in the dusty wastelands of Western Mudos, where the player controls Stranger, a mysterious bounty hunter who captures outlaws for money to fund a secret medical operation. He uses live critters as ammunition and takes missions from a Bounty Store, switching between first- and third-person views.

Players travel back in time to build legendary structures like Stonehenge and the Taj Mahal, solving challenging match-3 puzzles with power-ups while choosing which sections of each wonder to construct and watching them come to life.

A casual action-puzzler set among the pyramids of ancient Egypt, where the player uses a winged scarab to shoot approaching magical spheres across 88 3D-rendered levels, collecting power-ups and earning ranks from Farm Hand to Pharaoh.

A scarab embodying a slain Pharaoh must stop approaching spheres from reaching the pyramid by matching three or more of the same color. Players call on Egyptian gods for power-ups, collect Ankh coins to buy upgrades, use reflectors, and clear over 140 levels across seven modes to free the captive gods.

Players match runes to break blocks and reveal locks and keystones across a rotatable cube board, then rotate cube faces to guide the keystone along created pathways. Completing all six sides and the inner cube yields pieces to build nine historic wonders and uncover a hidden city.

Wielding the falcon-wing shooter of Horus, the player travels from Egypt along the Silk Road through 18 cities, tracking robbers and assembling Queen Nefertiti's stolen artifacts across 100 action-puzzle levels, with a Battle Mode and in-game upgrades.

The player nurtures a tribe of little villagers on a mysterious island, teaching them farming, building, and science while guiding their daily lives, breeding new generations, and responding to unpredictable island events as the village grows and uncovers secrets.

Castaway villagers discover lost children on the western shore of a Pacific island and must care for them while exploring, solving puzzles, and expanding their village. Players watch villagers age from toddlers to elders, brew strange stews, collect items, and manage real-time events.

A gardening simulation where players grow, prune, and crossbreed plants to discover rare species and solve a genetic puzzle to find the six Magic Plants of Isola, while managing plant health, harvesting seeds, selling creations, and customizing a virtual nursery.

A virtual fish breeding simulation where players crossbreed over 400 species to solve a genetic puzzle and find the seven Magic Fish, buying supplies, selling fish in a pet store, and customizing aquariums in a persistent real-time world.

A group of villagers settles on hidden northern shores and rebuilds the remains of a mysterious ruined city. Players gather food, raise families, craft potions from hidden herbs, collect items and uncover the secrets of Isola in real-time simulation with changing weather.

A casual family simulation running in true real time where you adopt and nurture a person, help them find a mate and raise generations, training personalities through praise and scolding while managing illness, trophies, hidden puzzles, and synchronized day-night cycles.

Players shoot through abstract levels where each stage has its own musical, graphical, and gameplay style, triggering guitar riffs and sounds with every shot. Points earned unlock extra lives, shuffle mode, and visual filters, turning destruction into a harmonized all-guitar soundscape.

As Special Forces Sgt. Michael Becket, the player fights through an apocalyptic landscape against the supernatural wrath of Alma Wade, using slow-motion reflexes and environmental cover in close-quarters combat. The horror shooter also includes multiplayer competition and a toy-sized update with miniature battle arenas.

Players ride a motorcycle across over 51 tracks in four event types: racing rivals, performing flips, holding wheelies, and navigating dynamic obstacle courses. Global high scores, ghost challenges, and achievements reward repeated attempts at faster and trickier runs.

A thief named Deckard accidentally unleashes mythical creatures from Pandora's Box, plunging the modern world into war between man and myth. Players fight through collapsing cities with high-caliber weapons in first-person firefights against griffons, werewolves, and a clandestine society.

Players lead a European nation from an oppressive homeland to the New World, exploring, negotiating, trading and fighting to build a self-sufficient colony and eventually battle for independence, guided by historical founding fathers and shaped by diplomacy with natives and rivals.

As Pharaoh, players guide a people from hunter-gatherers to an immortal civilization in a city-building game. They manage individual households, economies, temples, trade, exploration, and warfare while constructing pyramids and commemorative wonders to shape their dynasty's legacy.

A city-building expansion adding a three-scenario mini-campaign set during and after Alexander the Great's career, where players rule as new pharaohs of Egypt. Each citizen has wants and needs to tend, and players grow Alexandria while constructing the Great Lighthouse and Great Library.

Build a settlement in a random fantasy wilderness while leading a party of settlers through fast-paced RPG combat. Recruit characters, arm them for defense or production, develop farmers into warriors, and tame the wild Hinterland against orcs, dark elves, goblins, and undead.

Players take the role of Sergeant Sykes in a combat mission behind enemy lines, fighting through a fully interactive war zone to retrieve vital cargo captured by the enemy, using customizable weapons, vehicles and squad support against enhanced human and alien AI.

Players guide a species from a single-celled organism through five evolutionary stages—Cell, Creature, Tribe, Civilization, and Space—using creation tools to design creatures, vehicles, buildings, and starships, shaping their own universe and the fate of their civilization.

A first-person action-adventure where Faith, a courier called a Runner, flees through a heavily monitored city to clear her framed sister's name, using acrobatic parkour, chases, and combat across rooftops in a dangerous urban environment.

As Commander Shepard, players lead an elite squad across the galaxy, uncovering an ancient threat and battling the traitor Saren's army to save civilization, customizing their character and engaging in tactical real-time combat throughout an open-ended storyline.

A survival horror game set aboard a dark deep-space mining ship where engineer Isaac Clarke fights alien Necromorphs by strategically dismembering their limbs, using improvised weapons and real-time combat in zero gravity while uncovering the horrific truth.

Players command Soviet, Allied, or Imperial armies in an alternate-history World War III, building bases and fielding outlandish weapons like Tesla coils, armored bears, and transforming tanks across land, sea, and air, framed by live-action story videos and a wacky sci-fi tone.

This cyberpunk multiplayer shooter pits Punk mercenaries against Corporate security forces in tense battles across a high-tech physical world and a three-dimensional cyberspace. Players jack into terminals to hack systems, fight enemy hackers, and complete interlinked objectives through combined real-world and cyberspace action.

Nuclear Dawn combines first-person shooter combat with real-time strategy in one multiplayer model. Soldiers fight as armoured, assault or stealth infantry across post-apocalyptic city maps, while a commander player builds bases, manages resources, researches technologies and directs squads toward objectives for one of two factions.

Create a character in classic comic style and join Gabe and Tycho in the alternate 1920s New Arcadia, battling savage enemies in turn-based combat, solving mysteries and puzzles, and meeting bizarre characters in an authentic Penny Arcade adventure.

In an alternate 1920s New Arcadia, the player creates a character and joins Gabe and Tycho to battle savage enemies, solve mysteries, and meet bizarre characters, blending classic adventure puzzles with turn-based RPG combat and adult humor.

Players control DeathSpank, a self-styled hero searching for a mysterious artifact, exploring a large comedic world full of odd characters and dangerous foes. Combat and dungeon crawling are paired with collecting hundreds of weapons and armor, plus optional local two-player co-op.

Players guide the hero DeathSpank across war-torn battlefields, plains and seas, fighting enemies in fast action-RPG combat while completing over 150 quests and collecting weapons, armor and loot, optionally with a friend in couch co-op. The tone is comedic and epic.

Players defend the solar system from alien invaders by placing satellites in orbit around planets, moons and space stations, rotating the orbits to reposition defenses against each wave. The story and visuals pay homage to 1950s sci-fi films, with flying saucers and rubbery aliens across more than 40 levels.
Players solve over two hundred physics brain-teasers by assembling gears, levers, pulleys, and other contraptions to achieve quirky goals, and can design their own puzzles with a building editor.

Set in 1883 Santa Fe, players lead a group of men through missions to stop outlaws behind a kidnapping, covering train robberies, saloon fights, jail-breaks, and shoot-outs. Six playable characters bring distinct skills and weapons to the Wild West revenge story.

Players defend a base from waves of invading enemies by strategically placing and upgrading fortification towers across 20 levels, using ten tower types with unique trade-offs and special attacks. Challenge modes and efficiency-based rewards encourage repeated attempts at each map.

A puzzle-platformer set in a ripped-paper collage world where the player runs, jumps, and rotates the world in 90-degree intervals to solve physics-based challenges. It includes 17 levels across three environments, plus speed-run modes with shareable ghost replays and online high scores.

Jump into physically driven online kart combat, customizing your kart and character before racing and battling up to eight players across many maps and modes with outrageous weapons and power-ups like tornadoes and repulsor shields.

Alex Shepherd returns to his hometown to investigate his brother's disappearance, descending into the foggy streets of Silent Hill. He faces horrific creatures and his own fractured reality while solving deadly puzzles to uncover the evil cursing the town and Toluca Lake.

Sparkster the opossum returns to the ruined kingdom of Zephyrus after 15 years, using his rocket pack to bounce, ricochet, and drill through side-scrolling platform levels while fighting a wolf army with burst projectiles and vortex attacks across four new worlds.

Alice, scarred by a fire that killed her family and released from an asylum, returns to a corrupted Wonderland to uncover the truth of her past. Players fight through dark third-person action with upgradeable melee weapons, magical size-changing abilities, and interactive puzzles.

Players command a WWII Airborne squad through the Normandy campaign as Sergeant Joe Hartsock, fighting historically recreated D-Day battles with authentic weapons and vehicles. The game combines squad-based tactical shooting with a story-driven single-player narrative, cooperative play, and multiplayer missions in a serious military tone.

Players command an elite FBI counter-terrorism squad through eleven global missions, issuing field orders and leading the unit in combat against terrorists, from eliminating threats to rescuing hostages and destroying weapon caches, using modern weaponry and multiplayer support.

Players command an elite multinational counter-terrorist squad, planning assaults on a map interface and then executing raids in first person to rescue hostages, defuse bombs, and stop a doomsday plot across global locations. The tone is tense and tactical, focused on careful planning and stealth.

As a gun for hire trapped in a war-torn African state and stricken with malaria, the player takes missions from corrupt warlords, using fire, destructible environments, and an open world to outmaneuver superior enemy forces.

An action-adventure set in ancient Persia where the player controls an acrobatic prince exploring open-world environments, fighting corrupted enemies with a new combat system and aided by a magical AI companion named Elika.

On a Mars colony run by the Ultor Corporation, miners suffer abuse and a deadly plague, sparking a rebellion. Players fight through 20 levels using destructible environments, vehicles, weapons, and stealth objectives in this first-person shooter.

Players fight as Alias, a nanotech-enhanced demolitions expert, leading a squad to overthrow a corrupt dictator in twenty-second-century Earth. The first-person shooter features destructible geometry, vehicles, specialized weapons, boss battles, stealth and puzzle objectives, and alternate endings based on combat style.

As the last pilot of a crippled space research station, players mine asteroids, gather resources, research alien technology, and build custom fighters to rebuild defenses and escape. They explore grid zones, encounter allies and the Archnid race, and uncover why the crew was brought there.

A 3D action-puzzle-adventure RPG where a service mechanoid named Asimov journeys through the malfunctioning interstellar colony ship Eidolon to rescue robot friends and frozen human colonists. Players explore over 200 rooms, solve puzzles, fight enemies, and hack hostile networks in a ghost-hack minigame.

A retro-inspired brick-breaking game that mixes familiar action with physics effects, power-ups, special attacks, and boss battles. Players explore ten vibrant 3D worlds across Story, Endless, Boss Rush, and Time Attack modes, with co-op multiplayer and leaderboards, all set to a synthwave soundtrack.

Play as Geralt of Rivia, a professional monster slayer in a morally ambiguous dark fantasy world, making difficult decisions that shape a non-linear story with three endings while fighting in tactically deep real-time sword combat and building skills, potions and magic.

The monster slayer Geralt returns in a mature, non-linear fantasy RPG where every decision carries dire consequences across a branching story with multiple beginnings and endings, fought through a tactical combat system mixing melee, ranged weapons, potions, traps and magic.

LEGO Batman: The Videogame lets players control Batman and Robin through Gotham City, building, driving, swinging, and fighting to recapture escaped Arkham villains, then replaying the story as the villains themselves in a comical LEGO adventure.

Players take the role of masked vigilantes Rorschach or Nite Owl, fighting through six chapters of brutal street combat against gangs and criminals in a crime-ridden city. Battles pit the heroes against up to 20 enemies at once, with split-screen co-op available.

Players join the elite F.E.A.R. team to confront a mysterious paramilitary force and paranormal threats at an aerospace compound, fighting through cinematic first-person shooter combat and terror, with two expansion campaigns continuing the story.

Players take the role of a genetically enhanced soldier or his undead psychic brother, battling through a hellish paranormal nightmare to confront their twisted mother Alma. Frenetic first-person combat, slow-motion modes, and divergent co-op unfold across a world tainted by the Almaverse.

A LEGO-style retelling of the first four Harry Potter stories, letting players explore Hogwarts, Diagon Alley, the Forbidden Forest, and Hogsmeade as Harry, Ron, and Hermione. Players learn spells, brew potions, solve puzzles, and relive the adventures with co-op play and tongue-in-cheek humor.

Betrayed and imprisoned, bionically enhanced Nathan Spencer is sent behind enemy lines after terrorists devastate Ascension City. Players swing between skyscrapers with a bionic arm, fight through ruined 3D environments, and use physics to throw objects and pummel enemies, with multiplayer stat-tracking.

A remake of the classic NES side-scroller, players control Nathan Spencer swinging and shooting through 2.5D levels to rescue agent Super Joe from the Imperials, with new weapons, bosses, co-op, challenge rooms, top-down stages, and online leaderboards.

As BSAA agent Chris Redfield, the player travels to Africa with partner Sheva Alomar to investigate a biological agent turning locals into aggressive creatures, fighting through the outbreak while uncovering the truth behind the events.

A wheelman framed and imprisoned for twenty-eight years returns to New York seeking revenge, working as a hired driver across both the 1970s and the modern day. Players shoot, smash and steal through the city's underworld, customizing cars and motorcycles with body work, engines and accessories.

The player commands an army in a persistent online World War III, choosing among the U.S. Joint Strike Force, European Enforcers or Russian Spetsnaz, customizing battalions and fighting real-time battles on destructible battlefields using voice commands and a third-person camera.

Command World War II armies in a real-time strategy game where bluffing is central: deploy RUSE cards to deceive enemies, camouflage troops, place decoys or spy on opponents. A campaign, operations, skirmish and multiplayer modes span North Africa to Western Europe with zoomable battlefields.

In the Old West of 1864, the McCall brothers fight their way toward the legendary Gold of Juarez, switching between Ray and Thomas and their distinct weapons and abilities. Players shoot through outlaws, ride horses and wagons, and explore iconic Western landscapes as loyalty is tested by money and women.

Players drag and drop squirming globs of goo to build bridges, towers, and other structures across strange, beautiful levels, solving physics-based construction puzzles. New goo species with unique abilities appear as the game unfolds, and a leaderboard lets players compete to build the tallest towers in a sandbox.
