In the war-torn land of Calradia, an unknown adventurer rises from lone mercenary to army commander or lord of castles and towns. Players roam a free-form sandbox of over a hundred locations, fighting on horseback and on foot with medieval weapons while interacting with hundreds of characters.

Players command one of 175 nations through World War II and an alternate World War III, managing diplomacy, production, and military campaigns across land, air, and sea. The strategy game emphasizes realistic movement-based combat, political shifts, and historical or alternate scenarios, with co-op multiplayer letting players share a country.

A first-person survival horror game in which players explore ominous, mysterious environments, solving physics-based puzzles and interacting with objects through natural mouse movements while avoiding violence and gore, uncovering dark secrets as the unknown waits behind every corner.

Two opposing castles face off, and the player rolls an enormous boulder downhill to smash the enemy tower while placing defenses against an incoming boulder. Strategy and action mix across historic art periods, with online and offline multiplayer modes and several game types.

Players take the role of real-life operative Richard 'Demo Dick' Marcinko in a first-person shooter campaign, going behind the Iron Curtain to disrupt a North Korean missile program and uncover a Cold War conspiracy. Stealth, brutal kill moves, and online multiplayer combat round out the action.

Players create a custom character and explore the open world of Morrowind, following the main quest against a spreading blight or roaming freely through strange locations, dungeons, and the snowy island of Solstheim, with expansions adding new creatures, factions, and colony-building choices.

An open-world fantasy RPG where players create any character and explore a vast, detailed world at their own pace. The Game of the Year edition adds two expansions with new quests, lands, and foes, alongside first-person melee and magic combat and autonomous NPC schedules.

Set in the 1920s and inspired by Lovecraft, players explore towns and alien locations including the Deep One City, solving puzzles and fighting with period weapons. A dynamic sanity system causes hallucinations, panic attacks, and paranoia as the story unfolds.

A first-person shooter set on the Ark, a floating city on the brink of civil war, where players choose Security or Resistance and carry one customized character between single-player, co-op, and competitive multiplayer battles using a SMART movement system.

Players create a customized character and explore the ruined post-apocalyptic Capital Wasteland, fighting raiders, mutants and aliens while making choices that shape the world. Combat mixes real-time shooting with the pause-and-target V.A.T.S. system, and add-on packs expand the story and raise the level cap.

Players traverse the post-apocalyptic Mojave Wasteland and neon Vegas Strip, choosing sides among warring factions, battling mutated creatures, and shaping the outcome of an epic power struggle through choices and combat.

Two players control E'lara, a ranged expert, and Caddoc, a swordsman, descending into the dark fantasy world of Kala Moor. They combine ranged and melee combat, cover tactics and spells against waves of enemies, solve puzzles in dungeons and ruins, and can build and share custom levels.

A turn-based fantasy card game where the player takes the role of one of six wizard types, dueling other mages by summoning creatures and casting spells across five magical elements. Players build their spellbook through a campaign and face the computer or online opponents.

Teams of heavily armed worms battle across destructible landscapes in turn-based matches, using an arsenal of bizarre weapons and customizable cosmetics. Players fight through campaigns, puzzles, races and fort modes solo or with up to four players online and locally.

A sci-fi arcade shooter aboard a fatally damaged space vessel, where Chief Engineer Conrad fights an alien horde to reignite the ship's engines and survive. Players battle through five environments with upgraded weapons and armor, plus survivor and co-op modes.

Players select rectangles of matching yosumin to make them disappear in a puzzle game, working through an adventure to recover shattered stained glass or an endless mode. The game offers over 180 stages with cute graphics, sounds, and collectible treats earned along the way.

As governor of a Roman province, the player builds and manages a prosperous settlement, constructing authentic historical buildings, bridges, and aqueducts while balancing economy, religion, and strategy. Scenarios span Britannia, Germania, and Egypt, with crime, riots, natural disasters, and a battle system adding pressure.

As governor of a Roman province, the player chooses a noble family and completes missions by building cities, trading, researching, and defending against barbarians with real-time battles, naval warfare, and unit abilities across a large campaign.

Players guide the deposed tyrant Ceville, a knight, and a kind girl through the fairy-tale realm of Faeryanis, solving puzzles that often require teamwork between up to three playable characters to stop a treacherous counsellor and his summoned beasts.

A tongue-in-cheek dictatorship simulation set on a remote Caribbean island during the Cold War, where the player charms, persuades, intimidates or oppresses citizens, plays superpowers against each other, builds tourism or industry, and wins elections across a 15-mission campaign.

As a faction leader in the barbarian city of Jorvik, players explore a fantasy world, slay monsters, complete quests, and plunder loot while competing with rival factions through diplomacy, trade, and war. A living world reacts to choices, with ignored threats and angered factions bringing real consequences.

Players drive officially licensed trains across detailed real-world routes in the USA, Germany, and England, mastering realistic signalling, brakes, and weather. They complete career scenarios or Quick Drive sessions, and can build their own railways and scenarios with editor tools and Steam Workshop sharing.

A free-to-play massively multiplayer action game set in the DC Universe where players create a hero or villain, customize their powers, and fight alongside or against Batman, Superman, and the Joker. Story-driven adventures span Gotham City, Metropolis, Arkham Asylum, and the Watchtower.

Players take the role of hardened career criminals pulling off six high-stakes heists, either with three live or AI partners. They load out with weapons and equipment, trade hostages, and progress through a skill tree while chasing the next big score.

Players guide Naija, a lone underwater adventurer, through a vast sunken world of dark caves and sunlit oases, exploring uncharted waters, gathering treasures, cooking items, and battling massive sea creatures while uncovering the truth about her family and past.

Players beam down from their starship with allies to complete planetside missions across the galaxy, leveling up their Spore creature as a Space Captain, collecting rewards and accessories, and creating their own custom missions with the Adventure Creator.

A city-building simulation in which the player acts as mayor, zoning a whole region of linked cities and managing transportation, services, and growth. Players can reshape terrain, summon disasters, and take direct control of vehicles in missions such as chasing criminals or fighting fires.

As commander in a future war over the alien substance Tiberium, the player builds bases and armies across 35+ missions and online battles, controlling three factions in an epic real-time strategy campaign with live-action cutscenes.

Four mini-campaigns continue the Red Alert 3 story across the Soviets, Allies and Empire of the Rising Sun, plus a dungeon-crawler campaign for commando Yuriko Omega, with real-time strategy battles and fifty Commander's Challenge missions against nine commanders.

An RTS expansion centered on Kane and the Brotherhood of Nod, spanning a twenty-year campaign from the Second Tiberium War onward. Players command armies across tactical battles and a planetary conquest mode, deploying new units, sub-factions, and customizable epic units.

An Irish racecar mechanic works with the French Resistance in 1940s Nazi-occupied Paris, seeking revenge on the colonel who killed his friend. The player fights across rooftops and alleys, drives vehicles, uses stealth and disguise to sabotage enemy operations, and frees districts, restoring color to the black-and-white city as townspeople rally.

Players control a lightning-fast acrobatic ninja rabbit, choosing to pick off enemies stealthily or charge into groups, using context-sensitive combat and physics-driven movement. Death brings instant retries, and an integrated editor lets players try community mods after the story.

Turner, a rebel rabbit with strong combat skills, seeks those responsible for slaughtering his village and uncovers a conspiracy involving corrupt rabbit leaders and neighboring wolves. Players fight through open-ended levels using context-sensitive combat, stealth, and ragdoll physics.

An arena-based 3D shooter where players fight across ten campaign levels and multiplayer matches, choosing from ten classes with special abilities. In Invasion mode, players place map tiles to build unique combat maps before each match, with co-op and 16-player online play.

Players take control of one of over 250 historically accurate nations between 1453 and 1820, guiding it through centuries of exploration, trade, warfare and diplomacy to build a global empire, with flexible government, society and trade choices and historical figures to recruit.

A historical grand strategy expansion where the player governs a nation through diplomacy, trade, province development, and internal factions, including playing as Japanese daimyo vying for the Shogunate or managing China's Mandate of Heaven, with new maps, buildings, and over fifty achievements.

As a medieval king, players grow a kingdom through war, diplomacy, and economy, managing loyal knights with special skills across military, administration, and diplomacy roles. Players develop estates, build infrastructure, lead troops into sieges, and arrange marriages and alliances while guarding against spies and assassins.

Players guide any of over 150 nations through World War II from 1936 to 1948, waging war, conducting diplomacy, and building industry across a detailed map of more than 10,000 provinces. They command armies, navies, and air forces with historically accurate commanders and a deep political and economic system.

A royal treasure hunter explores the fantasy land of Endoria, traveling through towns, wilderness, and dungeons in real time while fighting turn-based tactical battles. Players build armies, choose among three hero classes, and use spells, artifacts, and morale to win.

A grand strategy game in which the player leads any of over 250 territories through a global economic collapse, managing diplomacy, economies, and a detailed military command system. The Gold edition adds the Global Crisis expansion with new scenarios, a sandbox campaign, and an expanded tech tree.

The player rules the fantasy kingdom of Ardania, building a city and defending it from monsters by indirectly controlling self-willed heroes through monetary incentives across a 16-mission campaign and multiplayer maps.

The high-definition edition of a classic fantasy strategy game includes the main campaign, the Northern Expansion, and two new quests, with updated resolutions and bug fixes for players to build and defend their realms.

In this 3D action-adventure, the player guides Frank and his ravenous alien companion Maw, who absorbs the traits of whatever he eats and grows without limit, using a versatile leash to manipulate creatures and objects while solving puzzles and traps across eight levels to eat their way to freedom.

Players assemble working machines from sliding tiles across fifty levels, arranging gears, pipes and other widgets to solve mechanical puzzles. Three modes vary the challenge, including timed and limited-move variants, encouraging efficient and quick contraption building.

A puzzle-platformer in a painterly style where players journey through worlds from a city house to rescue an abducted princess, manipulating time in unusual ways such as rewinding and parallel realities, with nonlinear puzzles that never kill the player but challenge the mind.

A short atmospheric horror game inspired by Little Red Riding Hood, set in the modern day, where six sisters each travel through a forest to their grandmother's house; exploration and introspection drive a dark tale about choices and consequences.

An abstract arcade-style shooter set in environments generated by a graphics synthesizer, presenting itself as a shooter while hiding deeper strategies. Across 200 levels, players chase high scores through synaesthetic shooting action that responds to audio input.

A modern reimagining of the classic Gridrunner shooters in which players blast through 100 levels across four difficulties, chaining kills to produce abstract visual performances, with procedurally generated backdrops, multiple modes, and simulations of the original Commodore 64 and Vic-20 games.

Players control Lynch, a self-medicated psychopath, and Kane, a desperate ex-mercenary, as a simple job goes wrong and they fight to escape Shanghai's criminal underworld. The gritty crime shooter offers single-player, online co-op, and Fragile Alliance multiplayer modes with a raw documentary-style visual presentation.

Players help a band of fruit-loving creatures earn money by cleaning gardens in a Match 3 puzzler, dragging and dropping pieces across five vibrant locations to fund equipment and win a grand prize at a fairy town music showdown.

Players uncover a grandfather's hidden sheet music among antiques and musical relics, piecing together compositions through music box puzzles and unlocking a creative mode to write their own arrangements in a house full of secrets.

Players control a mote in an ambient physics-based world, propelling by ejecting matter and absorbing smaller motes to grow, while navigating attractors, repulsors, and intelligent rivals across 47 levels with time-warping controls and a minimalist electronic soundtrack.

Players adventure across the fantasy world of Tyria in three parallel campaigns, fighting Charr warbands and rival gangs, building characters from ten professions and thousands of skills, and teaming with other players, NPC henchmen, or customizable heroes in tactical battles and PvP.

A comedic point-and-click pirate adventure in which Guybrush Threepwood accidentally infects the Caribbean with LeChuck's voodoo pox and sails the seas seeking a legendary sea sponge cure while evading hunters and unraveling a sinister plot.

An agent from the U.S. Department of Puzzle Research investigates strange events in a town where puzzles, secret societies and odd forest sounds are connected to a central mystery. Players solve mazes, logic puzzles, riddles and brainteasers, collecting gum to reveal hints, in a comic-styled narrative adventure.

As Nancy Drew, the player travels to Paris for a fashion internship and investigates a designer's strange behavior, exploring environments, interrogating suspects, and solving puzzles and mini-games in a first-person point-and-click mystery.

As Nancy Drew, players board a haunted luxury train heading West to solve a century-old mystery for a socialite, exploring dining cars, crypts, and mines. The first-person point-and-click adventure involves interrogating suspects, gathering clues, and solving puzzles and mini-games.

A first-person point-and-click adventure where the player, as Nancy Drew, investigates a seaside amusement park after an antique carousel horse is stolen and the ride moves on its own at night. Players explore, interrogate suspects, and solve puzzles and mini-games.

As Nancy Drew, the player travels to an old English gothic manor to investigate a mysterious malady afflicting a newlywed neighbor, exploring detailed rooms, interrogating suspects, and solving puzzles and mini-games while uncovering dark family secrets and a werewolf legend.

As Nancy Drew, the player investigates vandalism and accidents on a remote Pacific Northwest island, exploring environments, interrogating suspects, and solving puzzles and mini-games to uncover whether an orphaned orca or a deeper threat is involved.

As Nancy Drew, players explore a moonlit forest, cemetery, and speakeasy to solve the mystery of ghostly hounds with glowing eyes. They gather clues, interrogate suspects, and solve puzzles and mini-games in a first-person point-and-click adventure.

Nancy Drew travels to New Orleans to investigate a suspicious death tied to a crystal skull, teaming with Bess to search a creepy mansion and misty cemetery. Players explore in first person, interrogate suspects, solve puzzles and mini-games, and infiltrate a secret society to recover the relic.

As Nancy Drew, the player goes undercover on a cursed Hollywood film set to find hidden objects, gather clues, and solve mini-game tasks like lock picking and smoothie making while investigating sabotage and a fallen star's curse. The casual mystery tone is light and fast-paced.

As Nancy Drew in 1930, the player investigates a mystery around a will left by an eccentric millionaire after an explosion at the Lilac Inn. Players explore environments in first person, drive a roadster, interrogate suspects, and solve puzzles and mini-games.

Playing as Nancy Drew, a deputy curator at a Washington D.C. museum, players explore environments, interrogate suspects, and solve puzzles and mini-games to uncover the mystery behind a series of thefts marked by a scarlet handprint tied to ancient Maya artifacts.

As Nancy Drew, the player investigates sabotage at a Hawaiian research compound, exploring environments, interrogating suspects, and solving puzzles and mini-games. With help from the Hardy Boys, the player navigates beaches, forests, and volcanoes to uncover whether a mythical creature or rivals are responsible.

As Nancy Drew, players investigate a missing groom at a wedding in Ireland's ruined Castle Malloy, weighing banshee superstitions against cold feet. Players explore, gather scattered clues, arrange bouquets and seating charts, play Irish drums, and enjoy arcade games at the inn.

As Nancy Drew, the player goes undercover in Venice to track down a phantom thief stealing historic artifacts. Players explore environments for clues, interrogate suspects, solve puzzles and minigames, learn Italian, don disguises, and play the card game Scopa.

A first-person point-and-click mystery adventure where the player, as Nancy Drew, investigates strange howls and sabotage at a frozen Canadian lodge by exploring for clues, interrogating suspects, solving puzzles, cooking meals, and riding a snowmobile.

Players work through 200 Mah Jong tile layouts set in Ancient Egypt, clearing matching tiles across Adventure, Single, and Traditional modes with three difficulty settings, exotic tile sets, and power-ups, rising from farm hand to Pharaoh through a ranking system.

As a mystery writer, the player investigates the death of Edgar Allan Poe, guided by his ghost through his famous works, collecting clues, interviewing witnesses and solving hidden-object puzzles to uncover a 160-year-old conspiracy.

Players solve thousands of arithmetic-based logic puzzles with colorful cages, using automatic notation of possible solutions to focus on deduction rather than math, across many puzzle varieties and sizes with a tutorial guiding newcomers.

Players bowl against zombies that have taken over the town's lanes, selecting colorful characters and balls while using power-ups and tricks like werewolves and buzz saws to knock the undead back to the graveyard. Zombies advance when missed, and players battle through six lanes toward a final showdown.

Players guide Indiana Jones through a point-and-click adventure set in 1938 Europe, racing Nazi forces to find the Holy Grail, visiting many locations and solving puzzles with mouse clicks while earning an Indy Quotient score.

Players relive all three classic Indiana Jones films in tongue-in-cheek LEGO worlds, battling enemies, solving puzzles and hunting treasures across more than 60 playable characters, with a friend able to join in co-op.

Three pilots—a rookie Naboo flyer, a mercenary, and an alien pirate—form an alliance against an assault on Naboo. Players fly three distinct starfighters through over fourteen missions including deep-space dogfights, attack runs, and escorts, across open plains, space, and the Droid Control Ship's corridors.

A remastered classic adventure in which a naive hero tries to become a pirate in the Caribbean, solving humorous puzzles, winning the confidence of Mêlée's pirates, and confronting the ghost pirate LeChuck, with updated art, voiceover, and a hint system.

Players become the last hope of the Jedi Order four thousand years before the Galactic Empire, mastering the Force, building a lightsaber, choosing a party from nine characters, and traveling eight worlds while deciding whether to save the Republic or fall to the dark side.

As Kyle Katarn, the player wields a lightsaber and Force powers across 3D levels, fighting stormtroopers and seven dark Jedi while choosing between the light and dark sides of the Force in a Star Wars action story.

Set five years after Kyle Katarn's victory, players take the role of Jedi Mara Jade defending a Rebel outpost from Imperial forces, using new weapons and Force powers across 14 levels while Kyle pursues secrets in an ancient Sith temple.

Players control Darth Vader's secret apprentice in an action game set between Star Wars Episodes III and IV, unleashing Force powers and combos across missions and bonus levels, uncovering an untold story that leads toward a confrontation with Luke Skywalker.

Play through all six Star Wars films as LEGO characters, solving puzzles through creative building and teamwork, battling enemies with Force powers, and customizing from over 120 characters, with two-player local co-op for friends and families.

A LEGO action-adventure retelling all four Indiana Jones films, letting players battle through levels, collect artifacts to unlock over 60 characters, and build custom levels for two-player split-screen play.

Guybrush Threepwood returns to hunt the treasure of Big Whoop while the zombie pirate LeChuck seeks revenge. Players solve puzzles, meet old friends, and use humor and wits across the Caribbean in this remastered point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn HD art.

Players command the Rebellion, Empire, or criminal underworld in a Star Wars real-time strategy collection, managing fleets and ground forces across dozens of planets, fighting space and land battles, and shaping the fate of the galaxy through campaigns and multiplayer.

Starkiller, Darth Vader's fugitive apprentice, returns as a possible clone seeking his identity and his love Juno while Vader hunts him. Players wield dual lightsabers and devastating Force powers through combat, puzzles and boss battles across worlds from the Star Wars films.

Players relive Clone Wars stories in LEGO form, controlling clone troopers in massive ground battles, building bases, deploying vehicles, switching between teams, fighting giant bosses, and flying ships through multi-layered space combat with tongue-in-cheek humor.

As a member of Delta Force, conduct swift and silent missions across varied terrain and five continents, from Central Asian airfields to South American cartels and nuclear threats in Russia. Players switch between first- and third-person views, observe enemy movement, and engage at long distances in realistic outdoor environments.

The player joins an elite U.S. Army special operations unit fighting terrorism worldwide, approaching objectives by parachute and using terrain and cover to move undetected. Missions can be played solo or online with up to 50 players, and a mission editor lets players build their own battles.

Players take control of an elite US Army anti-terrorist unit, choosing from specialized soldiers and fighting across vast outdoor and indoor environments with an arsenal of modern firearms. Single-player missions and large online multiplayer battles are both supported.

As elite US special operations soldiers, players infiltrate real-world locations in Somalia, Colombia and Iran, using a large arsenal of weapons, UAV reconnaissance and air strikes to complete 25 missions, with large-scale multiplayer and a mission editor.

As a member of the elite Delta Force, the player takes on over 60 single-player and multiplayer FPS levels, including enhanced classic missions and new maps, testing close-quarters and long-range combat skills with stat tracking.

An expansion to the Delta Force military shooter, following Team Sabre on fictional missions in Colombian jungles and Persian Gulf islands. Players pick from 24 weapons and vehicles to complete objectives across two campaigns, with large-scale multiplayer maps and mod support.

A tank simulation in which the player commands a fleet of M1A2 Abrams tanks across four campaigns and over 50 missions set in troubled regions. Players control commander, gunner or driver stations, call in artillery and air support, and fight infantry in solo or co-op play.

Players pilot an authentic F-16 fighter jet through 40 single-player missions and 12 multiplayer missions, engaging in air-to-air combat and precision bombing with night vision systems. The flight simulator emphasizes a Lockheed Martin-approved flight model, avionics, and a fully interactive 3D cockpit for realistic aerial warfare.

Fly the MiG-29 Fulcrum fighter jet in a combat flight simulation with an authentic flight model developed with a Russian test pilot. Play 40 single-player missions plus 12 multiplayer missions, use the mission design tool to create sorties, and switch among eight camera views in detailed cockpits.

Players pilot a Comanche RAH-66 helicopter through six single-player campaigns and multiplayer, blasting tanks, jets, and warships with missiles and cannons across urban, forest, arctic, desert, and sea environments.

As a mercenary space fighter caught in a violent conflict on the galaxy's fringe, the player explores a detailed universe, chooses sides, flies missions, and engages in large-scale space combat around massive ships and stations, with dialogue and decisions shaping the story.

Players join large-scale modern online warfare as one of seven fighting forces, battling across over thirty massive Indonesian multiplayer maps with drivable tanks, hovercraft, and helicopters, choosing specialized classes and fighting alongside up to 150 players online or 64 on LAN.

Players run restaurants across Paris, Rome, Munich, and LA, combining business strategy and RPG-style progression with a sandbox mode, hiring chefs, decorating themed venues, and completing a 16-mission campaign following the Leboufs' marriage and professional struggles.

A top-down shooter where the player fights through a monster-infested military complex, clearing the base with explosives, stationary guns, and purchasable weapons and implants. Thousands of aliens swarm each map as the player attempts to stop the invasion and save humanity.

A top-down arcade shooter with RPG progression where players fight through 17 missions against swarms of aliens, upgrading characters and using over 50 weapons and gadgets across campaign, survival, and gun-stand modes.

Players battle through a secret research base overrun by zombie hordes, shooting through contaminated maps with upgradable weapons and skills, and testing themselves in Survive and Gun Stand modes to uncover the cause of the catastrophe.

An action RPG where the player picks a character, earns experience and money to upgrade skills and gear, and fights through zombie-infested ruined cities with dozens of weapons, drones, and vehicles across campaign and survival modes.

As rogue agent Sam Fisher, the player uses stealth, gadgets, and the Last Known Position and mark-and-execute systems to outmaneuver enemies while pursuing a personal, cinematic conspiracy storyline. The tone is tense and action-driven, with a distinctive visual style.

Players follow Ezio Auditore, a young Italian noble seeking vengeance after his family's betrayal, becoming a master assassin across Renaissance Florence and Venice while free-running through crowds and choosing how to approach missions.

The Prince visits his brother's besieged kingdom and uses the ancient power of the Sands, wielding nature and time-rewinding abilities, to fight multi-enemy battles and traverse acrobatic environments in an epic adventure set between Sands of Time and Warrior Within.

Zeit² is a 2D side-scrolling shoot-'em-up where the player warps forward and backward in time, teaming up with a shadow version of themselves to combine shots and power. Players blast enemy swarms, fight eight bosses, upgrade weapons, and chase high scores across six modes and 70 challenges.

A god-game where the player guides a primitive tribe across a dynamically evolving archipelago, mastering nature's forces to protect them from tsunamis, wildfires, and volcanoes. The sandbox simulation and puzzle-like challenge maps task players with sculpting terrain and helping the tribe recover ancestral powers.

Players rule a remote Caribbean banana republic, balancing poverty, corruption, rebels and public happiness while building an island economy and tourist trade. The compilation also casts players as a Pirate King managing buccaneers and prisoners, with over 100 scenarios and a random map generator.

Set in the 13th-century Hanseatic League, the player builds a medieval trade empire across European cities, managing politics, prestige and economics. Through warehouses, workshops, diplomacy, piracy or smuggling, they grow a town into a major trading center and may become Lord Mayor.

A remastered point-and-click adventure in which journalist Nico Collard and companion George Stobbart investigate a drug gang and an ancient Mayan artifact, uncovering rituals, kidnappings and divine threats. Players explore detailed locations, question over sixty characters and solve hundreds of puzzles to unravel the conspiracy.

An action racing game in which the player drives through a 32-square-kilometer open city and autobahn network, completing over 70 missions while investigating a terrorist organization's crime series. Players chase suspects, interview informants, and choose how to stop opponents, using more than 40 vehicles by day and night.

Players solve over 1200 puzzles across eight types, including crosswords, sudoku, and picture logic, in Quickplay or Challenge modes. Winning earns hint tokens and unlocks bonus games, while a handwriting recognition feature lets players teach the game their own writing style.

Brave Zee Tee sets out to rescue the Princess of the Flower Kingdom from the Ghulibas of the north, shifting dimensions to change the levels around him. The retro-style platformer spans eight crafted worlds and hides plot twists and three different endings.

Players run their own pet vet clinic, nursing dogs, cats, horses, birds, and other animals back to health across more than twenty cases. Earnings are used to build kennels and expand services, while players also play with and pamper the recovered pets.
Drive over 25 rigs hauling extreme cargo across ice, desert and jungle terrains, managing fuel, truck maintenance and tight deadlines while building a trucking empire in dangerous conditions.

A medieval fantasy RPG prequel set in Aventuria, following a journey down the Great River from Ferdok to Nadoret aboard a ship. Players pick from new hero archetypes, take on varied quests, and face monsters with choices shaping opportunities.

Players enlist in various US Army roles, from infantry to pilots and tank crews, in a realistic military simulator set in the Central Asian region of Takistan, featuring large maps, detailed ballistics, vehicles and extensive single-player and multiplayer modes.

Control fish secret agents Max Flounder and Tina Guppy in an underwater puzzle game with over a hundred levels built on simple mechanics. Animated sequences tell a funny story, with thousands of dubbed lines, bonus content, three playable characters and a level editor for player-made missions.

Players control Michael Thorton, a disgraced secret agent who alone holds information to stop an international catastrophe. Each mission offers choices in how objectives are accomplished, and every decision shapes the kind of spy Thorton becomes and the fate of the world.

Players command armies through two decades of Napoleonic warfare, from the Italian campaign to Waterloo, leading troops in large-scale battles and managing campaigns, including the Peninsular Campaign across 32 Iberian regions with guerrilla units and elite reinforcements.

A kart racing game in which players choose from 20 Sonic and SEGA characters driving unique vehicles across 27 tracks, dodging traps, using power-ups and All-Star moves, and racing friends in four-player split-screen.

Set in 16th-century feudal Japan, players lead a clan as Daimyo, using real-time samurai battles, turn-based campaign strategy, economics, diplomacy, spies, and sieges to reunite the warring nation and become Shogun.

A third-person stealth-action game following Semion Strogov, a captain in the WWII Soviet counterintelligence agency SMERSH, as he gathers intelligence, assassinates enemy agents and captures spies across Europe, the USA and the USSR using period weapons, vehicles and gadgets.

A sci-fi colony building game where players grow settlements from landing pods into domed metropolises across a solar system, managing industries and colonists. Eight factions pursue their own agendas, requiring diplomacy and orbital combat, while a detailed tech tree and ship design system support expansion.

The player commands Free Nations Union forces against the Phantom League across six distant planets, waging war on land, sea, and air. A secret-allies political system lets troops shift the balance in regions, supported by 3D landscapes and detailed units.

A turn-based strategy sequel in which the Free Nations Union and Phantom League fight over distant space colonies, featuring new planets, campaigns, scenarios, units and an Assault mode built on the Secret Allies concept.

Players take a job as a space pilot for the corporation Project Freedom, flying combat missions across a 21-mission campaign set in open space, on planets and moons. The story follows an original plot with unexpected turns while the player handles escort, strike, and rescue operations.

As the Luftwaffe launches its aerial offensive, players join the outnumbered Royal Air Force, flying Hurricanes and Spitfires to hold off the enemy. The game offers over a dozen missions with a detailed damage model, arcade or simulator controls, and multiplayer as either the RAF or Luftwaffe.

A special ops sniper is sent to a tropical island to help rebels after a military coup, undertaking covert missions that require stalking, surveillance, and precise shooting. The game simulates realistic ballistics with bullet drop and weather effects, and mixes sniper missions with assault scenarios and multiplayer levels.

As a sniper, the player takes steady, carefully timed shots at long range, accounting for wind, gravity and bullet drop while evading enemies who flank and close in, across jungles, mountains and urban environments like Sarajevo.

A physics puzzle game in which the player uses trained rats, functional objects and physics to devise creative solutions that kill cats in humorous cartoon ways, aiming for faster times and higher scores across 44 maps.

Lara Croft explores dense Central American jungles and deep tombs in an isometric action-adventure, solving puzzles, traversing deadly traps, and fighting undead warriors raised by the evil Xolotl, with cooperative and competitive multiplayer elements.

Players become Batman exploring Arkham Asylum, chaining melee combos against Joker's henchmen, using stealth takedowns from vantage points, and solving forensic puzzles with gadgets to uncover secrets and face iconic villains across a gritty island.

Players lead U.S. armed forces against radical terrorists who have seized Saudi Arabia, using tanks, helicopters, and infantry in realistic desert and urban settings. Missions involve capturing vehicles and buildings, gaining troop experience, and wearing down enemy morale.

An off-road racing game offering ten modes including capture the flag, gate hunt and helicopter pursuit across 170 races on four continents, with eighteen upgradable vehicles, detailed destruction and tuning, and multiplayer for up to eight players.

Set during the Battle of Stalingrad from 1942 to 1943, the game puts players in gritty multiplayer firefights as German or Soviet soldiers, with tactical modes, first-person tank combat and a cover system. Persistent stats, ranks and hero status reward continued play with better weapons and abilities.

A first-person action-adventure where an archaeologist trapped in a Mexican volcano uncovers ancient ruins and a mysterious metal Ball, using it to solve physics puzzles, overcome traps and fight strange guardians across eight large levels.

A physics-based puzzle platformer in which a wizard, knight and thief are bound together by an artifact and must save a kingdom fallen to the undead, switching between heroes to solve environmental puzzles, alone or in three-player online and local co-op.

Three heroes—a wizard, a knight and a thief—traverse a fairytale world across twenty levels of physics-based puzzles, platforming and combat, playable solo with free hero switching or in online and local co-op for up to three players.

Players explore a grey limbo of 29 chambers as a soul, nourishing, hunting, or mining Color through drawn sigils, interacting with alluring Sisters and grotesque Brothers, and choosing whether to obey or fight to break the cycle.

Set after World War II, the player travels the globe to source exotic ingredients and designs custom chocolate recipes, managing their economic impact while building a chocolate empire and following the Baumeister family saga.

A time-management cooking game where the player helps Flo and her grandmother run four DinerTown restaurants, preparing and serving meals across over 50 levels. Players master recipes in five restaurants, delight customers, and spend earnings on decorative and functional upgrades.

As detective Petra, players investigate a conspiracy of magic and intrigue in the shadowy underbelly of the Emerald City of Oz, encountering new foes and familiar faces like Scarecrow, Lion, and Toto. The point-and-click adventure spans five chapters of puzzles, witnesses, suspects, and allies across detailed environments.

As wedding planner Quinn, manage guests, fulfill bride and groom requests, and handle comedic disasters across exotic locations to become the world's top wedding planner, with story and endless modes spanning fifty levels and five environments.

Zenerchi is a meditative take on the three-in-a-row match game, swapping colored rings to fill containers one hue at a time. It offers journey and zen modes across 50 levels in 10 worlds, with special busts, obstacles called binders and enigmas, and inspirational quotes for expert scores.

The player manages a series of local diners to fend off the Grub Burger fast food chain, which has bribed its way into DinerTown. Stocking ingredients, setting fair menu prices, buying decor and advertising, and running over a dozen restaurants across five neighborhoods are the core tasks.

After DinerTown loses a tug-of-war contest, Jo opens a gym and helps residents get in shape through over 50 levels of workout-machine management, upgrading equipment and serving customers across story, endless tug-of-war, and endless shift modes.

After a solar eclipse transports the player and friends to an unfamiliar world, they must gather resources, build shelter, and research the environment to found a new civilization. Couples pair up by zodiac compatibility, and puzzles, artifacts, and upgrades must be completed to restore a teleporter home.

Players work through two comedic point-and-click adventures, solving puzzles and reading funny dialogue while traveling from Peru to alien invasions and time-hopping battles against Hitler's robot Nazi dinosaur clones. The tone is tongue-in-cheek throughout, with thousands of unique responses to player actions.

Players match jewels across hundreds of puzzle boards while following Rupert and Emma around the globe to find the Golden Jewel Board and cure their daughter's fading sight, encountering monkeys, pearls, and rival experts along the way.

A collection of three Mahjong tile-matching puzzle games following Kwazi from a mysterious monastery birth through life choices, dragon battles, and spiritual journeys, with quest, freeplay, tournament, and classic layout modes.

As the newly arrived Coconut Queen on the island of Lui Lui, the player builds and customizes a tropical resort across 55 levels and seven locations, adding over 30 buildings and landscape elements to reinvent the island as a tourist destination before it declines.

A strategy game where the player builds, buys, and sells houses to become a real estate mogul, flipping properties for cash or collecting rental income. Players visit scenic towns, complete goals for mayors, and upgrade neighborhoods in career or casual mode.

Players build, buy, and sell houses across new towns, choosing paint colors, upgrades, and landscaping to boost curb appeal and profits while constructing parks and shops to beautify neighborhoods and earn money in campaign or casual modes.

A casual management game in which the player travels across Europe restoring rundown houses, building service buildings and landmarks, and landscaping neighborhoods to raise curb appeal. Changing neighborhood needs, weather, and small emergencies must be handled to finish jobs on time.

Players help friendly towns grow by building neighborhoods and generating clean energy with solar towers and wind farms, dispatching technicians to improve efficiency. Careful power management avoids blackouts while recreational facilities beautify the neighborhood across multiple campaigns with awards.

A farm management game where the player tends fields, raises cows and other animals, gathers eggs, and sells goods at the town market. Earning money allows investment in equipment like a cheese dairy, warehouse upgrades, and larger trucks across over 45 increasingly challenging levels.

Players grow grass, feed chickens, collect eggs, and sell produce at market, spending earnings on buildings that yield new products like steaks and cakes. Dogs drive off bears threatening the farm across many levels, with hidden gags to click and trophies to earn.

Players grow grass, feed animals and collect produce, then turn the goods into pizza ingredients to serve customers around the world. Across 90 levels they fend off bears, buy ingredient-producing buildings and upgrade trucks and planes in fast-paced point-and-click casual farming gameplay with zany animations.

Players manage five farms around the world, growing crops, feeding animals, collecting produce and manufacturing goods across 95 levels. They help Scarlett earn votes to become president of the farmer's union, with wacky animals, upgrades, and comic book interludes.

Players manage a farm with Scarlett, growing crops, feeding animals, collecting produce, and manufacturing goods across 90 new levels filled with quirky characters and buildings, plus an endless mode for continued play.

Players rebuild Ancient Rome by solving match-style puzzles across more than 100 levels, constructing landmarks like the Coliseum and Pantheon while advancing through five historical epochs from a small village to the Golden Age of the Empire.

Players solve match-style puzzle levels to rebuild the lost capital of Ancient Persia, traveling through seven historical epochs and collecting supplies to unlock the wonders of Persepolis while freeing a genie from a lamp.

Players explore the devastated ruins of a post-apocalyptic world in this classic role-playing game, using the SPECIAL system to build drastically different characters. They talk, sneak or fight past mutants, gangsters and robots, making meaningful decisions that determine whether they survive the wastelands or become another fallen hero.

A post-nuclear RPG in which the player crosses a wasteland searching for a device to save their village, mastering skills and traits to endure radiation, mutants and betrayal. The tone is bleak and cynical, with a retro-future apocalyptic setting and a story built on deceit.

As a recruit of the Brotherhood of Steel in a radiated wasteland, the player leads a squad through tactical turn-based combat, relying on weapons, skills, and squadmates to protect the weak and survive in a dark post-apocalyptic world.

Players run a street gang in a decaying urban world, ordering recruits to attack, defend, or crack safes for cash, then spend it on weapons in an intense first-person shooter. Revenge drives the campaign as they climb the criminal hierarchy and eventually confront the Kingpin himself.

Players command units in a real-time strategy game where combat replaces resource gathering, relying only on mana and souls, capturing enemy souls for troops, casting powerful spells, and choosing gods whose favor grants different spell selections.

The player drops into alien mining cities from the sky using a stealth parachute and a head-mounted sniper weapon, seeking out and eliminating the alien leader. The description emphasizes smooth 3D gameplay and outlandish futuristic weapons. The tone is action-driven and darkly comic.

A cosmic accident drops a super suit onto an ordinary earthworm, turning him into Earthworm Jim. Players guide Jim through dozens of weird levels, using weapons and abilities to rescue Princess What's-Her-Name while dodging bounty hunters and facing Queen Slug-For-Butt.

A side-scrolling platformer in which Jim chases foes across the galaxy through bizarre levels, using new weapons and abilities to run, jump, fly, and swing past obstacles. The tone is absurd and comedic, with untraditional level designs and returning characters.

A puzzle game disguised as a platformer: players must collect every egg in a level using a limited set of tools such as the Telewarp and Freeze-o-Matic, planning moves carefully. Across 80+ levels in four worlds, new tools are introduced gradually, with accessible and hard levels for all ages.

Players guide cubes through fully three-dimensional levels to color-coded exits using conveyor belts, warps, stop signs, and splits, solving over seventy puzzles of increasing difficulty. Controls are mouse-only drag-and-drop, with a hint system and stylized environments to keep the focus on solutions.

Players directly control a cube and roll it through dozens of retro-styled platforming levels, hunting for prisms and shortcuts while racing the Dark Cube and competing on Steam leaderboards. The extended edition adds over 40 new levels and an 8-bit inspired soundtrack.

An action RPG in which the player, heir to the near-extinct Legionnaires, defends the nation of Ehb against returning evil, blending fast-paced combat with a robust ability and loot system, playable solo, in local co-op, or online in a full multiplayer experience.

Starting as a humble farmer, the player travels a continuous 3D fantasy world, gathers a party of up to eight characters, and fights an unleashed army of evil through non-stop action as a larger plot unfolds.

A generation after the first victory, a new menace awakens as magic wanes and an ancient heir grows in power; the player wields sword and spell across the Land of Ehb to stop the coming abomination and decide the fate of the Second Age of Man.

A massively multiplayer online RPG where players join over thirty million adventurers in an ever-changing fantasy world, experiencing story-driven expansions, diverse jobs, and dungeons playable solo with NPC allies or in parties with friends.

A nameless hero arrives in the war-torn fantasy land of Myrtana, overrun by orcs and divided among rebels and southern Hashishin, and roams a huge open world completing quests, choosing sides and fighting with melee, ranged weapons and spells in a class-free character system.

After tearing down a magical barrier, the player navigates a detailed medieval world of over 500 characters with daily routines, taking on more than 100 missions and shaping the story through their own choices. Combat uses over 200 weapons and spells, and the Night of the Raven add-on is included.

Set in Europe around 1400, the player runs a commercial enterprise in a growing medieval town, choosing a trade, hiring and protecting workers, and guarding goods from bandits and rivals. Blackmail, kidnapping, and sabotage can raise political standing, and the business passes down through generations after the avatar dies.

Stranded between Heaven and Hell, players fight through over 30 levels of swarming hellish monsters with paired weapons and a morphing ability fueled by collected souls. The first-person shooter emphasizes relentless, fast-paced action against dozens of enemy types and giant bosses.

This collection bundles three fantasy titles in which players control a rune-bound hero-avatar across shattered lands connected by magic portals, mixing real-time strategy army command with role-playing character progression. Heroes grow in skill and strength while battling dark mages, necromancers, and a Prince of Darkness threatening the world of Eo.

Players lead a Shaikan hero bound to an ancient dragon, mixing roleplaying action with real-time strategy to unite heroes and armies against shadowy powers threatening the world of Eo. A long campaign spans three races per faction, with infantry, mounted and flying units and enormous titans in mass battles.

Pilot a submarine through a rendered underwater world of caverns, currents and glittering cities, completing 34 missions of violent individual and team combat against over 40 enemies and monsters, with LAN and internet deathmatch modes.

Set in the late Middle Ages, players found a dynasty and live out a merchant or thief's life in a real-time 3D world. They marry, make friends and rivals, build a party of up to three characters, and grow or lose power as their family's fortunes rise and fall.

A medieval life simulation in which players trade by sea, engage in naval battles, build harbours and outposts, and take on professions such as pirate or medicus across new maps and a campaign spanning over ten hours.

On Mars in 2044, a man named Chaser awakens aboard a spaceship with no memory of who he is, why men in black uniforms are hunting him, or what they will do if they find him. He becomes entangled in a twisting plot while fighting with authentic weapons and multiplayer modes.

Set in 14th-century Europe as trade empowers a rising middle class, players take on professions and build businesses amid the shift from feudal order to the Renaissance. New scenarios, goods, buildings, and an improved nobility system support economic and social competition.

Players explore a fully open fantasy world as a hero, fighting with an intuitive combat system featuring special moves and three basic attack types. They complete side quests solvable in multiple ways, gain experience to level up attributes and crafting skills, and follow a story set in the Gothic universe.

A fast-paced arena shooter where the player fights hordes of zombie mutants and bosses in close quarters, earning perks across modes like Barricade, Survival, and Free Play, playable solo or in local and online co-op.

Players command one of three factions in large-scale real-time strategy battles, building customizable armies of land, air and naval units plus experimental war machines. A research system unlocks technologies and units mid-battle, and three character-driven campaigns continue the story 25 years later.

Players forge their own path on the island of Faranga, choosing sword, staff, or mage combat while exploring a gritty fantasy open world filled with monsters, earthquakes, and treasures. Side quests and player actions alter the island's destiny across a lengthy adventure.

Command American, British, French and Soviet forces racing toward Berlin in 1944-45 real-time strategy battles, or play a German campaign in an alternate reality where futuristic prototypes reached mass production, managing over 100 units, weather, and detailed vehicle damage.

A point-and-click detective adventure that draws the player into a global conspiracy surrounding the Tunguska explosion, exploring detailed pre-rendered locations and interacting with characters to unravel the mystery.

Private detective Nina Kalenkow witnesses a murder in Hamburg and is drawn into a far-reaching conspiracy spanning continents and centuries. The player solves logical puzzles and follows the adventure through detailed pre-rendered backgrounds with animated 3D characters.

Players race off-road vehicles down near-vertical mountain tracks at extreme speed, steering mid-air to adjust jumps and angles. They assemble and tune custom vehicles from parts and compete across 14 tracks in four locations with a licensed soundtrack.

A third-person RPG set in a dark, gritty pirate-themed world where the hero, a member of the Inquisition, travels island locales to stop monstrous sea creatures, shaping the world through choices, skills, and a day/night cycle.

A little robot named Josef is thrown into the scrapyard outside the robot city of Machinarium and must puzzle his way back to rescue his girlfriend Berta from the Black Cap Brotherhood, exploring hand-drawn locations and solving logic puzzles and mini-games in a wordless, atmospheric adventure.

A space gnome's dog is kidnapped by mischievous aliens, so the player sets out on a short surreal expedition to rescue the pup, meeting curious strangers along the way while soothing music plays. The enhanced version adds full-screen graphics, a zoom feature, achievements, and a revamped save system.

Players control an animated cube of meat leaping across walls and past buzz saws through hundreds of brutally difficult platforming levels, haunted hospitals, and hell itself to rescue his bandage girlfriend from an evil fetus, with boss fights, warp zones, and unlockable characters.

Players guide the mischievous Winterbottom through over 80 puzzles in a silent, comical world, recording their own actions and using time-bending abilities to cooperate with, compete against, and disrupt past and future selves while chasing the Chronoberry Pie through space-time.

A castle simulation game where players design and build medieval fortresses with working economies, then besiege enemy castles in real-time warfare across 21 story missions or online matches, plus a combat-free economic campaign focused on gathering resources and producing weapons.

Players rule a medieval castle, managing peasants, punishing criminals, holding banquets, and building a war economy before laying siege to rival lords. Skirmishes and competitive online battles for up to eight players are supported, along with a map editor and Workshop sharing.

Players relive the Crusades as Richard the Lionheart or Saladin, building desert fortresses and commanding armies in real-time battles across historical campaigns and over a hundred skirmish missions, with siege engines, castle defenses, and new units.

A castle-building and siege strategy game set in a mythic medieval world, where the player commands King Arthur, Siegfried, or Vlad Dracula across story missions, raising castles, casting spells, and deploying legendary heroes and mythical beasts against AI or online opponents.

A remastered arcade first-person shooter in which players battle hordes of Mental's minions across ancient Egypt, wielding revolvers, miniguns, and cannons. The campaign spans fifteen levels of frantic action and supports up to sixteen players in online co-op.

A first-person action shooter throwback where the player holds down the trigger against endless waves of bizarre creatures across near-future Egypt. It offers a full arsenal, brutal melee kills, and co-op or versus multiplayer for up to sixteen players.

As one of Earth's last human survivors on a flooded archipelago, the player entertains pint-sized floating creatures called Buddies to restore gravity, using physics-driven sandbox gameplay to assemble vehicles and explore islands, underwater areas and interiors across changing seasons.

Gratuitous Space Battles is a sci-fi strategy game in which the player acts as a space admiral, designing individual ships and composing fleets, then issuing orders and formations before large auto-resolved space battles, with skirmish and survival modes and many hulls and modules to unlock.

Players control a selfish bard who summons magical characters through song to fight across a vast fantasy world of towns, forests, castles and dungeons, gathering loot and defeating bosses. The remastered action RPG includes the original trilogy and a comedic, self-aware tone.

A third-person team-based multiplayer shooter set in the violent Old West, where players pick one of four characters and fight fast gunfights in classic Western locations, with a synergy system that rewards cooperation and objective play.

A casual hidden-object mystery in which the player searches scenes for concealed clues to identify a prank bomber threatening a spa. Players combine clues, solve puzzles, and replay mini-games in an arcade mode to earn bonus points and unlock extra content.

Playing as Nancy Drew, players investigate a murder at a local high school in a first-person point-and-click adventure, exploring environments for clues, interrogating suspects, and solving puzzles and mini-games across two detective difficulty levels.

Players become Nancy Drew, going undercover as a storm chaser to investigate sabotage in a competition to predict tornado touchdowns. The mystery adventure involves studying clouds, reading Doppler data, surviving tornadoes, driving a truck, and playing arcade games to buy collectibles.

A first-person sci-fi action thriller in which the player fights enemies from the past and present using advanced weaponry and a Time Manipulation Device, traveling between 1950s Russia and the modern day to uncover a conspiracy behind a catastrophic event that fractured time.

A cinematic first-person shooter sequel following a global conflict in the world's darkest hour. Players fight through a campaign, compete in expanded multiplayer with new maps and modes, and take on co-op Spec-Ops missions and Survival Mode.

Players take on the role of an elite special forces soldier in a cinematic campaign of covert operations across global conflicts, while multiplayer modes offer customization, wager matches, combat training against AI, and a co-op zombie-slaying mode.

A grand strategy simulation spanning 1936-64 in which players lead any nation through World War II, managing economics, diplomacy, research, intelligence, and land, sea, and air warfare. Detailed production, logistics, trade, and espionage systems plus extensive modding support let players rewrite history across single-player and multiplayer scenarios.

Players manage a space-faring civilization after Earth is ravaged by aliens, researching technologies, designing ships, and expanding across star systems. The collection bundles the base game and three expansions, adding new races, weapons, and scenarios for single-player or multiplayer play.

In a satirical fantasy world based on Norse mythology, the player controls a wizard tasked with stopping an evil sorcerer. Combining elements to cast dynamic spells, they fight through campaign levels solo or with up to four players in co-op, plus wave-based challenge modes.

Guide a nation from the era of absolute monarchies through industrialization, political reform, military conquest, and colonization to become a great power by the dawn of the 20th century, managing populations, economies, and diplomacy in a grand historical simulation.

In 2171, a young engineer is drawn into a war between super nations after an orbital elevator is destroyed. Players pilot customizable wanzers in third-person shooter combat across cities and Antarctica, with online team deathmatches and overdrive battle skills.

Players manage their own zoo, customizing habitats and building hands-on relationships with over 40 animal species, creating new animals, and playing mini-games while learning facts from National Geographic cards.

A fast-paced third-person action horror game focused on multiplayer, where players liberate cursed places and survive assaults from the minions of Hell across eight environments with unique events, over 30 upgradeable weapons, and co-op survival plus humans-versus-demons modes.

As undercover detective Nancy Drew at an exclusive girls' boarding school, the player investigates threatening notes and dangerous accidents targeting valedictorian candidates by exploring environments, interrogating suspects, and solving puzzles and mini-games before the threats turn deadly.

The player runs a fantasy horse-breeding farm, raising legendary steeds like Pegasus and Unicorn, crafting horseshoes and potions, training and racing horses, decorating stables, and completing quests to recover lost magical crystals.

A turn-based strategy game blending Minesweeper-style exploration with empire building. Each level grants 85 turns to uncover cities, build roads, and research technology before barbarian hordes attack; surviving captures a Glyph of Power, and twelve glyphs win the game.

Players pilot fighters, attack aircraft and bombers through more than 50 missions recreating famous World War II aerial battles across six European theatres, with historically accurate aircraft, a detailed damage engine and difficulty ranging from arcade to realistic simulation.

As knight Fortix, the player must reclaim the land of Fortiana from dragons and evil forces by fencing off sections of the battlefield to corner enemies, collecting catapults and power-ups to besiege fortresses across 22 increasingly difficult levels in a family-friendly arcade strategy game.

As the knight Sir Fortix, the player conquers castles across the island of Artalom, dodging tower turrets and monsters through maze-like levels to defeat the evil mage Xitrof. It is described as a reverse turret defense game with thirty levels.

A zombie survival horror sequel set in Fortune City, where the player controls Chuck Greene, who must rescue his infected daughter and clear his name while surviving 72 hours by crafting combo weapons from everyday items and mowing down thousands of zombies, alone or in online co-op.

Ultra Street Fighter IV expands the fighting game with five new characters, six new stages, rebalanced gameplay and original modes, letting players battle through martial arts matches in a long-running competitive series.

Players control photojournalist Frank West through a reimagined Fortune City zombie outbreak, fighting psychos with combo weapons, exploring new areas like the Uranus Zone theme park, and photographing violent, dramatic or hilarious moments for Prestige Points. The tone is chaotic, gory and comedic.

A horror first-person shooter prequel set in World War I, where the player controls a German soldier who discovers evil forces unleashed by the war, fights zombies and demons across massive battles, and becomes the first Necromancer, using new weapons, vehicles, spells and close-combat fatalities.

Players command a fleet in a lawless galaxy, choosing missions freely, forming a team, and developing companions' skills across 110 star systems. A non-linear story with multiple endings lets tactical decisions shape the outcome of an intergalactic conflict.

Players command a party of freelance bounty hunters in a 3D space RPG set during a political crisis in the 21st-22nd century, upgrading ships and using team tactics in real-time battles against pirates, rogue AIs and empire patrols across non-linear missions.

FBI agent Victoria McPherson investigates a serial murder case in modern Chicago while reading her grandfather's old case file from 1920s Prague, uncovering eerie parallels between the two investigations as she examines crime scenes and solves puzzles woven into the storyline.

Lawyer Kate Walker and eccentric Hans Voralberg travel together toward a mystical Syberia in search of the last fabled mammoths. The player solves integrated puzzles and faces obstacles while uncovering the story's surreal, forgotten world.

Former New York detective Gus Macpherson returns to Paris to paint, but a woman hires him to investigate the gruesome beheadings of her sister and brother-in-law. Guided by a clairvoyant sixth sense, he uncovers a blood-soaked conspiracy of ancient rituals and artifacts.

Set in England in 1190, players take the role of Robin Hood and his Merry Men, battling Prince John's forces across a non-linear campaign of over thirty missions that mix robbery, infiltration, castle attacks and ambushes using stealth-based real-time tactics.

A grand strategy game set in the era leading up to and during World War II, letting players control any nation across over a thousand land and sea regions. Players develop cities, manage economies and resources, research weapons, conduct diplomacy and espionage, and command land, sea, and air forces to alter history.

After a luxury cruise ship wrecks on an uncharted Pacific island, survivors form separate camps. The player explores the island, gathers wood, fishes, finds hidden treasures, and builds alliances with castaways while collecting radio pieces to hoist atop the central volcano.

Players build and defend a castle while competing with thousands of other lords in a persistent feudal world, specializing through a research tree in farming, trade, diplomacy or warfare, joining factions and elections, and besieging rival players' strongholds across PC and mobile.

Isaac Clarke wakes on the Sprawl, a space station orbiting Saturn, plagued by visions of his dead girlfriend and a new outbreak of reanimated Necromorphs. He fights through the station using improvised tools, telekinesis, and zero-gravity movement to uncover the truth behind the chaos.

Players step into the boots of Tier 1 Operators in a single-player first-person shooter campaign set in present-day Afghanistan, using surgical special-forces tactics alongside Army Rangers to fight a new enemy in harsh, hostile conditions.

Players become a Grey Warden, one of the last guardians, chosen to unite a war-torn kingdom and slay the archdemon, exploring a fantasy world, making complex moral choices, and fighting massive creatures in bone-crushing combat.

The player creates a Sim by shaping appearance and personality, builds and decorates a home without grid limits, then guides the character through a career, romance and friendships while exploring the neighborhood. The tone is light and playful, framing life simulation as a creative sandbox for living out fantasies.

Command a German U-boat from a first-person periscope view, leading your crew through dynamic Atlantic and Mediterranean campaigns against the Allies, choosing strategies, managing the submarine, and reacting to enemy adjustments in a tense, realistic simulation.

An open-world action adventure in Renaissance Rome where Ezio leads and customizes an assassin brotherhood, deploys secret weapons and stealth assassinations against the Templar Order, and invests currency to revitalize the crumbling city, with a multiplayer mode included.

Set 400 years before Heroes V, players lead the Griffin dynasty through an epic campaign as a resurrected Archangel General plots against the Faceless and Demons. They explore large adventure maps, gather resources, build cities, recruit troops, and fight tactical turn-based battles while shaping choices through a reputation system.

Players build and manage futuristic island cities in 2070, engineering production chains, trading goods, and choosing between industrial Tycoons or sustainable Ecos while facing climate-changed seas. The tone is strategic economic management.

Players assemble a band of warriors in the war-torn medieval land of Calradia, leading them in mounted battles to expand their realm and claim the throne. A campaign lets them recruit lords, marry for romance or politics, and manage soldier morale, alongside multiplayer battles for up to 64 players.

A standalone expansion to Mount & Blade set in a historically researched 17th-century land where firearms join swords on the battlefield. Players build and outfit customizable armies, pursue three story-driven quest lines amid political intrigue, and fight sieges and multiplayer battles, with multiple endings encouraging replay.

In a fictional world shaped by industrial revolutions and environmental destruction, the player commands one of four factions in turn-based strategy matches, balancing resource harvesting against preserving land, collapsing terrain to defeat enemies across a campaign and multiplayer battles.

As Flo, the player helps Quinn renovate and run hotels across DinerTown, delivering luggage, room service, and towels to keep guests happy for tips, then spending those tips on upgrades and decorations while a mysterious troublemaker causes mishaps.

Players choose from four new classes and fight across the frozen tundra and varied environments of Pandora, seeking revenge against the Hyperion Corporation and its CEO Handsome Jack while collecting procedurally generated loot in online co-op.

Players join the US Colonial Marines as a squad of up to four, fighting through an eerie campaign against a Xeno infestation in environments inspired by the Aliens films. They use pulse rifles, motion trackers, and flamethrowers, earning experience for perks, weapons, and squad customization.

Beat Hazard is an intense music-driven arcade shooter where the player's own songs shape each level's ebb and flow, boosting spaceship firepower as the music builds. Players fight enemy ships and huge bosses, chase high scores, and can play local two-player co-op or head-to-head.

Players pilot a craft that cannot propel itself, using scattered objects in each level to gain thrust and reach the goal. Across a world map of distinct islands, they work to recover a lost love through over 50 increasingly difficult levels that blend racing with puzzle solving.

The player controls Bruce, who must stay alive and protect Daisy while fighting endless zombie hordes with bats, guns, chainsaws and explosives. Burning zombies move faster but boost score, and players chase high scores across arenas and modes.

War, the first Horseman of the Apocalypse, is accused of prematurely starting the end of the world and stripped of his powers. He returns to the ravaged Earth to find the truth, battling angels and demons with an arsenal of weapons and supernatural abilities while uncovering relics and upgrading his gear.

Players guide Professor Fizzwizzle through over 200 puzzle levels set around a mysterious volcano, using new gadgets to outwit Bat-Bots and defeat a cunning villain. Three difficulty settings, from kids to advanced, plus a level editor, let the whole family build problem-solving skills.

A hidden-object adventure in which the player races rival groups to the summit of Mount Everest, searching over thirty scenes around the world for hidden clues and playing character mini-games with guidance from climber Ed Viesturs.

As part of the Hidden Expedition Adventure League, players dive to the wreck of the Titanic across 14 missions and 17 locations, searching scenes for hundreds of hidden objects and playing mini-games to recover antique artifacts, culminating in the Crown Jewels.

A hidden-object mystery game where players search crime scenes and picture puzzles for thousands of hidden clues. Solving over fifteen crimes across more than twenty locations earns the rank of Master Detective, with item placement varying each playthrough.

A fortune teller foresees her own death at midnight, and the player investigates each quirky carnival worker to establish their whereabouts. Exploring the magical carnival, the player questions suspects with motives and solves brain-bending puzzles to uncover secrets hidden in the crystal ball.

The Queen's Hope Diamond has been stolen, and the player searches 22 levels and 29 illustrated locations for hidden clues to identify the culprit and recover the gem. Items and clues shift between visits, giving each investigation a fresh arrangement.

As Master Detective, the player searches the rooms of Ravenhearst Manor for hidden clues and assembles missing diary pages to uncover the story behind the unsettling estate. Dozens of puzzles and thousands of hidden objects fill 32 rooms.

Players explore the cursed Ravenhearst Manor room by room, solving puzzles and hunting for clues across more than 150 detailed scenes while following a ghost's warning about lingering evil. The hidden-object adventure carries a spooky, atmospheric tone with an original soundtrack and immersive first-person-style investigation.

A madcap Match 3 game in which players cure the ailing Mel by matching sets of medicines, using a scanner to diagnose his ailments and buying special remedies and power-ups. An untimed Relax Mode offers a slower pace.

Players match marble colors in sets of three to knock out doomsday devices across 100 levels, destroying static orbs so new chains keep filling the track, earning coins for upgrades and playing a mini-game between stages in an art deco puzzle adventure.

The player leads a fleet of orbital battleships through a randomly generated galaxy, fighting, trading, and exploring planets while installing upgrades and artifacts on ships. Combat uses full 3D movement to flank enemies, and a splitscreen co-op mode plus skirmish battles against friends or AI are included.

Players command mercenary forces during a zombie apocalypse, conducting rescue operations to evacuate civilians before the undead reach them. Using snipers, artillery, and orbital bombardments in destructible, randomly generated cities, they hire and upgrade units across tactical missions, with optional three-player co-op.

In a near-future occupied America, the player joins a resistance cell fighting a nuclear-armed Greater Korean Republic through a first-person shooter campaign using guerrilla tactics, vehicles, and drones. Multiplayer pits infantry, tanks, and helicopters against each other on large battlefields.

Fifty years after freeing Mars, humanity faces a new threat when the Terraformer is destroyed and colonists flee underground. Darius Mason accidentally releases a dormant evil, and players fight across the storm-blasted planet and beneath it to save mankind, with co-op and competitive modes.

Players race MX bikes and ATVs across rivers, swamps, and deserts, using dual controls to steer rider and vehicle independently while the terrain deforms with every lap. They also perform freestyle tricks for judges and customize vehicles.

As Captain Titus of the Ultramarines, players battle a massive Ork invasion of an Imperial Forge World using bolters, chainswords, and unlockable weapons, armor, and abilities. The Anniversary Edition bundles the original campaign, all DLC, and bonus materials, plus 8v8 online multiplayer.

Nyx flies across the ruins of ancient Greece searching for her friend Icarus, invoking the powers of Zeus and the gods to cast rays, command winds, and control fire. She fights the Hydra, surfs blazing sands, and solves physics-based environmental puzzles across 12 levels, with time trials and hidden relics.

Players guide a character through 100 twisted 3D puzzle structures, collecting sunflowers and reaching portals while manipulating gravity, ice, fire, teleporters, and spikes. The game emphasizes aha-moment puzzle solving with adaptive audiovisuals and online leaderboards, presented in a clean, abstract style.

Players guide Daniel, who wakes in a desolate castle with almost no memory, through narrow corridors and eerie pathways while piecing together his troubled past. With no means of fighting back, survival depends on hiding, running, or using wits against a threat that draws ever closer.

As a merchant in late medieval northern Europe, the player trades goods, builds production and fleets, and rises through the Hanseatic League toward election as Elderman. Economic rivalry, price wars, sabotage, piracy and sea battles complicate the climb to power.

Players take the role of an evil Dungeon Lord who digs corridors and rooms with goblin workers, lures heroes with treasure and fights, then harvests their soul energy in prisons or torture chambers while fending off rival Dungeon Lords and a demanding boss.

Set in the 13th century, players control a French Templar and a noble lady branded a heretic as they uncover Templar mysteries, a grand conspiracy and the secret of the Holy Grail, fighting enemies across historically recreated European locations with combo-based action and RPG-style skill trees.

As El Presidente, players govern a Caribbean island nation in a changing world, running a 20-mission campaign across new maps. They manage the economy through trade, build new structures, respond to disasters, appoint ministers, and balance factions and foreign powers to keep public support and personal wealth.

Players command mercenary and rebel forces to free the island nation of Arulco from a ruthless dictator, mixing turn-based tactical combat with real-time elements, resource management, diplomacy and RPG-style character advancement.

Players step into the boots of Duke Nukem to fight off an alien invasion stealing Earth's women, blasting through waves of enemies with over-the-top weapons, driving vehicles, solving puzzles, and engaging in multiplayer modes while delivering constant one-liners.

A young sausage-dog named Gaius James Rover, son of a famous clown, sails across three Caribbean islands to fulfill his dream of starting a circus, hindered by pirates, villains, voodoo, and love. The game is a traditional 2D point-and-click adventure with a one-click interface and an integrated hint system.

Lucas MacGuffin, a magician turned thief turned werewolf, sneaks and smashes through a city in lockdown, switching between human and wolf forms to solve puzzles, lift his curse, and clear his name in a comedic hand-drawn adventure.

Players help Brian and Gina solve mysteries across nearly a hundred detailed visual sets, working through over 200 puzzles in a comedic, twist-filled adventure. The story follows Gina's search for the missing Brian, with humor, suspense, and multiple endings, plus adjustable difficulty and an interactive help system.
