Players guide journalist Liz and macho Dan through a comedic Hollywood adventure where movie monsters rebel against their roles, solving wacky puzzles and mysteries across genre-themed film settings. The game offers animated-movie presentation, colorful characters and a humorous tone.

A real-time strategy game set in 1980s Europe during a Cold War turning into World War III. Players command over 350 vehicle and infantry units across large maps in a military campaign, with online multiplayer supporting up to eight players in massive battles.

Players guide Glowfish, a small sea creature, through underwater platform levels to rescue Coralline and other captive sea friends from Dr. Urchin. Gathering allies forms a circle to free friends or fire bubble attacks at enemies, while collecting coins upgrades Super Chums for boss battles.

A music puzzler where players push, combo, and chain hexagons through a pulsing technicolor dreamscape at 130 BPM, with an audio engine composing music based on play. Three modes—Campaign, Puzzle, and Arcade—offer distinct challenges amid particle effects and evolving soundtracks.

Players build a fantasy empire across 12 races, commanding troops in turn-based tactical battles, capturing locations, sieging cities and exploring dungeons. Heroes gain upgradable abilities, alliances can be forged, and a campaign can be played from the light or dark side, with multiplayer options.

Join an immortal circle of wizards and restore balance to a collapsing fantasy world. Build forces from twelve races, command over 130 units and champion heroes, research spells across seven magic spheres, and conquer rivals in turn-based strategy campaigns or multiplayer.

A fantasy strategy game where players build an empire, use diplomacy, and lay siege to enemy cities with tactical and magical forces. It adds the eerie Shadow World, three new races, a five-episode campaign, a map generator and a scenario editor.
A calm, meditative puzzle game in which the player paints wooden sculptures by wrapping them in rope, solving spatial puzzles across over a hundred levels with paint bombs and a gentle soundtrack.

An arcade-style puzzle game starring Biggs, who uses his sticky tongue to grab critters and feed them to each other in chains until they burst, dropping jewels to eat. Includes single-player modes and co-op or versus multiplayer, online or local.

As an air traffic controller at an increasingly busy airport, the player points and drags a never-ending stream of aircraft to their landing zones, trying to keep the chaos under control across nine maps of varying difficulty, including a Steam-exclusive stunt map with gates to fly through.
Players rotate and place shapes against the clock to form solid quads and fill the grid, remixing and embellishing music tracks by various artists as they complete levels and chase high scores.

Players control a dragon in a fantasy kingdom, raiding villages, burning castles, kidnapping princesses and fighting knights and thieves to build the largest treasure hoard, with upgrades and multiplayer competition or cooperation across many kingdoms.

Players fight in a futuristic lethal gameshow sport, either defending a Money Ball against robot waves in co-op Blitz or battling rival teams in Crossfire, upgrading classes and spending earnings on turrets, custom classes, and cosmetic tags.

A side-scrolling strategy game where the player commands the Vikings, Aztecs, or Chinese in a global quest for the gods' favor, controlling an entire army, casting magical abilities, and demolishing enemy castles across 2D battlefields in campaigns, skirmishes, and multiplayer matches.

The player explores a deceptively beautiful world of dense jungles, caverns, and monolithic structures, solving devious puzzles and seeking secretive characters to uncover the truth about a troubled land and its inhabitants.

Players are an Osmo exploring the galaxy in a spaceship, visiting seven bizarre and goofy planets. The game focuses on exploration and discovery rather than winning or challenges, offering something for both children and adults.

A point-and-click adventure through the whimsical World of the Manhole, where the player follows Mr. Rabbit and his animal friends through doorways into dreamlike locales, meeting characters and exploring bright magical places in a journey aimed at children and all ages.

An educational exploration game in which Professor Spelunx and Mr. Seudo study Planet X, a cave world filled with toys, mini-games and activities that quietly teach principles of math, biology and physics to younger players.

The player explores surreal 3D worlds and the lost D'ni civilization, following Yeesha, solving puzzles, and uncovering historical and cultural lore across the base adventure and two expansions in this first-person Myst-style adventure.

Players are transported to the surreal island of Myst by an old book and must explore, solve puzzles and uncover an ancient betrayal through secret linking books to other worlds. The point-and-click adventure emphasizes wits and imagination over combat.

A rhythm-based arcade game in which players juggle beats and ride the vibe through brain-melting visuals, boss battles, and cutscenes, following CommanderVideo's journey. The Steam version adds an easy mode, leaderboards, achievements, and motion controls, backed by a chiptune-inspired soundtrack.

A retro-inspired rhythm platformer where the player runs automatically through pixel-art stages, jumping and dodging obstacles in time with the music, with simple controls that are easy to learn but demand timing and skill to master.

In a fantasy world of human kingdoms, orc clans, dwarven citadels and elven forests, the player commands armies across three story-connected campaigns, laying siege to castles, upgrading units, and using terrain and troop cooperation to win epic turn-based battles.

Players command armies through the Armored Princess campaign and two arena-focused mini-campaigns, exploring in real time and fighting deep turn-based tactical battles while building heroes, recruiting companions, and experimenting with army compositions and a world editor.

A real-time tactics game set in the jungles of Southeast Asia in 1968, telling the Vietnam War through U.S. Special Forces and North Vietnamese campaigns. Players command squads through stealth, rescues, ambushes, and defenses, using era weapons and vehicles, with four-player co-op.

A tactical strategy game recreating the Korean War of the 1950s through North Korean and American campaigns. Players move forces across the peninsula, managing reserves, fuel and ammunition, while tactical battles are generated from the strategic situation.

A tactical World War II real-time strategy game where players command five factions across European and Pacific theaters, managing squads, vehicles, and artillery. A Direct Control feature lets players personally operate any unit, with destructible environments and deep simulation of ammo, fuel, armor, and morale.

An old-school point-and-click adventure set in an alternate 19th century where humanity has already conquered space travel, following Kaptain Brawe and two other playable characters across four colorful planets as they uncover a conspiracy and track down kidnapped alien scientists.

Play as an acrobatic janitor who leaps and dashes off walls and ceilings to clean dust and disorder across over 75 levels of a 2D platformer, ranging from exploration to hardcore challenges, with online leaderboards, local multiplayer, and a level editor for sharing community-made worlds.

Players command teams of fantasy creatures on a chess-like board, teleporting into real-time combat arenas to fight for contested squares. Victory comes from defeating all enemy pieces or claiming the Power Squares, with free-for-all and team modes for up to four players plus a single-player campaign.

Thrown into a magical-barrier prison colony where inmates mine ore and rival factions vie for power, players must survive, form volatile alliances and grow strong enough to escape, exploring a living world with weapons, spells and over 50 hours of RPG gameplay.

A standalone add-on to the Gothic series in which the nameless hero returns to Myrtana to unite orcs and humans into a new empire, exploring a lively open environment, fighting monsters with an improved combat system and completing new quests.

Players take the role of a civilian helicopter pilot helping the Larkin family's struggling aviation business survive by taking on contracts and competitors, flying detailed helicopters across large open terrains based on Seattle and South Asia with authentic flight dynamics and a mission editor.

A tactical military shooter with realistic simulation elements, following a campaign across large-scale battlefields where players command a squad, use modern weapons and vehicles, and fight smart enemies on land, in the air, and over water.

A remastered version of a 2001 military combat simulation, set during a fictional Cold War conflict over the Malden Islands. Players fight through campaigns using an arsenal of weapons and vehicles, now with a modernized 64-bit engine, controller support, mod tools, and updated multiplayer.

Players choose from four hero classes to defend the land of Etheria against waves of enemies, summoning towers and fighting directly in action-RPG combat, while leveling characters, forging loot and teaming up in four-player co-op or PvP deathmatch.

Players lead an expedition colonizing an alien planet after Earth's society collapses, exploring terrain, researching technologies through a nonlinear tech web, building cities and Wonders, customizing units and competing with up to eight players for dominance of the new world.

Players control Jackie Estacado, head of a New York crime family and wielder of a supernatural force called The Darkness, in a first-person shooter. After a mysterious organization attacks, he fights through a war while confronting memories of his girlfriend's death, using demon arms and shadow-based powers in a dark graphic-noir world.

A frantic multiplayer shooter set in an alternate 1942 where Hitler has resurrected dinosaurs; players join the Allies or Nazis online, choosing human or dinosaur classes with distinct weapons and abilities, from rifle infantry to raptors, dilophosaurs and a playable T-Rex.

A minimalist platformer where Captain Viridian flips gravity instead of jumping to rescue teleported crewmates across an open, non-gated map, with frequent checkpoints, chiptune music, time trials and a level editor.

As Recette, a girl left with her father's debt, the player runs an item shop: buying and pricing stock, decorating the store, and diving into randomized dungeons with adventurers to gather loot, all to repay a demanding fairy before the loan comes due.

Five years after a witch's curse turned Chante into a fairy, she and her sister Elise search for a way to restore her, exploring ruins and dungeons near a strange town. The player fights through classically styled action-RPG areas, faces inventive bosses, and fishes for collectible catches.

Players command teams of worms in destructive turn-based cartoon battles across fully destructible 3D environments. They fight through over seventy single-player missions and challenges, use classic weapons, customize their worms, and compete in online or local multiplayer for up to four players.

Players tee off in a cartoon golf game starring Worms characters, navigating puzzle-like holes with interactive objects, utilities and ball spin. A singleplayer career spans three 18-hole courses plus challenge mode, and up to four players can compete hot-seat while customizing their worm's appearance.

The player commands an interstellar empire in a procedurally generated galaxy, expanding from one system to thousands while researching technology, designing ships, and fighting intricate battles where any component or star can be targeted. Diplomacy, trade, exploitation of cosmic phenomena, and multiplayer matches against up to ten opponents round out the strategy.

Sonic and five friends race to stop Dr. Eggman from using the seven Chaos Emeralds to unleash an ancient monster, each hero following their own adventure. Players also raise and breed pet Chao in a garden minigame and pit them against others.

A mysterious power creates time holes that send Sonic and his friends back through time, where he meets his younger self. Players control both Classic and Modern Sonic through reimagined HD stages, mastering each one's moves and racing tracks while battling notorious bosses and rivals to save their friends.

A management simulation where the player oversees public transportation in Vienna, Helsinki, Berlin, and Amsterdam from 1920 to 2020. Players build routes with buses, trams, and subways, balance profits against commuter satisfaction, and can create custom cities in a sandbox mode.

Players command nations through grand and battle scenarios spanning the darkest chapters of the 20th century, from the Great War to the onset of the Cold War, using a dynamic diplomatic system and a new AI that reacts to hundreds of situations on a redesigned strategic map.

A turn-based grand strategy game set in the 19th-century colonial era, where the player guides one of eight Great Powers from 1850 to 1920 through industrialization, diplomacy, colonization and military conquest on a global map, with detailed economy, army and fleet systems and multiplayer.

Players match gems across eight modes, from relaxed Classic cascades and a customizable Zen retreat to timed Lightning rounds and forty Quest puzzles, earning badges while smooth cascades and new gems keep the board sparkling.

A global strategy game spanning 2020 to 2200 in which the player balances Earth's resources and climate against the demands of a growing population. It offers scenarios, policies, technologies and events across twelve regions, with a scientific climate model.

Tiny robots at Dr. Hugo's factory sneak out to open a mysterious buried box, then work as a team to solve puzzles across 17 levels, outwitting children, animals, and absent-minded inventors while uncovering a diabolical plot.

Gemini Rue is a point-and-click adventure following an ex-assassin on a rain-soaked planet and an amnesiac man trying to escape a hospital, whose paths converge in a sci-fi mystery about bought identities and redemption, told through hand-drawn backgrounds and an investigation system.

A farming simulation where the player runs a new farm through 18-hour days, choosing vehicles and machinery, breeding and feeding cows, milking, plowing, seeding and baling to build wealth for better equipment, with career mode and multiplayer farm management.

As one of four detectives, players explore the village of Little Riddle by selecting map locations, interview villagers, and solve over 90 puzzles and cross-examinations to identify a murderer across six episodic mysteries, alone or in co-op.

Pilot modern planes turned into racing machines through scenic canyons, islands, and mountains, using power-ups and combat to overtake or shoot down rivals. Race solo or with up to eight players across three modes.

In a near-future Earth invaded by aliens, the player commands an armor squad through city streets, planning routes and choosing units to destroy enemy turrets in a reversed tower defense mixing action and strategy across a story campaign and assault modes.

As a member of the secret society E.Y.E, players are caught between rival factions and political conspiracies while an unknown force threatens humanity. The first-person shooter offers 25 weapons, hacking, PSI powers, reactive AI, and co-op modes that influence solo play.

As Clyde or his clones, the player escapes the Dupliclone, Inc. building by working through simulated environments, avoiding traps and mutant clones. Combining clones with co-inhabitants creates mutant forms like Chicken-Clyde with special abilities, used to solve puzzles across 40 levels.

A comedic platformer set in the primeval land of Ooga, where the player befriends seven zany tribes, uncovers their ancient abilities, and leads a revolt against the tyrannical Boolis. Gameplay mixes classic platforming and puzzle solving with an eat, carry, and puke inventory system.

Players race and battle heavily modified vehicles through apocalyptic tracks, using special front, side and rear abilities to destroy rival cars, competing in single-player or online multiplayer races for speed and carnage.

On a floating city at sea in 2051, systems engineer Kate fights back against terrorists who have seized the vessel, using water-based powers and environmental hazards. The action-adventure mixes combat, puzzles, and platforming as she confronts her childhood memories and the Malthusian prophecy.

Players defend Earth bases across the solar system from invading Titans by building turrets, barricades and mines while mining resources to fund defenses. Researching technologies and structures drives a real-time strategy and tower defense campaign, with endless and survival modes.

Players blast through a neo-classical top-down shooter set on 17th-century British Colonial Mars, fighting as a team of up to four in local co-op where any surviving player can revive fallen teammates, with bonus levels and arcade modes.

A point-and-click adventure about entering other people's dreams, following Victor Neff as he settles into a new apartment, uncovers strange secrets among his neighbors, and confronts an elusive landlord, all rendered in hand-built clay and cardboard environments.

A fast-paced fencing tug-of-war for two players, where combatants use lunges, parries, and dirty tricks to gain ground and run toward their goal zone. Arenas feature chokepoints and strategic formations, and matches are decided by a series of kills rather than a single one.

An FBI agent from the Department of Puzzle Research goes rogue to return to an eerie Minnesota town and solve the mystery of the Hidden People, working through a variety of challenging puzzles in a creepy adventure with dark humor.

A comedic point-and-click adventure starring Detective Inspector Hector, a violent, drunken lawman in the grim British town of Clappers Wreake. Across three episodes he negotiates with terrorists, hunts a psychopath, and tries to save his town from extinction.

A space traveler crash-lands on a mysterious alien planet and must navigate hostile terrain, fight bloodthirsty creatures, and rescue crewmates to escape. The fast-paced 2D platformer mixes shooting, jetpack flight, gravity-hook physics, and puzzle solving across non-linear environments and arcade modes.
Two players cooperate to guide ibb and obb through a puzzle-filled world where gravity pulls both up and down, solving double-gravity challenges across levels and hidden worlds.

An arcade flight simulation set across World War I and II, where the player flies over 49 missions in seven campaigns, choosing aircraft, completing objectives like bombing and escorting, upgrading skills, and fighting in local or online multiplayer.

After a meteor shatters Tiny Planet, players restore the world and help its inhabitants by fixing machines and solving puzzles across five chapters. The hand-drawn, text-free point-and-click adventure offers over thirty brain teasers and simple navigation suitable for the whole family.

An open-world sandbox set in an infinite abstract universe where the player is a celestial object rather than a character. They grow their system, nurture life on planets, crash into other bodies, steal planets, and complete bizarre tasks for a god-like figure, or simply drift and expand freely.

An immortal Kohan reawakens into a fantasy world devastated by cataclysms and must rebuild their race's former glory while uncovering the mystery of its destruction. This real-time strategy game offers a full campaign, up to eight-player multiplayer across four factions, over 40 units, magical spells, and a map editor.

A real-time strategy prequel set in the fantasy world of Khaldun, where the player commands armies of Shadowbeasts and Undead through campaigns and custom maps, controlling heroes, spells, and technologies to ravage enemies across many game types.

Set in the fantasy world of Khaldun, players command armies of six warring races and five factions in real-time strategy battles amid civil war and a gathering ancient evil. A campaign, random map generator, and online matches for up to eight generals are included.

Frozen Synapse is a simultaneous turn-based tactical game in which the player issues detailed orders to a small squad, tests the plan, then primes it so both sides' turns execute at once. A near-future campaign and competitive multiplayer modes are backed by procedurally mixed maps.

Commanding antique WWI toy soldiers across trench-filled European dioramas, the player deploys tanks, cavalry, biplanes and flamethrowers, positioning defenses and taking direct control of units or the whole battlefield in an action-packed strategy game with included DLC campaigns.

Major Fletcher, an army veteran in the last human city of Bezoar, is drawn into a conflict between two of mankind's greatest enemies and discovers nothing is as it seems, fighting hordes of enemies and bosses in a fast-paced old-school single-player shooter with weapon upgrades in a cyberpunk setting.

A classic roguelike in which the player descends into randomly generated dungeons to stop the Dark Lord Dredmor, choosing skills to build a character, crafting bizarre items, deploying traps and fighting hand-animated monsters, with frequent deaths expected.

An action shooter in which players must defeat the madman Inferno and his forces across varied environments using a range of vehicles, fighting alone, in two-player split-screen, or in four-player online co-op while leveling characters and competing for leaderboard rankings.

Players maneuver a sphere through picturesque 2D worlds using realistic physics, solving cerebral puzzles across eleven massive levels. Multiple difficulties, vehicles with distinct dynamics, secrets, and an ambient jazz soundtrack heighten the surreal exploration experience.

Stranded on an alien world, the Spiral Knights explore the ever-changing Clockworks beneath the surface, fighting monsters, solving puzzles, and seeking treasure with friends in fast-paced cooperative action. Players gather weapons and gear, alchemize an arsenal, and form guilds while working toward the mysterious Core.

Players live as pirates in a persistent online world where sailing, gunning, swordfighting, and trading are all resolved through over 20 puzzles and mini-games, letting them build ships, run shops, hunt sea monsters, and rise to govern an island.

An abstract real-time strategy game with mathematical puzzle elements, set on a geometric surface. Players move around, claim territory, capture solid faces for defense, and manipulate vertex colors to power special abilities, balancing attack, defense, expansion, and coloring to defeat enemies across campaign, puzzle, and multiplayer modes.

As a War Mage, the player defends fortresses from waves of orcs and other beasts using weapons, elemental spells, and deadly traps placed throughout twisting passages and towers. A story campaign spans multiple difficulty levels, with persistent trap upgrades and leaderboard scoring.

A retired Gatling Gear pilot and his niece fight the resource-hungry Empire across six environments, blasting hordes of enemies and oversized bosses with twin-stick shooting. The campaign supports co-op play, and a Survival Mode challenges players against endless waves.

A 2D brawler where the player fights hordes of goons and bosses using a redesigned multi-weapon combat system with combos and counter moves. It also offers an arcade-style co-op survival mode, interactive environments with destructible objects, and unlockables to discover.

A puzzle-platformer starring Ms. Splosion Man, who explodes her way through fifty single-player levels and a separate fifty-level co-op campaign. The game adds expanded map features, unlockables, and ghost replays as players blast through a chaotic science-facility setting.

Players dig, fight, explore, and build in randomly generated worlds, gathering materials to craft gear and machinery while battling foes. They can also construct towns for mysterious allies, blending action combat with open-ended sandbox creativity where the player sets their own goals.

Players swing, climb, and jump through vibrant organic gardens as a tiny Grimp, growing plants and destroying pollen enemies while hunting hidden Spectra, with each garden offering unique puzzles, hazards, and challenges.

Players explore over forty hand-painted environments as a hero uncovering the secrets of the Calamity, a surreal catastrophe that shattered the world. Wielding upgradeable weapons against savage beasts, combat rewards finesse while a reactive narrator comments on every action.

Dem the Skeleton Knight and his undead companions explore a world of the dead seeking secrets of the past in this retro parody RPG. Players fight fast-paced turn-based battles, customize branching characters with frequent level-ups, and use unite techniques and combo breaks.

Players deploy into large open military worlds with realistic ballistics, driving tanks, flying jets, and commanding squads across single-player campaigns and multiplayer scenarios, customizing loadouts in a detailed combined-arms sandbox.

As inventor Arkwright, the player brings liquid machines to life and must stop the chaos they cause. Gameplay centers on physics-based puzzles solved by combining simulated liquids with creatures made of them, across detailed mechanical worlds, while upgrading equipment with protoplasm.

Survivors loot houses, build defences and delay inevitable death in a zombie-infested open sandbox loosely based on Kentucky. Players explore a vast map, craft weapons, farm, fish and manage hunger, illness and boredom while evading relentless hordes, alone or in multiplayer.

A best-selling writer's wife vanishes on vacation, and his search uncovers pages of a thriller he doesn't remember writing while a Dark Presence stalks the town of Bright Falls. Players fight the darkness with light-based combat through a TV-series-style psychological thriller narrative.

Players fight an alien invasion in a ruined New York City, using the Nanosuit's stealth, armor and power abilities to survive real-time combat. The Maximum Edition adds multiplayer maps, weapons and class unlocks to the urban sci-fi campaign.

A free-to-play online action RPG set in the Dungeons & Dragons Forgotten Realms, where players create adventurers to defend the city of Neverwinter from the Lich Queen Valindra's army of darkness, exploring iconic locations and battling enemies solo or with friends.

As LAPD detective Cole Phelps in 1947 Los Angeles, the player investigates arson, racketeering and murder cases, interrogating suspects and reading facial performances to uncover corruption reaching his own department. The tone is dark and atmospheric, evoking a corrupt post-war city where everyone hides something.

A physics-driven game where players guide a truck through levels, earning medals for successful runs and rewards for different play styles. It features hand-painted cartoon art, leaderboards, and silly achievements encouraging repeated attempts to beat best times.

A 2D side-scrolling shooter starring Serious Sam, who stacks multiple weapons together and fires them all at once against bizarre hordes. Players fight through 18 levels across three worlds, battle bosses, clear challenge rooms, and hunt for hidden secrets.

Players control Tetrobot, a tiny robot that drills and collects blocks of matter and recycles them into tetromino pieces, combining platforming and puzzle-solving across 40 adventure levels plus bonus stages. Different materials behave uniquely, and an editor lets players build and share their own puzzles.

Players join a secretive order of spies and assassins as a Hand of Avadon, forming a party of warriors, exploring dungeons, hunting treasure, and unraveling a conspiracy threatening the homeland, with choices leading to multiple endings in a fantasy role-playing saga.

Players assemble a team of specialized thieves and pull off heists in a top-down stealth game, either solo or with up to four players online or locally, competing on daily leaderboards while casing joints and evading security.

Choose to be a Criminal or Enforcer in the urban warzone of San Paro, battling the opposing faction in massive open-world PVP districts. Customize characters, weapons, and vehicles extensively while completing missions and progressing through faction ranks in this third-person action MMO shooter.

In a charming Halloween role-playing adventure, players choose a hero and trick-or-treat through three environments, completing quests and collecting costumes that transform them into powerful champions to defeat the evil Repugians. The included DLC adds new enemies, quests, and costumes.

Playing as Charlie Blackmore, the world's tiniest Russian stacking doll, the player jumps into over a hundred unique dolls to use their abilities to solve puzzles and rescue Charlie's family from the industrialist Baron, traveling from a royal train station to a zeppelin.

Players join the Mobile Trench Brigade to defend humanity from the Monovision menace, combining mobile firepower with stationary defenses in tower defense shooter combat across Europe, Africa and the Pacific, customizing trenches with thousands of loadouts and unlocking loot in an added Martian campaign.

A historical real-time strategy game where the player commands 19th-century armies of Napoleon, Russia, Austria, Britain, Prussia or Egypt across Europe. Players fight large battles, manage troop morale and supplies, and use treaties, treachery and economic pressure alongside combat.

Starting with Columbus's 1492 landing, the player commands twelve nations and tribes through eight historical campaigns and 42 missions, waging real-time battles of up to 16,000 soldiers while managing technology, diplomacy, morale, and fortifications across the Americas.

A real-time strategy game covering three centuries of conflict across the Americas from 1517 to 1804, with campaigns for Spain, Germany, Russia and others. Players command up to 16,000 units with formations, morale and supplies, plus a new battlefield mode for tactical duels.

As infected soldier Sgt James Heller, players cut a bloody swathe through post-viral New York Zero, building genetic weapons and shapeshifting powers while hunting and consuming enemies. Disguising as soldiers and scientists to absorb memories, Heller pursues his ultimate goal of killing Alex Mercer in an open-world action game.

Play as a mute owl who flies through cloud-filled skies, carrying friends as gunners to fight enemies while exploring monster-infested ruins, solving obstacles, and battling challenging bosses in a story-driven pixel-art adventure.

Players control a small fish in the abyssal ocean, drawing lines to claim territory and destroy monsters while avoiding any enemy touch that kills instantly. The arcade game offers 45 levels, ten enemy types, two modes, and score challenges encouraging replay.

A young boy uses his uncle's Interdimensional Shift Device to switch between dimensions in real time, altering object weight and gravity to solve puzzles across a strange mansion and rescue his missing uncle after an explosion.

Players take the role of detective Nancy Drew investigating ghostly accidents at a traditional Japanese inn, exploring dark hallways and onsen baths while learning about origami, tea ceremonies, and calligraphy. The tone is suspenseful horror, with a mystery that may involve a vengeful yurei or human sorrow and jealousy.

The player commands teams of customizable worms in turn-based artillery battles across destructible 3D landscapes, choosing among four classes and using dynamic water, physics objects, and new weapons. It offers campaign and puzzle missions plus local and online multiplayer for up to four players.

Players become Batman in the sprawling walled district of Arkham City, gliding and fighting through gangs and a rogues gallery of Gotham's criminals to deliver justice. The edition adds extra playable characters, challenge maps and skins.

As commander of the secret paramilitary organization XCOM, the player defends Earth against a global alien invasion by managing resources, researching technologies, building a base, and directing soldiers in turn-based tactical ground battles across dozens of missions worldwide.

Players choose from four classes and fight through a randomly laid-out overworld of Vilderan, battling monsters for loot and leveling up, with co-op multiplayer, pets, fishing, mod support, and a New Game Plus mode. The tone is lighthearted dungeon-crawling adventure.

An action-adventure where an amnesiac boy wakes in a dark cave and must run, jump, shoot and explore Mimiga Island, battling bosses and a maniacal scientist to save the rabbit-like Mimigas, with multiple weapons, upgrades and four endings.

Players join Ky as he climbs a mysterious tower guided by a girl named Naia, fighting monsters and meeting strange characters. The game blends rhythm-based combat with role-playing elements, featuring item synthesis, spell customization, and a fully voice-acted story mode with original music.

An indie fantasy RPG where players create and command an army of obedient creatures while navigating a huge open storyline. Choices let players join or fight the overlord, help or torment peasants, and shape how the story unfolds, with enemy AI that patrols and stalks.

Players build decks of runes and battle opponents in turn-based tactical matches, either against other players, AI skirmishes, or single-player campaigns. Collecting and trading runes across eight factions drives deck customization and progression in a free-to-play collectible strategy game.

The player creates a hero from 21 races and 26 classes and adventures across the fantasy world of Norrath, questing through handcrafted zones, dungeons and raids. Alongside combat and character progression, players master tradeskills, build and decorate housing, join guilds, and take part in an ongoing community with regular expansions.

Players guide a young chicken across a lush forest island to find five Ancient Frogs and destroy a floating crystal. Using only whistle and stomp moves, they solve increasingly complex puzzles, observe and manipulate critters, and explore freely in a cute but challenging puzzle adventure.

Orcs Must Die! 2 is a strategy action game where the player, as a War Mage or Sorceress, defends fortresses and dwarven mines by laying traps, weapons, and guardians against waves of orcs and monsters, playable solo or in co-op with new Endless Mode.

Set in an alternate 1960s ruled by a twisted Nazi regime, players take on first-person combat against robots, Super Soldiers, and shock troops. They storm fortresses, explore underwater, break into secret facilities, and upgrade weapons while following a story-driven narrative with memorable characters.

Master assassin Ezio Auditore travels to Constantinople in the Ottoman Empire, following the footsteps of his mentor Altair in search of answers. He uses new weapons, bomb crafting, and enhanced free-running to eliminate Templars threatening the region while uncovering mysteries within the Animus.

Players blast through a non-linear galaxy of varied shooter levels, using skill to alter routes, uncover new stages and enemies, unlock challenge levels, and fight bosses toward multiple endings. The tone is colorful, upbeat, and arcade-like, with combo medals and online scores.
A 2D side-scrolling platformer in which Sonic races through stages using the Spin Dash and Homing Attack to defeat Dr. Eggman's rebuilt creations, continuing the classic saga for old and new fans.

Nancy Drew returns to her hometown of River Heights to investigate an arson and clear her name. Players switch between Nancy, Bess, George and Ned, gather evidence, question suspects whose answers vary by character, and identify fingerprints at the police lab, with Junior and Senior difficulty options.

A strategy wargame set in ancient Greece where players campaign across a satellite-accurate map, managing supply lines, sieges, and diplomacy. Players lead Macedonia, Athens, or Sparta through historical campaigns or pick from 26 factions in sandbox mode to forge an empire.

Fight to stop a murderous evil double and change reality itself in a story mode, then survive until dawn in an arcade mode using the Fight with Light mechanic. Twisted enemies stalk the shadows and must be dispatched with an arsenal of weapons.
As Agent 47, players stalk targets through a cinematic world, choosing to fight head-on or adapt, stealing disguises and using Instinct Mode to predict enemy movement and line up precise kills.

Players follow Lara Croft's gritty origin story as she fights to survive a hostile, forgotten island, exploring environmental puzzles and tombs while salvaging resources to upgrade weapons and tools. Combat and discovery drive her transformation from a young woman into a hardened survivor, with multiplayer modes included.

As the last surviving tank commander on Earth, the player fights off an alien invasion across five worlds and 100 levels, battling swarms of fighters, bombers and giant boss motherships. Bounty money buys ship upgrades like cannons, rockets and lasers, with challenge stages and online high scores.

Players lead Olaf, a Viking warrior, against an undead invasion across the frozen northern lands of Endoria. They explore a large hand-crafted world in real time and fight deep turn-based tactical battles, using Rune Magic, Valkyrie companions and Viking units.

Players take the role of a great mage building an empire in the fantasy land of Ardania, researching spells, commanding armies, managing cities, and conquering rivals through military, diplomatic, or magical means in turn-based strategy. The collection adds expansions featuring new mages, gods, and an end-times mode against the Dremer.

Sonic and Tails race across four new zones to stop Metal Sonic and Dr. Eggman, using combination moves against new badniks. The side-scrolling platformer features updated physics, HD graphics and online or local co-op, plus a bonus Episode Metal zone for owners of both episodes.

In 2080, Dan Marshall and his squad are sent into a futuristic Tokyo to stop a robotic community infiltrating society, fighting destructible robots in squad-based shooting while choices and words carry consequences and weapons and skills can be upgraded.

Playing a Christian lord between 1066 and 1337, the player expands a feudal domain, appoints vassals, roots out traitors and heretics, contends with the Pope, and guides a dynasty through successive generations. The grand strategy experience depicts medieval Europe as an epic game of knights, schemes and thrones.

A young bird catcher in the superstitious kingdom of Andergast is tasked by the king with dealing with an aggressive plague of crows, a job that becomes the first step of an epic fantasy adventure across Aventuria.

An old-school side-scrolling arcade shooter set in 2051 on the abandoned planet SATAZIUS, where the crew of the Trafalgar charges a space pirate base. Players shoot through stages with 13 upgradeable weapons, power-ups, and giant bosses.

Players grow a hero from adolescence into legend in a fantasy realm, with every action shaping skills, appearance, and reputation along paths of good or evil, engaging in real-time combat with blades, stealth, and arcane arts while exploring an evolving world.

An exploratory action adventure with a strong audiovisual emphasis, following a wandering warrior monk through a mythic bronze age mountain wilderness. The player uses a sword in battle and evokes musical sworcery to solve mystical puzzles, in a world affected by real-world moon phases, accompanied by an original prog rock soundtrack.

A washed-up, painkiller-addicted Max Payne takes a bodyguard job in São Paulo, only to be pulled into a spiral of violence as he searches for the truth. Players fight through a dark, cinematic third-person shooter story with cover-based gunplay.

A LEGO action-adventure retelling the final Harry Potter books and films, where players explore locations like Diagon Alley, Grimmauld Place, and Hogwarts, learn charms and dueling skills, battle Death Eaters, and unlock over a hundred characters, with drop-in co-op play.

The player rides a wave of light through the solar system, dragging the mouse to adjust amplitude and wavelength while steering past strange objects and hazards. Across over 100 levels from Pluto to the Sun, they restore light to a dying galaxy consumed by a Singularity, at a relaxed or challenging pace.

A logic puzzle game in which the player manipulates gravity and perspective to traverse impossible Escher-like architectures, solving 48 hand-drawn black-and-white puzzles with a time-backtracking system and an alternate version unlocked after the main storyline.

In the year 3587, robot armies hire mercenaries called Awesomenauts for galactic supremacy. Players fight 3-on-3 online or in local splitscreen as customizable characters, upgrading skills, pushing lanes with creeps and turrets, and using a map editor for community content.

A 2D side-scrolling arcade adventure where players hack and slash through the kingdom to save princesses and crash castles, alone or with up to four friends locally or online. Over 25 unlockable characters, 40 weapons, skill points and animal orb companions support the campaign and arena modes.

Running the shop Rusted Gold, the player hunts for bargains across farms, antique shops and storage units, haggles with quirky characters, appraises finds with experts, combines items and prices them for shelves or auctions, blending hidden-object searching with resource management to turn a profit and build a reputation.

Players take the role of a ruthless bounty hunter tracking the Old West's most notorious outlaws, fighting through all-out gun battles with pistols and rifles, dodging bullets, and developing shooting skills while traversing Western landscapes in a violent homage to Wild West legends.

Players command a small squad of elite soldiers defending against a vast, constantly mutating alien horde, using real-time tactical combat, turrets, and weapon upgrades across procedurally generated maps to outmaneuver and destroy the enemy's hives.

A 2D arcade game where players swing through nearly 70 levels across seven worlds, collecting items, smashing bricks, dodging traps, and knocking opponents away, with local four-player battle modes and global score chasing.

An 8-bit open-world throwback to the 1980s, players run missions, outrun the law, and rampage through a city with weapons, power-ups, and stolen vehicles. Story and arcade modes, minigames, collectibles, and heavy pop-culture parody fill the retro sandbox.

Command a Soviet penal battalion under Order 227 through four connected campaigns from 1942 to 1945 on the Eastern Front, from desperate defenses to the assault on Germany. A real-time tactics game based on veterans' accounts, demanding precision, sacrifice and tactical realism in brutal skirmishes.

A real-time space strategy game in which three races splinter into Loyalist and Rebel factions amid an ongoing war. Players command fleets including Titan-class warships and capital ships, choosing technologies and playstyles while pursuing multiple paths to victory across the galaxy.

Players control one of Europe's great Christian dynasties across 400 years of medieval history, managing vassals, laws, taxes and courtiers in real-time grand strategy. They build castles and cathedrals, weather multiple-choice events, and reenact the Crusades, Hundred Years War and Mongol Wars.

The third entry in the retro-arcade BIT.TRIP saga has players freely move around the screen to interact with music and rhythm, surviving waves of Beats across levels with boss battles. Color and its absence drive the synesthetic audiovisual presentation.

Players become a supernatural assassin driven by revenge in a steampunk city, combining powers, weapons, and gadgets to eliminate targets. They can sneak through levels unseen or attack head-on, with the world reacting to their choices and play style.

As Ash, a devil rabbit and prince of Hell, the player hunts down the jerk who posted his private photos online while exterminating monsters across ten Hellish worlds. Gameplay mixes platforming, drilling jetpack shooting, loot and shop upgrades, and over thirty humiliating finish-him minigames.

As a young sea captain in the 17th-century Caribbean, the player builds power in the New World through either conquest or commerce. The Adventurer path involves piracy and naval battles, while the Trader path develops trade routes and colonial economies, with free play and multiplayer mixing both.

As Sherlock Holmes in a faithfully reproduced London of 1898, players investigate a case of theft, fraud, and double-crossing while suspected themselves. They examine crime scenes, find clues, interrogate suspects, and explore detailed locations across the city to uncover new leads.

Enter Norrath, a long-running fantasy MMORPG with dozens of zones, thousands of creatures, and quests to complete. Choose from sixteen races and classes, level past 120, and group with others for dungeons and raids.

As commander of a private military corporation, the player hires mercenaries to retake the frozen mountain nation of Khanpaa from paid mercenaries. Tactical squad combat uses the Plan 'n' Go system to plot moves and execute them in real time across a new campaign.

In 2011 New York, a young heir and his friend investigate the disappearances of homeless people and a mysterious Y-shaped scar, crossing paths with an amnesiac man named John Yesterday. The point-and-click mystery adventure spans the globe with shady characters and a dark, somber tone.

The player controls Tiny on a quest to recover grandpa's underpants from his arch enemy Big, slicing through a fully destructible world with a grappling rope, rockets and lasers. The hand-drawn, physics-driven sandbox adventure mixes platforming and creative puzzle solutions with a humorous story and collectible indie music tracks.

Exiled to a shattered world shard, the player takes the role of a Great Mage in a turn-based fantasy strategy game, raising armies, researching spells and conquering rivals to return to Ardania and take revenge on the United One.

An enormous fantasy role-playing adventure set in a subterranean nation of rogues and misfits. The player wanders a vast underground world, takes on hundreds of side quests, and uncovers secrets while struggling for survival and wealth in monster-infested darkness.

Players explore a vast underground fantasy nation in this indie RPG, taking on hundreds of quests and side dungeons while battling clever enemies and scripted encounters. They learn dozens of spells and battle disciplines, hunt magical items, and craft unique equipment amid a story of betrayal and mystery.

Players explore a vast subterranean fantasy nation in the final chapter of a long-running RPG series, undertaking hundreds of quests, battling clever enemies, learning dozens of spells, and crafting magical artifacts across side dungeons.

The player controls an ill-tempered blob that grows by swallowing everything in its path, evolving from a tiny captive into a world-eating giant. Across 24 retro 50s-inspired levels and bonus stages, it gains abilities like magnetism, telekinesis, and rocket boosting to devour humans and civilization.

The Saints' boss becomes President of the United States, then after an alien invasion is trapped in a bizarre simulation of Steelport, using superpowers and strange alien weapons to free humanity from overlord Zinyak in an open-world adventure.

Two doctors enter the mind of a dying elderly man to grant him a final wish, traveling back through fragments of his past to understand why he wants to go to the moon. The story-driven, non-combat experience blends adventure elements with classic RPG aesthetics.

Players create unique heroes and delve into treacherous dungeons in a free MMORPG, actively blocking, tumbling, and cleaving past traps and iconic monsters like dragons and Beholders, alone or grouped with friends in the city of Stormreach.

Players command an AirMech, a flying cursor-like unit, in real-time strategy battles, dropping units onto the field or transforming into mech mode to fight alongside them. They build armies from dozens of units and choose among nine frames, each suited to a particular playstyle.

An arcade racer where players drive twenty vehicles across nine reversible circuits with shortcuts, dodging cones, exploding barrels, and surfaces slick with snow, sand, water, or oil. It supports four-player split-screen multiplayer and global leaderboards for family-friendly competition.

A Sundance award-winning documentary following the developers of Super Meat Boy, Braid and FEZ as they sacrifice money, health and sanity to finish their games. The film captures their emotional journey through expos, launches and creative struggle, with commentary, subtitles and video extras included.

A four-player competitive platformer where costumed racers swing on grappling hooks, fire rockets and drop mines to knock rivals offscreen while keeping pace with the leader. Includes local and online multiplayer, bots, a single-player campaign and a level editor with user-made maps.

A party of four prisoners is exiled into Mount Grimrock and must descend level by level through ancient tunnels and tombs, casting rune spells, crafting potions and fighting monsters to escape and reclaim freedom.

Set 700 years before Ys I & II, players join a search party of knights and sorcerers climbing a demon-built tower to find two vanished goddesses. The game blends arcade-like platforming, action combat, exploration, and puzzles across a multi-faceted narrative with three playable characters.

When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by Darktoons, Rayman and friends set out across hand-drawn worlds to restore balance, running fast-paced platforming challenges, gaining powers like the HairlyCopter, and uncovering secrets alone or in local co-op.

A century after the hero Noitu Love defeated the evil Darns, they return amid time-bending chaos, and a new Peacekeeper named Xoda Rap must stop them. Players fight through seven levels of fast mouse-controlled arcade action against huge inventive bosses, with multiple difficulties and unlockable modes.

Play as Lee Everett, a convicted criminal given a second chance in a world overrun by the undead, protecting an orphaned girl named Clementine. Across five episodes, players make difficult, time-pressured decisions whose consequences carry through the series, experiencing the horror of the zombie apocalypse.

Players guide five small plant-like characters through more than 150 detailed locations, solving light puzzles and clicking on animated scenes to help them save their home from a threat, with no text or lengthy dialogue and a humorous, relaxed tone.

A vertical shooter in which the player's own music files become battlefields, with each song's intensity and tempo shaping the action. The player fights a mysterious entity corrupting the music, discovers and upgrades items hidden in songs, customizes a ship, and battles bosses to reclaim the Symphony of Souls.

The player picks one of four character classes and fights through the fantasy world of Ancaria in side-scrolling co-op brawling, riding mounts, using war machines, collecting loot, and combining weapons to define a fighting style.

As the last explorer in a shattered empire, the player journeys through vast 3D worlds in this final Myst chapter, using a point-and-click interface and an interactive slate to communicate with creatures and shape the fate of a civilization through their choices.

Players guide one of twelve civilizations toward galactic domination through trade, diplomacy, exploration, or war, exploring hundreds of star systems and uncovering the mystery of the ancient substance called Dust. Fleet customization, hero admirals, and simultaneous turn-based play support both quick matches and long campaigns.

A horror-focused first-person shooter set in a Mars research facility overrun by demons, where a lone survivor fights through chaos toward hell. The package includes the 2004 original, its Resurrection of Evil expansion, the BFG remaster, and the Lost Mission expansion.

An epic fantasy RPG set in a vast subterranean nation where the player, banished to the underworld, explores huge outdoor areas, eighty towns and dungeons, and hundreds of quests while choosing among three separate game-winning goals.

As a fresh immigrant in 1920s Atlantic City, players climb the criminal hierarchy by recruiting a gang, expanding territory, gathering intel and fighting tactical turn-based battles with cover and stealth, building their own crime syndicate across the city's districts.

Players pilot a lunar module in a realistic Newtonian-physics simulation, delivering cargo to moon bases on tight fuel budgets, surveying sites, and recovering lost cargo. Missions earn money and experience for upgrades, with time trials, leaderboards, achievements, and online multiplayer combat against other pilots.

Players help the ghost of Mark Twain unravel an evil stalking him in the afterlife, tracing his past and a debate over Shakespeare's true identity. They search hidden-object scenes for tools, solve puzzles and interview apparitions while dangerous forces loom in this mystery adventure.

Bess Houdini's spirit asks the player to reunite her with Harry Houdini, prompting an investigation into his past, rivalries, and a secret society. Players solve puzzles, interview apparitions, and search for tools across globe-spanning locations in a mystery adventure.

As Batman, players tear through Gotham City in the Batmobile and soar across the skyline to stop Scarecrow and a roster of villains uniting against the city. The finale of the Arkham trilogy combines FreeFlow combat, stealth, forensics, navigation and puzzle solving.

Players control Ayumi, a blonde heroine who rewinds and accelerates time to solve puzzles and battle monster armies across snowy valleys, jungles, ancient temples and sky islands. She learns over 40 combo attacks and spells, meets quirky characters, and can join co-op or PvP matches in the Outbreak mode.

Players take on two different heroes across two original quests set in the Westeros universe, navigating conspiracy and betrayal around the Iron Throne. The role-playing game offers tactical battles, secondary quests, and exploration of mythical locations while meeting iconic characters.

Players become an early-career Batman on Christmas Eve, hunted by eight assassins in an expanded Gotham City, using FreeFlow combat, gliding, and a detective mode to reconstruct crimes, take down gangs, and hunt Gotham's most wanted criminals in a prequel storyline.

Players fight giant robots called Titans in first-person bullet-hell boss battles, tearing off their weapons and armor piece by piece. A construction kit and arena builder let players create their own Titans and levels to share.

Guns of Icarus Online is a team-based PvP game of steampunk airship combat where players serve as Captain, Gunner, or Engineer aboard customizable airships. Crews must cooperate to maintain their ship's integrity while destroying enemy vessels across multiple modes in a world ravaged by an out-of-control industrial revolution.

A crossover fighting game pits teams of two characters from Street Fighter and Tekken against each other in real-time tag battles. Players switch partners, equip strategic Gems, and use juggles, Cross Assault and Super Arts across online and offline modes.

A first-person shooter following a crippled nation's Special Operations forces, led by a mysterious group called Ghosts, fighting a technologically superior global power across a single-player campaign and multiplayer with customizable soldiers and dynamic maps.

Sneak through 80 fast-paced levels across eight worlds, hiding in dynamic shadows from security bots and cameras. Use equipment like the Camo Suit and Decoy, solve puzzles, find secrets, and build your own levels with the included editor.

In the 25th century a generation ship vanished, and millennia later it is found. Players read the dead crew's logs with the help of an AI companion to uncover what happened to the final generation, pursuing two characters and five endings in a dark, non-linear visual novel.

As Dax, one of seven elite Magrunners, the player uses a magnetic glove to polarize and manipulate objects, solving over forty action-puzzle levels in high-tech training rooms and cosmic chasms. The training program turns into a nightmare as Lovecraftian Cthulhu creatures emerge.

Set in a plausible future where private military corporations dominate warfare, the player fights as an advanced exoskeleton-equipped soldier using boost jumps, cloaking and hi-tech weapons across a campaign shaped by a powerful PMC leader.

A hack-and-slash action RPG set in a fantasy world ruined by ancient war, where the player levels heroes, collects weapons and armor, unlocks spells, and slaughters hordes of enemies, optionally with a friend in co-op, using an incarnation power to control powerful foes.

Players rearrange microscopic cells into target structures across over 75 puzzle strands, experimenting with how cells react to one another and predicting sequences of splices. Set in an abstract microbial world with soothing visuals and piano music, it rewards careful visualization and efficient solutions.

A masked protagonist must escape a disease-ravaged city while questioning whether what he sees is real. Players sneak or fight, eat, sleep, take drugs, craft items, and manage mental health, with choices shaping the story across two distinct paths and multiple endings.

Triple Town is a puzzle game where players grow a city by matching three or more pieces, combining grass into bushes, trees, and eventually houses, cathedrals, and castles. Giant bears block progress, and the goal is to build the largest city before the board fills.

A Nancy Drew mystery set in an ancient Egyptian tomb where the player translates hieroglyphs, reassembles artifacts, explores hidden chambers, and chooses questions carefully to uncover secrets, with selectable difficulty levels and Egyptology-themed puzzles.

Players pick one of four character classes and defend oxygen-producing Cores from alien hordes by building tower mazes while fighting in first person. Customization of towers, weapons, and perks plus a progression system support solo or four-player co-op across the campaign.

An action game in which the player rises as a warrior and fights with swords, maces, hammers, and axes in vicious close-quarters melee. It includes redesigned levels, new enemies, and multiplayer modes such as Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Arena, and Headball across over 35 singleplayer and multiplayer levels.

The player wakes alone on a strange island with no memory and explores an open world of dozens of locations to solve over 500 puzzles, hoping to regain their past and find a way home. The tone is quiet and contemplative, treating the player as an intelligent solver.

A top-down action RPG sequel where the player mows down huge crowds of aliens, upgrades character stats, wields over sixty weapons, drives vehicles, and takes on campaign, survival, and gun stand modes.
A chess game fused with combat-oriented mechanics, featuring animated fantasy pieces on 3D boards, strategy campaigns, and an interactive action mode with beat'em up fights and PvP duels.

The goddess Hel marches on Midgard to free the wolf Fenrir and trigger Ragnarok, and the warrior Skarin is chosen to stop her. Players explore vast open Viking worlds, fight in brutal melee combat, tame dragons, wield divine magic, and liberate kinsmen to fight in epic battles.

A fiendishly difficult action platformer inspired by Lovecraft and classic horror, blending pixel art with paper and ink textures. Players fight shadowy monsters with a one-button combat system, kicking foes into hazards to earn placeable checkpoints across eleven levels of precise platforming.

In a dying, corpse-filled world, survivor Randall Wayne navigates a 2.5D cinematic platformer where missteps mean death and the environment must be turned from foe to ally. Players avoid direct confrontations, conserve scarce bullets, and follow Wayne's journey toward Seattle in search of something beyond survival.

Play as Shuggy across a non-linear castle map, solving rotation, teleportation, rope-swinging and time-loop puzzles alone or with a friend in 36 two-player co-op levels, and defeat bosses using wit and teamwork.

RaceRoom is a free-to-download racing simulation with data-driven vehicle physics, laser-scanned circuits, ranked multiplayer, time attack leaderboards, and driving assists for all skill levels, plus VR and triple-screen support.

A first-person stealth game in which a master thief sneaks through large missions, avoiding guards who can see, hear, and raise alarms. Players use a blackjack, sword, and various arrows to infiltrate dark environments and complete objectives.

The player sneaks through 15 complex, non-linear levels as a master thief, stealing loot and outsmarting guards with improved enemy AI and new gadgets, in a world of powerful new technologies, fanatical religions and corruption.

Command a four-man squad of SAS or Delta Force specialists through fifteen missions in urban, desert and indoor environments, calling air strikes, driving vehicles and fighting enemies with realistic ballistics while squad expertise grows.

Players take the role of war hero Keith T. Maxwell, flung 35 years into the future, and fight an alien armada across an open galaxy. They battle pirates, trade cargo, explore solar systems, customize ships, and negotiate with shady characters to uncover the truth and find a way home.

Players take on the role of a warrior in a grim fantasy world, mastering precise non-targeting combat and using the environment itself as a weapon while pursuing the goddess Morrighan's promised paradise across diverse landscapes.

A cop and family man, Davis Russell, is thrust into war when his city is invaded and his daughter goes missing; he and his partner master gravity-manipulating combat, using a Gravlink device to crush objects, float enemies and blast through destructible environments.

A kart racing game where players choose from over 20 Sega All-Stars with transforming vehicles and race across 25 tracks and arenas in World Tour, Grand Prix, and Battle modes, using weapons and character-specific All-Star Moves, with split-screen and online multiplayer.

An online RPG set in Tolkien's Middle-earth where players create and advance a hero through races, classes, and professions, explore locations like the Shire and Moria, join solo or co-op skirmishes, craft gear, and fight as a servant of Sauron in PvMP combat.

Players command an elite special-ops squad in near-future asymmetric warfare, using drone tagging and a dynamic cover system to coordinate synchronized attacks, flank enemies, and overwhelm hostile forces through superior technology rather than fair odds.

Players captain a spaceship fleeing across a randomized galaxy, managing crew, power distribution, and weapon targets in pausable real-time combat while making tough decisions through text encounters. Permadeath and varied events make each run tense and different.

Players guide a young footballer from unknown prospect to international legend, managing matches, seven skills, and eight relationships while haggling contracts, giving interviews, and gambling riches away in casino mini-games. Newspaper reports track highs, lows, and scandals across thousands of clubs and leagues.

A LEGO action adventure in which Batman and Robin pursue villains through Gotham City, collecting dozens of DC characters and using super abilities, suits, and vehicles to fight foes and solve puzzles, playable solo or in drop-in co-op.

Players choose between hero and dark campaigns, controlling Sonic, Tails, Knuckles or Shadow, Eggman and Rouge as they race for the Chaos Emeralds across 30 action stages. The game also offers two-player kart racing and competitive modes, plus raising pet Chao and entering them in mini-games.

Players create a new kid in South Park and join Stan, Kyle, Cartman, and Kenny in a comedic fantasy-themed quest over the Stick of Truth, recruiting characters and fighting with magical weapons and armor while customizing their appearance extensively.

As the prophesised Chosen One guided by the wizard Zandalor, the player must unite the seven races of Rivellon and stop a cult from birthing the Lord of Chaos. The lengthy RPG offers non-linear quests, classless skill development, and pausable hack-and-slash combat.

Players guide Rufus, a grumpy man living in a garbage-covered world, through a comic point-and-click adventure as he schemes to reach the floating city above after meeting a woman named Goal. The game features hand-drawn graphics, wacky humor, and challenging puzzles.

Amanda Ripley explores the decommissioned space station Sevastopol to learn what happened to her mother, scavenging resources, hacking systems and crafting tools while evading a dynamic Alien that hunts her through the shadows.

Players relive the Lord of the Rings film trilogy reimagined with LEGO humor, exploring an open Middle-earth and battling Orcs, Uruk-hai, and the Balrog. They collect and forge items, unlock over eighty characters, and can drop in and out with family and friends.

A family-friendly puzzle game where players help an adorable hungry creature devour cake by placing items and manipulating physics across increasingly tricky levels. It spans five worlds with dozens of puzzles, plus a built-in Puzzle Maker for creating and sharing custom puzzles with friends.

An unknown pilot in a prototype fighter joins the war for Lydia against the numerically and technologically superior Caldea, battling overwhelming enemy fighters and massive bosses with Gatling, Winder, and lock-on weapons to reach a final objective.

Players control Freesia, a fairy protecting Lita Forest from monsters and humans seeking its spirit stones. Using kung fu combos and mana-learned skills, she juggles and chains attacks against waves of enemies and bosses, surviving days as the story of human-forest harmony unfolds.

A remastered space RPG where players choose between fighting the machine Dominators or joining a pirate uprising threatening the Coalition. Starting as a lowly pirate, players complete story missions, planetary battles and text adventures, with their actions and AI shaping the galaxy's outcome.

A Metroidvania-style action-platformer set in a magical Mexican-inspired world, where a luchador uses melee moves and dimension swapping to battle evil and uncover secrets. Combat and platforming intertwine, with local two-player co-op and costume customization.

An RPG action game where each quest must be completed within thirty seconds, as the player meets people, fights through dungeons, earns money, upgrades gear and levels up to defeat evil, with over sixty short RPG scenarios and retro 8-bit graphics.

Daniel Garner, the Curse of Darkness, fights through fifteen adrenaline-filled levels of Purgatory against over thirty demonic creatures, wielding a unique arsenal in singleplayer, co-op campaigns, and PvP/PvE multiplayer, in this modern remake of classic shooters.

A strategy game where players command Roman or rival factions in large-scale campaigns and battles, including the Imperator Augustus campaign set in 42 BC amid the aftermath of Caesar's murder and the Second Triumvirate's power struggle.

A fantasy MMORPG set in the World of Twelve, where players choose from 18 classes, fight creatures in turn-based tactical battles, explore dungeons and quests, join nations and politics, and build a Haven World base while allying with other players.

Players create a customizable adventurer in the world of Rune Midgard, choosing among branching classes and leveling up while exploring towns and dungeons, battling monsters in PvE and PvP, joining guild wars, and trading in a player-driven economy.

A humorous point-and-click adventure in a war-torn fantasy world, where an old gremlin archaeologist guards a world-shaping artifact. Players control multiple characters, solve over 150 puzzles, combine items, and meet eccentric creatures across a large, detailed game world.

Players join a shadowy modern-day war against the supernatural, traveling from London to Seoul to New York and beyond while battling mythic creatures with weapons and superhuman powers. Investigation missions reward wits as much as combat, and a dark, voice-acted storyline can be played solo or with friends.

The player takes on the role of Hardboiled Chicken, sent to assassinate the totalitarian penguin leader of Albatropolis in a cinematic platform adventure. Armed with a variety of weapons, the player fights through solo chapters and puzzles, with a co-op campaign following Budgie commandos on a rescue mission.

As the monster hunter Van Helsing, the player explores the gothic-noir world of Borgovia, where mad science threatens peace between monsters and mortals. Accompanied by the ghostly Lady Katarina, the player fights supernatural foes, customizes skills, forges items, builds a hideout with traps and can join co-op hunts.

In the surreal world of Zenozoik, Ghat and his former foe Rimat fight hordes of bizarre denizens in first-person melee combat, using precision punches, blocking, and lock-on targeting. RPG mechanics let them grow stronger and recruit allies, with drop-in co-op support.

Players work undercover for the US government in Arulco, hiring and managing mercenaries, winning over a skeptical population, and fighting a drug cartel through a mix of real-time reconnaissance and turn-based tactical combat across a non-linear campaign.

Players create a customizable hero from dozens of classes and adventure through the side-scrolling world of MapleStory, exploring varied regions, clearing dungeons, fighting bosses, and socializing with other players in an online role-playing game.

Armed with gateway guns, players explore a sprawling lab in this retro-styled 2D platformer, teleporting across rooms, resizing to fit passages, walking on walls and ceilings, and cooperating with past echoes of themselves through time travel to solve puzzles.

Set in the Warhammer Fantasy world, players manage and train a team of brutal fantasy races, buying equipment and improving skills, then compete in ultra-violent turn-based matches using dirty tricks, spells, and illegal weapons across leagues and a World Cup mode.

A role-playing game set in a world at war, where the player leads an Orc warrior and a Goblin assassin through hostile Imperial territory on a mission to kill the Emperor and free their persecuted people, leveling up and developing skills along the way.

Players command teams of worms in turn-based artillery battles, using over fifty odd weapons and tools to blast enemies off the map and be the last worm standing. They can play a single-player campaign, training modes, and online multiplayer matches.

A free-to-play massively multiplayer online game set in the brutal fantasy world of Hyboria, where players pick from twelve classes, fight with active directional combat, and join guilds to build cities and wage siege warfare.

Players fly authentic WWII aircraft in arcade-style aerial combat, mixing dogfighting, escort missions and ground assault across a campaign, with split-screen co-op and versus modes for flying alongside or against a friend.

Players run, jump and kick through 120 rhythmic platforming levels across five worlds, facing boss battles and choosing from eight characters while a narrator and pulsing soundtrack drive the action. The tone is vibrant and whimsical.

The player joins one of three warring empires in a persistent free-to-play massively multiplayer first-person shooter, fighting in huge battles across four continents with infantry, vehicles, and aircraft while capturing territories and customizing a class-based soldier.

A tower-defense and RPG hybrid where individual characters replace towers, leveling up, learning skills, and equipping gear in real-time battles that can be paused, wrapped in a fast-paced character-driven story with adjustable speed and accessibility options.

Four-player co-op shooters don masks as the original PAYDAY crew, taking dynamic contracts across Washington DC from convenience store hits to bank vault heists, choosing skills, customizing weapons and masks, and approaching each job stealthily or guns blazing.

The player controls Lucius, a boy whose supernatural nature is revealed on his sixth birthday, in a 3D open-world horror adventure. Using telekinesis and mind control, the player experiences cinematic cut-scenes and a terror-filled tale drawn from classic horror movie conventions.

A puzzle game where Maxwell explores a free-roaming open world and solves challenges by summoning any object he can imagine, with an object creator for building and sharing custom items, a library backpack and a merit board of hints.

A frantic 2D action game where the Mercenary Kings, elite warriors-for-hire, storm an island laboratory base seized by the CLAW forces, crafting and customizing guns, blades and armor while fighting solo or with friends.

Set in an alternative 1989 Miami, a mysterious antihero follows voices on his answering machine into a murderous rampage through the underworld. Players choreograph fast, deadly close combat and gunplay through outnumbered encounters while unraveling a surreal chain of events.

Players fight in fast-paced medieval multiplayer battles, besieging castles and raiding villages with swords, axes, bows and siege weapons. A real-time melee system lets them adjust attacks and blocks, while objective modes push team tactics and strategy across gritty battlefields.

A meditative, text-free exploration game where the player wanders procedurally generated islands with a shifting palette and a dynamic soundtrack that follows the world's mood, rewarding patience and immersion while allowing discoveries to be saved and shared as postcards.

Play as Wilson, a scientist trapped by a demon in a mysterious wilderness, who must gather resources, craft, hunt, farm, and fight to survive in an uncompromising world. Explore randomly generated maps with dark, whimsical visuals and unravel the land's mysteries.

An epic RPG where the player fights as both human and dragon, using strategic form-switching to defeat enemies and become the ultimate Dragon Knight. Choices shape the storyline, a Battle Tower serves as base, and collected body parts build a summoned fighting creature.

Players join a medieval multiplayer battle where teams build freeform fortresses, dig tunnels, sail ships, and drive siege machines while destroying enemy castles with physics and explosives. The game mixes cooperative and competitive modes with a living animal and plant world, plus singleplayer and mod support.

Shy schoolgirl Lilli lives under strict convent rules and escapes into imagination until her friend Edna vanishes, sending her on a journey to confront her subconscious fears. The hand-drawn point-and-click adventure follows her obedient exterior and the strange Censor-Gnomes that paint over anything upsetting, through bizarre characters, wacky humor and challenging puzzles.

A dark action RPG where players combine dual classes, customize skills through devotion constellations, and collect extensive loot. Face quests with choices and consequences, earn favor with factions, rebuild human enclaves, and fight fast-paced visceral combat solo or in four-player multiplayer.

Bwana and Kito run a rundown gas station until a lost journal sends them into a plot of corruption and danger tied to the mysterious Underland. This point-and-click adventure follows their puzzle-solving journey with an Afro-Caribbean flavor.

A physics-based motorcycle trials game where players ride bikes through indoor and outdoor obstacle tracks, compete globally, customize bikes and riders, and build their own tracks with a track editor, bundling content from two Trials titles.

The player runs a space program for the alien Kerbals, assembling rockets and spacecraft from parts governed by realistic aerodynamic and orbital physics. They launch crews, explore moons and planets, dock stations, build surface bases, and research technology across a full solar system.

Players control Jason Brody, stranded on a lawless tropical archipelago, fighting to escape a descent into madness while confronting the infamous Vaas. They assault outposts, snipe, or use stealth takedowns, craft gear, upgrade skills, hunt wildlife, and explore by land, sea, and air.

Players run a modern farm in a large open world, raising cattle, chickens and sheep, growing and selling crops, and driving over a hundred licensed vehicles and machines. The career grows over time, and up to ten players can manage a farm together online or over a local network.

Players control Dante, a young outcast caught between demon and angel heritage, battling through the shifting demonic world of Limbo with transforming sword and gun combos, angel and demon weapons, and stylish third-person action in a contemporary retelling of his origin story.

As a lone Cargo Commander stranded in space, the player drills through fully destructible, name-generated sectors, fights with a Fistcannon, loots corpses of other players, and upgrades tools while competing on leaderboards across Career and Journey modes.

Rufus must reunite the three split parts of Goal's consciousness so they can reach Elysium and save Deponia. This hand-drawn point-and-click adventure mixes bizarre characters, wacky humor, and challenging puzzles across a comic-style world.

Players drive weaponized vehicles through a zombie-infested city, completing story missions, racing rivals, and surviving endless waves in arena modes. The game mixes arcade racing with shooting, letting players upgrade cars and smash hordes of undead with miniguns, flamethrowers, and rocket launchers.

Leon, Chris, Ada, and newcomer Jake face the highly virulent C-virus across North America, Eastern Europe, and China in four intertwined campaigns. Players shoot, slide, roll, and take cover in action-heavy survival horror, with solo or co-op play and an online mode where hunters control monsters.

Players are dropped into post-apocalyptic wastelands with one goal: survive. With no quests or map markers, they must loot, craft, and read the environment while facing infected, wildlife, disease, and up to 60 other survivors across two large maps.

Conquer asteroids in space, using their resources to grow floral creatures that do your bidding, expanding your empire and fighting AI opponents for resources across a story mode, skirmish levels, and procedurally generated maps with an ambient soundtrack.
