The player throws toys and objects into a virtual fireplace, watching them burn and interacting with them as they combust while staying warm inside. It is a short, polished indie experience built around playful destruction and discovery within a single cozy, slightly unsettling setting.

Players command historical civilizations across more than a thousand years, building economies and armies through classic single-player campaigns and online matches against other Steam players in a quest for world domination. The tone is strategic and historically grounded.

Players deploy towers across 21 dynamic maps in a story-driven campaign, planning placements and timing defenses against waves of enemies. The game offers solo, online co-op, and competitive multiplayer modes, plus challenge variants, level creation tools, and an Aftermath DLC chapter.

A guitar and bass learning tool that adapts to the player's skill level, teaching real songs through a 3D Noteway with practice tools like Riff Repeater. Players build a personalized song library, play multiplayer with friends, and refine techniques using bundled exercises and tracks.

Players assemble a team of three explorers from seven characters, each with unique talents and a dark secret, and descend into a seamless cross-section cave world filled with puzzles, oddities like a subterranean amusement park, and hidden treasures, playable solo or in local co-op.

A point-and-click adventure in which players switch between Nate and Critter, meet eccentric characters like a Yeti and animal activist Petra, and solve puzzles across detailed backgrounds. Two difficulty levels and roughly ten hours of story round out the standalone add-on.

Playing as Stanley in a first-person exploration of an office, the player follows or defies a narrator whose contradictory commentary shapes the experience, breaking the rules of how games normally work while slowly revealing meaning behind the paradoxes.

A fighting game where players choose from a roster of 64 fighters and battle in team-based matches, either offline or online with rollback netcode, lobbies, and ranked play. It is the final edition of KOF '98 Ultimate Match, featuring rebalanced modes and the original NEOGEO version.

A fully upgraded version of the classic KOF 2002 fighting game, offering 66 characters, redesigned balance, new and returning moves, and multiple modes including practice, challenge, endless battles against the CPU, and online matches.

A survival horror game where players investigate dark confined locations like a cruise ship and snowy mountains, fighting infected enemies with limited ammo and weapons, using a scanner to find hidden items, and taking on Raid Mode missions solo or in online co-op.

A mercenary squad wrongly accused of crimes against the Lion of Alahan is hunted across the fantasy lands of Aarklash. The player controls four of eight characters in tactical, active-pause battles, looting items and reshaping skill trees while bonds form between the heroes.

Players control four powerful giants who terraform a planet, creating mountains, oceans, and forests and enriching it with plants, minerals, and animals. Humanity remains beyond control, so players provide for them or punish them, watching greed and virtue shape the world through upgrades and synergies.

Set in 1985 as NATO and the Warsaw Pact slide into all-out war, players command Cold War armies across huge battlefields, choosing from 750 units including tanks, planes, helicopters, and infantry to fight real-time battles in a dynamic campaign or large multiplayer matches.

Players fight in tense close-quarters multiplayer and cooperative battles set in Middle Eastern, African and Central Asian environments, capturing strongholds, destroying supply caches and escorting targets with realistic weapons and squad-based communication. The tone is lethal, unforgiving and focused on tactical realism.

In an occupied Philadelphia, players lead a Resistance cell in open-world first-person guerrilla warfare against a superior military force, using ambush, sabotage, and infiltration. They recruit revolutionaries, establish bases, customize weapons, and can team up online in co-op to inspire an uprising.

Players control Giana through contrasting dream worlds, morphing between sweet and punk personalities to alter abilities, solve puzzles, and fight nightmare creatures in a hardcore platformer. A local competitive arena racing mode for up to four players is also included.

Players live a week as the Postal Dude, an everyman running errands in an open, non-linear American town while fighting or avoiding hostile caricatures with an arsenal of weapons, in a darkly humorous first-person adventure.

A voxel sandbox where the player starts with nothing and builds a civilization, gathering resources, crafting, sculpting terrain, and placing settlers who work once fed, while hostile creatures threaten in survival mode or creative building proceeds freely.

Guide four Buds with distinct powers through over forty lush levels to save the World-Trees from a destructive foe. Players switch characters, redistribute Helys to alter the environment, and use vision modes to solve platforming puzzles and free the inhabitants of Helicia.

A free-to-play combat flight simulation offering authentic military aircraft, ground and naval units across maps like the Caucasus and Mariana Islands, with a mission editor, network play and a sandbox spanning multiple historical eras.

An action RPG following swordsman Adol Christin as he sails to the monster-infested land of Esteria to uncover a 700-year-old mystery tied to a lost kingdom, using classic bump combat and magic across selectable difficulties, with remastered graphics and multiple soundtrack and art options.

Players follow I.R.I.S., a self-aware assassin motorcycle skilled in martial arts, as she and her engineer Pablo flee across the country from a rival motorcycle and a weapons cartel. The story is an over-the-top action road trip toward freedom.

Players cooperate online as survivors in a world collapsing from an unknown disease that turns the dead into flesh-eating zombies, scavenging scarce weapons and ammo while completing dynamic objectives and defending shelters, with infection from a single bite forcing hard choices about teammates.

Playing Dawn, the imaginary friend of a young girl, you shift between a dreamlike 3D 1920s vaudeville world and its parallel 2D shadow world, manipulating light sources to distort shadows and solve puzzles that advance the girl's story.

Players control Octodad, an octopus disguised as a human father, flailing his boneless tentacles through mundane tasks and a disastrous family trip to the aquarium while hiding his cephalopod nature, with physics-driven comedy, hidden neckties to collect and optional co-op for up to four players.

Players manage a procedurally generated underground colony, mining and rebuilding a fully destructible environment, crafting items at workshops, and constructing mechanical contraptions, while choosing between peaceful town-building or raising a military to repel invasions in an open sandbox.

Gomez, a 2D creature, learns of a mysterious third dimension and journeys to the end of time and space. Players rotate 3D structures from four classic 2D perspectives to explore a serene open-ended world full of secrets, puzzles and hidden treasures while uncovering the truth about perception.

Players pilot one of five spacecraft in an open space battlefield between Earth and the Moon, fighting an invasion by Moon Nazis through dozens of missions, dogfights, and capital-ship assaults while salvaging wreckage and upgrading ships. The tone is pulpy and self-aware, mixing sci-fi combat with darkly comic alternate history.

Players control two brothers simultaneously with each thumbstick as they journey through varied fairy-tale locations, solving puzzles and fighting boss battles to find the Water of Life and cure their ailing father.

Roadie Eddie Riggs is pulled into a heavy metal fantasy world of demons and chrome, where the player explores an open world on foot, by car or in flight, fights with an axe and guitar in action combat, and commands legions of metalheads in real-time strategy band battles.

A roguelike set in a voodoo realm where the player chooses a god, mask, and pins, then explores randomly generated levels and dungeons, fighting enemies and leveling up. Quests vary in story and goal, with online co-op for four and competitive multiplayer modes for up to eight.

Players become a vampire hunter in a world of blood and darkness, stalking enemies from the shadows, using invisibility and powerful melee attacks to eliminate humans and fellow vampires, while earning experience, choosing dialogue, and developing skills through museums and hidden fortresses.

The player builds and manages a mass transit network across dynamic cities, choosing buses, trams and ferries, setting timetables and watching transportation choices shape city growth through day and night cycles in campaign, sandbox and multiplayer modes.

Players take on the role of Rico Rodriguez in the Mediterranean republic of Medici, using a grapple, parachute, wingsuit, vehicles, and explosive weaponry to cause creative chains of destruction and topple the dictator General Di Ravello across a vast open world.

A sandbox platformer where you play a SoupCo astroworker exploring alien planets for ingredients to make soups for hungry customers. Build and automate a base with robots, fend off rival corporations and wildlife, and share custom planets in co-op.

A 2D point-and-click adventure following Captain Vincent Cassini and his robot partner MAC as they investigate a war crime that vanished thousands of Cetans, including his ex-wife. Puzzle-solving and relationship decisions branch into multiple endings across six to eight hours.

A survival-mystery action game set on the island of Narapela after the Dead Island outbreak, following journalist Cliff Calo as he seeks the origins of the zombie virus. Players choose between stealth and combat, use makeshift weapons and tools, and collect clues through a distorted, reactive world.

Desktop Dungeons is a quick-play puzzle roguelike where players fight through randomly generated fantasy dungeons in ten minutes or less, exploring unrevealed terrain to regain health and mana. Building a kingdom unlocks new classes, races, and challenges, and a seeded Daily Dungeon lets players compete with friends.

A third-person action game in which a rig pilot named Jim Peyton works a hazardous contract on the frozen planet E.D.N. III, surveying terrain, harvesting Thermal Energy, and battling indigenous Akrid creatures while uncovering the planet's colonial history.

Players rule a fantasy empire as one of six RPG-style leader classes, exploring a living world, founding settlements, forging alliances with races and monsters, and commanding heroes in detailed 3D turn-based tactical battles. Campaign, random-map scenarios, and up to eight-player multiplayer are included.

The player leads a chosen alien or human civilization into a galactic golden age through a massive 4X sandbox, researching technology, designing starships, colonizing worlds, and pursuing military, cultural, technological, or political victory. Negotiation, espionage, and warfare shape each uniquely generated galaxy.

In a post-apocalyptic world of discarded machines, a solitary robot named Horatio and his droid companion Crispin lose the energy source powering their airship to a rogue robot. The player guides Horatio through an epic story about humanity's extinction, with optional puzzles revealing more of the world.

A boy named Quico plays with his best friend Monster, a huge beast whose addiction to poisonous frogs sends him into violent rages. Players explore a fantastical South American favela, solving environment-based puzzles while uncovering the complicated relationships of Quico's family through an interactive narrative.

In the final days of World War II, Hitler unleashes a legion of undead super soldiers, and sniper Karl Fairburne must survive a Berlin overrun by supernatural forces. Players fight through blood-soaked levels alone or in four-player co-op, using precise sniping and traps against occult enemies.

An action-strategy folktale set in 19th-century Canada, where two feuding brothers must save their sister from the Devil. By day the player places inventive traps in the forest; by night they lure and fight werewolves with musket and axe, using fear to scatter packs.

The player drives a truck across more than 60 European cities, hauling varied cargo over real road networks while building a fleet, buying garages, hiring drivers, and managing a growing company, with optional online convoy play and photo sharing.

A remastered animated arcade classic in which you control the knight Dirk the Daring through a dark wizard's castle and caverns, reacting to on-screen prompts to dodge monsters and obstacles on a quest to rescue the princess from an evil dragon.

A dungeon-crawling puzzle RPG match-3 game in which the player matches swords, staves, stone and wood to fight pixel-art monsters, uses backpack items and potions, and spends loot on gear upgrades and castle improvements across repeated roguelike runs.

Players control Mickey Mouse through five magical worlds of enchanted forests, rebellious toys, and living books to rescue Minnie from the witch Mizrabel. The adventure reimagines the Sega Genesis classic with new HD graphics, hidden challenges, and unlockable classic costumes for Mickey.

Players become Sam "Serious" Stone and fight through ancient Egypt, Mayan, Persian, and Medieval European landscapes against hordes of nightmarish enemies. The arcade-style shooter bundles two classic campaigns with new maps, bosses, weapons, and co-op and versus multiplayer modes.

Players command Bricktrons on floating voxel islands, ordering them to dig, gather resources and build castles and villages. Mysterious Corruptrons attack, so players construct defenses, catapults and traps, with physics affecting structures, plus multiplayer conquest, co-op and a world editor.

Players command Allied squads through pivotal WWII battles starting at the Normandy invasion, using cover, squad tactics, and destructible environments to defeat German forces. A cinematic single-player campaign is joined by competitive multiplayer matches for up to eight players.

Players lead a fantasy kingdom as a sovereign who recruits champions drawn by fame, developing heroes through skill trees and fighting tactical turn-based battles against monsters and rival factions across large maps. The tone is epic and strategic, focused on empire building and heroic progression.

Players customize a hero, gather companions, and roam the Sword Coast through a long classic Dungeons & Dragons campaign plus expansions and an arena mode. Combat is real-time with pause under 2nd Edition rules, with choices shaping the journey. The tone is adventurous and nostalgic.

In a 2084 Neo-Paris where memories are digitized and traded, the player controls Nilin, an elite memory hunter, breaking into people's minds to steal or remix their memories while fighting and exploring to recover her own past.

A remastered classic graphic adventure following Ben Throttle, leader of a biker gang, who is drawn into a tale of motorcycles, mayhem, and murder, solved through point-and-click exploration with updated hand-drawn art and audio.

A full-contact racing game where players drive battered cars in demolition derbies and no-rules banger races, upgrading and customizing vehicles for crashes and speed, competing in career championships and online multiplayer, with physics-driven destruction and challenge modes featuring odd vehicles.

Players race cars on sensational tracks through a canyon environment in solo and multiplayer modes, with accessible handling, extensive track and car creation tools, an in-game video studio, and community sharing of user-generated content and rankings.

An arcade-inspired blend of action and turn-based strategy set in the Japanese afterlife, where the player commands an army of colorful spirits and demons through a 24-level campaign and battles up to four players on multiplayer maps.

Players fight through reworked Capcom arcade beat-'em-ups set in the Dungeons & Dragons fantasy world, alone or in drop-in co-op with up to four players. House Rules alter the arcade experience, while a challenge system, leveling, vault unlocks, and leaderboards add progression around the classic combat.

A multiplayer first-person shooter built around community-created maps, modes and rankings, with quick-fire arena matches for solo or team play. Players improve their ranking, compete in eSports events, and use editors to build and share their own game experiences.

The player controls the stuntman Joe Danger through over 100 levels, racing, boosting, and pulling combos and ludicrous stunts to beat rivals and earn Pro Medals, while also building and sharing custom levels in a sandbox and competing on leaderboards.

In a crumbling society divided among noble Houses, the player investigates what destroyed the world, allying with or betraying seven factions through dialogue and choices rather than dungeon crawling, in a noir-flavored RPG where words and actions shape outcomes.

A dungeon management game where the player excavates and builds an underground fortress, filling it with rooms, traps, and minions, then defends it against heroes from the overworld. Campaign, skirmish, survival, and multiplayer modes plus a map editor support creative villainy.

An ex-patient suffering bizarre visions explores the Hanwell Mental Institute, researching its past and solving puzzles in a slow-burning first-person horror adventure focused on atmosphere and storytelling.

A fast-paced momentum-based platformer where a ninja darts through hand-crafted minimalist levels, evading homicidal robots and collecting gold, with hundreds of levels, leaderboards, local co-op and competitive modes.

Players create, destroy, and interact with planets, stars, and galaxies in a realistic physics-based space simulator. Real-time gravity, climate, collision, and material interactions let players collide bodies, terraform worlds, trigger supernovae, and share simulations.

Players join an online multiplayer RPG and journey through the fantasy world of Vana'diel, exploring wild lands, discovering creatures, and completing quests alongside players worldwide. The complete edition bundles five expansions, add-on scenarios, and battle add-ons, plus bonus in-game clothing items for new adventurers.

Players control bio-metal Warframes in a third-person combat experience across a sprawling interplanetary system, fighting warring factions, crafting weapons, customizing suits, and teaming up with friends in co-op missions and open worlds.

Explore the sprawling ancient ruins of La-Mulana in search of the Secret Treasure of Life, solving mysteries, disarming traps, and fighting monsters in a deliberately punishing retro-style action adventure that grows harder the deeper the player descends.

Young Jerry follows a white rabbit into Mousewood, a realm of talking animals, to pursue his dream of becoming a magician. A sinister force offers the residents a magic-show deal with a steep price, and the player explores the world and solves puzzles across a story that shifts from light comedy to drama over roughly 20 hours.

An action-adventure in which Beatbuddy, an ethereal creature, travels through lush hand-painted levels that pulse to an original soundtrack, interacting with the environment and creatures to open paths and solve puzzles while uniting with his sisters against Prince Maestro.

The player designs and builds cities across a shared planet, placing over a thousand building types on more than sixty large maps while meeting citizens' needs for employment, housing, and recreation and managing a large-scale economy.

A magical realist adventure in five acts following travelers along a secret underground highway in Kentucky, including an aging driver, a TV repairwoman, and a child with a giant eagle. The story explores debts, abandoned futures, and the search for community.

In 1938, adventurer James Lee Quatermain escorts an agent to an Egyptian temple to retrieve the Heart of Atlantis, fighting Nazi occultists and supernatural foes in first-person shooting while solving ancient puzzles and exploring exotic ruins.

Players command Soviet, German, and Western Front armies in tactical WWII real-time strategy battles, using cover, line of sight, and combined arms to outmaneuver opponents. Campaigns and multiplayer armies let players make meaningful tactical choices across the Eastern and Western Fronts.

A turn-based pixel-art RPG framed as a pen-and-paper session where players control both the adventuring party and the game master. They pick classes and quirky characters, set up monster encounters, and explore a fantasy world to defeat a dark mage.

The original European truck simulation: players drive long-haul freight between cities like London, Rome, Berlin, Madrid, and Prague in realistically modeled trucks with working instruments. Cargo must be picked up and delivered on time, with a camera that pans around the cabin.

Players fight hordes of specimen clones across Europe in first-person co-op or solo survival combat, wielding an eclectic arsenal of weapons. A versus mode lets players take turns as humans or zeds, with visceral gore and coordinated enemy AI.

Arriving home in 1995 after a year abroad, the player finds an empty house and explores it at their own pace, opening drawers, picking up objects, and reading notes to piece together one family's story of uncertainty and heartache. There is no combat and no puzzles, only observation.

On a water-starved Mars, a renegade named Roy fights through corporate wars, developing melee, ranged, stealth, or Technomant powers, crafting gear, recruiting companions, and making choices that shape an epic quest across the red planet's colonies.

Two teenagers in parallel worlds, Vella and Shay, take control of their own lives through a hand-animated point-and-click adventure filled with puzzles, as the player freely switches between their coming-of-age stories and their strange companions.

Players command Crusader or Arabic forces in the medieval Middle East, building castles and managing a desert economy while besieging enemies with troops and siege equipment. Campaigns, skirmishes, co-op and multiplayer modes support real-time strategy and city-building play.

The player races high-speed cars through over sixty-five solo campaign tracks in the Stadium environment, earning medals and comparing times worldwide, while using tools to create and share custom tracks, skins, and game modes.

Players pilot combat helicopters as part of a mercenary wolf pack fighting global terrorism, flying 13 missions across four regions in an arcade shooter. They choose among nine helicopters and varied weapons, battle masses of enemies and bosses, and can fly with a friend in local co-op as pilot and gunner.

A reimagining of a classic first-person shooter in which corporate shogun Lo Wang, betrayed by his employer, fights demonic armies with guns, a katana and mystical powers. Players upgrade an arsenal, unleash sword combos and call on magic to banish an invasion from the shadow realm.

A stylish arcade shooter in which the player picks from over 125 combinations of weapons, plane bodies, and propulsion systems to battle enemy fighters, battleships, submarines, and rival aces, completing over 100 missions to unlock new Rauser configurations and color variations.

Four friends arrive at their old high school to find a ghost town overrun by monstrous creatures, and must fight through hordes in 2.5D side-scrolling levels. Alone or in co-op, players pick characters, complete varied objectives, find weapons, unlock powers, and chase high scores.

Players explore the lost world of Kairo, wandering through vast abandoned monuments of abstract architecture, repairing ancient machinery to bring the world back to life, and piecing together the land's purpose through environmental storytelling without dialogue or text.
As cyber commando Rex Colt in a 2007 VHS-style nuclear future, the player shoots through cyborgs, mutants and blood dragons to rescue a girl and save the world, embracing every cliché of 80s action.

A supernatural detective thriller in which a murdered detective, now in the afterlife of Dusk, explores modern-day Salem using ghostly abilities to possess people, walk through walls and evade demonic spirits while solving the mystery of his own death.

A fantasy role-playing adventure where the player serves the keep of Avadon as a spy and warrior, fighting enemies of the homeland through dungeons, side quests, and secrets, with five character classes and multiple endings depending on loyalty.

Four heroes unite to aid their queen in a world divided into light and shadow, traveling through a countryside turned battlefield by Aklorian forces. Players switch between the four champions at will, fighting in real-time combat with spells and combos while customizing armor, weapons, and abilities.

Set in 1960s Europe, players follow an investigator and a constable through a three-chapter crime adventure involving a legendary master thief, a stolen ruby, and a raven feather, solving puzzles and uncovering twists in a cinematic whodunit and heist story.

Players design, build, and manage a prison as a warden, allocating resources and staff to keep inmates contained while handling disease, gangs, and riots. They can also attempt escapes in Escape Mode or explore player-created prisons and sandbox building.

An RPG that evolves as you progress, shifting from old-school 2D action-adventure visuals to active time battles and full 3D action, letting players revisit areas in 3D, explore by airship, and solve dungeons and puzzles while collecting secrets and achievements.

A remastered action-platformer in which the player guides a protagonist through an alien world after a scientific experiment goes wrong, solving environmental challenges and surviving hostile creatures across three difficulty modes with updated graphics and sound.

An over-the-top operation simulation in which the player, as would-be surgeon Nigel Burke, performs transplants and emergency procedures on patients using deliberately awkward finger-by-finger controls. The darkly comedic surgeries take place in operating theatres, corridors and moving ambulances, with absurd patients and tools.

Worms Clan Wars is a turn-based artillery game where players command teams of worms across destructible landscapes, using an arsenal of weapons and physics contraptions. Players form clans, customize emblems and outfits, compete online through WormNET leagues, and play a story mode with swinging rope bridges and rescue challenges.

A free-roaming squad-based RPG set in a harsh desert world where the player chooses roles like trader, thief, farmer, or warlord, recruits and trains characters, builds and upgrades bases, and survives against factions, slavers, and cannibals in a dynamic simulated sandbox.

Daniel, an average gamer, is teleported into a castle and shares his body with a shadow that wants him dead. He explores 200 rooms, fights bosses, learns spells, and upgrades skills in a 2D platforming RPG full of pop-culture humor and multiple endings.

Gabriel Belmont, a holy knight whose wife was murdered by dark forces, battles creatures of evil across a shattered land to reach the mysterious Lords of Shadow, in a dark reimagining of the Castlevania mythology.

Players become Mad Max in a savage post-apocalyptic wasteland, fighting bandit gangs on foot and in vehicles while scavenging supplies to build an ultimate combat car and seeking the fabled Plains of Silence.

Players follow three characters, Jack, Aliena and Philip, through twelfth-century England as a small town builds a cathedral amid poverty and war. Exploration, dialogue and decisions let players alter the novel's events and shape the fates of characters across a decades-spanning epic of conspiracy and romance.

Players collect and level up hundreds of Marvel heroes and villains, matching gems on a board to trigger superpowers and defeat cosmic threats in tactical puzzle combat, including head-to-head PvP and seasonal events.

A scientist awakens as the lone survivor of a shadowy research facility on a remote planet, where a central AI has reactivated dead personnel as combatants. Players scavenge random equipment, craft improvised weapons, and fight through ten levels that restructure each run, with permanent death creating dread.

As a shadowrunner in 2054 Seattle, investigate a mysterious killer through slums and megacorp offices, commanding a team in turn-based tactical combat and growing a classless character with combat, tech and magic skills in a cyberpunk-meets-fantasy world.

The player wages the Fourth Great Ninja War through an epic storyline, confronting giant bosses and Tailed Beasts in dynamic ninja battles. The roster spans many characters, with additional missions, costumes, and a new playable character in versus mode offline and online.

A 2D action-adventure through the surreal dream world of a silent protagonist named Young, exploring dungeons set in apartments, hotels, and abstract lands while solving puzzles, defeating enemies with a broom, and collecting cards to unlock deeper areas.

Players control ninja Strider Hiryu as he takes on Grand Master Meio, using fast combat, plasma weapons, and agile traversal to slice through enemies across a large interconnected world filled with cybernetic soldiers and bio-mechanical creatures.

An American geological expedition in Siberia uncovers an unknown mineral identical to the fuel of an extraterrestrial artifact found near Tunguska, a device that transports objects hundreds of thousands of years into the past, setting up a story of secret experiments and time travel.

A World War II real-time strategy game where the player commands Soviet, Axis, or Allied forces across three historical campaigns and skirmish matches against a neural-network AI. Over 200 authentic units, terrain, weather, and sight ranges factor into tactical battles on historically accurate maps.

Players control Raiden, a half-human cyborg ninja, and slice through enemies with a high-frequency katana in fast-paced action combat. The game follows his vengeful path through an epic story, with DLC missions, boss battles, and body upgrades included in this PC version.

In the Warhammer Fantasy End Times, the player becomes one of five heroes fighting alongside up to four co-op players through Ubersreik's streets, towers and tunnels, using melee and ranged weapons against hordes of Skaven while earning loot dice.

As Sam Fisher, the player races across the globe to stop a devastating threat called the Blacklist, choosing between ghost, assault, or panther playstyles. Using gadgets, drones, and a karambit knife, they infiltrate enemy locations and build a new Echelon team aboard the Paladin airliner.

A digital adaptation of the board game where the player commands whimsical fantasy races such as dwarfs, wizards, orcs and giants, sending troops to conquer regions and overthrow rivals. Nearly endless race and power combinations keep each strategy match of expansion and conquest varied.

As a powerful Master, the player explores and rules provinces, recruits and equips heroes, manages buildings and diplomacy, and fights turn-based tactical battles to shape the destiny of the fantasy land of Eador.

A music-driven game that turns the player's own songs into visualized tracks, where the shape, speed, and mood of each ride follow the chosen music, with modes focused on timing, block matching, and dodging spikes, plus leaderboards and Workshop mods.

An experimental indie platformer where the player controls four bound-together elements across 16 levels in four stages, rearranging reflexes to overcome nature and the sun, with a soundtrack by Mind Tree and a competitive race mode using adaptive ghosts.

Guide Psychobot, a microscopic robot, through the cogs and circuits of Tetrobot by swallowing and spitting blocks of matter, learning how pipes, lasers and slime work to repair machines and collect memory blocks across over 50 puzzle levels.

Players control a hero in a traditionally animated action-adventure, exploring an expansive world filled with characters, quests, and secrets. Nonlinear platforming rewards exploration and experimentation, backed by a fully voiced cast, a deep storyline, and an award-winning musical score.

Players captain their own spaceship in a 3D tactical space simulator, roaming the war-torn Gemini system two years after the second Gemini war. They trade commodities, take generated missions, hire crew, upgrade over 70 ships, and fight real-time battles amid fifty factions.

A free-to-play cross-platform MMO military game where players command over 3,000 aircraft, helicopters, tanks and warships in realistic competitive land, air and sea battles across 100 historical maps, alongside PvE campaigns and solo missions, with regular content updates and custom content sharing.

Players explore a vast, labyrinthine world as a customizable warrior, fighting twisted monsters and deadly bosses in a punishing action RPG with deep gear customization and cooperative or competitive online play. The tone is dark, obscure, and deliberately challenging.

A fast-paced arcade maze game where the player wakes ghosts, forms long chains of pursuers, and chomps them at high speed to beat scores. It offers seven mazes, five modes, leaderboards, and customizable difficulty, music, and visuals.

Players coach teams in a turn-based strategy adaptation of Games Workshop's board game, blending American football with the Warhammer fantasy world. They manage 24 races and Star Players, build mixed-race rosters, and compete in solo leagues, challenge modes, and custom online competitions.

Players control any nation in the world from the late Middle Ages to the Napoleonic era, managing wealth, diplomacy, religion, and warfare to build a global empire, with hundreds of dynamic historical events and the freedom to start at any date.

Players fight through side-scrolling dungeons in a free-to-play online action RPG, choosing from thirteen customizable characters with distinct stories and skills. The game offers co-op party play, skill-based PvP matches for up to eight players, job changes and extensive cosmetic customization in a manga-styled world.

Players lead a 16th-century Spanish expedition into the New World, managing resources and followers while forging alliances or fighting natives in turn-based battles across varied terrain. A branching storyline spans two campaigns with over 30 recruitable characters. The tone is strategic and adventurous.

A remastered reimagining of the 8-bit DuckTales platformer, following Scrooge McDuck and his nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie across exotic worldwide locations in a quest to retrieve five Legendary Treasures, with hand-drawn sprites and classic cartoon voice talent.

Players experience the complete remastered adventure concluding The Longest Journey saga, shaping the story through choices with lasting consequences. They explore detailed worlds blending a cyberpunk future with magical fantasy and a decaying dreamscape, across multiple playable characters and episodes.

At the dawn of time a war between good and evil destroyed the world of Agarest, and now darkness awakens again. The player leads heroes across five generations, fighting creatures in turn-based battles and shaping the next generation through the Soul Breed system.

Players wield a powerful talking sword called the Transistor, combining thousands of Functions in real-time combat with a strategic planning mode while uncovering an atmospheric story through dynamic voiceover and hand-painted art in a vibrant futuristic city.

Players lead a caravan of humans and horned giants across a frozen landscape, making narrative choices that shape the story and managing resources for survival. Combat is turn-based and strategic, with permanent character loss, set in a hand-drawn world inspired by Norse mythology.

In a divided near-future where mechanical augmentations separate rich from poor, players take on conspiracies through stealth, hacking, social manipulation, or close-quarters combat. Character augmentations and weapon upgrades support multiple approaches, and choices shape how the story unfolds across an enhanced campaign.

Set in North Africa during World War II, players stalk and eliminate targets of the Afrika Korps through canyons, oases and ancient cities. They use stealth, planning, rifle ballistics and traps to sabotage a Nazi super-weapons program, with co-op and competitive multiplayer modes.

This pinball game recreates classic tables from Stern and Gottlieb with painstakingly emulated flippers, bumpers, sounds, and displays. Players download it to play authentic tables, starting with a free Frankenstein table, as updates add more classics over time.

As investigative journalist Miles Upshur, players break into the remote Mount Massive Asylum and must run, hide, and sneak past its unpredictable inhabitants to uncover the terrible secret at its heart, in a first-person survival horror experience.

Up to four wizards traverse a fantasy Midgård armed with a dynamic spellcasting system, combining elements to cast thousands of spells at foes and friends alike, with always-on friendly fire producing chaotic co-op comedy across a story-driven campaign.

Players face slow-moving zombies in a tense survival horror game with randomized rounds, using firearms, melee weapons, and explosives to escape or extract civilians. The gory co-op experience features multiple game modes and a dark apocalyptic atmosphere.

Shipwrecked and forced to perform for cats, players use weapon-tools to battle through hundreds of platforming levels, freeing over 300 imprisoned friends. The game supports solo, co-op and arena play, plus a level editor for sharing custom stages.

Players create and lead a party of four adventurers through an open world of intrigue and political conflict around the city of Karthal, battling mythical creatures and collecting magical treasures. The first-person RPG offers twelve classes, over twenty skills, and a four-act story.

An online action RPG set in the dark fantasy world of Wraeclast, where players choose from seven classes, build characters through a vast passive skill tree and itemized skill gems, trade in an orb-based economy, and explore high-level maps to face dangerous bosses.

As an immigration inspector at the Grestin border checkpoint in the communist state of Arstotzka, the player reviews travelers' documents using primitive inspection systems and decides who may enter, who is turned away, and who is arrested, amid hidden smugglers and spies.

Players pick from six classes with unique skills and fight through dungeons in a cooperative action RPG, upgrading characters and customizing difficulty with modifiers. Up to four players can join online, over LAN, or locally, and the game supports mods and level editing.

Two to four players fight as samurai armed with a sword and a three-bullet gun, using simple jump, slash, and shoot controls with one-hit kills, deflecting bullets and employing stances and air control in fast Bushido brawls.

Four youths chosen by the crystals journey to restore light to a darkened world in this 3D remake of a classic role-playing game, featuring updated visuals, story sequences, job systems and monster records.

Players survive in a city overrun by a zombie virus, using parkour to scale buildings and reach remote areas. Gory combat, a day-night cycle that turns hunters into hunted, and four-player co-op support a story campaign with difficult moral choices.

Players step into the silent shoes of Garrett, a master thief in a fear-ridden City, sneaking through back alleys and guarded mansions to steal loot and uncover secrets while an uprising against the Baron unfolds.

In 1899, industrialist Oswald Mandus wakes feverish to find his children in peril and his house ruled by an infernal machine. Players explore in first person through a dark, horrific tale of greed, power, and madness while evading threats.

Dracula awakens weakened after centuries and must reclaim his powers, pact with Death, and confront Satan and his descendant's revenge in an epic fantasy adventure spanning a modern-day world, concluding the Lords of Shadow saga.

Players guide squishy explorers through randomly generated, fully destructible platforming levels dense with danger, learning from frequent deaths, filling an explorer's journal, and competing in daily challenges, local co-op, and deathmatch arenas.

A dark visual novel in which the player spends three real-time days aboard a derelict generation ship, working with a traumatized AI sidekick to uncover how a patriarchal political program eroded her society, reading messages and making choices along the way.

Players help Wryn, a girl with a big arsenal and bigger dreams, take down the Greatest Heroes of All Time in fast-paced action across seven levels with bosses, multiple difficulty levels, local co-op, unlockable characters and arcade and challenge modes.

Starting in a small garage office in the 1980s, the player founds and grows a video game development company, choosing development focus areas, researching technologies, hiring and training staff, and releasing increasingly complex games to become a market leader.

An arcade laserdisc game where players control the heroic Ace, who must stop the evil Commander Borf from reducing humanity to infants and taking over Earth. After being hit by the Infanto Ray and losing Kimberly to Borf, Ace fights through animated scenes to save the planet.

In this arcade animated adventure, players guide Dirk the Daring through time to rescue Princess Daphne from the wizard Mordroc before she is forced into marriage and lost in the Time Warp. The PC version includes original scenes, a Director's Cut ending and a full watch mode.

A punishing climbing game in which the player uses only a mouse-controlled hammer to swing, jump, and climb an enormous mountain while a narrator offers philosophical commentary, with progress repeatedly lost along the way.

A post-apocalyptic RPG where players lead a Desert Ranger squad across a hellish wasteland, customizing characters and weapons, choosing how to overcome obstacles, and making decisions whose short- and long-term consequences reshape events and lives.

Players take the role of Sherlock Holmes solving six varied cases, from murders to thefts, using fourteen detection skills, choosing lines of enquiry, interrogating suspects and naming the guilty, with deductions and moral decisions shaping reputations and consequences.

Players explore a mysterious flying city called Starship Frivolity, battling its card-obsessed inhabitants to earn their trust and cards. The card game is played on a shared board where connected cards build combos to damage, heal, or disrupt opponents, with an adventure mode and online multiplayer.

An adventuress and her sidekick crash-land on a strange island full of loot and odd inhabitants, and must explore it, solve devious puzzles, and combine tools in clever ways to uncover its secrets. The tone is light and playful, with hand-drawn visuals and speedrun-friendly shortcuts.

After a zombie outbreak, survivors band together in a third-person open-world action game where the player chooses a home base, fortifies it, raids for food and ammunition, and rescues other playable survivors with unique talents.

Players assume the office of Inquisitor in a plague- and famine-ravaged land, investigating heresy, gathering evidence, and extracting confessions through torture while exploring an open-ended isometric world. The dark old-school RPG offers three classes, extensive dungeons, and a story of betrayal and damnation.

Players control inventor Rufus and, later, three clones of himself in a point-and-click adventure to rescue Goal, reach the orbiting paradise Elysium, and stop the Organon from destroying the junkyard planet Deponia. The comic sci-fi story unfolds through puzzles and animated cutscenes.

Set in Middle-earth, players take on the role of a ranger fighting orcs and dark forces in an open-world action adventure. The game features the Nemesis system, letting enemies remember encounters and rise in rank as players pursue revenge.

Players become pirate captain Edward Kenway in the Caribbean, switching between blades and pistols, commanding a ship to plunder and board galleons, and exploring an open world of cities, ruins, and shipwrecks while clashing with Templars.

A steampunk Victorian-era run-and-gun shooter in which one or two players pick from six mercenaries and battle the hostile creations of the Chaos Engine across four worlds, with classic and enhanced modes plus co-op play.

A turn-based tactical strategy game set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, where a small squad of Blood Angel Terminators assaults a derelict space hulk overrun by Genestealers. The player guides the squad through claustrophobic 3D corridors, fighting fierce Xenos and uncovering ancient relics across a campaign of missions.

Players control Styx, an aged goblin, infiltrating the towering Tower of Akenash in a dark fantasy world to uncover his origins and steal treasure. Gameplay centers on hardcore stealth, assassination, cloning, and RPG skill trees while avoiding detection in vertically layered levels.

DC Comics heroes and villains clash in epic fighting-game battles across a world where good and evil blur, with an original story mode plus extra characters, skins, and S.T.A.R. Labs missions. Players fight as icons like Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman in large-scale combat.

As the lone survivor of a jet crash, players explore a mysterious forest, chopping trees to build shelters and fortresses, scavenging food, crafting weapons, and defending against or stealthily evading a society of cannibalistic mutants in caves and above ground.

An FBI agent with the power to see the past investigates a serial killer in Boston while confronting the cold case of her brother's murder, playing through a four-part point-and-click thriller with branching investigation.

Players fight in multiplayer first-person trench warfare on the Western Front of World War One, using historically accurate weaponry, gas masks and squad tactics across dynamic frontlines and other team-based modes on maps based on real battlefields.

Two protagonists in different eras of Aventuria are followed: princess Sadja seeks glory in the Mages' War, while bird catcher Geron, 450 years later, tries to lift a curse turning his love into a crow. Point-and-click puzzles and magic skills connect their stories.

A musical exploration game set in a forgotten world built on sound. The player explores an open landscape, solves music-based puzzles to rebuild machinery, and unlocks tools to compose, export, and share original music in the in-game studio.

Players race arcade-style rally cars through a sprawling valley environment, competing solo or in large multiplayer sessions while building custom tracks and editing video highlights. The game blends accessible handling with simulation-leaning realism and community sharing.

As hacker Aiden Pearce, players roam a networked Chicago, hacking cameras, traffic lights and infrastructure to pursue those who harmed his family, mixing stealth, gunfights, baton combat and driving through a fully simulated open city.

Tikiman defends his Tiki babies from waves of land and air monsters by placing arrow, cannon, ice, laser and other towers across three islands and 47 environments. Campaign, co-op and challenge modes plus a randomly generated island extend the tower defense play.

Players drive armed, customizable cars through a combat racing campaign and multiplayer tournaments, blasting rivals with weapons and power-ups across 40 tracks and arenas. Seven multiplayer modes, vehicle upgrades, and team battles round out the trigger-happy racing action.

A realistic WWI flight simulation where players pilot canvas-and-wood aircraft in air combat over war-torn Europe, re-enacting battles of legendary aces, with training, career, quick missions, and multiplayer gunner roles, plus advanced flight models and damage systems.

Players command squadrons of authentic WWI fighter planes over Europe, engaging in dogfights by rolling, slipping, and looping to outmaneuver enemy aces. Across 180 missions they upgrade aircraft, promote pilots, and unlock new aces with special skills, with single-player and hot-seat multiplayer.

A remastered collection of classic space real-time strategy games, where the player commands fleets across more than 30 single-player missions, researches and builds ships from fighters to carriers, and chooses formations and tactics, with multiplayer supporting up to eight players.

A next-generation racing simulator recreating licensed cars and laser-scanned real-world tracks with an advanced physics engine, offering career mode, special events, and single-player and multiplayer driving with support for wheels and VR.

The player controls a badger protecting and feeding its cubs in the wild, evading birds of prey, crossing rivers, escaping forest fires and staving off starvation. The journey tests whether the family can find enough food to survive another day.

A first-person puzzle exploration mystery set in an abandoned building, where the player solves puzzles, decodes text, and finds clues to learn who they are and how to escape. Nightmares of being chased through hallways alternate with the serene but foreboding waking world.

Players control fierce warriors in a fast-paced 2D fighting game set in an extraordinary Dark Deco world, with 14 original characters each featuring unique mechanics and personality, plus a fully voiced story mode and soundtrack.

Players take control of five damned souls trapped inside an insane master computer, exploring each character's unique environment and confronting disturbing psychological dilemmas to outwit the machine. Based on Harlan Ellison's story, the adventure deals with dark fears and adult themes in a tense, unsettling tone.

A classic fantasy role-playing game in which players assemble a party of six companions and enter an ancient castle to retrieve the Cosmic Forge, a magical pen that altered the river of time. Progress comes through turn-based combat, spellbooks, skills, puzzles, and encounters with cryptic NPCs across a continuous journey.

A political strategy game in which the player becomes president or prime minister of a simulated Western industrialized nation, adjusting laws and policies to address crime, unemployment, debt, terrorism, and climate change while modeling the motivations of individual voters and pressure groups.

A platform-racing game where the player rides motocross bikes across obstacle-laden, ramp-ridden courses, performing FMX tricks and choosing branching paths while competing for track records and playing custom tracks built by the community.

Players rule a Caribbean island as El Presidente, guiding it from colonial times into the modern era through city building, research, trade fleets and dynasty management. Up to four players can cooperate or compete, sharing resources or declaring war on shared island maps.

Players command heroes across a 300-year war, marrying them to produce children with inherited genetic traits and managing an aging party where death is permanent. Fallen heroes' weapons can become relics passed down through houses, demanding long-term planning dozens of years ahead.

Players defend a fantasy kingdom from orcs, trolls, and evil wizards by placing and upgrading towers, casting spells, and commanding heroes across forests, mountains, and wastelands. Cartoon hand-to-hand battles and boss fights unfold across a multi-stage campaign with bonus modes.

Players evolve a deadly pathogen from Patient Zero, adapting traits and abilities against humanity's defenses to end civilization, all within a realistic simulation of global infection, with multiple disease types, scenarios, competitive and co-op multiplayer, and user-created content.

An adventure game with tactical battles, RPG and strategy elements set in a ruthless medieval world of old Germany where superstition comes alive. The player leads a small feudal army, equips each fighter, and follows a non-linear story, choosing between conscience, power and justice while risking the loss of troops and gold.

A digital adaptation of the classic fantasy board game, players roll dice to move characters across a perilous land, drawing adventure cards, fighting monsters, and building power in a race to reach the Crown of Command. Up to five friends can play online or in hot-seat mode.

Players control Agent 47 as he travels the globe eliminating international terrorists and crime bosses, improvising with disguises and environmental objects while evading squad-based enemy tactics. The setting spans criminal underworld locations, and the tone is dark and tense, focused on stealthy assassination.

Special agent Francis York Morgan investigates the brutal murder of a young woman in the small town of Greenvale, exploring an open world of locals, side quests, and mini-games while supernatural creatures and an axe-wielding killer threaten his investigation.

Set in a World War 2 Europe overrun by the undead, players fight through zombie-infested Berlin alone or in four-player co-op to secure sacred artefacts. Combat emphasizes third-person sniping with an X-ray kill cam, traps, turrets, and survival against overwhelming hordes.

A side-scrolling exploration game where a mute sprite with growing powers travels an underground world of tunnels, running, jumping and climbing through over 1,800 rooms to ring six bells of fate before a chain reaction destroys the planet.

As a divine being, the player commands a tribe of dwarves on a randomly generated island, digging layers of earth, building a fortress, crafting gear and feeding the settlers while fending off underground monsters and portal-spawned waves. Spells and traps help defend the growing colony.

Players design a pretender god and command one of over sixty nations in a turn-based fantasy strategy game, wielding vast magic, monsters, and rituals to achieve ascension to godhood across three eras.

Toribash is an online turn-based fighting game where players control individual joints of a ragdoll body to design their own martial arts moves, competing in unique physics-driven fights with extensive character customization, tournaments, and a built-in mod maker.

A real-time tactical strategy game where the player commands a SWAT team during interventions, planning routes, choosing equipment and breach points, and coordinating troopers to reach hostages before criminals react, with non-linear levels, a mission editor and two-player online co-op.

Players draw a stickman and then draw tools, weapons, and environmental elements to guide him through a fantastic world. Using pencils, they solve puzzles and overcome obstacles across 14 non-linear levels plus a hidden bonus level, with secrets and achievements encouraging replay.

In a near-future post-apocalyptic Michigan wasteland, the player takes turn-based actions to scavenge supplies, craft gear, manage hunger, thirst, and temperature, and fight or avoid threats while piecing together their own identity, with permadeath and no leveling.

Surviving prisoners crash onto the planet Auriga and must form a team of heroes, gather Dust to power rooms, and build defenses to hold off waves of monsters. Players carry a crystal through procedurally generated dungeon levels, decode Endless ruins, and fight toward the surface, with four-player co-op.

In a world abandoned by gods and scarred by Titans, the player sets out to reclaim a shattered life, freely exploring medieval towns, mines, and a shadow world while choosing among three guilds. Combat mixes weapons with crystal magic, and quests branch in how they can be tackled and resolved.

As the Devil, players run a monsters-only apartment building, luring residents with rent and furniture while keeping them happy, then calling them to battle against invading heroes in tower defense fights, with procedurally generated monster traits and family reputations.

A horror game set in an old cabin in the woods where the Lodger must stay awake and sane until dawn, hiding from nightmarish Guests, repairing the house, and searching for a lost key that may explain whether the visitors are real or imagined.

Shipwrecked on an isolated island, players gather food, water, and shelter while collecting Survival Guide pages and crafting over 100 weapons and tools to fend off zombie-like monstrosities. Three characters with distinct skill trees, four explorable islands, and co-op challenges round out the survival experience.

A bridge-building puzzle game where the player designs and constructs bridges over valleys, canals and rivers, choosing wood, steel, cables or concrete within a budget, then stress-tests them as cars and trucks cross or the structures collapse under physics.

A fast-paced 2D shooting game following three migrants traveling west along a wagon trail, with short semi-randomly sequenced scenes where the party faces buffalo, bears, snakes, avalanches and sharks, and members die permanently without checkpoints.

An old-school isometric turn-based RPG set in a distant future where humanity survives in underground metro station-states. The player explores and fights amid warring factions, using varied weapons, psionic powers, stealth, lockpicking, hacking and an elaborate crafting system.

Command the military forces of 17 nations in a 1991 Cold War conflict across Asian battlefields, deploying meticulously reproduced tanks, aircraft, warships and infantry. Players assemble armies for tactical real-time battles in dynamic single-player campaigns or large multiplayer matches.

Play as an ordinary structural analyst surveying routine damage who becomes caught in a fight for survival amid past schemes. Armed only with a camera and wits, the player solves puzzles through a detailed city infrastructure, with choices determining who survives.

Players run a Power Rangers-inspired TV studio, hiring actors and crafting cardboard mechas, then direct their five jumpsuit-clad heroes in turn-based tactical battles. The pixel-art tactical RPG follows a branching storyline with three endings, blending studio management with dramatic tokusatsu-style combat and giant robot fights.

A digital adaptation of the Mensa Select board game in which players place insect tiles that form the board itself, maneuvering to surround the opposing Queen Bee. It offers local and online play, five AI difficulty levels, hot-seat mode, expansions and asynchronous matches.

Students perform an internet charm and are pulled into a ruined elementary school haunted by vengeful child spirits; players explore in retro 2D adventure style, making choices that alter a chapter-based story with multiple endings.

Robert, a clueless court musician in the hollow world of Asposia, sets out with the mysterious thief Laura to discover why the wind fountains are dying. The player solves tricky puzzles and explores hand-drawn environments in a funny 2D point-and-click adventure.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland overrun by the undead, the player explores, loots, crafts, and builds fortified bases with traps and turrets, fighting zombie hordes and other players in a first-person survival sandbox with RPG progression.

The Impossible Game is a one-button platformer in which the player guides an orange square over spikes and blocks, where any mistake means instant death and a restart, with a synced soundtrack, practice checkpoints, medals, and a level editor for sharing custom levels.

Players build and manage a thriving city on the war-torn continent of Ateria, gathering resources and assembling armies of troops, vehicles, and exotic creatures to battle rebels and rival players across varied terrain, guided by a humorous wartime narrative.

The player takes a week-long trip through Japan alongside two young sisters who act as tour guides, visiting famous sightseeing spots, eating local dishes, and growing closer to them in this guidebook-style visual novel.

A persistent free-to-play WWII campaign where players take Army, Air, or Naval roles across one enormous battlefield and decide attacks, defenses, and strategy themselves. Players earn Victory Points through supportive play to unlock premium units, join squads, and serve in High Command.

A fourteen-year-old princess inherits a throne after her mother's death and must survive court intrigue, hostile neighbors, and magical threats until her coronation. Players make choices that shape her education and fate, balancing politics and danger in a narrative-driven kingdom.

Divide By Sheep is a math puzzle game in which the Grim Reaper floods the world and the player solves addition and subtraction puzzles to ferry sheep, wolves, and pigs across sinking islands, with difficulty and dark humor escalating across 120 levels.

A space strategy and action game set in a post-apocalyptic galaxy where the player scavenges, builds modular ships from salvaged parts, forms factions and fights for scarce resources among two hundred persistent AI captains who pursue their own goals in a living, non-player-centric galaxy.

Players wake naked on a hostile island and must survive wildlife, environment, and other survivors by gathering resources, building bases, and raiding rivals. Procedurally generated worlds support farming, electricity, vehicles, and server modding in an ongoing multiplayer survival sandbox.

Players drive double-decker and articulated buses along Spandau routes, following original timetables and managing vehicle systems and malfunctions. A chronology feature lets them experience the Berlin district between 1986 and 1994, capturing the changes after reunification.

A creature born from the Void appears in a colorful world and must use five colors to alter ground physics and transform the environment while fleeing the Void that chases and destroys everything in its path.

An intrigue-filled mystery adventure aboard the 1914 Orient Express on the eve of World War I. As American doctor Robert Cath, investigate your friend's murder by exploring carriages, eavesdropping on conversations, and making choices that lead to multiple endings.

A hidden-object adventure in which Count Dracula, weakened after his last battle, allies with his enemy Van Helsing to stop the Queen of Vampires from destroying humanity, traveling the world for the Knights of the Order of the Dragon across many locations and puzzles.

Susan Ashworth, a lonely 40-year-old on the verge of suicide, encounters five strangers who change everything; the player moves her through a suspenseful psychological horror story with stylized art, simple keyboard controls, and an atmospheric soundtrack.

A cute 3D platformer starring a tiny space-travelling girl who stitches magical hats to gain powers. She jumps, climbs, and fights across five large worlds to recover her scattered fuel, encountering quirky factions and unique missions along the way.

The player guides a small band of settlers in a procedurally generated forgotten land, securing food, building shelter, and defending against raiders while managing moods and expanding a town. Settlers take jobs that level up into new classes, and extensive modding tools let players customize the world and share creations.

A psychological horror game inspired by the developer's struggle with mental illness. Thomas wakes from a nightmare into deeper dreamscapes, hiding from apparitions and outrunning inner demons while uncovering what is real, with a branching narrative and three endings.

Players survive in an endless block-built world, gathering raw materials to craft weapons and tools while building structures and defending against zombies, dragons, and skeletons. Modes range from randomized permadeath endurance runs to creative building with enemies disabled, playable solo or in online co-op.

Command the United Civilized States or the Eurasian Dynasty in a 22nd-century war over the last natural resources. This real-time strategy campaign spans over fifty missions with mechs, tanks, aircraft and ships, plus formations, escorts and other tactical orders.

Players command factions in a far-future real-time strategy trilogy spanning nine campaigns and skirmish battles, building fortified bases and deploying over 100 units across land, air, and sea while facing cunning AI opponents and internal betrayal.

A medieval real-time strategy and settlement simulation set in 1200 A.D. Anglo-Saxon times. As a palace guard captain, the player builds a prosperous economy, arms troops, and fights to reclaim provinces for the king across two campaigns and multiplayer battles.

A NATO team led by Cole Sullivan enters a sealed former Soviet secret city overrun by deformed creatures, exploring the area, developing characters through dialogue choices, and fighting tactical turn-based battles while uncovering the truth behind the disaster.

A young Junker woman named Maya is drawn into a global catastrophe on a multi-level world orbiting a giant Biocomputer, and must gather allies to fulfill an ancient prophecy before the continents converge. The fantasy RPG blends turn-based and real-time combat across many explorable locations.

An atmospheric medieval action game set in a world split by a bottomless rift between the lands of Light and the barren Outlands of Darkness. Players fight through two story campaigns with twelve character classes and over twenty-five fantasy missions.

In a mystical fantasy world threatened by corruption, the player forms a hero across eight RPG chapters of dungeons and strange companions, then commands loyal subjects in 24 real-time strategy missions to restore Prince John to his father's kingdom.

Crash-landed on an alien world, the player builds automated mining and assembly lines, researches technologies, and digs deep underground. The factory must be defended from waves of alien attacks with turrets while power systems are developed and expanded.

A roguelike survival game where the player remotely pilots drones through procedurally generated derelict spaceships using a command line interface, scavenging upgrades and fuel while avoiding unseen creatures, and piecing together the fate of a dead universe from corrupted ship logs.

A billiards simulation built around a realistic physics engine, letting players pull off trick shots with or without aiming assists and replay them in slow motion. Online or offline play is supported, alongside cosmetic customization of balls, cues, tables and locations.

A remastered HD version of the survival horror action game, running at 60 frames per second with upgraded visuals, widescreen support, and bonus content including the Separate Ways epilogue. The description focuses on technical improvements rather than gameplay details.

Set in 1268 England amid a vacant throne, the player rules a small county, managing crops, taxation, trade and castle construction across seasonal turns while fighting rivals in real-time battles to become the undisputed lord of the realm.

As a squad commander in 1943, the player leads a small multinational team behind enemy lines in turn-based tactical missions, choosing the Axis or Allied campaign while uncovering a mysterious rising power. Fully destructible 3D environments and authentic WWII weaponry support careful planning and multiple approaches to each mission.

In 1954 San Francisco, a jailed heist planner and his wife each pursue hidden loot, with players switching between them and making choices that shape the outcome. The point-and-click adventure mixes challenging puzzles, shady criminals, and a gritty comic-style 1950s setting with Beat and jazz atmosphere.

A point-and-click adventure set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland where mutated insects inhabit a bomb shelter. Two roach buddies, Jim and Bud, journey toward the surface, crawling along walls and ceilings, exploring secret underground areas, and communicating through humorous nonverbal means in a comic-styled 3D world.

Young Edna and her talking stuffed bunny Harvey attempt a whacky escape from a padded cell, journeying across an insane asylum and beyond. The point-and-click adventure delivers over 20 hours of twisted humor, crazy characters, and comic-style visuals.

Players act as mayor building and maintaining a modern city from the ground up, balancing services, economy, traffic, and districts while managing day and night cycles, with extensive modding support.

A fairy-tale-inspired RPG told in verse and rhyme, following Aurora through the painted world of Lemuria as she battles enemies with an Active-Time Battle System alongside the firefly Igniculus and a party with skill trees, aiming to recover the sun, moon and stars.

An officially licensed rally racing game recreating the 2013 FIA World Rally Championship season, where players drive 65 cars across 78 courses in 13 countries through varied weather and surfaces, building a career and racing online against up to 16 players.

Players race through the official MXGP motocross championships in the MX1 and MX2 categories, competing on faithfully reproduced tracks and building a career from a debut season toward official team offers, with dual-stick control separating bike and rider physics.

Players gather survivors and rebuild a ruined city after a zombie apocalypse, making strategic decisions about farms, fortifications, housing, and hospitals while fending off raiders, illness, starvation, and madness. The strategy sim blends 4X-style city rebuilding with narrative events and dark humor.

Playing as Rif the Fox, the player must clear his name after the Orb of Storms is stolen, traveling through hostile lands and ancient human ruins via point-and-click exploration, conversations, and puzzles in a world of anthropomorphic animals.

This enhanced edition of the classic RPG continues the Bhaalspawn saga through the Shadows of Amn and Throne of Bhaal campaigns, plus arena battles. Players build characters from many classes, recruit companions, and fight tactical real-time-with-pause battles in the Forgotten Realms.

Sam "Serious" Stone and his squad of misfit commandos battle Mental's alien hordes across a ravaged Earth. Players circle-strafe and backpedal through overwhelming enemy numbers, wielding an arsenal of devastating weapons in a chaotic campaign playable solo or in four-player co-op.

Astrobiologist Rachel Manners wakes alone on a damaged space probe orbiting an unknown planet, and with the ship AI and a reconnaissance robot she repairs the vessel and investigates the fate of her crew and the artificial signal.

Max Gentlemen is an arcade-style manners simulator about stacking hats, inspired by a spam email. The player collects over 39 hats, competes on online leaderboards, and challenges friends in local multiplayer across extra characters, levels, and modes.

A classic 2D platformer following Oozi, an alien pilot who crashes on Earth, loses his spacesuit, and must find his way home. It offers hand-drawn HD visuals, four difficulty levels from Kid to Hardcore, boss fights, and a challenge mode.

Players become Paul Prospero, an occult-minded detective investigating a missing boy and a trail of murders in Red Creek Valley. The first-person story-driven mystery focuses on exploration, observation, and communicating with the dead, with no combat, emphasizing atmosphere and mood.

A detailed truck driving simulation where players maneuver a Scania R-series through licensing challenges, obstacle courses, precision parking, and competition-inspired disciplines, plus freeform delivery missions across a 3D city and extreme driving scenarios.

Players take control of a powerful Pretender God ruling a nation and aspiring to godhood, choosing their divine form and how their Dominion affects lands and followers. To become the new Pantokrator they must defeat rival pretenders through conquest, extinguishing dominions, or claiming the Thrones of Ascension in a fantasy 4X turn-based strategy game.

Players control Edward Carnby through an episodic, action-packed journey across a dark re-creation of Central Park in New York, fighting enemies with weapons and vehicles while uncovering a conspiracy behind a terrifying supernatural threat.

After being ambushed following a heist, the rogue Sneaky sneaks through shadows, dashes between cover, and shoots, stabs and loots across the land to reclaim twice-stolen treasure, gaining experience to upgrade attributes and finding items to fight numerous monsters.

After bandits burn his family farm and his father vanishes, an ordinary young man sets out to become a hero. Players explore a picturesque isometric landscape with simple point-and-click controls, gathering resources and helping others in a stress-free, unhurried RPG.

A roguelike RPG set in the lore-rich world of Eyal, where the player picks from many unique races and classes, explores randomly generated dungeons, and fights tactical turn-based battles while building a tailored mix of abilities and powers across unlockable progression.

As a lone cop with a sniper rifle and pathogen-coated bullets, the player shoots exploding zombies to trigger chain reactions across 100 levels, earning medals and cash to buy upgrades and stop the outbreak in Redfield.

A strategy RPG prequel in which a young officer named Sieghart encounters a strange girl and changes the world's fate. Players fight turn-based battles across a multi-generational story, choosing light or darkness, crafting gear, and selecting brides to shape future heroes.

As Aveline, a mixed-heritage Assassin in 1765 Louisiana, the player hunts and eliminates enemies using machete, blowpipe, whip and pistols, navigating the bayou and swamps while uncovering a story set before the American Revolution.

Players follow interwoven stories of soldiers and a faithful dog through the trenches of World War I, solving puzzles, sneaking past enemy lines, and exploring historical Western Front locations in an emotional animated comic-book adventure.

Players create a personalized 3D avatar and enter a simulated social casino, playing Texas Hold'em, roulette, slots, blackjack, and video poker at low or high stakes tables while earning clothing rewards and climbing seasonal leaderboards.

A reclusive neurobiologist and a street magician recruit test subjects at Oxford, but inexplicable incidents begin to occur, drawing players into a gothic mystery that blends science and the supernatural across eight chapters while playing both characters.

A stealth puzzle comedy compilation in which the player sneaks around a neighbour's house and a cruise liner, setting elaborate pranks and traps on the unsuspecting resident while avoiding detection, presented as episodes of a reality TV show with cartoon visuals.

The player controls a stylish executioner slicing, dicing, and shooting enemies through action combat. A Nightmare difficulty demands tactical use of specific attacks, while theater mode and bonus outfits expand the experience.

Players build and expand a space empire across vast procedurally generated galaxies, exploring star systems, negotiating with alien empires and pirates, and managing private enterprise in a pausable real-time 4X strategy game with storylines, victory conditions, and open-ended sandbox play.

Tex Murphy, an old-school detective in dystopian post-war San Francisco, wakes with seven years of his memory erased and must retrace his steps through murders, hidden agendas, and lost Tesla technologies. The player explores 3D environments, solves logic puzzles, and picks dialogue in branching paths toward five endings.

Players create a character and roam the medieval land of Calradia, raising armies, trading, crafting, and managing fiefdoms while fighting large real-time battles in first or third person, with multiplayer PvP and mod support.

Set on Pandora's moon between the first two Borderlands games, players shoot and loot through low-gravity lunar landscapes using ice and laser weapons and new vehicles. The story follows Handsome Jack's rise to power, with four new character classes and a blend of shooter and RPG mechanics.

A puzzle-adventure game following Esteban, Zia and Tao through levels across China, from Asian forests to the Forbidden City, solving puzzles, avoiding traps, and evading the villain Zarès' men while searching for the local City of Gold.

As struggling author and bookstore owner Gabriel Knight, investigate savage ritual killings in New Orleans and their link to voodoo mysteries. This remastered murder-mystery adventure adds new puzzles, scenes, and high-resolution 3D graphics to the 1993 original.

Players recruit and lead flawed heroes through twisted forests, warrens, and crypts to reclaim an ancestral estate, battling monsters and psychological stress in a challenging gothic turn-based RPG with permadeath and procedural dungeons.

A first-person shooter comedy set during a zombie pandemic, where the infected hero must drink beer to stave off turning while gunning down zombies, balancing sobriety against carnage as he searches for his girlfriend and a way out.

A dungeon management game where the player controls the Dungeon Lord, building a network of dungeons, recruiting monsters, defending against heroes, and then venturing to the overworld to wage tactical real-time war on human cities.

A free-to-play 3D simulator and interactive encyclopedia of firearms, letting players examine, fire, cut away, and fully disassemble hundreds of historical and modern guns down to the smallest part. Learning, armorer, and timed modes plus shooting ranges, paint mode, and quizzes reward mastery of each model.

Players take turns drawing cards to score points, weighing risk against reward since any draw could bust their turn. Card special powers like Swords, Mystics, and Chest-and-Key combos drive strategic play, while dozens of tournaments and eighteen customizable traits add variety to this PC card game.

Players race top-down cars through over 200 events across two cities and 60 tracks, drifting through varied weather, buying and upgrading vehicles, and climbing driver rankings in career mode or online multiplayer with up to 12 players.

Players survive onslaughts of aliens, zombies, and mutant creatures in a top-down arena shooter, unlocking weapons and stacking perks as they level up through quest chapters and multiple survival modes, playable solo or in local co-op.

Bwana, Kito, and Lina descend below the metropolis of St. Armando searching for the mysterious Underland, uncovering a conspiracy about Captain Kaonandodo while dodging pirates and the law in the foggy town of Port Artue.

In Paris, a gallery robbery and murder send American George Stobbart and journalist Nico Collard chasing a stolen painting and a conspiracy rooted in ancient mysteries. Armed with logic and humor, they solve riddles and survive threats in classic point-and-click adventure style.
