An adventure-roleplaying game set in the enchanted world of Driftmoon, where an ancient evil threatens a home village and a young man allies with a firefly, a panther queen, and a skeleton to journey through a magical land full of quests, characters, and humor.

A story-driven strategy game set in a land resembling modern Japan, where a proxy war is fought between human-shaped tanks of two rival kingdoms. Players fight turn-based battles across over 30 maps, spend resources to develop and customize tanks, and see multiple endings based on performance.

Girls Like Robots is a puzzle game where the player arranges moody characters so each sits next to their friends, sometimes breaking hearts to save the day. Across three acts and 110 puzzles, an epic tale of love, volcanoes, and planetary invasion unfolds over a stringband soundtrack.

A free-to-play fantasy MMORPG where the player explores handcrafted realms, battles monsters and bosses in cooperative PvE, masters gathering and crafting, designs a homestead, joins a shared village, and develops one of ten combat specializations across multiple platforms.

Playing as a renegade sorcerer sealed inside a magical tome, the player assembles a party of monsters, fights heroes in strategic turn-based battles, and solves environmental puzzles to escape the prison and regain lost powers.

An open-world puzzle game starring a boar who digs through an underground world of mines, temples, and laboratories, learning how surrounding blocks behave and piecing together a forgotten history at the player's own pace.

A visual novel following a girl with a failing heart and a boy with a terminal illness who meet in a hospital and travel together, confronting disease, suffering, and death in a quiet, melancholic story.

Players are lootmancers in a roguelite deckbuilding adventure where magical coins serve as both weapons and currency in duels. Coins looted from chests and enemies become future moves, so spending must be planned carefully across randomly generated levels with permanent death and 19 unlockable classes.

After crash-landing on an alien ocean planet, players dive through reefs and trenches, managing oxygen while scavenging resources to craft gear and build underwater habitats. They unravel the mystery of the crash and the infecting sea life while avoiding predators.

As an employee of Polar Sanitation Inc, the player cleans up the bloody aftermath of Santa's violent breakdown across his workshop, using mops, gloves and sniffer tools to remove gore and debris. The janitorial sandbox also allows making more mess and playing with physics, alone or in co-op.

Players take the role of Harkyn, a branded sinner, fighting through a grim dark fantasy world to stop a malevolent god's return. The game offers Soulslike melee combat, magic, loot, boss battles, and gameplay-affecting choices across human and demonic realms.

In a zombie-infested open city, the player scavenges, crafts combo weapons and vehicles, and fights to escape before a military strike destroys everything. The action-heavy survival horror can be played alone or with a friend, with character customization and experience carrying between modes.

Players battle through waves of cute enemies in a light-hearted turn-based RPG inspired by 16-bit classics, growing characters and customizing equipment and skills. They explore a diverse world, solve puzzles, and save the world amid cringey dialogue, immature humor, and video game references.

Players craft and share 2D pixel-block worlds in a sandbox where over 200 physics elements interact, from water and lava to circuits and lasers. A mission-based campaign and free create mode let players build contraptions, pixel art, and chiptune music, with larger PC worlds and all elements unlocked.

A first-person adventure set inside the fragile human mind, where the player explores the town of Pinwheel to unfold a patient's story. An optional deeper path offers challenging pen-and-paper style environmental puzzles, letting players choose between narrative exploration and complex puzzle solving.

A single-player turn-based dungeon crawler set in Frostmourn Keep beneath the World's End Mountains, where the player builds a classless rogue from talents, spells and heritages to overthrow the king through randomly generated dungeons and permanent death.

Players connect shapes to fill each board in a minimalist puzzle game, working through hundreds of pre-built levels plus an endless stream of procedurally generated daily puzzles, accompanied by soothing dynamic audio and unlockable colour palettes.

The player is an adventurer fleeing an encroaching shadow that advances from the left with every action, racing rightward through procedurally generated worlds to defeat a Demon Lord. Each run offers new monsters, allies, shops and classes, with time-freezing and inventory storage to aid repeated attempts.

After a storm-triggered apocalypse unleashes the living dead, survivors rebuild by cultivating a farm and running a restaurant to feed their community. Players grow crops, raise animals, upgrade the restaurant, and defend against vegetarian zombies using mazes and towers.

A quirky adventure RPG hybrid on the whimsical island of Geos, where Lili meets comedic locals, explores colorful environments, solves puzzles, completes quests, and confronts an oppressive regime, with collectible hats and spirit encounters.

A classic real-time strategy game in which players command armies of mythological creatures like Minotaurs and Cyclopes and call on gods for aid, flattening enemy towns with meteors or lightning storms. The extended edition adds the Titans expansion, a campaign, improved visuals, and multiplayer features.

Defend cows from a Martian invasion by building towers, traps, and wacky machines across seasonal levels, while firing a zapper directly at quirky little green men in this tower defense and time management hybrid.

Detective Sebastian Castellanos investigates a mass murder and awakens in a deranged world of hideous creatures and shifting environments. With limited resources, players fight for survival through brutal traps and twisted horrors in this survival horror action game.

Players dock with randomly generated spaceships, sneak past or fight crews in slow-motion gunfights, and use gadgets like teleporters and stealth shields to complete missions. Each life is a new character working toward a personal heist while liberating stations across the galaxy.

A 3D puzzle platformer in which the player flings, swings, and climbs across 90 levels using a gooball that reacts differently to each surface, with sandbox puzzles, cannons, secrets, checkpoints, unlimited lives, and a speed run mode.

Players command massive armies as a general across World War II campaigns, from Russian snows to North African sands, in a turn-based strategy game with hundreds of scenarios and expansions. Core forces carry through the war, with mods and human opponents extending replayability.

Commanding the mobile headquarters Avenger, the player leads remnant XCOM forces in turn-based tactical guerrilla combat against alien occupiers ruling Earth, recruiting soldiers, researching upgrades, and igniting a global resistance across procedurally varied missions.

A point-and-click adventure in which Sadwick, an unusual hero, sets out to understand recurring nightmares of a blue sphere and a collapsing world. An oracle named Shana warns that he is the cause of the coming doom, so players solve puzzles and meet strange characters across a fantastical world.

Players take on a blood-soaked quest for vengeance as either Yuki, a mentally unraveling prisoner with machine arms, or the Dishwasher, a reanimated samurai, fighting the corrupted leaders of society. It is a fast-paced, combo-driven 2D action platformer with a gritty graphic-novel art style.

A choose-your-own-adventure game for one to four players that randomly generates a unique story each time, following a town's locals as they live their lives before the dreaded Yawhg arrives, with their decisions determining one of over 50 endings.

Set in 19th century Sweden, you venture into dark woods on a vision quest, solving cryptic puzzles and listening for clues while learning folklore creatures from an encyclopedia, seeking to foresee whether your loved one will love you back.

Set on Mars in an alternate Cold War era, Super Motherload is a couch co-op digging adventure for up to four players. Players pilot mining pods for Solarus Corporation, purchasing upgrades and solving explosive puzzles while uncovering a branching story with multiple endings.

Sports Bar VR recreates a virtual pub where players hang out with friends and play bar games including pool, darts, air hockey, rampball, chess, and shuffleboard. Players compete online or against AI, earn tickets to unlock cosmetics, and freely throw and smash objects around the bar.

A visual novel set on a colonized moon in the far future, following young Haru as he chases an impossible dream by gambling his capital on the stock market, guided by two harsh rules about never taking a loss.

Players traverse the cyberpunk city of Harbor Prime as a hunted fugitive, choosing to fight, hack, or talk their way past a far-reaching organization. The 2D action-RPG offers real-time combat, character customization, augmentations, and a hacking mechanic that dives into Cyberspace.

A third-person supernatural horror game in which Linda, a high school student, is trapped in an abandoned Indonesian town with her friends. Armed with a smartphone and camera, she battles sinister beings, solves puzzles, and develops strange powers while uncovering the town's dark secrets.

X-Plane 11 is a detailed flight simulator where the player sets up and flies aircraft using a redesigned interface, 3D cockpits, and realistic avionics. It simulates living airports with ground vehicles and European cities, offering a modern, realistic aviation experience.

Playing as a Warrior, Wizard, Assassin or Shaman, the player descends into procedurally generated dungeons to defeat an evil Dark Lord who stole all light. Turn-based combat, loot, tomes, shops and permadeath drive repeated runs through a retro 16-bit world.

Run, jump, and slide to the rhythm of your own music library as Melody, with audio detection algorithms adapting the obstacle course in real time to the intensity of each song. Collect floating light orbs synced to the beat across four difficulty modes.

The player undertakes a time-pressed quest through Darkwood Forest to recover the missing pieces of the legendary Hammer of Stonebridge, a dwarven artifact protecting villagers from ancient doom. Adapted from a classic gamebook, it presents a full-colour interactive adventure with dice-based battles, auto-mapping and stat tracking.

Waking in a hospital with no memory in a 2035 Buenos Aires under paramilitary control, the player guides Christian and fellow patient Victoria through point-and-click puzzles to escape the guards and uncover the truth behind the city's destruction.

A classic European fantasy RPG in which the player must unite elves and dwarves against orc invaders, using over 70 spells and 50 skills within a pen-and-paper ruleset, aided by an autodiary and automap across a medieval setting.

The player explores a seaside town, its dungeons and underwater regions in a classic European fantasy RPG, following a sinister plot against the city's leaders while managing a party under pen-and-paper rules with adjustable difficulty.

Players lead a hero through the fantasy world of Ether across five campaigns, mixing role-playing progression with tactical turn-based card battles. Hundreds of spells and creatures support deck-based dueling, and multiplayer modes include co-op battles and a round-robin tournament.

Players own and operate an auto repair shop, interacting with customers, ordering parts, purchasing manuals, and performing over 120 repair tasks across eight car models. Expansion content adds 4x4 off-road vehicles and a quarter-mile test track for tuned cars.

Players take the wheel of licensed American trucks, hauling cargo across California, Nevada, and Arizona while building a freight company from hired driver to owner-operator. The simulation covers detailed truck customization, varied trailers, realistic brake and transmission settings, and company management.

On a colonized Mars, corporate titans compete to build profitable companies. The player acquires resources, builds and sells goods, and manipulates a real-time player-driven market, using economic pressure rather than weapons to dominate rivals in single-player or multiplayer.

In 2088, the player commands humanity's first interstellar starship, exploring a vast living universe, landing on exotic planets, meeting alien civilizations, and assembling a fleet to defend Earth from hostile galactic powers.

Starting in 1900 with little money, players build a business empire in this economic simulation, choosing products to manufacture, sourcing raw materials, setting retail prices, paying wages, and operating a transport network across 20 maps and a 20-mission campaign.
Players help Trey and the Tribloos save their island from unnatural storms by planning and managing resources across over 90 levels, traveling far from home to uncover the source of the weather.

A prophecy names the player as the Great Champion who must oppose a conspiracy within the Circle of Mages and the invading army of Lord Barrowgrim. The action RPG offers class skills, loot, and a co-op story mode for up to eight players across a long campaign.

An adventure through a city full of card-nuts and lunatics, where players battle for eight legendary cards to enter the city's biggest competition. The card battle system breaks from fantasy TCG conventions by connecting cards to form combos, with 180 unique cards collected by playing the singleplayer story.

Ralph, a legendary hero reduced to Level 1, must summon over thirty magical girls to fight through dungeons on his quest to defeat the Demon Lord. The RPG mixes serious dungeon crawling with comedy that pokes fun at RPG tropes, plus side quests, housing upgrades, and character scenes.

The first chapter of a four-part RPG series where players journey across a massive world to stop a power-crazed lunatic from enslaving humanity. Players recruit a party, fight turn-based battles, learn skills at academies, run a farm and hunt treasure.

The player joins a multiplayer first-person shooter about tense deals, double-crosses, and car chases, where rival corporations trade or seize colored disks for money and power. Modes include open-ended corporate competition, a round-based variant, and a hidden-role mode where a secret Eliminator hunts a Savior protected by another player.

A narrative-driven isometric RPG set in the Ninth World, where the player is a new mind born in a body once used by the Changing God and hunted by the Sorrow. Choices, words, and companions shape a philosophical story, with a Crisis system mixing combat, puzzles, stealth, and social interaction.

Players fight through ninja battles with over 100 characters from the Naruto universe, using new combo jutsu and combined attacks, plus a four-ninja tournament mode and the untold origins of the Akatsuki woven into gameplay.

Players take on an experimental minimalist sport game with five modes, chasing an ending through psychedelic effects and electronic music. The short arcade experience emphasizes reflexes and includes jokes and LOLcats alongside flashing-light warnings.

A realistic racing simulator built with support from real teams and drivers, featuring the Brazilian Stock Car V8 season plus extra series and tracks, with ongoing free updates adding content and improving the driving experience.

Players fight through neon-soaked levels as several factions whose violent paths intersect, using varied weapons and melee attacks against punishing opposition. The brutal finale to the saga pairs relentless top-down combat with a pounding soundtrack and a haze of bloodshed.

Players run and gun as dozens of unlockable bros in a paramilitary squad, blasting terrorist forces through fully destructible side-scrolling levels with chain-reaction explosions, either solo or with up to four players in co-op and competitive modes, plus a level editor for sharing custom stages.

The player skateboards through fifty crafted levels and multiple modes, chaining over 120 tricks and grinds, timing landings precisely, and competing worldwide for high scores on levels and daily randomly selected spots.

An assassin turned campaign manager works for a future rabbit mayoral candidate, clearing three city districts of criminals with cover-based shooting, sliding and diving, while winning over undecided voters. Players pick from nine heroes with distinct weapons and abilities across dynamic missions with surprise mid-level events.

Players guide Sgt. Burden and his crew through six tense chapters of interstellar espionage, from hostage situations to torture scenarios, solving narrative puzzles and moral dilemmas. Every choice weighs team lives against saving the world from genocide, with no clear good or evil.

A heartbroken, broke writer travels the open road to win back a lost love in a story-driven experience where relationships and empathy replace combat, and choices about gender, race, and sexuality shape how NPCs treat the player and which paths open.

After a deadly circus fire, clown Dropsy sets out on an open-world point-and-click journey of redemption, helping strangers, hugging people and talking to animals while uncovering dark secrets about his past. Puzzles are solved at the player's pace, and characters communicate through visual icons rather than text.

Players take the role of either a shark or a diver in dark underwater matches, hunting or defending against AI or other players. Sharks use speed and senses to stalk and tear prey apart, while divers explore for treasure to upgrade weapons and gear in a tense aquatic atmosphere.

A 3D language learning game where the player walks freely through a realistic apartment, clicking everyday objects to hear their names and native-speaker pronunciations in a chosen language, building practical vocabulary at their own pace without timers or rigid lessons.

The player controls a lynx raising cubs in a vast, harsh tundra, hunting prey and protecting the young while seasons shift from blooming summer to bitter winter. Exploration, stamina and maternal care drive the experience in a quiet, atmospheric wilderness.

Siblings Wren and Reynold travel through spooky time-bending landscapes, donning costumes that transform into powerful warriors to battle hygiene-obsessed dental soldiers. The RPG adventure has players collect Creepier Treat Cards for turn-based combat and save Halloween.

Set in 2017 amid depleted oil reserves and political collapse, the player joins Russian resistance fighters against a large-scale U.S. military invasion aimed at seizing nuclear weapons and resources, in a third-person 3D action game.

Players take command of Red Army or Wehrmacht forces in the Battle of Kharkov, directing tanks, guns and soldiers across large reconstructed battlefields. Detailed ballistics, morale and weather systems shape each tactical engagement.

The player commands defenses against aliens, taking the fight to their homeworld in a sci-fi tower defense campaign. They place turrets and orbital weapons, deploy a leveling commander unit in power armor for direct attacks, and customize loadouts across twenty levels and endless modes.

A real-time strategy game where players command robot soldiers across thirty levels in six worlds, building forces from air, ground, and sea units while capturing territories to speed resource production. The non-linear plot follows warring robots with a warped sense of humor against Zod's space renegades.

A real-time strategy war game where players command robot soldiers and vehicles in a free environment, racing to capture territory and resources across twenty levels on five planets while humorous cutscenes frame each mission.

A real-time spaceship construction strategy game where the player builds and upgrades modules on a cargo ship while flying through hazardous space, defending against asteroids and pirates in tower-defense-style encounters to deliver shipments quickly and earn reputation.

The player restores a ruined riding stable, renovating stables, a riding hall and a guesthouse to earn money, then builds a breeding stable, raises and trains foals, massages horses for owners, and races cross-country on nine tracks to win the Cup.

Players lead warbands through the ruined Warhammer city of Mordheim in turn-based tactical skirmishes, recruiting and equipping units, looting Wyrdstone and gear, and customizing troops whose losses are permanent. A solo campaign and multiplayer modes pit rival factions against each other amid chaos.

As a Dungeon Lord serving the Dark Mother, players dig and build a multi-layered underground base, run production chains and crafting, manage minion needs, and defend against monsters and humans while raiding the surface, across randomly generated worlds and a narrated campaign.

Mina, a castaway sailor, explores an island inspired by Jules Verne, gathering items left by previous inhabitants and combining them to survive and hope for rescue. She must also fend off a haunting specter and solve the island's deepest secrets.

The player commands European empires in the Napoleonic era, fighting real-time 3D land and naval battles while managing over 50 provinces through a turn-based model in a bid for continental domination.

Adewale, a former slave turned pirate and trained Assassin, is shipwrecked in Saint-Domingue without weapons or crew and must acquire a ship, gather a crew, and free and avenge the slaves in a short single-player campaign.

As a young female inquisitor in a world where God is dead, players destroy a dangerous relic and are drawn into a war between mages and a cult seeking to resurrect the Dead God, exploring many locations and fighting monsters while shaping their own morality.

Love and Hate are trapped in a dark cave after pressing a mysterious red button, and the player uses their opposing forces to influence surroundings and other creatures. By loving or hating the Other Ones, the player solves puzzles across caves, ice, castles, and factories to find a way home.

A robot named Elvis navigates a hostile, appearance-obsessed world by switching his suit to change how the environment reacts, running walls and solving puzzles across six illustrated worlds in a comic-styled platformer adventure.

A boy searches for his lost uncle and stumbles into an imagined world, using his uncle's inventions and a grappling hook to leap and swing through caves, lost civilizations and mystical landscapes in a non-violent first-person platforming adventure focused on story and atmosphere.

A star mechanic in an airship repair shop is drawn into a city-wide conflict after a mysterious customer appears. The story-driven adventure unfolds in a steampunk world of magic and metal, with multiple character classes and an orchestral soundtrack.

In this chapter of a four-part RPG series, the player flees a vampire mage after seizing a relic that can enslave humanity, sailing the high seas and exploring a large world to unlock the gate to Naylith. The journey includes turn-based battles, party management, skill academies, and humorous side quests.

Explore the world of Caspartia, battling monsters and unsavory figures across forests, ruins, caverns, and besieged towns while collecting loot and weapons. Cast spells, solve puzzles, trade spoils, and journey to reclaim a nation from the Hydra Dragon.

Players act as a head of state in a WWI grand strategy game, managing national economy, diplomacy, and military while building trenches, bombarding regions, and waging submarine warfare to shape world events and keep their population from rebelling.

The player becomes the hero of a non-linear fantasy adventure in Magnamund, making meaningful choices, fighting dynamic turn-based battles, picking locks, and solving the Shianti Cube's challenge while customizing a character's disciplines and gear.

As a young dragon in the world of Nimoa, the player flies through twelve large regions, fights the daemon Skarborr's forces in fluid aerial combat, develops spells and abilities, and builds, maintains, and defends human settlements while controlling other characters on side missions.

A healer is summoned to cure the queen of the Eagle Kingdom, but when the infant prince vanishes and the queen is condemned for dark magic, the healer has one day to explore ruins and magical woods, solving hidden-object scenes and puzzles to break the family curse.

A point-and-click adventure in the fantasy world of Aventásia, following four heroes through political intrigue, an assassination plot, and personal troubles as the player solves hundreds of puzzles and switches between characters in a humorous story spoofing famous fantasy works.

Players build bridges across valleys, canals, and rivers in 30 levels, choosing among wood, steel, cable, and concrete, then stress-test their creations against cars and trucks. A tutorial and badge system ease newcomers into physics-based construction across five scenic settings.

As a shadow-wielding assassin summoned by a mysterious girl, the player teleports between shadows, uses shadow powers, and chooses between stealthy ghost-like infiltration or lethal dispatch while fighting the army of Light to rescue Yamiko.

Players fight a spreading fluid-like enemy across terraformable maps, building fortifications and weapons while adapting strategy, and can create, script, and share custom maps and missions through an online database.

A real-time planet simulation and strategy game in which the player manages space colonies, building cities, power plants and factories, researching technologies and trading resources while balancing corporate profit against pollution, climate change and rival factions across nine campaign planets.

In a ruined Buenos Aires of 2035, an amnesiac protagonist escapes a hospital and explores the city's streets with allies, solving puzzles to uncover what destroyed the city twenty years earlier and to reverse the disaster.

Christian returns to the ruins of Buenos Aires to join the Resistance against the tyrant Sergio, teaming with Victoria and Pablo to gather parts of a mysterious device. The point-and-click adventure uses classic 2D graphics, hand-drawn animation, voice acting, and challenging puzzles.

A reimagining of the NES classic where the player, as a boy, feeds jelly beans to his blob companion to transform him into useful objects, solving puzzles and escaping danger across forty levels to dethrone an evil emperor and restore Blobolonia.

A strategy RPG in which the warrioress Eneya, met by the deposed ruler Alexander on his journey home, leads large-scale tactical battles against the legions of Samael, combining real-time movement across the world with turn-based combat and magic.

A ground-based real-time strategy prequel in which players command fleets of land and air vehicles across vast desert maps, managing resources, researching technology, and positioning forces tactically while following Rachel S'jet's expedition to uncover an anomaly.

Players lead a caravan of viking clans across a breaking world in a story-driven role-playing game, making leadership decisions, managing scarce resources, and fighting strategic turn-based battles. Choices carry over from the first game, and fallen characters are permanently lost.

Munin, Odin's raven messenger, is transformed by Loki into a flightless mortal girl and must journey through the nine worlds of Yggdrasil to reclaim her lost feathers. Players rotate and shift parts of the environment to build bridges, move obstacles, and solve physics-based puzzles across 77 levels.

In a film-noir single-player campaign, the player fights through 16 levels of zombie and monster hordes as a top-down shooter, using a large upgradable arsenal, a strategic flashlight against light-fearing enemies, destructible environments, side quests, boss fights and local multiplayer.

Lead a civilization that has just discovered interstellar travel, sending science and construction ships to survey a procedurally generated galaxy, encountering alien species, forging alliances or declaring wars, and shaping a unique empire through exploration, diplomacy, and grand strategy.

Players race motocross and ATV vehicles across over 35 dirt tracks, performing jumps and scrubs in Rhythm Racing, Free Ride open-world maps, and 12-player online races against more than 60 professional riders.

Players control a group of civilians trapped in a besieged city, managing their shelter by day through crafting and trading, and scavenging dangerous locations by night. Life-and-death moral choices shape survival, presented in a charcoal-stylized look inspired by real events.

In an underwater research facility, the player uncovers the truth behind a machine uprising by exploring terminals, documents, and the last inhabitants. Corrupted humans, creatures, and a pervasive AI must be avoided through stealth and wits, since fighting back is impossible.

Commanding a fleet of customizable starships, the player explores new worlds, completes missions against pirates and hostile factions, builds a planetary federation, and pursues multiple paths to victory in a sci-fi strategy adventure.

Take control of any of 193 real countries and steer its economy, diplomacy, and military in a real-time geopolitical simulation, building modular forces and waging wars where alliances shift with the balance of power. Solo scenarios, sandbox mode, and multiplayer for up to 32 players support varied styles of world domination.

Trevor Belmont, knight of the Brotherhood of Light, storms Dracula's castle to avenge his mother, fighting through hidden secrets and mastering dozens of combat moves, magic, and secondary weapons. The gothic action adventure culminates in a boss-rush survival mode with online time comparisons.

Command an empire in a massive-scale 4X/RTS set in space, exploring and colonizing systems, exploiting resources, designing custom ships via blueprint painting, and wielding diplomacy and influence as core mechanics. Research grids, moddability and up to 28-player multiplayer support the grand strategy.

A musical puzzle game in which players carefully listen to piece together the different parts of a song across 25 tracks. Minimal graphics keep focus on the audio, which spans electronic ambient, dubstep, and epic orchestra, making listening the core of the challenge.

A digital multiplayer board game where characters from Orange Juice's games battle with dice and cards across single-player campaigns and online matches for up to four players. Players collect cards, use character-specific abilities, and customize avatars while a dark narrative unfolds.

After being defeated and banished, the goddess Neptune loses her memories and joins companions to journey across four nations of Gamindustri to save the world. Players engage in turn-based JRPG battles, customize difficulty via Plans, and craft equipment.

A shipwrecked sailor explores a cursed island of forgotten cities and blood-soaked dungeons, fighting shambling horrors in fast, brutal 2D combat while discovering, crafting, and upgrading hundreds of weapons, armor pieces, spells, and items in a dark RPG realm.

A young heroine must stop a Frost Giant from freezing the world, exploring a Nordic mythology setting where she survives harsh lands, fights trolls, and solves puzzles. Players customize a warrior, sorceress, or rogue, using inventory and wits alongside combat training to overcome obstacles and monsters.

Sam, an ordinary kid who becomes the superhero Pajama Sam with his red cape, journeys into the land of darkness inside his closet to face his fears. Players explore cartoon locations, collect information, and solve a learning adventure that changes each time it is played.

A point-and-click adventure for kids starring suave agent Spy Fox, who must rescue cow-napped cows and stop William the Kid from depleting the world's milk supply. Players use spy gadgets and Talk Balloons to solve logic puzzles, earn clues through activities, and reach possibly different endings.

Kids help Putt-Putt bounce his pal Pep into the air to pop colorful balloons across 120 arcade-style levels, including hidden bonus rounds. A construction mode lets children build their own levels, with hand-drawn animation and score tracking for many players.

An arcade-style maze game for young children starring Freddi Fish and Luther, who navigate over 50 underwater caverns to collect scattered kelp seeds, with a custom level builder and score tracking for many players.

A point-and-click adventure in which the player wakes in a gloomy asylum after a car accident, bandaged and without memory, and must solve riddles to uncover why they are there. The story sits on a thin line between sanity and madness, in an intense dark world.

Players drive dozens of customizable vehicles across large open-world environments in a physics-driven simulation. Soft-body damage modeling makes crashes visceral, while free roam, delivery scenarios, time trials, and community mods let players experiment with vehicle builds and terrain.

The player manipulates the look, sound, and feel of fifteen surreal landscapes, adjusting eighteen audiovisual dimensions per world to transform terrain and music in real time. It is an immersive, meditative sensory journey through space and time with dynamic interactive music and no combat.

In Victorian England, Jeremiah Devitt investigates a cryptic letter from an old schoolmate, journeying through abandoned manors and underground warrens while uncovering a buried occult secret. Players explore and solve puzzles in a low-resolution point-and-click horror adventure told across four suspenseful episodes.

The player investigates a forgotten underwater city built in Art-Deco style, uncovering spine-chilling secrets and supernatural forces while solving cleverly designed minigames and hidden-object scenes, facing an ancient evil lurking in the deepest chambers of Eden.

Players investigate a carnival's Hall of Mirrors and an alternate dimension behind it, solving hidden-object scenes and minigames to uncover the story of star-crossed lovers and stop an ancient being called the Evil One from breaking its chains. A helper monkey aids the journey through two hand-drawn worlds.

A detective wakes after a storm outside a small Vermont town with no memory of recent events, and must solve an ancient mystery, find a missing teenage girl, and save herself by gathering evidence and working through hidden-object puzzles and riddles.

Players follow a demonic preacher's trail into the misty Ravenwood Park, investigating claw-marked campsites and shadowy secrets. This casual adventure mixes hidden-object and puzzle solving with an evidence board, hand-drawn locations, and a horror-tinged detective story full of plot twists.

A steampunk detective adventure in which Agent Evangeline Glass, aided by a mechanical raven, infiltrates a mountain castle to rescue the vanished Dr. Ink and uncover the cause of worldwide earthquakes, mixing puzzle solving with espionage, glider flights and battles against mechanical creatures.

A young woman returns to her twin sister's wedding in a superstitious village near a feared abyss, uncovering dark secrets through hidden object scenes and mini-games in a hand-painted world of gloomy forests, temples, and castles, aided by a cat companion.

A paranormal private investigator arrives in the coastal town of Serpent Creek to find her missing reporter friend, only to discover snake-infested streets and sleepwalking citizens. Players search crime scenes, combine clues in Detective Mode, and solve puzzles to uncover a 1950s noir mystery.

A private detective boards a ship that vanished years ago and reappeared with no crew or cargo, investigating a supposed curse, a hooded hook-handed figure, and a family's unsolved murder through hidden-object puzzles, an interactive map, and a journal.

A detailed economic simulation of the global automobile industry in which the player designs chassis, engines, and vehicles, manages production lines, factories, marketing, unions, and stock systems, and competes against AI rivals across historically accurate maps and events.

A top-down real-time and turn-based hybrid strategy game where the player commands Union or Confederate troops through ten famous American Civil War battles, coordinating plans, managing supplies and messengers, and adapting to an unpredictable enemy across short, demanding scenarios.

Players design and build a theme park, constructing roller coasters with loops and barrel rolls and adding attractions like monorails and water rides. They manage guest happiness, finances, and park themes such as Ice World or Medieval to grow profits in this classic tycoon simulation.

Players design and manage amusement parks, building roller coasters, rides, and facilities to satisfy visitors across scenarios, including Six Flags parks and themed areas like Wild West and Pirates, using improved building tools and a coaster designer.

The player runs a matchmaking agency under drag queen boss Kitty Powers, pairing procedurally generated clients with candidates and guiding them through awkward conversations and dating dilemmas. Success unlocks new venues, clients and agency upgrades like a salon and gift shop, with voice-over advice throughout.

A turn-based strategy game following a warrior's son whose village was raided, who rises to command an army of archers, scouts, healers and more across hexagonal battlefields in a hand-drawn world, evolving his hero, finding artifacts, learning battle magic, and fighting bosses over three story chapters.

Players simulate a virtual tabletop with physics-based pieces, playing included classics like chess and poker or building original games, RPG dungeons and custom assets, then sharing creations through Steam Workshop with up to ten players online.

A science-fantasy cinematic visual novel following Princess Selphine and her Royal Guardian Ritona, who are teleported to an unknown forest after their homeland is devastated, as they journey home while uncovering who attacked them and what happened to their land.

A realistic tank simulator with tactical elements, split between an operational layer for choosing battlefields, supplying units, and repairing vehicles, and a tactical layer for controlling tanks and commanding attached units. Players fight across four operations as Soviet, Iranian, Iraqi, or Angolan forces with no fixed missions.

As an operator aboard the colony ship Europa, the player uses a visual programming language to command the service droid Algo Bot through over 40 puzzles across five environments, restoring ship systems while a light, bittersweet story with British humor unfolds.

Players control a small, seemingly insignificant creature navigating a dark Norse medieval world inspired by Swedish folklore, solving classic point-and-click puzzles and activating four elemental runes to alter the environment and find a place to belong.

The player layers colored ribbons to match patterns in a minimalist puzzle game, sequencing moves with forethought as puzzles grow larger and harder. Optional perfect clears and recorded sounds accompany each action for players of any age.

Darren Michaels searches for his missing friend Angelina while plagued by intensifying nightmares, a quest that leads from a New England town to Black Mirror Castle in England. The player explores over a hundred atmospheric locations, interacts with dozens of characters, and solves challenging puzzles across six chapters.

Players alternate between two characters as they explore atmospheric locations and interact with many characters to uncover the truth behind nightmares, a past crime, and dark forces haunting Black Mirror Castle in this horror adventure's final chapter.

The player helps Jane and advisor Fey investigate an unnatural winter freezing the magical land of Nearwood, exploring locations, aiding villagers, and uncovering the awakened evil Killiman behind the cold. The hidden-object adventure includes bonus scenes, collectible creatures, and a bonus chapter.

In a post-apocalyptic 2033, play as Artyom, raised in the Moscow Metro, on a mission to warn survivors of an impending threat. Journey through catacombs and toxic surface wastelands, fighting mutants and humans with handmade weapons and a gasmask in atmospheric survival horror.
A man wakes in a town of strangers to find his fiancee missing and a bloody skull on her bed, with only an invitation from a mysterious order as a clue, in this violent adventure game.

A turn-based tactical strategy game set on Second World War fronts. Players command small groups of units using combined-arms tactics such as ambushes, suppressing fire and flanking, while watching troop morale and recon, with multiplayer, a scenario editor and mod support.

Claire Redfield and Moira Burton are abducted and wake in a dark detention facility on a remote island, while Barry Burton searches for his missing daughter with a girl who senses enemies and hidden items. Players alternate between pairs, managing scarce ammo and weapons to survive terrifying creatures in episodic survival horror chapters.

Players drive one of 28 remote-control cars through oversized everyday environments such as museums, supermarkets, and neighborhoods, racing across 13 tracks organized into four cups while navigating household objects as obstacles.

Players control Artyom in post-apocalyptic Moscow's Metro tunnels, fighting mutants and human foes with handmade weapons and a gasmask, choosing between survival-horror and combat-focused play styles amid a civil war over a doomsday device.

Players guide a nation from the Ancient Age to the Information Age in real-time strategy, gathering resources, researching technologies, building Wonders, and commanding land, sea, and air units to conquer rivals across varied maps and a linked campaign.

Set in 1793, players are secret society member Louis de Richet, invited to a private island by Lord Mortimer amid high-profile guests and his mother's disappearance. They investigate a murder mystery, develop skills, and use Social Influence in confrontations where choices carry permanent consequences.

In 1984, Snake awakens from a nine-year coma and builds a private army to pursue the shadow group XOF, carrying out open-world tactical missions with freedom in how to approach objectives, backed by photorealistic visuals and cinematic storytelling about warfare.

A minimalist strategy game where the player designs subway layouts for a rapidly expanding city, drawing routes between stations and constantly redesigning lines to keep commuters moving, across real-world cities and multiple modes including a stress-free sandbox.

Young Elena Elkhorn searches the Willows Mansion for her missing father, using an amulet to astral project into a ghostly realm and speak with the dead. The player solves the mansion's tricks and puzzles and helps lingering souls.

Players explore dungeons and an overworld in classic turn-based roguelike fashion, mixing six class archetypes and over 75 abilities without class restrictions. Heroes crush monsters for loot, and the Dungeonmans Academy home base grows with each run, all wrapped in a light-hearted tone.

Players follow cryptic letters and solve intricate mechanical puzzle devices in ever stranger places, on a time-spanning journey where alchemy meets myth. The enhanced edition adds an epilogue with more content and puzzles.

Players shape a hero or villain in a fantasy land, choosing actions that age and evolve their character while building a reputation through deeds, allies, and followers. A remastered edition adds HD visuals and a punishing Heroic difficulty for veterans seeking a harder challenge.

As Meredith, daughter of the enchantress Salina, players search detailed scenes for hidden objects, collect magical items and solve puzzles to recover the stolen Books of Power. The journey crosses kingdoms of Elves, Humans and Orcs with a map, journal, voiceovers and adjustable difficulty levels.

The player leads a civilization from primitive beginnings through history, expanding cities across hex tiles, researching technology and civics, building districts and wonders, and competing with rival leaders across five paths to victory.

Lead one of eight civilizations on the dying planet Auriga, surviving harsh winters while exploring randomly generated lands, expanding cities, training heroes, trading resources, and waging turn-based battles to achieve victory in a fantasy 4X strategy game.

A turn-based strategy game with RPG elements set in a fantasy world, where the last heir of a slaughtered royal family seeks revenge and the throne. Players move freely across an open world in real time, fight large tactical battles, recruit allies, and risk their hero in combat.

Playing as a professor's assistant, the player enters the subconscious of a comatose young woman via a dream machine, destroying her nightmares and searching for hidden objects, diary pages, and dream catchers to wake her and stop the Sandman's rite.

Six heroes descended from the Titans must stop a former hero corrupted by a magic bracelet that turned him into the dark Master threatening their land. Set in a fantasy world of Slavic hunters, Byzantine traders, and Viking warriors, the RPG involves quests, dialogue, and settlement management.

Set in the fantasy land of Woodland, this RPG draws on Scandinavian and Slavic mythology as rival warriors vie for the empty throne of the Grand Principality. Players craft weapons and armor with magic potions, use battle magic, and manage settlements while seeking the legendary Champion Sword.

The player creates a character and explores a non-linear 3D isometric RPG set in a planet's criminal underworld, fighting enemies in real time with firearms and melee weapons while choosing behavior through a deep dialogue system.

Players command forces in a fast-paced real-time strategy game set in a science fiction universe, where terraforming lets them build or destroy the gameworld environments themselves. The focus is on tactical combat and reshaping terrain to gain advantage.

A standalone tactical RPG in which the player controls one of three dark heroes—an Orc warlord, a Vampire lord, or a Demoness—exploring a large fantasy world, building an army, and fighting deep turn-based battles against the forces of light.

Playing as Arno, a new breed of Assassin, the player uses parkour, stealth, and a revamped combat system to take down targets across an open-world recreation of Revolutionary Paris, witnessing events from the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI.

An arcade-style action adventure in which Lara Croft and up to three co-op partners explore an Egyptian temple, fight hordes of underworld enemies, solve puzzles and dodge traps. Players cooperate through the story while competing for treasure, artifacts and score, with drop-in/drop-out online and offline multiplayer.

In a dark world ravaged by the Thanatos Incident, players create a biological weapon called a Temperion, choose among four races and classes, and fight alongside factions against encroaching darkness on PvP or PvE servers across ruined Ethergia.

A tactical action game following a mercenary chasing a Russian businessman through a Latin American country, navigating political conflict between military and rebels while managing firearms, equipment, and a non-linear storyline with multiple endings.

A shipping company management game where the player builds a fleet of merchant ships, chooses a home harbor among 55 real-world ports, and manages routes, freight loading, and dynamic trade prices. The goal is to balance expenses and profit and expand into the most successful transport empire.

Players operate 16 realistic construction machines from Liebherr, Still, and MAN to excavate foundations, pour concrete, and place roof trusses across a freely navigable world of towns and highways. Successful jobs grow the motor pool and unlock larger contracts, with up to four-player co-op and modding tools.

Players build ocean fortress settlements on the cliffs and waters of the Great Ursee, growing faction populations and unlocking commanders, ships and abilities. They scavenge resources, set trade routes and strike alliances or fight, with a cosy freebuild mode and a total conquest mode available.

Players control a hero from one of Armello's clans, questing, scheming, hiring agents, exploring, fighting monsters and casting spells on a board-game-like map, with the goal of storming the palace and becoming monarch. The fantasy kingdom is threatened by corruption called the rot, and matches blend card tactics, board strategy and role-playing against friends online.

Players place pieces on a board to deflect energy bullets that fire to the beat, guiding them to the exit across 63 levels with distinct soundscapes. Solutions create the music, and a level editor plus Steam Workshop support let players build and share their own rhythm-puzzle stages.

Players join an online action RPG set in a spirit-filled Japan, partying with other players or eight NPC companions and switching weapons mid-battle against Youkai. The story follows a young woman and an Oni child after one of three divine seals shatters and dark forces rise again.

GNOG is a playful 3D puzzle game about exploring monstrous virtual toy heads. Players press, pull, slide and rotate each hand-crafted head to uncover hidden worlds inside, with nine musical levels, a reactive soundtrack, and optional VR support in a tactile, surreal setting.

In a dystopia where wealthy capitalists control elections and media, the player commands a movement of ordinary people rather than a single hero, brawling through streets in couch co-op with unlockable weapons and perks to fight for a better world.

A free online real-time strategy game where players pick one of four races and vie for the Black Gem and dominion in a vast fantasy world, developing cities and heroes even offline, forming clans and alliances, trading, spying and waging ruthless wars against thousands of other players.

Players command one of three factions in a real-time strategy struggle for control of a remote world, emphasizing base-building and balanced combat. A single-player campaign and multiplayer modes let players fight or play as the Shroud and use tech upgrades and Epic units.

Lead a party of four heroes through the post-apocalyptic underground world of Steel, developing talents and gear and fighting tactical turn-based battles against dark powers threatening humanity's last settlements.

Brawlhalla is a free-to-play platform fighter where players battle as legendary characters across ranked 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 matches or casual modes like Capture the Flag, with cross-play across many platforms and a rotating roster of crossover fighters.

Players build a party of companions and explore a fantasy realm, delving into monster-infested dungeons for lost treasures and ancient mysteries. Character customization, faction reputations, and real-time-with-pause or turn-based combat shape a branching story.

Ghost-hunters Nigel Danvers and Lucy Reubans investigate a tale of horror and haunting along England's fog-shrouded coastline, using modern ghost-hunting tools like E.V.P. and night-vision cameras. Players explore creepy locations and solve integrated puzzles in a point-and-click adventure while uncovering secrets hidden from the living.

Playing ghost-hunter Nigel Danvers on Halloween night, the player explores a harbour-side inn and wall, using ghost-hunting gadgets, interviewing locals, and gathering spectral evidence to solve a paranormal mystery in this classic point-and-click adventure.

Players deploy as emergency responders into zombie-infested locations, teaming with up to eight players in co-op to complete missions, scavenge supplies, and survive the horde, where infection and permadeath threaten each character's progress across distinct maps and modes.

The player solves everyday problems in the whimsical style of Rube Goldberg by assembling elaborate chain-reaction machines from odd objects like jack-in-the-boxes and cymbals. Across 18 puzzles, creative solutions are rewarded, and the game is used in schools to teach physics and logic.

Branded enemies of the state, a band of strangers flees through the floating world of Cocoon, fighting to challenge the forces controlling their fate and prevent destruction. The story unfolds through cinematic sequences and a battle system blending action and strategy.

The player travels through time across changing environments, choosing paths that shape the world and untangling temporal threads to witness the full story. Battles use a dynamic clock and cinematic action sequences, and over 150 monsters can be recruited into the party.

A point-and-click adventure in which the suave secret agent Spy Fox must find a hidden off switch at the World's Fair to deactivate a dogbot and stop the villain LeRoach, solving puzzles and mini-games along the way.

Players take on the role of SPY Fox, a secret agent who must stop Poodles Galore from blasting hairspray vapors into the ozone to corner the sunscreen market. The interactive spy adventure features kooky characters, multiple paths, mini-games, and original songs as players save the planet.

A starship-building simulation where the player designs ships for a galaxy-wide market, choosing fuselages and laying out interiors, then trains crews in real-time strategy missions and decides which star systems and business partnerships to pursue across sandbox and campaign modes.

A detailed grand strategy game set in Europe during the Seven Years' War, where players command Prussian and allied armies under Frederick II against the Austrian-led Coalition, maneuvering across over a thousand regions with historical leaders, units, and scenario-based campaigns.

A young superhero afraid of thunderstorms travels to a weather factory in the sky and accidentally throws the world's weather into chaos. The player helps him explore, solve puzzles, play mini-games, and fix broken machines with the help of Thunder and Lightning before Mother Nature notices.

Pajama Sam travels to Mop Top Island where the fats and sweets are quarreling and four delegates have gone missing. Players explore colorful locations, click on objects, talk to food characters, and gather clues to restore peace before dinner. It is a lighthearted, educational point-and-click adventure for children with randomized elements each playthrough.

When an evil ruler taxes his people to starvation, the player helps a humble hero rise to become a champion. The player gathers a band of merry men, uses unique skills to solve puzzles, competes in archery minigames, interacts with good and evil characters, and robs the rich to give to the poor.

A hapless tinkerer on a trash-covered planet schemes to reach the floating city of Elysium, accidentally dragging a woman from there down with him and impersonating her double. Players solve inventory puzzles and follow a comedic point-and-click adventure across a long, dialogue-heavy story.

A third-person graphical adventure following a rich storyline across six chapters and over a hundred locations, including a medieval underground temple, a mental hospital, and a cemetery. Players solve inventory, environmental, and tactile puzzles amid atmospheric rain, fog, and storms.

A first-person puzzle adventure in the world of the Odd Gods, where the player conjures triangular platforms from walls to climb, solve puzzles, redirect light, and reach hidden fox statues across sixteen stages, with no combat and optional leaderboard challenges.

A narrative-driven visual novel retelling a Cinderella-like fairy tale, where the player controls Cinders' personality and choices across 120 decision points and multiple endings, exploring themes of freedom, dreams, and sisterhood.

As a ranger in a vast forest after a brutal winter storm, the player rescues lost children through randomly generated levels, using levitation magic to solve hand-crafted puzzles and defeat creatures while building relationships with villagers and shaping a personal story.

Players design cars and engines with detailed tools spanning 1946 to 2020, then build factories, research technology, and market their vehicles to simulated buyers in a campaign to grow an automotive company. Creations can be exported to BeamNG.drive for driving and racing.

A cooperative horror game where up to four investigators explore areas for clues while avoiding a supernatural creature, relying on teamwork and trust to make the right choices. It can be played solo or online, with multiple characters and scenarios.

A point-and-click RPG adventure where a stranded space traveler and three alien companions seek to repair their ship amid warring factions, making meaningful choices, collecting loot, and fighting turn-based battles against multi-form bosses.

Players manage a colony of shipwreck survivors on a distant world, building structures, tending moods and relationships, fighting raiders and creatures, and trading while an AI storyteller generates tragic and triumphant events.

As the Seed of Prophecy, players enter a living castle to defeat the Warlock Lord, solving countless puzzles, managing inventory, and mapping rooms in a first-person point-and-click adventure, with modern, classic, and immersive interface options and many ways to die.

Children join Freddi Fish and Luther on a tropical vacation to find the stolen Great Conch Shell before the Founder's Day Festival. They explore ruins, a carnival and a sunken airplane, clicking to uncover surprises and piecing together clues to identify the culprit.

Players help Freddi Fish and Luther track down hogfish rustlers in a Wild West setting, exploring locations, gathering clues, and meeting characters to solve the mystery, with a different game each playthrough.

Freddi Fish and Luther investigate a mysterious sea creature lurking in Coral Cove Park before its grand opening, with the player finding clues, solving puzzles, and collecting tools across changing locations, plus a Mess Hall Mania mini-game.

A child helps Putt-Putt and Pep round up missing baby animals before the Cartown Zoo opens, exploring clickable scenes, playing mini-games, singing songs, and taking photos of zoo animals. The tone is cheerful and family-friendly, with hundreds of hidden surprises to discover along the way.

A children's point-and-click adventure where Putt-Putt travels through time to rescue his friend Pep after a time machine malfunctions. Kids explore eras like the dinosaur age and the Old West, meet friendly characters, and play memory and math activities with hidden clickable surprises.

Kids join Putt-Putt and Pep exploring new Cartown locations to gather items before the Cartown 500, clicking through hundreds of interactive points and meeting old friends, then drive the purple convertible themselves in a race toward the checkered flag.

The player joins Putt-Putt to help five circus acts prepare for a show, piecing together a recipe card, patching a pool, and solving other problems. Kids explore colorful worlds at their own pace, practicing observation, kindness, and teamwork with lovable friends.

Players help Pep the dog hop through over 100 fast arcade levels using a hoppin' stick, collecting goodies while dodging oil slicks, trampolines, teleporters, and animal rivals like jet-pack pigs and bouncing bears. It is a hand-drawn, family-friendly action game aimed at children ages 3 to 8.

A tower defense strategy game with new levels, weapons and opponents. Players choose difficulty settings, pick weapon types and positions to defend effectively, and use airstrikes and temporary weapon power boosts to hold off waves of enemies across varied landscapes.

Players inhabit a universe made entirely of jello, where streets, continents, and the world itself are wobbly and playful, built purely for amusement. The game explores a world of Non-Newtonian fluids through movement and physics-driven play, with a soundtrack by Disasterpeace.

Players work to save a family farm from foreclosure by buying and caring for animals, collecting their goods, and manufacturing products to sell in town while balancing money and time. Across 90 levels in four worlds, they complete tasks, protect the farm from pests, and earn trophies and achievements.

Lead a small band of settlers in an untamed land, managing food, shelter, jobs and production while researching technologies and defending against pirates and wild tribes, with each citizen's temper and your spending choices shaping the colony's fate.

A physics-based competitive climbing game where players take turns climbing atop a tower formed by previous climbers and a goat, trying to reach the highest point before time runs out, with flinging moves enabling massive towers and risky falls.

A fantasy RPG in which the player becomes the Herald of the Gods and leads a customized party across the continent of Xulima to restore balance. Exploration, turn-based battles and character building across diverse regions demand strategy rather than hand-holding.

Players train and customize a boxer, fighting over 20 opponents with distinct styles through a career mode with three belt titles. Mini-games build up the fighter, and local or online multiplayer lets players bet virtual currency and climb leaderboards across four arenas.

Playing as Lucius, the son of the devil and lone survivor of his family's destruction, the player explores a five-storey hospital and the town of Ludlow, setting traps and using supernatural abilities to kill over a hundred victims in a sandbox adventure continuing the original story.

A girl named Sarah lies in a coma, and the player explores her surreal dream world as a platformer, collecting items that change her abilities, talking to strange characters, and solving puzzles to help her wake up.

A remastered turn-based strategy classic in which the player leads heroes and fantasy creatures through campaign scenarios and skirmish maps, rebuilding the kingdom of Erathia while managing armies and resources across a magical medieval world.

A point-and-click adventure parody in which the world's worst detective and his clown robot sidekick investigate a contradictory murder in Hotel Lisbon, searching for clues and interviewing witnesses. The pixel-art comedy, styled after 80s and 90s adventures, includes three additional cases.

A challenging arcade puzzle game in which the player guides a chameleon spy through 75 levels across five missions, changing color to blend into the environment and avoid being spotted by enemies. Each level offers collectibles and time challenges, with layouts designed for speedrunning.

Niko sets out across Gogapoe Island to recover his stolen birthday cake, recruiting friendly monsters whose powers help him explore, solve environmental puzzles, and defeat hostile creatures. The top-down adventure spans four areas with secret paths, oddball NPCs, side quests, and unlockable costumes.

A World War II strategy game recreating Operation Epsom, the British offensive west of Caen. Players command battlegroups at the strategic level and squads in tactical close combat, using infantry, tanks, artillery, and air strikes to fight as either British or German forces.

The player manages a chariot racing team in ancient Roman circuses, training drivers, upgrading chariots and horses, and directing tactical races against rivals while building fame across provinces toward the Circus Maximus.

As commander of a ragtag space colony, players build and manage a base with over a hundred buildings, keep a crew of unique colonists happy and paid, and defend against alien threats while turning a profit for a corporation.

Players command one of ten races in a spacefaring 4X strategy game, exploring vast galaxies of up to a hundred solar systems, researching technologies, customizing ships and negotiating or warring with alien civilizations. Multiple victory paths include conquest, technology and diplomacy across turn-based play.

Players fight through the open world of Kyrat, choosing between stealth and explosive force with a diverse arsenal while scouting enemy territory from gyrocopters and wingsuits. They can ride war elephants against outposts and invite a friend for drop-in co-op.

An RPG sequel following Marine as she gathers allies to challenge the Lords of Mystrock. Players explore a magical world, complete quests, battle monsters including Animal Kings, and uncover secret rooms across multiple difficulty levels.

Players guide Marine and her companions through the Eastern world of an RPG series, exploring towns and secret rooms, completing quests, and battling monsters including the Animal Kings, with adjustable difficulty and encounter options across a long story-driven adventure.

The fourth chapter of a retro RPG series follows Marine and friends as they race six days to find four warriors and reach a showdown. Players battle monsters including Animal Kings, complete quests, explore secret rooms, and summon a fairy ally across adjustable difficulties.

A point-and-click puzzle horror adventure in Lovecraftian style, following an investigation into disturbing corners of the psyche, nightmares, and the occult. Players collect and examine clues in a thinking screen, decipher dreams, and underline documents to solve puzzles in a first-person environment.

A young woman wakes trapped inside a glowing coffin in a dark, warped environment and must explore in third person, solving puzzles and overcoming twisted obstacles to uncover who she is and what the white chamber holds.

Players captain eight detailed vessels through famous European ports, battling realistic water physics and weather conditions across 20 missions. Each ship handles differently, bridges can be explored in first person, and a mission editor lets players adjust waves, triggers, and AI ships.

A text-based interactive novel in which the player becomes a celebrity superhero in Millennia City, fighting Powered gangs, choosing a sidekick, and joining or upstaging famous champions. Choices about gender, romance, and motives shape the story toward multiple endings.

Players explore a Japanese pop-up book world, folding and sliding paper structures to solve puzzles and uncover the secret behind a dying cherry tree. The journey passes through dark forests, abandoned shrines and mountain waterfalls, accompanied by an atmospheric soundtrack.

Players defend abstract grid landscapes against waves of colorful spheres in a 3D cooperative tower defense game, unlocking turrets, upgrades, and tracks while using programmable turrets for micro-strategy. Online co-op supports up to eight players.

An ice-cold mercenary named Black wakes in a mysterious asylum with no memory of his past. Guided by an anonymous captor called Red, he uses a headset that lets him relive memories, traveling into his own mind to uncover the truth behind a rescue attempt involving a teenage girl strapped with a bomb.

Players race licensed cars from multiple eras across scanned circuits worldwide, competing in a single-player career, online modes, and in-game events. A physics engine, dynamic weather, drying racing lines, and a 24-hour cycle aim for authentic motorsport handling. The tone is intense and competitive.

An astronaut wakes among the wreckage of a destroyed space station with no memory and a leaking EVA suit, exploring the debris for resources and repairing an escape vehicle while uncovering what killed the crew. The tone is tense and isolating, set in cold open space.

Players lead a motorcycle gang across a post-apocalyptic country, racing at high speed while fighting rivals with pipes and weapons to hunt down an assassin and claim a bounty. Races, assassinations and robberies earn money for upgrading character, bike and weapons, with four-player splitscreen co-op and a deep motorcycle combat system.

An RPG set in the Realm of Dreams where Lily and her companions confront literary antagonists like Hyde, the Headless Horseman, and Dracula. Players fight fast-paced turn-based battles, craft magic and furniture, solve puzzles, build a house, and explore a world of folklore and dreams.

In a cyberpunk Berlin of 2054, players lead a team of shadowrunners through a story-driven campaign, investigating rumors that a Great Dragon may still be alive. The game blends turn-based tactical combat with a branching narrative, character development, and team customization.

The player shoots pool in a detailed virtual hall, choosing among four modes from American 8 Ball to Killer, plus challenges and live online multiplayer. Matches build an AI profile of the player that can be faced later, and online tournaments feed global leaderboards.

Players learn and play chess across nine detailed sets and six locations, following a tutorial that covers basic to advanced techniques while tracking ELO and tournament ratings on ranking boards. It is a polished celebration of the classic strategy game with antique and modern pieces.

A free-to-play anime MMORPG set in a colorful magical world, where players pick from several fantasy classes, complete quests and daily missions, join guilds, and fight bosses in dungeons. Social features include apprenticeships, parties, dancing, and in-game marriage.

Anna travels to an Aztec ruin to uncover an ancient secret, matching tiles across many levels while powerful totems aid her. The player upgrades a character to level 100, builds a Ziggurat, and faces an epic boss battle in this mystery-filled puzzle adventure.

As a frozen insurance operative thawed aboard a cargo starship, the player stalks a vast non-linear vessel, using stealth, sabotage, and first-person shooting to survive after space pirates board the ship. The tone is wry and chaotic, with sneezing and bare feet among the hazards.

A roller coaster simulation that lets players ride famous coasters in real time or design their own with a CAD-style editor, placing track, supports and scenery under realistic physics. It includes a park editor, many coaster styles, seat selection and VR support.

The player is trapped in a mansion with five men, one armed with a gun, while a countdown runs toward someone's death. By connecting wires and making choices, the player steers the story toward one of eleven endings and tries to escape the mystery alive.

Explore the macabre past of a 1930s mansion in a fully black-and-white survival horror, solving puzzles of light and shadow. Collect matches to light your way, avoid apparitions lurking in the dark, and uncover the mansion's mysteries in a Film Noir style.

Players fight through three campaigns of undead super soldiers unleashed by Hitler in the dying days of World War II, battling alone or in online co-op across fifteen missions. Gruesome enemies are dismembered with firearms and explosives, with a horde mode and customizable difficulty adding replay value.

In an alternate 1960s space race, players command US or Soviet forces fighting over alien bio-metal across planets, blending first-person vehicle combat with real-time strategy base building, resource scavenging, and multiplayer battles in remastered visuals.

Players control Miku, a young girl who brings her wounded brother by boat to a mysterious flooded city. They explore by boat and on foot, climb drowned buildings, use a telescope to find supplies, and uncover hidden objects that reveal a story of a broken world and family.

Players control Johnny Gat or Kinzie Kensington, tearing through five districts of Hell to rescue the Saints' leader's soul. They use supernatural powers and outrageous underworld weapons in an open-world playground filled with historical icons, a talking gun, and a musical number.

Commanding the Royal Army, the player fights back in a story-driven strategy war between the Kingdom and Empire of Japon, deploying human-shaped tanks across over 100 missions. Players develop, build, and recruit over 250 tanks, customize them with modules, and replay in New Game+ or Free Battle.

In the land of Japon, human-shaped tanks fight a final war as their fuel dwindles. The player commands a squad of tanks in over 50 semi real-time strategy missions, scouting enemies and planning charges and self-destruct attacks, knowing each tank is lost forever after one hit.

A bus driving simulation in which the player transports passengers around a realistic city, keeping to a timetable and planned route while obeying traffic rules and avoiding upsetting or injuring riders, across twelve buses, thirty routes, varied duties, and changing weather and times of day.

Players return to their childhood home of Pilgrim's Hook to save their twin brother from a mysterious underwater force terrorizing the island. They solve puzzles, find hidden objects and morphing sea creatures, and interact with townsfolk to unravel the mystery.

As reporter Sam Wilde, players investigate a series of disappearances of young beautiful people, which becomes personal when his love Anna is taken by a serial killer. Searching Goldvale Manor, they solve puzzles, avoid traps, and scour hidden object scenes to rescue her before it is too late.

Playing the eccentric Michel Ardan, the player explores the hidden face of the moon, wandering dreamlike ruins of an abandoned temple and solving puzzles in a non-linear story to find a way back to Earth.

As a young reporter, the player investigates an old explorer's tale of the mysterious Amerzone and a stolen white-bird egg, exploring the region and unraveling its secrets in a classic point-and-click adventure.

A survival horror game set in an 1890 British natural history museum, where an archaeologist and her friend fight fog-created creatures after the theft of an Egyptian statue, traveling by steam train and cargo ship to a pyramid tomb to destroy the ancient evil.

A free, peaceful game about swinging through randomly generated spaces with a grappling hook, both in the air and underwater. The only goal is to collect points by swinging swiftly and smoothly without hitting anything, building momentum as music and glowing trails respond to elegant arcs.

Guide the hero Solar and his helpers across seven magical lands to stop a dark sorcerer and rescue Lumina, rebuilding towns and completing quests through time and resource management in a colorful, lighthearted fantasy adventure.

As Roman soldier Marius Titus, players fight through cinematic, brutal close-quarters battles against barbarian hordes to avenge his murdered family, rising through the ranks and leading men toward the heart of the Empire.

An asymmetric multiplayer tactical action game where teams of thieves and guards use unique operators, gadgets, and weapons across competitive and casual modes. Dynamic lighting and interactive environments support stealth play, with leveling, unlockable operators, and user-made maps.

Players command troops in modern-warfare battles, mixing real-time strategy with direct first- or third-person control of individual soldiers, tanks, and helicopters, using cover and destructible environments in competitive online combat.
Two metal-heads trapped by a zombie invasion at a medical research facility must solve point-and-click puzzles and deal with deranged characters to escape, in a comedic horror adventure.

A first-person adventure quest in the magical land of Namariel, where magic and science meet, following the king's daughter as she escapes an air prison, finds a prophet, and sneaks into the Iron Lord's citadel to free the land, solving steampunk puzzles with a robot assistant.

As the Wizard's Apprentice, players defend castle towers from numbered monsters by adding their values together to cast spells. This tactical tower defense puzzler spans thirty levels across five regions, with combos, potions, and dynamically generated levels aimed at family-friendly math practice.

In a vibrant alien-invaded universe, the player builds a space fortress, reroutes enemy paths with modules, and deploys upgradable weapons, traps and superweapons across 300-plus waves in 14 missions to exterminate alien hordes. The tone is energetic and combat-focused.

After waking without memories in a mysterious town, players navigate a mafia war, sheltered by the Oz famiglia, and pursue romance routes with several men while rival affections compete, shaping whom to trust and love and whether peace can be brought to the town.

The player awakens without memories in a decrepit mansion, guided by a jade-eyed Maid through four tragedies set in different eras. This visual novel follows residents across centuries, from flourishing 1603 to a cursed 1099, as the player seeks some trace of themselves.

A role-playing game set in the dying magical world of Avalon, where the player creates a character, explores mythical places, develops abilities and equipment through turn-based battles, and recruits fantastic companions such as dragons and trolls to save the kingdom.

Players take on one of four Witcher characters, traveling a rendered fantasy world to complete quests, hunt monsters, and solve mysteries. This digital board game adaptation offers card-driven play against AI or friends in online and hot-seat modes. The tone is adventurous and mysterious.

An action MMO in which players join friends in procedurally generated, fully destructible realms, battling the forces of Shadow through dungeons and lairs, collecting loot and costumes, and building personal cornerstones and shared club worlds block by block.

A special forces team investigating bizarre murders near Raccoon City is attacked and takes refuge in a mansion, where they must scavenge scarce supplies and survive horrific threats in this remastered HD version of the genre-defining survival-horror game.

A text-based interactive novel where the player competes on America's top hero reality show, using newly discovered Infini powers to battle rivals, vote out contestants, and pursue romances, with choices shaping the story across 175,000 words.

Wildlife Park 2 is a zoo management simulation where players build and run a zoo, caring for over 50 animal species, constructing enclosures and facilities, managing staff and budgets, and attracting visitors across missions and sandbox maps.

Players choose a Knight, Samurai, Viking, Wu Lin, or Outlander hero and fight in team-based melee battles using a three-directional combat system. The game offers 4v4 objective modes, smaller duels, ranked play, and a roster of customizable warriors with distinct weapons and fighting styles.

A point-and-click puzzle adventure set in a mysterious mansion's parallel world, where the player slides room tiles to guide a character to each exit, using teleporting phones, explosives and water pumps across over 100 rooms to collect golden pieces and find a way home.
