An open-world third-person action game where players control a roster of distinct Super Agents fighting the villainous organization LEGION and its Ministries in Seoul. Agents bring unique weapons and skills to rout out operatives and thwart plans for world domination.

As captain of a Victorian steamship on a vast underground sea, the player explores, trades, and fights in a gothic horror RPG where madness, cannibalism, and death stalk the crew. Rich storytelling, unique officers, and generational legacies shape each voyage across a dark, hand-drawn world.

Players scavenge supplies, hunt for food, and build shelters in a zombie-overrun world, exploring massive levels by air, land, and sea, fortifying bases, and choosing to cooperate with friendly players or fight them in PvP raids, with free-to-play cosmetics and Workshop mods.

A rail shooter adapted from a graphic novel, following a mafia godfather's psychopathic son and an ex-Navy SEAL hitman as they take on a gang war across Los Angeles and Jamaica. Players shoot through story and arcade missions, alone or in local co-op, with combo scoring.

After a geomagnetic disaster, a lone survivor explores a vast frozen Northern Canadian wilderness, balancing hunger, thirst, fatigue and cold while scavenging over a hundred gear items across twelve regions. Survival Mode is a free-form sandbox where death deletes the save, alongside an episodic narrative mode.

A puzzly narrative adventure with randomized wilderness survival. Waking in mysterious forests, the player gathers resources, builds gear, learns skills and explores over 40 areas while following a spirit guide's tale, seeking to understand their purpose and escape before an endless winter and malevolent apparitions consume everything.

A puzzle platformer following a confused protagonist who can swap minds with other versions of himself that perceive the world differently, using shifting perspectives to turn pits into paths and locked doors into keys while questioning his identity and purpose.

A simulation and strategy game where the player leads a colony of climate disaster survivors awakened from cryo-sleep in sea-based shelters. Starting from zero development, the player manages and trains citizens, builds habitats and platforms, develops technology, trades or pursues self-sufficiency, and salvages remains of 21st-century civilization.

Players write their own story into Tamriel's distant past, nearly 1,000 years before Skyrim, exploring regions like Morrowind and battling Daedra. The shared fantasy world supports solo or group questing, PvP duels, and seasonal content updates with epic rewards.

A turn-based grand strategy game covering the American Civil War from 1861 to 1865, where the player leads the USA or CSA as military and political leadership, commanding armies, appointing historical leaders, and making economic and diplomatic decisions across a large regional map.

Players command Axis or Soviet forces across four campaigns and random skirmishes on the Eastern Front of World War II, managing over 130 accurately modeled units through a detailed turn-based combat model with weather effects, plus cooperative and PBEM multiplayer.

A sci-fi adventure from the creators of Myst in which an organic artifact abducts the player across the universe into an alien landscape scattered with pieces of Earth. Players explore enigmatic worlds, gather clues, and make consequential choices to find a way home.

In this card-based RPG, the player chooses to be a warrior, mage or druid and fights arena battles and assassins across deserts, forests and mountain peaks. They explore cities, ruins and sacred sites while investigating a mystery threatening the homeland and the stranger called The Wolf.

Players take the role of a zombie horde leader who must infect every human on each map, converting victims into allies and commanding them to attack, follow, or wait, requiring tactical planning against armed soldiers.

Players follow Warren through a supernatural Wild West, hunting those who wronged him across story scenarios and turn-based tactical missions. Choices shape a branching narrative with multiple endings, while cards grant special abilities and a cover system drives combat.

Players become undercover cop Wei Shen infiltrating Hong Kong's Triads, fighting through brutal hand-to-hand martial arts, gunfights, and street races while climbing the criminal organization without blowing their cover in an open-world city.

Caliber is a team-based online shooter where players pick from over seventy special forces operators across four classes and coordinate with allies to complete combat objectives. It offers competitive player-versus-player modes, co-op missions, clans, and leaderboards across maps set in various theaters of war.

Players direct NASA, the Soviet space agency, or a fictional global agency through the 1950s-60s race to the Moon, managing budgets, opening programs, funding research, recruiting personnel, and launching missions in a realistic turn-based strategy campaign or sandbox.

Players fight in a chaotic battle royale across a GTA-style city, looting, shooting, casting and driving while drafting random skills each level to build combos. Matches run three fast rounds, and dead players continue as zombies to loot or hunt survivors for revival.

A turn-based pixel-art RPG where players control a party of pen-and-paper role-players guided by a Game Master, choosing races and classes, delving into dungeons, crafting items, and battling monsters with a comedic tone full of geeky jokes.

A visual novel dating sim in which the player is the only human at a pigeon high school, chatting with bird suitors, choosing elective classes to raise stats, giving gifts, and following branching narratives toward romance or darker twists and multiple endings.

Set in a small Japanese village in the early 1980s, the player follows a story where a yearly mysterious death and disappearance occur around a dam construction project. The player reads through a visual novel narrative, uncovering whether events are conspiracy, coincidence, or curse, in a tense mystery.
A hex-based wargaming strategy game with a powerful scenario editor, random game mode, alliances, and a large scenario bank covering conflicts from modern battles to fantasy realms.

As mayor of a small settlement in 1050 AD Europe, the player founds cities, researches medieval technology, produces and trades goods, and raises armies to defend trade routes and conquer rivals. This real-time empire simulation emphasizes economic domination, exploration, and expansion across a vast historical map.

A tactical strategy game set in the 1970s, following a team of thieves planning stylish heists and a revenge plot against a betrayer. Players assemble and equip a crew, then plot routes through mansions and museums while avoiding detection.

This edition bundles the full base game with remastered classic Zombies maps, offering three modes: a campaign, competitive multiplayer, and the Zombies survival mode. Players fight through shootouts and undead waves across remastered and new environments.

Nine participants awaken imprisoned in an underground facility, forced to play a deadly game where an escape hatch opens only after six people die. Players explore 3D environments, solve puzzles, and make life-or-death decisions in a non-linear narrative with multiple endings.

Set in 1400s middle Europe, players build a family dynasty across centuries, working as craftsmen and traders, attending social occasions, entering politics and plotting intrigues while rival AI dynasties pursue their own goals, in real-time 3D with day-night cycles and seasons.

Set in a war-torn fantasy realm plagued by the Bloodburn, players create a hero, build an army, and command Elves, Orcs, or Humans in a campaign blending real-time strategy battles with RPG party management. Choices and companions shape a fully voiced story, with multiplayer modes included.

Players command sailing ships in the Age of Sail, mastering realistic wind and physics-based naval combat, fighting PvP battles and conquest campaigns for control of the West Indies while progressing from small cutters to massive first-rate ships.

This prologue to Metal Gear Solid V drops the player into an open-world setting where missions can be undertaken with unrestricted stealth or all-out gunfire, each approach affecting consequences and advancement. A central story mode and Side-Ops missions offer tactical action and covert operations.

Set in 18th-century North America during the French and Indian War, players control Shay, a former Assassin turned Templar hunting his old brothers. They use stealth, an air rifle and naval combat aboard the Morrigan across an open world of icy seas and river valleys.

A free-to-play version of the fighting game DEAD OR ALIVE 5 Last Round that lets players use most modes including online play, but only a limited roster of fighters, with additional characters and Story Mode sold separately as downloadable content.

As a Legendary hero, players confront a corrupt president's campaign against Powered people, deciding whether to trust an archenemy and how far to go for justice. This text-based interactive novel follows branching choices, romance options, and multiple endings across a political superhero story.

A turn-based strategy game covering World War I from the 1914 invasion of Belgium to the 1918 Armistice. Players command infantry, cavalry, tanks, and artillery across a large hex-based campaign map spanning Europe, Africa, and beyond, with historical events and play-by-email multiplayer.

A grand strategy game covering World War One across Europe and beyond, where the player controls a major power, managing production, diplomacy, research, trenches, supply and historical leaders and units across thousands of regions and multiple scenarios.

Lead Imperial forces and Space Marines against an Ork invasion of Armageddon in a hex-based, turn-based strategy campaign spanning over thirty scenarios, carrying veteran units between battles and upgrading their equipment.

A turn-based hex wargame covering World War II campaigns, where the player builds and manages armies, fleets, and air forces across various theatres, using commanders, supply lines, and specializations to win battles in dynamic campaigns.

Players take the role of elite marksman Karl Fairburne in World War 2 Italy, using tactical third-person stealth and long-range sniping with realistic ballistics to hunt Nazi officers and aid the Italian Resistance across large open levels.

In 1930s Egypt, players join the Strange Brigade to hunt the risen Witch Queen Seteki and her army of mummies and monsters. They explore ruins, solve puzzles, collect treasure, and blast undead foes in third-person action, alone or in 2-4 player online co-op, with traps and extra modes.

A digital adaptation of the laser board game Khet, where players alternate turns moving Egyptian-themed mirrored pieces and then fire a laser to blast the opponent's Pharaoh. It offers local and online play, five AI difficulty levels, hot-seat mode, and full 3D camera control.

Players follow Cecil and companions through a dramatic fantasy story in this 3D remake of the classic RPG, using the Active Time Battle system and Augment ability transfers, with voice-acted scenes, a mapping feature and selectable difficulty. The tone is emotional and epic.

As a masterless samurai in the mid-19th-century port town of Amihama, the player chooses among three factions—pro-government, isolationist or foreign—making key decisions that branch the story, customizing a character and fighting with swords and gunpowder weapons.

Players follow an amnesiac young man bound to atone for killing a god, fighting strategic battles across a multi-generational story in a parallel fantasy world. The tactical RPG offers character customization, soul breeding across generations, and mini-games.

A remastered interactive drama following a supernatural murder mystery through four playable characters, with branching dialogue and multiple endings presented in a cinematic split-screen style. The noir narrative and orchestrated score drive a chilling, story-focused experience.

A tactical battalion-level combat simulation set on the Eastern Front, combining a turn-based operational mode for shifting and resupplying forces with a real-time tactical mode for firefights, territory capture, and vehicle destruction across four large-scale operations with detailed ballistics and armor modeling.

An interactive graphic novel adapting Goethe's Faust to the present day, where an ordinary young man is offered the chance to sell pieces of his soul for granted wishes. The player chooses how the story unfolds and ends, guided by comic-book illustrations and a moody soundtrack.

After a plane crash, players are stranded alone in the Pacific and must survive by exploring islands and reefs, crafting tools and weapons, building shelters and rafts, and managing hunger, thirst and injuries. Procedurally generated islands, farming, hunting and bosses add variety, with online and split-screen co-op.

Players run their own farm in an open Nordic and North American countryside, harvesting crops, raising animals, selling produce and cutting wood while driving over 140 authentic vehicles and tools, and can invite up to 15 friends to build the operation together.

A relaxing nature simulation in which the player experiences existence as a mountain, watching time pass as things grow and die while nature expresses itself, offering a contemplative and existential experience rather than conventional gameplay goals.

Players command Allied, German, or Soviet forces through historically researched WWII battles in real time, managing over 200 vehicles and 40 infantry types. A flexible campaign structure offers side missions, while editors let players build bridges, dig trenches, lay mines, and modify missions and units.

Players command Soviet, American, or German forces across three WWII campaigns, planning operations, calling in reinforcements, and promoting commanders. They fight 68 missions on global fronts using hundreds of authentic units, tanks, and aircraft, with tactical cover and destruction in a gritty, strategic war setting.

Stranded alone on a mysterious alien planet after the destruction of Earth's last colony ship, the player explores handcrafted islands, caves and tombs while surviving extreme weather, tides and earthquakes. Scavenge equipment, uncover over two hundred secrets, and rebuild a communication device to call home.

A grand historical strategy game covering the Roman civil wars, from Caesar crossing the Rubicon onward. Players build and train armies, maneuver them across a detailed map of the Roman Empire, and balance economy and diplomacy with neighboring powers while managing historical leaders, events, and campaigns.

A first-person horror adventure inspired by Lovecraft, in which Frank Gilman wakes in a deserted Antarctic research base with no memory and explores the facility, dreams and visions, studying clues and avoiding macabre beings while uncovering what happened to the expedition.

Mona De Lafitte, an opera singer turned vampire, escapes her captor's gloomy castle with a cheeky bat companion and tries to reach Paris. Players explore over 30 hand-drawn locations in a classic point-and-click comic adventure, using her vampire abilities and limits to solve strange encounters.

A free-to-play pool simulation using the Pool Nation physics engine, offering 8 Ball, 9 Ball and snooker with career modes, trickshots, endurance play, local and online multiplayer, and unlockable cues and modes earned through in-game cash.

Players guide an aphid grub through stages of metamorphosis in a lucid insect world, solving puzzles and uncovering hidden secrets as it journeys toward its spawning ground. The hand-drawn adventure emphasizes discovery and immersion in an organic microcosm.

Players pilot a wide range of aircraft, from jumbo jets to helicopters, taking off from over 24,000 airports worldwide, setting weather and season, and completing missions or racing friends in a realistic flight simulation.

Players control a hero trapped by a spell in a magical forest, fighting through a ruined castle and randomized dungeon labyrinth full of goblins and skeletons, gathering weapons and spells and upgrading along the way, alone or in two-player co-op.

Players rebuild a shattered world of floating Fragments by sending multiple parties of heroes into procedurally generated dungeons and managing towns to train and equip them. The turn-based first-person dungeon crawler combines exploration, looting, and town construction across countless worlds.

Players explore a 1:1 scale simulated universe, flying seamlessly between procedurally generated planets, stars, galaxies and black holes, accelerating time and piloting spacecraft, with mod support and interactive tutorials in a science-based space simulator.

Abe, a floor waxer at a meat processing plant, discovers his bosses plan to turn the slave workforce into snack meat and must escape, sneaking past guards and beasts through ancient ruins and temples to discover his destiny in this recrafted classic adventure.

During a wartime air raid, teenager Noah and his sister Renie take shelter in a bunker and enter Silence, a world between life and death. When Renie is lost there, Noah ventures through the idyllic yet threatened realm, meeting characters and fighting dark creatures to save both Silence and themselves.

A point-and-click adventure following Randal, a kleptomaniac who sells his best friend's engagement ring and is cursed to relive the same Monday repeatedly. He must retrieve the ring and repair the space-time continuum, aided by geek culture references and black humor.

A turn-based grand strategy wargame where the player commands armies of ancient and medieval nations such as Rome, Persia, the Inca, and Chinese dynasties. It offers skirmishes against AI, hotseat play, cross-platform multiplayer with rankings, diplomacy and economy management, and a map editor for custom scenarios.

The player governs any nation across World War II, the Cold War, or the modern era, managing economy, diplomacy, espionage, and military forces in real time. Campaigns, scenarios, and sandboxes let players trade technologies, forge alliances, and command land, air, and sea units toward chosen victory conditions.

A third-person action shooter in which Harley Quinn, Deadshot, Captain Boomerang and King Shark are sent into an open-world Metropolis ravaged by Brainiac's invasion to kill corrupted Justice League heroes. Players use each member's traversal and combat styles alone or in online co-op.

A soldier is sent to watch over Sion, a genetically engineered felix kept in an island facility, as a red star threatens to end all life on Earth. The cinematic visual novel tells the planet's final love story through event illustrations and music.

Players solve interlocking laser puzzles by switching between characters with unique abilities, working through over 120 levels set in a 22nd-century postage company. The cyberpunk puzzler includes a story touching on post-humanism and virtual reality, plus local co-op and a level editor.

A story-driven real-time strategy game recreating the bloodiest battles of World War I across six campaigns, letting players command infantry at divisional, squad and soldier levels with authentic weapons, gas attacks, artillery and tanks, playable solo, in co-op or multiplayer.

A monster rolls snowballs to build snowmen in this adorable puzzle game. Players push and stack snow across lovingly crafted levels, accompanied by charming graphics and an original soundtrack, in a gentle, thoughtful experience about assembling snowmen.

Players guide Manny Calavera, a travel agent in the land of the dead, through a conspiracy threatening his salvation. This remastered point-and-click adventure blends film noir with Mexican folklore across a four-year journey of the afterlife.

A doctor under contract and a mysterious newcomer in an isolated, snowbound city investigate the disappearance of a local madman, uncovering the unsettling truth behind the city's splendor in this dystopian mystery thriller.

A life simulation visual novel following either Max or Anne through their first year at Latin House dorm, where players schedule classes and jobs, raise stats, and pursue romantic routes with fellow tenants amid light comedy writing.

Pirate heroine Nelly Cootalot stars in a point-and-click adventure to rescue birds hypnotized by Baron Widebeard, racing aristocrats, commandeering an airship, and entering a monkey wizard's mind. The journey spans Port Rubicund to Gloomholm, with puzzles, 45 characters, and 35 hand-drawn locations.

A young warrior descends into caves and mines beneath an evil sorcerer's tower, fighting monsters in real-time gesture-based combat, solving puzzles, avoiding traps and chaining runes for elemental magic in a first-person old-school dungeon crawler.

A turn-based strategy war game set on the desert planet Folvos, where the player commands soldiers, tanks and aircraft for either the native people or the invading Vasgalan Empire across two campaigns and twenty scenarios, using tactical positioning and flanking on varied landscapes.

Players build and explore worlds from cubes in a persistent online voxel world shared with other players, creating parkour challenges, houses, or anything else. They mine resources across varied biomes, craft items at workbenches, customize characters, and tackle obstacles like spikes, lava, and quicksand.

A turn-based dungeon crawler where the player builds the dungeon around an autonomous hero using cards drawn from guild decks, placing rooms, monsters, traps and loot while the hero decides where to go. Between runs the player manages the guild, expands rooms and decks, and customizes dungeoneers.

A WW2 reverse tower defense game with 3D graphics in which the player defends a bunker against waves of enemies using rifles, mortars, flamethrowers and air strikes. Across 21 missions and an Endless mode, players analyze the battlefield and destroy tactical points to block enemy paths.

Command one of three global superpowers in a modern-war real-time strategy game, building bases, harvesting oil and cash, and producing prototype military units. Players fight AI skirmishes and online PvP battles, and follow a single-player campaign set in volatile conflict zones around the world.

Four nerds are pulled into a fantasy world and mistaken for heroes, battling through a comedic turn-based JRPG adventure full of parodies and cameos. Players control the party, customize a leader, level up through 100 levels, and use hundreds of spells and items across a long, joke-filled story.

As a wizard at an elite demonic law firm, the player battles demons and undead attorneys, drafts contracts and wins souls to repay student loans. The text-based story offers romance, intrigue and career choices in a fantasy legal world.

Players pilot a giant robot through an interstellar civil war in a text-based interactive novel, customizing their mecha and dueling enemy pilots with plasma swords. Choices shape the story, determining whether the protagonist becomes a hero, villain, or renegade, and whom they love.

Squishy, a pig in a yellow sweater, must complete a deal with the devil to reach his parents in animal heaven. The player solves complex puzzles and makes tough platforming jumps across forests, deserts, mountains and space, with boss fights and speedrun mode.

Hana conducts chaotic, uncoordinated Tempopo creatures to smash, block, lift, and push through seasonal island puzzles, rescuing scattered musical flowers that grow into a personal melodic garden in a bright, rhythmic world.

Great Permutator is a hard puzzle game where the player builds a complex system of conveyors and action blocks so colored boxes travel across a factory and arrive at the right places in the right order. It offers 50 levels plus bonus levels, a level editor, and leaderboards.

Ester Ambrose travels through time and space with a portable time machine to prevent a magical cataclysm, solving time-manipulation puzzles and hidden-object scenes across hand-painted locations. The finale of the Time Mysteries series also lets players control Michael in an additional adventure.

A princess and her fiancé haul the departed king's coffin-on-wheels through 25 physics-driven underground levels, alone or in couch co-op, exploring vibrant caverns, riding fast sequences and collecting mountains of loot while the king's ghost complains.

A god-game homage to Populous where the exiled warrior Thallos gathers scattered tribes and lost totems across 34 planets and 184 islands. Players wield 15 upgradeable totem powers to control nature and unleash its fury on rival tribes with their own aggression traits.

Players follow Max Caulfield, a photography senior who discovers she can rewind time after saving her best friend Chloe, using that power to reshape events and make choices that lead to multiple endings in a modern episodic adventure.

Players control Raelius, a revived God of War, seeking revenge across the empire of Eridia. Blending tower defense, RTS, and reverse tower defense, they command minions, cast spells, and build defensive towers to repel Heroes of Light while conquering territory, with gory death animations and a 20-level campaign.

A medieval bridge-building puzzle game where the player constructs sturdy bridges to supply a city or cunning traps that collapse under attacking troops, using wood, stone and ropes across forty levels with siege and bonus challenges.

One to four players explore a randomly generated Mesopotamian-inspired world to solve why the moon failed to rise, racing a five-day deadline before war breaks out. Each run under an hour, with seven character classes, animal familiars, and choices that build a hero's legend as a constellation remembered by later generations.

In early 20th-century Kyoto, a serious clergywoman named Hamomoru meets a self-professed scientist who shows her a mysterious Star-seeing Basin that grows stars from pebbles. She assists his research, creating celestial objects and walking the city to test whether the stars influence the world.

In an alternative 1960s England, three quietly rebellious citizens of Wellington Wells try to escape a society kept cheerful by the drug Joy. Players hide, conform, or fight through a procedurally generated dystopian city, crafting weapons and uncovering the town's dark history across interwoven narratives.

Players run an auto repair shop, taking time-limited customer jobs to fix cars built from hundreds of interactive parts, then spend earnings on workshop upgrades, buy and renovate used cars at auction, and manage the business to grow their reputation and collection.

After a meteor's energy causes a professor's machine to destroy a city and mutate its plants and animals, the player is an investigator hired to destroy the machine, rescue two abandoned children, save the city, and arrest the professor through puzzles, mini-games, and hidden-object searches.

An exchange student spends two months in Tokyo and grows close to three girls he meets there, navigating everyday life filled with laughter and tears. The romance visual novel presents a fully voiced, animated story where choices lead toward one of the friendships becoming something more.

Players spin a collection of fifteen authentic casino slot machines, wagering on single or multi-line bets in Career or Free Play modes, building a bankroll and tracking detailed statistics on their wins.

A visual novel following a large cast of characters whose genders are flipped by absurd circumstances, letting the player pick a character and pursue romance and outrageous transformations through dating-sim choices, puzzles, and investigation scenes across many endings.

A young man wishes to become his favorite comic book hero, Dengeki Stryker, and years later must defend a city from an invading cyborg army, in a long visual novel with animated cutscenes and superhero themes.

Players descend through procedurally arranged basement levels of a twisted nightmare, fighting demons and monsters alone or with up to four players. Fast-paced old-school shooting, weapon mods, magic trinkets, and a punishment system where greed increases the threat.

A female-oriented dating simulation following Heejung Kim, a business student who moves out of her mother's home and, after finding mysterious animals, embarks on a dramatic story with charming characters, accompanied by artwork, music, and partly voiced Korean dialogue.

Players race boats in kart-racer style across rivers, ports, and Caribbean islands, using torpedoes, rockets, mines, and frogs to smash rivals. Winning earns cash and sponsors to buy faster boats and lavish homes, with leisure cruises in yachts and cargo ships between races.

A classic Dungeons & Dragons cRPG set in the frozen North, where players customize a party of up to six heroes and brave the Spine of the World, battling monsters, delving ancient dungeons, and uncovering buried secrets. It includes the original campaign, expansions, restored quests, and real-time-with-pause combat.

Mel must find and destroy the Orb of Death inherited from her evil ancestor, journeying through the Eldrion Empire in a humorous fantasy RPG. Solve quests, brew potions, raise pets, and battle monsters across forests, deserts, and mountains.

Mel, a girl hiding her magic, is sought by Darklings who believe she will build a dark empire, while her friend Edward and professors from a magical academy try to convince her to enroll. The party quests, battles monsters, learns spells, and pursues romance to stop the prophecy.

Set during a war of succession in the fantasy realm of Ashan, players explore and conquer the world, develop their economy, and lead armies of legendary creatures in turn-based battles. Heroes gain hundreds of abilities and artifacts through RPG progression amid a strong narrative.

The player creates a custom heroine and travels through four enchanted kingdoms to meet Cinderella, Ariel, Snow White, and Jasmine, helping them overcome evil and restore order. Dress, hair, and appearance can be customized while the story touches on courage, friendship, trust, and discovery.

The player commands a steam-driven robot pirate crew in turn-based tactical shootouts aboard enemy spaceships, manually aiming guns for skill shots and bullet bounces. Recruits are upgraded with abilities and weapons across procedurally generated levels, with a New Game+ mode after the campaign.

The player rearranges the panels of an animated comic book to guide a silhouetted spy through a noir adventure, shifting the narrative with each move to produce comedic mishaps, deaths, or stylish heists across a series of logic puzzles.

Players command humanity's first mission to Mars after a micrometeoroid storm damages the ship, guiding the crew through disasters, food shortages, and cryptic signals using turn-based dice-driven strategy while making difficult decisions to survive.

In an entirely frozen world, players build the last city on Earth, managing heat, resources and steam-powered technology while establishing laws and balancing hope and discontent, with every decision carrying a moral price.

Playing as BUD, a small robot, the player climbs and grows a giant alien plant across floating islands to reach higher ground, collecting crystals that enhance abilities while exploring a whimsical world of strange plants and animals.

Trapped as the protagonist of an unfinished first-person fantasy game, players confront indecisive god-like designers, seizing and remixing their creations and behaviors to solve open-ended environmental problems and uncover a darkly comic story.

A disgraced former general is summoned by the emperor and must prove himself while living among seven princesses in a lavish palace garden, in a fantasy romance visual novel about love, hate, myth and forgiveness amid a divided empire.

Players follow Tomoya Okazaki, a guarded delinquent at Hikarizaka High School, as he befriends the mystifying Nagisa and helps her revive the drama club, meeting other students while seeking solace and belonging in this remastered visual novel.

A bus driving simulation where players transport passengers across five city districts, managing schedules, tickets, passenger behavior, and vehicle maintenance while growing a bus company, hiring drivers, and unlocking new buses and routes.

In a fantastic 1930s world, players command a real-time strategy campaign across remote islands, combining over 50 animals into genetically altered mutant creatures to build armies, fight a villain, and battle up to six players online.

Players control former shogun Lo Wang, a mercenary in a corrupted world where humans and demons coexist, fighting demonic legions with guns, blades, and magic. The first-person shooter offers four-player co-op and procedurally generated landscapes to explore while collecting weapons, armor, and relics.

A first-person puzzle game set across two overlapping black-and-white worlds, where the player shifts between dimensions and uses switches, boosters and gravity to reach each level's exit through increasingly mind-bending challenges.

In an isolated town troubled by murders, characters struggle to separate memory from illusion and dream from reality. The player follows a branching narrative across two episodes, making choices that lead to one of fourteen endings, accompanied by an extensive soundtrack and illustrated artwork.

A boy abducted by aliens while camping teams up with two alien mercenaries to find his way home, outsmarting hijackers and foiling a corporate plot. This retro-style point-and-click adventure spans atmospheric space environments with story-driven puzzles and multiple playable characters.

Arctico is a peaceful exploration and base-building game about recovering a late mentor's work on a snowy island. Players gather resources, run experiments, grow and sell plants, upgrade their outpost and sled, and uncover antique objects and letters, alone or with up to three friends in co-op.

A wordless puzzle adventure set in the Stone Age where the Neanderthal Ungh, banished after letting the village fire go out, searches the world for a new flame, solving intuitive click-and-swipe puzzles across hand-drawn scenes in a savagely hilarious story.

A strategy game set in 395 AD at the dawn of the Dark Ages, combining turn-based campaign management with real-time battles. The player leads a barbarian or Eastern kingdom or defends the crumbling Roman Empire against the advancing hordes of Attila.

A story-driven real-time strategy game with RPG elements where the player commands an insectoid hive mind, building a colony, harvesting DNA from defeated enemies to evolve creatures, and leading a swarm through an ancient underground world toward the surface.

Players pick one of two alliances in a war-torn fantasy realm, developing characters, joining guilds, and fighting in massive PvP battles over castles. They craft and enhance gear with runes and crystals, run dungeons and raids, and compete in weekly tournaments across a large open world.

After a bicycle accident ends his racing dreams, a young man returns to his hometown and joins a struggling school club to rebuild a glider and chase a rare cloud phenomenon. The visual novel follows friendship, romance, and flight across five character-specific story branches. The tone is somber yet touching.

Based on the classic tabletop game, the player leads a party of adventurers through perilous dungeons in the Warhammer World, leveling heroes, looting weapons and artefacts from fallen enemies, and crushing Orcs, Goblins, Trolls, and other foes in search of wealth and glory.

Players join a persistent medieval open world as soldiers, crafters, or farmers, fighting non-target combat for territory and castles, looting defeated foes, and shaping a player-driven economy through crafting and resource gathering.

Anna, a girl with telekinesis and a shady fox companion, frees a talking teddy bear and sets off through a grim, hand-drawn fairy-tale world, solving classic point-and-click puzzles, using black magic, and dealing with witches, trolls, and other odd characters with dark self-irony.

The player helps Owen Wright rescue his daughter from the Lonely Hearts Killer, a mysterious figure abducting people unlucky in love, by searching Victorian homes and a 19th-century English city for clues and solving hidden-object puzzles and mini-games before time runs out.

As super-spy Max Remington, the player travels across three continents and fifty cities to unravel terrorist, smuggling and extortion plots, gathering intelligence by recognizing faces and breaking codes, then using guns, grenades and remote bombs when stealth fails. The tone is a modern techno-thriller drawn from headline-inspired cases.

Play one of four colonial powers sailing to the New World to explore, plant colonies, manage resources and trade, and balance economics, diplomacy, and military strategy against natives and rivals before launching a revolution for independence.

A short, wordless story about a boy who finds an injured bird, told through a blur between reality and imagination. The one-hour experience mixes adventure game elements with classic RPG aesthetics and an original soundtrack, with no dialogue and no time-wasting mechanics.

In an alternate 1880s Victorian England, players command a giant walking war machine called an Ironcast, fighting invading enemy Ironcasts through turn-based resource-node combat, looting technology, and customizing weapons in a roguelite campaign.

In Manhattan 2094, freelance hacker Ransom Stark is turned into a vampire and must find a cure while navigating cyberspace, rage gangs and mega-corporations. He recruits mercenaries and hackers, hacking through ICE and exploring virtual reality in a gritty cyberpunk role-playing adventure.

Players lead a band of four adventurers through 15th-century Germany as medieval people imagined it, a land of mythical beasts, sinister robber-knights, and witch sabbaths. Traveling among ninety cities, they fight real-time battles, brew alchemical potions, and improve attributes and skills without artificial classes or levels.
Play as a samurai in warring-states Japan, fighting melee duels and real-time battles while managing honor, statesmanship and intrigue to unite 48 provinces under your rule and become shogun.

An old-school adventure where players fight hordes of strange, silly, and scary monsters while exploring caves, castles, and dungeons tied to an ancient evil. Along the way they meet warriors, princes, pirates, zombies, and woodsmen across a large retro world with 8-bit artwork and an original chiptune soundtrack.

Players lead one of seven races in a strategy game of resource management and military conquest, searching for the secret power of an ancient civilization. They build colonies, trade, research technologies, and fight land, sea, and air battles while managing production through an automated colony assistant.

Potatoman journeys through deserts, forests, cities, and mountains toward an ultimate answer, dodging hazards and facing odd, ever-changing challenges. The game tests reflexes and quick thinking with precise platforming, strange puzzles, and a humorous, bizarre tone.

A guilt-ridden mother explores a grand manor house in first-person to uncover the truth behind an urban legend of a demonic witch and save her estranged daughter. Players search for clues and use items to fight or escape, with optional VR support.

Players take any of ten crew positions aboard a B-17 bomber in a 25-mission WWII campaign over Nazi-occupied Europe, planning missions, managing crews, manning turrets, navigating, and bombing targets, or flying German fighters against the Mighty Eighth.

Players pilot the F-117A stealth fighter through night missions in nine global hotspots, flying historically based sorties against enemy AI while managing stealth and firepower. The combat flight simulator emphasizes authentic cockpit views, generated scenarios, and the tension of unseen strikes on unaware targets.

A flight simulator recreating carrier-based F-14 Tomcat operations, from catapult launches to air-to-air combat and landing on a pitching deck. Players train at a naval air station, then fly missions in Norway and the Mediterranean against Soviet aircraft, commanding a wingman.

Players control Nero and other characters in a gothic supernatural world, fighting demons with guns and sword combos using the Devil Bringer arm while uncovering the Order of the Sword's motives. The Special Edition adds new playable characters and a mode with massive enemy waves.

Players match gems and skulls on a puzzle board to earn mana, unleash troop abilities, and damage foes in 4v4 battles across the fantasy world of Krystara. They collect and upgrade over 1,400 troops, conquer kingdoms, and compete in alliances for regional control.

State of Decay: YOSE is a zombie survival-fantasy game where the player explores an open world, recruits a community of survivors with unique skills, fortifies a base against undead hordes, and raids for food and ammunition to live another day.
Sonic must team up with Dr. Eggman to stop the Deadly Six on the mysterious Lost Hex, speeding through twisting levels with new parkour moves and Colour Powers, and battling bosses in dynamic fights.

Choose a fighter and battle the minions of the evil wizard Phantom across eight Tokyo-inspired stages in a 2D beat 'em up with fighting-game twists. Dash through colorful locales, level persistent characters with customizable skill trees, and team up in local or online co-op and PVP.

A fast-paced strategy game of global conquest where the player commands a superpower, allocating resources and troops, gathering military intelligence, and directing land, sea, and air forces across fictional world wars while weighing the risks of nuclear war through a point-and-click interface.

As an evil keeper, the player digs out and builds a multi-level dungeon, recruits and equips minions, and fights the forces of good in simultaneous turn-based tactical battles across a procedurally generated world, managing rooms, traps, and raids while risking permanent game over if the keeper dies.

Play a hardened mercenary who gathers a band of adventurers and sets out on an epic quest for a weapon once wielded by a deity, fighting evil through turn-based battles with magic and storyline twists. The HD remaster enhances textures, lighting, and shadows while keeping the classic 32-bit era RPG tale intact.

As ex-pizza delivery guy Eurico, players join a team of paranormal detectives to investigate monsters disappearing from the supernatural underworld. This point-and-click adventure sends players through hand-drawn, comic-style locations, solving eerie puzzles and gathering clues alongside a werewolf, demon, and gargoyle.

Players dive into underwater multiplayer deathmatches as divers or as a Great White shark, hunting each other across flooded seascapes while sharks join the bloodshed, with co-op and solo survival modes against waves of sharks and character gear customization.

A cyberpunk point-and-click adventure in Neo-San Francisco where a journalist helps a self-aware ROM named Turing find their missing creator, exploring a branching mystery through dialogue choices and multiple endings while considering identity and what it means to be human.

Two unreliable narrators, a Hyperion company man and a clever con artist, team up after a shady deal goes wrong and travel across Pandora encountering gangsters, bandits and wildlife. The player guides their choices through five episodes, shaping relationships and consequences ranging from comedic to heartbreaking.

Playing as rookie racecar Lightning McQueen, the player competes in over thirty races and mini-games across open environments with ten characters from the film, aiming to win fame and fortune at the Piston Cup Championship.

A puzzle game where a girl named Anne is trapped in a twisted mansion of rooms that slide like puzzle pieces. Players move rooms and use gadgets and special abilities across 144 levels to reach exits and uncover the mansion's dark legend.

An ex-minister named Teddy ventures through six levels of a frozen Hell, using a slingshot against bizarre beasts and solving puzzles while searching for his kidnapped three-year-old daughter and uncovering the secrets of his past.

Relive the One Piece story from Fushia Village to Dressrosa as Luffy and the Straw Hat Crew, gathering characters and fighting through epic battles at Marineford, Fish-Man Island, Punk Hazard and Dressrosa. The action-heavy Warriors installment adds new co-op actions and a larger roster.

Players control WALL-E, a lonely robot cleaning a trash-covered Earth in the year 2700, as he meets EVE and journeys across the cosmos. Gameplay uses his abilities to create cubes for platforms and distractions, solving puzzles alongside up to four-player competitive mini-games.

As one of the last shapeshifters, the player flies between sky islands as a bird, exploring an open world of ruins and temples, solving puzzles, and uncovering mysteries on a pilgrimage to save a shattered world.

A simulation game set in a workshop specializing in truck servicing. The player repairs and replaces over 100 parts across seven detailed truck models in three weight categories, upgrades the workshop with individual test tracks, and unlocks achievements.

Players run an airline in a real-time economy simulation, managing aircraft purchases, routes, financing, stock listings, personnel, marketing, and maintenance while fending off competitor sabotage. The comic style and jokes accompany deep management tasks, with local network play for up to four players.

Mater hosts a national race festival where racers from around the world challenge Lightning McQueen. Players race against new characters, explore Radiator Springs and McQueen's racing headquarters, and take on more than twenty mini-games, with appearances by characters from Monsters, Inc.

Players explore procedurally generated worlds built entirely of LEGO bricks, freely manipulating and populating them with models, prefabricated structures, and landscaping tools, then traveling by helicopter, dragon, or gorilla to unlock treasures while characters and creatures interact in unexpected ways.

A naval strategy game where the player builds a fleet of WW2-era warships, arms them, assigns captains and destroys enemy fleets. Battles use an angle-and-power aiming mechanic with 3D ships, hit locations, fog of war, aircraft and strategic command cards across campaigns and multiplayer.

Trapped in a dark world of nightmarish mazes, the player runs from monsters in fast-paced first-person arcade horror, stunning and avoiding enemies rather than killing them while unlocking powers and dodging environmental hazards.

In the Drakalor Chain, Chaos has broken into Ancardia and you control a single character of many races and classes, exploring towns, dungeons, and temples, completing quests, and balancing corruption's power against damnation across numerous endings.

A young patissier opens his own shop and finds two catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, hidden among his belongings; they beg to stay and help him run La Soleil, leading to a heartful comedy of their earnest, sometimes clumsy efforts.

A science fantasy roguelike set in a deeply simulated world of ancient civilizations, where the player builds a mutant or true kin character from mutations and cybernetics, explores and fights turn-based in a sandbox, and pursues allegiances among dozens of factions.

A graduate of the Academy of Magic journeys through mountains and southern lands, fighting orcs, ghosts and nomads in turn-based battles, recruiting allies, collecting artifacts and learning three schools of battle magic.

In a recreated Akihabara, a young man turned undead by vampires joins the Akiba Freedom Fighters to uncover the Synthister plague, fighting brawler-style with improvised weapons and stripping enemies' clothing, with divergent paths and multiple endings.

A stop-motion clay-animated point-and-click adventure following space explorer Tommynaut and his blind talking alien dog Beak-Beak as they explore a fortress holding them captive and solve puzzles to unravel its mysteries.

A small beetle arrives on a tropical island to deliver parcels, but must traverse it using pinball mechanics, platforming, and open-world exploration to help locals and wake a sleeping island deity. Players rebuild the post office, earn abilities, and fight giant bosses across beaches, jungles, and snowy mountains.

Players guide a prisoner through a bleak, nightmarish world of gloomy castles and surreal realms in a point-and-click adventure. They solve varied logical puzzles, meet strange characters, and make moral choices that shape the ending of a dark story between dream and reality.

An old-school anniversary RPG mixing OrangeJuice characters across whimsical worlds created by a fairy for a sleeping princess. Battle with over 80 characters, explore varied settings from school life to ruined warzones, and play online multiplayer.

Dozens of mice race to bring back cheese within two minutes across millions of player-made and official maps, while one player as Shaman builds contraptions to help or doom them. Physics mishaps, cosmetic hats, tribes, and level editing fuel a free-to-play multiplayer platformer.

Players journey through a dark, atmospheric world of overwhelming enemy encounters and diabolical hazards, fighting through overhauled enemy placements and online invasions in a punishing action RPG. The tone is obscure, grim and relentlessly challenging, rewarding persistence with intense emotional payoff.

Command a spaceship and custom crew as a pirate, merchant, bounty hunter, or other roles across a procedurally generated open galaxy, managing ship upgrades, crew talents, and faction politics amid war and alien threats.

A turn-based RPG set in the post-apocalyptic wasteland of Olathe, where the player leads a party through a bleak, darkly comic journey and must make brutal, permanent sacrifices and choices to survive and keep companions alive.

A short rock opera about a paper mayfly, blending rhythm challenges with point-and-click adventure as the player moves through handcrafted paper, glass and paint settings whose intuitive interactions play in harmony with the original guitar soundtrack.

As a US Army commander in 1965 Vietnam, the player wages a counter-insurgency campaign to secure the Ia Drang valley, hunting Vietcong insurgents and countering NVA offensives. Coordinating airmobile troops, artillery, and local forces while winning hearts and minds and home-front support is central.

Typoman is a puzzle platformer in which the player controls a small character made of letters navigating a dark, hostile world. By creating, changing, or destroying words, the player alters the environment to solve puzzles and progress through a surreal, atmospheric story told through wordplay and puns.

As a king in a procedurally generated medieval fantasy world, the player builds a city, manages resources and industry, trades and conducts diplomacy or war with neighbors, and researches magic. Subjects act on their own, and sandbox or campaign modes let players shape a realm.

A former Navy SEAL escorts scientists to an alien world in a parallel universe to recover a damaged probe, only to be separated and hailed as a messiah by the natives. The player explores free-roaming voxel environments, fights reactive AI enemies, and uncovers a story across a long adventure.

Two detectives pursue a rogue former owner through fifteen comic-style locations to recover a rare striped elephant stolen from a provincial Russian zoo, solving puzzles and playing timed mini-games in a humorous family adventure.

A madcap detective adventure in which Brother Chief and Brother Colleague track down their kidnapped cat Arsenic, foiling Experimental Chef Sumo. Players build a composite of the catnapper's face, sneak past ticket collectors, ride a handcar, and solve puzzles across nine levels.

As augmented operative Adam Jensen in a segregated 2029 society, players unravel a worldwide conspiracy using weapons, augmentations, and stealth or combat approaches. Their choices and actions shape the outcome across diverse near-future locations.

The player assembles a team of comic-book heroes and battles villains across dynamic environments in a cooperative card game, playing cards, using powers, and drawing cards to trigger combos. It supports single player and online multiplayer, with unlockable variant cards and expansions.

Players engage in chaotic first-person melee combat across scenarios like bar fights, discos, and western saloons, smashing fully destructible voxel enemies with whatever is at hand. A rogue-lite campaign, arena modes, online co-op, and a level editor round out the experience.
Two doctors enter the mind of a dying patient, Colin, to grant him a wish he could not fulfill in life, unraveling a life split down the middle in this story-driven adventure about memory and regret.

A free-to-play MMORPG set in the magical world of Azmara, where players pick from four races and seven classes, explore landscapes and dungeons, fight in PvP arenas and large castle sieges, craft equipment, and customize heroes with costumes, wings, pets, and mounts.

Players run a trucking business, driving rigs across 30 cities from Mexico to Canada while dispatching over 45 cargo types, managing up to 35 trucks, and handling weather, accidents, police, and deadlines. Profits fund repairs and upgrades as the operation grows into an empire.

This collection of classic point-and-click adventures tells stories from the Lands of Dream, a surreal world of imagination, death and transformation tied to our own. Players click through whimsical scenes, meet strange characters and follow a tapestry of tales about war against a god-king.

Players command German, Allied and other armies through operational World War II campaigns from the invasion of Poland to France, choosing strategic options before battles, moving regiments and divisions, coordinating attacks and managing logistics, with hypothetical scenarios and multiplayer team play.

A visual novel for a female audience following Eri, an ordinary high school student who collects ball-jointed dolls and lives alone after her grandfather's death. After a strange dream, she hears noises in her kitchen, and the story unfolds over roughly 40 hours with full Korean voice acting.

Players follow Essi, a psychic junior high student investigating a murder and disappearance at a school tied to her mother's death, training her abilities, exploring the school, collecting notes, and making choices across thirty days in a visual novel and dating sim blend.

Players bash friends to gain control of a puck and fight toward the opponent's goal across over twenty maps littered with spikes, bumpers, and speed boosts. It is an eight-player local multiplayer party sports game with a single-player challenge mode, customizable teams, and instant replays.

Players pilot a ship through waves of neon space enemies in a retro arcade shooter, leveling score multipliers and shields while surviving escalating challenges across several modes including time attack, survivor, and meteor storm.

Players command armies across three historical turn-based strategy games, leading Axis, Soviet, or Allied forces in WWII campaigns and Medieval wars, while managing economies, resources, and military development on large maps with skirmish and hotseat multiplayer modes.

Players guide gawky cat-mole hybrids through underground caves by rotating and altering level tiles to shape the path they follow. The creatures face traps, monsters and tricky challenges while collecting mushrooms and relics, with secondary goals, trophies and secret levels to find.

Players assemble a party of three heroes and journey through a randomized world of dungeons, procedurally generated loot, and quirky NPCs, battling the Sons of Dawn cult across campaigns with permadeath and a graveyard tracking fallen heroes.

Players command one of twelve ancient human kingdoms or seven Fryhtan species in a real-time strategy game blending city management, trade, industry, espionage, diplomacy, and conquest. Victory can come through fighting or buying influence, with heroes, gods, and a random campaign generator.

A 4X turn-based grand strategy wargame spanning the rise of Rome to modern civilization, in which the player commands armies of ancient and modern nations, manages diplomacy, research, economy and population, and wages wars solo against AI or in cross-platform multiplayer.

Players control rescue workers rebuilding three storm-ravaged islands, clearing debris to free trapped workers, repairing houses, restaurants and sawmills for resources, and racing the clock to collect gems, extinguish fires and save swimmers across sixty levels.

Players explore an uncharted island and help natives rebuild ravaged villages, gathering resources and calculating efficient task routes while defending workers with Moai statues against an active volcano and attacking ghosts. Comic-book cutscenes and colorful graphics frame the resource-management quest.

Princess Bow disguises herself to enter her father's Royal Games and uncovers a plot threatening the Space Station Kingdom. Players eat to grow, barf to shrink or attack, and explore interconnected overworlds with hand-crafted puzzle levels, disguises, and wild bosses in a surreal arcade adventure.

A Match 3 puzzle game set in Japan's Edo period, where the player helps a geisha and a samurai preserve ancient Japan. Players make matches in swap, pop, and chain modes, build an ancient Japanese village, and take on a challenge mode with limited moves.

A man with no memory navigates a collapsing dystopian world ravaged by a pandemic that grants the sick supernatural powers before killing them, in a point-and-click adventure. He must recover his identity and decode the disasters that shattered civilization before time itself dissolves.

Set in a quarantined London overrun by infected, the player scavenges scarce weapons, ammunition and supplies while navigating streets, canals and landmarks. Death is permanent: the fallen character becomes a zombie holding the player's bug-out bag, and a new survivor must retrieve it.

A text-based interactive sci-fi novel spanning thirty years in the life of a brilliant robot maker, from graduate school to a future transformed by their creations. Players shape a robot's personality and appearance, romance characters, and decide whether to spark a robotic uprising or teach machines to love humanity.

A challenging roguelike dungeon crawler with turn-based combat where the player builds a hero, collects randomly generated equipment with prefixes and suffixes, and descends through procedurally generated dungeons. Players choose between items, traps, and events, sacrifice to gods for blessings, and face permanent death.

A twin-stick shoot-em-up rendered entirely in tiny voxels, where the player fights off an alien invasion of their home planet, destroying fully destructible enemies and environments while advancing through the Moon and Mars toward the aliens' mothership. The tone is explosive, action-packed, and self-aware.

An online street basketball game where each player controls one character in a chosen position and progresses through leagues. Players learn over thirty shooting and passing skills, customize outfits and accessories, and team up with crewmates for tournaments against other players online.

A cheerful puzzle game about arranging cuddly cats on a blanket, matching identical pairs to create higher-tier cats and cascading combos, using gravity physics and quick matching for bonus points while players develop their own strategies and compete for high scores with friends.

rFactor is a realistic racing simulation offering detailed vehicle physics, tire and aerodynamics modeling, and a full day-night cycle. Players race AI or online opponents across customizable cars and tracks, with career upgrades, driver swaps for endurance events, and extensive replay tools.

A point-and-click detective adventure starring private eye Ray Hammond, who investigates a case through interrogation, snooping, and puzzles while uncovering occult and noir-tinged deception. The story jumps between past and present, and gunfights and chases punctuate the drama.

A year after civilization collapses, a former hedge fund manager leaves his bunker to scavenge, trade, farm, and recruit survivors into a community. Players make morally weighty choices, fight fast zombies, and uncover dark secrets across a large open world with action-RPG and real-time strategy elements.

Starting in an old uncle's basement, the player runs an illegal drug-dealing business to fund development of a dream video game, expanding influence, selling at higher rates, hiring workers, buying equipment and weapons, and upgrading production while dealing with rival gangs, police, junkies, and an investor.

A dog life simulation where the player hatches a unique dog, manages six need meters, and explores Dogstown while peeing, digging, barking, and playing arcade games. Permadeath and lurking dangers threaten the dog's health, and home customization and dog parties round out the sandbox.

Playing as Dr. West, the lone survivor of an underground Mars colony, the player battles evolving monsters, manages hunger, thirst, oxygen and injuries, scavenges and crafts gear with 3D printers, and explores randomly generated sub-levels to escape the infection.

A 2D action roguelite platformer set in Lady Tallowmere's dungeons, where the player raises a shield to block, strikes at the right moment, dodges traps, loots weapons and gear, and turns in souls to grow stronger across procedurally generated rooms.

A puzzle game spanning over 60 levels where players guide fish to freedom by manipulating the interactive environment, avoiding obstacles and predators. Tools include missiles, growable plants, harpoons, and ice, across Adventure, Free, and Survival modes with coins to collect and equipment to buy.

As Kayto Shields, newly appointed student council vice president and club manager, the player balances studying, fixing up troublesome school clubs, and a bet to get a girlfriend by year's end. The comedic school life sim follows his hectic days among eccentric club captains.

A turn-based grand strategy game in which the player defends Earth from an alien invasion and battles for control of the Solar System. The player negotiates with Earth's governments for support, establishes bases on other planets, and designs and builds spaceships to take into battle.

Found a game studio in a 1980s garage, developing game concepts, hiring and training staff, researching technology, and expanding offices while buying out competitors and dominating the world market for video games.

Players command historical armies across ten scenarios spanning ancient Rome to World War II, fighting turn-based battles on a region-based map with income, unit purchases, and event cards. The board-game-style strategy system aims to simulate conflicts from many eras in one consistent ruleset.

Players control Glorkian Warrior and his Super Backpack against endless waves of alien creatures, collecting energy crackers and powering up lasers, rockets, fireballs and tennis balls. Each run adds progress and unlocks new features regardless of performance, with ranks to climb.

An elite battle cyborg is sent to a mysterious island to investigate anomalies after scientists awaken a hostile alien life form. The player runs, jumps and shoots through seven levels of biological monsters and fierce boss fights to save humanity.

Work with friends to defuse procedurally generated bombs: one player sees the device while the others read a manual they cannot show, forcing fast, tense verbal communication before time runs out in a local co-op party puzzle game.

A misanthropic killer hunts down humans in a city's outskirts, shooting and killing without mercy while evading and fighting back against armed forces. The isometric shooter emphasizes cold-blooded slaughter, running, hiding, and brutal destruction with no rules or compassion.

A fast-paced turn-based strategy game inspired by RISK, where players conquer over 900 varied maps in short matches, competing online in ranked leagues or against AI, with map editing tools, plugins, and biohazard mode altering each game.

In a zombie-overrun post-apocalyptic southwestern America, the player explores canyons and mines in VR, scavenging ammo and handling motion-controlled weapons to survive hordes. A campaign can be played solo or with up to three co-op survivors, with real-life weapon movements and free exploration.

A VR real-time and turn-based strategy wargame set across magical worlds floating in the sky, where players build armies and command forces to free worlds from demons mining their crystals. Players manage resources, cast spells, research units, and fight in a story campaign.

A strategy game recreating real-world protests and riots, letting the player command either police squads with crowd-control tactics or rioters and journalists, choosing aggressive or softer approaches across campaigns and scenarios while public opinion is rated.

A fast-paced time management adventure retelling Greek myth, in which Hercules races across crumbling roads and ruins to rescue his wife from Hades, rebuilding as he goes, completing puzzle mini-games, and overcoming beasts and obstacles thrown in his path.

The player explores a non-Euclidean hyperbolic world of hexagons and heptagons, gathering treasures across about 60 lands while avoiding monsters, with the goal of collecting the Orbs of Yendor. Experimental modes add racing, real-time shooting, 3D geometries, and VR options to the puzzle roguelike structure.

A wicked witch turns princes into frogs and imprisons fairy-tale princesses, twisting stories like Sleeping Beauty and Snow White. Players free the frog-princes and reunite them with their brides to break the spells and restore happy endings.

A barbarian leads a small party of heroes into a dungeon beneath Darkwood to stop an evil sorcerer whose minions raid nearby villages. Players control up to three characters with unique abilities, fight orcs and undead, roll the skull of fate, and trade in the village.

Players operate New York's Line 7 subway as either driver or conductor, running missions and scheduled service through 21 stations in a 1970s-80s setting, managing speed, braking, and stop positions while interacting with colleagues at a depot.

Players build rockets and rovers from parts, launch from planets across the solar system, and complete challenges teaching real orbital physics, with a persistent sandbox for constructing space stations and bases that can be saved and shared.

A 250,000-word interactive novel about a wrestler pursuing stardom in professional wrestling, where choices shape relationships, promos, and matches. Players develop physical abilities and wrestling style, decide when to keep kayfabe, and influence the ending through their final match.

Maya Anderson, a certified hypnotherapist, enters clients' inner worlds to question patients at a mental facility whose head doctor has vanished, confronting their fears and phobias while uncovering a larger problem and a romantic plot in a point-and-click adventure with arcade elements.

A precision platformer about hungry alien creatures searching a food-scarce universe for a satisfying meal. Players jump through over 170 challenging levels across five zones, alone or in online co-op and competitive race modes for up to eight players.

As the last of an ancient line of kings, the player explores a dark ruined fortress room by room, solving puzzles and managing objects to stop the Warlock Lord from raising the titan Behemoth. This restored 1987 first-person fantasy adventure presents classic drag-and-drop puzzle solving.

After a nighttime car crash, players enter a Gothic mansion to find their missing brother, exploring over fifty rooms filled with ghosts and demons while racing against time to preserve their sanity. Classic first-person adventuring uses drag-and-drop objects and puzzles.

An animated tube television stranded in a recycling center must find its remote control while dodging machines that would crush it into scrap. Players navigate six factory areas, using eight weapons such as uzis, C4, and rocket launchers to solve explosive puzzles and fight malfunctioning machines.

Set aboard a high-tech space station in 2088, players explore the crew's lives through a digital surveillance system, rewinding and fast-forwarding 3D recordings to reconstruct a story of trust, fear, and resolve amid disaster. The narrative adventure emphasizes investigation and environmental detail.

A hidden-object puzzle adventure in which the demons of the Seven Deadly Sins escape their prison and take over Sacra Terra, and the player explores a decaying hospital, a medieval abbey, and eerie catacombs, gathering items and solving puzzles with help from a spirit called Angel.

Players slide a water droplet around a window-pane, avoiding spikes and collecting pearls across increasingly difficult logic puzzles, accompanied by gentle music and a side narrative about love, loss and nostalgia.
After saving a girl, Masaya is invited to attend an all-girls academy for a year, where he navigates sheltered students, strict faculty, and romance with four heroines across a full school term.

A cinematic visual novel continuing the science fantasy story of Selphine and her companions as they travel back to their homeland after the events of the first milestone. A new 3D camera system aims to make the reading experience more immersive and larger than life.

The player runs a pharmaceutical conglomerate, designing production lines of machines and ingredients to manufacture drugs, then selling them in a shifting market against rival companies. Part business simulation and part logistics puzzle, it asks players to balance curing disease with maximizing profit across scenarios and a free-build mode.

An ancient civilization's stronghold is invaded by alien raiders, and players build and upgrade towers anywhere on the field across 40 levels, choosing improvements and strategies to repel diverse enemy armies in a classic tower defense campaign.

Lightning awakens after centuries in crystal stasis to save humanity's souls as the world sinks into chaos with only thirteen days left. Players customize her outfits and weapons and fight in action-oriented battles while managing limited time across a doomed world.

An aging King Graham recounts his life of adventure to his granddaughter Gwendolyn across five chapters, with players solving puzzles that offer multiple solutions, choosing between Bravery, Wisdom and Compassion, and befriending peculiar companions in the land of Daventry.

A horror-adventure game in which a man crashes on an old road through an ominous autumn forest and must uncover past mysteries and perform a ritual to free an innocent soul trapped in a monstrous form. The player explores a fairy-tale-styled forest with occasional humor across five sections.

A deck-building card game set in a dark fantasy world where players choose among four factions and over twenty heroes. Players collect and craft cards, battle other players in draft tournaments and constructed matches, and progress through a story-driven campaign, with all cards earnable through play.

Players guide a character through over 400 rooms across four zones in a classic isometric platforming adventure, overcoming self-contained challenges and hunting for secrets and hidden mini-games in a nostalgic tribute to 80s and 90s gaming.

After a flying island appears above her city and her friend Mary vanishes in a beam of light, the player explores the creepy island, befriends its spirits, solves puzzles, and collects missing crystals to bring Mary home. The point-and-click adventure spans 52 locations and 19 mini-games across three difficulty modes.

A visual novel in which a young man burdened by guilt and regret arrives at a walled academy and meets five young women, each carrying her own sorrow. Through their stories he searches for a new thread of hope.

A visual novel sequel continuing the story of a young man and the girls he met in a peaceful life, as he reflects on guilt from his past and watches the girls find meaning and recovery. The narrative follows their emotional journeys from being protected to becoming protectors.

The final chapter of the Grisaia visual novel series follows a young man reflecting on saving five girls and his past, with a prologue set before his arrival at the academy and the grand conclusion of the overarching story.

Players race over 100 licensed motorcycles from 14 manufacturers across a World Tour of festivals held at 15 worldwide locations, competing on GP, country and city tracks, customizing bikes and riders, and climbing the world rankings in single-player and online multiplayer modes.

Players build medieval siege machines from a large block collection and use them to destroy castles, annihilate armies, and clear physics-driven campaign levels. A sandbox and multiplayer modes let players test contraptions, share community machines, and create custom levels.

A 2D stickfigure online shooter where players enlist in the petty conflict of Somewhere Land against an evil sorcerer. It offers over 70 weapons, dual-wielding, platforming with walljumps and ladder tech, seven modes, thousands of unlockable skins, and map and skin editors with Workshop support.

A tennis simulation offering deep tactical play with varied strokes, difficulty levels, and a full World Tour career spanning thousands of players and hundreds of tournaments across many court surfaces, plus singles and doubles matches.

A relaxed point-and-click adventure RPG in which the player gathers supplies, trades and explores islands by land and sea to rescue a sister taken by pirates, with no failure or time pressure and a world that improves through good deeds.

You run a trading enterprise, hiring and equipping heroes, crafting hundreds of items, and sending workers out to fight monsters across varied environments, balancing resources and sales to grow your economy and become the wealthiest merchant in the land.

Players follow Prince Ceodore and other heroes in a 3D remake of a sequel set seventeen years after a war, exploring ten unlockable tales while fighting monsters with the Active Time Battle system and moon-phase-influenced abilities.

The player builds a business empire starting from a lemonade stand, investing in ventures and hiring managers so income keeps accumulating even while offline. The idle capitalism simulator emphasizes exponential growth, angel investors and constant spending in a lighthearted tone.

A story-driven cyberpunk RPG set in the Hong Kong Free Enterprise Zone, where the player leads a team through corporate greed and urban strife, using turn-based combat, cyberware, and magic while uncovering a deadly conspiracy in the main campaign and bonus campaign.

An asymmetrical multiplayer game where players bribe, coerce, and trick human opponents into acting against their own interests, with one player commanding a giant robot while others use stealth and cunning to subvert control and earn the most money by round's end.

Players pilot a top-secret radar-evading jet through realistic scenarios across four regions, managing pitch, roll, thrust, and radar profile while dogfighting, bombing, and landing on carriers or land.

Traveling at light speed in search of a new home for humanity, players command a massive starship armed with fighters and plasma weapons while encountering alien races of varying intent. They must choose quickly between combat, diplomacy, and trading as second thoughts could prove fatal.

After Victor Frankenstein resurrects the dead, the player faces monsters, overcomes obstacles, and solves puzzles to save the unhappy creatures and stop the baron Igor. Restoring nature's course and rescuing Victor and Elizabeth drive the story.

Atlantis is sinking, and the player becomes champion of its last queen. Across fifty time-management levels, build roads, manage resources, establish towns, and raise armies to defeat enemies and save villagers before the land is destroyed.

Rebuild the destroyed city of Athens and enlist the Heroes of Olympus to battle an evil god, gathering gold through match-three puzzles and city-building interludes while meeting the needs of the population and summoning gods.

Work through four hidden object adventures: search spine-chilling locations for clues, solve puzzles and mini-games, and unlock new areas. Stories span a desperate wife's search, a cursed gem, a bride snatched by the Faceless Ones, and the mystery of Atlantis.

A Chinese high-school dating simulation where the player balances romance with classmates against preparing for the Gaokao college entrance exam over 100 days, choosing between study and love across many storylines and dozens of endings.

Players join an online platform for classic card games like Rummy, Solitaire, Skat and Doppelkopf, competing in ranked leagues, clubs and tournaments or playing private tables with customizable rules, tutorials and statistics to improve their skill.

Players combine basic elements like earth, air, fire and water to discover new elements, life-forms and objects, gradually building an entire universe while managing unintended consequences such as plagues, and can compete with friends in tournament mode.

A relaxing logic puzzle game in which the player solves a suite of ingenious levels accompanied by a hand-painted art style and an acclaimed score. A side narrative about love, loss, and nostalgia unfolds alongside the puzzles, aiming to test the mind without frustration.

An atmospheric logic puzzle game in which players solve a large set of carefully balanced puzzles accompanied by an orchestral score, voice-over narration, and beautiful visuals, guiding them through a nostalgic journey of discovery.

A young boy named Cantus meets Maris, a mysterious girl by the sea, in a slice-of-life supernatural visual novel. Players collect seashells and unlock wallpapers, theaters, and side stories while enjoying a cute, relaxing story with animated backgrounds.

As part of an elite squad, players explore a vast underground cave in a damaged drilling truck, fighting unknown creatures. They build turrets in real time, gather resources with a robot assistant, develop weapons and gear, and search for relics to escape.

A short serious visual novel set in a world containing nothing but endless rain and a single inhabitant, a girl named Rin who declares herself its mistress; the protagonist arrives by elevator and learns of her long solitude, with a bonus Narcissu episode included.
