A short narrative adventure following a lonely office worker in a cold, overpopulated megacity whose monotonous commute is disrupted by strange events, exploring themes of urban isolation and dread through a dark, surrealistic and atmospheric story.

As the young Archmage Domino, the player mentors two gifted students, Aria and Kaya, in a magical world recovering from war, teaching lessons, sending them on quests, and shaping their growth over three years toward one of many endings.

A visual novel set in 1945 Taiwan after Japanese colonial rule ends, following residents of Keelung as Chinese soldiers arrive and expectations of a better life sour, with the story continuing into the traumatic events of 1947.

In an alternate 1946 where the Nazis near victory, war hero B.J. Blazkowicz undertakes a two-part mission through Bavaria, fighting Nazi soldiers and monstrous creations with new weapons, dual-wielded pipes, wall climbing, and stealth take-downs in first-person combat.

As the boss of a shipping line, the player starts with a small fleet of worn-out feeders in one of sixty ports, completing contracts, planning voyages, expanding ships and subsidiaries, and reacting to oil prices and rival companies in single-player campaigns or competitive multiplayer.

In a future where humanity lives deep underground, time negotiator Elcia travels across dimensions to recover lost resources. Her first mission leads her to the unknown Area-X, unraveling conspiracies tied to her own past across six chapters with multiple romances and endings.

A digital jigsaw puzzle game offering full-size professional puzzles with piece counts from 21 up to 1410, each cut in unique shapes no physical jigsaw could match. Players customize settings and environments, use hints and power-ups, and enjoy a peaceful puzzling atmosphere with autosaving.

Players act as an upgradable antivirus defending a hacked computer system, using customizable weapons and turrets to destroy waves of viruses and bosses in fast-paced top-down arcade shooting. Objectives include scanning sectors, retrieving stolen files, and defending encrypted files from decryption.

A simple action RPG following heroine Senia, designed for relaxing play with a battle system that requires no attack button, offering a fluent and accessible adventure meant to evoke memories of classic MMORPGs.

Set in the Far North long ago, you live as a member of one of nine iron-age cultures in a procedurally generated wilderness, choosing to fish, hunt, trap, trade, craft, or build while surviving harsh conditions and engaging with northern folklore and spirits.

In a gamified world called Gamindustri, the player leads a party of characters against a crime syndicate through turn-based battles with transformations and support members. Players also send a character into dungeons in a real-time mini-game, adjust difficulty and loot via Plans, and craft custom equipment from Idea Chips and Blank Discs.

Players guide four heroes through quests to foil Loki's schemes while growing a humble Viking town into a large city, exploring territories, establishing trade routes, and developing inexperienced fighters into renowned heroes across three difficulty levels.

Players guide the retired hero Bjarni back into action as darkness spreads across the world, exploring unknown territories, establishing trade routes, and raising inexperienced fighters into renowned heroes. The strategy adventure tasks them with solving the mystery of the 8th Wonder of the World and banishing evil.

Players build zany Rube Goldberg-style chain reactions from over 220 objects and 300 parts, using electricity, explosions, lasers, and wind to solve physics puzzles, then create and share their own machines and levels through Steam Workshop.

In a medieval fantasy world torn by war between two nations, the player takes on the burden of the Shepherd to fight human darkness and reunite humans and Seraphim. The journey features large environments, animated cutscenes, and a battle system built on fusing with Seraphim.

On a colorful fantastic planet, the player commands steam-robot armored trains along railroads, developing an economy from resources and repelling hostile creatures and elemental forces across twenty missions with changing weather and landscapes.

Joe, a simple janitor, uses a mysterious time travel device to move between 1972 and a post-apocalyptic 2012, solving puzzles and piecing together the cause of humanity's demise. The story unfolds across ten chapters with voiceovers and a minimalist art style.

A funny pixelated karting game where the player races across 29 handcrafted tracks, collecting totems and coins to unlock races and characters, using weapons and shortcuts while chasing Froggy, the Daddy Crapo's runaway daughter.

A visual novel about Atcchan, who returns to his small hometown for three days after two years away, reconnecting with old friends and confronting his fear of change, with relationship choices that can lead to unpleasant outcomes.

Guide a fledgling species called Nuggets from the Stone Age to the Space Age as a godlike force, wielding powers like tornadoes and lightning while managing resources and ecosystems. Research 200+ advancements and colonize procedurally generated planets in this strategy city builder.

Players follow Elise, Franz, and Frederic through the magic-ruled city of Overture as they pursue a broken piano and an impossible healing spell amid brewing revolution, making choices in a lengthy visual novel with six endings.

As heir to a throne, the player leads a caravan from town to town across a pre-medieval Oriental setting, trading goods, undertaking quests, and fighting bandits, beasts, and djinns. Strategy and RPG elements mix with folklore-inspired adventures drawn from Arabian Nights tales.

Players control Neptune, trapped in an alternate late-1980s version of Gamindustri, and must gather enough shares to escape while fighting the Seven Sages. Combat uses customizable five-move attack combos, alongside dungeon mini-games, crafting, and plans that alter dungeons.

Assil sneaks into the pharaoh's pyramid, accidentally unleashes a deadly curse, and must flee a mad Osiris through Cairo's bazaar and along the Nile. The comic point-and-click adventure offers over 80 puzzles and more than 45 characters in ancient Egypt.

A rally racing simulation featuring the cars, drivers and 13 official rallies of the 2015 FIA World Rally Championship. Players drive on gravel, snow, asphalt, dirt, ice and sand in varying weather and time of day, learning basics in Rally School, progressing through Career mode, and competing online.

While covering for a colleague, the player faces a mysterious panel whose only component is a red button, and despite instructions not to touch anything, pushing it triggers a chain of cryptic consequences across 25 enigmas.

LoveBeat is a free-to-play online rhythm game where players hit arrow keys and the spacebar to dance to indie songs, competing or teaming up across many modes while customizing avatars with thousands of fashion items and socializing through emotes, couples and families.

In this match-3 puzzle game, a flock of birds seeks revenge after cats steal their chicks. Players match clusters of birds to clear paths, surround cats to remove them, blow up walls, and earn powerups, while unmade matches cause more birds to hatch and complicate goals across dozens of levels.

An operational wargame recreating the 1942 Eastern Front, where players command Wehrmacht or Soviet forces through large campaign scenarios, managing units and supply while answering to a high command that assigns difficult orders and can remove them from command.

Players guide self-proclaimed explorator Bertram Fiddle through a quirky, animated Victorian London, following clues and exploring over 30 locations to track down a serial killer called Geoff the Murderer, in a dark-humoured point-and-click comedy murder mystery with action sequences and terrible puns.

A classic-style RPG that begins with an interrupted wedding and a kidnapped bride, then grows into an epic saga of war, love and betrayal where choices affect entire nations. Players explore a world, craft thousands of items, sneak past enemies with map AI, and fight using a positional tile-based battle system.

Players drive rally and rallycross cars from past and present across global off-road events, tackling asphalt, mud and snow, drifting through turns, following co-driver instructions, and customizing vehicles while chasing best times on hill climbs and circuits.

MotoGP 15 lets players race against MotoGP, Moto2, and Moto3 riders across the 18 circuits of the 2015 championship. An expanded career mode adds personal teams, while overhauled physics and AI and a Beat The Time mode test riding skill.

Players direct the Freelance Police, dog detective Sam and hyperactive rabbit Max, on a road trip across America's quirky underbelly to find a runaway carnival bigfoot. They explore tourist traps, intimidate bizarre characters, and solve puzzles in a comedic point-and-click adventure.

Play as one of five classes of special military operatives in a first-person co-op zombie shooter for up to five players, completing objective missions by planting explosives in infected areas or fighting escalating waves in survival mode, online or offline with AI teammates.

The player guides Clara through seven playable days in the town of Delilah, exploring her personal relationships and searching for a cure while doctors call her delusional. This short narrative adventure is lightly interactive, with an original soundtrack and a story told from Clara's perspective.
Players guide cute furry creatures into an evil wizard's castle to rescue their princess, exploring rooms and solving short, simple puzzles in a lighthearted, mildly brain-teasing adventure.

Players guide Leo, a turquoise-furred engineer, through hand-crafted environments to recover his stolen gold and uncover the thief. The journey spans forests, deserts, pirate cities, and snowy mountains, combining physics-based puzzles, precise timing, and a story-driven mystery with an optional no-death hardcore mode.

The player guides a group of travelers on a post-apocalyptic road trip across the United States, scavenging fuel and supplies while avoiding creatures that are drawn to noise. Each randomly generated level and character forces hard choices about rescuing survivors, upgrading the wrecked car, and surviving the end of the world.

As a dungeon lord, players defend their dungeon from greedy adventurers by placing and upgrading traps across handcrafted levels. Kills grant experience for permanent upgrades, and difficulty runes, summoning portals, and environmental hazards like boulders and minecarts add variety.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, the player keeps a family alive inside an underground bunker, managing supplies, crafting, and morale while sending members outside to scavenge, and facing moral choices whose outcomes determine whether the family survives.

A real-time strategy game recreating the Battle of Stalingrad from June 1942 to January 1943, letting players command over 150 unit types across 43 missions in two campaigns for the Wehrmacht and the Red Army on historically reconstructed maps.

Private investigator Sydney Emerson hunts a killer through Victorian London, searching slums, taverns, brothels, and surreal dreamscapes for clues. This noir point-and-click adventure mixes dark humour, eccentric British characters, and an existential crisis against a soundtrack blending film noir and Victorian instruments.

The player builds a transportation empire from 1900 onward, laying tracks, roads, and bridges and running trains, trucks, buses, planes, and ships to move goods and people while competing with rival companies across varied scenarios and difficulty levels.

Take the role of an average high schooler trying to win the heart of his childhood friend, who happens to be a giant grasshopper. This sweet and charming romance visual novel ends with a life-or-death decision and includes grotesque, non-human imagery.

Players guide Madeleine Valois, companion to a prince, as she steers him through royal politics and keeps him from scandal while managing her own feelings. This visual novel branches through alliance choices toward fifteen endings, exploring romance and court intrigue under social obligation.

A romance mystery visual novel where the player partners with the redheaded Kurenai inside a virtual game attraction, uncovering his identity and the truth behind East Tower while navigating comedic and romantic scenes.

A tired neighbour decides to silence loud parties by stealthily killing guests with a knife and environmental traps across semi-procedurally varied levels in the USA, blending in while dancing and avoiding capture, with unlockable characters and local co-op.
Players guide snake-like birds through over fifty puzzle levels on a non-linear world map, growing their length by eating fruit and navigating themed zones to reach ever more fruit.

Players guide a Chinese city or tribe from humble beginnings into a great empire, developing land, building cities, raising armies and waging large-scale turn-based battles on one detailed map of China and Mongolia while advancing technology, culture and religion.

Players control marines exploring procedurally generated, beast-infested spacecraft in first-person, retrieving data cores and activating sentries while sealing doors to survive. After downloading all data, they overload the reactor and must reach the airlock within 90 seconds. Permadeath and intense arcade-style combat define the experience.

A minimalist puzzle game where the player draws a single continuous line across tiles, flipping each from black to white, and must turn all black tiles white. It includes over 100 levels, achievements for multiple solutions, and a level editor with Steam Workshop sharing.

A console-style fantasy RPG following Tachi, prince of Clan Minas, sent to retrieve a fallen star. As clans betray each other for its power, he journeys across the planet through dungeons and hidden areas, fighting in a fast-paced battle system with customizable difficulty and character growth.

A private detective with the ability to dive into the past through objects called mementos investigates his wife's murder while piecing together his lost memory, following her cryptic final words. The episodic mystery adventure unfolds through a cast of eccentric characters and clue hunting.

Players lead expeditions through procedurally generated late-19th-century worlds, seeking fame, science and treasure. They plan treks, manage resources and sanity, trade with native tribes, loot trap-filled temple ruins, and fight wild animals, mystical creatures and dinosaurs.

The Gruzzles have stolen all the numbers, and the player, as a boy or girl, travels through undersea, volcano, and cosmic locations solving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division problems to recover them. It is an educational math adventure aimed at children aged six and up.

A side-scrolling action game where the player switches between a sword-wielding warrior and a fireball-casting sorceress across three chapters of realms filled with traps, enemies, and bosses, viewed from a tilted perspective with vibrant VGA graphics and multiple difficulty levels.

This 1995 classic is a fast-scrolling first-person shooter where players fight hordes of digitized enemies through huge multi-story levels filled with traps, hazards, and destructible objects. Players pick one of five characters with unique abilities and wield thirteen weapons, with modem and network multiplayer support.

Based on the classic Talisman board game, players command Space Marine Legions as Warlords in the 31st Millennium's civil war, building legions and armadas and battling in turn-based 2v2 matches locally or online against friends or AI.

A turn-based tactics game in which the player commands Captain Kayto Shields, the prototype starship Sunrider and a squadron of mecha pilots through punishing battles. Between fights, a story-driven narrative unfolds, including a plotline about a spy among the crew, with fully voiced Japanese dialogue.

Toko, a demon expelled from hell, cannot ferry souls and grows more human each day on earth while being hunted by her past. Taken in by the cheerful human Nadia, she navigates comedy, action, romance, and rock music in this kinetic visual novel.

A 13-year-old girl is puppeted by the ghost of her old friend as they explore an abandoned island where several people were recently murdered, searching for a way to kill her. The player explores non-linearly, solves puzzles, and uncovers a bizarre secret in a monochromatic, atmospheric horror narrative.

A fast-paced shower simulation where the player showers with one of three 8-bit dads across several singleplayer modes, including endurance runs and dad matching, plus multiplayer head-to-head showering and unlockable secret modes.

A broken robot falls from a cargo ship onto a post-human Earth now inhabited by robots and must race back using a gravity-manipulating engine, boosting through junkyards and varied biomes across 11 levels while competing for fast completion times.

Playing as a heroine hiding her recent memory loss, the player navigates relationships with five men and chooses a romantic path from the start. Branching choices, relationship parameters, mini-games, and a gallery of voiced images lead toward one of over twenty endings.

A ghost on a boat at sea must discover why it died by possessing the ship's residents and using their relationships to pry loose secrets. Players switch between nine characters, read minds, and follow an intricate mystery with multiple endings.

An open-world RPG where players travel a vast world by blimp, artifact, or foot, completing quests in multiple ways with lasting consequences. Choosing one of three starting paths and a party of six classes leads to over seventy endings.

A detective investigates the murder of Freya Fellow at Tangle Tower, where the prime suspect is a painting; the player explores the strange mansion, gathers clues, interrogates peculiar suspects and solves puzzles to uncover its secrets.

Players take part in 5v5 attack-versus-defense tactical shooter rounds, using operators, gadgets, drones, and environmental destruction to breach or fortify bomb sites. Team coordination, intel gathering, and map manipulation decide each round in a highly competitive online setting.

Players take the role of assassin Nikolaï Orelov during the aftermath of the October Revolution, moving through propaganda-styled Russia in 2.5D stealth gameplay, infiltrating the Kremlin and boarding the Trans-Siberian train. Players also switch to Anastasia, using period tools and vehicles.

A classic point-and-click adventure based on H.P. Lovecraft's writings, where an American naval intelligence agent aboard a Royal Navy submarine in the Antarctic must thwart a Nazi plot, recover secret cargo, and confront horrific creatures while mastering time travel across 150 settings.

Two remastered role-playing adventures: star blitzball player Tidus joins summoner Yuna to save Spira from the cycle of destruction wrought by Sin, and two years later Yuna becomes a Sphere Hunter seeking answers to a mysterious image.

An atmospheric open-world horror game focused on exploration, in which the player wanders large environments and progresses non-linearly through a mysterious story without hand-holding. The emphasis is on haunting atmosphere and discovery rather than scripted scares.

A survival game set in zombie-infested Louisiana where players find food, water, and shelter, build and upgrade a safe camp with traps and workshops, craft gear, and fight off infected hordes alone or with up to sixteen players in online and local co-op.

An open-world action game set in 1968 New Bordeaux, where a Vietnam veteran builds a new criminal family to take revenge on the Italian Mafia that killed his surrogate family. Players choose brute force, gunplay, or stealth to tear down the mob.

A branching visual novel about Miyon, a girl whose power to control fate makes her the key to a war between East and West Taria, and Gai, sold by his family into her temple, as the two struggle against destiny.

A fast-paced time management adventure in which Hercules rebuilds what the Cretan Bull destroys, tracks the beast down, meets legendary heroes and gods, faces mythical beasts and raises new Wonders, framed by colorful comic-panel storytelling and puzzle mini-games.

Players guide Megara, wife of Hercules, through a fast-paced time-management adventure to rescue her captured husband, rebuilding roads and clearing obstacles across Amazon forests and Mount Olympus while collecting puzzle pieces and beating gold times to construct a great castle.

A relaxing flow-style adventure where the player guides a swarm of returning creatures across a hostile planet, splitting and reforming the swarm to solve puzzles, collecting energy to grow and evolve new abilities and restore balance.

Play an expanded tic-tac-toe where each square holds a smaller board and your move sends the opponent to the matching board, strategizing to win three small boards in a row, with a Forget mode, AI opponents, hot-seat and online multiplayer, rankings, and leaderboards.

Players lead a group of nerdy heroes through a comedic turn-based RPG adventure, recruiting twenty heroic spirits, equipping gear, and fighting hundreds of enemies across a long main quest. Exploration reveals hidden secrets, and an online arena offers asynchronous battles against other players.

Inspired by the 19th-century oil rush, players lease land at auction, search for oil, build rigs and pipe networks, store and sell oil at the best times, and buy upgrades while outbidding rivals to become mayor, with procedurally generated single games and online multiplayer matches.

The player controls a desperate crew of imprisoned street fighters in an alternate U.S.S.R., battling an oppressive criminal authority and forced drug addictions through brutal brawling. Players punch, stab and inject narcotics to fuel rage, fighting solo or in local co-op for up to four players.

The player is an Astroneer exploring a strange seven-body solar system, using a terrain tool to dig, shape, and color ground. They build modular bases, automate resources, craft, and survive challenging biomes while uncovering mysterious structures, alone or in online co-op.

Players rebuild a farm after a hurricane, caring for animals, gathering produce, and learning recipes to sell in town while foiling ferrets that steal goods. Dozens of levels mix simple point-and-click farming with roulette bonuses and collectible stickers in bright, animated style.

A young woman raised as a boy joins an army seeking her brother, then rises through the ranks to lead a mad king's forces amid political intrigue, war and romance, in a fantasy visual novel where choices shape battles and relationships.

A 3D isometric dark fantasy RPG dungeon crawler with a physics-based combat system where momentum, collisions and precise inputs determine outcomes. Players explore an underworld, fight smart enemies, survive with a detailed damage model, and hone skills in an arena mode.

A business management simulation where players construct office buildings, hire and train employees, and design software and hardware products to compete in a randomized market. Players manage teams, contracts, patents, and facilities, and can play against or cooperate with friends.

A creepy point-and-click adventure following Fran, a young girl with a mental disorder who escapes a children's asylum to find her black cat after her parents' gruesome death, solving story-based puzzles and using medication to reveal a hidden world.

The player builds a trucking empire from a single hauler into a convoy network, delivering extreme loads under deadline across five hazardous locations including ice roads, steep mountains, and thin rainforest tracks. Thirteen big rigs and risky cargo types feed reputation and profit.

Players solve logic puzzles that reveal gentle melodies, waking a philosophical feline companion named Ren, or compose freely in a full sandbox editor. Community creations can be shared via Steam Workshop in this calm, music-driven experience built by a single developer.

Players become physicist Gordon Freeman at the Black Mesa Research Facility when an experiment goes wrong, fighting through an alien invasion and a military clean-up crew across 19 chapters. The reimagined campaign spans secret labs, deserts, railways and the Xen dimension, with multiplayer maps and modding tools.

Players race karts as Garfield and friends across sixteen colorful 3D circuits, using bonus items to attack rivals and defend their lead. Modes include Grand Prix, single races, time trials, and daily challenges, with character customization through hoods and accessories.

As a Fatebinder in the Overlord Kyros's army, players arbitrate law in the war-devastated Tiers, making world-altering choices, gathering companions, and engaging in tactical real-time-with-pause combat while deciding whether to uphold or dismantle the new regime.

In a prehistoric world of cavemen, neanderthals, and dinosaurs, the player builds a clan, teaches skills, hunts and gathers, and leads warriors against rival tribes and dinosaur attacks, with extra modes and split-screen co-op.

After her car plunges into a river, Alice wakes in a dream world of her own memories ruled by the Shadow. She explores hand-painted surreal locations, solves puzzles and hidden object scenes, and confronts characters from her psyche to find four totems and escape.

A shooter where the player pilots a sperm through procedurally generated uteri and throats, using lasers, torpedoes, and armor to survive defenses, earning deposits for a sperm bank and gestating trophy babies, with optional Oculus Rift support.

A darkly funny satire set in a Discordian underworld where no one can improve themselves. Players navigate dialogue-based puzzles, use sins as inventory items to help fallen souls, and explore an intricate black-and-white space of interconnected challenges while learning of the Curse of Grayface.

Players manage a weapon shop in a wacky potato world, forging weapons with potato smiths and selling them to questing heroes. They research hundreds of weapons, train smiths, explore areas for materials, and build customer loyalty across a humorous simulation.

A real-time strategy adaptation of the tabletop game pits Chaos, Imperium, Eldar, and Orks against each other in space battles, with players customizing ships, managing fleets, gaining crew experience, and fighting through a campaign during the Gothic War.

An idle clicker game where the player clicks to defeat endless waves of monsters for gold, hires and upgrades dozens of heroes who keep fighting while away, and ascends to reset progress for permanent power. Numbers escalate toward absurd damage-per-second totals across ever-tougher zones and bosses.

Organa, an apprentice organ harvester, tends a greenhouse of growing kidneys, hearts, and other organs for shopmaster Irene's busy village shop. The player waters and harvests goods, fulfills delivery quests, and serves odd customers, gradually advancing a story about becoming a master harvester.

Sierra Ops is a space strategy visual novel following Captain Junius Fahrenheit and the crew of the Sierra as humanity enters its first interplanetary war, combining tower defense and shoot 'em up battles with a branching, morally gray narrative, relationship systems and ship customization.

The player controls a boy with supernatural powers such as telekinesis and mind control in a 2D open-world horror adventure rendered in low-resolution 16-color pixel art, experiencing a tale drawn from classic horror cinema with an 80s atmosphere.

A fantasy strategy game set in the Warhammer Old World, combining a turn-based campaign of empire-building with real-time battles. Players command five distinct races and legendary lords, wielding battle magic and flying creatures such as dragons and griffons across a war-torn world.

A husband's romantic getaway with his wife spirals into madness and murder, and players decide what kind of man he truly is. This dark point-and-click horror adventure follows his journey for redemption with voice acting and an original soundtrack.

Players take the role of a young card-master wizard traveling across Selvarin, fighting FreeCell battles against an archmage's forces, leveling up, collecting cards to unlock free cells, buying loot, and learning spells across hundreds of towns.

A digital adaptation of the traditional Japanese Hanafuda card game Koi-Koi, where players compete to form card combinations called Yaku and call Koi Koi for extra points, with tutorials for beginners and a collection mode of scenic postcards.

A private detective arrives in a remote northern Canadian village in 1970 to investigate vandalism, only to find the town eerily empty; players explore the frozen landscape, gather clues, and battle the elements to survive and uncover the mystery.

As head of a 1950s Hollywood movie studio, the player writes, directs, produces, acts, or edits films, choosing genres, casting, and marketing while mingling with stars. This text-based interactive novel offers romance, blacklist dilemmas, and five endings.

Players command a WWII U-boat prowling the Atlantic, hunting enemy convoys while evading escort ships and depth charges. They can sneak with decoys or attack with torpedoes and deck guns across quick encounters or full War Patrols, with location-based damage and random encounters.

A fantasy visual novel about Lilia, an ordinary bakery worker who suddenly shrinks and grows cat ears and a tail, discovering she is a luccretia. She flees into town and collides with her childhood friend Ronan, a city guard, as both hide behind masks.

Players lead a mercenary company across a procedurally generated fractured world, taking contracts from settlements and noble houses, hiring recruits, and equipping the band. Turn-based tactical battles against bandits, monsters, and undead alternate with real-time travel, trading, and choices that shape faction reputations.

Players act as a lone user following automated emails from a deceased hacker, using a terminal-based interface and real UNIX-style commands to break through firewalls and uncover the mystery behind his death. The immersive simulation explores privacy, corporate greed, and hidden hacker networks.

A tactical and operational wargame recreating the Ardennes offensive of World War II, letting players command Allied or German infantry, mechanized, and armoured units across several scenarios. Success requires managing supply routes, terrain, and time limits while facing AI commanders or human opponents in multiplayer and tournaments.

As an agent in a pandemic-ravaged New York City, the player fights cover-based firefights, loots and upgrades gear, and explores a dynamic open world alone or in online co-op, including the risk-reward Dark Zone where PvP and PvE mix.

Heroes of Normandie adapts a fast-paced board game into a tactical strategy title set during the D-Day campaign, commanding small squads across three campaigns and skirmishes. It offers unique units, equipment, and abilities with a bombastic, humorous tone and light-hearted approach to tactical decisions.

The player descends into a randomly generated dungeon as one of several character classes, fighting monsters, avoiding traps, and collecting items to find the Amulet of Yendor. The pixel-art roguelike is easy to learn but hard to master, with shops, alchemy, and boss encounters across 25 levels.

Players race realistic cars against AI or other players across tracks with dynamic weather, day-night cycles, and grip that changes as rubber builds up. The simulation supports endurance events, driver swaps, and extensive community customization of vehicles and tracks for esports and single-player racing.

An arcade-style baseball game where the player picks one of six city teams and takes on the CPU in a 15-game tournament, or faces a friend locally in nine-inning split-screen matches with configurable controls and settings.

Players control a wild fox on a journey through a magical forest, using the ability to change seasons to alter the environment and open new paths. The 2D platform-puzzler features hand-painted visuals and a live string quartet soundtrack.

A text-heavy visual novel set in a distant future where the protagonist Meito Tanabe lives in a shadowless world of light until a girl named Shimon draws him into the world of shadows. The multi-layered narrative borrows from Norse mythology and includes a note system and relationship chart.

The player controls cute customizable characters in six party-style game types such as soccer, ice hockey and last-one-standing, competing against friends or in single-player practice, tournament and world tour modes. Simple click-and-aim controls and coin collection support lighthearted multiplayer fun.

A general store owner's arm is severed and a doll is blamed, drawing players into a mystery of bizarre incidents around town as they investigate crime scenes, answer reasoning questions, and unlock bonus stories in a story-driven adventure with light horror elements.

An industrial diver stranded on the Pacific seafloor struggles to surface before oxygen and sanity run out, moving in first person inside a heavy dive suit. Players use a knife, flashlight and flares against nightmarish deep-sea flora and fauna while a surreal narrative unfolds, with VR support.

Stranded across the galaxy after a jump drive malfunction, the player commands a crew through a procedurally generated universe, negotiating with alien races, raiding tombs and making consequential decisions in a roguelike RPG while trying to get home.

Fine Sweeper reimagines classic Minesweeper with a tutorial, a campaign of increasingly large and difficult boards, item drops, and a Classic Mode without extra lives. Players clear tiles using logic while managing luck, with leaderboards and achievements tracking progress.

Players design and build bridges across physics-based puzzle levels, balancing materials and budget so vehicles can cross. A sandbox mode and Steam Workshop support let players create, share, and download custom bridge puzzles and levels.

Players embark on an epic open-world adventure with three AI companions called Pawns, fighting hydras, griffins, and dragons through dynamic action combat. They choose among nine vocations, customize armor, and explore a vast underground realm full of terrifying monsters.

A minimal, relaxing puzzle game where the player clears all hooks from the board using mechanics discovered across 60 levels, with no timers, scores, or ads, accompanied by a calming ambient soundtrack and a zen, meditative tone.

An American sniper is dropped into northern Georgia near the Russian border to stop ruthless warlords from collapsing the country. Players explore open-world maps with dynamic weather and day-night cycles, choosing between long-range sniping, stealth takedowns and direct combat.

Players follow Faye Moonfallow and her squad of misfits as they train at a Space Sector Academy and try to join the Katajion Space Force. Choices guide Faye through a year of love, mystery, and growth in this yuri visual novel.

A World War II strategy game recreating the German counter-attack at Mortain, where the player issues orders to battalion-sized units on a strategic map, allocates air and artillery support, then fights the resulting engagements in detailed real-time tactical combat across linked battlefields.

As the Hunter, a customizable original hero, forge bonds with Marvel heroes and supernatural warriors at a mystical abbey while battling the demonic forces of Lilith and Chthon through tactical turn-based, card-based missions in the darker side of the Marvel Universe.

Players guide Ted through a procedurally generated house in a 60-second dash to gather family and supplies before a nuclear blast, then manage a fallout shelter through daily events, rationing food and water and making difficult choices. A dark comedy set in the 1950s.

Players sit at a mothballed desktop computer logged into a police database of 1994 interview footage with a British woman about her missing husband. By typing search terms and watching clips where she speaks those words, they piece together a non-linear crime story.

Detective Francis McQueen of the underfunded Darkside Division investigates bizarre occult cases in Twin Lakes City alongside his sidekick Officer Dooley. Players point and click through eerie locations, examining everything and using their wits to solve a comedic serial adventure of supernatural mysteries.

A third-person Norse horror adventure follows a mother searching for her missing son in a forest on Norway's western shores. Reactive narration recounts her terrifying journey through deceptive, light-and-dark environments inspired by Norse mythology and Norwegian folk tales.

An open-world action-adventure set in Victorian London where players control twin Assassins, Jacob and Evie Frye, using brawling and stealth to fight rival gangs, hijack carriages, and lead a gang to take over the city's underworld.

A rhythm-based action game where movement, dodging, and shooting sync to dubstep tracks as players fight alien enemies and bosses in a pixel-art spaceship shooter. Players unlock and upgrade ten ships with unique abilities across musical levels and four difficulty modes.

Players delve into a seemingly endless cave of randomly generated floors, choosing battles carefully to gather treasure, building a character through a sprawling skill tree, crafting potions and enchanting equipment, and deciding when to escape before danger overwhelms them.

Players help Alicia Van Volish escape District 8 and trace the source of a mysterious Golden Sphere in a classic point-and-click sci-fi adventure. The story, written by comic author Greg Rucka, mixes mystery, acid humor, romance and eccentric characters across varied new locations.

A doomed hero named Bathoryn fights through six cursed Gothic realms to free them from deadly overlords. Players master three elemental weapons, learn enemy and trap patterns, and manage mana through grueling melee combat, boss fights, and hidden secrets, all set to a heavy metal soundtrack.

A point-and-click detective adventure in which a young investigator and her partner respond to a distress call from an isolated psychiatric hospital in 1950s America. After a therapist falls to his death, the pair explore atmospheric locations, place clues in detective mode and solve mini-games to uncover the asylum's dark past.

Play as a living weapon imprisoned for millennia and unleashed to stop a cataclysm threatening all worlds. Explore futuristic fantasy worlds, master tactical gun and melee combat, and defeat legendary bosses in an unforgiving action RPG where death is not the end but every mistake is painful.

In a steampunk world of corrupt capitalist gremlins, players use a hand of cards to move around a board and perform actions like investing, stealing, extorting, and arresting rivals, competing for money, political power, and prestige in single-player or multiplayer sessions with teams and spectators.

Players run their own coffee shop, hiring and managing staff, designing the interior, planning marketing, balancing finances, and competing with rivals. They also source and roast beans from over a thousand varieties, craft seasonal drinks, and build the shop's reputation through barista skill.

Players solve tranquil hexagon-swapping puzzles, rotating pieces until all lines connect and reveal a pattern, with later levels adding spinning and color-changing pieces. A level generator offers vast numbers of levels, and the minimal interface has no timers, move limits, or scores, encouraging relaxed, meditative focus inspired by Zen philosophy.

A healing visual novel series of four independent short stories sharing a theme. The first chapter, Summer: Message on the Paper Plane, is a partly nonlinear tale about childhood memories in which players collect fragments from different viewpoints until the truth emerges.

Three unlikely heroes journey to save their world by collecting three elemental treasures, exploring a vast overworld by airship, snowcraft, and whirlwind. The retro-styled JRPG uses a color-based element system to add strategy to turn-based battles against monsters.

Players rewrite corrupted assembly-language code segments to repair a fictional parallel computer, solving over 45 programming puzzles, competing for efficiency scores, and designing their own challenges in sandboxes while uncovering the machine's secrets.

Players race as Hello Kitty and Sanrio friends across 16 tours by car, boat, and plane, using power-ups to distract rivals. They unlock extra practice challenges, customize paint jobs and outfits, and can join up to four players in split-screen multiplayer.

A farmer named Jerrat, an ordinary man rather than a knight, sets out on a journey whose outcome becomes tied to the fate of a nation. Players customize difficulty, enemy visibility and stat growth while exploring a long role-playing adventure with side quests, secret rooms and potion crafting.

A journalism student in the 1990s returns to her hometown to investigate her grandfather's mysterious death, following clues through pixel-art environments and extensive dialogue while uncovering a dark, sinister local secret tied to her own troubled past.

Players survive in a post-apocalyptic wasteland where society has collapsed, scavenging, foraging, hunting, and crafting while fighting mutants and bandits. They create and customize a character, explore a large open city, manage a colony, and face randomized events and weather.

A turn-based grand strategy game where players control any of over 80 nations, managing industry, research, trade, and military forces across scenarios before and during World War II. Players can replay or alter history, pursue different victory conditions, and build armies and infrastructure.

The player rebuilds a derelict precursor starbase on the edge of Terran space to stop an alien invasion, managing resources, facilities, ships, and a quirky crew. Exploration, diplomacy, and tactical ship and ground battles unfold through randomly generated galaxies and branching story events.

Commanding a customizable steam locomotive across the 19th-century American West, the player hires a crew, trades goods and passengers, and resolves conflicts through diplomacy, bribery or violence while pursuing a non-linear story about family and Native removal.

As the last survivor of a hunting group in the Stone Age land of Oros, players craft weapons, fend off predators like sabretooth tigers and mammoths, and outsmart rival tribes to become the Apex Predator in an open-world sandbox.

An MMORPG where the player journeys through a fairy-tale world in chaos searching for goddesses, building a character from numerous classes and ranks. Players fight bosses, join raids and parties, and compete in arena PvP and guild wars across diverse themed regions.

A turn-based roguelike in which the player explores five randomly generated worlds, fights monsters, and seeks an ancient artifact to save the world. Ten classes offer distinct playstyles, and players can charm monsters into joining the quest while a leaderboard and graveyard track their runs.

In a dying world, a Chosen One is prophesied to rise and rebirth the land, blurring the line between good and evil across two interlocked worlds. Players experience an epic story with real-time 3D battles combining special attacks and magic.

A rhythm game that turns the keyboard into an instrument, letting players perform along to catchy chiptune melodies. It offers strum and tap modes, three difficulty levels, leaderboards, official songs, and custom song sharing.

Players explore a large open-world sandbox MMO, building combat, magic, and crafting skills across dozens of hand-crafted pixel worlds and random dungeons. They trade in a player-driven market, level many skills without caps, build houses, and collect pets and items.

In 1955 New York, a detective investigates the mysterious disappearances of five mafia bosses and of children who all drew the same butterflies, uncovering a strange force behind the crimes. Players solve hidden-object puzzles and collect items across a bonus chapter and integrated strategy guide.

A hidden-object adventure in which an ordinary housewife is pulled through a portal back to the fantasy world of the Lost Lands. As the warrior Susan, she explores over fifty locations, solves puzzles and mini-games, and seeks the weaknesses of the Four Horsemen to save the world.

A chemistry learning game where children run virtual experiments at home using augmented reality through a simple webcam or mouse, exploring answers to their own questions instead of being given solutions. Players print educational cards and conduct safe, hands-on chemical experiments without reagents or lab equipment.

An arcade-style beat 'em up where the player controls Kung Fury and other heroes, punching through waves of Nazi enemies across stages like back alleys, sewers, and a Viking age, with a practice mode and stereo music in a retro cartridge-game presentation.

As a young Source Hunter investigating a routine murder, players gather a party, discuss decisions with companions, fight foes in turn-based combat and explore an open fantasy world, manipulating the environment with skill and spell combos in solo or co-op play.

A dragon girl who turns lies into physical beings travels with her caretaker through a mysterious world, buying and selling secrets while uncovering their past. Across three chapters they visit a secretive town, a casino, and a mansion, meeting colorful characters. The tone is atmospheric and emotionally resonant.

In Renaissance Italy, an aristocrat named Adriano searches for the kidnapped Duchess Claudia in the abandoned plague-research town of Apothecarium, uncovering an insane alchemist's experiments. Players solve hidden object scenes and puzzles across more than forty locations to rescue her and stop the lunatic.

A World War II real-time strategy game in which the player commands Allied, German, or Soviet troops across three campaigns, leading over 100 unit types and choosing among nine commanders to outmaneuver the enemy through ambushes, positioning, and air strikes in single-player scenarios and skirmish mode.

Set in 1992, a graduate FBI agent and her seasoned partner investigate a boy's disappearance in a small Virginia town, uncovering hidden agendas and making decisions that shape both agents' lives in a cinematic first-person thriller.

A knight returns to his cursed homeland and fights bloodthirsty monsters through castle dungeons and an open world, leveling up and buying gear to reverse the corruption. Choices such as slaying or helping characters lead to multiple endings, with optional local co-op.

Take part in combat operations as a mercenary in a PMC market, completing contracts and building reputation across global battle locations. Choose from four classes with skill systems and a large arsenal of modern weapons and modifications, fighting dynamic firefights to earn income and harder jobs.

As fires fade and the world falls into ruin, the player journeys through a dark fantasy universe of colossal enemies and environments, facing intense combat and rewarding challenges in the latest chapter of the genre-defining series.

A historical strategy simulation of the Russian Civil War from 1917 to 1923, letting the player command either the Reds or Whites across a detailed map from Poland to the Pacific. Manage armies, politics, diplomacy, and new weapons like tanks and armoured trains through campaigns and what-if scenarios.

The player must move a payload from point A to point B using only simple tools and the laws of physics, building ramps and catapults and watching objects tumble and fall. Each hand-drawn puzzle grows more complex, with budget-based completion earning hints for later projects.

A real-time strategy action game where the player picks three of five Champions with elemental powers to fight beasts and bosses across deserts, forests, snowfields and jungles. Between missions they develop a stronghold, craft potions and gear, and confront a malevolent wizard and his undead army.

An investigation adventure adapted from Agatha Christie's novel, casting the player as Hercule Poirot in third person. Players explore crime scenes across the United Kingdom, examine suspects, solve puzzles, gather clues, and build a timeline to deduce the identity of the murderer ABC.

As a U.S. marshal in the Old West, the player reads through a massive text-only interactive novel, making choices that shape the story while confronting outlaws, finding romance, enduring the elements, and uncovering a conspiracy stretching from San Francisco to New York City.

Players manage a pizzeria with Gastone and Lucky, designing pizzas, setting prices, buying furniture and advertising, while racing a 30-day deadline to beat rival eateries, with a branching story, many characters and adjustable difficulty.

Players guide Shawn O'Conner through a fantasy university by day and dungeon-crawling by night, balancing classes, friendships and rogue skills while exploring a mysterious castle, fighting foes and uncovering his past, with optional combat and humorous dialogue throughout.

A football management game focused on transparent attributes and tactical control, where the player selects players, sets formations per opponent, plans finances and develops talent without micromanagement or spreadsheets.

Players act as an office employee who programs little workers to automate each task the boss assigns, solving increasingly complex logic puzzles to earn promotions through a vast office building, with extra challenges for experienced programmers.

Players race arcade-style cars across outlandish tracks in four environments, from a gravity-defying lagoon to canyon drifts, unlocking up to 200 campaign tracks and climbing worldwide rankings. The game adds offline splitscreen, a two-controller double-driver mode, a track builder, and VR tracks.

Players build bustling cities and industrial complexes on Earth, then travel to the Moon to mine helium-3 and secure fusion energy, managing a corporation across multiple regions in a strategic city-building simulation that expands into space.

The player explores over a hundred mountain caves, collecting crystals while outsmarting and trapping RoboTTech robots with block physics and avoiding being trapped. Puzzles and action challenges mix, with multiple solutions rewarding creativity and later stages demanding precise, difficult problem solving.

Players nurture a pot of succulents that grow in real time, watering and caring for them in a quiet, meditative space. Plants can die from over- or under-watering, and players can name favorites, buy new plants from a nursery, and keep the game open as a calming companion.

An apprentice alchemist is marooned on an airless alien world after a starship accident, with crewmates missing. The player types commands in a text adventure, learning rituals, gathering scarce ingredients, and solving interlinked puzzles to repair the ship and uncover what happened.

A comedic point-and-click adventure where research assistant Kelvin chases a physicist through time to stop him from preventing Beethoven, Newton, and da Vinci from completing their masterworks. Players solve wacky puzzles across three hand-drawn chapters to repair the unraveling timeline.

A platforming adventure where a kitten journeys across tropical, snowy and desert islands to catch a legendary big fish, gathering artifacts to unlock new areas. It features over sixty levels, bosses requiring special strategies, puzzles, and comic-style story inserts.

The official digital adaptation of the board game Splendor, where the player acts as a Renaissance merchant acquiring mines, transport, and artisans to turn gems into jewels, attract nobles, and earn prestige through solo, pass-and-play, and online matches plus historical challenges.

In a world where comic books are real, the player becomes the hero Darksheer in the City of Darkness, facing vampiric and demonic villains in an adult graphic adventure filled with grisly imagery and dialogue-driven exploration.

A remastered holiday-themed visual novel sequel in which the player travels through fantastically styled winter worlds, meets new bird characters, and pursues romance and bizarre episodic side stories with familiar pigeon boyfriends, presented in high-definition hand-drawn watercolor scenery.

As the sole survivor of Vault 111, players emerge into a post-nuclear wasteland and explore a massive open world of hundreds of locations, joining factions, making choices, developing a customized character through perks, fighting with real-time gunplay or slowed V.A.T.S. targeting, and crafting gear and settlements.

The player wakes with a headache to find an identical man accusing them of being fake, and must decide who is lying through dialogue choices. Nine endings range from tragic hero to sly villain, with a supernatural mystery-thriller tone and comedic touches.

Susan's son Jimmy is pulled through a shimmering portal, and she must find a way into a magical other world to save him. The player explores strange worlds, solves challenging mini-games and puzzles, and uncovers who took Jimmy and why.

Players command armies in the Thirty Years War, English Civil War, Great Turkish War and Italian Wars, fighting tactical battles and managing a strategic campaign map where terrain, supply, attrition and sieges shape outcomes. Historical battles and skirmish army lists let players refight or mix factions from 1494 to 1698.

A single-player wuxia RPG where the player customizes a martial artist's personality, talents, and relationships, progressing through character growth and interacting with emotional NPCs. Hidden stories, multiple endings, and numerous romance options reward exploration of a free-form martial arts world.

Connect same-colored blocks on a board in a jumbled world of colorful puzzles, encountering special blocks like bolted, sleeping, entangled, sticky and flip blocks, and finding hidden moon pearls to unlock the next challenge.

Players follow Azai Kyousuke, son of a gangster, whose life is disrupted when a beautiful girl and an international criminal called Maou arrive in town, drawing him into a cat-and-mouse game of plotting and intrigue.

A beach-set visual novel dating sim in which a daydreaming student visits the shore with two childhood friends. He is preoccupied with stargazing through his telescope, but gradually notices his friends want his attention instead of the constellations.

Aria moves into her grandfather's old house and accidentally frees a flirtatious demon named Lyria, binding them together by a lifestone. Players make choices across the supernatural romance to pursue multiple yuri routes and endings.

A visual novel spinoff following Michiru, a nobody idol who dreams of fame and meets a black cat from the World of Magic asking her to become a Magical Girl and save the world. The story unfolds across 13 anime-style episodes, with Part 1 containing the first seven.

A visual novel following Michiru, a magical girl competing with her rival Kazuki to seal the Chaos threatening the world and win a wish. Told in anime-style episodes, this second part continues her story as a new threat approaches.

Zidane and the Tantalus troupe abduct Princess Garnet, who joins their journey as they uncover the secrets of the Crystal and a malevolent threat. Players learn abilities through equipment, enter Trance for powerful skills, synthesize items, and enjoy minigames in this classic fantasy RPG.

Players manage a struggling TV channel, choosing programming, selling shows, hiring staff and actors, producing original movies and series, pleasing advertisers and audience groups, and competing against rival channels for fame and survival.

Players choose from seven heroes and fight through randomly generated levels in a turn-based tactical roguelike, with permanent death and fresh adventures on each restart. Three story campaigns and an endless mode pit the party against bandits, ogres, and worse while legendary items reshape each run.

The player acts as a hacker using old-school command prompts that simulate a real operating system, breaking into the accounts of a mysterious organization, reading files and emails for clues and riddles, and climbing through over fifty levels to uncover the group's dark plans.

A 4X multiplayer strategy game with city-building where players grow a civilization of Pigmen from the stone age, settling procedurally generated isometric regions, trading resources across biomes, managing a socio-economic simulation, and fighting real-time battles in their own cities.

After a catastrophic accident leaves the player in a heavy exoskeleton inside a ruined facility, they fight haywire robots and augmented co-workers in visceral melee combat. Targeting and dismembering specific limbs yields loot used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor.

A point-and-click adventure in four acts, inspired by real events in recent Italian history and adapted from David Yallop's book, following realistic characters through over ten high-resolution locations with integrated puzzles and animated comics.

A turn-based survival strategy game set in Slavic myth after the Darkness engulfs the world. Players lead a few starving survivors, building up their village, exploring a procedural world, and resolving conflicts through card battles, diplomacy, stealth, or combat to save their people.

A spaceship management game set in a persistent 8-bit online universe where the player builds and commands a starship, manages power and resources, recruits crew, explores planets, and battles other real players while forming alliances and programming AI commands.

Players explore procedurally generated islands in a turn-based, top-down wilderness survival roguelike, gathering and crafting from over 750 items while building skills through interaction rather than classes or levels. Day-night cycles, temperature, taming or fighting creatures, and optional permadeath shape a challenging, simulation-heavy sandbox.

Play Henry, a blacksmith's son whose village is destroyed by invaders, thrust into a civil war in medieval Bohemia where he seeks revenge and fights for the resistance, exploring a realistic open world with non-linear quests, challenging combat, and character development.

Run a restaurant business by serving dishes to customers and dealing with troublesome gangsters, earning money to repair and upgrade four themed eateries while playing mini-games and progressing through many levels.

Players assemble animated jigsaw puzzles from beautiful pictures with soft motion effects, choosing piece shapes and difficulty levels. Daily challenges, turn-based multiplayer battles, and a workshop for creating puzzles from personal images or GIFs round out a relaxing, family-friendly pastime.

A first-person shooter where the player battles relentless demon hordes through Hell with destructive futuristic guns, fast movement, and melee finishers, either in a single-player campaign or in fast-paced arena multiplayer, with a built-in level editor for sharing custom maps.

In a near future where one corporation controls all game development, a young intern explores the company's secrets in a short point-and-click adventure. Players click on objects, walk around, and talk to characters while uncovering what happened to indie developers.

John Maracheck awakens from stasis aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft plunging into Neptune's clouds, with his wife and daughter missing. He explores the dark vessel, solving puzzles and gathering clues while unraveling a gruesome dystopian mystery.

A realistic first-person online multiplayer fishing simulator where players cast from boats and yachts across 27 photorealistic waterways, pursuing over 300 fish species with behavior tied to season, weather and water conditions. Players join clubs, compete in events and leaderboards, and display catches in a trophy room.

An interactive fiction piece set aboard a transport ship leaving Earth, where the player scrolls a social media feed and replies to messages while light-speed travel stretches the delay between sends and replies into hours, days, and years back home.

In an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game, four Survivors try to escape a procedurally generated Killing Ground while a first-person Killer hunts, catches, and sacrifices them, with each side progressing through unlockables and unique powers drawn from horror lore.

In virtual reality, players use a paddle to direct an energy ball called the Proton, breaking bricks across over 50 levels to destroy the M.O.A.I. core. A Space-Time Dilator slows fast action, and the arcade brick-breaking is presented from a first-person 3D perspective.

An abstract puzzle game about time travel and paradoxes, where players solve over 50 designed puzzles by choreographing actions across multiple timelines. Minimalist visuals and an ambient soundtrack accompany the exacting logic of constructing impossible solutions and paradoxical loops.

Players choose a class in a free-to-play side-scrolling 3D fantasy MMORPG, exploring over thirty maps filled with monsters and characters. They unlock classes, use skill-based action combat, decorate a private home for buffs, and raise pets while adventuring with friends.

Trapped in a penthouse atop a mutant-infested hotel after a bio-weapon attack, players descend through randomly generated floors to find food and supplies. The roguelike RPG uses turn-based combat with risk and reward, crafting, experience and unlockable abilities in an apocalyptic survival setting.

Players build a civilization inside a fully simulated ecosystem, harvesting resources, farming, crafting, and trading while every action affects plants, animals, and climate. Facing an imminent meteor strike, they analyze simulation data, propose and debate laws, and hold elections to balance progress against ecological collapse.

Arra awakens from her coffin and must reach her father's castle, now floating in the sky, to destroy the Amber Throne before others claim it. Players explore a painted world and fight turn-based battles against monsters that change stances, learning their behavior and crafting the best equipment.

Players run, gun, and dodge through an asteroid dungeon as a crew of relic hunters, fighting waves of space ducks and turtles to defeat Duke Ducan, unlocking new weapons and characters in a fast, free top-down shooter.

A fast-paced clicker game where the player defeats endless hordes of enemies by clicking, earns gold to buy costumes, and hires allies to help fight. It includes voiced character reactions during combat.

Players survive in a vast space sandbox, building capital vessels, settlements and stations piece by piece, exploring planets with unique terrain and resources, crafting equipment, and fighting or allying with others in single player or multiplayer.

Players survive a zombie outbreak on the tropical island of Banoi, exploring an open world and fighting the undead with visceral melee combat, alone or in four-player co-op. The remastered edition includes all previously released DLC and improved graphics.

Caught in a zombie outbreak on the tropical island of Banoi, the player fights through a sprawling open world with visceral melee combat, smashing and slicing the undead. The remastered edition supports four-player co-op as survivors struggle through a world gone mad.

A puzzle-adventure in which the player explores a dangerous grey land, changing the background colour to make matching obstacles disappear and unearthing coloured fragments while searching for a missing mother, meeting lively characters and uncovering a heartfelt story of love and loss.

Two junior high school students investigate urban legends at a Tokyo aquarium on a full moon night, glimpse a missing sister, and become lost in a crimson flooded building. Players follow Mayu's perspective, making choices across three routes that lead to over thirty mostly bad endings.

Lead a small Aegean village to become a powerful Greek polis, choosing Athens, Corinth or Sparta for diplomatic, trading or military strategy while managing workers, resources, technologies, colonies and diplomacy across the ancient world.

Set in 1989 Wyoming, play as Henry, a fire lookout retreating from his messy life, who explores the wilderness and communicates with his supervisor Delilah over a handheld radio. When something strange draws him into the forest, he faces a mystery and choices that shape their relationship.

In a world rebuilt after the Old World's destruction, an S-Rank Mechanician from the Halbern Machinery Academy wields the legendary relic Machina amid a struggle over ancient Attributes. Players explore Halbern, meet its inhabitants, and fight foes using a fast-paced action point-based combo system.

Players pick elemental rivals and fight in 1v1 or 2v2 platform battles, or explore story, wave-based abyss, and tetherball modes, with extensive training tools and online ranked play. The setting is a world of warring civilizations wielding Fire, Water, Air, and Earth.

Players explore a 3D anime-style MMORPG world of islands and ocean, choosing among twelve classes, developing separate land and sea levels, sailing and upgrading ships, fighting dungeon bosses, joining guilds, trading, and fishing.

A free-to-play Texas Hold 'em poker game set in the gambling city of Prominence, where players face four factions and their leaders in a solo story mode, compete online in ranked and tournament play, and customize avatars and table items.

Players dive into a vibrant ocean world as a graceful swimmer, exploring detailed aquatic ecosystems, discovering hundreds of real species, and interacting with schools of fish while descending toward ancient secrets and lurking dangers in the depths.

Play as a ninja in a retro action platformer, climbing walls, slicing enemies and mastering tricky platforming sequences across seven worlds, with cutscenes, intense boss battles, optional collectibles and hidden secrets for experts.

Stranded on a Bermuda island, the player manages a team's hunger, fatigue, sickness, injury and depression, researches and crafts to upgrade camp, explores a hundred randomized map areas and handles evolving relationships and choose-your-own-adventure encounters in the jungle.

A physics-based arcade shooter with a flat geometric art style where the player fights waves of enemies across multiple game modes. Players compete for leaderboard rankings against friends or the wider Steam community, accompanied by an energetic soundtrack.

In 1848 Paris, the player becomes Monsieur Jayjay Falcon, a bird lawyer, and with his apprentice Sparrowson takes on clients, interviews witnesses, gathers evidence, and argues cases to reach one of three endings. The tone is comedic, full of bird puns and colorful characters.

Players join Nika, a seven-year-old genius, on her odd quest to build MechaNika and destroy everything she finds uncool, starting with her home, school, and city. The hand-drawn adventure involves meeting quirky characters and solving puzzles with multiple possible solutions.

A sandbox drum simulator where players build and customize drumkits, then perform along with included drumless tracks or their own music. It offers extensive sound and image customization, workshop items, learning tools like a metronome, and support for keyboards, gamepads, MIDI controllers, and electronic drumkits.

A pixel horror game made in RPG Maker where a player helps a crying girl named Cat find her way home. The journey leads through a surreal world of bizarre monsters, riddles, and painful family secrets.

Players lead Lethal and an elite party of warriors through a large fantasy land, fighting turn-based battles against varied creatures. The game offers eight playable characters with unique abilities, crafting of armor and weapons from boss materials, over fifty story quests, an arena for tougher rematches, and collectible pets with battle abilities.

An idle clicker where players destroy cubes to collect gold, upgrade a Click Pistol, and hire a team of elite shooters to defeat enemies across waves. Gold accrues offline, Time Cubes unlock artifacts, and saves can be shared across platforms with live leaderboards.

Players follow the daily routine of Shigure and the Minaduki household's six catgirls as they wake their master, prepare meals, clean the house, take walks, bathe, and sleep together in a short, leisurely visual novel set before Kashou opened La Soleil.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, players craft unique armored vehicles from dozens of parts and drive them into multiplayer battles on land and in the air, trading parts and fighting for survival and victory amid factions and mysterious robots.

Players become pirate Christopher Raven, seeking revenge on the gang that murdered his family, in an open-world action-RPG across the West Antilles. Swordplay, naval battles, crew and ship upgrades, and reputation choices drive missions and side-quests by land and sea.

Players choose from over a hundred mythological gods and fight in team-based arena battles from a third-person action viewpoint, using each deity's weapons and powers. The game offers accessible auto-buy and auto-level options alongside competitive ladders and world championships.

In a text-based interactive novel set in a mythic Greek world, players fight monsters, soldiers and gods, choosing whether to accept divine gifts, win allies through humility or deception, pursue romance, and decide whether to overthrow the gods.

An old-school platformer with a fully destructible world where players fight as infantry, scientists, movie stars, knights, zombies, and internet memes to defeat enemies and restore justice. A campaign tells the heroes' story, and a map editor lets players create their own adventures.

Players design a secret underground contraption of coloured tracks on which cats ride trains, routing each cat only along matching-coloured rails so every train's cats fly away and Earth's orbit stays stable. Across more than fifty logic puzzles, solutions must handle multiple train configurations.

Samantha Coleridge, a depressed literature student reimagined as an anime girl, joins a school trip to the Lake District hoping to repair her fractured friendship with Lillian Wordsworth. The player reads through a gloomy romantic visual novel and makes choices leading to one of four endings.

A challenging endless platformer where randomly generated worlds keep players on their toes with varied scenarios and obstacles. Global and friends-only leaderboards drive competition, and frequent updates add new obstacles and game modes for those seeking an extreme test of skill.

Play as Rick Grimes in pixel art, managing a band of survivors from the comics as they craft weapons, keep daily routines, and fight zombie hordes while escaping five infamous locations in a story that follows the comic timeline.

Players command the armies of World War I across Europe and other theaters, managing trenches, artillery shells, research, reconnaissance, and national morale. The grand campaigns span from the 1914 German offensive into France to the final battles of 1918, letting players rewrite the war's history.

Three unlikely friends travel through time to stop Dr. Fred's mutated purple tentacle from taking over the world in this remastered cartoon puzzle adventure. Players switch between classic and remastered art and audio while solving mind-bending inventory puzzles across eras.

Players act as general manager of a baseball team from any year between 1901 and 2014, setting lineups and pitching rotations, making trades and managing finances while a detailed engine simulates each pitch across seasons and decades.

An atmospheric platformer set inside the mind of a man facing his own mortality, where the player manipulates gravity and surroundings to solve over 60 physics-defying puzzles while a narrator guides them through stages of grief and acceptance.

A horror-themed match-3 puzzle game in which the player matches shapes to clear Old Town, collects gold and powerups, and buys spooky yard decorations that boost gameplay. It offers 100 levels, bonus items, and relaxed or timed modes.

Players descend through procedurally generated dungeon levels, making choices every few steps and fighting monsters and bosses with wisdom in a puzzle-focused roguelike crawler spanning five themed zones with items, secrets, and multiple difficulty levels.

Players guide teenager Alex through an overnight party on a former military island where she and her friends accidentally open a ghostly rift. Dialogue choices shape relationships and the story as they explore the island's dark past and confront supernatural creatures.

A VR experience set in planetary dream worlds where the player floats and flies as a bodyless consciousness with ghost-like arms, using hand motion controllers. It offers unique locomotion, climbing, exploration, challenges, and asynchronous multiplayer in an artistically designed environment.

A classical point-and-click adventure in which the player explores strange parallel worlds abandoned by their inhabitants, solving puzzles and mini-games and using found items to find a missing brother and escape.

A card game where a student of an old wizard is chosen to save the magical world of Emerland from the evil sorcerer Sat. Players unite Elves, Humans, Dwarves, and Mermaids while mixing several Solitaire styles with hidden-object searches across two difficulty levels.

Players choose one of two warring nations and fight in constant PvP battles across designated zones and scheduled events like Castle Siege and Lunar War. Between fights they quest, kill monsters for loot, and upgrade equipment, building a warrior in a long-running old-school MMORPG.

As astronomer John T. Carter, the player investigates the New England fishing village of Illsmouth in 1910, piecing together its history and the strange terror afflicting its inhabitants as Halley's comet returns. The point-and-click adventure draws on Lovecraftian horror, ancient rites, and hidden ritual grounds.

Players control a single cell in a microscopic multiplayer arena, absorbing smaller cells to grow while avoiding larger ones, dividing for speed, and using viruses strategically across modes like free-for-all, battle royale, and capture the flag, with guilds, equipment, and daily tournaments.

Players fight through cinematic story battles and intense duels to uncover the conclusion of the Mishima clan's ceaseless conflict. The fighting game explores love, revenge, and pride through its characters and their motivations, playable with friends and rivals.

A timid boy finds a magical crown and becomes king of the poor kingdom of Alpoko, commanding loyal subjects to dig treasure, build structures, and clear obstacles while questing to unite rival kingdoms. The storybook-style HD port blends kingdom management with exploration and NPC relationships.

A free-to-play fighting game where players pick characters such as a fiery archer, a painter, and a martial artist who becomes a dragon, then battle online in casual, ranked, and friend matches. Moves are single-button and combos simple, with cross-platform play and practice modes.

Lara Croft races a ruthless organization to uncover the Lost City of Kitezh in Siberia, battling hostile environments, hunting and crafting, using stealth or open combat, and exploring ancient tombs filled with traps and environmental puzzles.

Players control a human who falls underground into a world of monsters and must find a way out or stay trapped, using a unique battle system where killing is unnecessary and danger can be negotiated away, with timed attacks, top-down dodging, and a humorous, character-rich story.

A digital adaptation of Senet, the ancient Egyptian board game, framed as a mummy's afterlife journey through the underworld of Osiris. The player moves pawns across the board against an invisible adversary, racing to reach the final space and leave the board.

Players take the role of a painter in a decaying Victorian home, roaming warping rooms that shift to reflect his crumbling sanity as memories blur into sinister visions, uncovering the truth behind his obsession and his masterpiece in a tense first-person horror journey.

A fast-paced neo-arcade game where the player frantically dodges through five rage-inducing levels to chase high scores, accompanied by an original electronic soundtrack and trippy visuals, with global and friend leaderboards and an epileptic-friendly mode.

A fast-paced arcade BMX game in which the player rides through four distinct environments, pulling off real-world tricks and chaining combos to complete over 500 challenges. Riders and bikes are customizable, and leaderboards reward skill and speed.

Lead one of eight civilizations in a strategic space opera, exploring mysterious star systems, colonizing planets, managing populations and politics, designing ships, and fighting real-time space battles to build a stellar empire amid the ruins of the ancient ENDLESS.

Players help a displaced elven tribe survive on a lost island sealed by a magic storm, completing quests, hidden-object scenes and puzzles while fighting dangerous creatures to advance the story. The fantasy adventure is free to play and expands through regular updates.

A remastered first-person shooter campaign that follows soldiers battling a rogue enemy group across global hotspots from Eastern Europe to the Middle East, alongside classic online multiplayer modes with killstreaks and progression.

Players join massive 50-versus-50 combined-arms battles as part of a nine-person squad, fighting across large realistic environments with faction-specific weapons and vehicles. Teamwork, tactics, and a building and logistics system let players fortify positions and supply their team in intense, authentic military firefights.

Players survive alone or with friends in a harsh multiplayer open world, gathering resources, crafting tools and weapons, and building strongholds to defend loot. They explore biomes, restore abandoned vehicles, and face fierce creatures and other players in skill-based PvP and PvE combat.

Players roam open-world lakes and rivers around the world to ice fish, choosing gear and reading depth maps to find the best spots. Realistic fish behavior, changing seasons and weather, tournaments, and multiplayer modes support both single and competitive fishing.

Players clear classic Mahjong Solitaire tile pairs before time runs out across over 50 shuffled patterns, revealing five anime-style girls in sexy costumes as stages progress, with recorded voice work and strategic tile-matching to avoid dead ends.
