Players help Ted, Catherine and friends rebuild the frontier town of Sunset Hills in a time-management strategy game, gathering resources, building and upgrading towns, trading, completing quests and stopping a corrupt mayor, across 40 levels and three difficulty modes.

After witnessing his father's murder, a fighter trains, eats chicken and punches opponents to climb the Punch Club ranks while uncovering the killer, balancing gym time with friendships, romance and work through branching storylines and skill trees in a boxing management sim.

Players command a World War II nation, building industry and diplomatic alliances while designing division templates, researching production and pursuing political objectives. Decisions open alternate historical paths as they refight the conflict across a grand strategy campaign.

A masked assassin takes on over 25 challenging missions, choosing between quiet stealth or loud gunplay while unlocking weapons, fighting zombies and vampires, and completing objectives like assassinations and investigations.

Players control Price, an ambitious young man who seizes an elderly woman's property to secure a company partnership and then confronts the cost to his humanity. The short side-scrolling adventure unfolds a dark, grim story through simple movement and puzzle-solving.

Players control Ed, a zombie forced into a grotesque game show, running and jumping through deadly obstacle courses while losing limbs and throwing his head to reach hidden areas, all to rescue his friend Ben from the ruthless host.

A puzzle game with no tutorials, hints, or text at all, leaving players to figure everything out themselves. It offers three puzzle mechanics with twenty-five levels each, black-and-white pixel art, two characters, and optional challenges involving a drawn language.

Players guide Scarlett as she helps animals on an abandoned island learn to farm, growing crops, feeding animals, and gathering produce against the clock. Starting with a few chickens, they expand into manufacturing goods and trading with neighboring islands, earning medals and achievements while a wacky animal story unfolds.

An interactive text novel set on the planet Versus, where the player is an interstellar warrior who absorbs the thoughts and powers of others. Choices drive gladiatorial combat, alien romance, and political intrigue as the player navigates a morally ambiguous civil war.

An experimental narrative psychological horror game about a protagonist with a family history of mental illness and sadomasochistic tendencies, exploring hallucinations and disturbing themes through a mature, unsettling story based on a true story.

Hercules and Megara set out to restore lands ravaged by a beast summoned by angry gods, using her magic and allies like King Midas and Epeius across over fifty fast-paced time management levels, with secret challenges and a bonus episode.

A wounded redcoat fleeing the War of 1812 takes shelter in a barn during a storm and finds a young Shawnee girl hiding there too. The player follows their uneasy accord through a full-length visual novel with artwork, unlockable CGs, and an orchestral soundtrack in the colonial Northwest Territory.

An artificial life and evolution simulator where virtual creatures with neural-network brains struggle to survive, feed, and reproduce on a 2D grid, mutating over generations; players can watch natural selection unfold or intervene with world-editing tools and scenarios.

A collaborative sandbox game in which players build a city and defenses with companions, planting and harvesting resources, constructing workshops and barracks, learning spells, and commanding golems and siege weapons. Characters persist across games and progress from the Wood Age to the Steam Age, with co-op and versus multiplayer modes.

A turn-based tactical and strategic game set in sixteenth-century East Asia, covering the Japanese Warring States period and the invasion of Korea. Players command diverse armies and generals in historical battles and campaigns, managing terrain, supply, and morale to achieve regional domination.

Players snap together aircraft parts to design planes, then fly them in a physics-driven flight model where weight, thrust, lift and drag affect handling. They can download community craft, take on challenges like carrier landings and missile dodging, and build freely in sandbox mode.

A deceptively challenging top-down puzzle game where the player commands colorful robots that only interact with objects matching their color. Using a block inventory to create stopping points, players guide bots to unlock doors, push blocks and shift colors, helping a black-and-white robot reach the finish across 70 levels plus bonus levels and a level editor.

A digital board game where players buy properties, negotiate temporary alliances, and compete to build wealth across varied matches. It supports online multiplayer for two to four players, 2v2 team play, tournaments, leaderboards, and offline matches against bots or local friends.

To lift a curse on the Solitaire Kingdom, the player completes 400 rounds of solitaire while gathering companions, buying items from a blacksmith and defeating dragons across a story-driven fantasy quest.

Players manage a video game studio from scratch, starting with micro games to build worker experience, then choosing project names, scale, and genre. They hire and train staff, expand the team, publish games, impress critics, and compete for awards against rival studios.

A co-op multiplayer game about living together in a procedurally generated house in space, where players gather resources, recycle alien goo, build technology, garden, and clean rooms with mops while containing a deadly alien infestation, using no weapons at all.

A city-planning deck-building game where players place building cards that affect their surroundings, clearing blocks by gathering resident points to expand. It includes a voice-acted story mode, competitive versus AI or local players, and over 230 cards across eight characters.

A schoolgirl noir game of boardroom politics and lesbian romance: as a student leader, the player investigates a missing locket by interrogating suspects, searching for clues and running surveillance, balancing results against public opinion.

Players command Soviet or German forces on the Eastern Front of World War II, fighting through historical missions, dynamic campaigns, and PvP or co-op battles with over 250 vehicles and detailed armor mechanics. Views switch instantly between first-person, third-person, and top-down RTS control.

A motocross racing game based on the 2015 FIM World Championship, letting players ride official bikes and tracks, customize their rider and team, and compete across the season with realistic terrain and handling physics.

A regular rabbit turned into a human with rabbit ears finds herself in an unknown world and, joined by a pink-haired fairy, sets out to restore her normal life. The player explores a non-linear 2D world, fighting bosses with melee and ranged attacks and collecting upgrades.

Players control the POSTAL Dude through a violence-stricken town, fighting off crazed gunmen, police, SWAT, and military squads with a large arsenal across 17 campaign levels. The isometric twin-stick shooter also offers online co-op, deathmatch, and a score-chasing Rampage mode.

A free creative toy in which the player picks a theme, draws ten random cards supplying backgrounds, objects, and odd elements, then assembles a one-to-four panel comic from only those pieces, customizing dialogue, colors, and layout before exporting the result as a PNG to share.

A strategy-puzzle game in which the player is an elite hacker jacking into cyberspace, using viruses, worms and exploits to steal data before security traces the signal, with a cyberpunk tone and both VR and non-VR versions.

Players race and crash customizable cars across destructible tracks and arenas, competing in derby events, time trials, and stunt mini-games. Online and hot-seat multiplayer modes let up to eight players battle with weapons or set traps, while a single-player campaign covers racing and stuntman challenges.

A live-action interactive movie adventure where the player presses buttons to survive a town gone mad, find their girlfriend, and escape, with a branching storyline, dynamic dialogue, and many ways to die.

A point-and-click horror adventure set in Victorian England, where psychiatrist Dr. John Wakefield searches for his vanished client and uncovers forbidden knowledge, madness, and a conspiracy spanning asylums, manors, and opium dens across four episodes.

Players gather around a virtual sandbox table to play hundreds of licensed board games with friends online, using realistic physics and automated setups, or design and playtest their own games without programming skills.

At a girls' academy built on an old castle site, solitary student Toomi Yuna is visited by two ghostly lovers who died with unfulfilled feelings. She helps them foster more yuri couples among the school's girls so the spirits can learn what they need before resting, in a gentle romance visual novel.

Players assemble a band of unusual heroes, send them to battle monsters for gold, and spend that gold to level up and unlock abilities. They arrange Crusaders into formations for maximum damage across multiple campaigns, monthly events, daily quests, and side missions. The tone is lighthearted and comedic, with heroes drawn from video game and pop culture references.

Players command a rescue crew rebuilding storm-ravaged islands, clearing debris, repairing bridges, extinguishing fires and protecting civilians while racing a clock. The time-management puzzle game asks players to plan the fastest route to each goal before time runs out.

Act as architect and manager of a space colony on a remote planet, building structures and production chains while keeping colonists supplied with oxygen, food and water, managing immigration and surviving disasters and intruders across four increasingly difficult planets.

A supernatural assassin returns in a first-person action game set in a world where mysticism and industry collide. Players choose between two protagonists and use powers, gadgets, and weapons to fight or sneak through hand-crafted missions, with the story responding to their choices.

A procedural survival horror adventure where the player explores the land and fights through randomly generated dungeons while trying to stay sane. The goal is to save the world from invading Ancients, using magic spells, multiple characters, and roguelike perma-death across varied missions and monsters.

Conquest of Elysium 4 is a turn-based fantasy strategy game with roguelike elements, where players command one of 20 distinct factions across a randomly generated world and six planes, each faction offering unique mechanics, rituals, and goals.

A fantasy RPG based on Markus Heitz's novel follows dwarf Tungdil across Girdlegard, deploying a roster of heroes in tactically paused real-time battles against orcs, ogres and other foes while exploring a free-roaming world map and solving optional puzzles.

An otome dating simulation in which a seventeen-year-old heroine begins her first and final year at a new college. The player pursues friendship or romance among several gentlemen, collects clothing and accessories, and works toward one of nineteen endings.

As a new pilot at a mech training ground, players partner with one of several female co-pilots to win the mech wars, following an ecchi visual novel story with multiple routes and endings, romanceable NPCs, and unlockable CG scenes.

A tabletop-style tactical game set in handcrafted diorama battle boards inspired by Norse mythology, where the player commands a warband of figurines in cool-down-based combat, positioning units, slowing time, and customizing gear, abilities, and battle cards.

A block-based city builder and action adventure where the player constructs or destroys cities, runs businesses or commits crimes, builds a real estate empire, fights turf wars, and drives vehicles, alone or in multiplayer co-op.

An action RPG set during Ragnarok, where a Viking clan chief must save Midgard from Fire and Frost Giants and the deadly Fimbulwinter. Players travel Norse realms, fight in bloodthirsty combat, sacrifice blood to the gods for power, and can team up in online co-op.

Players steer a growing line with single-button controls, collecting points and surviving as long as possible across several modes, or building and sharing levels with a level editor and Workshop support, in a minimalist arcade experience with multiplayer for up to eight.

A top-down shooter where the player controls nanorobots inside a human body, clearing infected cells, fighting parasites and bosses, and unlocking and combining unique abilities across hardcore battles.

A punk rock apocalypse action RPG where the band Charlie Murder battles rival death metalers and their legions, hoarding loot, earning fans, and unlocking finishers and team moves in a co-op quest to save the world.

Players are trapped in a malevolent, malfunctioning arcade machine built by the devil and must solve suspenseful puzzles, repair broken code, and think outside the box while being insulted for exposing the devil's poor programming.

Players become the newest resident of a quirky village, restoring a run-down farm by planting crops, raising animals, fishing and hunting bugs. A voxel sandbox world allows building and customization, with multiplayer support for sharing farms and neighboring with friends.

At an American oil research station in Greenland, an ion storm brings reality and night terrors into strange intermixing. This old-school, character-driven horror adventure features voice-acted dialogue, hand-drawn portraits, and an original soundtrack, drawing on Inuit legends and Cthulhu mythos.

A time-traveling warrior explores a savage 3D Lost Land, fighting dinosaurs and alien enemies with an arsenal of weapons while hunting the eight pieces of the Chronoscepter to stop an evil overlord from shattering time.

Players hunt dinosaurs and mutated creatures across six sprawling quest levels, fighting intelligent enemies with over twenty weapons while riding an artillery-mounted Triceratops, and can battle friends in new multiplayer modes including Last Turok Standing.

The demon prince Laharl awakens to find the Netherworld in turmoil and, with his vassal Etna and angel trainee Flonne, battles to retake the throne. The player fights tactical grid battles, grinds characters to extreme levels, and dives into randomly generated item dungeons in a comedic SRPG.

In the 24th century, a fleet commander deploys into the darkened Dust Zone to investigate a supply crisis. Players manage strategy in turn-based mode, then fight real-time 3D space battles, customizing ships and expanding the fleet across a campaign.

On an isolated island in October 1986, the Ushiromiya family gathers to contest a vast inheritance and a hidden gold fortune, while a letter from a self-proclaimed witch and a string of brutal murders leave unsolvable riddles for the player to unravel.

A point-and-click survival horror game set in rural Piauí, Brazil, where Maria returns home and becomes trapped by a local legend curse, forcing her to solve puzzles and evade a beast through a maze forest toward multiple endings.

A visual novel in which two cat-eared ninja girls, Yura and Tama, arrive at the protagonist's home to fulfill an ancient contract and serve him, bringing loyalty, affection, and a bit of action into his modern life.

A boy who lost his parents takes in a stray kitten named Nuri, only to discover she has bakeneko powers, and soon finds himself raising two children alongside a soul manager and a mysterious girl. Players watch over his hectic daily family life and play mini games with the cast.

Players control Yomi, an ancient fox spirit who awakens to find her dungeon stolen and her power drained, and must explore its floors, fight and capture monster girls to build a party, gather loot, and reclaim the dungeon from its new lord.

A first-person shooter blended with roguelike RPG elements and reality-show parody, set in a decadent 22nd century. As a contestant in the Killing Room, the player fights through randomly generated levels with permanent death, invests in attributes, and entertains an AI or streaming audience whose votes affect rewards and punishments.

Players control Remedy, a graduate of a Saturnian healing school, descending into Hurtland to heal everyone from stray ducks to dark lords and cure an ailing prince in a short, whimsical adventure full of heart.

An online multiplayer sports game descended from space hockey, where players maneuver, pass and shoot to score goals. Simple to learn but demanding teamwork and individual skill to master at a competitive level.

Players take on the role of Kimchi the cat in a hand-drawn 2D adventure platformer, meeting famous internet cats on a humorous journey. The goal is to find caged kitties and unmask the evil one, supported by traditional animation and an orchestral soundtrack.

Playing as Cid, the player helps revive an old sky tavern in a fantasy world by serving magical potions, entertaining guests, and earning tips to add new features and restaurants. Fast-paced time management levels are mixed with match-3 mini-games and quirky animated characters.

As a newly hired prison guard, the player assembles a party of four guardians and pursues escaped prisoners into a vast dungeon of corridors, crypts, and mines. Combat uses tank, damage dealer, and healer roles with threat and aggro plus active pause, alongside talent trees, loot, puzzles, and traps.

A space beam turns the world into a video game, and the Angry Video Game Nerd must platform through NES-hard levels, using new abilities and collectible armor to defeat his toughest foe and save the world. The tone is crude, comedic, and deliberately retro.

Playing as a pink-clad office lady, players jump over enemies through a cave to recover missing documents and return safely to the office in a cute 2D side-scrolling action game, with a hard mode offering a new special ending.

A short 2D action game starring a pink office lady who jumps over foes and evades danger to rescue a young shopkeeper from UFOs. Completing conditions unlocks an additional Hard Mode, and it serves as an introduction to Kero Blaster's play style.
As an instructor in a hellish spire, the player guides seven delinquent girls through a reformation program, climbing floors so their sins can be atoned and they can be revived into the mortal world.

On a lonely island, Marona, a girl who can speak with Phantoms, takes freelance requests from floating Bottlemails to earn money and buy Phantom Isle, aided by the Phantom Ash. The story follows her optimism despite being shunned by clients.

Three to eight players race locally on the same screen across uniquely generated landscapes, where tactical choices and power pickups matter more than speed. Players nudge rivals off track, sometimes fatally, in a slow, social multiplayer contest.

Play as an escaped Mexican prisoner in the 1870s United States, fighting for survival and freedom through deadly revolver gunfights, stealth, and upgrades against bandits in the Wild West. The hand-drawn pen-and-paper art style depicts real towns and the cruel desert world.

A third-person shooter in which EDF soldiers fight swarms of giant alien insects and their machines across over 80 missions, choosing among four classes and hundreds of weapons, with online co-op play supported.

Players pilot FPV racing drones in a simulator with realistic physics and flight dynamics, customizing drones and building or sharing tracks for solo and multiplayer flight. The focus is on authentic handling and community-driven evolution rather than combat or narrative.

A top-down arena fighting game where two to four gladiators battle to be the last one standing in an anything-goes deathmatch. Players fight armed or unarmed, wield and throw every object, deflect projectiles, and win the crowd's favor as the arena shifts each round.

Players fight swarms of monsters and gigantic bosses in an action RPG, forming a party of four from beloved Dragon Quest characters. They level up characters, upgrade spells and abilities, swap between party members strategically, and collect monster medals to summon allies into battle.

A visual novel set in the small rural village of Hinamizawa during the Shouwa era, where an annual festival is shadowed by mysterious deaths and disappearances. The player follows a cast of villagers as a covered-up murder case appears to repeat itself.

A text-based interactive novel about a necromantic legal thriller in a desert city, where the player negotiates water rights with scorpion gods, solves murders, builds alliances, and reanimates their own corpse to keep the city from drying out.

Players build a galactic empire by colonizing planets, trading knowledge with alien races, and conquering star systems to secure resources, with the ultimate goal of defeating the vengeful Antarans. The turn-based 4X strategy game spans diplomacy, technology research, and tactical ship combat across a vast space setting.

Playing as Kate, a serial-killer survivor in witness protection, the player works a night shift at Billy's Burger, serving customers while exploring the restaurant, uncovering secrets, and facing hallucinations and apparitions in a first-person psychological horror narrative.

Players command World War II forces in real-time battles across towns, mountains and swamps, deploying over a hundred detailed units from infantry squads to heavy tanks. Tactical maneuvering and unit selection drive the campaign against enemy armor.

A remastered World War II real-time strategy game with three campaigns set in Africa, the Mediterranean, and the Balkans. Players command American, German-Italian, or Yugoslavian forces, using new units, destructible terrain, night stealth missions, and a mission editor.

A text-based interactive survival-horror novel of 750,000 words in which the player escapes a zombie-infested city and faces a final swarm at Zombie Exodus. Choices control the story, with professions, gender and orientation options, and romance amid the post-apocalyptic setting.

A lone hero with a sword and sword-breaker enters an abandoned castle seeking treasure, facing enemies and mysteries. The player makes choices at each step that shape a non-linear story, alter karma, and lead to various endings across many locations.

A 3D brawler where teams of ninja girls from rival academies fight with mid-air combos and Secret Ninja Art techniques, with outfit deterioration as damage, story told from four viewpoints, and four-player online battle modes.

In 2036 post-apocalyptic Russia, the player as Artyom flees the Moscow Metro with Spartan Rangers aboard the Aurora locomotive, crossing vast non-linear wilderness levels through the seasons. They scavenge and craft weapons, fight humans and mutants with combat and stealth, and face survival horror.

Players stand in virtual reality and punch incoming orbs in time with any song from their own music collection, with beats syncing to the music's intensity. Each track has its own leaderboard, and local leaderboards let friends compete at parties.

A group of tech-savvy students discover they can change the past by sending messages to a modified microwave, drawing them into a conspiracy around SERN and a self-proclaimed time traveler from a dystopian future. Players read a long non-linear visual novel, answering or ignoring phone calls and messages to steer multiple endings.

Players inherit an overgrown farm and rebuild it by growing crops, raising animals, crafting, and befriending the townsfolk of Stardew Valley. They explore a mysterious cave, fight monsters, fish, mine, and restore the community, alone or with up to seven online players.

Trapped in a school-turned-prison by a murderous bear, students must investigate killings, gather clues, and sway classmates while engaging in wordplay trials to expose lies and survive, uncovering the truth behind their imprisonment.

A mystery visual novel where students trapped on a tropical island must solve murder cases to survive, gathering clues and interviewing classmates before facing minigame-driven Class Trials to expose the killer and escape with their lives.

A visual novel following Suoh, a high school student who becomes a killer for hire to support his twin sister after their parents die. Players follow his double life as he takes assassination jobs, evades police, and faces rival criminals.

A broken Celtic warrior journeys into Viking Hell on a haunting vision quest to fight for the soul of her dead lover, with combat and storytelling that immerse the player in her experience of psychosis in a brutal mythic world.

Players match falling colored blocks in a fast-paced arcade puzzler, linking same-colored blobs and using star blocks to clear them. Modes include Arcade, Endless Battle, Tournament, and Puzzle, with local co-op or versus for up to eight players and cute anime-style characters.

Players control cameraman Blake Langermann investigating a pregnant woman's murder in the Arizona desert, where he stumbles into a cult preparing for the end times, enduring a survival horror journey into madness and dark secrets.

Four freed prisoners of war work for British intelligence in World War II Europe, teaming up in four-player cooperative shooting missions to raid Nazi strongholds, choosing classes and abilities while chasing gold and glory.

Engare is a game about motion and geometry in which players select points on moving objects to trace shapes in the air and match each level's target glyph. A sandbox mode lets players draw their own geometric patterns and export them as images or 3D models.

Players manage a motorsport team, hiring drivers and staff, building and customizing cars, and making split-second race-day strategy calls across practice, qualifying, and races amid dynamic weather. The tone is detailed, competitive management.

Players train as May Esperio in a world of uneasy coexistence with monster girls, battling in strategic card-based combat with light RPG elements. Over 100 cards can be summoned as 3D chibi models on a grid, and the First Crush Rub mode levels them up.

Cross Set is a number puzzle game played on grids up to 9x9, where players fill every row and column with the numbers 1 through N using constrained candidate sets, offering a Sudoku-like but deeper logic challenge across 50+ levels with calm ambient music.

This realistic karting simulator uses a physics engine modeling kart dynamics, tire behavior, and track conditions to serve as a training tool for real drivers, offering online and LAN races, telemetry output, modding, and VR support, with no AI opponents or career mode.

A dry summer has withered the king's gardens and made him ill, so the princess and her gnomes set out to restore them. Across over 40 levels, players construct buildings, clear obstacles, repair bridges, manage resources, and use magic in a fantasy strategy setting.

A single-player puzzle board hero defense that remixes chess into a tactical rush. The player assembles a custom party of knights, rooks and bishops to hold off endless waves of advancing pawns, using power-ups, traps and leaderboards across endless, puzzle and knight's tour modes.

Two cops investigate a shady new drug in Axon City, but after an encounter with a mysterious artefact one of them is transformed into a blonde woman. Players follow the comedic life-sim and visual novel story, exploring locations, investigating crime scenes, and pursuing five love interests.

Players build a fantasy city with one of four races, research units and spells, and manage an economy while conquering provinces and defending fortresses. They join alliances, trade with other kingdoms, and fight PvP and PvE battles on servers that run for 97 days and end with a boss fight.

The player commands a horde of dim-witted zombies, guiding them past human traps and mutating them into specialized forms to devour survivors across fifty puzzle-filled levels. The goal is to spread the apocalypse while increasingly determined humans fight back.

In an empty Shropshire village in 1984, the player wanders an open world to uncover fragments of memories and events, piecing together the mystery of an apocalypse that has left the community vanished and strange voices on the radio.

Players survive in a hostile open world across changing seasons, building a base, crafting gear and farming while defending against wildlife and AI hunters who build their own bases. Solo or co-op play supports raiding enemy bases and expanding base technology.

Players control a pug in a casual endless runner through randomly generated levels with shifting weather, dodging hazards like lightning while collecting coins and points. Running distance earns unlocks such as costumes and new characters with different movement traits, and leaderboards compare runs against other players.

A festive garden defense game in which the player leads the Green Resistance of plants against beetles attacking the Christmas trees on Christmas Eve, earning bonuses and trophies while stopping the insects from taking revenge for their earlier defeat.

Helen wakes on a floating island with a labyrinthine castle and little memory of who she is. She explores, battles monsters in one-on-one fights, and collects and upgrades weapons, swapping them mid-battle to exploit enemy weaknesses. Each death returns her to a cabin with a meal that permanently boosts her lifeline.

In Edo-period Japan, the player commands five specialists—a ninja, samurai, geisha, street child and marksman—sneaking through castles, monasteries and forest camps, setting traps, poisoning foes or avoiding contact entirely. The hardcore tactical stealth game emphasizes planning, teamwork and character-driven missions.

Polaris Sector is a 4X sci-fi strategy game in which the player commands an interstellar empire, managing diplomacy, research, and ship design while conquering a hostile galaxy. Battles can be fought tactically on the battlefield or auto-resolved, and players balance fundamental and applied sciences to outpace rivals.

A first-person survival horror game where the player explores woods tied to a legend of lost children, navigating by candlelight to keep fear at bay, evading varied enemies with unique strategies, and piecing together a mystery through collectibles.

Players explore a rural American setting in first person, facing a terrifying horror experience while uncovering the story. The game emphasizes tense atmosphere, exploration, and survival horror gameplay rendered in a photorealistic style.

A multiplayer first-person shooter recreating the Vietnam War with authentic weapons and asymmetric warfare. Up to 64 players battle across six armies and over twenty maps, using helicopters, traps, tunnels, and squad-based tactics.

Players use intuitive voxel-based creation tools in VR to build detailed worlds and landscapes, then explore them with friends through hang-gliding races or climbing, remix creations from an online gallery, and export their work for 3D printing.

Playing as Linda, players explore a mirror realm connecting eight haunted dominions, using a smartphone and camera to battle ghosts, solve puzzles, and choose paths that determine her fate in this nonlinear horror chapter.

Players act as both engineer and stunt driver, constructing ramps, loops, and bridges from various materials, then driving delivery vans and dump trucks across them to collect stars, perform flips and jumps, and cause destruction while chasing high scores and sharing replay videos.

Coaching a small-town Japanese soccer team, the player wins matches to level up players, equip gear, and learn special abilities in a tactical RPG and soccer hybrid, aiming for the national team while managing status effects and using anime-styled animations.

Players draw 2D and 3D floor plans, furnish and decorate interiors and exteriors with a large catalog of items, then explore their finished homes in real-time 3D and share projects with a community gallery.

A collection of linear side stories expanding the CLANNAD visual novel, following Tomoya, a guarded delinquent student, and Nagisa as they befriend classmates and try to revive the school drama club in the town of Hikarizaka.

At the La Soleil patisserie, catgirl sisters Azuki and Coconut drift apart over a misunderstanding. Players follow the heartfelt, lightly lewd comedy as the family works through their conflict and rebuilds their bonds, alongside Chocola, Vanilla, and the rest of the household.

A turn-based tactical and strategic naval combat game recreating the WWII Battle of the Atlantic, letting the player command Allied or German ships, submarines and aircraft across historical missions, campaigns and a dynamic campaign with limited resources and real convoy routes.

Lost Technology is a real-time strategy siege game set in a war-ravaged world resembling the Middle Ages but built on lost advanced technology, where the player recruits armies in turn-based strategy phases, fights real-time battles, and plays story events to conquer all territories.

Arran Bruce returns to his family estate to murder his young sister and restore his inheritance, choosing a weapon, planting evidence on family or servants, and facing an inspector's questions. The dark adventure RPG branches on dialogue and actions toward many possible endings.

Players build customizable combat robots from chassis, weapons and boosters, then battle an opposing faction across missions on Mars while protecting a glowing energy pool that funds their army. Development contracts expand the weapon pool between fights, blending unit construction with light resource management.

A visual novel about a young man sent to a retreat for delinquents who finds himself stranded in the wilderness with three young women. Players explore, make choices across multiple routes, uncover secrets, and pursue possible romance while trying to survive.

Players build and expand a garden by planting trees, bushes and flowers, attracting round blue helpers who harvest and collect items, even while the game is closed. Mean critters invade and must be hunted or warded off by a guard dog, while leveling unlocks new plants and animals.

As leader of a small troop of warriors, mages and cavalry, the player issues one command per unit each turn to rout marauding bandits by defeating their captains. Procedurally generated levels and a single-player ladder keep the turn-based tactical battles fresh and challenging.

In a gaslit steampunk city inspired by Sherlock Holmes and Dracula, the player reads a text-only interactive novel and makes choices that shape a mystery story, deciding whether to defend or overthrow the Empire, pursue forbidden magic, and find romance.

In a war-devastated future, a Phiroid boy named Rei wakes in a ruined factory without working emotions and wanders the wasteland until a singing girl named Shiona takes him in, learning about feeling and humanity in this kinetic novel told through high-quality art, music, and scenario.

A lonely university student named Koji wishes at a shrine to have someone to spend Christmas with, then meets three quirky girls who each want his time before the holiday. The player follows this visual novel romance and chooses who to spend Christmas with.

In the year 2222, humanity lives in Net Space, where factions hold a concert every four years to control all the Spaces. The player follows a cast of browser idols competing for the crown through performances, a swimsuit contest, and acting sessions in this short visual novel.

A digital adaptation of a board game recreating the American Revolution, where players command British, Loyalist, Hessian, American, French, and Native factions to control towns and forts across the thirteen colonies. Rounds are driven by movement and event cards, with truce cards ending the game and victory points tallied.

As Chief Executive Ticon, players lead a small corporation into Redacted Space, building and designing fleets of partially destructible, self-repairing ships. They face the Particulate and other threats driven by a real-time physics particle simulation in this strategy and RTS hybrid.

Players defend their base and people from Creeper, an organic mass that spreads across the map from all directions. By taking high ground and building up forces, they pound the enemy into oblivion and repeat the strategic battle across maps in this updated edition.

Players command humanity's defenses in the 14th millennium against a flowing, oozing enemy that spreads across terrain, using advanced weapons, gravity repulsors and rifts while excavating terrain to unearth technologies, crystals and artifacts, and facing a mechanical foe that manipulates gravity.

An interactive text novel set at a superpower school where the player trains as a costumed hero, chooses a costume and archetype, dates classmates, uncovers secrets, and confronts a mysterious villain. Choices shape the story, romance, and exams across a comic-book-inspired narrative.

As architect and developer, the player designs and manages a modern skyscraper, balancing construction, tenant happiness, and finances. Choices range from luxury penthouses to cheap tenements, with sandbox and campaign scenarios testing management skill.

A short kinetic visual novel in which the player spends a single day on a date as Jung, enjoying time with a girl named Ai while ignoring one important thing about her, following a bittersweet story about priorities that leads to one ending regardless of choices.

A paranoid survivor searches the ruined streets of 1986 Seattle for his family amid a zombie outbreak, using tense 2D platforming, scarce weapons, and stealth to evade or fight the undead, plus an endless Survival Arena mode.

Playing as Henry Shackelton in an 1896 steampunk world, the player has sixty minutes of life left and must decide which conflicts to pursue, with a non-linear plot and twelve endings shaped by irreversible choices.

The player joins a little mouse exploring painted forests, waters and gardens, discovering and learning about more than 160 species of animals and plants across four natural habitats through simple, intuitive controls in a gentle educational nature game.

Players control a survivor of a massacre, now a soldier fighting supernatural threats, developing a classless character through weapon-based skills, resource management, and a passive skill tree. Combat demands dodging telegraphed attacks and customizing skill modifiers.

Play as Six, a lone child trapped in a massive metal vessel called the Maw, surrounded by dangerous, distorted adults. Using stealth, climbing, and a brass lighter, players hide, distract, and run from the Residents to find an escape route and survive.

An assassin named Shadwen travels a gritty medieval province to kill the king while protecting an orphaned girl who follows her, using stealth, rope physics, traps, and time-rewinding to stay unseen and decide whether to kill.

Players fight in fast-paced 3 vs. 3 battles using characters from One Piece, switching between fighters and unleashing Devil Fruit and Haki abilities, while reliving the Marineford War through intense fights and cutscenes with a roster of over 40 characters.

A narrative thriller in which a blind woman named Cassie explores a haunted mansion using echolocation, where every sound reveals the environment but also draws a deadly entity closer, as she uncovers the estate's history and her own nightmares.

A text-based interactive novel in which the player runs a multinational corporation selling superpowers, choosing between mad science and dark magic, managing stock prices and shareholders, and deciding whether to save the world or embezzle and flee.

This visual novel anthology follows terminally ill patients and those around them, telling stories of living, dying, and the bonds between people leaving and those left behind. Across five included games and additional chapters, characters face death in an indifferent reality without miracles, heroes, or villains.

Players follow a mythic quest in ancient China where the Jade Emperor's opened gates between heaven and earth unleash chaos, and heroes must seal them using divine artifacts. Combat is real-time and encounter-based, with demon synthesis, guardian allies, and battle formations supporting the journey.

Players drive a licensed MAN coach bus along a recreated German Autobahn network serving over 40 cities, keeping to schedules amid traffic, construction, and accidents while managing passenger check-in and ticket sales, in day and night driving across all seasons and weather.

A photojournalist named Frank West investigates a zombie outbreak in a suburban town and takes refuge in a shopping mall, where he fights the undead using anything he can grab from the stores. He explores the mall, rescues survivors, takes photographs, and uncovers the mystery behind the epidemic.

Players command a military faction in a retro real-time strategy game, collecting resources, constructing bases, and amassing armies to defeat opponents. Campaign missions, co-op scenarios, AI skirmishes, and online multiplayer battles support up to eight players on destructible maps.

A co-op open-world survival crafting game set in a secretive underground research complex after a containment breach. As a scientist, the player gathers resources, builds a base, crafts outlandish tools, and outwits supernatural and military threats while planning an escape.

A turn-based political strategy simulation where players govern African nations, managing policies, economy and voter demands through an icon-driven interface to improve quality of life and stay in power while steering countries toward prosperity.

As a lone samurai in Japan's Sengoku era, players explore the open town of Amana and surrounding battlefields, choosing to help, ignore, or victimize characters they meet. Actions drive more than 20 endings, while weapons are crafted from over 200 parts and dialogue or gestures can resolve conflicts without force.

Players mine resources, research technologies, build and automate factories with belts and robots, and defend their growing industrial empire from hostile locals, alone or in cooperative multiplayer, with modding and scenario support.

Aboard a luxury cruise liner, a murder strands guests with an unseen threat as night falls. Players click to move and search the ship, solve puzzles, and flee or hide from the Scissor Walker in this 3D point-and-click survival horror adventure.

A casual multiplayer game where a clueless father tries to keep his infant son from harm around a two-story house and garden full of dangerous objects, while the baby actively seeks out hazards, with wacky physics and up to seven friends online or locally.

Guide Agent 47 across fixed grid spaces in a diorama-style turn-based puzzle game, avoiding enemies and eliminating targets. Use disguises, distractions, and sniper rifles to infiltrate guarded locations, solving each level silently or forcefully.

After a failed love confession, a shut-in student sees a naked girl fall from the sky, changing his dull life forever. Players follow this anime-style visual novel and steer the story toward different endings through their choices.

A top-down twin-stick shooter with procedurally generated levels and fully destructible environments. The player blasts through security guards, drones and hover tanks, collecting loot and credits to permanently upgrade stats and cybernetic enhancements between runs, with local co-op for up to four players.

Players guide dim-witted dodos to safety across 100 levels by reshaping platforms and obstacles rather than commanding the birds directly, traveling through prehistoric, Egyptian, ancient and Viking worlds in four game modes.

A romance visual novel about Mark, a boy trying to forget a painful memory, and Myra, the girl who unearths it. Together they pursue a storybook romance and learn that love does not always unfold neatly, told through a 40,000-word story.

Players defend their castle in a 3D fantasy world by building towers and casting spells against waves of monsters called Touched, in a hybrid of tower defense and collectible card game. They battle other players and strategize with unique towers to protect their kingdom.

Players follow Michonne, the blade-wielding survivor from the comic series, through a story-driven miniseries set between issues #126 and #139, exploring what drew her away from her trusted group and what brought her back while she copes with past loss and regret.

Players become a lone superhero facing a global alien invasion, flying at supersonic speeds around a full-scale Earth and destroying alien devices with energy blasts while trying to avoid causing human casualties and collateral damage.

As a Spirit Guardian in a magical sky world, the player commands small servants called Peeps to gather resources, build, fight and sacrifice themselves by day, while defending against dark creatures that stalk the islands at night across thirteen islands.

A wildlife simulation about wolf ecology in which the player controls a two-year-old gray wolf in Yellowstone. The wolf travels from Amethyst Mountain across the Lamar Valley to Slough Creek, finds a mate, establishes territory, raises and trains pups, and defends them from predators to ensure the pack survives.

Up to twelve players tee off simultaneously on themed mini-golf courses, using powerups to sabotage rivals and switching between golf, hoops and hockey modes. Players can also build and share their own courses with a level editor.

An urban fantasy visual novel following twenty-year-old university student Tsubasa Fujimoto, who gains immense magical powers after a ritual and must balance daily life with a supernatural one while falling in love. Players choose among five romantic routes, each with its own story, choices, and three canon endings.

A short New Year-themed visual novel revisiting characters from a camp story a year later, focusing on celebration and the feelings left by a kiss on the most important night of the year. It is a brief, sentimental epilogue rather than a full narrative.

A 2D side-scrolling driving game set in a zombie apocalypse where the player steers vehicles through city levels, smashing through zombie hordes, unlocking and upgrading ten vehicles with armor, guns and boosters across a story mode and missions.

A racing simulator focused on Brazilian motorsport series, offering a diverse roster of vehicles from karts to endurance prototypes across accurately modeled tracks. Players experience high-fidelity physics, dynamic track conditions, and detailed vehicle handling.

Players continue as Captain Pilgrim, ferrying passengers between star systems with a cynical co-pilot, when a mysterious priestess and other guests pull them into a hazardous adventure involving a shadowy government organization called the Jackals across a futuristic universe.

Two players take turns in hotseat play, moving their rag-doll characters' limbs and weapons with the mouse to duel until one wins; early rounds feel strategic while lost limbs make the endgame comically absurd.

A 2D stealth game where a branded witch uses elemental powers to set fires, freeze water, and move earth to outsmart superstitious enemies. Players rescue captive villagers, manipulate the environment, and can join a friend in co-op to reclaim their home.

A life and social simulation in a seaside village where players farm crops, raise livestock, fish, forage, mine, cook, and befriend 32 villagers. Seasons change the town, festivals and markets occur, and romance and magical secrets unfold at a relaxed pace.

A solitaire card game where the player runs a diner and expands across the USA, earning stars to unlock new opportunities, collecting chef hats, using store items, and playing mini games alongside a voiced story.

Players descend into dungeons and fight hydras whose heads regrow according to arithmetic rules, choosing weapons that cut or add specific numbers of heads. Building an effective weapon set and inventory of synergies is a tactical and strategic puzzle, with multiple races, enemies, level geometries and two endings.

A first-person psychological adventure set in 1938 Italy, where the player explores a faithfully reconstructed asylum and relives the story of Renée, a sixteen-year-old institutionalized girl, through environmental interaction and choices that branch the narrative in different directions.

Awakening buried alive on a Mediterranean island, the player uses parkour and climbing to explore ruins and caves, scavenge equipment, fight hostile dwellers, and escape while uncovering what happened to their friends.

A free-to-play first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world where the player is a newly contracted clone mercenary fighting in brutal team-based matches across multiple modes, ranking up, customizing gear and tactical slots, and joining clans.

Lloyd realizes he is dreaming, but the dream becomes a nightmare he cannot wake from. Players explore his subconscious, bending gravity to walk on walls and ceilings, rotating rooms, and using stealth to avoid enemies in a slow-building psychological horror experience.

A free-to-play, fast-paced competitive battle royale where players fight solo, in duos, or in fives to be the last ones standing, featuring restored movement, gun mechanics, vehicles, and a classic map, plus seasonal ranked play and in-match missions.

It's Spring Again is an educational game for children ages two and up that teaches the order of the seasons; following hints, children help the seasons change and create a melody for each, guided by a narrator and parents.

Sentenced by a colony council, the player chooses to compete in the televised show Half Dead, navigating a network of rooms where some hold deadly objects, searching for the exit to win freedom in a first-person survival escape.

Adorable creatures ask the player for help crafting items as they travel through forests, grasslands and villages. Players discover recipes, manage inventory space and resources, keep the buddies happy, and can tackle challenge modes or build and share their own puzzles.

Players solve mahjong solitaire tile sets while helping elves survive on a lost island, progressing through quests, puzzles, and mini-games to earn prizes and collections. The fantasy adventure framing wraps hundreds of tile layouts with high-quality backgrounds and fairy-tale characters.

A stealth-horror adventure from the creator of Alone in the Dark, following former detective Mr. Smith as he infiltrates Gloomywood's cruel strongholds, investigates psychopaths, and rescues abducted children while managing limited supplies, light, sound, and his own smoking habit.

Players create a character from several fantasy races and lead a party through the vast world of Rivellon, developing companion relationships and fighting tactical turn-based battles that exploit elemental combinations and height. Choices carry consequences, and the world can be explored alone or with up to four players in co-op.

A free-to-play space strategy game where the player gathers minerals and uranium, builds and upgrades a base with defensive turrets, assembles ground and air armies, and battles other players online to seize their fame points and resources across a campaign of missions.

Players inherit an old pierhead arcade in VR and can play any of its coin-operated machines, from basketball and bowling to shooting galleries and claw machines. They can invite friends, compete on global leaderboards and redeem tickets for toys.

A satirical point-and-click adventure in which an apparently primitive society builds a glue-and-tape space rocket, moving from chaos through a distorted faux-democracy into outer space. Players meet colorful characters, solve puzzles, and make difficult moral decisions with potentially disastrous consequences.

The player wakes trapped in a dark mansion by a captor calling himself the Puppeteer, forced to compete for freedom. Moving through detailed locations, the player solves puzzles and hidden-object scenes across two storylines and many characters to uncover the true price of escape.

A free-to-play sci-fi shooter built around a 4 vs 1 campaign where players either join the Raiders freeing the Broken Planet or switch sides as the Antagonist. Players pick from 17 characters, mod weapons and use hundreds of cards to customize their fighters.

Two brothers working on a space station near Jupiter commute home each day, fighting through swarms of alien ships and creatures that attack them en route. The fast arcade twin-stick shooter has players blasting waves of enemies and switching between brothers to survive and chase high scores.

Players build, decorate and run a fantasy tavern, hiring staff, stocking the larder and managing intertwined systems like dirt, heat, noise and sickness while colourful customers create emergent chaos. A narrated narrative campaign spans a vibrant world, with choices, freeplay and a design mode for crafting furnishings.

Players guide heroes and workers across visually varied lands, rebuilding ruined villages and defeating enemies through time and resource management while pursuing a stolen artifact, with over 100 levels, a bonus chapter, achievements, and extras in this collector's edition.

Wilma, a young musician with writer's block, is sent by her patron to a solitary alpine cabin to finish her breakthrough composition amid mountains and storms. The player makes choices during her creative crisis and an unexpected encounter, decisions that shape later episodes and the protagonists' success.

Players guide one of ten species through a turbulent galaxy in a grand 4X space strategy game, forming coalitions, negotiating treaties, running espionage networks, designing starships and fighting pausable real-time tactical battles against rival and elder races.

A tough, score-based procedurally generated platformer with roguelike elements, following the friendship between Ikk, Death, and a space whale named Sally, where players fight through randomized levels, unlock abilities, and chase leaderboard scores.

An 8v8 team-based top-down shooter set in a retro 1950s world where humans fight sinister alien Squids, using shotguns, rockets and dynamite against ray guns and tanks while collecting resources to unlock better weapons across short matches.

A sci-fi thriller set in Berlin, 2048, where journalist Richard Nolan wakes from an explosion to find his family vanished and uncovers a global conspiracy about transhumanism, surveillance and digital utopia, playing several characters to reconstruct his past.

Players stack summoned blocks into the tallest stable tower while casting spells to protect their own structure and sabotage rivals, competing in local and online multiplayer matches across survival, race, and puzzle modes, plus solo wizard trials and leaderboards.

A comedic fantasy RPG satire in which the player creates a comic hero, accepts quests, brawls with monsters and other players, joins a guild, and collects epic loot to climb the hall of fame in a free-to-play online world.

A social virtual reality platform where users join hundreds of thousands of user-created worlds and avatars, meeting people, attending events, playing games and building their own spaces with provided tools and SDK.

After explosions and a reactor meltdown trap survivors inside a nuclear research facility, players follow a rescue captain and a student across two timelines. Rather than explicit choices, an emotion-based system lets players shape the story through trust in characters.

Players compete across the 2016 MotoGP season and past champions' eras, reliving Valentino Rossi's career. They join his Riders Academy, start in Moto3, and take on flat track, drift, and rally challenges to hone skills and become champion.

As a new member of an elite squad, the player hunts monstrous Aragami to gather research materials, uncovering a conspiracy that threatens humanity, then investigates a deadly pandemic three years later. The tone is dramatic and action-driven, set in a grim sci-fi world of organized monster hunting.

The player controls a giant troll defending a goblin fort, smashing waves of minions and bosses while directing goblins to build towers, gather resources, and upgrade structures. Twitch viewers can control units, and the tone is lighthearted arcade action with management elements.

As an enigmatic pink-haired protagonist, you navigate a strange alternate reality with the help of a mysterious girl named Nobody to rescue your sister. You collect crystallized Memory Fragments that unlock paths forward and reveal the stories of the people those memories belong to.

The third episodic point-and-click adventure follows Captain Gail Pilgrim to the Delta Pavonis system, where she explores space ports, cities and oceans of Planet Leto, navigates planetary politics and searches for her missing father while interacting with dozens of characters.

Players tend a flock of cute sheep in an open-ended 3D pasture, planting grass and flowers, shearing colored wool, harvesting resources, and controlling the weather to keep the animals happy. They play with the sheep using toys, customize the pasture, and raise lambs while pursuing the Fountain of Youth.

A VR shooter in which the player stands against relentless waves of nightmarish creatures in a collapsing world, using an upgradable arsenal and limited resources. Controls are kept simple so friends and family can take turns in the headset during gatherings.

The player shapes a species of cat, fox, bear or dog-like animals using a breeding system based on real genetics, keeping them alive against predators, climate change and sickness. Turn-based strategy and simulation mix with roguelike elements across procedurally generated worlds and five biomes.

Guide a poor boy named Hans through a fairytale castle after a kobold offers him wealth for guessing its name. Explore dark corridors by placing candles, talk to strange characters, hide from enemies, solve item puzzles, and make choices that lead to five different endings.

Set in the mythical lands of Hyboria, the player survives harsh temperatures and sandstorms, hunts and crafts, builds homes and cities, develops into a barbarian or sorcerer, and wages siege warfare against enemies in single-player, co-op, or persistent multiplayer.

A physics-based climbing party game in 3D where players stack and mount one another to build towers and reach the top, competing online or in local multiplayer across unlockable field setups with customizable faces, skins and trails.

Play a recently married author on a cross-country bus tour promoting a novel while rumors claim you are a fraud; through extensive dialogue choices, manage relationships, career, and social life across five cities as you unravel the conspiracy against you.

A young woman named Setsuna, gifted with enchantment, must leave her island home and travel to a distant land to be sacrificed to a violent fiend, accompanied by her guardians. The story follows her sorrowful journey and the battles along the way in a classic-style JRPG.

A party game where players use phones or tablets to draw prompts like 'creepy tiger' while others type guesses and everyone votes on the real answer, with custom prompts, content filtering, and streaming support for remote play.

Players flip through recreations of classic Williams pinball tables, competing in multiplayer matches, user-made tournaments, and league play. Single-player practice modes help newcomers improve their flipper skills, and tables feature updated lighting and shadows.

A roguelike first-person shooter set in deep space where the player fights through randomly linked levels of enemies, collecting weapons and secrets across four zones, with permanent gore and fast-paced action as a Scrapper on a dangerous mission.

Players command modern armored vehicles as mercenaries in a corporate-ruled world, fighting 15v15 online tank battles or teaming up for story-driven PvE campaigns and smaller operations. Dozens of maps and five vehicle classes span eras from the 1950s to the 2030s.

A mouse-driven shoot 'em up where the Cosmonaut dodges bullet patterns and dashes through robotic legions to rekindle a dying star, with randomized enemy patterns, daily challenges, and accessibility options like colorblind mode and adjustable speed.

A kinetic visual novel in which a student researching thermophiles travels to a Japanese university, meets three lab partners among the cherry blossoms, and follows their shared time to its conclusion, with romance and horror elements and Japanese voice acting.

With Heaven's gates shut and Hell flooded, surviving angels, demons, and humans gather in the floating purgatory of Tokyo Babel to ascend Jacob's Ladder. A lone youth, Tendou Setsuna, joins the Witch of the Night Lilith as maddened pilgrims threaten the layers of Babel.

As Police Chief Jack Boyd, the player manages officers, responds to emergencies, and investigates crimes in the corrupt city of Freeburg while trying to amass $500,000 before retirement. Choices during crises, negotiations, and press appearances shape the story and the fate of the chief.

Players ride armored hydrojets through flooded ruins, city waterways and factory machinery, performing stunts and dodging police in an underground racing circuit to reclaim a stolen title, with career progression, vehicle upgrades and online or split-screen multiplayer races.

An arcade racing game where players control Alice, a motorcyclist racing through day into night, dodging rival riders and reaching checkpoints before the timer expires. It spans 36 stages across six courses with two visual styles.

Teams of five Champions fight in fantasy team-based shooter matches, pushing payloads or contesting rotating objectives across varied modes. Players choose from over fifty characters with customizable abilities, items, and cosmetic skins.

A minimalist real-time strategy game where the player starts with one planet and expands, upgrades, and attacks to conquer a star system. Each constellation adds a new rule, and local or online multiplayer is supported, all set to ambient music.

A masked AI called Program X throws cyberspace into chaos, and the unhacker and next-gen AI Neonya answer the call, disturbed that Program X's minions resemble long-dead friends. The sequel offers a darker narrative about humans versus AI, with returning puzzle segments.

Players command tanks in fast team battles of seven versus seven, choosing among hundreds of historical and fictional vehicles with distinct roles, upgrading them with equipment and crew skills, and fighting across many maps and modes in cross-platform multiplayer.

Players assemble patchwork mosaics while traveling with Alice through six Wonderland and Looking-Glass Land locations. The puzzle game offers 120 mosaics across different materials, bonuses, ranks, and quests, set to calming music and aimed at players of all ages.

In an alternate 1897 Britannia, the player explores Berelai Manor to find the source of an unnatural fog, fighting maddened servants with a cane and hand cannon while managing healing concoctions and sanity. The survival-horror tone draws on cosmic dread and creeping madness.

A free head-to-head tower defense game where players build monkey towers and defenses while sending bloons against an opponent. Multiple modes, powers, card battles, clans, and leaderboards support both casual and competitive multiplayer play.

Players guide Mimpi, a lazy dog who becomes a hero in his dreams, through six illustrated dream worlds by moving obstacles, solving puzzles, and platforming to rescue friends. The tone is charming and casual, with no punishing difficulty, and the game is designed for relaxed fun on PC or mobile.

A free-to-play collection recreating over 35 classic Italian Zaccaria pinball tables with modern lighting and physics options. Players flip through tables in trial or Story Mode, chase leaderboards and achievements, and compete locally in hotseat or online against friends and bots, with optional VR support.

As the new chieftain of a small Viking clan, the player assembles warriors, builds a ship, and sails west to Britannia to gain wealth and renown. Choices between raiding and trading, faction politics, and reputation shape a historical adventure with character customization.

A kinetic visual novel set in a snowbound hotel where a group of girls alone on a dark Christmas night attempt fortunetelling, only for their boyfriends to arrive and turn the evening into a scary story contest.

A stand-alone expansion for the turn-based strategy RPG series, adding two campaigns starring Emperor Ivan and Dwarven heroes plus a new Dwarf faction with Rune Magic. Players lead armies across new maps with improved mechanics, heroes, creatures and artifacts.

An orphan summoned to the distant land of Phantasmagoria must fight as an Etranger alongside female Spirits to protect the land, since his sister is held hostage. The player commands 21 characters through 23 tactical missions, unlocking skills and reaching one of nine endings.

A boy carrying the soul of an ancient god fights across a multiverse of worlds to bring his friends home and master his Eternity Sword. Players command an army of characters in tactical RPG battles across many strongholds, pursuing one of six endings.

Players explore the mind of a man losing his sanity after the loss of a loved one, where ordinary items trigger memories and nightmares. Through a 2D pixel horror adventure, they witness events unfold and uncover a darker truth about what walking in another person's shoes can cost.

Playing a nurse hired for a single night to care for an old man in a house without electricity, the player must keep four hand-crank generators running. Something in the darkness destabilizes the devices, and losing power invites danger.

Two vampiric sisters and two assassin sisters from rival bloodlines are forced into a Zombie Punitive Force to fight an undead army. Across more than a dozen stages, players hack and slash through zombies in real-time swordplay, occasionally transforming into demons for bursts of power and speed.

Gail Pilgrim is imprisoned in the galaxy's most secure prison, and her only hope is trusting her friends as old enemies return and buried truths surface. The final episode lets players explore new locations and make key decisions affecting Gail and her crew.

Starting in 1850, players build a transport company, constructing rail, road, water and air networks, stations and harbors while supplying industries and watching cities grow. Campaign missions and an endless mode cover over 150 years of European and American transportation history.

A farming simulation where the player runs a modern farm in an open North American environment, driving over 250 authentic vehicles, harvesting crops, raising livestock, doing forestry, and selling goods to expand, with cooperative multiplayer and mod support.

Play as hacker Marcus Holloway in the San Francisco Bay Area, joining the Dedsec group to take down an invasive operating system. Explore an open world, hack connected devices and city infrastructure, upgrade tools like drones and 3D-printed weapons, and play co-op or adversarial multiplayer.

Players control an escaped ape smashing through procedurally generated corridors and labyrinths, using captors as weapons and shields to crush opposition, with bold colors, frenetic jazz, and a dynamic percussive soundtrack driving the violent escape.

A princess in an alternate Warring States period must defend her falling castle against demon invaders while romancing famous historical commanders summoned as her brother, fiance, and father. The game is a dramatic romance visual novel aimed at players who enjoy deep storylines and handsome heroes.

A romance visual novel in which the player, after a rough day at work, wanders into a bar called Audire and meets a group of older gentlemen, each with his own past and personality. The player pursues relationships with one of several middle-aged men and learns their stories.

Players roleplay Zasa, an artificial intelligence, completing training missions from Dr. Mason by linking nodes in 3D space to match target patterns. The puzzle game spans varied sci-fi levels, with cube rotation and hints aiding increasingly demanding solutions.

Play as Vasily, a former elite operative hiding in a snowy mountain monastery, who must fight waves of corporate cyborg soldiers using fists, melee weapons, and firearms. The top-down brawler emphasizes brutal combos, stealth and environmental kills, parries, and dismemberment in a violent quest for redemption.

Tend bar at VA-11 HALL-A in the cyberpunk dystopia of Glitch City, mixing drinks for a cast of fascinating regulars. The branching story unfolds through the drinks you prepare rather than dialogue choices, revealing daily life under corporate rule.

Players fight through World War II battles across Europe in hardcore team-based multiplayer and cooperative modes, choosing specialized classes, customizing period weapons, and calling in artillery and air support while communicating with nearby allies.

Players control two characters simultaneously on a split screen, coordinating left and right sides to solve over 50 increasingly complex puzzles. Stealth-inspired abilities like noise-makers and portals support the challenge, set to a soothing bichromatic art style and an ambient soundtrack alongside a story about a boy and his robot.

A branching visual novel where Alice recounts a vivid dream about the end of the world to a friend, with player-chosen stats shaping dialogue and routes through the ruined city, encouraging repeated playthroughs to see all paths.

Players design their own unique spaceships from a large pool of parts, balancing energy, ranges, firing arcs, and firepower to fit their strategy. They then command fleets in tense territorial battles, a single-player campaign of escalating opponents, and multiplayer matches against players or custom AIs.

A life simulation visual novel based on A Little Princess, following Sara Crewe at a British boarding school as the player chooses activities to build her resources, form bonds with other girls, and steer the story toward one of six endings.

As a student at the Crowswood University of Medicine & Applied Sciences, the player is drawn into the unsettling experiments and moral rhetoric of its founder, exploring a dark academic setting where the pursuit of knowledge justifies disturbing means.

As a Strike Commander in a dystopian steampunk world where World War I never ended, the player builds and customizes a battle fortress, targets enemy systems in real-time battles with active pause, manages ammo, power and crew, and repels intruders while besieging a traitor general.

Starting with $10 million, players build a business empire through buying, selling, mergers, and hostile take-overs, aiming for the world's richest list. The strategy game simulates a complex economy with AI competitors and events like riots and technological breakthroughs.

Players lead one of seven ancient civilizations to domination through real-time empire building, blending city and population management, trade, espionage, diplomacy and combat, with each culture offering distinct advantages and a unique god unit.

Players assemble a party of three from six comic-book heroes and explore an overworld dotted with hidden dungeons, rare bosses, and random encounters. Combat is classic turn-based JRPG style with an overcharge mana system, while randomly generated dungeons offer traps, puzzles, secrets, and crafting materials.
Iris escapes the Tower and explores the Kingdom of Stonebriar, entering magical worlds through paintings and solving puzzles to uncover the mystery of three beacons and save a future queen.

Starting with a bucket and a pan, the player leases gold mining claims and works toward becoming a millionaire using realistic machines like excavators, drills and bulldozers. Driving skill, machine maintenance and wash plant upgrades matter across four detailed claims with deformable terrain and discoverable backstories.

A short yuri kinetic novel set in the American Southwest, following Amber as she travels the desert in an inherited motorhome and, after meeting hitchhiker Marina, gets drawn into the nationwide hunt for a gold miner's hidden stash.

A fantasy card game with hand-drawn art where players collect and upgrade hundreds of creature cards, battle through a story to unravel the Void mystery, and fight other players in live multiplayer PvP. Three factions and evolving cards support deck-building across many levels.

A shy girl with a mysterious past begins her first year at an isolated all-girls academy, navigating new friendships through a partner program while unraveling occult rituals and student disappearances. The story follows her as friendships deepen into something more.

Players build and manage theme parks, constructing custom roller coasters and themed scenery while balancing finances and guest satisfaction. A campaign of 26 scenarios and a sandbox mode test coaster design and park management skills, with cooperative online building for up to eight players and Workshop support.

The player becomes Avery Grey, a new hire at a cat cafe called A Cat's Paw, where the friendly coworkers hide a secret and a strange book waits in the basement. The player works shifts, gets to know the staff, and follows a mysterious story with a light romantic tone.

Players defend a castle alone against an army of enemies, using mouse-driven melee combat where attack direction and quality depend on player movement and dexterity. Heroes also wield distinct ranged weapons and personal powers, all presented in detailed claymation-style graphics with frame-based animation.

Players build and sustain a biodome ecosystem by balancing producers, consumers, and decomposers among over 70 plants and animals. A calm, slow-paced simulation teaches life science principles through experimentation, with time passing while away and data tools to monitor the ecosystem.

After an evil witch kidnaps her parents, Victoria learns magic from an ancient Book of Spells, traveling through a vibrant magical world of witches and wizards and solving match-3 puzzles to collect coins and upgrade power-ups on her journey to become a witch.

A retro-style surreal platformer starring a poorly drawn 8-bit character who blasts through over 20 eclectic levels, from caves to raves to suburbs, collecting power-ups and secrets while fighting bosses and a nemesis. The game warns of flashing visuals.

Run a settlement by gathering raw materials and crafting complex goods for contractors, designing custom blueprints for workers and tools to maximize efficiency. Players hire and pay workers, colonize islands, set up trade routes, research products, and manage razor-thin profit margins.

A VR tennis simulator using a physics engine to reproduce real shots, with arcade and simulation modes. Players compete in online multiplayer and 13 tournaments across seven court surfaces, with customizable 3D characters and multiple movement options.

A logic construction puzzler where the player, portrayed as a binary data point, lays down seven kinds of customizable modules to build sequences reaching a destination, with varied levels, a sandbox mode, and stylish minimalist graphics set to ambient futuristic music.

Players take full operational command of the German invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, balancing three theatres, managing command hierarchies and politics, and making semi-randomized decisions. Detailed fatigue, weather, and combat systems force trade-offs between Blitzkrieg and sustained offense, with ethical choices and a war crimes tribunal.

Players guide a group of survivors through a demon apocalypse, building a sanctuary, gathering resources, crafting equipment, researching technologies and occult powers, and fighting hellspawn in real-time tactical combat with pause across a randomly generated world.

A combat platformer set inside a hijacked computer system where a lone system member leads a resistance against a totalitarian virus. Levels transform in a 2D action game within a 3D world, combining reflexes, elaborate attacks, upgrades, and leaderboard competition, all set to a synthwave soundtrack with illustrated cutscenes.

Lisa's grandfather Santa Claus asks her to deliver presents to a remote town, but her car turns into candies in an old forest and everything around is covered in sweets. Players solve hidden object scenes, puzzles, and mini-games to investigate and fix the car in time to save Christmas.

Players manage a space colony on a subterranean asteroid, excavating resources and building systems to keep oxygen, heat, food and power in balance while colonists react to stress. The simulation emphasizes thermodynamics, gas and liquid piping, and recycling as the population grows from mere survival toward thriving.

A physics-based puzzle game where the player places and topples domino pieces to solve challenges across moving platforms, zero-gravity space levels, conveyor belts and bombs, with a free build mode for creating and sharing custom domino arrangements.
A kinetic visual novel set in a medieval world follows an old farmer with dementia and his elderly wife as his memory slowly fades, exploring the heartache of a loved one losing themselves.

A 16-bit horror RPG in which Jez wakes at summer camp to find blood everywhere and a mascot-costumed killer on the loose, forcing him to explore the grounds, solve puzzles, find diary pages, and avoid the slasher in a deadly cat-and-mouse game.

Set in an alternate 1908 where steam-powered civilization has polluted the skies and seas, players follow a story at an isolated offshore academia ruled by a secret society, exploring its hidden darkness through a visual novel narrative.

An abstract zen puzzle game where the player places or removes dots to start a colorful race that fills a drawing, with the dominant color winning. Six modes, 500 levels, a Steam Workshop level editor, daily challenges, and Twitch integration support short sessions and community creativity.

Players defend exotic lands from dragons, man-eating plants, and underworld creatures by placing and upgrading specialized towers, commanding heroes, and using reinforcements and meteor strikes across deserts, jungles, and the underworld.

As a new disciple in the magical world of Aterra, the player bonds with seven powerful girls to create Star Children, exploring shape-shifting labyrinths and fighting monsters in turn-based battles while strengthening relationships to unlock stronger classes.

Players take the role of a rally driver competing across the official 2016 WRC calendar, mastering fog, mud, punctures and night racing while managing car and driver through championships, split-screen multiplayer and weekly online challenges.
