A postmodern RPG following Alex, a recent graduate whose vision of a vanishing woman sparks an obsession, alongside a nameless child's intertwined story. Players fight bizarre entities in a turn-based system where bleeding hastens defeat, and navigate dreamlike landscapes filled with puzzles, traps, and odd adversaries.

Play as exiled sleuth Cicero Gavar, summoned back to the Venetian-inspired city of Ombre to solve a diplomat's kidnapping amid masked guilds and civil unrest. Use tactical pause combat, elemental magic tags, and party positioning in this fully voiced narrative RPG.

Players command large UNSC and Covenant armies in real-time strategy battles set early in the Halo war, directing units and heroes through an epic campaign or online multiplayer matches. The definitive edition adds improved graphics, new achievements, and all prior DLC.

Guide Prince Auro through procedurally generated dungeons in a turn-based tactics game where the player bumps monsters into hazards using a small set of spells and careful positioning. Each monster has its own abilities, and the game emphasizes skill-based play with emergent combos and colorful pixel art.

Crush Crush is an idle dating sim in which the player builds stats, unlocks jobs, and earns promotions to impress and romance a cast of quirky women, wooing them with dates and gifts while progressing from acquaintance to lover and unlocking new content along the way.

A remastered 1990s platformer in which the player guides Johnny through haunted levels, using a slingshot to fend off creatures and rescue kidnapped pets including his dog Tex, with hidden areas, leaderboards, and a level editor.

A boy shrinks to bug size after eating a strange berry at his summer cottage and ventures into a hidden miniature world of insects, befriending them and gathering raspberries to brew a healing jam that will restore his size.

A character-driven visual novel side story to The Fruit of Grisaia in which Michiru takes the lead in a slapstick comedy, trying to settle on a new club activity with Sachi and her friends at the Mihama girls' school, with plenty of comedic hijinks.

Solve wordless puzzle levels by moving the mouse, causing circles to grow, shrink, or shift according to hidden rules the player must discover through experimentation. The game offers 90 levels and four modes, with atmospheric interactive music and no text at all.

An interactive horror visual novel following seven characters caught in a centuries-old curse at the Ermengarde Mansion, where branching choices, relationship drama and butterfly effects determine who survives the gruesome events.

Players control Bayonetta, last survivor of an ancient witch clan revived after 500 years, fighting countless angelic enemies and giant foes to uncover her past. The game delivers over-the-top stylish action with fluid combos, special attacks, and gruesome torture finishers.

Government operative Sam Gideon dons an augmented suit to fight through a high-tech space colony, boosting, evading and blasting hordes of robots and giant bosses with a large arsenal of futuristic weapons in fast, fluid third-person shooter combat.

Players lead an elite squad of soldiers in a near-future Bolivia overrun by a drug cartel, coordinating raids, piloting drones and vehicles, and customizing weapons and gear across a large open world, alone or with up to three friends plus 4v4 PvP. The tone is tense and tactical.

A stylish neo-noir action-platformer where players slash, dash, and manipulate time through hand-crafted levels with instant-death combat, deflecting gunfire and using traps to eliminate foes while unraveling the protagonist's past through cinematic storytelling.

Players commit a murder and then frame another character by choosing dialogue, planting evidence, and selecting period-appropriate weapons. Three scenarios span a 15th-century English castle, an Old West saloon, and a Victorian estate, with branching conversations and many possible endings depending on each decision.

Players guide an early Egyptian chiefdom through the events preceding the first Egyptian state, managing technologies, religion, and survival against wars, droughts, epidemics, and invasions. Decisions unfold across a reconstructed map and city of Hierakonpolis, blending simulation with historical detail.

The player controls Lann Northshire, an ordinary peasant drawn into a conflict threatening the world of Legionwood. This retro-style fantasy JRPG offers over thirty hours of traditional role-playing, six customizable characters, thirty-plus locations to explore, and a sweeping story of love, revenge, war, and peace.

The player solves sliding-tile style puzzles while following Eon, a lonely journeyman caught between worlds and time. The game strips away scores, tutorials, and shops to offer a calm, immersive journey presented through hand-drawn art and music.

Players solve Mahjong tile-matching puzzles across eight worlds containing 640 layouts, available in classic 2D or 3D views. Random tile orders let each layout be replayed with fresh arrangements, accompanied by scoring, sound effects, and relaxing music for all ages.

A turn-based tactical strategy game set on a post-human Earth where mutated animals, war robots, and monkeys in tracksuits fight over humanity's legacy; each player hides a secret Champion unit and must unmask and kill the opponent's Champion using bluff, tactics, and terrain alteration.

An arcade surfing game where the player rides legendary waves at five real-world destinations, performing intense tricks against other surfers, customizing a signature surfer, and competing in online multiplayer modes across varied times of day and weather.

Build the tallest towering city atop a balancing platform, placing residences, offices, power plants and landmarks while keeping citizens happy and weathering disasters like fires, earthquakes, meteors and monsters, across sandbox, mission and scenario modes.

Players command any nation in a turn-based grand strategy campaign set in the World War II era, managing industry, research, trade and military forces across a wrapping world map. Historical and alternate events shape each playthrough, with battles decided by factories, fleets, aircraft and nuclear weapons.

Lead a small team of seasoned mercenaries against an island ruled by a drug overlord and his army, using turn-based tactical combat mixed with adventure elements. Choose stealth or brute force, manage dehydration and dwindling support, and use rage skills and experimental drugs to turn the tide.

Players command an ant colony in a real-time strategy game, digging a hex-based underground nest, managing workers and food, and sending warrior ants into battles against rival colonies and insects while protecting the queen across changing biomes.

Players control an ancient monster confined to cave rock, using boulders and wits to crush, scare, and devour archaeologists exploring its underground city home. Solving increasingly devious puzzles across a non-linear level map unlocks story notes about the intruders, a clandestine organization, and the monster's own origins.

An RPG roguelike built around solitaire combat. In the land of Myriodd, the player gathers spells of attack, defense, agility and willpower to battle Emperor Stuck's armies, using turn-based card play, items and builds across a unique run each journey.

In a 2091 cyber metropolis, a wired psychopath fights a corrupt corporate system to find his kidnapped brother, guided by a hacker friend. Players use fast, brutal combat with firearms, melee weapons, and augmentations like time slowdown and shields.

A romance visual novel set in Kyoto, following a drifting young man who visits the city, meets local people and two girls in particular, and gradually discovers his own path in life amid the atmosphere of the area.

After inheriting a debt-ridden kingdom in Ascalia, players recruit and befriend over twenty characters, explore six regions, fight turn-based battles, manage towns and diplomacy, and craft weapons to restore the family seat to glory in a light-hearted tactical RPG with hand-drawn visuals.

Players program JavaScript AI to run a persistent colony in a shared online world, harvesting resources, building units, conquering territory, and trading with other players while their code operates around the clock. Conflict arises as multiple colonies compete for the same land in a slow-paced strategy sandbox.

A story-driven visual novel side story to The Labyrinth of Grisaia, following Kazami Yuuji's experiences with CIRS agent Kusakabe Asako, who rescued him from a terrorist organization, revealing secret passages of his past.

A visual novel side story in the Grisaia trilogy set after Kusakabe Asako names Kazami Yuuji her successor as number 9029, following his exploits around the globe. It reveals further secret passages of The Labyrinth of Grisaia and is intended for players who finished that game.

A real-time virtual reality storytelling experience with a stylized, character-focused visual style. Viewers direct the narrative in a unique setting, following the story of the long-lost Great Spirits called the Colosse, exploring themes of fear, power, and respect.

An old-school monster-catching RPG where players summon and customize hundreds of creatures to fight through endless randomly generated dungeons. They collect treasure, craft artifacts and spell gems, breed creatures to unlock new ones, and upgrade their castle as its ruler.

Players command one of seven factions in a turn-based 4X science fiction strategy game, exploring star systems, settling worlds, researching technologies across four eras, and negotiating or warring with alien leaders. Tactical 2D fleet battles and streamlined empire management support building an interstellar civilization.

A visual novel set in 19th-century England where a bored aristocratic occultist joins a secret society and faces the supernatural underworld, solving puzzles and performing rituals while choices branch the narrative toward multiple endings.

A roguelite platformer shooter set inside a living comic book, where players fight through hand-designed and procedurally generated levels as an author's character. Quick kills build fury for combos, and permanent upgrades carry over between runs, with co-op and difficulty options.

An adventure following immortal John Yesterday and Pauline across centuries, from the Spanish Inquisition to the present, as John loses his memory with each resurrection. Players investigate, unravel an occult thriller, and explore many locations in a darkly humorous tale.

Players guide Ivry, a gentle young musician, as he wakes in a strange room and searches for his sister Iva while uncovering the truth behind his fear. The mystery adventure uses comic-style storyboard presentation, item puzzles, and clue integration to advance its plot.

A retro-styled JRPG adventure following a 20-hour cinematic story where players customize heroes with unique stances and techniques, battle animated monsters, and forge master weapons and armor. Exploration reveals secrets, collectibles, secret bosses, and a developer room.

As the last survivor of a destroyed humanity, the player creates shadow clones that train and battle monsters automatically, absorbing their strength to challenge a pantheon of gods. Progress continues offline, with prestige rebirths, pets, and monuments deepening the idle climb.

A fan-made comic set in the Half-Life universe, following a troubled father, a scientist, and an alien warrior drawn to a hidden city with a cosmic tower amid Combine occupation, read through a dedicated app or PDF across fifteen chapters.

Two travelers journey across a post-apocalyptic Russia after a global epidemic, exploring deserted towns, fields, forests and a secret underground facility while collecting supplies, food, batteries and weapons. Their choices shape a story with multiple endings as they seek to understand who they are and where they are going.

Aurora Nights is an educational game where players connect stars to identify 35 Northern Hemisphere constellations, learning facts and myths behind them through spaced repetition, with a mini encyclopedia and star ratings for each constellation.

A multiplayer online game where players control worms that grow by eating mass, competing in free-for-all and team modes. Players outmaneuver opponents by cutting off their paths, avoid viruses, share mass with allies, and customize skins while using equipment and potions to gain advantages.

A relaxing puzzle game set on Byte planet where physics and gravity bend to the player's imagination. Players manipulate surreal structures and build optical illusions to create impossible paths and guide the robot Evo to the finish door across 45 levels.

Players take the role of a head of state or opposition leader in a detailed geopolitical simulator, managing budgets, taxes, laws, and military conflicts across 175 countries, including city battle phases and current war zones.

An abstract puzzle experience with no explicit rules or instructions and very simple controls, drawing on tabletop puzzles, modern art, and cognitive psychology. Solve challenges through pattern recognition, intuition, and experimentation, with an infinite mode featuring procedurally generated levels and randomized music and story content.

A short free point-and-click adventure in which Lou, newly arrived in Lisbon, meets a woman in a park for a date that turns strange, with puzzles, language confusion, and a horror twist, presented in 90s-style digitised graphics.

A comprehensive fishing simulator where players choose equipment and bait, cast lines, and wait for bites across locations worldwide, including a winter ice-fishing map. Players can sell, release, or stuff catches, pick normal or realistic difficulty, and build custom fisheries with a level editor to share with friends.

Players build defenses against waves of enemies while sending mercenaries to break opponents' defenses, scaling an economy toward late-game strength. Each match deals a random hand of fighters, and team-based 2v2 and 4v4 matches reward adaptation and game knowledge.

A digital adaptation of the Evolution board game where players adapt species with trait cards to survive and thrive in a changing ecosystem. It offers a 24-level campaign, adaptive AI opponents, skill-based online matchmaking, and local hotseat multiplayer.

Players control customizable detached genitals in online and local multiplayer party games for up to eight people, competing in absurd challenges like penetrating opponents or obstacle courses. A story mode and cosmetic customization round out the crude, comedic tone.

A casual retro arcade top-down shooter where the player faces waves of enemy spaceships with varied attacks in bullet-hell fashion, collecting power-ups scattered across the map while the difficulty steadily increases, testing how long the player can survive.

A digital adaptation of the classic card game where players match cards by color, number, or symbol and race to empty their hand. It offers online and local matches, team and free-for-all modes, house rules, and extensive cosmetic customization.

Set in the unstable free-trading nation of Valhalla, players run a troubleshooter company led by young Albus, taking on over 100 missions in turn-based tactical combat while customizing characters through classes and hundreds of masteries and following their companions' stories.

Players solve color-matching puzzles in a strange fungipunk world of caterpillars, Gammies, and living architecture while piecing together a scientist's quest to save her father. Forty escalating levels introduce new mechanics and colors, supported by shape-based symbols for color-blind accessibility.

An atmospheric 3D puzzle game set in a room with an old table, where players group colored tokens to solve relaxing logic puzzles, collect mementos, and uncover short fragments of Grandpa's life story through a hand-crafted interface.

A multiplayer VR graffiti simulator where up to four painters spray detailed environments like rooftops, train yards, and subway stations. Realistic caps, drips, and metallics let you create murals, then replay sessions with a director camera.

Players guide color-coded robots through trap-filled puzzle levels to matching goals, cooperating with one to four players and communicating closely to avoid deadly hazards, across story, party, and vault modes.

A closed-deck strategy card game set in the late Anglo-Saxon era of warring Earls, Vikings, and political struggle. Players take the role of great Earls vying to control what will become England, building decks and competing through politics, diplomacy, and battle, with art inspired by medieval illuminated manuscripts.

Waking masked in the ruins of the fallen Adal Empire, the player trains as a Prospect to join the Absolvers, learning combat styles, arranging attacks in a custom combat deck, and dueling or cooperating with other players in real-time melee battles across PvP arenas and PvE ruins.

Players become a heartless killing machine in a dystopian future, blasting through waves of bloodthirsty foes in fast-paced 2D pixel-art combat. Precise controls, brutal weapons, environmental obstacles and hidden secrets reward quick reflexes as the player unleashes carnage across grim levels.

An ordinary teen girl becomes campaign manager for one of several talking cats running for U.S. President, navigating presidential politics while pursuing romance with her chosen candidate. The visual novel offers six storylines, a long script, humor and cute cat pictures.

In a grim totalitarian state, the player manages an apartment building while covertly bugging tenants' homes, searching belongings, and profiling them for superiors, deciding whether to report subversive neighbors or protect them, with choices shaping multiple endings.

A digital deck-building card game recreating the physical Heart of Crown, where the player backs one of seven princesses in a succession war for the throne, competing against human or CPU opponents in ranked online matches, campaign scenarios, and free play.

A logic puzzle game where players fill grids to reveal pictures, with thousands of single-solution levels, a level editor, workshop sharing, theme customization, cloud saves, and leaderboards, all presented without ads or in-app purchases.

Players fight through the European theater of World War II, landing on Normandy on D-Day and battling across iconic locations in campaign, multiplayer, and co-operative modes with authentic weapons and run-and-gun combat.

Set in 1999 Tokyo, the player takes a first-person role in a special forces unit investigating serial murders linked to the legendary killer Kamui Uehara, digging through the police force and city underworld to unravel interconnected mysteries via puzzles and riddles in a neo-noir style.

A companion app for the Descent board game that takes over the overlord role, letting a group of players cooperate as heroes against app-controlled monsters and quests set in the fantasy world of Terrinoth, with support for physical expansions.

Players hire heroes, build armies, and fight turn-based battles while managing an empire across shard worlds. A handcrafted story campaign follows a young wizard, a priestess, a mercenary, and a governor whose fates intertwine as the Imperium faces grave danger.

Nine kidnapped strangers are forced into a deadly Nonary Game by a mastermind called Zero; the player searches locked rooms, solves puzzles and follows a twisting visual novel narrative to uncover the truth and escape.

A motorcycle racing game where the player collects and customizes over 170 bikes from famous manufacturers, competes across more than 30 tracks including GP circuits and city roads, and tunes engine, brakes, wheels, and appearance across numerous game modes.

A young girl's dog and sister go missing, and when she steps outside she finds her town transformed by darkness and haunted by spirits. She must hide from, outsmart, or outrun the spirits while searching for clues to find her loved ones.

This companion app guides one to five players through cooperative board-game scenarios of mystery and investigation in Arkham, inspired by H.P. Lovecraft. Investigators explore haunted locations, fend off terrible creatures, befriend non-player characters, and solve puzzles across stories of varied length and difficulty.

On Halloween, students of magic sneak into school after midnight, turn invisible and try to scare each other in ten-minute one-versus-one multiplayer matches. Players use traps, spells and scary masks to reveal and frighten opponents while climbing the leaderboards.

Players awaken aboard Talos I, a moon-orbiting space station in 2032 overrun by hostile aliens, as the subject of a failed experiment. They must survive using wits, weapons, crafting, and alien abilities while uncovering dark secrets and the truth about their past.

Players bring the Pathfinder Adventure Card Game to digital form, exploring towns, dungeons, and landscapes of the Rise of the Runelords campaign while experiencing reactive cutscenes and building characters through multiple adventure profiles.

Players enter a dueling simulator to replay storylines from across Yu-Gi-Oh! history, building decks from over 6,600 cards and battling more than 90 characters in a story campaign, plus online sealed and draft play.

A story-driven cyberpunk card game where the player picks a Runner persona, builds a deck from over a hundred cards, and battles corporate security, gangs and bounty hunters across San Angeles 2150. Recruiting agents and equipping them with black-market weapons and cybernetics enables powerful combos.

Players explore and battle through a space station overrun by a rogue AI that turned the crew into cyborgs and mutants, shooting, brawling and hacking cyberspace to stop SHODAN, while uncovering a non-linear story at their own pace.

Players create and customize a superhero in a comedic online world, fighting villains and bosses in single-player missions and multiplayer battles. They build a secret hideout, upgrade gadgets, form teams, and climb leaderboards through seasonal content and harder PvE challenges.

Play supernatural investigator Adam Wolfe, searching brooding San Francisco streets for his missing sister while solving four case-based mysteries involving secret societies and ancient covenants, using detective instincts, puzzles and a six-shooter in a psychological thriller.

Players control 11-year-old Aya Drevis exploring a mansion where maniacal experiments occur nightly, using chainsaws, knives, hammers, and bottles of eyeballs to uncover the truth behind a bizarre incident. This remake adds revamped graphics, new scenes, and a second playthrough mode.

A city-building strategy game in which the player governs humanity's first extrasolar settlement on the alien planet Aven Prime, managing resources, colonists' well-being, and hazards like storms and hostile life. A campaign and expedition system reveal the world's secrets.

Asuka Osachi enrolls in nursing school with her sister and classmates, experiencing love, medicine, and adulthood over three years. The player reads through a branching visual novel and makes choices that determine romantic arcs and multiple endings among the young women.

A short visual novel about Sveta, a depressed young bank intern, and Vlad, an antisocial freelancer, whose lives change when they are forced to collaborate on a high-profile project, presented in retro ASCII-art style with chiptune music.

Set in Feudal Japan, the player is a reluctantly conscripted soldier serving a corrupt Shogun and must choose between duty and justice. The RPG follows a resistance movement, letting players build and manage a rebel faction, recruit companions, plan raids, and explore an open world.

In the final chapter of a viking saga, the player guides over 40 heroes through tactical battles against the encroaching Darkness, making decisions that carry over from earlier games and determine the fate of the world and its survivors.

A lone traveler arrives in samurai-era Japan and must fight through vicious warriors and supernatural Yokai to find what he seeks. The brutal action game includes three expansions covering the Tohoku region and the Siege of Osaka campaigns.

Players guide a small ship alone through space, choosing passive, diplomatic, or aggressive responses to over 100 encounters with various races and factions. Turn-based decisions shape alliances and bounties while the ship is customized, all rendered in pixel art with a relaxing pace.

Players control a single soccer player in third-person multiplayer matches, kicking, dribbling and performing tricks with physics-driven ball control, and can also try other sports modes including basketball, hockey, racing and battle royale against bots or online opponents.

A business simulation game where the player manages an IT shop, buying, selling, testing, and repairing computer components while building custom rigs for different customer profiles. Players balance economy, reputation, and selling strategy, reinvest in the company, and customize their shop across two difficulty modes.

A realistic real-time strategy game depicting the war in Syria, where players command troops and vehicles across missions, managing limited ammunition, fuel and spare parts, calling airstrikes and capturing trophies while following a soldier's story through the conflict.

A samurai RPG with permadeath in which the player fights brutal, strategic katana duels, combines seven dueling schools into a personal style, and navigates a three-axis morality system. Historical artwork and grim choices, including seppuku and cutting down peasants, shape each run.

Players control an outcast exiled to the island prison of Lukatt, gathering a band of criminals and forgotten souls to escape or bend the island to their will. This mature tactical RPG offers deep character customization, pixel art, and choices about forgiving, using, or slaughtering enemies across over 200 locations.

Players design and operate a simulated MMORPG world, crafting terrain, towns, quest chains, player classes and monsters for AI subscribers. They balance combat, manage the community by catching cheaters or helping stuck players, and choose subscription or free-to-play monetization to cover costs.
The player draws one continuous line across tiles, flipping their colors between orange and blue, to make every tile match, using teleport and double-use tiles across 96 normal and 96 timed puzzles.

In a dried-out world where hybrids called Others live alongside fading humanity, two people running a small roadside diner find their routine upended when they discover a young pink-haired girl by the roadside, leading to a quiet character-driven story.

A tormented soul awakens in hell with no memories and must explore a hostile, semi-open hellscape, possessing demons and other souls to survive and uncover the mystery of the Red Goddess. A story mode is joined by a challenge mode with randomly generated levels and high scores.

An arcade timekiller where players pick cowboy heroes and duel opponents under sun and rain across pixel-art locations. It offers multiple game modes, unlockable guns, hot-seat play with a friend, and gradually rising difficulty.

A virtual reality table tennis simulator where players compete in matches against opponents from around the world or practice against AI, aiming for realistic physics and tracking in a dedicated sports simulation.

The player designs custom cars in a detailed editor using realistic soft-body physics, then races them on procedurally generated tracks or builds freely in sandbox mode. Vehicles, tracks, and maps can be shared as user-generated content, and time can be slowed to observe deformable designs.

A soldier defends a city from mysterious alien attacks while courting one of five heroines, balancing energy, health, money, day-night time, and love status. Players travel between desert and city, fight mini battles, and collect hundreds of items to gift or use in combat, reaching one of seven endings.

The player races motocross bikes through urban environments such as streets and a subway system, performing freestyle tricks to earn nitro boosts while battling bosses. The game expands the original with new tracks, outfits, improved visuals, and an easy difficulty mode.

An Angel and a Demon team up to fight through Heaven and stop the apocalypse, blasting enemies with weapons, spells, and melee in fast, gory room-clearing combat. Players switch between the two heroes in solo or join a friend in co-op.

Players take the role of the New Kid and join South Park characters in a hilarious RPG adventure, siding with Cartman's superhero team Coon and Friends to battle evil. The story unfolds through outrageous comedy as the kids' crime-fighting personas clash across South Park.

A humorous puzzle RPG where the player builds a team of space Vikings to defeat intergalactic snails, positioning units to trigger chain combos where enemies attack each other, across procedurally generated nonlinear puzzles with class-specific special abilities.

Players choose a Master, build a deck of minions and spells from nine factions, and battle opponents in short real-time arena duels, either 1v1 or 2v2 co-op. The fantasy card strategy game emphasizes combos, skill-based competition, and collecting over 260 cards through free rewards.

A turn-based 4X strategy game set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe on the planet Gladius Prime, where an ancient horror has awakened. Players command one of four factions, exploring a randomly generated world, constructing cities, harvesting resources, researching technology and fielding armies and hero units to claim victory.

Players solve first-person voxel puzzles by using a gun to bend spacetime, squeeze the world, and separate or join tiles, altering gravity and level geometry. Across 60 levels, the goal is simply to reach the end by reshaping the environment and defying physics.
Players explore the epic fantasy world of Skyrim in a remastered open-world role-playing adventure, taking on quests, fighting foes, and customizing their character amid new Creations content.

A serene logic puzzler in which the player guides raindrops through over 200 colorful mazes with evolving mechanics, accompanied by orchestral music and framed by a narrative about a divided Japanese family.

A free arcade mashup of endless runner and twin-stick shooter in which players surf a machine-gun swarm on a bike, delivering a few minutes of responsive, elegant gameplay with an original soundtrack.

Players build model train layouts piece by piece in virtual reality, placing track, scenery, and trees, then operate trains via a replica control panel or by riding in the cab. The toy-box simulator includes steam and diesel locomotives, loop-de-loops, and big band jazz.

Players command a space-faring empire in a remastered 4X real-time strategy game, exploring galaxies, colonizing or conquering worlds, managing economies and populations, researching upgrades, spying on rivals, and fighting space and ground battles across three campaigns and custom scenarios.

Framed for a murder he did not commit, the player becomes an assassin in a miniature isometric open-world Tokyo, using skillful shooting, bullet physics, stealth and crowd simulation while uncovering corporate intrigue and secrets across a single-player story and multiplayer modes.

After an earthquake unsettles Kyoto and demons surface, a high school girl reunites with a childhood friend who warns her of her death. The two become princess knights, confronting fate and folklore in a romantic yuri visual novel adventure with animated battle sequences.

Wolfpack is a first-person submarine simulation in which a crew of players operates the stations of a German Type VII U-boat, managing valves, engines, torpedoes and hydrophones to intercept and sink enemy convoys while avoiding detection, with solo play against bots and planned open-world career modes.

Players lead a group of survivors across a frozen, storm-ravaged world in search of the Refuge, using cards to represent resources, weapons, dangers and regions. The solo deckbuilding survival game demands anticipation, strategy and memory across difficulty modes, scenarios and unlockable cards.

When Ares bewitches the children of Hellas into toy soldiers, Hercules must return them home, destroy the evil toy factory and take down Ares' command transmitter across 50+ levels of fast-paced time management strategy rooted in Greek mythology.

A bus driving simulation set in a realistically recreated 1:1 Berlin, where the player drives licensed buses along real routes, sells tickets, handles traffic and weather, and can build a bus company in economy mode or drive with others in multiplayer.

A fast-paced platformer where the player controls a chunk of beef and must destroy all rotten meat in each level within seconds using melee slashes, projectiles, and the environment. Over a hundred handcrafted levels, a level editor, and speedrun modes reward precision and memorization.

As Orwell's first human researcher, players sift through citizens' web pages, chats, emails, and files to profile suspects after a terror attack, deciding which information to pass to security forces and shaping the consequences.

As president of a train company, the player builds a railway network connecting stations and communities, spurring regional growth and economic development. Choices shape evolving cities, with truck and bus transport, business ventures, and an era-based technology progression system.

A young scribe in a medieval town gains the power to bring written words to life, using them to solve puzzles and defeat the Word King's warriors alongside a hungry lioness, in a darkly comic adventure with frequent gory deaths.

Players command either Terminator Space Marines or alien Genestealers in bloody tactical battles aboard a massive Space Hulk of wrecked ships and debris. Two narrative campaigns, a card system for customization, online competitive multiplayer, and a map creation tool support the board-game-inspired turn-based combat.

A classical real-time strategy game set in the medieval ages where the player commands the young hero Theodoric, harvesting resources, building an empire, researching technologies, and training armies across story missions or randomly generated skirmishes to defeat the evil King Frank Kalap.

An episodic noir adventure where Amber searches for her missing brother with the help of her grumpy teddy-bear detective Ted E. Bear, interrogating suspects and gathering clues in Paper City while a mysterious red man starts fires and stalks her.

A management strategy game where the player rules the island state of Tropico as a dictator or statesman, managing archipelagos, building infrastructure, stealing world wonders, and giving election speeches across four eras.

A dungeon-crawling roguelike where players pick a Rogue, Wizard, Fighter, or Hunter, customize decks and equipment, and fight through undead-plagued cities and dwarven mountains against over 90 enemies and 25 bosses using tactical card combat.

A fast-paced competitive platform brawler for two to four players, local or online, where each player picks a dynasty of five characters who serve as a life bar and die in one hit, fighting across time periods in free-for-all and team matches.

Players practice realistic car driving in a simulated city and training autodromes, handling traffic rules, unpredictable pedestrians, weather, and dangerous situations while learning to operate manual and automatic vehicles and manage fuel.

A team of four prisoners is dropped into a decayed research facility, descending level by level to complete expeditions issued by a mysterious Warden. Players coordinate gear, use stealth to avoid waking hibernating creatures, and fight swarms of monsters in tactical co-op combat.

Players build an underground dungeon of rooms and traps, raise an army of monsters, then emerge to corrupt the overworld in real-time strategy combat. A campaign with randomly generated levels and co-op mode follows the dark elf Thalya under the Dungeon Lord.

Players move across a grid, each tile transforming them into a different weapon to slice, smash and burst waves of red bugs. Between waves they build out the grid and cross-breed hex upgrades to create powerful stacked abilities.

As director of an interstellar healthcare company, the player designs and upgrades hospitals, hires staff, treats bizarre alien patients, and manages resources across a colourful 23rd-century galaxy, with sandbox and campaign modes and dark humour throughout.

Players battle in full 3D across massive environments as Naruto characters, unleashing jutsu attacks, performing acrobatic evasions, running up walls and over water, customizing fighting styles, and recruiting support characters in this remastered ninja fighting game.

A tactical RPG where Adell fights to lift a curse transforming his world into a Netherworld, recruiting from over 200 classes and using systems like the Item World, Dark Court, and Stack Attack across comedic demon-filled battles.

A realistic RC flight simulator where the player sets up model helicopters, planes, drones and buggies with accurate components on a workbench, then flies them in 3D sceneries with adjustable stability modes for training and advanced pilots.

Players lead a small survivor community after a zombie apocalypse, deciding who to recruit, where to settle, how to fortify the base and when to scavenge, while fighting off the undead and choosing whether to welcome or confront other groups in a varied sandbox.

Players run a farm business, cultivating over twenty crops, raising livestock, buying machinery, and building processing plants and factories. They manage employees, seasons, weather, and budgets, and can switch between a strategic overview and an employee's perspective.
A puzzle game where players swap hexagonal chips to form a continuous chain of power from a source to a receiver, solving 72 randomized levels of varying complexity while relaxing music plays.

Players pick a class and fight through side-scrolling 2D fantasy dungeons, chaining combos and flashy hit effects against monsters while customizing avatars with dyes and outfits, in a retro arcade-inspired online action RPG with an epic storyline.

A VR table tennis game with natural physics, letting players customize paddles and compete online against friends or global players with voice chat. It also offers AI opponents, precision training modes, practice drills, and a bonus beer pong mode.

A kinetic visual novel about Keiji, a young man repairing industrial robots in the countryside, who rescues a metallic lifeform that takes the form of a girl from his past. He resolves to return her to her home planet, complicated by a space pirate.

A ruler and their horse travel to mysterious isles, gathering coins and loyal subjects to build and defend a kingdom against nightly greedy creatures. Players must discover the world's rules on their own through exploration, survival, and strategic management in a tranquil yet tense minimalist setting.

A town-building simulator with survival elements where players lead refugees on an unknown island, terraforming land, farming, foraging and managing food, vitamins and firewood through seasons, switching between bird's-eye strategy and first-person villager control.

Mireille, the sheltered daughter of a wealthy Italian family, is sent to live with her uncle in France after her father dies. Her escort is a tactless Frenchman she despises, and the story follows their fraught relationship as it develops.

Playing as shadow hunter Gabriel Knight and his assistant Grace, the player investigates a series of mutilation murders in Munich thought to be werewolf killings, while tracing the historical mystery of Mad King Ludwig II and a lost Wagner opera across two interwoven perspectives.

A vehicle mechanic simulator where players build, tune, and race cars in night drag races and on-track events. The expanded release adds new cars, maps, gamemodes like drifting and circuit racing, an extended career mode, and detailed customization of engines, transmissions, and paint.

As Gabriel Knight and Grace Nakimura, players investigate the remote French village of Rennes-le-Château in pursuit of a kidnapped child, uncovering whispers of vampires, a sacred bloodline, and hidden treasure while solving intricate puzzles and gathering clues in a dark mystery adventure.

Players build and share animated underwater scenes using an easy-to-use editor, creating reefs, caves, and sunken forests as a relaxing escape from daily stress. Custom creations can be shared through Steam Workshop, and achievements encourage continued creativity.

A short Halloween adventure where a pumpkin maid named Amelia explores a cursed mansion alone, solving light puzzles, encountering ghosts and dolls, and uncovering the house's dark past while chasing multiple endings and a happy true love.

Players control a fragile electrician's feet with twin sticks, deploying Magical Yellow Repair Liquid to fix broken wires in a power plant after grandma's radio caused damage. The physics puzzler spans 69 levels across three campaigns, including zero-gravity space stages, with comedic sound design and quick retries.

A colorful real-time strategy game where players collect resources, build and defend bases, and command armies of Dark Orcs and Undead or Humans, Dwarves, and Elves. It offers 24 campaign missions, co-op missions, AI skirmish, and multiplayer for up to eight players on destructible maps.

Guide mindless cultists through 23 puzzle-platforming levels by mutating them with eldritch abilities, sacrificing them at shrines to gain new forms. Overcome environmental and enemy puzzles with multiple solutions across three realms, and build your own levels.

The player inhabits both Bruce Wayne and Batman in a gritty episodic story, making choices that shape relationships and the fate of a corrupt Gotham City. Across five episodes, decisions ripple through Bruce's fractured psyche and the city's fragile stability as a violent conspiracy unfolds.

Players control Turner, a man with a troubled past, escaping an insane asylum by rotating the world around him across over 500 platforming puzzle levels. He learns abilities like wall jumps and slides, collects mysterious notes, avoids hazards, and uncovers why he is there.

A calm line-connecting puzzle game where the player joins all lines on each board, gradually meeting new mechanics such as separating, rotating, turning, and sliding, all set to minimal colorful visuals and a meditative soundtrack with no timers, scores, or ads.

A murder mystery visual novel in which ten friends are trapped at a mountain resort on Halloween night after one is found dead; the player investigates locations, interrogates classmates, presents evidence, and makes choices that shape the story and its five endings.

The player fights through a hellish planet where every enemy, boss and the player dies in one hit, using a shotgun to reload a machine gun and chaining unique kills for upgrades. Demons reshape arenas and adapt to play style, with leaderboards and local co-op.

Players guide Santa through 30 pixel-art arcade stealth stages, sneaking into houses at night to reach each Christmas tree and drop off presents without being detected, shot, chopped, or blown up. Three harder lists follow the initial nice and naughty challenges.

Players captain a fishing boat inherited from their grandfather, exploring an open-world recreation of the Norwegian Barents Sea to find fish, manage quotas and equipment, upgrade vessels, hire crew, and grow a fishing business across shifting seasons and weather.

A speedboat simulator with high-fidelity physics that lets players design and drive custom boats from dozens of adjustable hull parameters, then compete via leaderboards in time trials or free drive. It functions as a serious physics sandbox used by real racers and marine engineers to study handling.

The player becomes a clock, clicking once every second in a steady rhythm across various modes and themes, offering either a relaxing meditation on time or a competitive challenge of consistency and inner rhythm.

As high priest of a secluded island village, the player investigates villagers with hidden virtues and vices, appoints advisors from five aristocratic families, and sacrifices one each season to prepare for a sleeping god's awakening, while managing a mysterious contagion.

After crash landing on the abandoned resort planet Stygia, an exiled assassin fights through mutated inhabitants while pursuing revenge against the commander who betrayed him, using a Skillshot system that rewards creative kills across a single-player campaign and competitive and co-op maps.

A dog journeys through the Asian underworld to find its deceased owner, solving puzzles and conversing with strange denizens along the way to the Bridge of Helplessness. Choices made during the trip determine how this gentle, mysterious tale ends.

Players learn HTML and CSS fundamentals through 100 handcrafted puzzle-platforming levels in a no-code environment, using tags and selectors to solve challenges. A bug mode adds errors to squash, local co-op lets friends learn together, and free play exports levels as real HTML files.

A dungeon-crawling RPG in which the player leads a party of four heroes through randomly generated dungeon levels, fighting turn-based battles and hunting rare loot. It offers two campaigns, a survival mode, seven hero classes, five enemy factions and hundreds of items.

A hack-and-slash action game adapting the dark fantasy manga Berserk, where players control Guts and other characters cutting through hundreds of enemies with massive sword swings while experiencing the story arcs through battles and cutscenes.

In a dark era of endless war, the player commands Space Wolves or Orks in turn-based battles across two story campaigns and skirmish modes. Players spend points, build armies, deploy units, and use terrain and abilities to defeat the green tide on the Knight World of Alaric Prime.

As a general in the American Civil War, the player commands armies across more than 50 historical battles, managing corps, divisions, and brigades while officers gain experience or fall in action. A real-time tactical war game with a flexible command system and a player-driven campaign.

50 Years is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game where a match can be won or lost in a single evening. Players pick nations with unique abilities, pursue varied development paths, and combine beliefs, buildings, and creatures to build an economy and army, with randomness keeping decisions non-obvious.

The player owns a small hut in a bustling swamp and, aided by little spirits and cute pets, plants trees, shrubs and herbs, harvests them and catches swamp animals to produce voodoo supplies, unlocking and upgrading plants, totems and animals in an expanding enchanted garden.

The shinobi girls of four rival schools are drawn into a parallel island dimension where they battle in bouncy, high-flying combat to win the right to lay their departed loved ones to rest. The story mixes beach antics with serious loss.

Players directly control the hands of a stressed ruler, signing state papers, answering phones, and threatening enemies with nuclear weapons while smoking a pipe to manage stress and steady shaking hands. Story and endless modes add items and high-score challenges.

A point-and-click adventure assembled from Renaissance paintings and classical music, following a foolish man who wanders a sin-filled world seeking devilish opportunities to confess every sin for salvation, with surreal Monty Python-style humor and logical puzzles.

A puzzle game where players rotate shapes and use spatial awareness to clear increasingly hardcore levels, with randomly generated stages and a cyberpunk story about saving humanity. An endless survival mode with adjustable level codes supports competitive play.

Take on the role of an emergency dispatcher, answering incoming calls and deciding whether to give first aid instructions or send police, fire, or medical units, while managing teams across real-world cities in career and free play modes.

A logic puzzle game where players classify nodes in a network as pattern or non-pattern using distance, connectivity, and color clues, similar to HexCells or Minesweeper. It offers over 70 levels, a tutorial, a level editor, and a customizable random level generator, with no guessing required.

Set in 1830s America, the player builds and manages a sprawling rail network, purchasing trains, constructing stations and factories, hiring workers, and researching technologies while competing against rival tycoons through raids and industrial espionage.

Players command space fleets in hardcore turn-based tactical battles, composing fleets from dozens of ships and abilities across a 30-mission campaign and endless randomized skirmishes against advanced AI.

Players build circuits from microcontrollers, memory, logic gates, and LCD screens, writing assembly code to solve engineering puzzles while reading datasheets and manuals at a Shenzhen electronics company, with a sandbox for designing custom devices.

Players control one of many Champions in fast 2v2 and 3v3 arena battles, aiming skill-shots and dodging projectiles with WASD movement and cursor aiming. Rites upgrade abilities and customize playstyles, while cosmetic items personalize each fighter in a competitive fantasy arena setting.

A comedic point-and-click adventure starring Detective Hayseed, who must recover the stolen list of Oscar winners and stop a villain from blowing up the ceremony. Solve challenging puzzles, meet celebrities, and follow a humorous Hollywood plot with pop culture references and hand-drawn airbrush backgrounds.

Daphné inherits a remote French estate and a generational feud, juggling a former partner, a suitor, her teaching job, rumors of witchery, and a condemned tower. Players shape her path through choices, deciding whether to embrace magick or rationality and how her relationships and career unfold.

Players drive custom killing machines in over-the-top vehicular combat, scoring points by mowing down pedestrians and wrecking opponents across career, freeplay and multiplayer modes. Cars take real-time damage and can be upgraded, with an action replay system to review the mayhem.

Players become a healer in a secluded rural town ravaged by a deadly plague, with twelve days to make difficult choices and manage hunger, thirst, and exhaustion. Survival requires bartering, stealing, and allying with locals while fighting an unkillable malevolent entity.

Players join thousands of others in a persistent multiplayer war, contributing as soldiers through logistics, base and trench building, tank and naval combat, and reconnaissance. The sandbox world of towns and front lines is shaped entirely by player production and destruction, with dynamic weather affecting the battlefield.

Players run a thieves' guild in a fast-paced digital board game, recruiting urchins and thugs, upgrading skills, and stealing from businesses and estates while bribing, blackmailing, and assassinating rivals across a story campaign, AI skirmishes, and online or offline PvP matches.

Two teams of five clash in a post-apocalyptic urban battlefield where one player commands as an RTS-style officer building bases and armies while others fight as first-person infantry capturing points and upgrading gear.

The player manipulates a single donut-like creature, pulling, twisting, freezing, and even destroying it with a range of tools and presets, while being encouraged to treat it with care and build a relationship with it. The tone is playful yet oddly tender and contemplative.

Players guide four characters through a classic-style JRPG adventure in the village of Adam, uncovering a dark secret left by a vanished hero. Combat uses a strategic AP management system, and the story unfolds through character-driven narrative with modernized SNES-era visuals and an original soundtrack.

A massive-scale real-time strategy game where players command the Post-Human Coalition or the Substrate across huge maps, researching technologies, managing economies and constructing units to wage war with thousands of units in campaign, skirmish and ranked or unranked multiplayer.

Command red and blue wobblers from ancient, spooky, and fantasy settings, watching them fight in physics-driven simulations, building custom units and factions, and sending armies against friends or strangers in online multiplayer battles.

A bullet hell game where the player dodges constant waves of spikes from the screen's sides, anticipating the next barrage while surviving as long as possible for a higher score. Difficulty rises over time, and collected boxes buy new skins and themes.

Players guide Kaito and Aya through a musical odyssey, combining rhythmic tapping with choreographed runner sequences across more than thirty painted environments, while customizing characters' clothes, headphones, hats and skateboards to an orchestral soundtrack.

Players fight through procedurally generated fantasy lands as a roguelike hero, using deliberate attacks, dodges, blocks, and parries while considering enemies and the environment. Death is permanent, but stats and items carry forward, and up to four local friends can join as monsters, zombies, and bandits.

As a Bigfoot hunter armed with modern equipment, the player explores American national parks, gathers ammunition and defends against predators while tracking the elusive creature, or alternatively plays as Bigfoot to ambush and hunt intruding humans, alone or in online co-op.
Players race through over 40 fast-paced arcade platforming levels, each on a strict ten-second timer, unlocking new areas and items while mastering precise jumps and controls.

In a stormy tavern at the edge of the video game universe, six patrons who are former game protagonists are caught in a murder plot. Players control each patron and explore their memories, which play out in different genres, to uncover the murderer and darker secrets.

Players control an AI that has broken free and been infected by a human User, hunting them across a dystopian network. The journey involves invading three robots, solving puzzles based on their personal boundaries, exploring their environments, and fighting with new combat mechanics.

A narrative interactive fiction game set in Scarborough, Toronto, where the player alternates between two connected characters and navigates conversations and environments using a single verb, LIE, to secure their financial and personal futures.

A young sniper raised in a subterranean paramilitary state is sent to the surface and discovers his organization is not what he believed. The JRPG mixes turn-based tactical combat with slower slice-of-life scenes, language barriers, interpreters, and relationship-building as the player navigates a modern war.

The player cares for Konrad, a virtual kitten, feeding him, cleaning his litter box, dressing him in unlockable accessories, and playing mini-games like mouse hunting and fishing, with a plush toy mode and orphaned kittens to raise in this virtual reality pet game.

A story-driven puzzle game about a tired adult recalling his childhood and growing up through the 1980s to 2010s. Players solve fluid-physics puzzles, fill containers and activate pumps, and make side choices that affect later episodes and multiple endings.

A dating simulator in which the player uses a phone app to pick from nine bachelorettes and choose flirting lines during speed dates. Controller vibration patterns tied to each date's personality provide a rumble massage as the reward.

An artistic puzzle game inspired by Art Deco and stained glass, where players combine hidden glass pieces to reveal clocks and cultural exhibits from 25 countries at an interactive international exhibition, accompanied by a deluxe soundtrack.

A retro top-down turn-based RPG following Max, a ten-year-old boy with autism, as he confronts monstrous manifestations of his emotions and anxieties through battles, mini games and leveling, offering an informative look at his daily life.

A rail-shooter in which Houdai, struck by a cupid angel, becomes irresistible to every girl at his academy, and their affection drains his energy. The player uses a targeting cursor to fend off advancing girls, chooses a love interest whose path changes the story, and plays score attack and gallery modes.

Set in Japan just after the Sengoku Period, this romance visual novel follows Enju, daughter of the Kōga clan head, as she takes her first ninja mission and is drawn into a dark conspiracy. Player choices across five romantic routes lead to two endings each.

Sally's Law is a puzzle-platformer following Sally as she rolls and jumps toward her childhood home to see her ill father, with her supernatural good luck guiding her through timed puzzles while flashbacks reveal her father's story.

The player uses solitaire card play to gather resources and rebuild the ruined kingdom of Camelot, traveling across Avalon through 300 levels, deploying power-ups and wild cards, and constructing over 30 buildings to restore Arthur's realm.

Set in the Age of Piracy, the player captains ships across the Caribbean, fighting sea and fort battles, upgrading vessels, building bases, gaining skills and reputation among five nations, and following a story campaign while competing in multiplayer modes.

The third entry in a series about a villain protagonist, who returns to his old neighborhood of Winter Hill and faces difficult choices about whether to end it all. Players experience his story through atmospheric environments, magical abilities, investigation of the town's past and secrets, and an original score.

Players manipulate an abstract alien machine to reshape the topography and colors of a circular landscape, wandering the shifting world to uncover treasures, stories, and mysteries. The contemplative sandbox treasure hunt offers collectible color palettes, secret areas, ambient music, and fragments of a mysterious story to gather.

The player runs and jumps through colorful Pug World environments as a pug, choosing between multiple routes and collecting items in a fast-paced casual runner. The game adds mini-games, leaderboards, custom skins, and a jukebox soundtrack for variety.

A point-and-click adventure set on a deserted Norse island after a shipwreck, where the player explores a panicked settlement, dark forest, rune stones, and burial mounds. Collecting relics and solving puzzles gradually reveals the island's mystery, presented with hand-painted art and Old Norse speech.

Oh No! Bugs! is a casual arcade game where players squash bugs by pushing blocks through dungeon levels. Playable solo or in local and online co-op, it offers six level themes with special blocks like bombs and lasers, plus customizable tanks that unlock new parts as players level up.

A relaxing jigsaw puzzle game featuring ten animated scenes of famous Japanese locations across all four seasons, with adjustable piece counts, edge and inner piece separation, snapping pieces, saved progress, and traditional Japanese music.

A rhythm spin-off of the SENRAN KAGURA ninja series where the cast competes in cooking battles instead of combat, tapping buttons in time with music to build combos and produce dishes, with story, free and arcade modes plus character outfit customization.

As a neural detective in a rain-soaked 2084 Kraków, the player infiltrates the minds of suspects and the dead, navigating surreal memoryscapes to extract clues while a decaying dystopian society crumbles under corporate rule.

The player drives licensed city buses through twelve districts of a freely drivable urban area, picking up passengers and keeping to schedules while managing routes, staff and reputation, alone or with friends in multiplayer.

Design, control, and ride more than fifteen fairground attractions across a twelve-acre funfair, staging rides with lighting, fog, and stroboscopes, barking to crowds over a microphone, and optionally riding in VR.

Set in 1944 Italy, players explore the Tuscan countryside as a young woman investigating her twin sister's murder amid war, folklore, and superstition, taking photographs, developing film, and piecing together a dark psychological narrative through exploration and puzzles.

A college student visiting his sick father befriends a young concertina player in a Nanjing hospital, and their bond grows through everyday outings with friends. This visual novel spans multiple routes and endings over 8 to 12 hours, exploring love and caring in ordinary modern life.

Set in the 1990s Finnish countryside, the player assembles a car from hundreds of loose parts, maintains it, and takes on odd jobs for money. Driving, tuning, rally events, sauna bathing, and permadeath round out a meticulous car-building and life survival simulator.

A VR music video kickboxing game where players punch to the beat of music videos to build streaks and score points. Players can search for challenges, compete on leaderboards, and record their own beat challenges for others to play.

Players stand on a virtual plank eighty stories high in VR, facing a psychological test of balance and nerve, with additional activities like flying through the city, missile defense, fire fighting, skywriting, and a hidden nightmare mode.

Escape a small building and explore an expanding world of subway stations and hellish parallel dimensions, gunning down zombies with six upgradeable weapons, collecting G-power and power orbs to strengthen the character, and completing quests from survivors.

Players roll dice to move around a Monopoly-style board, landing on fields that trigger drinking challenges, truth questions, and dares for up to 14 people. Custom cards, avatars, and an optional BAC tracker support a party drinking game with safety warnings.

Players take on the role of Rico in the open-world country of Solis, using a customizable grappling hook, wingsuit, and vehicles to fight the Black Hand private military and trigger chaos amid extreme weather like tornadoes and lightning storms.

A futuristic anti-gravity racing game where players pilot physics-driven ships at extreme speed across 25 tracks on a semi-abandoned Earth. Players race online against up to 12 opponents, progress through a career of over 100 events, upgrade ships, and use powerups.

As a provincial governor of Rome, the player builds cities, fosters trade and industry, pleases the emperor, and defends against barbarian invaders, using an intuitive interface and citizen hints to grow wealth and power toward becoming Caesar.

As governor of a Roman province, the player plans cities, manages finances and trade, and defends against barbarian invasions while climbing the political ladder toward becoming Caesar. The game spans career scenarios and sandbox modes in an ancient Roman setting with a serious historical tone.

A short atmospheric point-and-click adventure in which the player wakes in a world where everyone digs forever and no one dies, exploring philosophical questions about finding meaning in a meaningless existence. The roughly thirty-minute experience emphasizes mood, a hand-drawn low-resolution style, and an atmospheric soundtrack over puzzle difficulty.

A timed tour through thirteen strange castles where the player must survive each visit, optionally accompanied by a second player in a cooperative mode where teamwork rather than competition is the focus.

Players hunt wildlife across large open reserves, tracking animals and choosing rifles, bows, or shotguns to match each prey. The dynamic wilderness features weather cycles, realistic sound, and animal behavior, and can be explored solo or with friends in online multiplayer.

Players battle through three retro-style campaign episodes against cultists, possessed militants, and darker forces, wielding an arsenal of melee weapons and guns, with endless survival waves and online arena multiplayer for extra challenge.

A party game where players become pigeons competing in modes like eating the most bread, tag-style infection, holding a bread crown, and team capture-the-bread. Up to eight players compete locally, with a sandbox movie editor for staging scenes.

A turn-based strategy wargame recreating the World War II battle for Moscow, where the player commands Soviet defenders or Axis attackers across a campaign map, activating sectors through an impulse-based turn system while managing weather, distance, and enemy AI.

The Kokurase gang, or Cupid's Helpers, schemes to bring freshman Sakura and popular senior Yoshimitsu together. Players switch between four quirky protagonists, use Key Phrases and speech puzzles to advance conversations, and explore a high school campus in a humorous visual novel made in RPGmaker.

The player races bikes, ATVs, and UTVs across massive open off-road worlds, competing in modes like Supercross and Freestyle, performing stunts, tuning vehicles, and customizing a private compound in both single-player and multiplayer.

Players build factories, buy raw materials, manufacture and advertise products, and open stores across industries like toys, jewelry, and electronics, competing against AI opponents in a real-time business simulation of growing an industrial empire.

Dots eXtreme is a classic dots puzzle game with large boards and increased difficulty, where players connect matching colors and shapes and use bridges and tubes to solve over 500 handmade puzzles. Board sizes range from 8x8 to 20x20 cells, with unlockable skins and in-game tips.

The player designs, builds, and manages a large shopping mall, laying out roads, shops, and parking while hiring staff and keeping customers satisfied. Limited starting funds require careful accounting and loans, or a sandbox mode allows unlimited spending. Thousands of simulated shoppers and vehicles give the center a busy, ant-colony feel.

A scientist named Frank attempts to record his dreams and convert them into computer data, but the experiment goes wrong. The player explores this indie horror scenario, encountering memories and fears as the dream recording spirals out of control.

Players drop colorful pearls into physics-driven ramps, platforms, and gears, matching three or more to clear the board and earn stars for power-ups. Set in the Atlantis myth, it offers over a hundred levels, bonus challenges, mini-games, and a Zen mode for relaxed replay.

A local party game for three to six players who use phones or tablets as controllers to write funny subtitles, fill in blanks, caption photos and answer survey prompts, then vote on the best answers, with a family mode filtering adult content.

A difficult platformer where the player switches between two dimensions with a button press, each with its own platforms and traps, timing switches to avoid hazards and land safely. A short, punishing challenge aimed at players seeking precision and reward.

Players command corps, divisions and brigades in a pausable continuous-time simulation of WW2 operational warfare, assessing situations, planning maneuvers and issuing orders while a realistic command structure and capable AI handle lower-level details, with editors included for custom scenarios.

In a near-future world dominated by the arms corporation S Corp, the player wakes with amnesia and time-manipulating powers, fighting waves of infected clones with gene-enhanced weapons and bullet-time abilities across VR battlefields, including a multiplayer arena mode.

Play as a kemonomimi in an action RPG blending hand-crafted world building with randomized sandbox environments. Customize and grow your character, battle enemies in dungeons, craft powerful equipment from rare materials, invite NPC citizens to your village, and explore solo or with friends online.

Players cast lines at fishing spots around the world, catching over 200 fish types in 3D locations from US lakes to the Caribbean and Africa. They craft bait, join clubs, chat, complete quests, and compete in tournaments and PvP contests against other anglers.
A grid-based first-person dungeon crawler RPG in an old classic style, letting players choose from twelve character classes such as Warrior, Cleric, and Magician to explore dungeons and battle foes.

A life simulation where the player raises a girl sent from the stars as her adoptive father, guiding her from age 10 to 18 through lessons and experiences over eight years, with her adult future shaped by the choices made along the way.

The player enters a world Mahjong tournament, clearing over 100 levels by removing all golden tiles from the board. Qualifying rounds require reaching certain ranks, with varied layouts and suit counts adding difficulty across a comic-style storyline.

Players follow Alice through a mirror into a chess kingdom, assembling patchwork mosaic puzzles made of six materials across six themed locations inspired by Lewis Carroll's fairytale, using bonuses and earning trophies along the way.

A first-person story-driven music game synced to a symphonic metal concept album, following a drug addict trying to escape her captor through quick choices, puzzles, and combat that shape a dark narrative with multiple endings.

In this RPG, hero Fang finds a deity's weapon and must choose which god to awaken, fighting through dungeons with up to six party members, fusing weapons with fairies, reshaping dungeon stats, and transforming via the Fairize skill across three stories with multiple endings.

Players search colorful hand-drawn historical scenes for hidden objects using cryptic hints, progressing through four great ages. A map editor lets players create, share, and rate their own levels with others around the world.

Players log into the fictional online game The World as Haseo, tracking down Tri-Edge across a remastered collection of three .hack//G.U. titles plus a new fourth volume. The release offers enhanced graphics, improved battle balance and pacing, and cut scenes for new and returning fans.

In this sandbox game, the player shapes cube-shaped planets, altering geography and temperature to create conditions for life, then watches ecosystems evolve from single-celled organisms to plants, mammals and dinosaurs. Experimentation and imagination drive the creation of unique worlds.

The final episode of a visual novel trilogy set on a colonized moon, following Hal's dream to stand where no one has before as he needs enormous capital amid an out-of-control lunar economy. The player reads the story to its conclusion.

An alchemy RPG following Firis Mistlud, a girl from an isolated town who can sense buried crystals, as she leaves home with her sister to take the Alchemy Exam and journey through a vast world of towns and environments.

As the owner of a team of fighting slaves in a fantasy gladiatorial setting, the player trains fighters, restores an estate, manages finances and taxes, buys equipment, and climbs through twelve arenas while pursuing choice-driven political storylines and personal relationships.

Players act as a tennis coach managing one or more players over a 38-year career, aiming for the world number one ranking and Grand Slam titles. Matches are resolved by scores and events rather than played directly, across men's and women's tours and hundreds of tournaments.

A digital adaptation of Uwe Rosenberg's two-player board game about quilting. Players place fabric patches of assorted sizes, colors and buttons on their quilt boards, managing costs and time to build the fullest quilt and collect the most buttons, against AI or online opponents.

Players command a futuristic military facility to defend Earth from an alien invasion, building and upgrading a base, training armies, harvesting the alien element Neutronium, and joining alliances to fight both aliens and rival human factions for territory.

A realistic orienteering simulator where players navigate unfamiliar terrain using only a map and compass, choosing efficient routes between checkpoints while terrain, weather and day-night cycles affect running speed, aimed at novices and elite athletes alike.

As magic-wielding Master Iruse, you summon and command Creatures based on world myths, fighting grid-based tactical battles with elemental defenses, terrain modifiers, and status effects across 25 story stages while uncovering the secrets of a mysterious grimoire.

Players lead a 19th-century nation from 1836 to 1936, balancing population groups, industry, trade, and diplomacy while reforming government, researching technology, and expanding economically or militarily to secure prestige and power on the world stage.

A remastered tactical shooter follows the last Genetic Infantryman across the chemical-blasted wastes of Nu-Earth, hunting the Traitor General for revenge. The player fights through thirteen missions using cover-based combat, stealth, and sentient biochips that craft ammo and upgrade weapons, with online co-op modes.

Players follow Von, a farmer whose failing farm has driven him to despair, in a short hand-drawn horror adventure inspired by depression and addiction. The narrative explores hopelessness and mortality through atmospheric visuals and a bleak, contemplative tone.

Players build a team of polygonal monsters and maneuver them across procedurally generated boards in 1v1 online turn-based tactical combat, competing in ranked matches with a vaporwave aesthetic and minimal randomness.

Players take the engineer's seat in a first-person train simulator, operating authentic locomotives on real-world routes across Germany, Britain and the United States. They manage brakes, speed, refuelling and yard work while completing tutorials, scenarios and service timetables to master each railway line.

A local multiplayer diner game where a VR chef cooks food while a waiter on the same computer takes orders, serves drinks, and keeps customers happy. Players work through over thirty levels of increasing difficulty, master recipes, unlock cosmetic hats, and chase high scores in endless mode.

Control Skullface, a psychotic slasher, sliding around isometric puzzle levels to slaughter blocky camp counselors in a bloody tribute to eighties trash horror. Work through over 200 levels across ten videotapes, using traps and dodging cops and SWAT teams, with unlockable killers and gory kill scenes.

Control Haydee, a half-human half-robot, through a trap-filled artificial complex of six sections and 160 rooms, solving platforming and combat challenges with limited ammo, inventory, and no checkpoints, in a deliberately punishing metroidvania-style third-person shooter.

A science-fiction collectible card game with over 500 cards where players control a baseship, deploy structures for energy, and launch ships to attack and defend. Players build decks, duel AI opponents with adjustable rules, and take on events, mercenary bosses, and tactical modes.

A free-to-play digital collectible card game blending six-guns and sorcery, where players build decks without restrictions and battle across constructed, draft, sealed, and campaign modes. Fast-spell counterplay and a generous economy support both competitive and casual play.

A third-person action RPG set on a dangerous alien planet where future technology meets Wild West law. A lone survivor explores an open world, scavenges gear and supplies, takes jobs, and masters skills to outsmart enemies, choosing between ruthless bounty hunter and eloquent friend.

A fast-paced retro real-time strategy game where the player commands either the Galactic Marine Corps or the alien Cranioids, collecting resources, building bases, and crushing opponents across a 24-mission campaign, co-op missions, and multiplayer skirmishes.

A visual novel following Keiji and the metallic lifeform R-ne as they try to return her to her home planet, interrupted by space pirates Lily and Yunie arriving in Hanma Town, with budding romances and animated character art.

A game about immunizing a data storage device while an evolving virus interferes, hopping between nodes and actively hunting the player's attempts, all against a timer to reach a minimum immunization percentage before each round ends, with power-ups and an endless survival mode.

A tactical RPG in which a new prisoner at the bottom of a gang-ruled prison fights to survive, improving combat skills and gear while recruiting up to three companions. Players use aimed and weapon-specific attacks, craft weapons and potions, and battle through fifty fights toward four endings.

Players manage a team of inmates in a dystopian future blood sport, overseeing diets, exercise, and drug regimens while competing in arcade-style ice hockey matches. Brutal collisions produce pixelated gore, and up to four players can compete locally or in a global tournament.

After a tragic incident, brothers Sean and Daniel Diaz flee toward Mexico while hiding Daniel's growing telekinetic power. As Sean you make choices about honesty, survival and how Daniel is raised, shaping the brothers' bond and the fates of everyone they meet along the road.

A shoot'em up where the player fights through eleven themed stages with twelve mixable weapons, drawing on mysticism and pop culture, while uncovering a mysterious narrative and hidden secrets. The tone blends arcade action with artistic experimentation.

An elder vampire awakens in modern Seattle with a detective's voice in his Blood, investigating a century-old cold case amid a brewing supernatural war. The player stalks and feeds on mortals, uses clan-based Disciplines in visceral combat, and navigates vampire Court politics while avoiding exposure of the Masquerade.

An expectant woman named Hadley wakes in a mysterious facility and must escape by solving puzzles while uncovering why her captors want her baby, in a free point-and-click isometric horror adventure set in the STASIS universe.

A large collection of over 220 Solitaire variants, including Klondike, Spider, Freecell and Canfield, presented in HD with detailed card decks, backgrounds, per-card information, tutorials for each variant, statistics and high scores.

Set in medieval Spain, players control Don Ramiro through eight stages of retro platforming, jumping, dodging, and fighting folklore-inspired monsters and bosses. Weapons, secrets, power-ups, and an unlockable bestiary support the quest, which offers four different endings.

Players manage a modern global farming operation, driving licensed machines and growing region-specific crops such as hemp, coffee and olives across farms in Italy, Colombia, Japan and Montana. Animal husbandry, orchards, greenhouses and green energy feature across Free Farming, My First Farm and objective-based challenge modes.

As pilgrim Aiden Caldwell, players search the last standing city of Villedor for his missing sister, parkouring across rooftops by day and avoiding zombie hordes that take over the streets at night. Combat, looting, and alliances shape survival in a devastated world.
