A logic puzzle game where players place all balls into their matching target slots across 100 levels in atmospheric 3D environments, with multiple solutions per puzzle and Casual, Normal, and Pro difficulty settings plus campaign and survival modes.

This VR experience presents stationary and moving scenes designed to trigger involuntary responses such as fear of heights, darkness, or sharks. It is not a game and offers no challenges, intended as a showcase to introduce new VR users to the medium.

A management simulation where the player designs and runs hospitals in Two Point County, laying out rooms and corridors, hiring and training staff, and curing unusual illnesses with specialized machines. Research, pricing and expansion decisions drive profits across increasingly busy facilities.

After society collapses from the undead, Javier searches for his lost family and meets Clementine, binding their fates together. Players make choices that shape a story where every decision could be fatal. The tone is dark and emotional.

A virtual reality collection of mallet instruments such as marimba, xylophone, and steel drums that the player can learn, practice, and perform in their own home, with sheet music import, metronome, and adjustable instrument settings.

Redie is a challenging single-player top-down shooter where players fight well-trained terrorists and soldiers in close-quarters combat across over 25 levels. Armed with 13 one-shot-kill weapons, they face enemies with unforgiving aim and fast reactions, with no story and optional mastery challenges to complete.

The player becomes a Tamer in the Digital World, raising and digivolving Digimon through real-time combat against evil Digimon and human villains. The MMO offers over a hundred mercenary Digimon, dungeons, raid bosses, guilds, trading, quests, costumes and dozens of maps to explore.

Players command a WW2 bomber crew, training and personalizing members whose names and skills are procedurally generated and whose deaths are permanent. Missions require managing fuel, ammo, and hydraulics in a physics-based plane while tagging enemy fighters and surviving flak, weather, and low oxygen.

This VR experience presents a front-row performance of the debut single by the three-member idol group Hop Step Sing!, with the characters singing and dancing in an immersive 3D concert. The description notes it is not a game but a music video showcase.

Players command a covert multinational military organization in an alternate 2009 Cold War, managing global bases, researching alien technology, and leading turn-based tactical squad battles against extraterrestrial invaders and their human collaborators while uncovering a conspiracy.

A point-and-click adventure through a surreal, disturbing dreamland where the player's actions drive an action-reaction design with no obvious choices. The player cannot die but can suffer, exploring a dark world with non-linear gameplay, hidden content, and high replayability.

A chaotic couch multiplayer golf game for up to eight players, combining simple 2D physics with procedurally generated holes and over a hundred modes, plus a customization system for powerups and scoring rules.

A seventeen-year-old student joins a mixed-class unit at a military academy in an empire divided by class conflict, bonding with classmates through school life to gain combat benefits while uncovering political intrigue in turn-based battles.

A free virtual exhibition collecting five short experimental games by independent designers, each a self-contained take on interactive narrative, puzzles, and exploration, from a cord dangling over arranged objects to wandering endless glass greenhouses and flickering photographs on virtual walls.

A virtual reality archery game where the player uses a bow with a VR headset to shoot as many birds as possible, chasing high scores, leaderboards, and achievements while uncovering secrets in the world of Skyhearth, the first chapter of an evolving experience.

Players match pairs of tiles in a traditional Chinese Mahjong game, clearing 70 levels of varying difficulty while avoiding becoming blocked in. Concentration and perceptiveness are needed to finish the ornate boards, and players can customize graphics and compare scores with friends worldwide.

Players control two police operatives neutralizing criminals, rescuing hostages, and defusing bombs across tense top-down tactical missions. A surrender system and real-time scoring reward careful arrests and stealth over shooting first, playable solo or in online co-op.
A young heir uses a pocket watch that rewinds time five minutes to pursue romance and help a shy girl retry her confession, in a school romantic comedy with dramatic turns.

Three young women at a prestigious academy for aspiring knights train, fight and live together, overcoming clashing personalities to join the warrior elite in a playful fantasy adventure featuring magic, humor, Japanese voice acting and illustrated heroines.

Players race through procedurally generated traffic in a retro top-down endless racer, dodging cars and barriers while managing fuel to beat high scores. Unlocking ten cars changes the game's palette, and short rounds, leaderboards and synthwave music evoke the coin-op arcade era.

Players command Union or Confederate forces in the opening battles of the American Civil War, from Big Bethel to Bull Run and Wilson's Creek. Missions involve infantry, artillery, cavalry, and generals, with formations, morale, flank attacks, and strategic movement across historical scenarios.
Match mahjong tile pairs against the clock to clear stages, gradually revealing anime-style girls in sexy costumes, with shuffled layouts across 100 patterns and Japanese voice lines.

A knight named Rosemary takes a job escorting one of four princes through a dangerous mountain pass, braving beasts and snowstorms while navigating romance and heartbreak. Player choices during the journey unlock multiple endings in this charming visual novel adventure.

Command a nuclear submarine during a escalating Cold War as WWIII begins, planning attacks on Soviet convoys and landings, choosing between stealthy torpedo runs and long-range missile strikes while managing sonar and surviving enemy escorts, submarines and aircraft.

Players command an elite platoon defending Earth from alien monsters in a tower defense game, building towers, equipping and training seven warrior classes, managing limited ammunition, and using bombs and drones across large-scale battles.

Players scavenge, craft and fortify during the day in a post-apocalyptic open world, then defend against massive infected hordes that gather at night. Bases and vehicles can be fortified, food managed through cooking, hunting and farming, and the game supports solo or cooperative play.

A boy with a prosthetic face explores an unsettling small town after a string of mysterious murders, using his handheld console to speak with the dead and uncover sinister secrets, aided by three friends and optional puzzles that reveal new narrative threads.

A puzzle strategy game where players guide colored trains to their destinations across 168 levels spanning four eras, from the Industrial Revolution to the Future, interacting with junctions, traffic lights, and traps in 3D environments.

The player takes the role of a young woman in a comedic dating sim who must romance and cure five muscular men cursed to remain animals, progressing through a long visual novel story that mixes humor, romance, drama, and mystery.

A calm logic puzzle game in which Slavya spends the summer at her grandmother's empty hut and restores lost alchemy recipes, gathering herbs and brewing potions while uncovering what happened to her grandmother.

A VR tower defense game in which the player builds and upgrades defense towers at set points, commands a hero, and throws spells or boulders to stop waves of invading monsters. It offers forest, desert, and ice maps plus an endless co-op mode and leaderboards.

A small personal-made trading mini-game where the player buys and sells items over a limited number of days, watching prices shift with hoarding, dumping, and events, with auto-save at the end of each day.

As photojournalist Frank West, the player explores an open-world sandbox, scavenging and combining weapons and vehicles to fight zombie hordes, with new zombie classes, EXO suits, and co-op multiplayer. The tone is chaotic, over-the-top action with heavy customization.

Following the Naruto Shippuden story arc, the player picks companions and fights opponents in arena battles, unleashing explosive Team Special Techniques in a remastered HD adaptation faithful to the anime universe.

A spin-off set in an alternate universe where the player creates a character and survives a hostile environment by scavenging resources, crafting weapons, building a base camp and exploring, with four-player co-op missions to fortify and defend areas against hordes of creatures.

Players settle an uncharted island by building roads and cities, trading resources and competing against others online, recreating the CATAN board and card games with expansions and scenarios. Matches run against friends, strangers or AI across platforms.

A weapons-based fighting game where players clash using new mechanics like Reversal Edge counters and Soul Charge power-ups, alongside a story mode revisiting 16th-century events, online matches, and a character creation mode, with Geralt of Rivia as a guest fighter.

Players command WWII forces in a free-to-play collectible card game, building decks around one of five major powers and an ally nation, deploying infantry, tanks, artillery, and aircraft while managing Kredits and frontline tactics against other players online.

Ten inmates are dropped into a dystopian post-apocalyptic arena in the Northern Canadian Rockies, where they gather resources, craft gear, and fight in melee and ranged combat to be the last survivor while a Show Director and spectators influence the match.

Players follow Stefan, a young designer who slacks off at work by browsing distractions, clicking through scenes and dodging a snitching co-worker and a boss with bad timing. Getting caught means being fired. A story mode and endless simulator mode frame the adult-themed content.

A Chinese-developed visual novel in which a man who knows the world will soon end lives lavishly until a girl steps under his umbrella, beginning a romance across seven chapters of intrigue and revelation.

An amateur photographer named Dimitri is trapped in a Yugoslav forest as war breaks out, and must survive months without combat training. The experimental interactive game uses full-motion video with VCR rewind, pause and fast-forward controls, point-and-click exploration, quick-time events, and choices leading to ten endings.

Players restore the ruined world of Buttonlands by completing over 100 match-3 levels, where each tile has two sides requiring distinct strategies. Power-ups clear obstacles, gold buttons fund restoration, and players meet cute characters across Normal or Relaxed modes, with bonus levels unlocked through achievements.

Lead a squad of vigilantes in turn-based tactical combat against gangs in the crime-ridden neo-noir city of Reiker, gathering intel through surveillance and interrogation, building base facilities, crafting gear, and customizing characters while pursuing a hard-boiled story with dialogue-driven advantages.

The player assembles traditional jigsaw puzzles made from looping video clips of wild animals such as lions, elephants, and pandas. Each scene offers three piece counts, with edge and inner pieces separated, snapping assistance, and the ability to save progress mid-puzzle.

A casual fantasy strategy game where the gnome princess gathers a team to rescue her family and castle from a warlock collector, managing resources and building construction across over 40 levels in magical lands full of strange creatures.

The hero arrives in the Caribbean to investigate mysterious events and is drawn into conflicts among drug dealers, bandits, and the Mafia. Players explore tropical islands freely, fight hostile factions with over thirty weapons, drive military vehicles, and follow a non-linear storyline with an original RPG system.

Players stretch an ever-extending arm through levels to grab a goal bottle, using physics to pull and drop objects while avoiding hazards. The story follows a strong-minded baby with an infinitely stretchy arm from cradle to grave across dozens of puzzle levels.

As Alyx Vance in a VR Half-Life story set between the first two games, the player fights the alien Combine occupying Earth, using environmental interaction, hacking tools, puzzle solving, and visceral combat while helping found a fledgling resistance with her father.

An experimental generative art piece rather than a conventional game, with no levels, points, or objectives. Players randomly generate or manually tweak audio-visual anomalies using sliding dials, exploring the sights and sounds they produce, and can capture, save, and reload favorite creations.

Goddesses descend to Akihabara and join a Divine Idol group, and the player follows their auditions, performances, and personal growth through a lighthearted story of magic, love, and music. The tale centers on idol culture and the relationships among the goddesses and humans.

A mosaic puzzle game in which players assemble images from different materials while a story unfolds about the Goddess of Creation restoring the world after the God of Chaos wipes out life. It offers 150 levels, relaxing music, and relaxed and fever modes.

Collect all the gems while avoiding moving and pointy hazards within a time limit, warping across screen edges and grabbing extra lives across 25 challenging stages in a retro-styled game evoking the 1980s ZX Spectrum era.

A virtual reality pinball game where players flip balls across three themed tables, Secrets of the Deep, Mars and Epic Quest, using realistic physics and detailed 3D graphics, while competing on global scoreboards for high scores and table statistics.

As a football team's general manager, the player trades, negotiates contracts, bids on free agents, drafts talent, sets game plans and playbooks, prices tickets, and manages stadium plans and finances to build a championship franchise.

A puzzle game where players slide arrow-marked marbles to match a target picture in each level, earning stars for using fewer moves. It offers 120 hand-crafted puzzles across six color and music themes, requiring planned, directional moves.

Players join a mining company and descend with up to three teammates into procedurally generated cave systems on an alien planet, extracting minerals and fighting alien hordes, choosing among four distinct classes with unique traversal and combat tools across destructible environments and eleven biomes.

Players fight through a lawless post-apocalyptic wasteland as the last Ranger, shooting factions of mutants and madmen with upgradable weapons and Nanotrite powers. They traverse jungles, swamps, and deserts in vehicles, driving anything they find while pursuing The Authority in an open-world first-person shooter.

A puzzle adventure in which the player guides Rose and a giant through a grim castle, using Rose's power to absorb blood and restore color and time to objects, lifting and throwing obstacles, and collecting blood memories that reveal vignettes of past deaths.

Command US Army or Wehrmacht forces in a battalion-level simulation of the 1943 Tunisian campaign, shifting troops in a turn-based operational phase and fighting real-time tactical battles with detailed ballistics, armor modeling, and realistic soldier morale across reconstructed landscapes.

A visual novel following Mina, an ordinary high school girl who gains supernatural powers after resonating with a doll and joins an organization fighting Puppets. The story blends a shadow war with daily life, romance, and mystery as she uncovers who controls the Puppets.

After a drunken night, players wake beside a naked stranger and explore the bedroom point-and-click style, seeking clues about who the person is and what happened, while choosing whether to stay and build a relationship or slip away, with twelve endings to discover.

Players run a laboratory testing weapons on durable human clones, combining melee, energy, firearms, and exotic tools like a black hole to destroy test subjects in increasingly insidious ways, presented as a relaxing sandbox for stress relief.

Girls infected with a virus that turns them into weapons are quarantined on a sun-soaked island school, where they battle one another to control the infection; players pick among seven characters and fight through story missions in fast combat.

Players choose among Swordsman, Archer, and Mage classes and adventure through varied locations, fighting monsters and other players or teaming up against stronger foes. They tame and train animals for tactical battle, and build a personal Miniland home with a garden for socializing.

A free-to-play military first-person shooter where players fight across many maps and modes using a large arsenal of weapons. Players customize characters with skins, complete daily missions for rewards, and compete in ranked, clan, and tournament play.

The player solves Lights Out-style puzzles by switching off all tiles in as few moves as possible, progressing through over a hundred handcrafted levels across six chapters with distinct color themes, in a minimal interface without timers or scores.

Players are reincarnated as the legendary onmyoji Abe no Seimei in Heian-period Kyoto, collecting and evolving shikigami spirits while unraveling supernatural tales. They assemble tactical teams for semi-real-time battles against other players in modes like duels, realm raids and boss challenges.

A woman named En wakes from stasis at an ancient Palace and explores its dark halls using forgotten technologies. The Palace copies her behavior into Echoes that mimic her tactics, so stealth, action, and shooting choices shape an increasingly punishing enemy across blackout cycles.

Players build vehicles, machines, creatures, and buildings from bricks in a sandbox editor, then test and destroy them with dynamic physics, sharing creations via the Workshop and joining multiplayer roleplay, chases, and chaotic community modes.

A minimalist ambient logic puzzle game where players place objects on a grid to redirect movement and solve over 150 levels, with mechanics like portals and destroyable obstacles. Trial and error reveals the correct order of placements, accompanied by relaxing music.

The player clears a Minesweeper-style grid where completing a line removes it and adds a new empty line on top. Difficulty rises as more lines are cleared, and players compete for the highest difficulty level while earning achievements.

Five heroes stand against a combined Chaos army and Skaven horde in a four-player co-op action game set in the Warhammer Fantasy world, fighting through hordes in bloody first-person melee while mastering branching careers, talent trees, and many weapon types.

Players fight to liberate Hope County, Montana from a fanatical doomsday cult, using a large arsenal, stealth takedowns, and vehicles across a dynamic open world. Recruiting specialized rebels and animal companions provides support, and the full campaign can be played in two-player co-op.

After a 1986 nuclear war between the Soviet Union and the West, the player explores the Soviet Wasteland as a survivor, creating a character, solving quests in nonlinear fashion, and fighting mutants and bandits in turn-based combat while uncovering a conspiracy threatening what remains of life.

Siblings Reynn and Lann journey through the toy-like world of Grymoire to recover their past and save the future, capturing, customizing, and evolving creatures called Mirages and stacking them to fight in strategic turn-based battles while exploring vertically layered dungeons.

A cyberpunk-styled puzzle game in which players must close every cell in a grid, opening steel doors only once and avoiding wrong steps. Each move demands careful thought, with hints and cheats available for stuck players.

Players command historic battleships, destroyers, cruisers, submarines and aircraft carriers in free-to-play naval battles across large maps, maneuvering and firing salvos while progressing through national tech trees, upgrading commanders and joining divisions or clans for competitive play.

A real-time grand strategy game where the player leads any modern nation, managing politics, economy, diplomacy, espionage, and military conflict amid crises and global threats. Players shape their political system and pursue world domination or cooperation through moral choices.

Players drive over 130 locomotives or manage a railroad staffed with dozens of AI drivers, choosing simple or realistic controls. They can also edit existing routes or build their own layouts with world-building tools, in a detailed simulation aimed at railroad enthusiasts.

A tactical mech strategy game where the player commands a rebel squad against an occupying force in war-torn Fyrland. Players predict enemy movements on a timeline, plot precisely timed counterattacks, then watch physics-based battles unfold in real time while customizing and leveling mechs and pilots.

A casual destruction game where the player places combustible objects around a peaceful village and then ignites a single flame, watching the fire spread across houses and trees. Procedurally generated maps offer new layouts each run for experimenting with different fire paths.

Players enlist as Helldivers in squads of up to four, dropping onto hostile planets to fight alien enemies with explosive firepower, armor, and stratagems, while capturing and defending planets contributes to a shared galactic war effort.

A roleplaying game combining turn-based combat with match-three mechanics, where the player joins Knuckles the Oaf and companions to save their homeland, matching gems to power weapons and unleashing attacks with a party chosen from thirty classes.

Players follow sixteen-year-old Chloe Price as she forms a friendship with Rachel Amber, making dialogue choices and using a risk-reward backtalk mode to shape a choice-driven narrative with multiple endings.

A spatial reasoning puzzle game where players fly through endless waves of abstract neon geometry, rotating and growing a set of cubes to fit through oncoming walls. Matching shapes raises the score, and VR lets players lean to spot the holes and time power-ups.

In a world where a nuclear accident made goats super smart, players join fast multiplayer arena battles as heavily armed goats, using goofy weapons and horn attacks across wild arenas from futuristic farms to outer space, with silly customization and multiple team and free-for-all modes.

Players compete in a futuristic table tennis tournament set in the Crown Galaxy, facing the Division of Steel across cups in singleplayer campaigns or challenging other players worldwide in multiplayer. Realistic physics, motion-captured opponents and simulation or arcade modes translate their swings into matches.
A visual novel in which the protagonist explores a forest with friends to verify a local legend, is attacked by something unknown, and meets two girls whose intentions and secrets remain unclear.

A 2D atmospheric horror side-scroller set in 1960s Taiwan under martial law, where two students explore a haunted high school, hide from monsters, and solve puzzles while uncovering the dark past of the cursed campus.

A free-to-play multiplayer shooter offering four modes in one package: open-world PvP with clan territory fights, zombie survival with scavenging and crafting, and a ranked competitive mode. Players loot weapons, customize characters with skins, trade items, and battle zombies and rival survivors across varied maps.

An exchange student named Brian experiences a year of Japanese high school life, learning customs and growing close to two classmates through summer festivals, Comiket, a Kyoto school trip, and seasonal events in this slice-of-life visual novel.

Players become a cyber ninja in a reimagined near-future Japan, performing triple jumps, wall runs, and bullet-time slow motion while fighting with katanas, firearms, and bows. The VR action RPG follows a covert organization battling enemies across mission-based levels.

Komaru Naegi escapes captivity into a city overrun by Monokuma robots and a group of children bent on exterminating adults; she teams with Toko Fukawa, using a Hacking Gun with varied Truth Bullets to shoot through enemies and solve puzzles.

Players fight in fast-paced neon arena battles for up to four players, using katanas, rocket launchers, and sledgehammers. After each round they draft stackable perks that persist through the match, with local and online multiplayer, AI bots, and an '80s-inspired aesthetic and synthwave soundtrack.

A digital adaptation of the cooperative deduction board game set in the 1920s, where a ghost guides psychics to identify a murderer, weapon and location using abstract vision cards, playable solo against AI, in pass-and-play, or online with up to seven players.
A solitaire card game framed as a seafaring adventure, where a retired naval captain sails to find his missing fiancée, clearing over 300 levels, earning gold, and buying ship and island upgrades.

In VR you fight as a gladiator in the Colosseum, wielding swords, shields and bows against ten enemy types across themed stages, surviving seven days, competing on leaderboards, or training in a customizable sandbox while a dynamic crowd reacts to your performance.

Players control a gunman guided by a sentient banana, chaining stylish acrobatic gunfights through a violent underworld using split aiming, slow motion, and window breaches to dispatch gangsters in explosive action sequences.

The player explores randomly generated dungeon floors as one of 13 classes, building a deck of cards that serves as their abilities and fighting monsters in card battles, with achievements that make later runs easier across short sessions.

The player controls a Puppet named Charlotte through an episodic story exploring themes of junk food, television, religion, and loss, alongside alien friends and an Observer. The narrative follows Charlotte's unraveling mind through surreal, dark events where death is a recurring possibility.

A short story-driven experience following Alex and Nic as they climb a mountain together for the first time, sharing memories along the way and choosing paths that reveal different story elements between the two characters.

Players pick a race, assemble a troop of ten units, and send waves of units onto the battlefield within 12-second preparation windows, using Commander Skills and teamwork to destroy enemy turrets and bases in strategic real-time battles.

Compete in an extreme off-road racing show broadcast on the Gravel Channel, driving powerful vehicles across four disciplines—Cross Country, Wild Rush, Speed Cross, and Stadium—through deserts, mountains, and arenas in offline and online modes.

A first-person philosophical horror story in which Ewan wanders mysterious places, hounded by his fears, to find a way out; the roughly ninety-minute experience ends with a choice that decides his fate.

An open-ended puzzle game about alchemical engineering. As newly appointed Head Alchemist of House Van Tassen, the player designs and builds transmutation machines from programmable arms, tracks, and esoteric components to produce remedies, gemstones, and weapons, competing for the simplest and fastest solutions amid a story of intrigue.

As leader of a secret organization called The Cabal, players run covert operations during the Cold War, investigating classified files, interrogating agents and fighting turn-based tactical battles to uncover and stop a global conspiracy before it plunges nations into conflict.

An adventure game about a little boy in a hospital who travels with his mother into a fantasy world from his storybook to ask the Guardian of the Forest for a wish. He helps his hospital neighbors by interacting with their alter-egos, solving puzzles and uncovering their secrets.

Players follow Iris as her younger sister Zoey transfers to her school and moves in, with Iris's attempts at sisterly bonding going awry as confusing sexual tension blooms between them, with in-game choices changing the ending of this yuri visual novel.

Playing as Kenji, the grandson of a time-machine inventor, the player joins four time-travelling girls on adventures through history, making dialogue choices that build affinity with each girl and unlock romance routes and scenarios while facing a threat to existence.

Manage your own vineyard in a 3D tile-based tycoon game: grow grape varietals, craft wine through crushing, fermentation, pressing and ageing, expand your estate across 33 tiles, and weather random events and wine awards over 60 in-game years.

Players pursue a rogue god across the Deadfire archipelago, captaining an upgradable ship, exploring islands, recruiting and customizing companions, and making meaningful choices in a single-player party-based RPG built on classic D&D-style mechanics.

A collection of three small games: a digital dodge-ball match for one or two players across four seasons, a fast-paced sword-fighting slice-'em-up with bosses and unlockable characters, and an interactive title screen full of secrets. Best played with a gamepad.

A cooperative puzzle-platformer in which the Rabbit and the Owl, confined to light and dark realms, must work together to traverse a hand-painted negative-space world. Puzzles emphasize analysis over mechanical skill, with an interpretive story pieced together along the way.

A hybrid visual novel, simulation, RPG, and casual game set in a shop run by Merlin, offering a long free storyline with 148 unique characters. It promises easy-to-learn but hard-to-master play and intense fighting, framed as an escape from everyday problems.

Players race motocross bikes across 18 official tracks from the 2016 MXGP and MX2 seasons, customizing riders and bikes with over 300 official components. The game emphasizes realistic graphics and sound, including the addition of 2-stroke bikes, for an immersive championship racing experience.

Players control an imp who possesses defeated enemies to steal their abilities while descending a procedurally generated turn-based death labyrinth. With multiple difficulty modes, randomized potions, traps, and shareable death cards, it offers an accessible yet deep traditional roguelike experience.

An eight-year-old boy tormented by monsters living in his house is the focus of this story-driven point-and-click horror adventure. The player makes critical choices that alter the ending while uncovering the mystery of the invading creatures, presented more like a movie script than a game.

A free-to-play online shooter where players customize futuristic tanks with turrets, hulls, augments, and drones, then battle other real players in real-time arena matches with instant respawns, power-ups, and multiple game modes.

Players answer multiple-choice quiz questions about the history, culture, and notable figures of Ancient Rus, split into missions of sequential questions. Each answer includes extra explanations and facts, turning the quiz into a light educational experience crafted by a professional historian.

Players fly a plane through procedurally generated tunnels, dodging and destroying thousands of enemies in a throwback arcade shooter, chasing high scores and leaderboard placement as difficulty constantly rises and kill multipliers reward accuracy.

A visual novel concluding a trilogy about Keiji, a mech garage worker, and R-ne, a shapeshifting metallic lifeform, as they try to return her to space while facing a mysterious organization in Hanma Town.

Players defend a realm against an invading chieftain by building a city, training an army and summoning defenders onto warstones in tower-defense battles. Choosing among Warlord, Sorcerer and Treasurer classes, they cast spells and upgrade units across story missions and PvP modes.

A casual physics-based puzzle game where a panda named Pew chases after toys scattered by an angry bird, jumping through over forty-five levels of obstacles, collecting stars, and changing outfits to stay unrecognized by the bird.

Trapped in a mystic art deco laboratory with a strange creature, the player solves puzzles and evades danger to escape, uncovering an old family curse and an evil artifact, with multiple endings shaped by how the nightmare is played out.

The player joins up to eight-player tactical co-op squads viewed from above, fighting alien swarms across campaigns and community maps. Missions involve shooting through infested levels, with challenges, PvP modes, new weapons and leaderboards for fastest completion times.

Players customize wrestlers, rings, and rules to compete for championship belts in this grappling simulation. They organize online matches and tournaments, create movesets and CPU logic, and try varied modes including deathmatch, gruesome fighting, and mixed wrestling-MMA rules.

A central hub that brings several Serious Sam first-person shooter games onto one updated engine, letting players jump between levels from different titles in a single application. It adds shared workshop support, cross-game mods, split-screen, VR multiplayer with flat-screen players, and various technical upgrades.

A free-to-play dungeon crawler where the player runs a tavern, buys sodas to attract adventurer classes, and sends teams into dungeons for loot, using turn-based combat or auto-combat while upgrading the tavern and ascending through dimensions and bosses.

Use a cutting tool to slice away a water-filled barrier hiding pretty girls while avoiding enemy sea creatures that destroy your tool, clearing stages by removing most of the barrier to unlock gallery photos and progressively revealing the characters.

Players lead and customize rival gangs in the dark, polluted Underhive tunnels of Necromunda, specializing members and fighting tactical gunfights in hazardous dystopian environments. They climb walkways, set traps, and ambush foes into bloody melee, following a narrative campaign and joining four-player online gang battles.

Guide Kim, a young girl descended from female warriors, through maze-like dungeons to stop a secret society. Movement and attacks are combined in a sliding turn-based puzzle system, letting players plan each slide to slash enemies and solve tactical rooms at their own pace.

As the living book Tractatus de Monstrum, the player commands squads of created puppet soldiers through a twisting, miasma-filled labyrinth, fighting monsters and solving puzzles while gathering treasure. Between dives, the player upgrades the brigade, synthesizes equipment, and takes town requests.

Players control ninjas with distinct abilities across thirty platforming levels to collect scrolls and rescue kidnapped friends from an evil ninja. An alternate path lets players find secrets and bugs to annoy the Game Manager, with boss fights and adjustable game speed.

An asymmetrical local co-op escape room for VR and PC, where a VR player as the Eye guides a small robot called the Light through a post-apocalyptic robot world, and the two perspectives must communicate to solve puzzles together.

A pirate-themed match-three game where the player clicks and drags birds across dozens of levels to match and remove them, clearing obstacles to reach guarded artifacts while using bonuses and following a comedic story about cats stealing a treasure map.

The player rules a randomly generated fantasy realm as a customized sovereign, managing cities, researching arcane constructs, recruiting armies and heroes, and exploring dungeons while rival wizards and warlords compete for conquest or survival.

A mahjong puzzle game in which the player solves tile-matching deals across over one hundred levels in six episodes, freeing magical pets from cages and following the trail of the crafty thief who captured them.

Katy and Bob open a cafe in a safari park, working through colorful time-management cooking levels across three locations. Players serve customers, complete bonus tasks, and upgrade their team while following a light family adventure plot with cheerful characters and music.

A melee combat game set on a merged continent where reborn historical heroes and generals lead legions of thousands into battle, using four-directional mounted slashing, armor penetration, and combo techniques in fast matches decided by skill rather than pay-to-win advantages.

Sixteen kidnapped students are imprisoned in a school where some will kill and some will die; players investigate twisted murder cases and use lies, logic, and fast-paced debate in trial scenes to guide classmates to conclusions, with new minigames between trials.

Players fight through frantic first-person shooter combat in virtual reality, blasting endless waves of enemies with a dual-wielded arsenal. The game emphasizes arcade-style action without cover systems, and supports multiplayer versus and co-op modes alongside Steam Workshop content.

Hercules and Megara play detective when Zeus vanishes from Olympus, working through fast-paced time management levels across volcano, winter, tropical and underwater environments with puzzles and a day/night cycle in a lighthearted mythological mystery.

A guitar rhythm game starring a tattooed, heavy-metal-loving Santa who travels the world with a band of leather-clad reindeer, playing rock and metal arrangements of classic Christmas carols. Players shred solos across five worlds in campaign and quickplay modes, with guitar controller support.

Manage a facility containing monstrous Abnormalities inspired by the SCP Foundation, ordering employees to work with the creatures and extract energy to meet daily quotas. Expanding departments and unlocking new beings brings escalating chaos, with an ever-present sense of tension and dread as each day progresses.

Players solve logic puzzles by coloring squares on grids to reveal pictures, progressing from small to large boards across hundreds of puzzles in four modes, with a tutorial, hints, awards, and a puzzle editor for creating and sharing custom puzzles.

A homunculus slave escapes the mines and descends into King Tarrius' cursed catacombs, fighting undead in tense third-person souls-like combat while hunting loot and gear. Dice-driven roguelike trials, three escalating curses, and optional four-player splitscreen co-op shape each risky run deeper into the crypt.

A crown princess cursed by a Fairytale Curse fights to regain her crown in a fractured kingdom, pursuing five bachelors across branching routes with ten endings, unlockable art, and a choice indicator in this otome visual novel.

A turn-based tactical RPG where the player commands slimes, the weakest of enemies, who possess human units to borrow their abilities and fight back against tyrannical invaders. Each battle poses strategic questions about which slime to use on which foe, and the lighthearted look hides a tough challenge.

A first-person horror adventure in which an unarmed player explores a large, oppressive Lovecraftian world, flees a lurking enemy, solves puzzles, and uncovers the mystery behind an ancient evil that has befallen the land.

Players grow a small hamlet into a sprawling medieval kingdom, laying out towns, farms, and block-built castles while keeping peasants fed, taxed, and happy through winter plagues and festivals, and defending against viking raiders and dragons in a stylized seasonal world.

Five strangers are drawn to a rundown 1987 town where a dead body, a haunted hotel, and a burnt factory hide a connected mystery. Players switch between characters, solve puzzles, and explore a bizarre world at their own pace in a comedic neo-noir adventure.

A short animated VR music video for Future Islands' song 'Old Friend', in which the player inhabits a jiggling cartoon body and dances through a joyful, absurd reactive world where only dancing matters.

SHENZHEN SOLITAIRE is a standalone solitaire variant inspired by Mahjong and FreeCell, originally made for SHENZHEN I/O. Players work through simple but persistently challenging card deals, most of which are solvable, aiming to win one hundred games for a Steam achievement.

A visual novel about a college student whose third eye opens, letting him see gods and spirits, while three feline beast-men involve themselves in his school life and future, exploring folklore, religion, and same-sex romance in modern Taipei.

Players return to the dark fantasy world of Lordran, fighting through a remastered action RPG with the Artorias of the Abyss DLC, learning enemy patterns and mastering punishing combat alone or with up to six players online. The tone is bleak and atmospheric, rewarding persistence with a sense of accomplishment.

Set in an 80s sword-and-sorcery fantasy kingdom, players choose among six characters with unique abilities and fight through non-stop, skill-based combat against monsters and enemies. Brutal mini-games, gore, multiple endings, a versus mode, and a heavy metal soundtrack round out the experience.

Players grab a putter and play minigolf across eight themed official courses or thousands of community-made workshop levels, using a detailed level editor to build and share their own holes, and competing on seasonal leaderboards in solo or large multiplayer gatherings.

As a human ambassador sent through a mysterious portal to a world of dragons, the player befriends and romances the locals while investigating a conspiracy. Choices during free-time sections permanently affect the world and lead to one of more than thirteen endings in this long visual novel.
Step into a virtual reality arcade and play over 30 physics-driven arcade games across several rooms, earning tickets to spend on toys, customizing an avatar, and playing solo or online with friends.
A virtual reality music creation app where players compose loops and sequences by placing instrument nodes in 3D space, performing and recording their sets with spatial audio across six environments.

Players line up seasonal shapes in a winter-themed match-3 puzzle game, clearing 110 levels against snowy backgrounds while building a power gauge for bonus blowouts and unlocking pictures for a gallery. The tone is festive, relaxing, and family-friendly.

Players transport cargoes across a large open-world map of Australia, completing over 1,000 towns by solving logistics puzzles, building and upgrading industries, and managing truck routes and bonuses in a strategy puzzle game.

Players race funky cars on top-down single-screen tracks, ramming rivals and grabbing bonuses to wreck them, either solo against AI in championships or with up to eight friends on one couch. Tracks span settings from a Caribbean island to the Moon, in a brakeless old-school arcade style.

Players design and pilot custom block-built vehicles such as helicopters, boats, and submersibles to run search-and-rescue missions across a vast dynamic ocean world, managing finances and base growth in career mode or building freely in creative mode.

A real-time strategy game of epic space naval battles set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe. The player commands fleets from twelve factions across three campaigns, customizing ships and fighting large-scale engagements in the Eye of Terror, with improved multiplayer modes.

The player leads a Viking family exiled on a mysterious island, managing resources, health and camp building while exploring 150 areas, making dialogue choices and surviving turn-based crises in a challenging survival management simulation.

A time management game in which the player helps Anna and her husband Bob build their dream farm across more than 60 levels, raising crops and animals, buying upgrades, learning skills, and playing hidden object mini-games.

A short 2D side-scrolling action game made by three university students, retelling the Little Red Riding Hood story with a rewritten plot. Players progress through a roughly twenty-minute adventure featuring two endings, a normal one and a true one.

A strategy game set in the fourth millennium where a crumbling human empire faces restless aliens and a strange invader; as its new leader, you manage colonies, research ships and weapons, forge alliances or wage war, and command real-time ground and space battles.

This action RPG sends players across the Seven Realms to restore order, fighting hordes of monsters in hack-and-slash battles of epic scale. Up to four players can team up online, control numerous heroes with unique abilities, change vocations, and even transform into monsters to defeat looming threats.

Survive a post-apocalyptic collapse alone or in co-op, PvE, and PvP modes by scavenging resources, crafting gear from salvage, building bases, and constructing vehicles. Manage hunger, thirst, temperature, and skills while exploring a desolate world of mutated enemies, radiation zones, and dynamic weather where careless decisions are punished.

Players guide Kora, a pink-haired girl, through a dreamlike world of nightmares using minimalist one-button jump gameplay, solving puzzles and avoiding shadow monsters and bosses to find her sister Lora, with optional co-op and hard mode time challenges across 300 levels.

The player runs a tabletop factory in a living room, organizing the floor, hiring workers, buying machines, and designing production lines to fill client orders. Over 50 products can be built from various materials in an open-ended sandbox, with expansion, day-night cycles, and worker care.

After her father's funeral, Elisabeth follows a black cat into her old house's basement and is plunged into a crayon-illustrated nightmare, guided by a purple demon as she searches for a way out while warned not to grow nostalgic about her time there.

A student secretly writes a risque romcom manga while joining his school's student council, where he discovers the council president is his illustrator. He balances keeping his secret, handling student requests, and dealing with a vice president who opposes his membership, in a comedic school romance.

Players assemble a party of heroes and fight fast tile-based PvP battles, placing fighters onto the battlefield within three-minute matches. Evolving champions, leveling them up, and combining squads builds tactical strength across rankings, tournaments, and a story campaign.

In this time-management game the player helps Katy and Bob return home by mixing cocktails and juices, growing fruits, serving customers, completing extra tasks, and buying artifacts to improve their bar while uncovering why they ended up so far away.

As the Harbinger in a barren, war-ravaged world, the player commands nanites from 'The Ash' to fight ancient golem war machines. Battles blend real-time strategy with card collecting: gather Glyphs into a deck, then deploy units, buildings, and traps on the field in tactical singleplayer and multiplayer matches.

Players join a 1980s hardware startup and design circuits in a hardware design language, building components from multiplexers up to a fully functional CPU, then simulating and verifying each design in an integrated development environment.

A casual mini-game collection with a darkly comedic premise where the only goal is to die, including modes about finding ways to harm yourself and choosing the right tree, presented as an edgy experience for the whole family.

As bouncer Warren Baker at the nightclub The Box, the player decides who enters each night, juggling quirky guests, VIPs, and undercover cops while managing salary and family ties. Choices shape storylines blending comedy and gangster thriller, with occasional punches thrown when diplomacy fails.

As a ruler in a Three Kingdoms setting, players manage cities, officers, and technology while commanding turn-based battles that hinge on terrain, climate, and unit composition. Over 1,300 officers and a relationship system support empire building and scenario editing in a strategic Chinese historical world.

A construction and demolition company simulator where the player uses heavy machines and hand tools to tear down buildings, buy land, hire and manage workers, gather resources and complete contracts across four freely navigable world locations, investing in properties and raising the company's rating.

Players explore a mansion of 1000 rooms, initially facing adorable terror before cute facades dissolve into hideous creatures that must be fled, with HD 3D visuals, VR support, endless mode, and Steam Workshop tools for building custom mansions.

Noda is a 3D spatial tool where players build and connect concept shapes in multidimensional space, using movement and voice to map ideas, collaborate with others in multiplayer, and create mind-maps, storyboards or memory palaces.

Players drop onto large maps, loot weapons and supplies, and fight to be the last survivor as a shrinking safe zone forces confrontations. Matches hinge on choices about where to land, how to gear up, and when to engage opponents in a battle royale.

Players build elemental towers to defend against waves of creeps in this tower defense game, choosing from six elements that determine available towers and combining countless strategies across multiple maps, modes, and difficulty settings while competing on global leaderboards.

Players stretch cute dogs across grid-based levels to reach their food bowls, using portals, rivers, and multiple bowls to solve increasingly tricky puzzles. The tone is lighthearted and charming, with 80 levels ranging from casual to hardcore difficulty.

As recent funeral direction graduate Charlie, the player runs a funeral home, preparing bodies through embalming or cremation, attending funerals, listening to loved ones' stories, and interacting with coworkers and clients in a short story-driven look at the death industry.

A classic 3D real-time strategy game where you command armies of seven factions—Tech, Magic, Egypt, Indians, Norsemen, Persian, or Romans—managing workers, scouts, and over a hundred units across 80+ maps, with strong AI and up to 8-player multiplayer.

Players become a property tycoon in a corrupt city, building houses and factories while managing tenants and sabotaging rival landlords through dirty deals, hired thugs, and gangsters. The tone is darkly comedic, celebrating crime and underhanded tactics as tools for urban domination.

Players control fluffy alpacas in an endless runner-shooter, jumping, dodging, and firing lasers at enemies while chasing high scores and collecting coins to unlock new characters and upgrades across shifting backgrounds.

Based on the board game, players build a prosperous space empire from Earth's former colonies by exploring, developing, settling, trading, producing, and consuming, competing against AI or networked opponents across five starting worlds and ninety cards.

As a commander, players lead Metal Maidens—modified human women in armored attires—in military strategy battles against runaway Beast Tanks in an alternate 194X, while exploring the secrets behind the creatures and interacting with Live2D-animated characters.

Players engage in hardcore tactical modern combat with realistic ballistics, minimal HUD, and precious ammunition, fighting in PvP matches up to 14v14 or cooperative AI missions, where squad coordination, specialized classes, and support strikes determine survival on shifting frontlines.

An auto-running platformer where Meat Boy constantly runs, jumps, punches and kicks through brutal levels to rescue his kidnapped baby Nugget from Dr. Fetus, with thousands of handcrafted level chunks recombined into new layouts on each replay.

Players test their knowledge and intuition by deciding whether a series of surprising statements are true or false, learning odd facts along the way. The quiz sequel offers new questions, Steam trading cards and achievements, and a calm, relaxing soundtrack.

The player explores ancient Egypt from deserts and oases to the Nile and Giza tombs, fighting hostile factions and wild beasts. As an action-RPG, they loot and wield dozens of weapons, develop progression mechanics, and take on powerful bosses while following multiple quests and stories.

Players inhabit any object in the universe, from animals to planets to galaxies, in a procedural AI-driven simulation of natural systems. They transform between forms, explore interconnected inner and outer space without goals or scores, and can let the game generate a narrated documentary about the world.

A simulation in which the player takes the role of a French artist painting and selling original artwork to survive wine and baguette bills, charming subjective art connoisseurs without losing artistic integrity while unlocking fancier galleries and customers in a living puppet-theater art world.

An open-world MMORPG where players create highly customized characters and fight in fast-paced non-target combat, join guilds in large-scale node and siege wars, and pursue life skills like trading, fishing, farming, cooking, and horse training across a vast world.

In post-apocalyptic wastelands, derelict robots band together to defend fragile communities from an otherworldly menace. Players assemble a team from five bot classes with distinct skills and fight a randomly selected boss each playthrough, combining abilities to defeat the evil boss bot and his flunkies.

A fisherman stranded on a mysterious island during a violent storm uncovers the secretive Arque Corporation and its dangerous operations. This first-person adventure mixes environmental storytelling through items, computers, and audio logs with gun and melee combat against threats on the island.

Players lay train tracks across tiny space stations, routing each alien passenger to its own home with only one seat per car, across hundreds of levels. The cute presentation and ambient soundtrack frame a challenging puzzle game about careful planning and spatial logic.

Players work through hundreds of solitaire hands across eight worlds, chaining combos to fill an energy meter and save the faeries, while earning gold to buy powerups and upgrades and raising a faerie pet to repopulate the magical land of Avalon.

A puzzle and shooting game where the player controls zombies, chasing and biting humans while bouncing little zombies through crowds to strike many with one shot. Keeping humans too close is dangerous, so players buy and activate powerful skills from Dr.Dead, including special zombies, infectious viruses, and items.

A turn-based tactical wargame recreating four historical battles around Richmond and Petersburg in the final year of the American Civil War. The player commands infantry, cavalry, artillery, and generals on hex-based battlefields, using terrain, positioning, concentrated fire, and flanking to break enemy lines.

After being forced into a robbery at a London auction house, mathematics student Matt must prove his innocence in this live-action FMV crime thriller. The player makes over 180 timed decisions that branch the story toward one of seven endings, with no pauses or looping footage.

The player guides an elemental firewall—a fire elemental bound with C++ code to protect a network of people and places—as she makes decisions, learns, forms relationships and possibly gains sapience, or instead burns everything down.

A mysterious traveller selling wares is betrayed by a goblin and stranded on cold moors, then finds a lonely church and two nuns; over one windswept night the player uncovers their mystery through choices and branches in this free yuri visual novel.

A kinetic visual novel about Robin Hawkins, a man stuck in a draining job and a failing marriage, who meets a mysterious girl named Bell at night and finds his dreams turning into nightmares. The story is linear with no choices and includes custom art and music.

A minimalist puzzle game built on Lights Out mechanics with hexagonal tiles, where the player switches off all tiles in each handcrafted level using the fewest moves across six chapters, presented with ambient sound and a meditative, distraction-free atmosphere.

A narrative survival game about sailing a small boat away from home across an open world of islands, dragons, and magic, catching fish, casting spells, and meeting ghosts while themes of isolation and depression unfold.

As high school student Kou Tokisaka, the player explores Morimiya City, builds relationships and battles nightmarish monsters in the Eclipse realm, with new scenarios, characters, dungeons and time-attack modes in this action RPG.

A choice-driven role-playing game set in a world split into the realms of Joy and Sorrow, where the player shifts between them, meets different inhabitants and monsters, and makes morally grey decisions that lead to one of five endings through turn-based combat.

A dinosaur survival game set in Hell Creek 66 million years ago, where players control extinct species from hatchling to adult, managing physical needs while avoiding predators and hazards in an open world built on up-to-date scientific knowledge of the ecosystem.

Play with a colorful GPU-driven fluid particle simulation in VR, using tools to pick up, hit, pull, explode, shoot, and paint particles. Customize physics and visuals, place force spheres, save scenes, and watch psychedelic visuals react to your music.

Players act as a god receiving letters from troubled humans, including a lovelorn nerd, a despairing painter, a rookie cop, and a stray cat. By dragging and rearranging sentences within each letter, players rewrite cause and effect, altering fates and triggering butterfly effects across interconnected lives.

A free-to-play local multiplayer brawler for up to four players where competitors stack falling blocks into towers, defend them with special blocks, steal rivals' towers, and hurl boulders or unleash explosions to topple opponents in versus and co-op matches.

Players manage an underground Vault from Vault-Tec, constructing rooms, assigning dwellers to jobs, crafting gear, and matchmaking residents while sending explorers to the post-nuclear surface and defending against threats from outside and within.

As the Reaper working for Death at Apocalypse, Inc., the player sorts clients into Heaven or Hell during a seven-week trial, judging their features under time pressure while handling catastrophes, weekly events, and theme days.

A young trapper skilled with traps meets an archer named Leah in the rural town of Country Ceremo, and together they confront troublemakers, beginning a story set in the peaceful, trade-rich fantasy kingdom of Granfesta.

Trapped deep inside a massive procedurally generated dungeon, the player sneaks and hides from creatures in the darkness, scavenging oil to keep a faint light burning while searching for a way to escape. The experience is intense, immersive horror built around stealth and survival.

After being overthrown in a coup, young king Evan sets out to found a new kingdom, unite his world, and protect its inhabitants from dark forces. The adventure blends animated film-style presentation with character designs by Yoshiyuki Momose and music by Joe Hisaishi.

A historical fantasy visual novel set in Kyoto during the Bakumatsu period, where the player takes the role of Chizuru searching for her father and romancing samurai of the Shinsengumi. Branching narrative choices lead to 30 endings across over 80 hours of story.

A rhythm shooter where the player drives a gundillac down a highway, blasting zombies in time with metal tracks across 24 levels, and can import their own music to design and share custom levels with leaderboards.

Two officers escape a military jail and fight through levels such as jail, forest, beach, and hospital in this platformer-shooter with quest elements, hunting for a key on each stage while fleeing dangerous enemies and defeating powerful bosses, all with plenty of humor.

A cyberpunk narrative game about fate and happiness, in which a bartender and a hacker work to stop a corporation's plan to eliminate negative emotions, using psychological bartending, genetic implant pottery and phone impersonation to gather information and unravel the conspiracy.

A visual novel in which Mariko wakes trapped in an eerie mansion with five strangers who have lost their memories; in a fantasy world of magic and dragons, the player chooses whom to trust, pursuing romance and unlocking multiple routes toward over twenty endings.

A turn-based tactics game in which the player commands mech squads defending civilian cities from the Vek infestation across Corporate-Nation islands, using telegraphed enemy attacks to plan perfect counters and sending help back through time after defeat.

A fast-paced breakfast-themed arcade game where the player guides a toaster around spiky doughnuts and angry forks to toast bread, using coffee and jam boosts to finish levels faster and earn higher scores across many levels and endless courses.

Players design and manage a car factory, laying out production lines, subdividing tasks, researching technology, and cutting costs to compete with multinationals for market share. The tone is analytical and efficiency-focused, aimed at players who enjoy optimization and business simulation.

Players defuse bombs under time pressure by analyzing electronic circuit boards, identifying components, and understanding connections to disable detonators. Cutting the wrong wire or flipping the wrong switch can trigger the bomb, and circuits grow increasingly challenging as logic puzzles.

Players run a dinosaur theme park, designing exhibits with the right biosphere, researching technologies, raising dinosaurs from eggs, and managing staff and guest reviews while containing destructive escapes. The tone is lighthearted tycoon management with chaotic dinosaur mishaps.

Players collect cards featuring characters from several animated comedy shows, combine them into combos and battle through chapters and bosses. The card game includes a multiplayer arena, guilds, limited-time events and hero leveling, all wrapped in a humorous tone.

Players drive a sleepy sloth home through 60 short but tricky stages, honing driving skills and learning each track's multiple routes and moving platforms. The physics-based driving game includes visual car customization, hidden collectibles, ghost replays, and top-10 leaderboards per level.

A calming puzzle game built around the Japanese tradition of raking sand in a zen garden. Each mechanic is simple, but combining them creates challenging levels that reward careful thought, since placing the rake cannot be undone and players must start over.

A turn-based strategy wargame recreating World War II in Europe, where the player commands the Axis or Allies across a hex map, managing each nation's troops, research, industry, diplomacy, and espionage while countering an advanced AI across multiple campaign start dates.

A horror adventure following Lorelai, a young girl whose world is torn apart, as she fights to reclaim what she lost, confronting the horrors of her family home in a psychological thriller with an immersive story, voice acting and a bittersweet ending.

Starting as a student in the 1980s, players develop their own TV series, research new ideas, and grow a studio into a streaming empire. Management of staff, facilities, advertising, and hundreds of setting-and-theme combinations drives this tycoon simulation.

In an oppressive Eastern European regime, the player joins an ally to reach the Red Alliance rebellion and stop Dr. Grey's mind-control experiments, fighting through abandoned streets, snowy mountains, and secret laboratories in a first-person shooter with optional stealth and an arcade mode.

Players hunt monstrous creatures and rival Hunters across ravaged American West landscapes, using sound, weapons, and gear to survive and claim bounties in tense competitive matches, alone or in duos and trios.

Shuyan Saga is a graphic novel whose action scenes become 3D combat, set in an ancient Chinese martial arts fantasy universe. As Shuyan, the player trains in Kung Fu, fights the Guer horde to save the Five Kingdoms, and makes dialogue choices across over 1,400 hand-drawn panels.

Players run their own veterinary practice, building stables, paddocks and shelters, treating, cleaning and feeding animal patients day by day, admitting animals for care, and enjoying relaxed horseback rides along beaches, forests and meadows.

A first-person shooter with roguelite elements in which a redneck tourist wakes mummified in ancient Egypt and fights through randomly generated pyramids full of monsters and bosses, unlocking classes, skills, and permanent upgrades across runs.

Players join Princess Ashe, Vaan, and their companions in a remastered RPG set in the war-torn world of Ivalice, fighting to liberate the kingdom of Dalmasca. The adventure spans hunts, battles, mini-games, and a new Zodiac Job system with improved battle mechanics.

A synchronized-turns world conquest strategy game inspired by classic board games, where players marshal troops, ally with teammates, and capture enemy headquarters across over 100 historical and fantasy maps, with online multiplayer leagues, challenging AI opponents, and a built-in map editor.

A multiplayer survival game of parenting and civilization building where players are born to another player as a mother, live an entire life in one hour, raise babies who are other players, and craft thousands of objects to rebuild civilization from scratch.

A young man with amnesia wakes in a game-like fantasy world and, guided by a mage, learns to fight monsters, complete quests, and investigate attacks on the town of Lightshire. The visual novel parodies JRPG tropes with humor, romance routes, and multiple endings.

Players run a railway company, issuing shares, building tracks, upgrading towns and locomotives, and delivering goods along a changing network to earn money and victory points. The digital adaptation of the board game supports AI opponents, friends, and online multiplayer.

Players memorize each level's rescue plan and race through occupied apartment buildings to save inhabitants, using a minimap to find stairs and the fastest routes. It mixes platforming with memory challenges, supports solo or local split-screen co-op, and presents a humorous retro style with linear level unlocks.

A stealth survival simulator set in a suburban neighborhood where the player controls a rat spreading plague through nine houses, stealing food, smashing objects, avoiding humans and pestmen, and fighting a boss to claim the area as rat paradise.

Captain a spacefaring steam locomotive through a hostile Victorian-tinged cosmos, smuggling souls and bartering for barrels of time while managing crew morale, fuel, supplies, and the captain's nightmares, fighting pirates, imperial agents, and sky monsters in the Fallen London universe.

As a bodiless voice only Shawn can hear, the player guides him through the world of Alterna, where a goddess's gift of Life's Breath powers magic and industry under the Ecclesia's watch. Dialogue choices shape relationships and the story across towns, puzzles, and turn-based battles toward four endings.

A historical 4X strategy game where players lead an empire across multiple generations, marrying for politics, raising heirs, and managing noble families. Recruit famed characters, explore a wilderness of tribes and ruins, and pursue ambitions through thousands of events while building a legacy that outlasts the current ruler.

Players draft cards to build a civilization in fast ten-minute matches, balancing military, economy, culture, and defense against an opponent. Hundreds of cards and twelve characters offer varied tactical paths to victory in single-player challenges or online ranked play.

A management simulation where the player builds and runs an international airport, constructing terminals, runways, and bag systems, hiring staff, signing airline contracts, and scheduling flights. Career and sandbox modes let players chase profitability or design freely while keeping passengers and airlines satisfied.

A comedy RPG where the player is the healer of an inept fantasy adventuring party, keeping health topped up while managing dwindling mana and status effects. Players learn spells, use skill trees, choose a karma alignment, and manage party moods through dialogue.

A 3D digital adaptation of the tile-placement board game Carcassonne, where players draw landscape tiles, place meeples to claim cities, roads, cloisters and fields, and score points as areas complete, with solo play, pass-and-play, and online ranked multiplayer.

A transport strategy game where players run a railway company on procedurally generated maps, laying track over difficult terrain, buying vehicles, managing routes and cargo, and upgrading stations and trains to build a profitable empire across historical eras.

The player builds and manages a pizza franchise empire, choosing recipes, locations, staffing, advertising and pricing while customizing restaurants and contending with gangsters who demand a cut through shady deals and blackmail, with guards and police hired to keep the mob at bay.

A first-person co-op horror game about teenage friends investigating why their town sleepwalks each night and what took their friend. Using drones, noisemakers, and grappling hooks, one to four players outwit adults, gather evidence, and take on procedurally generated missions in a modern neighborhood and its tunnels.

A mission-based strategy game where the player is an ambitious property developer controlling city land, workers, and resources to build high-value residences and businesses by any means necessary, while managing tenants and keeping rivals at bay.

Players rule the Soviet Union during the Perestroyka era, making political and economic decisions through the Council of Ministers and State Planning Committee, pursuing diplomacy or repression, and steering the country toward democracy, dictatorship, or other futures by 1991.

A warrior named Therion returns to the fortress of Valfaris, now corrupted by an arcane evil, and fights through tainted environments with brutal weapons, reducing grotesque enemies and bosses to piles of gibs in a pixel-art action platformer with a metal soundtrack.

An economic simulation where the player builds and runs an aquarium, designing tanks for nearly a hundred marine species, hiring and training staff, researching new animals, and managing finances and guest happiness. A campaign of ten levels teaches the systems, with a sandbox mode for open-ended play.

A racing game in which players drive on raised tracks above a tropical island, tackling roller-coaster layouts, jumps, and slippery surfaces across six game modes. It includes a solo campaign with medals and rankings, online multiplayer, local play, and tools for creating and sharing user-made tracks and videos.

Players fight to save humanity from man-eating Titans, using omni-directional mobility gear to fly through the air, close in on giants, and slice them with sneak and hook-drive attacks. The action game follows the anime's second season with an original sub-story and a customizable soldier.

The player controls demon hunters including Nero, Dante, and V as a demon tree invades Red Grave City. They fight through overrun streets with distinct stylish combat styles, mechanical Devil Breaker arms, and weapons, battling flying and colossal demons and epic bosses to a killer soundtrack.

A survival horror game where detective Sebastian Castellanos enters a nightmarish world to save his daughter, facing disturbing creatures and choosing between crafting traps, sneaking, or fighting with limited ammo.

Players build decks from collected cards and duel characters like Yugi and Kaiba in a digital trading card game, progressing through single-player stage missions and climbing online PvP rankings to become King of Games.

Players pick one of three characters in a broken-down sci-fi world, building separate combat and negotiation decks while taking jobs, making allies, and fighting bosses. Every choice affects factions and outcomes across roguelike runs through hand-illustrated environments.

A heartwarming cat comedy visual novel about two catgirls, Maple and Cinnamon, who help run the patisserie La Soleil. When Maple's dream is shaken, Cinnamon tries to support her, exploring their ambitions and family bonds, with a little ecchi content along the way.

A tower defense strategy game where the player protects a tribe from waves of monsters by blocking roads, placing 24 kinds of defenders, using powers, and teaching over 100 skills across multiple worlds and bosses.

Players lead civilizations through thousands of years of history in a grand strategy wargame, using military tactics and diplomacy to unify or conquer the world. Campaigns span from early civilizations to the far future, with editors for maps, scenarios, flags, and civilizations.

Set in 1999, you play an aspiring corpo-chimp router transferring images bit by bit from server to client using only two buttons, with or without rhythm. Make a single mistake and you're fired, while keeping the slow internet running.

A strategy game set in Prohibition-era Chicago's criminal underworld. Players choose a mob boss, build and manage a criminal empire of speakeasies and casinos, and defend territory from rival gangs in turn-based combat while hustling and intimidating their way to the top.

Players work as hackers in a shared persistent multiplayer world, scanning services, exploiting vulnerable software and using social engineering to break into systems, writing and modifying GreyScript commands, joining guilds, and taking contracts to trace evidence of crimes.

As a deity from a Slavic mythology-inspired pantheon, the player guides a small flock of believers through survival in procedurally generated lands, balancing diplomacy, war, exploration, crafting, and town-building while resolving conflicts through battle, mental, or spiritual challenges, alone or in co-op.

Sitting on the throne of the Varennes Empire, the player controls successive generations of rulers in battle against the Seven Heroes, using weapons and martial arts to learn techniques, form battle formations and grow the empire through a freeform scenario system.

A visual novel following a new incarnation of Mihama Academy, where a diverse group of trained students form an agency called SORD and are sent on dangerous extrajudicial missions for national defense. The story centers on the girls' choices and their fight to survive.

A kinetic visual novel following the SORD team at Mihama Academy as they search for a missing VIP, encountering twin sisters and a daredevil biker while uncovering past secrets, told through linear narrative without branching routes.

As the CEO of a small startup, players build a website to compete with tech giants, developing features, expanding hosting, running marketing campaigns, hiring and keeping employees happy, and choosing offices while growing toward industry dominance.

Players explore a remote magic-filled island, shaping its destiny through diplomacy, deception, stealth or combat while befriending or betraying factions and companions, and customizing a character's abilities and spells in a story-driven roleplaying journey.

EXA is a virtual-reality environment where players compose music by striking responsive shapes called ringers, record loops, design custom instruments and perform for audiences. It supports importing sounds and building virtual bands, aimed at creative experimentation rather than combat.

A young queen flees her war-torn kingdom and seeks allies across new lands, commanding armies in retro turn-based battles while players build custom maps, campaigns and cutscenes and share them online.

A free open-source rhythm game client for osu! standard beatmaps, focused on practice with customizable options, beatmap overrides, speed sliders, quicksave scrubbing, experimental mods, VR and first-person modes, and offline profiles.

Pale, a shunned goat herder, once drove the Toymaker up his mountain as a child; now strange things stir as midwinter approaches. Players traverse a dark, twisted world, fight creatures of darkness and light, assign classes to followers and make choices that shape an ever-changing story where anyone can die.

Svart Alfheim and the Accelerated World merge, and Yui goes missing. Kirito must defeat the Seven Kings of pure color to reach her. Players recruit characters from both anime series, use flight, magic, sword skills, and hyper jumps in aerial combat, and can join four-player online multiplayer modes.

Set at the beginning of the Star Ocean series, this action RPG follows humanity's search for a new home after World War III devastates Earth. Players explore the galaxy, meet alien races, and fight real-time battles across mysterious worlds, now remastered in 4K and Full HD.

Realm Grinder is a deep idle RPG where players grow a kingdom from a single farm into a vast realm, choosing among factions like elves and demons and investing in upgrades, buildings, and spells. Progress continues offline, with research, reincarnations, and achievements unlocking over months of play.

A story-driven tactical stealth game set in the Wild West, where John Cooper and four companions use distinct skills to plan and execute missions against enemies, choosing between non-lethal and deadly approaches across frontier towns, swamps, and cities on a quest for redemption.

A high school student's ordinary life with his girlfriend is upended when a bus ride from Alpaca Kingdom leaves him beside a talking alpaca that sounds exactly like her, prompting him to unravel the mystery behind the transformation and the theme park's connection.

The player manages a simulated YouTube career, recording videos, upgrading camera and editing gear, reading subscriber comments, accepting donations, and courting promotions from other creators while avoiding drama that can cost subscribers. Progress unfolds through chosen content paths and comparisons with friends' channels.

Players compete in fast-paced arena shooter matches, mastering sixteen Champions with unique abilities and a devastating arsenal including rocket launchers and railguns, across classic modes like Deathmatch, Duel, and Capture the Flag with signature rocket jumping and speed.

As the sole survivor of Vault 111, the player explores a post-nuclear wasteland in virtual reality, fighting for survival while using reimagined combat, crafting and building systems to rebuild and decide the fate of the Wasteland.

As the Dragonborn, the player explores the full open world of Skyrim in virtual reality, battling ancient dragons and traversing rugged mountains. The complete epic fantasy game and its official add-ons are reimagined with immersive scale and depth for VR.

Players guide seven monster-wrestling heroes through six historical time periods to stop the villainous Dr. Cube, touching enemies on the map to trigger turn-based battles. The 16-bit styled RPG mixes exploration, side quests, and hero-specific map abilities with a funky soundtrack.
