Players attend a raucous house party hosted by eccentric characters, navigating branching conversations and choices that shape the night. Exploring a two-story house full of interactive items, they pursue NPC storylines and relationships in a comedic sandbox adventure with no true ending.

Players join a necromancer named Bob and his evil cohorts to wreak havoc across the kingdom of Goodlandia, tapping to build power and conscripting zombies and monsters to work idle-style. The clicker game involves pillaging towns, unlocking skills, and embracing comedic villainy while progressing automatically.

Margaret Dawson joins her father at an Egyptian tomb excavation and uncovers oddities, hidden motives, and deadly threats. This visual novel blends mystery, adventure, and romance, letting the player pursue three men or a priestess, or side with the villain, across multiple endings.

A short visual novel in which a young nymph named Pumpkin, heartbroken by one-sided love for her mistress, ventures through a magical forest of talking animals and creatures to gather ingredients for a love potion, with humor, ecchi content and multiple endings.

A World War 2 real-time strategy game where the player commands Russian, German, French, American and British armies across large-scale battles including urban warfare, beach landings and aerial invasions, with up to a thousand units per scenario and destructible terrain.

A biomedical simulator where the player either engineers a lethal illness to torment a victim or leads a medical team to diagnose and cure a patient. Across two campaigns and many cases, players combine diseases, symptoms and treatments with timing and strategy.

A World War II real-time strategy game where players command German, Russian, British, American, and Imperial Japanese armies across global battlefields. It adds Pacific campaigns, battleships, landing craft, trains, aircraft deployment, individual vehicle crews, dynamic weather, and a map editor for custom missions.

The player commands joint naval, land, and airborne forces across large 3D maps in a World War 2 real-time strategy campaign, managing over 300 historically reproduced units and using realistic line-of-sight and projectile simulation to win battles for five different armies.

Lead a band of heroes through a witty parody fantasy campaign, fighting turn-based tactical battles on procedurally generated maps where trees and boulders become weapons. Build a base, gather resources, choose among four factions and classes, and grow heroes with new traits and cross-class skills across story and skirmish modes.

Players take on BJ Blazkowicz in a first-person shooter, fighting Nazi soldiers across occupied America, recruiting resistance leaders, wielding high-tech guns and new abilities, and blasting through legions of enemies in a hyper-violent campaign to liberate the country.

A turn-based strategy game set on the Russian front of the Second World War, where the player commands German or Soviet forces in hex-based tactical combat across increasingly complex missions. Objectives range from wiping out the enemy to capturing key points, protecting supply convoys and building bridges, with over 110 historical units.

Players place arrows to guide DiceMice safely to the mousehole while naive BlobCats roll around and threaten them, solving over ninety levels across five worlds with unique twists. Local and online multiplayer for up to four players has them competing to save the most mice and sabotage opponents.

A retro 2D turn-based pixel-art RPG where players create a party of six adventurers and explore a non-linear world with no level cap, side quests, shops, and many items and enemies, fighting rats in cellars and other monsters in the style of 80s RPGs.

Players guide Crono and companions across eras from prehistory to the far future, using Active Time Battle and combo Tech moves to save the planet, in an upgraded version of the classic RPG with added dungeons.

Players build, manage, and maintain a dream zoo, choosing from nearly 200 animals and detailed environments. They design roads and enclosures, complete campaign scenarios around the world, and can build and share zoos with up to four players.

Players take the role of supernatural assassin Billie Lurk, reuniting with her mentor Daud to hunt and kill the Outsider, sneaking or fighting through the city of Karnaca's fight clubs and cults using powers, gadgets and weapons, with choices shaping the story.

The player manages a steam train through randomly generated levels that shift from relaxing to hectic, using strategy to keep pace in night, day, and hardcore modes, with stylized low-poly graphics and touch or gyroscope controls suited to short sessions.

Players explore a text-based medieval fantasy realm, building characters, forging artifacts, sailing, and constructing cities while trading with others in a player-driven economy. The persistent world features guilds, races, quests, mounts, familiars, and a detailed combat system across hundreds of zones.

As one of the last humans, the player explores dynamically generated post-apocalyptic worlds and alternate realms, fighting monstrous creatures and bosses alone or with two co-op partners. Scavenged loot and materials upgrade weapons and armor to push back the ancient evil.

A party of champions climbs a tower where technology and magic collide, uncovering the history of Artara through lore and cinematics. Combat is tactical and real-time with pause or slow-time, and players develop classes, skills, and loot across hand-crafted levels and many bosses.

Players assemble animated video jigsaw puzzles featuring Japanese women in kimono, yukata, and hot springs, choosing from three piece counts and background colors. Pieces snap into place, edges can be separated, and progress saves mid-puzzle for a stress-free, casual experience.

A free-to-play turn-based tactical card fighter where players collect and upgrade martial arts technique cards, build fighting decks, and battle online opponents using Chi strikes and Dim Mak techniques. Real-time attacking and defensive mechanics produce detailed injuries and varied KO types.

A racing game featuring small cars on challenging tracks. Players compete against three opponents in arcade races, race solo in time trials, or play split-screen multiplayer with a friend across seventeen tracks with night, fog, and rain conditions.

A 3D dungeon crawler RPG in which the player creates and raises a party from sixteen occupations and nine races, explores labyrinth-like dungeons, fights monsters and follows events while questing to find the five rings.

A traditional farming and dating RPG where players run a farm, grow over 90 crops, fish, cook, raise and breed animals, and catch bugs. Players choose among three towns, meet over 100 characters, date and marry without gender restrictions, and either help stop a corporation or side with it.

Players take the role of a coder whose cat excels at machine learning, building flowcharts from blocks like decision trees and neural networks to construct a cat-to-human translator. Puzzles teach real AI concepts while players take freelance jobs, buy hardware, gamble on startups and dress up the cat.
A match-3 puzzle game set in a spring countryside where the player helps cute animal friends and the Easter Bunny melt winter away, clearing 100 levels with rainbow bonuses in relaxed or timed modes.

A first-year student at a mountain academy accidentally breaks a statue and is forced to join the school's Bureau for Special Affairs, where magic and a night realm merge with the school. He investigates supernatural incidents and troublesome magical items across a branching visual novel storyline.

Command Viking, Anglo-Saxon, German, or Slav armies through medieval Europe in a real-time strategy campaign, raiding enemy settlements and managing temporary bases. Tactical use of terrain, morale, and squad-based battles decides victory, with a cinematic camera and multiplayer battles.

Players assemble jigsaw puzzles from hand-drawn indie-game artworks, either alone or in co-op and versus multiplayer matches against friends and Steam leaderboard rivals. The game includes chat, achievements, and trading cards, mixing relaxed group puzzling with competitive contests.

Players solve nearly 100 hand-crafted sliding puzzles by moving invisible boxes around obstacles, using a helper power-up to briefly reveal them. The minimalist presentation and short tutorial support relaxed, memory-training play, with a three-star rating and tough final levels.

Players slash incoming blocks in time with music, ducking and dodging through handcrafted levels in virtual reality. A large song library, multiple difficulties, modifiers, and solo, party, campaign, and online modes let players chase leaderboard ranks.

A challenging single-player puzzle game where the player acts as an operator maintaining a virtual system, programming units with a simple graphical language to fight automatically, and uncovering a secret behind a program anomaly.

A simulation game where players run their own PC building and repair business, completing customer jobs while balancing the books. Players assemble PCs from licensed real-world components, customize cooling and lighting, benchmark builds, and overclock them.

Players take on the 2017 World Rally Championship, driving officially licensed cars from manufacturers like Hyundai, Toyota, Citroën, and Ford across 13 countries and 52 special stages. The game offers realistic physics, long endurance stages, local split-screen multiplayer, and weekly online challenges.

A dark comedic turn-based tactics game where the player commands the native insectoid Swarmers defending their homeworld from a dysfunctional human energy corporation. Players possess workers, set traps, ambush from vents, and consume human corpses to convert into new specialized alien units across a single-player campaign.

Players guide a nameable protagonist through a boarding school, managing her reputation while chasing jerky love interests, arranging dates, working part-time jobs, and choosing among multiple boyfriends in a free-to-play dating sim with hundreds of events.

The player joins Charlemagne and other Servants in a virtual lunar world, battling rogue programs and rival Servants in high-speed hack-and-slash combat. Team mechanics, changing battlefield conditions, and online 4-on-4 matches drive the action.

A management simulation about producing, breeding and selling marijuana in America, covering the financial, political and cultural sides of the business. Players cultivate and cross-breed plants, hire staff, manage distribution, bribe officials or fight for legalization, with scenarios, a sandbox mode and a Chill Mode.

Battle Chess brings the game of chess to life with animated medieval pieces that fight when one captures another. Players can face the computer across ten difficulty levels or play against friends, watching knights and soldiers battle on the checkered board.

A remastered off-road racing game where players drive over 160 sponsored trucks and buggies across 1,000 miles of harsh terrain, competing in hill climbs, circuit races, and long endurance events while managing vehicle damage and upgrades.

A family-friendly solitaire and Match 3 game where players use sugary ammo to fend off zombies, progressing through over 100 levels with power-ups, wildcards, and wacky multiple-choice adventures whose decisions shape the story.

Players continue a comedic escape from a zombie apocalypse that leads to Egypt, solving solitaire levels, match-3 duels, and time management battles while making multiple-choice decisions and using sweets and power-ups to fend off zombies.

A physics-based obstacle course game where the player controls a humanoid robot by switching between full-body animations, balancing gravity and mass to finish timed levels, earn medals, and unlock upgrades, with later levels featuring a robot dog.

The player pilots one of seven ships for the Bastards Federation, chasing dragons who fled with the Elixir supply through procedurally generated sector boards, fighting hordes in fast turn-based battles inspired by shmups and tactics games. Ships can be equipped and upgraded between jumps.

Players lead a team of imprisoned space-criminals as gladiators on prison planet Cerberus 7 in turn-based tactical battles, customizing fighters with crafted weapons, bionic limbs, and mutations, and competing in a solo campaign or multiplayer matches with three win conditions.

Two young girls watching summer fireworks are separated when darkness falls and something attacks them in their hometown. The player guides each girl through the night, hiding from ghouls behind bushes and signs, using found items to solve puzzles and distract enemies, and reading notes that hint at deeper horrors.

In a Japan where countless goddesses have descended to live among humans, the protagonist takes in a mischievous Aragami goddess who causes power outages, helping her rehabilitate while the story unfolds in a quiet Tokyo suburb.

Players type words to cast spells at monsters in a mashup of word game and action RPG. Longer words produce bigger attacks, and gold collected from slain foes buys wands, hats, robes, and consumable items to survive increasingly challenging levels and boss encounters up the tower.

Players tackle 3D platforming courses built around movement disciplines like surfing, bunnyhopping and long jumps, racing to beat each map in the fastest time with optional checkpoints. Maps range from rural to surreal, and multiplayer modes include tag arena and co-op.

After his mother's death, a man returns to Wales for her funeral and befriends a mysterious, cold young girl during a countryside walk, uncovering questions about how she knew his mother, her fascination with death, and her resemblance to his childhood sweetheart in this visual novel.

Trapped in underground villages with no memory of the surface, players explore an ever-changing labyrinth in tactical turn-based combat, choosing among twelve jobs and over a hundred skills while collecting items and capturing monsters as pets.

A strategy board game adaptation where players govern one of twenty factions, transforming the landscape to build structures while balancing proximity to rivals. It emphasizes luck-free tactical depth, includes the Fire & Ice add-on, and offers tutorials, replays, and multiplayer against friends or players worldwide.

Kai's childhood friend and tomboy neighbor Chris moves in while her parents are overseas and begins pursuing him, just as his crush Sophie enters the picture amid rumors. Players make choices across a romantic visual novel with two romanceable girls and five endings.

A puzzle platformer in which the player switches between 2D and 3D at will to traverse obstacles and solve puzzles across multiple worlds, collecting crystals with the help of a cheeky fairy guide while searching for a way home.

A Birdling taught to kill humans fails to kill a human child named Tayo, and the two become friends despite their species' hostility. The story follows both characters from childhood to adolescence across 21 decisions and five possible endings.

Players control a shark pup in an open world, eating wildlife and humans to grow and evolve into a massive apex predator while seeking revenge on the fisherman who dismembered them, all framed as a narrated reality TV show across Gulf regions.
A collection of three stylish action games following devil hunter Dante as he battles demons, featuring fast-paced combat, new moves and styles, and bonus modes across the original trilogy.

A couch co-op puzzle game where two players manipulate shadow and light, blocking streams for each other and juggling mass to grow large enough to cross barriers. Teamwork, timing and tactics drive progress through abstract worlds, with solo twin-stick play and online co-op also supported.

The four Goddesses enter an online fantasy game world modeled on themselves, choosing from twelve characters with distinct playstyles. Players fight real-time hack-and-slash brawls in four-person dungeon raids, map skills to buttons for flashy Awakening attacks, dress characters in cosmetic gear, and can team up online with up to three others.

The player is a detective in the city of Revachol, using a 24-skill system and a revolutionary dialogue system to interrogate characters, crack a murder case, or take bribes. Choices, clothing, thoughts, and substances shape whether they become a hero or a disaster.

A remastered 1998 story-driven first-person shooter set in a near-future dystopia, where security consultant Colonel John R. Blade takes on Doctor Elexis Sinclaire and her army of genetically engineered mutants. Players hack terminals, use vehicles, and make choices that create branching paths.

Players control Rosemary Reed investigating a girl's disappearance at Richard Felton's house, where the dread begins as she evades a stalker through stealth, hiding, and strategic combat in a realistic survival horror experience with film-like narration and psychological twists.

Players live as a feral cat in an open wilderness, hunting prey, fighting rival colonies, befriending or romancing other cats, raising kittens, exploring caves for treasure, and customizing their den and coat in a light survival RPG.

An action game in which the player helps Himari hold out against ambushes as long as possible, attacking enemies and casting magic while maintaining her health and chaining combos to grow stronger, with unlockable characters, online scoreboards and terrifying bosses.

On the dying colony world of New Providence, orphaned Rose and a team of mismatched heroes fight corrupt forces and marauders using a tactical puzzle grid where matching tiles powers combat abilities, across a narrative-driven sci-fi RPG campaign of betrayal and insurrection.

A gothic fairy tale action RPG following Aluche and her battle party as they journey to defeat the Moon Queen, fighting demons and recruiting Servans that transform into weapons to aid in close and long-range combat.

A prince and his friends embark on a road trip across a vast open world to reclaim their homeland, battling foes with warping, weapons, magic, and team attacks, with bonus episodes and a multiplayer expansion included.

Act as a mountain resort engineer building chairlifts, gondolas, jumps, and bridges across over 100 physics-based puzzle levels, then ride the slopes in winter and summer sports. Manage budgets and rope tensions while passengers reach destinations, with sandbox building and replay sharing.

A dungeon RPG following Io, a young man who cannot talk to women, as he ventures into Monstopia where rampaging Monster Girls must be fought, recruited and purified, building relationships through events and gifts to strengthen a five-person party.

Players act as a corporate CEO building a business empire in a detailed economic simulation, making decisions across manufacturing, marketing, research, retail, and real estate while hiring executives, developing technology, trading stocks, and pursuing mergers to grow a conglomerate.

As the Elder, you lead a handful of villagers into an empty valley and build a town before a foretold apocalypse arrives. Turns are spent assigning workers to farm, craft, and produce resources while the Domains unleash escalating disasters each round.

Sword Art Online Re: Hollow Fragment casts players as Kirito exploring the floors of Aincrad from the town of Ark Sophia toward the 100th floor and the Hollow Area, fighting enemies in active strategic battles and chatting with companion characters in real time.

Players work through over 125 logic and puzzle trials in a training course, using tools and developing skills to overcome obstacles and make discoveries. The description frames the experience as a test of outside-the-box thinking, with proceeds donated to anti-racism charities.

Players explore and conquer the contested Stolen Lands in an isometric RPG, building a kingdom while dungeon crawling, managing diplomacy, and shaping companions with differing agendas. Character customization spans many classes, spells, and feats drawn from the Pathfinder tabletop rules.

Trials Rising is a physics-driven motorcycle racing game where players ride over-the-top tracks set in locations around the world, compete against opponents online, share a tandem bike with friends, and create and share custom levels using a large item library.

The player runs a fully equipped professional kitchen, preparing over 80 recipes from 140 ingredients with physics-driven tools, either building a restaurant career through skill and timing or freely experimenting in a sandbox where dishes, knives and ovens can be flung, burned and blown up.

Players live inside strict prison routines by day while secretly crafting tools, digging tunnels, and engineering elaborate escape plans. Escapes span multiple prisons and can be planned solo or with up to three friends in co-op or versus modes, with a prison map editor for building custom facilities.

A voxel and physics-based puzzle game in which the player destroys abstract figures, discovering the rules without tutorials and triggering mesmerizing gravity-driven displays across levels designed to surprise and enchant.

A serene first-person exploration game in which a colorful, psychedelic world of flora, waterfalls and creatures grows around the player. There is no clock or danger; players wander at their own pace through a procedurally populated forest, observing animals and monoliths while a dynamic soundtrack responds to their journey.

Players fill grids using numeric hints to reveal pixel-art illustrations in this collection of nonogram logic puzzles. Three modes include Classic with 240 puzzles, procedurally generated Time Trials, and Mosaic, where solving tiles unveils large hidden images, alongside an editor and Workshop support.

As a gifted child, the player switches through every television channel on the planet in a small game inspired by nostalgia and the Stroop test, featuring simple gameplay, unusual achievements, multiple modes and secrets, and an immersive soundtrack.

A tower-defense game where the player commands orcs, demons and undead to defend magical gems from invading heroes. Players build and upgrade monstrous towers along paths, unlock spells such as meteors, and replay 24 levels in a darker Night Mode for extra challenge across a lush fantasy world.

Alphabear is a word puzzle game where the player spells words from adjacent letters on a grid, causing bears to grow and score points. Collected bears act as powerups in later games, and this premium edition adds a companion dictionary, prestige replay and daily boards.

Players act as masked Lords of Waterdeep, recruiting adventurers and assigning agents to complete quests over eight rounds. They buy buildings, play Intrigue cards to help or hinder rivals, and compete for influence against AI or up to five human players online.

A dark visual novel following high schooler Ren Fujii in 2006 Japan as supernatural violence shatters his ordinary life, entwined with a 1945 ritual in collapsing Germany, told through poetic dialogue and thrilling battles.

Players command Allied forces on the Western Front of World War II, from the 1943 invasions of Sicily and Italy through France and into Germany. This detailed wargame models land battles, strategic bombing, logistics, weather fronts, and an enormous hex map, letting players refight the campaign by their own plan.

Fortress of Hell is a dark role-playing game in which the player leads one of up to four parties through a monster-filled fortress, fighting countless enemies and bosses to free prisoners including the protagonist's girlfriend, with visible encounters, character customization and multiple story paths.

A real-time strategy game set in a distant future where players build and manage human colonies after a zombie apocalypse. They construct fortifications, gather resources, research technologies, and command armies against massive swarms of infected, with a campaign and randomized survival mode.

Players run an expanding auto repair shop, diagnosing and fixing randomly generated car jobs with dozens of tools and over a thousand parts, painting and tuning vehicles, hunting barn finds and junkyard wrecks, and testing cars on tracks while growing the business.

In a ruined far-future Earth where humanity entrusted its life cycle to a massive machine called Basel, mercenaries fight through a story about fate and the world's end. Players engage in fast-paced aerial gun battles combining strategy with thrills, remastered in 4K/HD.

A pixelated point-and-click adventure aboard a scientific spaceship where a lazy engineer and a secretive robot solve puzzles, uncover the mystery of a vanished crew, and encounter time travel and parallel universes, with a humorous storyline and a hint system.

Alicia Quatermain, granddaughter of explorer Allan Quatermain, travels distant lands to uncover why her father vanished and to find her grandfather's lost treasure. Players help companions, solve puzzles and avoid villains' traps across the world.

As an incarnation of Horus, the player guides ancient Egyptian pharaohs through unification, wars, crises, and pyramid construction between 3500 and 2140 B.C. The game blends city management, technology research, diplomacy, and historical events across the first six dynasties.

This VR music experience presents the idol group Hop Step Sing! performing their second single, kiss×kiss×kiss, in a castle setting. Viewers watch Niina, Mikasa, and Shikiri sing and dance in 3D animation rather than playing a game.

Players climb an ever-changing Spire in a single-player deckbuilder, collecting hundreds of cards and powerful relics, choosing risky or safe paths, and fighting bizarre creatures and bosses across randomized runs with four distinct characters.

A classic-style real-time strategy game where players command over fifty unit types in large-scale battles, build custom scenarios in a sandbox editor, and compete or cooperate in online multiplayer matches with replays and shared unit control.

An arcade futuristic racer where players pilot ships at extreme speeds through loops and twists, mastering boost and drift, while building and sharing their own tracks with a powerful editor and competing on global leaderboards.

Players manage operations across the Muertes archipelago, bioengineering dinosaurs with unique traits and behaviors, building facilities for science, entertainment or security, and handling challenges on the ground and in the air while expanding islands through a narrative campaign.

The player navigates a generation ship on a centuries-long voyage to a distant planet, negotiating among contentious factions after a mutiny. Choices determine allies and enemies in this isometric, party-based RPG set in a decaying spacecraft society.

Up to eight players use their smartphones to compete in a massive trivia contest hosted by Salli, an AI quiz host, answering questions across films, music, books, and games in various modes, with support for streaming to large audiences.

Stranded on a small raft in a vast ocean, players hook floating debris, gather resources and expand their floating home while fending off a man-eating shark. Alone or in co-op, they sail to islands, dive for supplies, farm and uncover a story.

A 3D visualization tool that renders vast four-dimensional objects driven by whatever music the player is listening to. Players run their own music app and watch trippy, defocused visuals, using it to zone out and relax rather than to play a conventional game.

As a cybernetic survivor activated after a demonic invasion of a Martian UAC facility, the player fights through intense first-person VR combat and puzzle-solving, using teleportation and jet-strafe movement to reach Hell itself.

A turn-based strategic artillery game set on a cosmic scale, where the player develops a home planet's infrastructure, gathers resources, researches futuristic technology and spies on rivals. Railguns, missiles and beam weapons are aimed across the planetary system, accounting for gravity and celestial bodies, in hotseat, online or AI skirmish matches.

Warbanners is a turn-based tactical strategy game with RPG elements in which the player manages a mercenary squad across a 42-mission fantasy campaign, hiring and equipping soldiers, using assistants for bonuses, and exploiting terrain, lighting, morale, and fatigue to win battles and become a legend.

Players gather materials from the world, drop them into a cauldron, and craft golems to fend off angry mobs within a one-minute time limit, all framed by a visual-novel story with humor and secrets to uncover.

A vertically scrolling shoot'em up set in a 19th-century world facing a robot rebellion, where players battle through seven stages and over ten bosses. Characters gain randomly generated abilities that shape each run, with leaderboards, replays, and local co-op supporting the arcade-style action.

Players fly vintage WW1 and WW2 aircraft in large online multiplayer dogfights and bomber raids, and also fight on land and at sea with tanks and boats, joining historical scenarios and air races in a persistent 24-hour war.

A digital adaptation of the solitaire card game Onirim, where the player is a dream walker lost in a mysterious labyrinth. By playing matching color cards or discarding keys, they collect eight dream doors before the deck runs out, while avoiding nightmare cards that force painful choices.

The player reclaims a derelict precursor starbase on the edge of Terran space and rebuilds it to research technologies, explore star systems and forge alliances against an approaching alien invasion. Base building, ship customization and tactical space combat drive a streamlined campaign.
An endless flag-identifying quiz game featuring over 650 world flags, with training minigames, a relaxed practice mode, and a timed endless mode where correct answers raise the score and difficulty.

A fantasy puzzle game where the player helps the queen of darkness recover four stolen Elemental eggs across 200 magic levels, defeating enemies with spells, earning gold to restore the world of Lumina, and solving point-and-click and hidden-object scenes.

A girl named Zee follows a squirrel through a portal into mirrored dimensions and must escape by choosing, rotating and dropping blocks whose reflections obey gravity, solving puzzles across 77 levels while avoiding the pool between realms.

As an East India Company insurance investigator in 1807, players board the derelict merchant ship Obra Dinn, which drifted into port with no crew. Through first-person exploration and logical deduction, they reconstruct the fates of the lost sailors in a minimal-color mystery adventure.

A VR world-building sandbox where you construct miniature worlds using thousands of objects like roads, buildings, and people across themes such as town, farm, and maritime, with intuitive gesture controls, articulated characters for posing, photo capture, and sharing features.

A competitive split-screen vertical shoot 'em up where players battle rivals head-on and transform into a gigantic Mega Gunship boss form to invade the opponent's screen, with multiple heroes, local and online versus battles, unlockable gear, and a single-player arcade mode.

The player creates a dad character and romances one of several dateable dads in the seaside town of Maple Bay, choosing dialogue and activities across dates. Minigames, sidequests, and multiple endings support a lighthearted, pun-filled dating sim.

The player guides a cube to the finish across 60 increasingly difficult levels using four directional inputs, navigating angular cubes and teleports in a minimalist puzzle presentation with smooth animation and pleasant music.

As caretaker of a colony ship fleeing a collapsing sun, the player uses cards to explore space, manage discovered planets, technology, and awakening colonists, building a new home for humanity in short strategic runs with unlockable cards, races, and procedural maps.

A realistic motocross simulator built on a detailed physics engine, letting players race online or over LAN with customizable bikes and gear, dynamic and wet terrain, and support for VR and head-tracking hardware.

John, a young man with severe depression, meets Lizzie, an affectionate but violent and unstable girl, and the player's choices shape both characters' mental states and their fates. This psychological thriller visual novel explores their psyches, with outcomes ranging from rejection and despair to violence or possible happiness.

A digital adaptation of a card-driven area control board game where 2-5 players pick cards to gain resources and take actions, spreading across a map to control regions and continents for points in quick matches.

Players control their own hands via keyboard and mouse across many levels, attempting awkward tasks like spinning fidget spinners, handling weapons, milking a cow, fishing, playing chess, or dueling in multiplayer. Clumsy physics-driven manipulation is the core challenge and comedy.

A toy train set builder where you lay track, build bridges and towns in a sandbox, then ride your train in first-person, customizing worlds, trains, and scenery from countryside to desert and foggy industry.

A boys' love visual novel parodying spy fiction, following Keegan, a young aspiring super villain, as his first heist is interrupted by spies from rival agencies, with two romanceable characters and branching endings that can stay comedic or turn serious.

Players race and battle in last-car-standing vehicular combat across preset or procedurally generated tracks, choosing from over 60 customizable game modes for one to four players in local competitive couchplay. The tone is chaotic, fast-paced and community-driven.

Follow Alvar, Landric, and Valerie as they bumble their way toward restoring a fallen dragon and stopping another dragon-god from destroying mankind. The RPG offers dungeon puzzles, over a hundred abilities to find and master, and equipment-based ability swapping with minimal grinding.

A romantic comedy visual novel following two protagonists, Tohru and Naoki, each caught in their own light-hearted love triangle at a Japanese academy, with voiced dialogue, branching paths and CG and music galleries.

A role-playing game following Hinako Shirai, a student recovering from a leg injury who gains the power to become a Reflector. Players balance ordinary school life, building friendships and taking missions, with excursions into the Common to search for items and fight, eventually confronting Sephira to save the world and realize her wish.

As a baseball general manager, the player builds a lineup through trades, contracts, and drafts, manages finances like ticket prices and broadcast rights, and can simulate or control each pitch across seasons spanning decades of team history.

Players compete in real-time online drift racing against others or ghost recordings, driving one of 20 cars across 12 real-world tracks. The simulator offers detailed physics, extensive tuning of engines, suspension, and tires, plus weather and time-of-day settings that affect handling.

A visual novel with multiple routes centered on Minakami Yuki and a town ritual of offerings to the sky, tied to the Summer Triangle and the meeting of world and sky. The story follows Yuki and three other characters searching for that place, with upgraded high-resolution artwork.

An off-road racing simulation covering rally, rallycross, drift, buggy, and hillclimb disciplines across continents and extreme conditions. Players drive over fifty legendary vehicles, upgrade and customize them in career mode, and race online or in split-screen multiplayer.

Players join a shadowy club and spy on strangers through surveillance cameras from a run-down apartment, deciding whether to interfere with the subjects' lives, extort them, or follow the rules. A darkly comic simulation about voyeurism and moral choices.

Start as a janitor in a persistent Vegas-themed online world and work up to casino mogul by completing missions, playing slots, poker, blackjack and roulette, and buying land to build and manage your own player-designed casinos alongside thousands of others.

As security engineer James Garner, the player decrypts Mantis Corp. files containing a strange chat, uncovering a love story and a conspiracy. The non-linear story-driven puzzle game mixes Sudoku and Minesweeper-style logic across roughly fifty levels.

Players command historically accurate armies in turn-based tactical battles set during the Rise of Rome from 280 BC to 25 BC, fighting historical scenarios or custom what-if battles against AI or human opponents with 86 unit types and varied tactical doctrines.

The player presses keyboard or mouse keys to raise and lower historically accurate computer progress bars at their own pace, or races friends and Twitch chat to fill bars fastest. It is a deliberately absurd, comedic single and multiplayer game about the humble progress bar.

A cooperative card game adaptation of the Dresden Files novels where players control Harry Dresden and his allies to solve cases from the first five books. It supports one to five players in what-if scenarios, plus a random scenario generator based on the Side Jobs short stories.

This poker simulation lets players compete in Texas Hold'em against a neural-network AI or online opponents across single-player, tournament, LAN, and internet modes, with adjustable limits, tables, chips, tutorials, and beginner tips for newcomers learning the rules.

A glitch fantasy roguelike adventure about cute monsters and a suspiciously talkative narrator. Players pick randomized characters, battle through procedurally generated forests, deserts, and dungeons in turn-based combat, craft gear, and die often while trying to purge the land of evil.

Players breed, feed, and care for an army of beetles in a nest, using a genetics simulation to shape traits, then send them into real-time tactical campaign missions to conquer an abandoned lot and gather resources.

A classic MMORPG set in an elegant medieval Europe-inspired world where players control up to three characters at once, exploring hundreds of areas, completing thousands of quests, and fighting in real-time faction wars and PvP battles.

A fast-paced time management adventure from ancient Greece in which Hercules helps Jason build the Argo, sail treacherous seas, solve puzzles, and steal the Golden Fleece, with bonus levels, achievements, and a lighthearted story aimed at casual strategy fans.

A multiplayer business dice board game for two to eight players where participants trade lands, build houses, win auctions, spin a wheel of fortune and risk Russian Roulette, aiming to gain monopoly and bankrupt opponents across online, solo, pass-and-play and LAN modes.

Players solve relaxing yet challenging puzzles by connecting same-colored, same-numbered squares to reveal pixel art images. The game offers multiple modes including normal, jigsaw, challenge, and random puzzles, plus a level editor that lets players create pixel art, generate puzzles, and share them with others through Steam Workshop.

Players take the virtual stage to perform stand-up comedy or songs for a live audience in user-generated rooms, or join the crowd to vote performers off and heckle them. Avatars can be customized, and dual-mic rooms allow collaboration or head-to-head competition.

A customizable physics sandbox where players use hundreds of weapons, tools and powers to mutilate disposable ragdolls, destroy items, and build contraptions from over 2000 customizable objects, linking triggers and buttons to create traps and experiments.

A historically accurate strategy game recreating the three-day Battle of Gettysburg and related engagements, letting players command Civil War units, artillery, cavalry, and generals across detailed scenarios with tactical features like flank attacks, formations, and day-night cycles.

A quirky visual novel in which the player takes the role of an underwater detective solving baffling cases for eccentric clients while romancing a shark girl, presented with vibrant cartoon graphics and irreverent, immature humour across short-play stories.

Players manage a prehistoric zoo, incubating and releasing over fifty extinct species from mammoths to dinosaurs while keeping guests, staff, and animals satisfied. They design parks with creative terrain tools, place infrastructure, and can explore their creations in first-person mode.

A fast-paced simulation-strategy game where players drop a virus into populations, splice DNA to unlock mutating zombies, and spread destruction across a world map of over 200 levels before humanity develops a cure.

An air traffic control simulation where the player guides incoming planes to runways at busy airports by issuing heading, altitude and speed instructions on a radar screen, scoring points for safe landings while traffic and difficulty rise.

Alicia Quatermain, granddaughter of a famous traveler, journeys through India and Tibet seeking the legendary Stone of Fate, dodging a secret organization, hijacking aircraft, solving puzzles, and rescuing tiger cubs while saving the world from villains.

The player leads a tribe through the European Stone Age, guiding generations as they discover technologies, manage resources and population, and build a city organically in a simulated ecosystem. Neighboring tribes can be traded with or attacked, and migration is an option when resources grow scarce.

An open-world guerrilla warfare game set on Mars where the player leads insurgent attacks on EDF targets using improvised weapons, modified vehicles, and physics-based destruction, choosing missions in any order, with multiplayer combat modes and reworked graphics.

After accidentally shooting an angel out of the sky, a cynic who disbelieves in love must take on the angel's mission of helping couples. Players decide whether each relationship is worth rekindling, weighing the consequences of their choices across several pairings and heroines.

In a utopian world where humans live alongside robots, a robot-control system launch goes wrong, spawning mutants and rebellious machines; the player fights through frenetic encounters using an experimental power glove and upgradable weapons.

In a fantasy world of airships and floating planes, the player takes up a departed captain's hat and jacket and joins a mismatched, inept pirate crew, seeking treasure in ruins and beneath the sea while evading the Navy in a silly, sexy adventure.

As a general, the player assembles mech armies from light swarms to colossal titans, customizes units and formations, and deploys them in 3D battles, countering enemy moves through tech trees and mid-battle upgrades across ranked, co-op, and survival modes.

Players control Lou, the son of Satan, shooting through four hellish districts to rescue a mistress from a fat clown, choosing among six weapons and a magic ability. Lou is healed by alcohol, and the game mixes fast shooter combat with RPG elements, boss fights, and crude humor in a darkly comedic Hell.

A film-noir motion comic with a non-linear plot follows Jon Lockhart, freshly released from prison, as he hunts the person who framed him for murder through a corrupt city, with match-3 puzzle battles, upgradable traits, and four different endings.

As a budding entrepreneur in a procedurally generated 1930s world, players build factories, manage production chains, move raw materials, and trade with growing cities while competing against AI rivals and random business events. The game balances accessibility with strategic depth across trading, production, and logistics.

A physics-driven sandbox where players pit dinosaurs, animals, and humans against each other in battles, attaching weapons like machine guns and flamethrowers, or taking direct control of a beast mid-fight. It includes challenge levels, a soccer mode, and tower defense, with gory dismemberment throughout.

Robin is a short slice-of-life vignette following three days in the life of a Chronic Fatigue Syndrome sufferer. The player manages limited time and energy, choosing what to do each day, with no perfect ending available, offering an insight into living with an invisible illness.

Work a junkyard from a hungover start toward fortune, processing scrap with heavy machinery, towing and compressing abandoned cars, restoring furniture and vehicles in a workshop, and selling finds on the Scrap Market. Explore on foot or by vehicle, buy containers of random loot, and take tasks from locals.

The player manages a global logistics network, transporting cargo to complete nearly 50,000 cities and 165,000 businesses across satellite-mapped continents, upgrading industries and solving transport bottlenecks in a vast open-world strategy puzzle.

Players build and manage a high school, constructing facilities like labs, courts and canteens while deciding how to handle budgets, teachers, delinquent students and hygiene needs. A cheerful but challenging management game with sandbox mode, staff routing, decorations and mod support.

Players command a World War II nation in long-running real-time strategy rounds, conquering provinces, forging alliances, researching secret weapons and building economies while units move continuously across historical maps against up to a hundred opponents.

Players manage a public transport network across large, lively cities, establishing bus, tram, and underground routes while competing against AI rivals. The simulation tracks thousands of vehicles and pedestrians, and players can question inhabitants about their needs as they expand and maintain service.

A puzzle-platformer where the player must unite every character to reach the next level, but all characters share the same input and move simultaneously, so the player must find ways to stop one so the others can catch up.

Locked in a prison cell, players craft and sell contraband items like cigarettes and bottles to fellow inmates, stash goods from patrolling guards, decorate their cell workshop, and complete jobs across four prisons to buy back their freedom.

The player runs an airport as its CEO, building terminals, runways and infrastructure while signing airline contracts, hiring staff and managing budgets and resources. Passenger satisfaction, delays, equipment breakdowns and bad weather all test the player's management skills in a deeply simulated tycoon experience.

A single-player sci-fi real-time tactics game styled like battle management software. Units are outfitted before battle with limited reinforcements, and combat unfolds over large scales with slow movement, aiming time, bullet drop and four movement types, rewarding ambushes and positioning over micromanagement and economy.

As Magos Dominus Faustinius, the player commands an Adeptus Mechanicus force on the rediscovered planet Silva Tenebris, customizing Tech-Priests and managing resources across 50 hand-crafted missions while trying to stop the Necron awakening, with choices leading to multiple endings.

Players create their own wrestler and pursue a career in the ring, or take charge of an entire promotion, making the right moves in a universe of 350 characters that evolves weekly. Exhibition matches and controller-based multiplayer let players blow off steam with a flexible animation system.

Players build and expand a farm from a small plot, growing crops, raising animals, and decorating buildings and avatars, with optional online co-op where friends or strangers can help, plus a house interior for cooking, painting, and music.

An airport tycoon and simulation game where you build and manage every part of your own airfield, from landing strips and terminals to roads and parks, designing passenger flow, managing economy and logistics, and researching technology from 1916 to modern days in a customizable sandbox.

Players control a native civilization or a European expeditionary force in the sixteenth century, exploring a procedurally generated New World, founding colonies, producing and trading goods, and fighting rivals to establish control.

A version of the popular 2048 puzzle game for PC and tablets, where players combine numbered tiles to reach 2048. It features modern and classic level types, a simple interface, a dynamic soundtrack, and continued high-score play after reaching the target.

Survive nightly waves of zombies in a top-down arcade shooter with tactical elements. Between nights, build barricades, buy guns, and set up turrets, then fight alongside up to four players in co-op or competitive modes.

Players spend a summer clearing creatures in generated action-combat dungeons, where the weapons they find transform into romanceable characters. They date or befriend these weapon-people, craft gifts, and investigate who is abducting and damaging weapons.

Players take the wheel of 19 all-terrain vehicles to cross extreme Siberian landscapes, completing deliveries and objectives through mud, rivers, and obstacles that react realistically to their vehicle, guided only by map and compass, solo or in co-op.

As the producer of an idol group, players guide seven heroines through the cutthroat entertainment industry, making choices in a dramatic visual novel about the harsh reality behind stardom and the dream of becoming the nation's greatest idols.

A charades party game for PC and Twitch streaming where players act, draw, sing, or describe secret phrases while viewers guess in chat. It includes nearly 3,000 phrases across many categories, local play for up to eight players, and multiple language options.

A visual novel following Vinty, an aspiring calligrapher who travels to Singapore after receiving a mysterious plane ticket, to investigate ghost sightings of the late calligrapher Kiki. The story explores her struggle to escape obscurity while uncovering the truth behind the appearances.

A strategic escape game where Claudia, locked in a witch's mansion for three years, fights through 30 stages using Mana Reinforcement and Magic Potions to grow stronger, recover her memories, and save her poisoned brother, with five possible endings.

Players command a team of self-replicating robots building a settlement across three Ages, laying roads, boats and trains, harvesting resources, farming and researching technology. Campaign missions, procedurally generated maps, sandbox mode, co-op and PvP multiplayer, plus a map editor and Workshop support offer varied colony-building play.

Players flip through twelve themed pinball tables ranging from space and the Wild West to dinosaurs and the deep sea, chasing high scores and unlocking mini-games. Customizable tables, mods, powerballs, and daily events against other players' scores round out the retro arcade experience.

Players command Chinese chess pieces in an animated strategy game where battles play out as humorous vignettes, such as dragons burning knights and counsellors flattening pawns with mallets. It offers 2D and 3D views, difficulty levels, move hints, and take-back options, turning abstract chess into entertainment.

The player explores a whimsical 2D world through mysterious doors, solving puzzles and stealing adorable animals to bring back to a Save Room that also records mistakes. Playable solo or in shared-screen co-op, it features boss fights, adaptive algorithmic music, and multiple endings.

Players become Revenants exploring a ruined world in a story-driven dungeon experience, teaming with an AI partner or co-op friend. They wield bayonets, axes, and spears, enhance abilities with Blood Codes and Gifts, and switch classes freely while fighting the Lost to unlock their past.

Cahal, a werewolf in exile, fights a war against a corrupt oil company serving a destructive entity. Players switch between human form to interact with people and machines, wolf form to sneak past enemies, and a ferocious beast form for savage combat, learning abilities through a skill tree and channeling rage into frenzy.

Campfire Cooking is a relaxing puzzle game about preparing meals over a warm fire during a year-long camping trip. Players twist, rotate, and jostle skewers and use tools like fondue pots, magnets, or a camping stove to cook food perfectly, while listening to campers share stories and jokes at each new campsite.

Players row around a scenic mountain lake in VR, choosing fishing spots, picking bait, and tiring out catches before reeling them in, while listening to radio music, skipping stones, and optionally completing missions to unlock new gear.

As a Paris taxi driver who survived a serial killer's attack, the player has seven nights to gather clues from passengers while earning money to pay bills. Dialogue choices and investigation decisions shape a non-linear noir mystery across multiple cases.

Players create an Outrider and fight across the hostile sci-fi planet Enoch in 1-3 player co-op, using gunplay, violent powers, and customizable gear to pursue a mysterious signal, with four classes, buildcrafting, and endgame expeditions against brutal bosses.

Players lead a group of survivors across a frozen post-apocalyptic wasteland, scavenging, hunting and making choices that shape the community and lead to multiple endings. A stat-based character system and a combat mix of turn-based battles and card mechanics support the narrative survival journey.

A physics-based building game where players construct contraptions from a large block collection to overcome obstacles and puzzles across many levels, with logic routines, a level editor, replay mode and Steam Workshop sharing.

Lead a band of outcasts and refugees across procedurally generated wastelands as a technopathic mystic, navigating a broken sci-fi world and fighting slavers and machines in turn-based card combat. Recruit followers, build decks, and manage resources on a high-difficulty roguelike journey with permadeath toward the mysterious Crypt.

A strategy tower-defense game set on Mars in 2065, where the player builds a defense base, manages crew and resources, and researches turrets to repel hordes of undead cosmonauts. A story campaign, skirmish modes, and a terraforming map editor support uncovering the mystery of the undead.

Players match blocks of elements across four views, swapping blocks vertically or rotating rows to form combos and earn atoms. Reaching goals such as water advances the game, with new element goals replacing old ones while scores track matches and combos.

Players design and build roller coasters, rides, and scenery in an isometric theme park, then manage staff, finances, and guest happiness across 95 classic scenarios and expansion environments to turn a profit and grow the park.

Players choose a party, campaign for votes by promising what citizens want, then decide whether to keep those promises once in parliament. The turn-based political simulation spans 20 nations and over 140 laws, with lawmaker management, bribery, coalition-building, and presidential appointments.

Explore a massive open-world RPG built in RPG Maker, with classless party members who can learn anything. Master over a thousand skills across 25 elements, grow a talent tree, play a card game, and tackle super dungeons and bosses.

Players build complex electronics such as adders, latches and multiplexers from simple components, solving over seventy open-ended puzzles that escalate toward constructing fully functional CPUs. The frame is a 1960s Silicon Valley startup the player tries to keep from collapsing.

As a new employee in the Aperture Science test lab, the player builds bridges, ramps and slides across 60 test chambers, using portals, gels and faith plates to guide vehicle-driving Bendies past turrets, acid and lasers while GLaDOS narrates the physics puzzles.

Players build and manage a colony of survivors after a world-ending event, constructing over 130 buildings and recruiting specialists with unique skills. They send specialists into a procedurally generated wasteland to gather resources, trade or compete with rival colonies, and make choices that shape the colony's happiness and future.

A large open-world strategy puzzle game where the player transports cargoes across the British Isles to complete over 2000 towns, planning routes, upgrading industries and trucks, and managing resources and contracts across a scaled map.

A virtual reality drum kit lets players practice percussion with realistic, responsive instruments, following beginner lessons or playing a rhythm game across many songs. Players can build custom kits, record and share performances, and compete for high scores.

An ordinary survivor navigates a zombie-ridden urban wasteland after a failed immortality vaccine, uncovering the Human X Plan conspiracy. Players scavenge, craft, sneak and fight varied zombies and bosses, make consequential dialogue choices with fellow survivors, and pursue multiple endings.

A visual novel about Nekohime, a bored computer repair technician in her twenties who abandoned her dream of making video games. Her childhood friend Clover introduces her to the flirtatious Suki, and together the three girls attempt to develop a game while Nekohime navigates self-doubt and romance.

The player breeds and mutates an army of cats in Boon County, outfitting them with class collars and sending them into turn-based tactical battles for loot. Returning cats pass on scars, skills and mutations, building ever stranger bloodlines across roguelite runs.

In a climate-devastated late 21st century, players command a resistance faction in real-time strategy battles, designing units, factories, and superweapons through a persistent tech tree. A story campaign and online multiplayer matches pit customized factions against the Collective and rival commanders.

Players lead a prehistoric people from either 4,000,000 B.C. or 6000 B.C., managing resources and researching over sixty technologies to build a prosperous civilization. More than thirty events such as ice ages, raids, and revolts shape each settlement's history, with a survival mode for added challenge.

Players guide Detective Ito through a dark branching investigation into her missing partner, making decisions that shift her sanity and professionalism while exploring Tokyo and solving point-and-click puzzles across eleven possible endings.

Players take the role of an ordinary footman during the Hundred Years War, fighting turn-based battles with weapons, fatigue, injuries, and consumables. Between fights they loot over 200 items, craft supplies, and make choices that change NPC opinions, with random elements making each playthrough different.

A fast-paced soccer and volleyball simulator with realistic physics, playable online against friends in PvP or co-op across eight stadiums, with replays, statistics, and shirt customization, aiming to be easy to learn but hard to master.

A part-timer wins a 30-day island vacation and resolves to change his dull life by bonding with the girls he meets there. Days are spent talking, drinking, and dating, while a color-matching puzzle minigame advances the story.

Players found and manage a kingdom of settlers in procedurally generated deserts, mountains, islands, and tundras, choosing from five races. They build structures, dig mines, research blueprints, equip settlers, and battle raiders and underground horrors.

A fast-paced tube shooter reviving the classic arcade formula, putting players in control of the Claw spacecraft to blast deadly creatures and obstacles across vibrant geometric prisms through 100 levels and three modes while chasing high scores.

Restoration follows two high school students, Oliver and Penello, who travel the region of Astrelia as Dream-Catchers, purifying despairing hearts to prevent them from becoming nightmares. The pilgrimage blends a touching story with several challenging tasks and a difficulty slider in a colorful world.

A retro-style puzzle platformer where the player collects all coins on a level to unlock the next, avoids hazards, and activates mechanisms in the right order. Dying once sends the player back to level one, and the music changes each level.

An immersive artistic short game in which the player journeys through six atmospheric chapters of the human psyche, interacting with environments and solving puzzles that symbolize aspects of anxiety and mental illness, from isolation to everyday situations distorted beyond recognition.

As an American car dealer, the player builds a business through a branching campaign with 27 paths, hiring staff, repairing and selling cars, and choosing between honest dealing and shady mafia-style schemes. Three difficulty levels and economic decisions shape the company's growth.

Players drive powerful off-road rally cars through real-world locations in New Zealand, Argentina, Spain, Poland, Australia, and the USA, mastering authentic handling and surface degradation while building a team and competing in career events and online challenges.

Players build an organic medieval city without a grid, creating modular buildings from individual parts, painting zones for homes and roads, and managing villagers through jobs, production chains, trade, and three progress paths while relaxing at their own pace.

A short visual novel about Max and his girlfriend Ann, following several ordinary days of their relationship as Ann prepares a surprise for him. Players read the story, make minor choices, and reach a single unpredictable ending, accompanied by detailed backgrounds, CG art, and atmospheric music.

A high school student known for dispensing love advice meets a mysterious fairy of love determined to make his own romance come true. Players follow a romantic school comedy through choices, multiple routes, and endings set during spring and summer.

Set in an alternate 1864 where European powers intervene in the American Civil War, the player commands Union fleets and armies around the Gulf of Mexico. A turn-based strategic mode covers blockades, amphibious assaults, and sieges, while real-time tactical battles use realistic ironclad ship models and ballistics.

The player builds houses, farms, and markets to grow a city, unlocking technologies with exponentially rising costs and adapting production chains and strategies to changing seasons, with no punishing failure mechanics.

When an imperial ship is set ablaze near the port of Meleda, young warrior Zadrian is thrust into a war to protect his kingdom's princess and lineage. You command grid-based units of knights and recruits through tactical battles in this strategy RPG.

A live-action seduction simulator where players make dialogue and action choices in everyday scenarios like a coffee shop, office, and bar, receiving feedback from a dating guru on each decision and seeing awkward or successful outcomes.

The player leads teams of shinobi girls through lighthearted water gun battles in a mysterious tournament, customizing weapons, abilities, and outfits. Battles use hydro-jetpacks across arenas, with single-player storylines and online 5-on-5 matches.

A murder in a Kanto apartment complex sparks interconnected events told from three perspectives in a bleak semi-futuristic Tokyo. Players follow multiple protagonists through a dark narrative presented with a rebuilt Film Window visual system.

As a dungeon lord, players defend their dungeons against greedy adventurers and heroes using physics-enabled traps and contraptions across handcrafted levels and procedurally generated dungeons, progressing through skill trees, equipment, and difficulty-modifying runes.

The player drives customized high-performance race cars across six twisting, dangerous tracks ranging from icy Scandinavian glacial routes to mountain courses and Egyptian desert spinouts. Realistic car physics convey jumps, turns, spins, and centrifugal force, and up to twenty cars can be customized for racing.

A stateless outcast in a dystopian space future leads a squad of mercenaries through derelict alien ships, fighting turn-based battles with card-drawn combat actions, looting gear, and upgrading the crew at a scavenger base to earn citizenship.

Players explore a nightmarish, dream-like world of interconnected regions in first-person, solving puzzles, managing a limited inventory and ammo, and fighting when necessary while piecing together the unsettling environment's story without cutscenes.

Players lead a party of eight heroes on a mission to topple a ruthless emperor in a war-torn fantasy world, navigating political intrigue and turn-based battles where each character's unique abilities and persistent equipment upgrades shape the fight.

A story-driven turn-based tactical RPG set in a fantasy world with steampunk touches. As Arbiter Kyrie, the player leads troops through elevation-based battles, customizes characters across over 30 classes, and uncovers corruption within her order.

A strategy game recreating medieval European battles across campaigns between France and its enemies in Flanders, Navarre, and Aragon, where players command knights, pikemen, and archers using flank attacks and strategic movement.

Humanity is enslaved by an AI, and players run the oppressor's side, exploiting humans for power while managing their exhaustion and hunger. Randomly generated events make each rogue-lite run unique, with dark humor and fast resource management.

Players control an Evil Genius building a secret island lair and cover operation, training minions, recruiting henchmen, and researching trap networks to repel the Forces of Justice. They carry out evil schemes toward a Doomsday Device and world domination in this satirical spy-fi lair builder.

In 1923 Argentina, Luciano must learn the tango before Martita's birthday to win her heart, dancing through a melodramatic rhythm game story of love, knife fights and telenovela twists, with an original tango soundtrack and challenge modes for mastery.

This concluding chapter follows the princess knights of Kyoto as conspiracy and truth unfold and Len turns her sword against her childhood friend Shinonome. The story is fully voiced in Japanese, with battle sequences and scenes drawn from real Kyoto locations and Japanese folklore.

Phantom Jump is a rhythm-based platformer where players have only four seconds to live and must hit phantom jump events to restore life and traverse levels quickly. It offers five worlds, boss fights, leaderboards, online races, and a speedrun mode for optimal play.

A strategy game in which an insectoid alien queen on Jupiter's moon Europa spawns and mutates minions from limited egg slots, gathers nectar with harvesters, and counters a rival queen across 21 campaign levels, with autonomous units handling combat while the player focuses on tactics.

This remastered visual novel follows a horror romance in which the protagonist must decide how far he will go for love, presented with artwork, haunting music, and a story from writer Urobuchi Gen. The Steam release has been edited for its audience.

A medieval MMO strategy game where players fortify castles, raise armies, and clash with rival alliances for global domination, choosing a faction and champion, crafting equipment, managing trade and defenses, and competing to become High King over the realm.

The player competes in fast-paced 2D sports matches across soccer, hockey, tennis, and darts, using reflex and strategy with realistic physics. It supports multiplayer PvP and co-op, stadium variety, shirt customization, replays, and statistics for casual and competitive players.

A classic Dungeons & Dragons role-playing adventure where the player creates a hero and explores cities, dungeons, and wilderness across the original campaign and expansions, alone or with friends, with enhanced graphics, restored multiplayer, and extensive modding support.

After colonists' stasis capsules malfunction, players rebuild a ruined underground facility on a distant planet, managing resources, power, and water while expanding across the surface. Colonists with unique quirks and moods must be kept housed and fed as players research technology, craft upgrades, and send expeditions to uncover alien secrets.

In a 2121 world where most people have mutated powers, you die but return in a dead teenager's body with help from a mysterious girl, seeking revenge and dangerous secrets while sharing the body. The visual novel blends mystery, romance, comedy, and sci-fi with branching routes and stat raising.

A top-down Japanese-style bullet hell shooter in which fairy girl Kei searches for her missing sister in a mist-covered forest. Players eat oranges to charge a counter gauge, reflect enemy bullets back as homing lasers, and defeat giant monster girl bosses across five stages.

Guide four outsider incarnations through an anomalous, experimentally driven story spanning a dead-end future, primeval past and present crossroads, exploring over 700 hand-drawn landscapes and characters with real-time combat and dialogue drawn from strange sources.

A turn-based war game recreating the American Revolutionary War around Boston, where the player commands troops against redcoats across four single-player scenarios or in hot-seat multiplayer, using flanking, defensive terrain and difficulty settings to win independence.

As Ash, a tormented leader in a frozen post-apocalyptic wasteland, players explore, scavenge resources, craft gear, and recruit followers to build a refuge while enduring blizzards and Eldritch monsters. Dynamic weather and snow tracking shape tense survival expeditions.

An eight-year-old boy named Jimmy adventures through his own dream world to save his family from an alien entity called the Pulsating Mass. He explores, fights in turn-based battles, and transforms into monsters he meets, confronting nightmares and his own shortcomings.

An MMORPG shooter set in post-apocalyptic wastelands where players explore an open world of radiation, mutants, and armed survivors, managing hunger and thirst while completing quests, crafting, trading, and fighting rival factions and players.

The POSTAL Dude and his dog Champ, stranded in the Arizona desert after their car is stolen, arrive in the town of Edensin. Players roam an open-world sandbox completing errands and side quests or causing chaos, using an absurd arsenal in a satirical first-person shooter with pacifist or violent options.

A steampunk RPG in which the player commands a mercenary squad of airship pilots answering a queen's call, fighting tactical turn-based battles, acquiring and upgrading ships and weapons, and leveling up the crew with little randomness.

A difficult logic puzzle game where players use numeric clues on varied tile grids to deduce and mark hidden mines across over a hundred hand-designed levels, with note-taking tools and no guessing required.

After the true ending of the previous game, Cinderella gains goddess powers and fights for her innocence, uncovering the Prince's secret plan and seeking revenge. Players hack and slash through 14 chapters and 50+ quests, dodging, guarding, and customizing outfits whose durability affects combat.

Players begin as a mysterious patient rescued by elderly survivors in a zombie-ravaged Atlanta and lead turn-based tactical combat with realistic ballistics, open-ended exploration, base rebuilding and heavy choices about who to save while preparing for an approaching horde.

A visual novel mystery where students and staff on a secluded island are stranded after their professor is murdered and phones fail. Players choose whom to spend time with, solve the murder, survive mounting pressure, and may pursue romance, with over twenty endings.

Players race official riders and bikes from the 2017 Monster Energy Supercross Championship on iconic tracks including Daytona, competing in career and online modes. A track editor lets players create and share custom stadiums, while extensive customization options cover riders, bikes, and over 80 official brands.

A comedy RPG where three friends venture through worlds based on games they once played, trying to return home. The player engages in turn-based battles, recruits allies through contracts, and unlocks quests while encountering lighthearted writing and appearances by other Team Four Star members and fans.

Players command fleets and armies in an alternate-history Spanish-American War, managing squadrons in turn-based strategy and fighting real-time tactical naval battles with realistic ships and ballistics around the Philippines in 1898.

Players take the role of an unfamous writer in a yuri visual novel, meeting and growing close to a girl with a very different personality. The story branches through choices and item collection, with puzzle-solving elements and four endings to reach.

Players guide Donut, a character pulled through a wormhole from Earth to Neptune, through short and very difficult platforming levels with only jump and forward/back movement. There are no points, coins, or lives; dying restarts the level, all set to heavy metal, grunge, and punk music.

A strategy game recreating battles of the English Civil War between Parliamentarians and Royalists, where the player commands cavalry, pike and shot infantry, muskets, and artillery across tutorial and historical campaigns, using flank attacks and strategic movement to win each engagement.

After his mother's death, a young man returns to his hometown and searches for the childhood friend he promised to marry, while meeting a scythe-carrying girl who claims to be a Grim Reaper. The visual novel follows his relationships with seven girls and branches into seven endings.

The Void Walker defends his hometown from an invasion of cultists worshipping ancient gods, fighting through new levels, enemy types, and secrets in a hardcore first-person shooter campaign that threatens the whole Earth.

A kinetic visual novel set in mid-19th-century England, following maid Lorina Waugh as she endures harsh work at a country estate and grows drawn to the mysterious, rumored-witch maid Taohua, told through around 100,000 words of text with detailed art and music.

Players follow Evelyn, a former tech worker who becomes a proxy reading AI-generated scripts for a virtual counseling app in Seattle. This visual novel explores her reconnection with past acquaintances, the clients she counsels, and her growing doubts about the technology through dialogue and choices.

As head of a nation's Sigma division, the player recruits and deploys covert agents to secure scientists and secrets before rival powers do. Turn-based missions involve seduction, blackmail, kidnapping and counter-espionage, with alliances and assassinations shaped through a dynamic narrative of over a hundred NPCs.

As a digital exorcist for the Church of Ain Soph's Inquisition, the player investigates three murder cases in a utopian city, questioning suspects, comparing timelines, and entering minds to expose lies and purge daemonic corruption.

Set in an alternate 1920s Europa, players lead one of five factions to become the richest and most powerful nation, exploring territories, recruiting forces, and deploying combat Mechs. The strategy game emphasizes asymmetry, engine building, and choice-driven combat.

After a mage war shatters the planet, the player acts as a Mage Overlord rebuilding a realm on floating landmasses, using magic to move and terraform terrain and connect lands. Units are given general goals rather than micromanaged, and warriors, archers, and mages tame flying beasts for aerial combat in a procedurally generated world.

Set in a 1920s world of hidden gods and secret histories, players seek forbidden knowledge by combining cards to found a cult, recruit disciples, translate grimoires and summon spirits. Choices shape a Lovecraftian narrative roguelike where investigators and authorities threaten, and a legacy system carries the story beyond death.

Players lead one of six factions emerging from a fallen galactic empire, building a colony through technological and social development while exploring planetary ruins and uncovering the Star Union's history. Tactical turn-based battles, diplomacy, and multiple victory paths unfold across a story campaign, random skirmish maps, and multiplayer.

The player commands a squad of Desert Rangers in a post-nuclear Colorado, dispatched by the Patriarch to rescue his land from his three bloodthirsty children. Building a base, recruiting and customizing Rangers, and fighting tactical turn-based battles, the player makes ethical decisions that shape the story.

Players build a military base, recruit commanders, and march armies across a real-world map in a persistent online war, fighting real-time PvP battles and coordinating with alliances to conquer nations. The setting is a modern global conflict with tanks, jets, and artillery.

The player controls a cat trapped in another dimension, navigating randomized bullet-hell levels and boss fights with simple one-handed controls, freeing partners who help fight evil, and comparing run results on leaderboards amid a psychedelic, glitch-heavy visual style.

A college student named Yan lives in a bookstore with Mori, a fox spirit who has guarded him since childhood, while another girl, Liya, enters his life. The visual novel follows this love story among animal girls with Live2D characters and illustrated scenes.

A former hero in a modern world with demons and fairies raises an orphaned princess candidate over eight years, setting monthly education policies, school schedules, and part-time jobs that shape her abilities and future. The player chooses between a normal life, stardom, or a return to the kingdom.

A management and tycoon simulator set beneath the city of Lubdon Town, where the player builds and runs metro stations across procedurally generated maps, managing crowd flow, power, heat, refuse, staff, and a consumer economy while coping with events like rat plagues and vandals.

Players command ancient Mediterranean war galleys across 24 historic naval battles, from Salamis to Actium, choosing among fourteen ship types. A WEGO system has them plan moves in advance, then watch simultaneous resolution, managing squadrons, ramming, boarding, weather, and crew fatigue.

Players form and deploy teams of SD Gundams from multiple Gundam eras in tactical RPG battles rendered with high-def 3D models, using series-specific systems of Development, Design, and Capture to build their squad and fight through scenarios.

A remastered World War II sniper shooter in which an elite marksman is parachuted into Berlin to stop Nazi rocket technology from reaching the Red Army. Players stalk targets, set up shots, and use stealth and patience across missions and multiplayer modes.

Players pick one of four mercenaries with RPG skills and hunt alien Vault technology across the desolate planet Pandora, collecting huge numbers of guns in first-person shooting and vehicular combat, alone or in four-player co-op, with all add-on packs included.

Players command amoebas in a real-time strategy game, exploring alien microscopic landscapes to feed them so they replicate via binary fission, then mutating weaker units into stronger species.
