It offers a story campaign, a co-op roguelike mode with randomized missions, and 18-player battle royale multiplayer.

A lazy cupid exiled to Tokyo accidentally shoots a waitress with a love bullet, forcing them to live together while a childhood friend hunts her down. The player makes choices that shape this romantic visual novel.

As an incident commander, deploy limited fire, medical, police, and technical units in real-time to contain disasters such as street races, fires, and nuclear meltdowns, across campaigns, remastered classic missions, freeplay, and multiplayer maps.

Players explore a series of unsettling locations—a dark forest, frozen wasteland, ocean, and abandoned facility—by selecting VHS tapes in a dusty room. Each area hides secrets and collectibles, and completing one unlocks a harder remixed version, all tied to an overarching mystery.

Become a medieval king and contend for control of Europe in a real-time grand strategy game. Appoint a royal court of marshals, diplomats, merchants, clerics, and spies, manage diplomacy and economy, and lead armies directly in RTS battles.

As a judge of the Revolutionary Tribunal during the French Revolution, the player presides over morally ambiguous court cases, questions witnesses, passes sentences, and weaves political intrigue among rival factions while confronting family disagreements and the risk of the guillotine.

In the dark land of Ashendalila, a hero fights monsters called white knights through a traditional turn-based RPG battle engine, leveling up and managing inventory and skills. The game centers on a ritual to eradicate the monsters and offers 5000 achievements to pursue.

A man carrying his grandfather's ashes survives a space hearse wreck and must scavenge debris, craft tools, and build a station while uncovering a conspiracy. The ironic tone mixes survival hazards like suffocation and freezing with absurd humor and junk-collecting.

In a civilization dependent on ancient blastia technology, two friends traveling separate paths are drawn into a power struggle that threatens all existence. This definitive edition adds new playable characters, updated HD graphics, new music, mini-games, bosses, and costume DLC to the epic adventure.

Players take charge of national volleyball teams, managing tactics and competing in international tournaments to become world champions. The simulation recreates indoor volleyball with spikes, blocks and floaters, emphasizing speed, reflexes and teamwork in a realistic sports experience.

Players command Allied or Axis forces in turn-based battles recreating the 1944 Normandy campaign, working through campaign, advanced, and full battle scenarios in 2D or 3D views. Solo or asynchronous multiplayer play, rank progression, and historical photos and unit fact sheets support the strategic, history-focused experience.

An interactive graphic novel set in a fantasy medieval northern Europe, following a group of shaman apprentices on a sacred island seeking their spirit-guides, where every choice shapes the heroine's mood, relationships, and multiple story paths and endings.

An otome fantasy visual novel following Inske, a student of magical arts distracted by an upcoming outdoors exam, as three charming characters compete for her heart and the player's choices lead to multiple endings amid romantic scenes and memorable locations.

A fantasy RPG following the first-generation hero Rain as he chooses a bachelorette, with the story spanning two generations where new protagonists inherit stats and abilities from their parents, alongside class assignment, crafting outfits, and an interactive Unification System.

A mercenary pilot with no memory of the Gray Christmas tragedy awakens on a virtual battlefield and must uncover the truth amid factional war in dystopian Suzushiro City. The game mixes visual novel storytelling with 3D mech combat, a branching weapon tech tree, and multiple playthroughs.

Players form The Saints with three allies and battle rival factions across the open streets and desert of Santo Ileso, shooting, driving and wingsuiting through missions and criminal ventures to build a crime empire, solo or in co-op.

In this short sequel, the protagonist lives with two cat ninja who behave like house cats, and the sub-character Nachi decides to train him to become a better Master, with the story turning as Nachi grows attached to him. It is a voiced visual novel focused on character interaction.

Players survive a dark, atmospheric zombie apocalypse by scavenging scarce resources and equipment in abandoned buildings, conserving ammo in combat. They can aid or abandon survivors, trade in a player-driven economy, build characters, and fight other players.

A visual novel set in a dried-out future where humanity is fading and hybrids called Others live alongside people. Two diner workers find a pink-haired girl by the roadside, and their quiet routine changes as new characters with their own circumstances enter their lives.

A first-person horror game set in the Swedish wilderness, where the player confronts creatures from Nordic folklore while exploring open areas and struggling to keep their sanity and survive the night. The tone is dread-filled and menacing, drawing on old stories that turn out to be real.

A priest in 1920s England seeks to prove his innocence amid demonic possession and divine apparitions, slipping into fear-driven trances that show gore and the devil's temptations. The adventure moves between a remote English village and a mystical Romania-inspired world.

In the aftermath of a civil war, a young swordsman journeys across a nation with his giant knight to reunite with his classmates and end the conflict. The role-playing game features turn-based link combat, an airship for fast travel, and relationship-driven conversations carried over from the previous game.

Players guide Riel, a novice adventurer in a demon-conquered open world, through an action-RPG where she gathers experience and equipment to survive against overwhelming fiends. Death is frequent and expected, and the tone is grim rather than heroic.

Players control Lara Croft as she survives a hostile jungle, uses stealth and camouflage against enemies, and explores underwater tunnels and deadly tombs filled with puzzles, uncovering a hidden city in the final chapter of her origin story.

A standalone mini-sequel visual novel in which the ninja Saiha warns the protagonist that a runaway ninja has entered town, possibly targeting him, and insists on staying close while Yura and Tama also hover around him.

A college student inherits his grandfather's estate and is drawn into his family's duty of guiding wandering spirits to the afterlife while aiding police on supernatural cases. With clairvoyance and demon familiars, he navigates multiple routes in this Japanese visual novel.

An old-school real-time strategy game set in the ancient Roman world, where players command seven civilizations and historical heroes in fast-paced military conquest battles, with RPG elements, a historical storyline, and multiplayer for up to eight players.

In 1348 France, young Amicia and her little brother Hugo flee Inquisition soldiers and swarms of plague rats, relying on fire and light to survive. The grim narrative adventure follows the siblings as they learn to trust each other amid a brutal, unforgiving world.

Seiko is an ordinary student who works at home as an online voice actress, taking on many roles including 18+ games. Players follow her and classmate Yusuke, also a voice actor, through scenarios while a Tsum Tsum minigame raises her level and unlocks more job opportunities.

Players pilot British, German, and Italian aircraft through the Battle of Britain, flying fighters, bombers, and attack planes over a large map of southeast England and northern France. Detailed cockpits, engine and damage modeling, campaigns, and large multiplayer aerial battles emphasize technical flight simulation.

A 17-year-old boy who was bullied for his feminine appearance enrolls at a strict all-girls academy disguised as a girl named Maria, hiding his true identity. He interacts with five heroines, including his roommate and cousin, building relationships that lead to romantic endings in this visual novel.

The player builds a space empire in a persistent galaxy, colonizing planets and setting trade and mining routes in Yellow Stars, cooperating to raid Red Stars before supernovae, battling rival corporations over five-day White Star matches, and dueling in short Blue Stars.

Players take on the world of Tokyo Ghoul as ghouls and investigators, using kagune or quinque abilities to fight through stages, and can team up with friends in co-op to survive a cruel, eat-or-be-eaten world.

Twin alchemist sisters Lydie and Suelle run an atelier in the kingdom of Adalet and dream of making it the best in the land. Discovering a mysterious painting containing a strange world rich in rare alchemy materials, they delve into its fantastic realms to gather ingredients and pursue their goal.

As head of all rescue units, the player dispatches fire, police, and technical crews across 20 missions involving accidents, disasters, and terror incidents, managing vehicles and personnel in a real-time simulation and strategy mix with a scenario editor and endless mode.

Players act as incident commander, dispatching police, fire, and rescue units to traffic accidents, fires, crimes, and natural disasters, where every second counts. The real-time strategy simulation offers a 20-mission campaign, free play in a living city, overseas missions, and multiplayer for two to four players, with dozens of vehicles and units.

As the Empire's secret envoy, the player recruits a strike team of dwarves, elves, amazons, nomads and nagas to investigate a spreading mist of undeath around the Castle of N'Mar, using social talents to bluff, intimidate or negotiate with foes, with optional visual novel mode and romance options.

Players race over 230 motorcycles across 30 photogrammetry-scanned tracks worldwide, customizing bikes and riders with a livery editor. A career mode structured around magazines and competitions offers single-player progression through varied racing disciplines.

Players lead a team of mutant outcasts through a post-human world reclaimed by nature, using real-time stealth to position before turn-based tactical combat. They explore ruined cities, scavenge supplies at the Ark, and unlock mutations while searching for the legendary Eden.

Players take on the role of a tennis coach guiding one or more players through a decades-spanning world tour of tournaments and rankings, optionally stepping into a 3D match engine to play points themselves or simulating results through text.

Players build analog and digital electronic circuits in a 3D sandbox and watch them function through simulation, with visual effects and animations giving feedback, plus playful components like fireworks and fountains, making the exploration of electricity and electronics educational and fun.

A detective adventure set in the fictional 19th-century port city of New Bretagne, where private investigator Miles Fordham solves five cases while haunted by his dead partner's voice. Players investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, and make choices that shape outcomes and people's attitudes.

An enhanced version of the classic samurai action-adventure, following a warrior through feudal Japan with intense swordplay and a dramatic revenge story, now featuring improved analog controls, high-definition visuals, and a new soundtrack.

A visual novel following a second-year student who meets Yua, a strange girl claiming to be a god, after finding an old book called 'your diary'. The story explores seven heroines and the seven ways people experience happiness, with player choices changing affection levels and branching their stories.

A sandbox MMORPG set in an open medieval fantasy world with a player-driven economy, where players craft nearly all items, combine gear in a classless system, battle other adventurers in full-loot fights, and join guilds to conquer territories and build homes.

Playing recently deceased friends Milo and Lola, the player stumbles through a Hell of interconnected islands, making conversation choices that reshape relationships and the story while drinking, partying, and attempting to outdrink Satan for a chance to return to Earth.

Players sit at a laptop loaded with a stolen NSA database of secretly recorded video conversations and type search terms to surface clips, piecing together a non-linear investigative thriller about four linked lives. The experience is intimate and intense, leaving the player to decide the truth.

Players run a logging business in an open world, felling trees with chainsaws and axes, driving realistic forestry vehicles, and selling logs at the local mill. Proceeds fund machines, land, and truck upgrades, with terrain alteration and physics-based vehicle handling shaping each delivery.

Players receive a unique anime girlfriend and care for her in a 3D virtual Tokyo, going on visual-novel-style dates, shopping, cooking, and dressing up together, with sandbox city exploration, UFO catchers, and yuri romance options, all focused on anime and otaku culture.

Players act as a friendly ghost haunting a house full of girls, solving puzzles, playing pranks, and possessing objects while leveling poltergeist powers, investigating mysteries, and using time travel to prevent the Earth from exploding.

A hardcore 2D platformer in which the player escapes the paws of Gachi, gunning down robots and white liquid with a jetpack and machine gun. The game promises addictive classic platforming, dangerous opponents, weapons, and revenge.

Players become a skyfarer journeying across the Sky Realm and its many islands. They engage in deep turn-based combat with elemental strategies, chain bursts and summons, tackle raids solo or in real-time co-op, and develop over 70 classes while following fully voiced character stories.

A wish upon a star upends your ordinary life as a bunny girl's house, a princess's castle, and a catgirl appear around town. You pursue five heroines with their own quirks, choosing whether to embrace these fantasies or confront why they arrived.

A tactical real-time strategy game set in 117 After Earth, where the player commands a secret taskforce against a mutant invasion. It combines a strategy layer with real-time combat missions, research, resource management, and up to eight-player co-op, all aimed at finding a cure and saving humanity.

A videogame adaptation of a banned adult card game in which one to six players secretly answer increasingly uncomfortable personal questions while companions guess their responses across three rounds. Local multiplayer, team and solo modes, worldwide vote comparisons, and Twitch streaming integration for large viewer participation are included.

Players race open-wheel vehicles across wild off-road circuits on the alien planet Proteus, using slipstream boosts and simulated physics. They progress through career series, challenge modes, and online races against other players.

Players tap along to a large library of songs, dancing through stages while beating enemies in the air and on the ground and dodging obstacles, in a beginner-friendly rhythm game starring cute characters with varied difficulty levels.

In a war-ravaged Warhammer Fantasy world, players choose from five character classes and fight through monster hordes to defend the Empire of Man. The hack-and-slash action RPG supports solo or four-player co-op with many powers, bosses, and difficulty levels.

As the Penitent One, the last survivor of a massacre, players explore the nightmarish gothic land of Cvstodia, fighting grotesque monsters and titanic bosses with brutal combos and executions while uncovering secrets to break an endless cycle of death and rebirth.

Players join Neptune and the Goddesses of Gamindustri across dimensions to battle the Dark CPU in a turn-based JRPG. The enhanced version adds smoother graphics, a revamped combo-based battle system with team attacks and transformations, plus a VR mode for hanging out one-on-one with characters.

An evolution simulator where players observe or intervene in life on a harsh world, watching creatures defined by genes mutate and undergo natural selection, or tinkering with the gene pool, triggering catastrophes, and tracking lineages through detailed tools.

Players pursue a professional motorcycle racing career from the Rookies Cup to the premier MotoGP class, racing on 19 official tracks while tuning bikes, managing tyre wear and tracking progress through the MotoGP ID system.

An anthology horror adventure following students of several academies through incidents in the cursed Heavenly Host Elementary, revisiting events from multiple timelines and viewpoints. Players use point-and-click interaction to explore these stories and steer characters toward alternate outcomes, some of which avoid previous deaths.

A visual novel midquel in which the vengeful ghost Sachiko Shinozaki grants her victims 24 hours of amnesty for a bizarre birthday party at Heavenly Host Elementary, with player choices across eight chapters leading to 28 endings.

A tongue-in-cheek adventure about a pin-up photographer who explores the streets of Sala City, meets quirky characters, and photographs ten girls in time to save a magazine, all set to a funky, upbeat soundtrack.

Full Ace Tennis Simulator aims for detailed, physics-driven tennis with accurate ball trajectory, collision, and friction, playable online or offline. Players can customize characters and abilities, progress through a career with training and retirements, and use extensive modding options for animations, outfits, courts, and umpires.

Players become the Slayer in a fast, push-forward first-person campaign against demon armies invading Earth, using a flamethrower, wrist blade, upgraded guns and glory kills, plus a 2-versus-1 multiplayer mode.

A turn-based 4X strategy game set in the ancient Mediterranean, where the player rules one of twenty factions, managing war, trade, diplomacy, politics and culture to conquer the world or build an empire.

Move into the shady town of Lakeview Valley as a new homeowner, solving or ignoring the murder of a local girl while befriending over twenty scheduled NPCs. Renovate your home, commit crimes without leaving evidence, defend yourself from night horrors, and reach multiple endings shaped by moral choices.

Players run a fledgling soviet-style republic, controlling mining, manufacturing, services, trade, and infrastructure while balancing rubles and dollars between Eastern and Western blocs. Deep interconnected simulations of supply chains, utilities, and citizen loyalty let players shape every facet of city life and economic growth.

Players race as teams of Sonic characters, sharing power-ups and speed boosts to outpace rival teams across varied tracks. The arcade racer offers online and split-screen multiplayer, vehicle customization, and an adventure mode introducing characters and mechanics.

The player runs a sheriff's department in a cold border town, managing cops with personal problems, investigating and interrogating suspects, and leading turn-based tactical operations where a single bullet can kill, all within a story-driven noir drama.

A Touhou doujin strategy game where a strange cup appears in Gensokyo and sparks a big fight. Players select from over 50 characters, practice strategy, and command their forces across two scenarios, with adjustable difficulty for beginners and advanced players.

You command a desert craft crewed by mice on an alien planet, navigating dunes to find treasure, crafting items, and constructing rooms to power up your squeaking subordinates while exploring ancient ruins and wilderness.

A digital jigsaw puzzle game featuring 19 illustrations in a Moe and Kawaii Japanese art style. Players assemble puzzles across three difficulty levels with conveniences like auto-save, optional piece rotation, and a peripheral-piece display, then view completed artwork in a gallery mode.

A grand World War II strategy game spanning the entire globe, letting players command major and minor nations across a massive map, manage unique unit types, and resolve historical decision events in singleplayer or multiplayer.

The player runs a construction company in the open world of Westside Plains, driving over 40 licensed vehicles to complete more than 60 jobs such as road repair, bridge rebuilding and building construction. Expanding regions and fleets grows the business.

Players run and expand a farm in American and European environments, driving hundreds of licensed vehicles and tending livestock including pigs, cows, sheep, chickens, and horses. The simulation offers open-world exploration, new crops like cotton and oat, and online multiplayer with mod support.

A point-and-click action RPG in which the demon Wilfried leads a ragtag army to reclaim the region of Groessen from three invading witches who transformed its people into stuffed animals, battling with wind and fire magic and stripping the witches in the process.

A side-scrolling hack-and-slash action game set in a zombie-overrun Tokyo. Hisako, a girl raised underground, travels to the surface to find a school, fighting monsters and customizing weapons from collected parts while exploring districts like Shinjuku and Akihabara.

A visual novel episode in which Lieutenant Tatsunami Hibiki, having secured a truce, faces a peace conference in Seattle threatened by France's nuclear ambitions and a fast-growing alien BETA Hive. Players read through a war story of human factions and alien invaders.

An alien girl trapped in a cave cannot fight the monsters around her, so she befriends them through love instead. Each run presents random boss battles at varying difficulty levels, and defeated monsters grant gifts that upgrade her heart for the rest of the run.

Players command Squad E of the Federation in a desperate war, leading young Commander Claude Wallace and his friends through snowy battlefields against imperial soldiers and the Valkyria. Battles blend overhead turn-based strategy, RPG progression, and real-time third-person shooting, framed by a hand-drawn watercolor story of wartime friendship.

A dungeon-crawling RPG following swordswoman Makina as she explores the ruins beneath the city of Gardona, descending floor by floor to fight enemies and bosses. The city serves as a base for restocking and meeting characters while she investigates the strange behavior of its citizens.

A detailed operational wargame covering iconic and hypothetical battles from the early 20th century to the modern day. Players command troops and terrain across over 200 scenarios, with revised naval warfare, an enhanced supply system, and AI assistance for large battles.

Felana, a historian oppressed by the Endless Court's anti-scholarship edicts, is drawn into a brewing war among Immortals as her forbidden knowledge becomes relevant. The player explores dungeons, customizes a party through equipment-based skills, and uncovers a twisting storyline.

As an ordinary adventurer in the world of Aurai, the player crosses untamed lands, endures harsh weather, disease, hunger and thirst, and fights creatures in hidden dungeons. The RPG survival experience supports solo or co-op play, plus spellcasting, enchanting and rebuilding a refugee camp into a city.

In a ruined future Tokyo, the player climbs the Tower of Barbs in underwear, fighting and sneaking past foes, scavenging weapons and eating odd creatures to survive, with death resurrecting fighters as enemies and rage moves finishing opponents.

Players learn to sail a yacht through interactive tutorials covering raising sails, tacking, reefing, mooring and anchoring, then explore the Shearwater Islands, take on races, treasure hunts and obstacle courses, or practice skills before crewing a real boat.

Players pick two of thirteen fighters and brawl through Last Resort Island, a city where violence is entertainment, using combos, finishing moves, and environmental objects like cars and helicopters to please crowds. The remastered action game follows Ranma and Michiru's rise toward becoming the island's strongest.

Playing documentary host Nigel Wimble, the player explores the bedroom of a man isolated for thirty years, selecting on-theme items and scenes to assemble a short documentary, then watches it unfold and sees the focus group's reaction in this brief cartoon-like experience.

Players build a railroad empire across 19th-century North America, laying tracks, digging tunnels, and connecting settlements while trading goods, researching technology, and lobbying politicians. Strategy and resource planning drive competition against AI or online players, with a sandbox mode for pure network growth.

An official motocross racing game where players tune bike suspension, brakes and throttle, practice in an open Compound, and build a career from MX2 to MXGP champion. It features Pro Physics, official 2017 tracks and riders, and free-form practice challenges.

Players lead an army of Daughters, echoes of a great warrior, against nightmarish creatures born of humanity's crimes in tactical turn-based battles. Sacrificing one Daughter to heal another strengthens survivors, and failure leads to returning with lost powers to face new nightmares.

In an alternate Hero Town where the Dragon Ball Heroes card game is the dominant pastime, players create an avatar, build decks, and battle through tactical card confrontations and missions to become world champion and restore peace when virtual villains invade reality.

A starship builder and commander game where the player designs ships module by module, manages individually simulated crew, and commands fleets in physics-driven real-time tactical battles while exploring a procedurally generated galaxy alone or in online co-op.

A visual novel about the unlikely romance between a high-class student council president and an average classmate, sparked by their shared love of anime in Akihabara. Player choices lead to either a tender love story or a passionate tale.

Players control a corporation competing to terraform Mars into a habitable planet by spending resources and applying technology to raise temperature, build atmosphere, and create oceans. They play project cards, build production, place cities and greenery on the map, and race rivals for milestones and awards.

Set five years after a nuclear disaster in a fictional quarantine zone of Northern England, players explore, scavenge, craft and fight through cults and government agencies while investigating an interwoven mystery, with scarce ammo and hand-to-hand combat demanding careful resource management.

A first-person humorous simulation where the player takes the role of a new mother who must feed, change, and soothe her baby through increasingly difficult levels, testing reflexes and nerves for the reward of the baby's smile.

Ren is mistakenly moved into a special dormitory housing a group of incompetent demons, including his succubus childhood friend and his stepsister, and becomes their assistant. His days are spent managing the troublesome, flirtatious antics of the girls in a comedic romance.

Muv-Luv is a visual novel collecting two arcs: a high school romantic comedy in which Takeru is caught between his childhood friend and a mysterious heiress, and a darker alternate timeline where humanity fights alien invaders, setting up a larger saga.

A visual novel sequel in which a young man in a war-torn alternate reality joins a secret UN project against alien invaders, navigating conspiracies, espionage, and parallel worlds. The story is an epic, emotionally heavy finale to a trilogy, with choices affecting scenes.

A virtual reality boxing game where players train with Manny Pacquiao through mitt work, dummy hitting, speed ball, and heavy bag drills, then fight opponents with five AI difficulty levels or in real-time multiplayer matches.

Players lead demon rebel Killia and his army against Overlord Void Dark across the Netherworlds in tactical, grid-based battles. The strategy RPG offers hundreds of hours of content, over-the-top humor, unit recruitment, item crafting, and extensive customization systems.

Race official GT3 cars against real drivers, teams, and laser-scanned circuits in a photorealistic simulation of the GT World Challenge. Compete in sprint, endurance, and 24-hour events solo or online, managing tyres, aerodynamics, and car systems.

A short kinetic novel about Tim, a boy whose long-standing hatred for a girl shaped his life until they parted ways. Meeting her again as an adult revives that destructive relationship and forces him to face its consequences, told through a linear narrative.

A simulation of a randomly generated galaxy where space empires wage wars, research technology, build ships and artifacts, and rise and fall, which the player can watch in observer mode, experiment with in sandbox mode, or steer directly in emperor mode.

A tactical real-time strategy game following the US 1st Infantry Division through Tunisia, Sicily and Normandy from 1942 to 1944, commanding squads, armor and artillery support across linked operations with realistic 3D movement and projectile physics.

Scientists link a psychic to cursed objects, and the player enters the nightmare of Henrietta Kedward, a malicious old woman, to uncover her history and stop the evil she embodies. Each playthrough shifts, demanding attention, logic, and tolerance for scares.

After drowning in a shipwreck, Morgan wakes in a world of monster girls where three suitors each demand he choose a wife within days. The player reads through a visual novel, making choices across four endings.

Eight members of a school Broadcasting Club return from a disastrous field trip to find their school deserted, and must repair their friendships and finish a rooftop antenna to reach other survivors while reliving the same week. The visual novel follows multiple routes over a looping summer.

A romantic comedy visual novel where the player joins a school games club after being kicked out of the computer room, befriending and dating a cast of nerdy girls including a childhood friend, a student council president, and a girl who pretends to be a robot.

This strategy game covers World War II through open-ended campaigns from the 1939 invasion of Poland to D-Day, plus Pacific Theatre battles across a large map. Players command major and minor nations, manage units and terrain in land and naval combat, and use a powerful editor with scripted events.

An RC quadcopter racing simulator offering line-of-sight and first-person flying with self-leveling, acro, and 3D flight modes. Players adjust input, camera, and physics settings, fly across nine sceneries, and build custom tracks with the included level editor.

A visual novel about music student Azusa, who is obsessed with the campus queen Mamiko. A mysterious figure named Venus offers to bring them together if Azusa proves her devotion through questionable tasks, leading into intrigue and deception.

Players command civilizations through a thousand years of history, building economies and armies across campaigns and online matches. The remastered edition adds 4K visuals, a remastered soundtrack, three expansions, and over forty-five civilizations to master.

As a disgraced one-armed warrior bound to protect a young lord in late 1500s Sengoku Japan, the player uses prosthetic tools, ninja abilities, stealth and visceral sword combat to take revenge against the Ashina clan in a dark, brutal world.

A protagonist wakes in an unfamiliar laboratory and must escape a dangerous building filled with creatures that can plunder his body, using only simple movement and sprinting. Players solve action puzzles, evade chases, learn creature behavior through failure, and uncover a mystery through exploration and multiple outcome lines.

A standalone expansion to the RTS/RPG SpellForce 3 in which a disgraced General returns to Nortander to gather allies against a hatemonger threatening the Dwarven realm and a Dark Elf cult harvesting souls, building heroes via skilltrees and leading armies in sector-based real-time battles.

The player runs a Victorian London business empire, recruiting and managing powerful executives while dating a cast of gentlemen and ladies, fighting rivals, and rebuilding a stolen family company through a replayable campaign with multiple romantic options.

Oakwood Academy of Spells and Sorcery is an adult visual novel in which the player takes the role of first-year student Thomas Middleton, meeting a cast of wacky characters at a magical academy. Choices lead down multiple routes and more than sixteen endings, presented with character artwork, backgrounds, and CG scenes.

Players control one of eight clones exploring flooded ruins and dungeons to uncover the deadly sins of their pasts, hunting materials and food while fighting monsters in real-time battles, all within a 13-day life cycle that resets with each death.

Set in an alternate 1897 Britannia, players investigate a fog-shrouded manor whose servants have gone violently mad, fighting them with a cane-sword and hand cannon while healing with concoctions and uncovering cosmic truths that test their sanity.

A visual novel in which Hiroki returns to the Ogasawara Islands for summer, meets a runaway blonde girl chasing sunken treasure and a childhood friend, and dives toward a legendary ghost ship. Player choices branch into character-specific routes amid tropical island scenery and underwater exploration.

The player manages a small talent agency, training young pop idols, hiring and firing staff, and handling scandals, feuds, and PR crises. They grow fanbases, produce singles and concerts, expand the agency building, and make branching decisions in visual novel substories with lasting consequences.

A 2D adventure with RPG elements where Erin arrives in the town of Azuliris chasing a witch, must free the town from bandits, and explores dungeons, castles, and mazes while fighting enemies with weapons and magic.

Maria, a plain herbalist, resolves to earn a fortune and marry after her mentor rejects her. Players explore forests and mines for materials, craft and sell items with herbalism, and woo five rugged middle-aged men in this otome visual novel with Japanese voice-over.

Set in an alternate 1920s Europe recovering from the Great War, players command dieselpunk mechs and three factions across more than 20 missions in three campaigns, plus co-op and competitive multiplayer, conquering resource points, building bases and using cover and stealth tactics.

Set in 1898 in a remote hotel with a macabre Welsh folklore history, players use stealth and a defensive sound device to avoid a cult of sound-based enemies, uncovering a supernatural mystery tied to a family empire built on torture, slavery, and piracy.
An RTS classic set during the Gallic Wars, letting players command Romans or Gauls in strategic conquest or follow Larax seeking revenge on the tribes that raided his village and killed his wife.

A fantasy real-time strategy game set in the world of Equiada, where players pick among three major races and subjugate smaller nations in strategy mode, or control heroes and a small squad through a multi-generational story in adventure mode, uncovering artifacts and the rise and fall of kingdoms.

Claire, a treasure hunter with hero blood, travels to Alstroemeria seeking a wish-granting treasure while a villain also hunts it. Players take guild quests, explore the world, upgrade gear and outfits, befriend a quirky cast, and experience story events that can change depending on who they befriend.
A visual novel in which a young man takes in cat-eared and bunny-eared ninja girls who arrive to serve him under an ancient contract, leading to a heartfelt tale of daily life, action and mystery.

A pixel-art adventure set in a cyberpunk city, following a veteran cop turned detective investigating a murder tied to a robot rebellion and an old serial case. Players examine evidence, solve environmental puzzles, and control a cat assistant to reach hidden areas.

A short RPG adventure where the hero Jacob searches an eternal forest for nuts, fighting monsters in turn-based combat, leveling up, shopping, and exploring a dimensional map to uncover hidden things.

A short romantic visual novel in which the player draws their own dream date and everything around them, flirting, seducing, and eventually marrying their creation across a drama-filled story with two love interests and multiple endings.

After your military plane crashes in war-torn Andarushia in 1925, you use your military knowledge to lead a band of inexperienced survivors to safety, commanding a customizable squad in mixed real-time and turn-based battles.

A deliberately crude 2D walking simulator in which the player is trapped in a room with a locked door and must find and use objects to escape. It is a short, self-deprecating demo with multiple endings, achievements and original music.

After crash landing on the dangerous alien planet Alternia, an unnamed protagonist desperately seeks friendship, traveling from underground clubs to mansions and meeting trolls across the social spectrum. The episodic visual novel blends dark comedy with survival on a harsh world.

A turn-based strategy RPG where the player conquers enemy outposts on grid-based maps, commanding many characters through story and optional scenarios. Flexible difficulty, redistributable skill points, and dozens of classes support both careful board-game play and faster pacing.

As an MI6 secret agent in 1942, the player infiltrates enemy territory to assassinate three high-ranking Third Reich figures, fighting through French towns, a Bavarian castle, and a Polish facility while using cover-based shooting against AI-controlled enemy classes.

A twin-stick roguelite brawler set in a grimy 1980s dystopia where the player is an alien parasite who snatches and absorbs over 60 human hosts, using their abilities to fight through procedurally generated streets toward a final apocalyptic button.

A nameless protagonist asks classmate Penny Black on a date at a cinema, and the outing unfolds as a text adventure where players type words to progress. The story spans over 25,000 words with branching choices, hidden options, and multiple endings, all set around a school romance.

As leader of the Phoenix Project, the player researches technology, builds bases, manages resources, and commands soldiers in turn-based tactical battles against a mutating alien menace. Diplomacy with rival factions and a branching narrative shape the campaign across a ravaged Earth.

As Commander of a derelict space station, players develop sectors, maintain three main decks, attract and entertain eight alien races for energy, and defend against invaders, mixing economic simulation, base building and RTS skirmishes with a sarcastic AI narrator.

An action RPG set in the VRMMO world of Alfheim Online, where the player becomes Kirito and, with his friends, sets out to conquer the floating land of Svart Alfheim. Players soar through the skies, fight enemies in fast-paced aerial and ground battles, and choose skills to develop their characters.

As the ruler of Nex, the player gathers and breeds over 700 creatures to fight the tyrannical King of Siralim, exploring randomly generated dungeons, crafting artifacts and spell gems, and battling through endless end-game content to restore peace to Rodia.

A third-person survival horror set in 1998, following an elite soldier, a helicopter pilot, and a forest ranger through a secret research facility incident that turns a small town's citizens into monsters. Players manage scarce ammo, solve environmental puzzles, backtrack, and collect lore items.

A physics-based multiplayer game where players throw balls at each other using parabolic arcs and rebounds rather than straight-line gunfire. Characters have distinct skills, shields deflect shots, and music rhythm fuels abilities across modes like chaos, flag capture, and team play.

A remastered collection of the three classic 1980s dungeon-crawler RPGs, where players build a party and carry it across all volumes to rescue a city, reforge the Destiny Wand, and confront a Mad God. Quality-of-life updates and a legacy mode accompany the retro adventuring.

Play as a bald peasant thug in an open-world, top-down medieval sandbox parodying GTA, completing twisted quests, fighting with swords and crossbows, and causing mayhem on foot or by stolen horse. The tone is crude Monty Python-style comedy full of anachronisms and pop culture references.

Players take charge of a football club as manager, building line-ups, training players, trading on the transfer market, negotiating sponsorships and upgrading the stadium while competing against other real players in live multiplayer matches and national leagues.

A real-time virtual aquarium management game where the player feeds, breeds, and sells over 400 fish species, researches advertising and food, renovates a storefront, and decorates tanks to grow from small merchant to aquatic entrepreneur.

Players take control of national teams and major leagues in intense rugby matches, playing solo or with others locally and online. The game emphasizes tactical depth, letting players adjust game plans, manage line-outs, and initiate set moves to gain an edge on the pitch.

GP Bikes is a realistic motorcycle simulator built on a detailed physics engine simulating tyre models, chassis flex, and dynamic track conditions. Players host or join online races, analyze telemetry data, and customize bikes, with no AI or career mode included.

A first-person puzzle platformer in which the player explores a custom neon world and manipulates the flow of time, stopping it to solve temporal puzzles and overcome platforming challenges. It was created as a student project for educational purposes.

A romantic-comedy visual novel and dating sim where a good-for-nothing squire raises strength, charisma, and intelligence, battles monsters in turn-based combat, and woos five heroines through gifts and dialogue to reach multiple endings.

Players use a Pheromone Shot gadget to exorcise demons possessing swarms of girls, manage a schedule of quests from love-struck academy students, and pursue romance with several characters while using motion controls and a vacuum gadget.

After a serious illness, student Sakiyama Youji returns to school and is plagued by hallucinations of blood and flesh while two classmates take an intense interest in him. This visual novel follows obsession and desperation, with choices shaping the ending.

An action-RPG set in a war-ravaged world where women take up arms after a century of conflict. Players explore dangerous lands, develop skills through rune customization, fight monsters and bandits, escape captivity, and subdue enemies to recruit them as allies.

Practice racing and freestyle tricks with RC quadcopters without risking a real drone crash. Fly in line-of-sight or first-person view across six sceneries and millions of generated tracks, adjusting physics and input settings, with timed races and multiple flight modes.

Players run a campaign to become President of the United States, competing against political opponents in key states and targeting geographic and special interest groups to accumulate the 270 electoral votes needed for victory. Each state carries different campaign costs and electoral values, requiring strategic planning.

As a top agent, the player investigates who froze the city of New Ice York, exploring, interrogating residents, reading whacky dialogues, and solving math and logic puzzles, with side activities like boxing, table tennis, and pool in a surreal multimedia experience.

A visual novel in which special forces soldier Maxx passes through a portal from Earth to the tropical planet Zeliria, home to cat-girls, knights and assassins. Players make choices that shape relationships and events, pursuing multiple character routes toward eleven different endings across roughly fifteen hours.

A visual novel about Rosetta, a girl who dreams of becoming a magician but lacks talent, until a mysterious eastern witch named Zara offers her magic powers in exchange for help fleeing a pursuing princess. Players follow a romantic comedy with multiple endings.

As Captain Nelson, the player explores an isometric colony world, secures scarce resources, and manages rival factions while customizing a party and fighting turn-based battles. A branching storyline with romances and a visual-novel mode lets choices reshape the colony's fate.

Players accelerate through an endless tunnel, dodging spinning obstacles by moving left or right or jumping through gaps. Collecting pickups multiplies score, grants extra lives, boosts speed or shields, and the run continues until all lives are lost.

Set in the classical Mediterranean from Alexander's successor empires to the rise of Rome, players manage populations, characters, armies, and provinces as a grand strategy ruler. They choose government types, battle tactics, military traditions, and trade policies while guarding against barbarians, rebellions, and treacherous governors.

As a ninja marked with cursed tattoos granting heightened senses, players use stealth, agility, and cleverness to outwit opponents across beautifully animated levels. Situations offer choices between ghost-like invisibility and silent assassination, with upgrades, optional objectives, and a New Game Plus mode.

Players control a skateboarder with dual-stick foot controls, learning realistic physics to land tricks in iconic 1990s street spots. There is no scoring; instead they film clips with a video editor, customize skater and board, and complete challenges to earn money for branded gear.

Players fight through crowds of female enemies in a fast-paced side-scrolling beat 'em up controlled entirely with the mouse, customizing attack combinations and equipping skills. Earned SP strengthens the character, and a Custom Battle mode lets players edit stages and choose opponents.

A short first-person narrative adventure in which the player explores the abandoned New Mexico compound of an apocalyptic cult years after a mass suicide, finding notes, recordings, and belongings that reveal who the members were and why they chose to die.

Players become a Reformer tasked with saving the world, using the Soul Alliance skill to defeat enemies, thwart a dark cabal, and collect monster souls as servants while strengthening the Power of Crystals in a retro-styled role-playing adventure.

The player controls a small Trebhum creature on a surreal alien planet, mutating and evolving new abilities to survive predators and explore four biomes while fleeing a colossal rolling cylinder that destroys the world in real time.

A girl born with the mark of a witch hides her identity in a town divided by rival clans and superstition, until the theft of a relic exposes staggering revelations. Players follow a suspenseful romance narrative, using a flowchart to revisit choices and pursue multiple endings.

Waking from cryo sleep on the derelict ship Von Braun in 2114, the player explores deck by deck, fighting hybrid mutants and robots while unraveling the crew's fate and stopping the rogue AI SHODAN. Three military branches support different playstyles, with co-op multiplayer and mod support.

Clementine, now a capable survivor, reaches the final chapter of her journey, protecting a secluded school and raising orphaned AJ. Players make consequential choices, fight the undead, and determine how her story ends.

Seria, a kingdom knight, investigates a mirage-like labyrinth where villagers vanish and starved demons roam. Players analyze enemies, use skills, items, and commands to survive traps and monsters, and explore with auto-mapping to solve the mystery and escape the dungeon.

Players command armies of great powers across Europe in the War of Spanish Succession and the Great Northern War, managing supplies, fatigue, sieges, and battlefield tactics. The game spans over 5,000 regions with historical leaders, unit types, production, and decision cards.

Players build, staff, and expand a fantasy tavern in the world of Delcrys, managing supply chains, recipes, and customer groups in real time. A campaign mode adds political intrigue and a branching story, while sandbox mode focuses purely on running the business and economy.

As Harman Smith, the player switches between seven distinct assassin personalities to hunt down a sinister foe and his suicide-bomber organization, fighting through a dark revenge tale that mixes first- and third-person shooting with puzzles and secret-finding.

The player controls Coop, an unpopular orphan navigating high school in the Cyanide & Happiness universe, in a point-and-click adventure. Players look at, talk to, and touch everything, complete side quests for Netherton's citizens, and collect costumes and secrets while enduring bullies and absurd humor.

As a woman searching for her missing brother, players explore the shifting environments of a secretive government agency invaded by a corruptive presence. Using transforming weaponry and telekinetic powers, they battle a relentless enemy through missions and boss fights, turning surroundings into weapons.

A kinetic visual novel entry in the Grisaia series, following Class A students after a terrorist incident as Yuuki returns and Murasaki questions her purpose. Told without branching routes, it mixes present drama with memories of Haruto's first meeting with Murasaki.

After getting lost on a school trip, Takuma and his friends are transported to a dangerous world of monsters and Digimon. Players explore, recruit allies through persuasion, and fight turn-based battles while choices shape relationships, evolutions, and the story's grim outcome.

A co-op MMORTS where up to sixteen players per city gather resources, specialize districts, establish trade routes, and defend shared city-states from barbarians, mixing city building with PvE and PvP tactical combat and Senate politics.

A puzzle-platformer where the player places portals with different properties to solve over 60 stages, earning points to unlock gallery images and skip levels, while following comedic dialogue with an anime companion and customizing how much story to see.

A classic turn-based first-person party RPG in a light fairy-tale fantasy world, where the player assembles seven heroes and explores a large open overworld on a quest against evil, with fast combat, quick travel and no grinding.

As a clone of Admiral Ellys Idaho, the player commands a battleship through a procedurally generated galaxy after the collapse of an empire dependent on god-like machines. Runs involve space exploration, tactical fleet battles, and story events that gradually reveal the truth about the Empire and the clone's identity.

Players adopt a virtual person living inside their computer, guiding them to find a mate, start a family, pursue a career, and earn money. They renovate and expand a house, buy furnishings, and respond to random life events while shaping their character's personality through upgrades and choices.

In a post-apocalyptic American southwest of 2087, the player leads a Desert Ranger investigating a sinister threat, recruiting help and following leads whose outcomes shape the world. This remaster of the 1988 RPG updates graphics, sound, and music while keeping the original storybook.

Three ordinary youths join a bounty hunter for one last adventure as the Age of Dragons ends and the Elder Dragon Kaia seeks to undo her kind's atrocities. Players explore the world, craft items, steal abilities from enemies, and customize gear in turn-based battles without random encounters.

A short visual novel about a high school graduation trip in a world where students lose most memories after graduation. Players follow three storylines as friends try to preserve their bonds through walks, hot springs, tower climbs, and fireworks, weighing whether to give up memories or endure.

Players lead a Riders clan through a Bronze Age world of gods and spirits, making long-term decisions across hundreds of interactive story scenes, managing resources, raiding neighbors, and building a multi-generational tale of survival and alliances.

A former cop hunts down the drug dealers and crime bosses behind his father's murder, sneaking through six dark levels to assassinate targets, steal disguises, hide bodies, and use distractions, with no checkpoint saves and multiple routes through each mission.

The official Supercross championship game lets the player live a rider's career through weekly agenda activities, train in the Compound, race over 80 official riders, customize bikes and avatars, and build and share tracks.

A turn-based tactical game set five years after XCOM 2, where an elite squad of human and alien agents works to stop underground threats in City 31, using breach-and-clear combat, interleaved turns, and a strategy layer managing HQ operations.

Players drive a high-speed commuter train on a tight schedule while taking side gigs, earning money, and exploring the city. They shop, furnish homes, manage properties via smartphone, and relax at clubs, arcades, and casinos.

Players command sentient penises in arena battles against friends, building up power to trigger special abilities and using dynamic environments to bounce, sneak, and transform terrain. Progression unlocks items to customize and decorate characters in this comedic multiplayer fighting game made by two hobbyist developers.

Rookie officer Leon Kennedy and student Claire Redfield navigate a zombie-infested Raccoon City, exploring dark corridors, solving puzzles, and fighting grotesque enemies in separate campaigns. The rebuilt survival horror classic uses an over-the-shoulder camera and photorealistic visuals.

A remastered edition of the classic Rome strategy game with updated 4K visuals, modern camera and interface features, and expanded mechanics. Players command armies and manage factions across a campaign map, now with 38 playable factions, a new merchant agent type, and cross-platform multiplayer battles.

An Atelier anniversary title blending town-management simulation with RPG elements, where the player governs and expands a town alongside legendary alchemists, collaborating with returning characters in a slice-of-life atmosphere while building the settlement's success.

Players start as a humble cook with a small restaurant and build a gastronomic empire, choosing locations, layouts, staff, menus and policies. They create an avatar, level skills, design recipes in a recipe editor, and specialize in meat, seafood, vegetarian or vegan cuisine in sandbox or story mode.

A slice-of-life RPG about Yukino, a clumsy student who falls for an aspiring doctor and takes a part-time job to pay graduate school admission fees while living with her uncle. The story follows her romance and choices, with a job system, clothing options, and multiple endings.

Players command fleets of customizable space warships in simulation-heavy tactical combat, managing radar, electronic warfare, weapons and positioning across three-dimensional battlespaces. Battles unfold in single and multiplayer skirmishes or a narrative campaign where fuel, munitions and ships are limited.

A single-player 2D action platformer themed around fireworks, following a squirrel-girl named Hanaby as she travels through varied worlds to pass her forest's coming-of-age ordeal. Fireworks serve both to hit enemies and to glide, and the simple jump controls support a mild story plus a speedrun mode.

Players lead a chosen deity in a turn-based 4X fantasy strategy game, exploring a randomly generated map, founding cities, gathering resources, defeating monster lairs and rival armies in tactical battles, and researching spells across ten schools of magic while customizing units and items.

Shinobi students at rival Japanese academies fight for honor, family, and friends in a 3D remake of the original SENRAN KAGURA Burst, using parries, a Burst Gauge, and hidden Top Secret Files to uncover the girls' daily lives.

In the idyllic virtual world of Mobius, created by a sentient vocaloid program, students relive high school in bliss until something feels wrong. The player joins the Go-Home Club to escape the false paradise, befriending hundreds of students and fighting turn-based battles with the Imaginary Chain system.

A short-story collection split between the lighthearted Muv-Luv Extra school romance timeline and the grim Alternative war timeline, following heroines through epilogues, training memories, and combat test flights as they face awkward relationships, boot camp, and encounters with the BETA.

A compilation of three Muv-Luv visual novel spinoffs: a Japanese cadet joins an eccentric British TSF battalion, an undercover EU agent investigates a base, and Takeru returns to a romantic comedy world. Players read through branching stories mixing military drama and harem comedy.

A snarky oni named Xavienne gathers two companions and journeys to hell and back to rescue her missing best friend, a princess, in a short RPG with tactical turn-based party combat, three playable characters, and two character-driven story decisions leading to different endings.

Clementine, a novice priestess of the Spirit of Aqua, explores a side-scrolling world and fights demons using water-based abilities gained through exploration rather than EXP grinding. A mysterious evil power approaches the Temple of Aqua as she grows stronger.

A demon of bad taste named Nate must gather disgusting ingredients for Satan's birthday pie, exploring four large worlds with an angel chained to him that serves as grappling hook and weapon. The game is a crude 3D mascot platformer with collectibles and outfits.

Players take control of an abandoned Soviet cosmodrome and assemble rockets from modular parts, then launch and fly them or plan automated missions across a scale-model Solar System with NASA-derived planet surfaces and a simulated atmosphere.

A student moves to a new town and reopens his grandmother's shuttered café with a childhood friend, hiring two girls as part-time staff; the youthful visual novel follows the bittersweet story across two routes with fully voiced Japanese dialogue.

Players follow Anna as she explores the upper and lower districts of the Water City, Somonden, uncovering the truth behind a defilement afflicting its people. The classic RPG story mixes mystery, drama, and intrigue in a post-apocalyptic world, with experience gained through good deeds rather than grinding.

Cassius is forced to live with Maia, the ex who vanished and has now returned still considering them a couple, and Ava, his best friend who stayed to help him heal, as the three navigate shifting relationships and decide where his heart belongs.

Sable, a human student at a magic academy, is dragged by his half-dragon friend Drakan to her home for the holidays, where her mother forces a cursed necklace on him and sets trials. This visual novel continues the series with choices leading to four endings.

An aristocratic knight named Luna abandons her rank to live as a mercenary in the Free City, but is enslaved and must escape captivity while uncovering and thwarting a great evil. The RPG follows her through a fantasy world with side quests, stealth, and day-night cycles.

After victory in the Free City, Luna and her allies push toward the Imperial Capital but she is captured by a superior foe, forcing her to escape captivity again in this fantasy prison-escape RPG featuring stealth, upgradeable equipment and a day-night cycle.

Vincent juggles a girlfriend and a mysterious blonde in a romantic horror tale, while at night he climbs nightmarish block towers, pushing and pulling blocks to escape monsters, with branching story paths and competitive puzzle modes.

A darkly comic puzzle sandbox in which the player rules train stations across time and space, staging derailings, explosions and other mayhem to fulfill Death's wishes, with a normal puzzle-quest mode and a freeform chaos mode.

As director of a magic university in a colorful fantasy world, the player builds a school, manages budgets, recruits teachers, and selects students. An original deck mechanism shapes each unique university, while choices in events affect factions and the school's future.

A visual novel set on a quiet island where the player follows a cast of characters through an emotional summer story, with character routes, voice acting, and an original soundtrack by Jun Maeda and others.

In a future Earth inhabited only by robots who fear humans as monsters, the player controls newcomer D-Tritus to investigate brutal murders committed by a human on the loose, hacking into fifteen characters, flying combat ships, and completing over 140 missions across the robot city.

A supernatural-noir FMV murder mystery in which the player is a detective who can shapeshift into other characters to unlock secret conversations and private encounters while investigating the death of Dorota Shaw and three tarot-reading suspects, with a randomly chosen murderer each playthrough.

A tactical RPG crossover where players command giant robots from many mecha anime series on battle maps, alternating ally and enemy phases, then using earned resources during intermission to train pilots and upgrade machines between chapters.

Players command WWII powers—Allies or Axis—in the official digital adaptation of the Axis & Allies 1942 board game, rolling dice and moving armies in asynchronous turn-based matches against friends, ranked opponents, or AI, with tutorials and hot-seat play.

A prequel visual novel episode in which the catgirls Chocola and Vanilla, still kittens, arrive at the Minaduki household, grow close to their master Kashou, share their first Christmas, and make a promise with him.

A realistic cinematography simulator where players use real-world film equipment to light and photograph environments built in Unreal Engine 4, freely creating scenes and sets in a single-player sandbox.

A visual novel following a young man at an academy for Fairy Fight dogfights who joins an all-female dorm and forms a mismatched team. Players read through a story of wartime planes and romance with four heroines.

Summoned to the magical world of Granvania as God's Gift, Itsuki forms bonds with twelve Star Maidens and raises Star Children to battle Impurities in positioning-based party combat through transforming Stardust Labyrinths.

A real-time strategy game recreating East Asian castle economies, where players command Mongol, imperial, and samurai forces to besiege castles across historical campaigns, skirmish trails, and multiplayer maps while recruiting and upgrading AI warlords.

A visual novel in which a student receives a device from his late father that lets him travel between parallel worlds. He revisits timelines, carries items between them, and romances characters to uncover the mystery beneath Sword Cape and prevent a calamity.

A free RPG Maker puzzle-adventure horror game set partly in WWII Krakow, following a psychiatric patient and a memoryless demon named Luna in a dark place facing an ancient evil. Players solve challenging puzzles and reach one of four endings.

Players defend a Russian provincial nightclub from waves of monsters, shooting enemies with an arsenal ranging from pistols to grenade launchers, earning money to buy new gear, and fighting bosses alone or in online co-op with up to four players.

A kinetic visual novel follows protagonist Aoi Ichitaro after he is evicted and moves in with his coworker Hiwa, the girl he has long admired. As they share daily life, awkwardness gives way to mutual feelings and a sweet romance unfolds without branching routes.

Players build and manage Victorian-era cities, balancing industrial progress with residents' needs by optimizing supply chains, planning urban districts, using electricity and steam, running expeditions, and building trade networks across distant lands while shaping their legacy.

You shape your own religion as a god, mixing tenets and traditions to define your worshippers' morality, guiding disciples through turn-based auto-battler sacraments against rival faiths, and expanding your holy site with temples and rituals in a mythical Meso-American world.

A retro point-and-click comedy adventure where Lancelot is sent by God to find the Holy Grail, fill it with booze, and throw England's biggest party, solving silly inventory puzzles and drunk mini-games across a medieval France full of absurd characters.

As a game detective in 22nd-century Warsaw City, players investigate crimes inside virtual worlds, gathering intel from witnesses and suspects through dialogue and deduction, shaping their character and professions through choices in a non-combat isometric RPG.

A traditional digital jigsaw puzzle featuring eighteen 'Sexy & Kawaii' illustrations in a Japanese cultural style. Players assemble puzzles on screen with auto-save, selectable backgrounds, and no need for physical space or worry about losing pieces, then view completed artwork anytime.

Players follow eight travelers across the world of Orsterra, each with their own story and side quests, using distinctive Path Actions and a turn-based combat system that rewards targeting enemy weaknesses, with decisions shaping each character's path.

An action fighting game based on the anime KILL la KILL, following Satsuki Kiryuin through a new alternate story. Players battle various characters using normal attacks, guards, and break attacks in a rock-paper-scissors style system.

A one-on-one competitive online game blending turn-based strategy with MOBA-style heroes. Players summon armies of legendary heroes with unique abilities, control three heroes at once, and use terrain and positioning to destroy the opponent's castle, with no randomness and league-based matchmaking.

A fan disc of six standalone stories, including prologue and epilogue, following Aoi and the Soaring Club in the windy town of Kazegaura as they pursue their dream of flying gliders to the far side of the clouds, with no branches or common routes.

A third-person roguelite action RPG with soulslike combat where a Yotun warrior explores procedurally generated dungeons to heal the dying Father Tree, wielding symbiotic weapons and bio-mutations against bizarre monsters, with permadeath and upgrades that benefit successive troll warriors.

Players join a four-player co-op campaign as immune survivors fighting hordes of parasite-infected Ridden in a post-apocalyptic world, using customizable characters, weapons, and a roguelite card system while a dynamic director adjusts enemy encounters, plus competitive PvP modes.

Players choose a protagonist and two companions from six characters and adventure across a fantasy world to stop evil forces from freeing the Benevodons and withering the Mana Tree. The 3D remake adds class changes, an abilities system, and expanded action battles, with the story shifting based on the party chosen.

A group of youngsters with memory loss find themselves trapped in a mansion in the woods with no way out, slowly recalling their past as they explore rooms like a library and instrument room. The story is a suspenseful visual novel with a mysterious, dark atmosphere.

Players race high-speed on- and off-road vehicles across more than sixty events in six environments, from icy mountains to deserts and beaches. The rally crossover offers a non-linear career, extensive car customization, realistic damage and physics, plus numerous multiplayer modes and maps with AI drivers that react emotionally.

Adapted from the card game Love Letter, players draw and play two-card hands to send letters to a princess, using guards, priests, princes, and other court characters to discredit rivals, bluff, and read opponents, competing in single-player, private, or online multiplayer matches.

A short, experimental slice-of-life comedy point-and-click game about the crushing weight of daily routine. Players click through a roughly ten-minute branching story with hand-drawn graphics, aiming for a few laughs and possibly tears along the way.

A student is possessed by a ghost girl who shares her body with six other spirits, each granted seven days before passing on. With his childhood friend's exorcism skills, he helps each girl spend her final days without regret, unaware of what awaits him.

Based on a simulation of the global war on terror, players take either the US side, neutralizing terrorist cells and encouraging democratic reform, or the Jihadists spreading fundamentalist rule. Card-driven events fuel asymmetrical play across campaigns, with tutorials and asynchronous online multiplayer.

Players command empires from Europe, Asia, and the Americas in a real-time strategy game with Home City cards and 18 civilizations. They relive historical battles in co-op scenarios, sharpen skills in Art of War challenges, and fight across 30 new maps.

A casual jigsaw puzzle game where players assemble images of young women, import their own local pictures to build custom albums, and use digital hints, with customizable music and no language barrier.

A drift racing game where players join professional drift competitions on famous tracks, competing online against real players with realistic physics, extensive car tuning and styling, and support for wheels, VR, and multi-monitor setups.

A visual novel in which an ordinary woman is summoned into the fantasy MMO world of Asaph Online and becomes Viola, a feared dark witch with vast powers, free at last from her mundane life and free to have some fun with her devoted maid and companions.

A survival simulation where the player learns real-world techniques by doing, reading tides, weather, and animal behavior across beach, jungle, and mangrove biomes, crafting with a two-hand system while managing calories, exhaustion, and wetness.

An alchemist must save her atelier from closure by fulfilling quarterly kingdom requests over three years, using synthesis, exploration, and battle to earn recognition and popularity, with multiple endings depending on performance.

Totori becomes an adventurer to search for her missing mother across the world of Arland, earning adventurer points through battle, exploration and quests to raise her rank and reach new lands while forming bonds with her companions.

A role-playing game where Princess Meruru uses alchemy to develop her small frontier kingdom of Arls within a time limit. Players synthesize items, explore, and battle to fulfill citizens' requests, earn development points, and build new facilities to grow the country.

A young woman with the supernatural ability to absorb and manipulate others' emotions investigates her brother's suspicious death in a small town, making dialogue choices, forging friendships or romance, and roaming the streets of Haven Springs while uncovering buried secrets.

A visual novel set in a mountain community where the protagonist inherits a shrine and spends his days listening to the troubles of Tatarigami goddesses who spread misfortune. When he helps one goddess, she proposes marriage, and rival goddesses compete for his hand as he solves their problems.

As a delegate of a magician council and newly appointed tutor to three royal princes, the player navigates court politics after the king's murder. Choices shape whether the princes are guided to power or the player falls to intrigue and assassins.

Five friends on a diving holiday encounter something sinister and end up aboard a ghost ship. Players make choices that decide which characters live or die in this branching cinematic horror game, playable alone or with friends online and offline.

Players return to a vibrant post-apocalyptic Hope County, Montana, 17 years after a nuclear catastrophe, and fight the Highwaymen and their leaders, the Twins. They recruit allies, upgrade a homebase, craft weapons and gear, and battle for resources alone or in two-player co-op.

Judgement 7, a team of young game developers, test an augmented reality program in Asakusa and find characters from their own games bleeding into reality, threatening to overwrite the city. Players follow Reiji through a story between fiction and reality, reacting quickly to timed emotional dialogue choices.

Set during the fourth Witch War, players control missionary sisters Semilla and Fran as they fight through an Inquisition-torn fantasy world to stop a forbidden witches' ceremony, using swordplay, spells, dodge-rolls and parries while leveling their characters.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland on planet Nexus, the player explores handcrafted ruins and deserts, fighting machines and monsters in real-time combat or talking their way through with dialogue choices. Stealth, crafting, inventory management, and character customization support a story campaign with optional local co-op.

A fast-paced racing and platforming game where players use rocket boots to jump, wall-run, flip, and fly through over 70 levels across four worlds. Players can build and share tracks, race ghosts, and compete online in real-time PvP.

A student in the artificial city of Senba is pressured into investigating a series of student disappearances on campus. Partner with a detective or a strange classmate, follow branching choices, and uncover the darker secrets hidden within the city.

Players command Rabbit or Pig armies in real-time tank battles across two single-player campaigns and multiplayer matches, using tanks, scout vehicles, artillery, and air support. Units can be upgraded with special abilities, and there is no base building, only direct combat.

A comedic indie game about exploring dark fantasies alongside iconic gachimuchi internet characters, presented as an endless journey of self-discovery with animated backgrounds, a soundtrack, and 88 achievements, where losing is impossible and a one-handed mode is offered.

Players join a spaceship crew of 4-15 online or local players, completing tasks to prepare for departure while hidden Impostors sabotage, kill, and deceive; crewmates report bodies, call meetings, and vote to eject suspects, with customization and multiple maps.

A high school student with the ability to see ghosts explores her hometown day and night, hunting spirits with a smartphone camera or melee weapons, completing side quests, and uncovering Indonesian urban legends in a third-person horror adventure.

Dark Envoy is a classic-style RPG where players lead a party of relic hunters through a conflict-torn world divided by technology and magic. Combat blends class-based skill systems with tactical options across five difficulty settings, while choices shape the story and its conclusion.

A psychological horror story set in the late 1980s about Patrick Calman, a man with paranoid schizophrenia who receives a call from his long-missing sister and must choose between staying home or seeking medicine while facing brutal combat and disturbing creatures.

Players build a six-member party of chosen classes, races, and alignments, then delve into dangerous dungeons near a central town hub, fighting vicious monsters in packs and retreating to resupply. Between expeditions they chat with locals, take quests, and bargain for equipment, growing from paupers into a mighty force.

A real-time village simulation in which the player settles a family on the ruined island of Isola, training villagers in skills, farming and fishing for food, crafting resources, solving puzzles, breeding and caring for families, and raising magical pets while random island events reshape the tribe.

Players raise a city from the ground up, laying roads and infrastructure while managing a deep simulation and living economy, balancing budgets, industries, and citizen needs as the metropolis grows and changes through seasons and unexpected events.

A new take on the 2048 puzzle formula where matching tiles gradually removes clothing from a companion character named Mia. The more points you earn, the further she undresses, with added tiles, temporary freezing mechanics, and a dynamic field, plus level progression that unlocks the next stage after partial completion.

A shrine priest, tired of his crossdressing sister's advances, prays for help and accidentally frees a sealed crossdressing goddess who declares herself his wife, sparking a rivalry in this comedic visual novel.

An HD remaster of a classic RPG in which the player selects one of eight protagonists and embarks on an epic adventure shaped by their choices, set in a world threatened every 300 years by the Rise of Morastrum and the legacy of the Archfiend and Matriarch.

Set during the Future War glimpsed in the Terminator films, players fight the machines as a first-person shooter, either running and gunning or sneaking and hacking through Skynet's defenses. They level up skills, scavenge a post-apocalyptic world for scraps to trade and craft, and interact with survivors whose fates can change.

A turn-based strategy wargame recreating World War II across a global hex map, letting the player command the Axis or Allies through a grand campaign and shorter scenarios with fog of war, research, diplomacy and decision events.

Players follow former crusader Theoderich von Akenburg as he hunts the scattered pieces of the Rod of Aaron before his old comrade Ulrich can unite them. The squad-based RTS spans Europe and the Middle East, with hero squads, skill trees, lootable gear, and co-op and competitive modes.

Players craft a defense from Monkey Towers and Heroes to pop waves of invading Bloons across dozens of maps. The tower defense strategy game offers upgrade paths, boss events, co-op play and regular content updates.

Players control four characters each following their own leads over four days to catch the Origami Killer before he claims another victim. This psychological thriller branches on every choice and action, with consequences that can determine who lives and who dies.

Players live the life of Jodie Holmes, a young woman linked to a supernatural entity named Aiden, across a globe-spanning psychological thriller. Choices and actions shape her fate as she faces danger and loss, with both characters playable in solo or local co-op.

A narrative-driven arena RPG in which programmer Eloise Fleming wakes in a cell with three captives and must fight through twenty arena floors to escape. Players build characters across four classes and subclasses, collect loot, and make dialogue choices that shape a personal story with multiple endings.

Build vibrant medieval cities where each character lives an individual life you can observe, growing your empire's wealth and aiming to be remembered as a legendary king. This modernized edition includes the main game and The Eastern Realm expansion.

Players build and manage a medieval kingdom, choosing roles such as scientist, merchant, or general while constructing a prosperous settlement amid forests and meadows. The History Edition modernizes the classic strategy experience for Windows 10, letting players shape their kingdom's fate through economic and military decisions.
