Azel, a huntress marked by a beast with a Demon Brand, travels to the frontier town of Niplheim to join the Hunter's Guild and find a way to lift her curse. She hunts monsters, gathers materials, and crafts outfits that grant new abilities, while managing the risk of losing control.

Players ride BMX bikes through 60 levels of increasing difficulty, chaining massive trick combos to climb global leaderboards and earn platinum medals by completing trick challenges. Fifteen riders and a bike designer are included, along with over 40 tricks, 200 challenges and ragdoll physics for crashes.

As journalist Rose Archer, the player explores the Helios, a colossal Tesla-inspired research vessel adrift in 1897 international waters, searching for her missing sister. Grand halls stand empty and a quarantine warning greets her, so she solves puzzles and uncovers hidden collectables to learn the ship's fate.

A lawyer transported into her favorite MMO continues her story in the magical land of Asaph, adventuring with a party of cute girls, taking quests and fighting monsters while wondering who summoned her and whether she wants to return to Japan.

A life simulation where the player runs a lumberjack business, restoring a rundown logging camp, cutting and selling timber, managing an economy, repairing buildings and vehicles, socializing with locals, finding love and founding a family dynasty across an open world.

Playing as an arrogant newspaper club president in post-earthquake Shibuya, players investigate a string of bizarre supernatural murders linked to killings from six years earlier. This visual novel has players choose between nightmares and daydreams to shift perceived reality, with six endings and ties to the Steins;Gate universe.

Lead a small band of renegade cops against a crime boss who controls their town, fighting turn-based tactical battles while short on supplies. Players use stealth, cover, and non-lethal tools, scavenge open sandbox locations, and weigh reputation against ruthless choices.

A visual novel following Alice, a schoolgirl in a photography club who discovers a mysterious young man's diary at a clock tower, opening multiple story routes with her friends. Players choose which story to read via a map system, unlocking a secret ending after completing the game.

A fantasy RPG adventure where the player picks from many classes, tweaks gear, and leads heroes through a tortured world to defeat a narcissist called The Master, with light grinding and a comedic, snarky tone.

This first-person simulator lets players use a toilet, peeing and pooping with a complex liquid system and detailed poop models. It includes destruction, a cursor-based peeing control scheme, cheat codes, a shit-shower summon, and two camera modes, presented as a deliberately absurd experience.

As a paid assassin, players take open-ended sniping contracts in the snowy wilderness of Siberia, eliminating targets for fixed rewards and bonus payouts. Stealth takedowns, drones, remote turrets, and an upgradeable AR mask support strategic play against rival snipers.

As a recruit of an interstellar exploration company, the player surveys the alien planet ARY-26 alone or with a friend, cataloging strange flora and fauna while using a laser pistol, jetpack, and 3D printer to survive its hazards. The tone is comedic and irreverent sci-fi adventure.

Players fight in a roster of new and returning fighters using custom character variations, experiencing a cinematic story mode that continues a saga spanning over twenty-five years. Combat is showcased with a new graphics engine emphasizing brutal, close-up impact.

A bus driving simulation where the player drives licensed buses on US and European maps, transporting passengers safely, optionally managing timetables, routes and bus purchases, alone or in co-op multiplayer.

A collection of six Halo games spanning the Master Chief's saga, offering 67 campaign missions, over 120 multiplayer maps and a Forge map editor, all optimized for PC with customizable settings and support for community-created content.

A confident police officer is framed for her parents' deaths and exiled from a luxurious utopia to steampunk districts below, where she works to clear her name while navigating class divides and growing romances with several men, tracked through an affection scale shaped by player choices.

As commander of emergency services, the player directs police, fire, ambulance and K-9 units across 25 real-time isometric scenarios, from traffic pile-ups and nuclear meltdowns to forest fires, negotiating with extortionists and rescuing victims in a realistic rescue-management simulation.

A remastered open-world action game where the Third Street Saints, now a celebrity brand, take on the Syndicate in the city of Steelport. Players fight through outlandish missions with exotic weapons and vehicles, customize characters, and can play co-op online.

A sandbox mayhem game where the player is an old retiree in a near future that wants them dead. Players perform dangerous challenges, explore for retirement tickets, and use a wide variety of objects to maim and cause chaos, alone or in online multiplayer.

Set in the packed cyberpunk arcology of Veles, players take up arms as an enslaved worker after the ruling corporation collapses. Alone or in co-op, they shoot through destructible districts, customize cyberware, level up skills, and uncover what triggered the catastrophe threatening their district.

Players choose a nation in World War I and balance material production, troops, and weaponry against scarce resources, forging alliances or fighting through the conflict. Up to 500 players compete in real time across historical and fictional scenarios, managing economy, armies, and diplomacy in a grand strategy setting.

A horror adventure in which an amnesiac protagonist marked by a deadly curse arrives at a Tokyo mansion and must search surroundings for clues, confront angry spirits in combat and solve riddles correctly to survive the countdown to death.

After school, the player massages shinobi heroine Asuka's hands in a reflexology minigame, using hands or tools to ease her worries and explore her daydreams. Branching story paths and multiple endings unfold through interactive storytelling, with outfit customization and additional characters available as DLC.

Race official motorcycles across the 2019 MotoGP season and historic eras, competing against machine-learning AI or online rivals, customizing riders and bikes, and developing your machine through a career mode.

Players control Vydija, a demonic succubus betrayed and maimed, who fights through a brutal hellish world to take revenge, using weapons and powers, customizing her appearance and hub, and climbing arenas to reclaim her rule.

As a young Roman Legatus fleeing Rome after his father's murder, the player builds military strength across campaigns in Greece, North Africa, and Gaul. They customize their character, lead companions in tactical turn-based combat, manage a legion and warcamp, and navigate Senate politics where choices shape Rome's fate.

A survival real-time strategy game set in the savage world of Conan the Barbarian, where the player builds a stronghold and fends off waves of invading monstrosities. Heroes with special abilities, resource management, research, and randomly generated maps support solo or co-op play.

A programmer re-enters his abandoned virtual-reality game to rescue a colleague trapped inside, where she must complete a bug-infested world to escape. Players switch between real-world investigation and turn-based battles against glitched monsters, with choices affecting the ending.

Step into the boots of a treasure-seeking Vault Hunter in virtual reality, blasting bandits and psychos across Pandora with procedurally generated guns, four playable classes, vehicles, and new slow-motion and teleport abilities.

As instructor Rean Schwarzer at a new branch military academy, the player trains a fresh Class VII while uncovering a dark plot threatening the Empire. The game pairs a long-running narrative with turn-based combat refined over decades, adding Brave Orders and a Break System, and sends the squad across newly annexed lands to meet old and new characters.

Players command tanks and avatars in turn-based artillery duels, aiming shots while accounting for wind and using terrain and totems for cover. Dozens of tanks, weapons, and avatar skills support varied strategies, and matches can be played against players worldwide on PC or mobile.

A martial arts action RPG following Yejin as he battles through a chaotic world to rescue his sister. Switch between weapons and combo skills, use bloodthirsty powers, and face randomized levels, monsters, and loot after each death.

Neckbreak is a first-person adventure set in Crimson Tide, a corporate-run European mega-city, where an ordinary middle-class citizen leads a routine office life by day and dispenses vigilante justice by night. Missions branch based on choices, mental state, and interactions, with semi-tactical close combat and pill use.

In a fantasy world built on ancient Chinese culture, the player controls characters through a real-time combat RPG, switching stances and dodging while managing stamina, making pacts with creatures, and developing a home base through research and crafting.

A young magic user named Peony travels a vibrant, fractured world where fae and humans uneasily coexist, summoning allies and casting spells in menuless turn-based tactical battles while uncovering the conflicts between the two peoples.

A police simulation game set in the fictional American city of Brighton, where the player patrols neighborhoods, issues tickets, responds to accidents and emergencies, and takes on duties like stopping drug deals, progressing through districts with an intuition system for interrogations.

Players design algae, plants, and animals with traits like glowing flowers or spiked trees, then build ecosystems on procedurally generated planets. Step-by-step scenarios teach the simulation, while sandbox mode adds seasons, random mutations, and evolution as species compete, bloom, and die out over thousands of years.

Players guide Tasi Trianon through the Algerian desert, retracing her shattered past while evading horrific creatures and managing limited physical and mental resources. Puzzles and environmental exploration drive a first-person narrative horror experience, with an Adventure Mode for those avoiding the horror.

Players run a restaurant alone or with friends, learning recipes from world cuisines, designing menus, cooking dishes to order, and decorating the space to attract customers. After service, they relax at a pub with drinks, music, and games.

Players control Brie, a pink-haired girl who can summon cheese sandwiches, exploring dungeons in a party-based JRPG with turn-based combat, time management, dating ten love interests, and minigames across Axon City's districts and shops.

A private detective investigates the disappearance of a boxer and a death at a New York boxing club in a 1950s city of anthropomorphic animals, gathering clues with feline senses, solving puzzles, and making dialogue choices that shape the case's outcome and ending.

Players race through official WRC rallies in an off-road racing game, adapting to dynamic weather, tyre choices, and stage setups. A rebuilt career mode adds calendar management, R&D, and staff recruitment, while weekly challenges and esports support competitive multiplayer.

A century after the Infinity Engine shattered, players recruit allies and champions from four factions, deploy mercenaries for surprise attacks, and rebuild the engine in a deckbuilding card game for two to four players with solo AI and network multiplayer.

A new adventurer arrives in the town of Ecallia beside a shifting dungeon said to imprison a Forsaken God. Players build up the town, recruit and romance over twenty party members, take open-ended quests, and fight through a roguelike dungeon in turn-based JRPG combat, working toward one of several endings.

Burdened by depression, debt and grief, the player chooses among routes involving the mafia, murderers, the church or caretaking, pursuing romance or ruin across twelve character paths, hundreds of choices and dozens of endings in a dark visual novel.

Players manage a Classical Age empire across Europe and the Mediterranean, expanding through conquest or cultural influence while guarding against decadence. They shape government, build structures, grow trade networks, and resolve simultaneous turns, with battles exportable to a companion tactical game.

A free-to-play idle game where the player plays a wizard who trains for combat, casts spells, raises and experiments on a minion, commands demons, explores the wilds, crafts gems, fishes, and runs dungeons, then reincarnates to grow stronger through an endless grind loop.

Lead a group of survivors in a fantasy world inspired by Slavic mythology, building a settlement, gathering resources, and training warriors to defend against monsters that emerge from the growing Darkness each night. Manage settlers' needs, skills, and morale while expanding into new lands to find a way to save the world.

A visual novel side story in which a vampire SS officer recounts his life to an interviewer in a New York vampire bar, tracing his path from World War II battlefields to a final journey to Japan. The narrative spans decades of carnage, nostalgia, and despair.

Blood Rage: Digital Edition adapts the Viking board game in which players lead a clan through three ages before Ragnarök, drafting god gifts, pillaging provinces, battling rival clans, and dying gloriously to earn glory and a place in Valhalla.

A narrative adventure following Frigg, a newcomer apprenticing as a carpenter in a small island town full of complicated residents. Players explore the island, play cards, and experience true stories retold as tall tales blending humor and heartbreak.

Players take the role of physicist Igor returning to the Chernobyl exclusion zone to find his missing fiancée, facing military, stalkers and supernatural creatures. They build a base, craft gear, manage companions and resources, and use stealth or combat across a non-linear story.

Players coach a fantasy football team in the Old World, where brutal matches allow murder, cheating and sorcery. They position players, dodge or eliminate opponents, and score touchdowns, while customizing teams and competing in leagues and a solo campaign.

An idle strategy game where the player develops tiles with production buildings, chooses a pantheon, religion, and god with combinable perks, and hires a customizable hero who fights for tiles. Restarts grant profit and let the player try new strategies as content gradually unlocks.

Return to the classic real-time strategy formula with modernized visuals and gameplay, playing over 40 hours of updated campaigns, competing in up to eight-player online battles, and building custom scenarios in this definitive edition.

Players race the official 2019 Motocross Championship season across worldwide tracks, riding bikes for MXGP and MX2 teams under dynamic weather. They can build and share custom tracks, train in a free-roam playground, and customise riders and bikes with thousands of items.

A roguelike dungeon crawler with item crafting in which players explore randomly generated dungeons through turn-based action, where each step affects events and enemies, presented in an 8-bit retro aesthetic with multiple characters and areas.

Command one of three vampire clans in a dark gothic world, combining empire management and turn-based battles with card-game elements across twelve missions, as four vampire lords pursue their own agendas amid an imminent war.

A trading and strategy game set in the 17th-century Caribbean, where the player governs a colony for Spain, England, France, or the Netherlands. They build production chains, establish trade routes, fulfill viceroy tasks, and fight rival fleets in turn-based naval battles.

A free independent visual novel set in a small village near Osaka in 1997, where a boy who just moved there meets three girls at his new school, one of whom hides a deep secret, and the story branches into three possible endings based on the player's choices.

As heir to a barbarian clan leader in the war-torn fantasy land of Keldonia, the player commands armies in turn-based battles, recruiting and training over 75 unit types, managing terrain, morale and equipment, and making campaign decisions that shape a growing force against rival factions.

A remastered RPG set in a world where humanity has been enslaved by invading Daemons for a thousand years. Players build a party through combat-based skill progression, explore themed realms using ships, beasts, and flying machines, and form alliances with guilds to confront the overlords.

A horror game that relies on atmosphere and suspense rather than jump scares, following a story about a child's fear of bedtime in a small, narrow room, while the player solves puzzles and encounters unfriendly creatures.
Players build and tune a drift car, earn sponsorships, and compete in online tandem drifting battles across real-world tracks to climb leaderboards and become a drift legend.

Players live the life of war hero Vito Scaletta, entangled with the mob in 1940s-50s Empire Bay as he works to pay his father's debts and climb the criminal ladder through crimes of growing reward and consequence.

In 1930s Lost Heaven during Prohibition, cab driver Tommy Angelo is drawn into the Salieri crime family and rises through the ranks of the mob, living a gangster story across a recreated interwar cityscape with expanded story and gameplay.

Players take the wheel as a professional bus driver, transporting passengers through Rio de Janeiro, Munich, and Los Angeles with realistic physics, weather, and day/night cycles, progressing through career and freeride modes or driving with friends online.

The second volume of a supernatural mystery visual novel series, following Kakeru and his sister Sora in the town of Shiromitsugawa as rival groups of Artifact users collide. The story features branching choices, two endings, and full Japanese voice acting.

Players sail, relax, and race in iconic real-world locations, mastering several boat types and practicing sail trim, speed management, and navigation through courses. Daily races, leaderboards, and multiplayer let sailors compete or explore freely in VR.

A squad-based real-time strategy game with horror elements, following a soldier searching for his missing brother amid a Lovecraftian invasion of nightmare creatures and reanimated dead. Players choose locations, equip survivors, build turrets and traps, and manage routes and random events across a dark campaign.

After a birthday pudding transforms into a monster and abducts the king to the tower's spire, you set out to rescue him in this free roguelike prequel. The turn-based combat is dynamic and unusual because there is no HP system at all.

A business management sim set in a sun-soaked 1980s city, where players build a drug compound and production line while running legitimate fronts like fried chicken shops to avoid detection. Expand plots, research narcotics, fortify defenses, and manage staff needs, morale, and safety.

An open-world turn-based tactical RPG set in a low fantasy world where the player leads and manages a medieval mercenary company as its captain. Traveling the Midlands, they take contracts, hire men, and fight detailed tactical battles in arenas, caves, ruins, and fortresses.

Players build and upgrade a kingdom in a magical world, recruiting heroes from varied races, training troops in different formations, and joining guilds for large-scale wars and territory battles against other players.

Players build a customizable character and fight through a sprawling fantasy world torn by war, mixing melee and magic in grand battles with brutal finishing moves, while evolving their class through the Destiny system and uncovering deep lore across countless quests.

Players take the Unionist or Secessionist side in the events leading to the American Civil War, using card-driven area control to place and remove political capital across four crisis dimensions over three rounds before a final confrontation.

In 1934, Norah travels to a remote South Pacific island following her missing husband's expedition, exploring lush terrain, lost ruins, and occult mysteries. She investigates clues from a previous voyage, solves varied puzzles, and uncovers the truth in an emotional, story-driven adventure.

Players act as cyber detectives or hackers investigating digital mysteries in a world where real and digital realms blur, collecting, raising and Digivolving over 300 Digimon. Classic turn-based battles let players build an all-star team, and the Complete Edition bundles both Cyber Sleuth titles into one story-driven adventure.

A young girl in a small town on the edge of the Arland Republic dreams of surpassing her legendary mother in alchemy. Players join Lulua and her companions, exploring the nostalgic world of Arland and unraveling the mystery of an ancient manuscript on a journey of alchemical mastery.

A yuri thriller visual novel set in a neon cyberpunk future, following veteran cop Cila as an advanced android named Mara enters her life and draws the attention of a powerful tech lab. Player choices shape the journey toward multiple endings.

Players take the role of a high school student who can seal the powers of mysterious beings called Spirits, choosing among eleven characters and over 150 dating events. Branching choices determine romantic routes and endings, with additional story content and localized light novels included.

An online 2D MMORPG where players choose the Draxian nobles or the Naru tribe amid a renewed war, exploring a large open world, fighting other players in PvP and rankings, picking mining, elementalism or jewelry professions, enchanting gear and trading through an auction house.

Play as J. Edgar Hoover directing the FBI through 1960s America, combating the Mafia, Communists, and other groups while uncovering assassinations and controlling politics from the shadows. A blend of strategy and RPG with tycoon-style management and interactions with henchmen and historical figures.

A hero who died defeating a demon is granted five more days to settle his affairs, growing weaker each day. Players explore the saved world, resolve problems, and court eight heroines, with over 50 endings shaped by their choices.
In a zombie apocalypse, players recruit and manage survivors, build a self-sufficient colony, and fight in third-person or overhead views, with characters who remember actions and form relationships.

A shy young woman home alone with a friend discovers a haunting painting in her living room, and their night turns bizarre as dread builds. Players steer a branching horror narrative toward one of thirty gruesome endings, with an eerie atmosphere and illustrated art rather than jumpscares.

Players create a custom character and explore a vast open field in a sci-fi online world, fighting powerful enemies with Photon Dash and Glide traversal while teaming with up to 32 people in free-to-play multiplayer adventures.

A co-op Wolfenstein adventure set nineteen years after Wolfenstein II, in which BJ Blazkowicz's twin daughters Jess and Soph fight through Nazi-occupied Paris after their father disappears. Players level up, explore, and complete missions to unlock abilities, weapons, gadgets and cosmetics, alone or with a friend.

Players join large-scale multiplayer battles on the Western Front of World War I, fighting in 100-player team matches across trenches and open maps. They pick factions and classes, coordinate with squads, drive era-specific tanks, and use period weapons and brutal melee combat to survive the brutal scale of the front lines.

Two classic tactical RPGs follow princes and wanderers caught in wars over legendary swords, with player choices determining alliances and outcomes. Players command dozens of characters across many classes, and decisions lead to numerous story endings and character fates.

A turn-based RPG where knight Zephy, granted dragon magic by witches, fights an empire of dragon hunters. Players battle dragons across three vertical tiers, transform using a Dragon Gauge, devour weakened dragons for skill trees, and manage witches whose hunger affects endings.

Viola, a woman transported into the real version of her favorite MMORPG, gathers a party of cute girls and sails across the ocean to stop a fallen goddess from destroying the world of Asaph. The player makes choices that decide the realm's fate and which companion Viola ends up with.

As an agent of a secret vampire-hunting institute, the player fights monstrous hordes across a stylized weird-wild-west frontier, using firearms, a lightning gauntlet and gadgets in gory action combat, alone or in co-op, while upgrading weapons and unlocking perks through a story-driven campaign.

As the newly appointed magistrate of Nakamachi in a Japan on the edge of modernization, players solve crimes and pass judgment alongside samurai, detectives, and inventors, working through four cases and over twenty hours of story in an anime-styled detective visual novel.

Command US or Japanese naval forces across the Pacific in a turn-based campaign of ten four-month turns, seizing key sea areas for victory points. Players manage battleships, carriers, submarines, and aircraft through gunnery, air raids, and island invasions, with hot-seat, AI, and multiplayer options.

The player runs a moonshining operation in Appalachia, managing fermentation, distillation and bottling while hiring workers, buying ingredients, unlocking technologies and planning deliveries. Missions, side quests and delivery events unfold across five regions, with choices about trusting an agent or a corrupt governor.

A narrative-driven action RPG set in Russia during a global pandemic, where a survivor must navigate violent factions and pathogen-altered humans. Players plan tactical firefights with scarce, weighty ammunition, explore open environments for resources, and manage injuries, fatigue, and supplies while trying to preserve their humanity.

A 3D virtual dice roller where players select dice from a collection or enter standard dice notation expressions, customize dice with their own images and sounds, and save frequently used rolls for tabletop RPG sessions.

Players lead a company of broken heroes across the tainted shores of Idra toward the Black Priory, exploring a dark fantasy world of lovecraftian horror through tactical turn-based combat, party building, crafting, and choice-based dialogue in a retro pixel-art style.

A spacecraft simulator built on Newtonian mechanics in which the player pilots several vessel types through the Noren star system, performing transport and search missions with realistic aerodynamics, gravity and orbital physics, docking at stations and outposts.

Players take the role of the devil, managing a team of three evil geniuses like Dracula and Bloody Mary through turn-based combat and interactive events. They can bend the game's rules by sacrificing health to manipulate enemies, collect souls, and seek revenge on Demon Hunters.

Players command armies of every major power in the European theatre of World War II, using deep turn-based mechanics covering movement, combat, spotting, encirclement, and weather. A branching campaign of around 60 scenarios, over 1000 units, multiplayer modes, and a scenario editor are included.

Players create custom players and courts in an editing suite, compete against ATP and WTA stars, and manage reputation, sponsors, and performance through a redesigned career mode in singles or doubles, plus scenario and legendary match modes.

A pinball game where Haruka's spilled concoction turns five shinobi friends into animal-like states, and the player uses flippers to bounce the magical Peach Ball around dynamic tables to cure them. It includes story scenes, minigame areas, and modes for dressing and posing the characters.

A forensic investigator is drawn into a murder case where science meets dark magic, gathering ingredients and casting spells while solving puzzles across Birmingham alongside a teenage witch. The point-and-click adventure follows a mystery steeped in English folklore and Greek myth.

Up to six players take the roles of Great Houses of Westeros, using diplomacy, secret order tokens, resource management, and military might over ten rounds to control strategic areas and claim the Iron Throne while wildlings threaten the Wall.

Players build a card deck and lead a party of up to six animal characters through the city of Dawn's Point, fighting elite opponents in card-based battles and navigating encounters with moral trade-offs to strike at House Ender.

Players take the role of a theater commander directing modern multi-domain warfare, from post-WWII clashes to near-future conflicts. They coordinate air, sea, land, space, and cyber operations using realistic physics, electronic warfare, doctrine settings, and real-time multiplayer battles.

As Miyuri, heiress of a martial arts clan with a mysterious inherited power, players navigate a fantasy visual novel about an arranged marriage to a rival clan's heir meant to end a cold war, choosing among four romance options and multiple endings while training to save the world.

A sandbox building game where the player designs and engineers robots of any shape, programs their movements with visual scripting, and constructs obstacle courses and race tracks to test them, alone or with other inventors, with over a hundred single-player challenges.

Players build and manage a Sumerian city-state in third-millennium Mesopotamia, balancing farmers, artisans, and vendors, expanding irrigation, providing services, trading, and constructing temples and a great ziggurat, with no warfare or attacks.

An interactive thriller in which a lone detective investigates a nightclub murder, with the player making meaningful choices that shape a mature non-linear narrative and lead to one of four possible endings, presented with professional actors, editing, lighting and sound design.

A first-person tech-noir mystery adventure in which an AI and psychology researcher uses a deep brain scanner to explore recorded memories and surreal dreamscapes, solving puzzles and following dialogue branches to uncover why a tech executive died in her apartment.

Two washed-up animal detectives, Sonny and Marty, reunite to solve a strange case in the city of Clawville, interrogating over thirty voiced characters and gathering clues and secrets. The dialogue-heavy noir adventure blends visual novel and classic adventure elements, presented with photo-based cinematic visuals and cutscenes.

Players pick Garfield or another character and race go-karts across 16 circuits inspired by the comic, using skids, shortcuts, and wacky bonus items to beat opponents. Modes include Grand Prix, Single Race, Time Trial, and local or online multiplayer.

Abducted and infected with a mind flayer parasite, the player gathers a party and travels the Forgotten Realms, choosing among races and classes, battling and romancing across a branching narrative where choices shape the fate of the world and the corruption within.

Kazuma Kiryu and Haruka leave Kamurocho for Okinawa to run an orphanage, but shadows of Kiryu's past drag them into a deadly power struggle between the Tojo Clan and political forces, told across Tokyo and tropical Okinawa in this remastered chapter.

Players run a soda brewing operation while competing on a reality TV show inside a prison compound, experimenting with flavors, automating production with machines, researching inventions, and outmaneuvering four rivals through strategy or sabotage.

Players run an auto repair business in virtual reality, dismantling and repairing engines, painting and tuning cars, buying wrecks at auctions, completing contracts and test-driving finished vehicles to grow their garage empire.

Players stabilize a war-torn country by balancing military and civilian priorities against a deadly insurgency, choosing governors, managing resources, and deploying tactics across regions in a strategic simulation inspired by modern counterinsurgency, with campaign and multiplayer modes.

Players race through the official 2019 AMA Monster Energy Supercross season with 100 riders across 15 stadiums, competing in career and online modes. A track editor, co-op compound, and improved physics support racing as male or female riders.

A real-time tactical wargame set in an alternate Cold War where NATO and Warsaw Pact forces clash across Europe. Players command mechanized formations on large maps modeled on real terrain, factoring in weather, visibility, munitions, and artillery to win challenging tank battles.

A psychological horror game following former police officer Ellis and his dog Bullet into the Black Hills Forest to find a missing boy, where the woods distort time and memory. Players investigate with a camera, phone, and flashlight while managing their sanity and their bond with the dog.

A visual novel set in a Japanese cafe in suburban America where a ninja descendant and a fire-hurling ghost run the shop while hunting monsters, taking in a mysterious girl as the Headless Horseman reappears and entangled fates unfold.

Strategic Command: World War I is a hex-based grand strategy game covering the Great War from 1914 to the final offensives, letting the player command armies across multiple theatres, research new weapons, conduct diplomacy, and play three campaigns as either alliance.

A romantic evening turns into a nightmare when a detective breaks in, accuses the wife of murder, and beats the player to death, only to restart the same twelve minutes. Players use a click-and-drag interface to change the outcome and break the loop.

Players lead a Gelfling resistance against the oppressive Skeksis in over 50 turn-based tactical battles, recruiting and customizing allies with jobs, abilities, and gear while uniting clans across the fantasy world of Thra to restore light to the homeworld.

Players fight through a campaign as Kait Diaz uncovering her connection to the enemy, alongside competitive team PvP and cooperative PvE modes like Horde and Escape. Three-player co-op and extensive accessibility options support squad-based shooting in a war-torn sci-fi world.

Explore the bizarre world of Dragonar, fighting eldritch monstrosities and dozens of unique bosses, upgrading and building a character freely, taming magical dragons to summon in battle, and riding a wheelchair through strange locales in this first chapter of a trilogy.

An HD remaster of the real-time tactics classic in which the player commands nine specialized commandos on covert World War II missions, using interactive environments, stolen uniforms and vehicles, and each operative's unique skills to overcome overwhelming odds across ten missions in varied locations.

A real-time strategy remaster set during the rise of the Roman Empire, where players command armies across Egypt, Gaul, and Italy to become Emperor. Success requires combining diverse troop types and exploiting enemy weaknesses, culminating in facing the elite Praetorian Guard.

A companion horror story in which the player searches for a missing sister using wits and a flashlight, teaming with shady characters to uncover a dark mystery while making deadly decisions that determine the fate of everyone involved.

A tactical stealth adventure set in a dark wartime story where players use interactive environments, distractions and sabotage to complete missions, or draw weapons when spotted, and can join a friend in co-op with distinct characters.

A roguelike deck-building strategy game where the player defends a final burning pyre in hell against heavenly forces, choosing routes, upgrading cards, and recruiting units across three vertical battle fields while building a deck from five clans.

Players control girls in a side-scrolling action game, shooting waves of zombies with guns and skills while opening rooms to find items. Characters can be upgraded persistently, teammates hired, and runs continued after failure, blending shoot'em-up roguelike and ARPG elements.

As an ambitious lord in Westeros, the player builds a base, expands territory, recruits characters from the HBO series, and trains armies. Battling among thousands of other players, they compete for castles and the Iron Throne while reliving events from the show.

Set in 2010 Tokyo, a shooting incident in a red-light district draws together four men whose fates overlap around legendary yakuza Kazuma Kiryu. Players control multiple protagonists through a violent crime story of human desire, exploring the city's underworld in this remastered chapter of the saga.

The fifth chapter of the Kazuma Kiryu saga, set in 2012 Japan, follows Kiryu hiding as a cab driver in Fukuoka while a plot threatens to drag the yakuza into war, told through the intertwined stories of four men and a girl across five major Japanese cities.

Players build and upgrade a space station, assemble modular warship fleets from blueprints, and fight large-scale space battles while forming alliances in the troubled Renney Sector. Exploration missions uncover stories behind the Supernova Event, and diplomatic or aggressive choices shape the sector's future.

Players control both a first-person camera moving through 3D space and a 2D avatar confined to the screen, repositioning the 3D viewpoint to create new 2D paths and solve spatial perspective puzzles to reach each level's exit.
Players relax in a serene temple garden and play a simple strategy board game, placing tiles to extend paths and sliding their stone along them while opponents' paths can redirect or eliminate them.

Players follow a coming-of-age story in rural Japan where the protagonist and friends investigate a chain of serial murders, forming bonds and confronting their darker selves through RPG gameplay in this enhanced edition.

A kind young man sets out with a talking tome to find the Sealed Verses and save his sister from the Black Scrawl, journeying through a ruined world with allies. Players fight monstrous enemies using customizable swordplay and magic in a dark, twisting tale.

An RPG set in a world of swords and sorcery, told entirely through cards as a tabletop-style adventure narrated by a gamesmaster. The player follows a self-proclaimed hero on a quest to slay a recently awakened dragon, experiencing a nostalgic yet new presentation.

In the open world of Sunset City, the player joins an underground racer network, competing in club, drift, sprint and freedrift races, running delivery quests and exploring districts while tuning and customizing cars to climb leaderboards and earn respect.

An open-world RPG where a traveler leaves their home village to explore a vast land, build a character freely, join factions, fight enemies, clear dungeons, recruit allies, and build and decorate a house while uncovering strange events.

A comedic RPG that teaches beginner Japanese through dialogue that shifts from English to Japanese as players learn hiragana, with professional voice acting and a battle system that drills on hiragana, words and kanji.

A sandbox life simulation where players create Parafolks, build grid-less homes with curved walls and split levels, pursue careers and relationships, and explore an open-world town filled with shops, parks, and museums while shaping their own stories.

The player restores a dilapidated family ranch in a forested valley, renovating buildings, raising livestock, farming crops, and hunting wildlife, alone or in co-op. Managing a profitable operation and defending herds from wolves drives this open-world simulation.

In 2083 Neo Hong Kong, Mei-Lin Mak explores the haunted Chong Sing Apartments, piecing together the stories of 14 lost souls and her family curse. The 2.5D survival horror game emphasizes slow dread, atmosphere, puzzle solving, and careful examination of the environment rather than action or jump scares.

In a post-apocalyptic world of toxic spore-emitting plants, players lead survivors building a settlement on the back of a giant wandering creature, managing production chains, researching lost technologies, and adapting to shifting biomes while balancing symbiosis or parasitism.

Players explore the hand-drawn world of Orcanon, visiting five cities and over twenty dungeons while commanding eight customizable characters in turn-based battles against more than 200 monsters. The mature story follows a doomed heroic team facing fate and sacrifice.

Players design and manage an underground train station, building multi-layered 3D layouts and guiding thousands of simulated passengers through corridors, stairs, and escalators. They place signage and services, balance budgets, and face daily evaluations, with sandbox difficulty options and Steam Workshop map sharing.

A restaurant management simulator in which the player designs a kitchen, hires and organizes staff, sources ingredients, builds a menu of French and Italian dishes, and cooks during services, growing a small café into a fine-dining establishment aiming for a Michelin star.

Players lead a civilization from the Neolithic era to the modern age, combining up to 60 historical cultures, making moral decisions, building wonders, and fighting turn-based tactical battles on land, sea, and air while pursuing fame.

Based on a board game, players command a crew aboard a besieged starship, coordinating members with unique skills to repair systems, fend off hostile aliens, and fix the Jump Core to escape. Managing stations like the Armory and Engineering under pressure is central to survival.

An officially licensed bowling simulation where players take on a career of over a hundred tournaments, compete online, and play quick matches locally, using realistic physics, pro players, and authentic oil patterns.

Players build conveyor-driven factories that feed turrets and produce materials, then defend their core from waves of enemies. They also construct and command mechanized units to capture enemy bases, expanding across two planetary campaigns alone or in co-op and PvP multiplayer.

The final volume of a zombie visual novel series in which the protagonist, gifted with a special power, faces a collapsing world, violent deaths and an approaching horde while deciding whether to become a hero or something else.

An official digital adaptation of the Dominion deck-building board game, where players buy cards from a rotating tableau to build a stronger deck and collect Victory Points, playing solo against AI or with up to six players online and across expansions.

A short-story collection in a zombie-apocalypse visual novel series, following Mitsuki, Tokiko and Sayaka through nine scenarios set before and after the outbreak, with full Japanese voice acting and unlockable CG and music galleries.

The player travels through the remains of a lost civilization, visited by the Ancient, and brings order to the symbols of the land. This reimagining of the hidden object genre presents 3D environments and a haunting soundscape to explore section by section.

A narrative-driven experience set during Westworld Season 2, played as Kate, a host who has gained self-awareness inside the Mesa facility. The player solves puzzles, manipulates other hosts, and evades a relentless killer host while uncovering the park's secret past.

The player becomes a helicopter pilot, taking on missions in an open world with realistic flight physics, performing pre-flight checks and cargo loading, and managing, maintaining, customizing, and upgrading a hangar of helicopters through training missions.

A railway management sandbox where the player designs tracks, stations, and lines on a detailed real-world map, runs trams, subways, and high-speed trains, and serves simulated passengers whose demand and satisfaction shift by time of day, with optional cooperative multiplayer.

King's Bounty II is a single-player fantasy RPG combining third-person exploration of the troubled kingdom of Nostria with turn-based tactical combat, letting players choose one of three heroes, recruit armies, and make decisions that shape their leadership.

Players fish across global lakes, rivers, and coastal waters using float, bottom, spinning, and casting methods, customizing gear and adapting to weather and fish behavior, with tournaments, daily quests, multiplayer, and a sandbox mode.

As a young, arrogant Sherlock Holmes on a Mediterranean island, the player investigates an open world of corruption and crime, gathering clues, using disguises, and choosing between wits and force. Decisions shape the detective's reputation and the man he becomes.

As ruler of a province in the Western Peninsula, the player holds court, settles disputes, manages taxes and armies, arranges marriages, and navigates grimdark medieval politics through a lengthy interactive novel with branching choices and hidden endings.

The player travels to a post-apocalyptic Soviet metropolis as an ATOM agent, exploring an open world, completing quests with branching outcomes, and fighting mutants and mercenaries in turn-based combat. Character builds, weapons, and exoskeleton armor can be customized.

The player takes the role of Jack, a hacker who strikes a deal with a gangster and must complete a mission within a set timeframe. He spies on senior managers, manages recruitment, and hacks candidates while protecting his own health, in a humorous action story.

As a new adventurer in the town of Ecallia, the player explores an ever-changing dungeon, recruits over twenty party members with their own quests, romances companions, builds up the town, and pursues a non-linear story toward one of three endings.

In a haunted inn, the player sneaks, flees, or fights stalkers while scavenging resources and solving puzzles to uncover intertwined mysteries. The psychological survival horror story follows returning and new characters through a dark, gloomy atmosphere.

A teenage heavy-metal fan and his musician friend open a door to an evil dimension for fun, and the player guides Denis through a retro-styled platformer and quest adventure mixing pixel aesthetics, black humor, and light philosophy about confronting the dark side of the world and oneself.

Players command a Chaos horde in the Warhammer Fantasy Old World, building a fortress, collecting Warlords and daemons, and gathering resources to raise an army. They march, pillage, and siege rival fortresses while coordinating with an alliance to conquer landmarks and earn the favor of the Chaos Gods.

The player roams a polluted island as an up-and-coming graffiti tagger, chatting with other taggers, tagging surfaces, and uncovering secrets and odd characters. Curiosity and free will drive the open-ended exploration, with apps, photos, cigarettes, and multiple endings shaping a grimy, comedic first-person stroll.

The player rules a small 8-bit kingdom in decline, making decisions that shape the story while balancing army, food, gold, faith, happiness, and health. Southern hordes threaten invasion, assassins lurk, and minigames like woodcutting, mining, trading, and dice can decide the king's fate across dozens of endings.

A classic 4X fantasy strategy game in which the player takes the role of a powerful wizard, customizing traits and spells, leading one of many races, and commanding troops to conquer the worlds of Arcanus and Myrror.

A free particle physics sandbox where you experiment with hundreds of elements, simulating air pressure, heat, and gravity. Build explosions, power plants, and custom CPUs, or download community creations and mod in your own elements with the Lua API.

An enhanced re-release of the 1997 first-person shooter sequel to DOOM II, where the last surviving marine is sent to abandoned Mars facilities to hunt the Mother of Demons and stop a renewed invasion, fighting through over thirty levels plus additional Lost Levels.

Awakening in a snowy, turbulent world, the player follows a long visual-novel story and fights tactical turn-based battles with a cast of characters, exploring a fantasy setting across thirty-plus hours of narrative and combat.

A card dueling game that adapts over twenty years of the Yu-Gi-Oh! animated series, letting players build decks from thousands of cards and duel iconic characters. Players relive story duels, take on villain roles, and compete in sealed and draft formats.

Players lead a five-member party across Valentine Island in search of a legendary treasure, using a classic turn-based battle system with tech sparking, growth stats, combination attacks, formations, quests, and randomized loot across eight plots.

A multiplayer open-world survival adventure set in post-nuclear West Virginia, where Vault Dwellers emerge twenty-five years after the bombs to explore, build camps, quest, and fight across evolving regions filled with factions, cryptids, and story content.

The final chapter of a tactics-RPG visual novel series follows the fates of two nations, Yamato and Tuskur, as the player reads over fifty hours of story and fights turn-based tactical battles with co-op finisher moves to resolve the mysteries of the past.

A gravely injured man with no memory, Hakuowlo, is taken in by villagers with animal ears and tails and rises to lead them against threatening nobles. The player commands comrades in tactical RPG battles while reading a long visual novel story that slowly reveals his lost past.

Ayesha, a young alchemist living in a world in decline, sets out to find her missing sister after glimpsing her in nearby ruins. Players explore fields, gather ingredients, and practice alchemy while progressing through a story-driven RPG with turn-based battles.

Two alchemists work to rediscover lost alchemy in a nation facing the end of the world. Players explore, gather materials, and craft items while following the characters' stories in this deluxe edition of the RPG, which includes past DLC content.
An RPG following two girls in a dying world where oceans turn to sand and life fades. Players pursue their wishes through alchemy and adventure in the third entry of the Dusk trilogy.

As young chieftain Akrog, the player leads a dwindling troll tribe plagued by poachers and disease, seeking to resurrect a fallen god. The campaign blends real-time strategy battles with RPG hero customization across a new continent, with skill trees, crafting, and multiple endings shaped by decisions.

Players rule a small nation on a devastated alien planet, reconquering it through turn-based 4X warfare, diplomacy, budget and infrastructure management, recruiting leaders and governors, and navigating political bodies, factions and unrest across procedurally generated worlds.

In a dystopian future ruled by corporations, a revenge-seeking contestant fights through deadly urban arenas in a brutal reality show, using turn-based tactical combat, recruiting allies, upgrading skills, and dodging traps while a show director meddles with each stage.

The player raises a faery-turned-human girl over eight years, choosing a father occupation, scheduling her training and activities, and competing at annual festivals. Choices shape her stats and determine which of multiple endings she reaches as she pursues her dream of becoming a princess.

King Arthur: Knight's Tale casts players as Sir Mordred, resurrected by the Lady of the Lake to hunt the undying mad King Arthur. It blends turn-based tactical battles with character-centric RPG management, hero loyalty, moral choices, and rebuilding Camelot in a dark Arthurian land.

A foxgirl named Mikoto, an inept magic student living in a hidden woodland settlement, runs away to a human village festival and falls for a knight named Juni, while her stern tutor Ohana tries to bring her home. The player follows this romantic visual novel and shapes the relationship's outcome through choices.

Players run a professional wrestling promotion in a text-based booking simulator, deciding the roster, storylines, feuds, and match outcomes. Workers request promises such as title shots, and an editable database lets players build and share their own wrestling worlds.

Players choose a noble house and lead their dynasty through a simulated Middle Ages spanning generations, using diplomacy, marriage, intrigue, and warfare to claim lands and titles, manage vassals and heirs, and shape a legacy from 867, 1066, or 1178 onward.

Players take on the role of Yun, a rewinder who enters people's memories and influences their actions to change history. Sent to investigate a deserted village full of resentful spirits, Yun uncovers what happened seven years ago in this 2D puzzle adventure inspired by Chinese folklore.

A motorcycle racing game where the player competes in the 2020 MotoGP season, manages a career team, develops bike performance across technical systems, customizes rider and livery, and races historic riders online or against improved AI.

As a blue-collar spaceship salvager for LYNX, players carve apart derelict ships in zero-g, treating each hull as a puzzle to dismantle for maximum profit. Using laser cutters and grapple tools, they manage hazards like decompression and radiation while upgrading gear and paying off debt.

A visual novel about Nekohime, an anxious writer whose debut game succeeded, now facing self-doubt and criticism while developing a sequel with her friends and confronting a hostile newcomer. The player makes choices that shape relationships and the story's outcome.

Control The Nerd in a retro-inspired action platformer spanning two games plus a new third chapter, jumping, shooting, and dodging through challenging pixel-art levels against classic gaming enemies and bosses with an energetic soundtrack.

Players explore ever-changing roguelike dungeons, defeating foes to build Omega Power that increases bust size and stats. Between runs they garden, decorate and rebuild an academy, enjoying a laid-back daily life alongside the dungeon crawling.

Players take on a high fantasy RPG adventure mixing eastern and western elements, choosing alignments and factions while recruiting party members and villagers. They explore an infinite dungeon, farm and breed mounts, and face permadeath difficulty options in a world that either destroys or idolizes them.

Players restore a rundown family ranch by breeding and raising horses, racing and jumping in competitions, managing resources, and exploring open locations, with story and online multiplayer modes plus a horse creator and photo mode.

The player leads a squad of demons through a chaotic otherworld kingdom, clearing room after room of escaped prisoners and rebels. Puzzles, traps, and obstacles are overcome with improvised tools, all set against a gloomy pixel-art kingdom with a mysterious atmosphere.

Set in post-apocalyptic Northern Finland after a 1975 disaster, players guide Aino through over 70 detailed isometric scenes, solving varied puzzles and managing a notebook to survive dangerous journeys for her community. The point-and-click adventure carries a melancholic Finnish atmosphere with voice acting.

As a detective in 1980s Italy, the player investigates a colleague's disappearance from a psychiatric hospital, exploring a doctor's house and twisted environments while solving puzzles, managing inventory, and evading supernatural threats in a slow-building psychological horror mystery.

A player-driven fantasy MMORPG set in the vast world of Nave, where players craft, tame beasts, join factions, rob others or protect the weak, building classless characters and shaping their own story through actions in a seamless sandbox.

Players explore the open world of Arrakis as a Bene Gesserit agent, uncovering the mystery of the missing Fremen while surviving sandworms, heat, and sandstorms. They craft gadgets, build bases, assemble vehicles, and choose to join the Atreides or Harkonnen in a survival adventure.

A 4X space strategy game where the player expands an empire across a hex galaxy, managing colonies with sliders, researching an endless tech tree, designing ships, and fighting turn-based tactical battles with diplomacy, spying, and modding support.

A remastered 2D version of the first Final Fantasy, where players become the Warriors of Light and journey to restore power to four lost Crystals and save a darkened world. Players switch character classes, travel by airship, and fight through a retro fantasy adventure with updated graphics and sound.

Four youths orphaned by war between the Palamecian Empire and a rebel army journey with allies including a white wizard and a pirate, fighting through a story-driven fantasy adventure whose skill system grows attributes based on how characters fight rather than leveling up.

Four chosen adventurers must restore the power of light against encroaching darkness in a remastered 2D role-playing game. The player switches between jobs such as Warrior, Monk, White Mage and Summoner, battles through a retro-styled world and can toggle encounter and experience boost options.

A dark knight captain rebels against his tyrannical kingdom and journeys with allies across land, underground, and even to the moon in search of crystals. This remastered 2D role-playing game features the Active Time Battle system, where time flows during combat, alongside a dramatic story and updated pixel graphics and soundtrack.

A young man and his Chocobo are drawn into a quest to protect the crystals that balance the world's powers, with the player developing characters through a flexible job and ability system in turn-based battles across a retro-styled fantasy world.

A remastered 2D pixel-art version of the classic RPG, following a cast of characters whose interwoven fates unfold in a sweeping melodrama a thousand years after magic vanished, with a magicite system for customizing spells, summons, and abilities.

As outlaw Arthur Morgan in 1899 America, the player robs, steals, and fights across the frontier while the Van der Linde Gang is hunted by federal agents and bounty hunters, and internal divisions force a choice between personal ideals and loyalty.

In a ruined postwar Tokyo, young fighter Akira is coerced into the deadly blood sport Igra to destroy the syndicate Vischio from within. This multi-ending visual novel follows his choices through a brutal underworld of crime and violence, with full Japanese voice acting.

An arcade scrolling shooter in which the player pilots a customizable spacecraft against an alien invasion, fighting through 15 levels across three locations. Players destroy enemy ships, battle bosses, and collect power-ups to upgrade weapons, shields, and speed while protecting an orbital station.

Players lead one of several human factions responding to an alien arrival, competing and cooperating over global research, covert operations and illustrated events while investigating the aliens' origins and motives, with the option to defend Earth, surrender, profit or flee the Solar System.

Blackjack Championship is a casino-style card game offering multiple blackjack modes with varied bet ranges and real casino rules. Players collect free chips, open lucky boxes, enter tournaments, chase jackpots, complete missions, and climb weekly rankings, with progress synced across devices.

A real-time strategy game of nuclear war where players command a continent, research technologies, build a nuclear stockpile, and strike enemy cities with ships, planes and missiles while defending their own population. Diplomacy, a strike planner and multiplayer are included.

Players manage a professional cycling team across hundreds of races and stages, handling finances, recruitment, training and rider morale, or pursue an individual cyclist career and compete online with up to fifteen players.

The player leads Shiren the Wanderer and his ferret sidekick Koppa through ever-changing mystery dungeons filled with monsters, traps and treasure, on a quest to conquer the Tower of Fortune and its fate-deciding god. New bonus dungeons and a music collection round out the roguelike adventure.

A narrative adventure about twins Tyler and Alyson who use a supernatural bond to relive childhood memories in small-town Alaska. The player explores locations, solves puzzles, and makes choices that shape the twins' relationship and their future.

A two-player strategy game recreating the 1939-1940 Winter War between Finland and the Soviet Union, played over 16 weekly turns. One side commands the outnumbered Finnish defenders holding defensive lines, the other the larger but initially poorly led Soviet forces, with event cards adding diplomatic, military and economic variety.

Players lead a band of adventurers through the ruins of a harsh low-fantasy world, fighting tactically rich turn-based battles on large maps and using environmental hazards. They recruit followers, loot fallen foes, and extract skills and traits from enemies to upgrade their units across a procedurally generated survival campaign.

WGT Golf simulates realistic golf on over a dozen championship courses using GPS data and a physics engine. Players drive, chip and putt across stroke-play formats, compete head-to-head online, join country clubs and tournaments, and upgrade branded virtual clubs and balls.

Players lead one of 30 Greco-Persian factions in a turn-based 4X grand strategy campaign set in 359 BC, managing economy, politics, and armies while pursuing nation-specific objectives and mythological quests such as the Golden Fleece.

Set twelve years before the first Gears of War, players command survivor squads as cities on planet Sera fall to the Locust Horde. They recruit and develop troops, upgrade skills and equipment with loot, and fight fast-paced turn-based tactical battles against swarming enemies and towering bosses.

Players lead a crusade into the Worldwound, where a rift to the Abyss has unleashed demonic terror, creating a hero from 25 classes and 12 races, gathering companions, and fighting in real-time-with-pause or turn-based combat while choosing among nine Mythic Paths.

A strategy game recreating five historical battles from Napoleon's 1812 invasion of Russia, plus non-historical skirmishes. Players command over 30 unit types across four infantry classes, using flank attacks, strategic movement, detailed combat analysis and map zoom, and can play most missions as either side.

A grand strategy game set in 1920s China during the Warlord era, where players build empires, conduct diplomacy, and lead military expeditions while managing loose cliques of unreliable, unpaid warlords. Players take roles such as communist activist, secret society grandmaster, bandit king, or Kuomintang politician across historically detailed factions.

In a world scarred by a war between gods and demons, the demon heir Loki joins four rivals invading the floating continent of Yggdrasil to claim the Heart of Yggdrasil and the Dark Lord's throne. Players compose divisions of up to six units, invest in bases, and battle goddesses in a strategy RPG.

Players start as a fresh garage owner and build a service empire in a detailed car repair simulation. They fix, paint, tune, and rebuild over 72 cars using 4000+ parts, take on generated orders and story missions, and buy vehicles at auctions and barn finds.

Playing an enlisted human warrior, the player shoots waves of clone female soldiers in a prison simulation city across multiple maps and levels, including infinite and size-varying modes, to test the clones' combat performance.

A free galactic strategy game where the player sends fleets to capture planets, uses their resources to build more ships, and places defensive satellites, balancing careful defense against opportunistic attacks while wary of the returning Antarans. Local and internet multiplayer and six AI levels are included.

A strategy game set in a feudal interstellar society after Earth's destruction, where the player leads a faction of star systems across generations, managing vassals, marriages, feasts, blackmail and political intrigue to secure the dynasty's survival and dominance.

Four college students and their professor are stranded in the fog-bound abandoned town of Little Hope, witnessing terrifying visions tied to the 17th-century Andover witch trials. Players make branching choices to escape the apparitions, alone or with friends online and offline.

As Custodian of the Chimera, players build and fortify deadly Outposts to guard genetic material, then raid other players' Outposts to steal more. The game combines trap-laden base building with first-person infiltration, loadout choices, upgrades, and optional two-player co-op.

A free otome horror visual novel set in an isolated mountain village where a plant parasite turns villagers' bodies into garden beds. A cursed girl, a worshipped living deity, and her childhood friend face choices leading to three endings.

The Erebonian Empire stands on the brink of all-out war, and the students of Class VII must unite with heroes from across the continent to prevent total destruction after their instructor Rean Schwarzer goes missing. The RPG offers refined turn-based combat with mech summons and side activities like fishing and card games.

A strategy game blending RTS and tower defense where players build towers, traps, and mobile mechs to defend a colony citadel from xeno swarms and corrupted humans. A branching campaign supports solo or two-player online co-op, with persistent upgrades, mazing tactics, and orbital strikes across varied planets and stations.

Players command German ground, air, and naval forces through continental WWII campaigns, managing units, upgrades, and equipment across historically detailed operations. Story cinematics and voiced dialogues with real historical figures frame plot-driven battles, while primary and secondary objectives and alternate what-if scenarios reward strategic planning.

A real-time strategy campaign set on the desert mining planet Kwalasha, where players command Mobile Infantry units against endless Arachnid swarms. Players position troops using line of sight and fire, unlock elite abilities, and clear underground hives across story missions and a territory control mode.

Players race pull-back toy cars across acrobatic tracks, handling simple controls through races, challenges, and mini-games like mini golf, darts, and bowling. Power-ups and pickups add chaos to a lighthearted party experience meant for quick, frustration-free fun with friends.

A full-contact racing game where the player competes in no-rules races and demolition derbies, wrecking opponents on circuits, obstacle courses, and arenas. Cars are old and patched together, and players customize their rides while racing solo, in career-style modes, or online against others.

Players drive 38 Monster Jam trucks across five new outdoor worlds and 12 authentic stadiums, training at Camp Crushmore and performing stunts like bicycles and back-flips. Online multiplayer modes and exploration let fans compete and uncover secrets in a cheerful monster truck setting.

As illustrator Andreas Maler in 16th-century Bavaria, the player investigates murders in a small town and abbey, choosing academic and social backgrounds and making decisions whose consequences unfold over twenty-five years and generations. The narrative-driven historical game emphasizes character development and choice-driven storytelling.

An off-road racing game where players ride bikes, ATVs, and UTVs across massive open environments. A career mode follows the risks and rewards of becoming a world-famous professional rider, with split-screen and online multiplayer, a Trails mode, and rider and vehicle customization.

Four flawed heroines—a naive thief, hyperactive mage, cowardly warrior, and weak priest—travel a detailed fantasy world full of dungeons, traps, and non-linear quests. The player guides them through challenging turn-based battles and lengthy humorous dialogue in an old-school RPG style.

A remastered collection of the classic real-time strategy games Command & Conquer and Red Alert, letting players command armies through campaigns and skirmishes, build bases, and fight online matches, with 4K graphics switching, mod support, and remastered music and cinematics.

A blizzard cancels school in South Park, and the New Kid joins Cartman, Stan, Kyle, and Kenny to battle warring factions through the snow-covered town. Players fight in 3D co-op with up to three friends or bots, equipping weapons and abilities to save the world.

A pixel-art hack-and-slash where the demon warrior You-ki fights cute monster girls across eight stages using jump and attack buttons. Players pick from five weapons, climb walls, perform brutal boss finishers, and unlock a time attack mode after clearing the game.

A free classic fantasy MMORPG that returns to old-school 2D isometric action-RPG roots, letting players build customizable warriors or mages, learn complex spells and professions, follow questlines, and fight in an intricate PVP system within a high fantasy world touched by steampunk elements.
Set in Detroit in 2038, players control three androids and make moral choices that shape an intense branching narrative, determining who lives or dies across dozens of possible endings.

As the Inquisitor, the player leads a band of champions to save Thedas from demonic invasion and warring factions, making weighty choices that shape the world. They explore a vast open world, fight strategic battles, and build their base at Skyhold across the base game and DLC.

An exclusively co-op adventure in which two prisoners, Leo and Vincent, form a reluctant alliance to break out of prison and gain their freedom. Players work together to solve puzzles, sneak, fight, drive, and fish through an emotional story-driven experience.

A first-person starfighter combat game set in the Star Wars galaxy, where pilots fly New Republic and Imperial ships in 5v5 multiplayer dogfights and fleet battles, customizing loadouts and diverting power between weapons, shields and engines, with a single-player story and VR support.

A free large-scale real-time strategy game mixing civilization-building with urgent warfare: players construct cities, assign workers, manage production chains and supplies, design a flag that colors their soldiers, command diverse armies across the map, and use diplomacy in local split-screen multiplayer for one to four players.

A tennis simulation where players compete as top professionals or create their own player to climb the world rankings, managing staff, equipment, and sponsors in career mode while mastering stroke timing and serve mechanics in singles or doubles matches locally or online.

Set in 1428 medieval Europe during the Hussite campaign, players follow a Hussite hetman and a Hospitaller knight through a dark fantasy story. Gameplay mixes challenging puzzles, stealth past patrolling enemies, and tough melee combat against knights, robbers, and supernatural beings.

Players race karts against a crew of rivals across a mysterious island of temples, castles and alien labs, unlocking and upgrading vehicles, mastering powerups, and customizing game rules for solo or local split-screen play with up to eight players.

In a dystopian Tokyo overrun by the undead, two estranged sisters trained in swordsmanship fight each other and hordes of corpses, as Aya hunts the Undead and Saki seeks revenge and her mother's resurrection. The remade action game follows their brutal conflict through fast sword combat.

Command one of the factions of the dark-fantasy Warhammer Age of Sigmar universe in turn-based skirmish battles. Collect and upgrade units, equipment, and skills across non-linear roguelike campaigns, then challenge other players in online one-on-one duels.

In near-future Tokyo, players pick from seven two-person teams of jet racers, steering high-tech machines through urban waterways while a partner fires water weapons at rivals, with story arcs, online multiplayer, time attack, and extensive customization of characters and vehicles.

A vampire named Valvatorez leads a ragtag army of werewolves, angels, and failed final bosses in a revolution against a corrupt regime in the Netherworld. Players fight tactical turn-based battles, level characters to extreme heights, build custom maps, and unlock dozens of characters and extra story campaigns.

A German soldier haunted by World War I moves between his family home and the trenches, solving puzzles and evading monstrous creatures to distinguish nightmare from reality and uncover his family's secrets.

Ichiban Kasuga, a low-ranking yakuza betrayed after an eighteen-year prison term, gathers outcasts in Yokohama to uncover the truth and reclaim his life. Players fight in dynamic turn-based RPG combat with switchable Jobs, and explore a modern Japanese city full of substories and minigames.

A turn-based pro-cycling simulation where players manage riders and team careers, then guide them through multi-day tours, classics, and time trials on procedurally generated stages, balancing positioning, slipstreaming, and stamina to build prestige and reach the top.

A mixed martial arts fighting game where players unlock over fifty moves, customize a fighter's body and face, and combine kicks and punches against many opponents. Faster button presses produce faster strikes, and friends can join through Remote Play Together.

A Napoleonic strategy game recreating the 1815 Waterloo Campaign, where the player commands Anglo-Allied, French or Prussian forces, issuing orders through a point-and-click interface across battles from small engagements to Waterloo and Ligny.

Players battle across Star Wars eras in large multiplayer ground and space combat, controlling heroes, troopers, and starfighters with unique abilities. A single-player campaign follows an elite special forces soldier across thirty years of the saga.

As the refugee Hawke, the player rises to power in the city of Kirkwall over a decade, fighting fast-paced battles with spells and companions while making dialogue and story decisions that shape relationships and the fate of civilization.

A first-person shooter set in World War II where players fight across land, air and sea with a complete arsenal of weapons, vehicles and gadgets, plus a full roster of Elites and extensive soldier customization for British and German armies.

Players fight in large-scale multiplayer battles across 29 destructible maps, choosing among four classes and commandeering tanks, helicopters and jets, while earning ranks, medals and weapon unlocks through combat.

Players fight through the battles of World War I in a first-person shooter, engaging in large team-based multiplayer clashes with vehicles and destructible environments, or experiencing an adventure-filled single-player campaign.

Players fight across dynamic, destructible battlefields using dozens of vehicles and weapons, from helicopters and jets to gunboats, on large chaotic maps. A single-player campaign follows a squad evacuating VIPs from Shanghai amid international tensions.

Players take part in cops-versus-criminals heists and high-speed car chases, then fight in large multiplayer battles or follow a detective through a single-player campaign inspired by TV crime dramas. The tone is action-driven and modern, with bonus packs and expansions adding weapons and customization.

A real-time strategy game set in the late 21st century after nuclear strikes wipe out civilization, where the player leads a group rebuilding society using pre-war technology, artillery, radar, and a deep research tree.

Players build and manage dinosaur parks, constructing buildings, hiring scientists, and caring for over 75 prehistoric species across campaign, sandbox, and challenge modes, including what-if scenarios drawn from the Jurassic World films.

Players terraform Mars by founding cities on craters and lava tubes, choosing buildings from randomly proposed project cards each turn, and geo-engineering the planet with volcanoes, space mirrors, and nukes. Procedural generation makes each playthrough unique, blending city planning with planetary ecology.

Descending into the depths of the Gut to save a loved one, the player navigates procedural horror levels, wielding randomized weapons and encountering bizarre talking objects and edible or throwable body parts in an eerie dark comedy.

As a Tarnished guided by grace, the player explores the interconnected Lands Between, fighting challenging foes and bosses with weapons, spells, and summons, building a custom character, and uncovering a mythic narrative while playing co-op or against other players.

Players run a modern farm, growing crops and raising animals through the four seasons while building production chains into an agricultural empire. They operate hundreds of licensed machines across varied regions and can farm together with friends in cross-platform multiplayer.

The player designs and programs factories of devices to produce cubes, using a grid command system, lasers, and sensors, then rewinds time to debug and optimize solutions. Set in a galaxy where cubes are the key commodity, the open-ended puzzle game includes a level editor and a conspiracy storyline to uncover.

A massively multiplayer open-world racing game set in 1:1 recreations of Hong Kong Island and Ibiza, where players buy and customize over 120 cars, race and complete delivery and taxi missions, and socialize in hubs like the Solar Hotel and casino.

Players pilot a wide range of aircraft, from light planes and gliders to helicopters and airliners, across a detailed recreation of Earth with live weather and traffic. They follow checklists, hone flight skills, and explore landscapes and airports in a realistic aviation simulation.

A 3D life simulation and crafting survival game set on a lush deserted island, where players customize realistic AI companions, build and gather resources, and enjoy a slow, carefree tropical life alongside autonomous NPCs.

In a demon-ruled world, the player is a survivor exploring a large grid-based dungeon in first person, fighting turn-based battles, customizing a character, casting spells, crafting from scavenged resources, and solving puzzles while hunting demons.

A first-person shooter where the player, as assassin Colt, is trapped in a time loop on an island and must eliminate eight targets before the day resets, using stealth or gunplay while optionally being hunted by a rival controlled by another player.

An epic RPG spanning Antiquity, Present, and Future, where the player leads a party through a time-crossing story, fighting enemies in strategic turn-based battles and building up gauges to unleash powerful attacks.

As owner of a mysterious Library, the player invites guests and battles them with librarians using cards and dice to turn defeated foes into books. Collecting books unlocks new guests and deeper secrets of the City in this stage-like battle simulation.
