A short horror game in which the player monitors live surveillance footage and must spot anomalies, from moved furniture to otherworldly intruders, then file reports describing each anomaly's type and location. Sharp eyes and good memory are needed to survive the night, alone or with friends.

A real-time strategy game set in 2047 after a comet forces humanity underwater, where three civilizations war for control of the abyss by deploying armies, researching technologies, mining resources, and hiding units in caves and cliffs across a 3D ocean.

A former outlaw biker scavenges, crafts and fights through an open post-pandemic wilderness, battling vicious gangs and roaming hordes of Freakers while riding his motorbike across a dynamic Pacific Northwest landscape, and searching for hope after a deep personal loss.

The official motocross championship game lets the player race as or against riders in the 2020 MXGP and MX2 categories, customize bikes and riders, and design and share tracks. A training playground, waypoint mode and online competitions round out the experience.

Players race hundreds of officially licensed motorcycles across dozens of scanned tracks worldwide, choosing a career path from regional events to professional leagues, competing in dynamic weather and day/night cycles, endurance races, and online multiplayer competitions.

Players learn Assembler programming by writing real code for a simulated 8-bit virtual machine modeled on 1970s computers, working through story-mode missions and logic puzzles under tight memory constraints while mastering registers, stacks, and instructions.

A first-person shooter sequel in which players fight waves of self-replicating clone female soldiers across new maps and levels. It adds new enemies, a physics-based doll system, an endless mode, and a crazy mode with adjustable enemy sizes, plus a shop and scoring.

Players take on the underworld of Fortune Valley, racing and battling cops to take down The House, a cartel controlling casinos, criminals and police. Three characters pursue revenge through heists, car battles, and customization across five car classes in an adrenaline-fueled driving fantasy.

A commercial fishing simulator set in the waters off Nova Scotia, where players captain upgradable boats, use varied fishing methods like harpooning and trawling, and manage a career amid dynamic fish prices, seasons, and realistic weather.

A space grand strategy and puzzle hybrid where the player colonizes planets, picks industries, and links colonies into mutually supporting trade networks, with no military combat, procedurally generated sectors, and short runs focused on economic decisions and technology choices.

A turn-based strategic wargame covering the 1941 Axis invasion of the USSR through the Battle of Moscow, letting players command either side with an operation-based system instead of hexes, offering distinct gameplay for German and Soviet forces plus PBEM and hot seat modes.

First-year student Kei Yagi is cursed so that the next love confession he receives will make him explode. He must dodge the affections of classmates while investigating the curse's origin, navigating multiple routes and endings through a chart system in this high school romantic comedy visual novel.

Players control Max Caulfield, a photography student who discovers she can rewind time after saving her friend Chloe. Together they investigate a classmate's disappearance, uncovering dark secrets in Arcadia Bay while Max learns that altering the past has consequences.

Mai explores the town of Le Choara by day, speaking with townspeople to find clues about her sister, and fights dark creatures in turn-based RPG battles by night. A faceless Berserker can kill in one blow, and players stack overkill damage and knock monsters between party members.

A turn-based strategy wargame recreating Rommel's Afrika Korps campaigns in Libya and Egypt between 1940 and 1942. Players command either Axis or Allied forces across scenarios ranging from small battles to a grand campaign, managing troops, air units and supply lines in the desert.

Alien invader Crypto returns in a swinging 1960s Earth, using classic weapons and a flying saucer to take revenge on the KGB, harvesting humans for DNA upgrades while exploring fictional cities, with optional two-player split-screen co-op.

Players take control of official drivers and cars across three WRC categories, racing over 100 special stages and 15 classic cars in an off-road rally simulation, with improved physics, redesigned environments, and online Clubs championships.

Players lead a civilization across ten thousand years of turn-based 4X history, choosing nation spirits, managing economy and research, and steering through variant or crisis ages that reshape the world. Alternate timelines and ages from first cities to space travel make each playthrough an epic strategy story.

Build and optimize a magic school while keeping powerful mages alive and inspired, then send them into the deadly Underschool labyrinth. Study lost arcana, grow exotic plants, brew potions, raise undead servants and magical beasts, and stop a deadly fog from consuming everything in its path.

Players collect iconic Hot Wheels vehicles and race them on spectacular tracks featuring loops, boosters, and gravity-defying stunts. A track editor lets players build custom layouts within interactive environments, and races can be played in split-screen or against up to twelve opponents online.

As an outcast seeking revenge on a village, the player uses necromancy, witchcraft, alchemy and demonology to sabotage the settlement's economy, spread plagues, and raise undead armies, choosing freely between stealthy reconnaissance, resource theft, or open assault while defending a lair from angry villagers.

A one-to-four player co-op shooter where crews of heisters pull off robberies across New York, from Wall Street to Manhattan penthouses, then fight through police, SWAT and special units to escape with the loot.

Command US or German forces in the winter 1944 Ardennes offensive across a grand campaign with a strategic map, dozens of hand-drawn tactical maps and scenarios, managing teams whose soldiers react realistically to stress, fatigue and morale.

A pausable real-time wargame recreating the Normandy invasion, where the player commands Allied or German forces across a strategy map and 64 hand-drawn tactical maps, managing teams, battlegroups and realistic soldier psychology through 60-plus battles, operations and campaigns.

A fantasy otome visual novel about an exiled alchemist whose failed elixir attempt shrinks her and seals her powers; the player makes dialogue choices, gathers ingredients, develops characters and pursues romance with three men while racing to brew the potion.

A friendship ritual transports high school student Ayumi and her friends to a haunted alternate version of their school, where vengeful spirits threaten them. Players explore Heavenly Host Elementary through point-and-click adventure and battleless RPG gameplay, making choices that change the story and the fates of its characters.

Players join a drift racing festival, exploring large open territories with iconic tracks, competing in single and multiplayer drift events, tuning and customizing Japanese, American, and European cars, and building a reputation and team ranking among drivers worldwide.

An open-ended puzzle game where players build assembly lines that push robots around and rewrite their paper-based brains to solve over a hundred puzzles. Beyond solving, players optimize solutions for speed and compactness, earn gold medals, chase leaderboards, and grow a robotics startup.

As the last defender of a peaceful land besieged by monstrous creatures, players build and position towers, upgrade them with gold, and adapt to increasingly powerful enemy waves and boss battles. Quick coin collection and power-ups round out the strategic top-down defense.

Set in 1942, players command Allied or Japanese naval forces in the Solomon Islands, protecting transports, deploying carriers and submarines, and engaging in real-time surface battles. The campaign includes tactical aircraft control, ship damage management, and historical missions.

Players dodge thousands of hand-crafted bullet patterns using a single button, with infinite lives and a deep scoring system for arcade mastery. The story draws on Philippine mythology and culture in a dark, gothic atmosphere with metal music.

At the close of the Iraq War, Special Forces searching for weapons of mass destruction uncover a buried Sumerian temple housing monstrous creatures. Players guide two rival factions through the underworld, making branching decisions that shape who survives, with online and pass-the-pad multiplayer modes.

A remastered city-building strategy game set in the medieval era, where players expand an empire, manage settlements, and trade across land and sea. The History Edition adds the Venice expansion with co-op and competitive multiplayer, new ships, quests, and items.

Players fight through dynamically generated worlds as survivors of humanity, battling deadly creatures and god-like bosses solo or in three-player co-op. They choose gear and weapons per biome, unlock and level Archetypes, and follow branching quests while crafting and collecting loot to stop an evil from destroying reality.

The player drives authentically recreated locomotives on high-speed, freight and commuter routes, mastering controls and physics while designing custom liveries and scenarios to share through the Creators Club.

A minimalist 2D platformer built from a 1x1 tileset where a small square jumps through levels with no enemies or projectiles, only precise platforming. Multiple difficulty levels, best-time tracking, and respawn counts challenge players to master each stage.

A challenging action-RPG set in an alternate-history Paris where King Louis XVI's automatons terrorize the city. Playing as Aegis, a mechanical bodyguard, players string together dodges, parries, and attacks against relentless machine bosses while exploring the city and shaping the French Revolution.

A strategy game set in the Roman Empire era where the player commands large armies on a strategic map, builds and manages cities and their economies, and fights tactical battles using formations against many tribes, nations and AI opponents across replayable maps and campaigns.

Players collect Witcher-world heroes and build decks to duel opponents online in round-based card battles across melee and ranged rows, using bluffing and tricks to win two of three rounds. Modes include classic, seasonal, and Arena play with hand-drawn card art.

Players become one of four Vault Hunters on the planet Kairos, battling the tyrant Timekeeper's forces with outrageous weapons, action skills and movement abilities while exploring an open world alone or in four-player co-op.

An online team-based action game set in 2040, where humanity uses cutting-edge exosuits to fight overwhelming dinosaur outbreaks. Players switch between assault, tank, and support suits during battle, coordinating with teammates to complete objectives against saurian swarms.

Players guide crescent-headed Wayne as he gathers a crew to stop the minions of the tyrant Gibby from resurrecting their master. They explore 3D environments with air-dashing, rolling, and gliding, fight turn-based battles, and find TVs granting new abilities.

A free-to-play massively multiplayer Star Wars RPG set over three thousand years before the films, where the player becomes a Jedi, Sith, Trooper, or other role, makes Light or Dark side choices across eight voiced storylines, and explores over twenty planets alone or with others in group content and PvP.

A dark fantasy strategy RPG where players liberate the war-torn land of Nevendaar, aligning with factions, recruiting units and fighting turn-based battles across a sprawling campaign with branching choices, base building and five endings, plus online skirmishes against friends.

A steampunk puzzle game in which the player, a novice engineer, programs automatons by composing nodes and arrows to solve client problems across 40+ levels, then optimizes solutions and builds custom puzzles in a level editor and sandbox mode.

Players control four companions who must survive terrifying foes across four episodes, using found objects, traps, and careful planning in settings ranging from a summer house to a cult film convention, a haunted TV studio, and a post-apocalyptic wasteland, alone or in two-player co-op.

Players command a WWII tank crew through procedurally generated campaigns spanning 1939 to 1945, managing terrain, weather, and enemy encounters in turn-based battles. Crew members gain experience and skills but risk injury or death, and success depends on tactics and survival rather than destruction.

A real-time strategy game set on a post-nuclear planet where the Survivors and the Evolved mutants battle for survival, using oil as the primary resource to construct buildings, train units, and upgrade forces across 50 missions.

Three factions—Survivors, Evolved, and Series 9 robots—battle over a scorched Earth in a fast real-time strategy game. The player captures oil fields with mobile platforms, builds structures, researches upgrades, and commands diverse air, land, and amphibious units across 51 missions and a mission editor.

Players follow homicide detective Dale Vandermeer through nine point-and-click chapters as he investigates a woman's death and is drawn into the surreal world of Rusty Lake. The anthology bundles classic Flash-era adventures with puzzles, achievements, and a hint system.

The player controls Marianne, a medium drawn to an abandoned communist-era resort, exploring the physical and spirit worlds simultaneously to investigate her past, solve puzzles, and defend against hostile entities in a haunting narrative shaped by trauma and sorrow.

In a 2030 retrofuture ruled by corporations, the player competes in a brutal blood sport that blends roller-skating tricks and grinds with third-person shooting, earning ammo from stunts and health from kills while uncovering a sinister conspiracy.

A VR action shooter inspired by Hong Kong action movies, pitting players against endless enemies in Ride runs, sandbox experiments and arena skill tests. Physics-driven interactions let players disarm foes, dual-wield guns, use slow motion and build custom weapons and ammo from any object.

An open-world first-person shooter set in an island town cut off by vampires who have blocked out the sun, played solo or in four-player co-op as heroes with unique abilities who uncover the mystery and fight the vampire legion.

Players pick one of eight heroes, each with a personal storyline and goals, and travel through a role-playing adventure where dramatic battles and the Glimmer system unlock new skills and combined ally attacks. The remaster adds a new playable character, restored cutscenes, and higher-resolution graphics.

Players command Warhammer 40,000 factions in fast-paced turn-based battles, developing armies and fielding heroes across a twenty-mission campaign and skirmish modes. Momentum systems, abilities, and air support drive combat, while a procedurally generated conquest mode and a daemon survival mode extend play.

Players lead a civilization through historical Ages, expanding territory, building Wonders, advancing technology, and pursuing scientific, cultural, militaristic, or economic victories, either solo or in online multiplayer.

A short VR game where the player becomes a knight on a medieval horse and defeats five enemy captains using motion controls to move, stop, rotate, and attack. Made by three people in two weeks, it requires Vive equipment and network access.

A strategy game where the player must survive hellish hordes flooding the world, choosing among eight classes and a procedurally generated world to explore, fight, build, trade, recruit allies, and forge gear, with multiple paths to victory and a sandbox or nightmare mode.

A visual novel following Estelle, an aspiring knight, as she works guild quests in a fantasy city with her elf, catgirl, and wolfgirl companions, fights plant and slime monsters, and navigates the bickering within her party while choosing a romantic partner.

Set in 15th-century Europe, players compete as merchant princes building trade empires across more than 40 cities, buying low and selling high while bribing senators, hiring mercenaries, raiding caravans and scheming for papal power. Wealth and influence decide victory against human or AI rivals.

Players control three ancient vampires in Boston's Camarilla, navigating a thriller of plots and power struggles where dialogue choices, investigation and vampiric disciplines shape the fate of the characters and the sect.

Players pilot speculative F-22 and F-29 fighters through training runs, dogfights against MiGs, and strikes on SAM sites across four Cold War-inspired environments. Dozens of tactical missions with air-to-air and air-to-ground combat build toward multiple objective campaigns and three unlockable endings.

Players race motocross bikes through a career mode, building and sharing custom tracks, exploring an island compound, and competing across official stadiums and tracks with over a hundred riders and customizable bikes.

Players are unwilling prisoners of the Murkoff Corporation during the Cold War, completing disturbing therapy trials alone or in teams of up to four while avoiding enemies, hiding, and using tools to stun or blind them. The tone is horrific and tense, with character customization and cell decoration.

Players command armies in real-time strategy battles by drawing lines across the map to move units, form defensive lines, and conquer territory. Inspired by classic RTS and board wargames, it emphasizes planning over micromanagement, with multiplayer up to eight players and procedurally generated asymmetrical worlds.

Five prisoners in an 18th-century Spanish monastery madhouse and inquisitorial prison combine their upgradable skills to sneak, explore, and manage their traumas and phobias in real time, uncovering the monastery's mysteries and planning an escape across two campaigns.

Players command armies of orcs, ogres, vampires, and knights across seven story-driven campaigns in medieval Bersia, leading heroes from the front while managing troops, terrain, weather, and artillery. Fifty missions and random battles let players build and evolve their forces.

A truck driving simulator where you run your own big rig business, bidding on cargo jobs and delivering across US highways through deserts, mountains, and coasts while managing fuel, road hazards, police, and cargo condition to protect your payout.

As guardian of the Getsu clan, the player descends into Hell to stop a cataclysm, fighting yokai and massive bosses in roguelike hack-and-slash runs. Each death reshuffles map layouts, while permanent upgrades, weapon crafting, and a soul-devouring power-up system deepen the challenge across repeated attempts.
A VR paintball trainer and simulator aimed at real paintball players, letting them design field layouts with a bunker editor and then walk and practice shots inside VR to prepare for tournaments.

Players guide a small marooned group surviving on a hostile alien planet, managing needs, health, and morale while building and defending a base against creatures and weather. Random events and resource scarcity drive an unpredictable strategic journey with research, farming, and crafting.

A brutal action RPG set in Japan's Sengoku period, where you create a protagonist and battle hordes of yokai across devastated locales. Use the Yokai Shift ability and face enemies who create Dark Realms that raise the stakes.

A visual novel in which photographer Hiroki discovers that several famous Japanese celebrities are succubi drawn to his scent, and must balance his job while romancing a growing harem of idols, a businesswoman, a social media star, an actress and a sportswoman.

Sent to a remote island to find a missing billionaire, the player survives a cannibal-infested open world by crafting, building shelters, and fighting mutated creatures alone or in co-op as seasons change and resources grow scarce.

A challenging card game where players build and constantly change their deck, using cards as hacking tools against adapting enemies across quick puzzle scenarios and long endurance tests. A story follows the people behind the code as a virus threatens the world.

Commander Shepard leads an elite squad across a galaxy in turmoil, with player choices carrying across all three remastered games and shaping missions, relationships, and the fate of the galaxy. The collection bundles the trilogy with over 40 DLC and 4K visual upgrades.

As a young deity, players build settlements and compete with rival gods for mortal followers, shaping a living world through blessings, visions, or tyranny. Actions influence followers' behavior and the environment, while day and night cycles allow guiding, sacrificing, or summoning undead and demons.

As governor of a province in ancient China, the player plans and grows a settlement into a prosperous city, managing production chains, resources, trade caravans, citizen needs, and divine favor while seasons and harsh winters test the infrastructure.

Players drive faithfully reproduced locomotives across 10,000 kilometres of European track while also running a railway company, hiring conductors, choosing contracts, maintaining trains and handling weather, signage and unexpected hazards on the line.

Players build bridges and constructions through bleak post-apocalyptic landscapes to guide survivors and iconic Walking Dead characters to safety, using movable objects, explosives and bait to lure walkers into physics-based lethal traps across numerous puzzle levels.

A post-apocalyptic survival strategy game where rising seas have destroyed the world. The player leads a band of survivors across islands, scavenging scarce resources, rediscovering technology, growing a colony, and defining laws and factions while balancing food, shelter, water, health and security.

As the Viceroy, players build a network of settlements for diverse fantasy races across a wilderness battered by Blightstorms, balancing needs and resources in a roguelite city builder where each expedition carries forward upgrades.

Players clean up crime scenes by disposing of bodies and erasing evidence without getting caught, planning stealthy routes or improvising through chaos. Four characters with unique skill sets can be swapped, set against a brightly colored 1990s-inspired backdrop with grime underneath.

This animated visual novel follows former assassin Luan, saved from man-eating creatures by a wandering dao priest named Ling Ling, as the pair face Chinese vampires, assassins and immortals across two episodes. The story mixes spectacular animated action, mountain-splitting explosions, blood, gore and humor in a dark, over-the-top tone.

A tactical first-person shooter casting the player as Raven, a contract sniper assassin operating in a lawless modern Middle East region, completing long-range contracts against a criminal syndicate through stealth, precision shooting and upgradable military equipment.

Set in 1863 Japan during the Bakumatsu period, players take the role of a nameless ronin whose choices between rival factions shape a branching story with multiple endings. Combat mixes melee weapons and styles with ranged arms, while an open world spans Edo, Yokohama, and Kyoto.

A story-driven turn-based strategy wargame set in World War II, where players command Soviet ground, air and naval forces through historical and alternate-history operations, upgrading troops, choosing skills and equipment, and following cinematic narratives featuring historical figures.

An interactive crime drama following two families in small-town Arizona from a 1998 robbery gone wrong across thirty years, where player choices shape character fates and relationships. Players make decisions in a cinematic, motion-graphic-novel style and can replay for different outcomes, alone or in cooperative voting with up to eight players.

Lieutenant Tatsunami Hibiki, hailed as the hero of Seattle, faces a new challenge when the Shogun visits with a synthetic food plant that could end Japan's food crisis, while hidden enemies threaten the fragile hope for peace in this visual novel episode.

A point-and-click adventure about an old scientist building a machine under a sinister doll-like entity that has enslaved mankind, gathering components while clinging to memories as a lethal climax approaches. Puzzles are solved with a simple interface and no dialogue, communicated through symbols and emotions.

Players enter the fantasy world of Gielinor as adventurers, choosing among 29 skills like woodcutting, farming, crafting, and magic while completing quests, fighting bosses, trading with other players, and building farms or ports in a long-running online world.

Players race cute animals through dreamy, nature-themed tracks in quick multiplayer races, using dive maneuvers to boost and dodge obstacles, and collecting bonuses to hinder rivals. Hidden shortcuts and a contemplative tour mode round out the family-friendly experience.

Players create a tennis star and compete through a career mode with merit-based rankings, tactical positioning and varied shots on grass, clay and hard courts, facing AI or friends in local and online matches while studying rivals and hiring coaches.

Players become both rider and engineer in a motorbike simulation, choosing from eight detailed real-world bikes, dismantling and tuning components in the workshop, analyzing live telemetry, and racing on ten faithfully recreated circuits and open roads.

Players command armies of new Commanders across land, sea and sky in three interweaving campaigns, using tiered Groove abilities to turn battles. A roguelike Conquest mode offers permanent choices, and in-game editors let players create and share custom maps, cutscenes and campaigns, with local or online multiplayer.

An RPG following a disillusioned hero who journeys to the Lemuria Continent alongside a runaway demon princess. The pioneer land offers dangerous monsters, unexplored terrain, and encounters with beautiful women as the hero seeks a person to share a hopeful future with.

Players act as a tower controller at Tokyo's Haneda Airport, issuing directions to aircraft so they fly safely and efficiently. Stages require precise timing and judgment, with extra and custom scenarios, replay resume, and adjustable conditions.

Meow Pow is a fast, physics-driven sports game where players control cats in local 1-4 player matches, slapping a ball toward the opposing goal within 90 seconds. Holding the ball halves speed, and slaps can steal it; dashing and bouncing bumpers across six themed arenas add chaos. The tone is energetic and playful.

Players build and manage a city in Ancient Egypt across 50 missions, cultivating the Nile valley, erecting pyramids and temples, and balancing economy, trade, culture, health, and religion. They must handle floods, plagues, wars, and the favor of the gods to make their city prosper and their pharaoh revered.

Players drive a taxi through a 1:1 scale reproduction of Barcelona, picking up passengers, following traffic rules, and handling weather, rush hours and random events. Fares fund new cars, upgrades and hired employees, building a transport business while managing routes and customer service.

A fantasy visual novel following Estelle, an aspiring swordswoman, and her party of elf, catgirl and wolfgirl companions as they take guild quests and confront a half-dragon gathering forces to avenge her fallen demon queen.

Set during the 1942 Kharkov battle, players command tanks and units across 30 missions in three single-player campaigns, taking crew positions like commander, gunner, and driver in first- or third-person views. Missions recreate historical events with realistically modeled vehicles.

Players build a nation one city at a time, zoning over 300 buildings, managing power, water, and services, and tuning a deep economic simulation with inflation, corruption, and immigration. Political policies, riots, slums, and bankruptcy shape a mature, statistics-heavy city-building experience.

A management and construction game where you build intricate railway networks to connect industries with resources, optimizing supply chains with multi-level tracks and varied engines across a 50-mission campaign, restoring an industrial colony while managing inputs, outputs, and bottlenecks.

As leader of a fledgling interstellar species, players explore the galaxy, research technologies, meet alien civilizations, design starships, and expand their empire through diplomacy, culture, or war. The 4X grand strategy game offers flexible play styles, custom civilizations, and multiple paths to victory across varied game lengths.

An RPG in which children board the giant tank Taranis to save their families from war, manning gun turrets in battle while living together inside the tank, building affinity among the crew and facing choices about sacrifice and the forbidden Soul Cannon.

Players fight through fierce battles in a fantasy world dependent on ancient crystals, customizing their party with various jobs and weapons across multiple difficulty options. The adventure revisits memorable locales and battle music from earlier Final Fantasy titles, offering nostalgia alongside an epic struggle.

A first-person boomer shooter spin-off set inside the deranged mind of the POSTAL Dude. The player runs and guns through hand-crafted, twisted environments with quake-like movement, fighting bizarre enemies with outlandish weapons amid crude humor and fantasy violence.

A lone wanderer with torn memories arrives in 2090s Cincinnati, a vast lawless cyberpunk city, in a text-based life-sim. Players spend daily action points on stories, skills, inventory, and risky choices, shaping who they become in a brutal, corporate-dominated world.

A medieval strategy city-building game where the player grows a village into a bustling city, managing resource production chains, districts, and seasonal demands. Expansion through conquest and historically accurate, gridless building inspired by fourteenth-century Franconia are central.

Players build 2D physics contraptions from wood rods, water rods, and wheels to move a red ball from a start zone to a goal area. The classic puzzle game includes a level editor, user-made levels, and a bundled sequel with magnets and moving platforms.

A dungeon-crawling RPG bundle in which a fallen hero returns to life 100 years after the Overlord of Darkness defeated the Knights of the Round, and must lead a new generation of heroes to restore hope. Players build parties, set traps, exploit elemental weaknesses, and bond with allies.

Players take the role of construction manager building Berlin's BER airport from the ground up, tackling over 100 recurring flaws and problems while trying to open it on time, in a satirical simulation that deliberately frustrates and includes archived articles to read.

A quadcopter simulator focused on freestyle acrobatic flight, with realistic physics and flight-controller tuning. New pilots build muscle memory while veterans adjust rates and thrust-to-weight ratios to invent tricks in a simulated environment built by and for the drone community.

After Earth vanishes in an electromagnetic burst, a Moon base crew assembles a ship and crew to find parts for the Centauri Drive and restore the planet. The open-world sci-fi RPG spans dozens of stars with resource harvesting, alien negotiation, real-time ship combat and turn-based ground fights.

A pausable real-time wargame recreating Eastern Front battles of World War II, where the player leads squads as a junior officer and earns promotions. It emphasizes historical accuracy, soldier psychology, limited ammunition, cover in buildings and trenches, and includes campaigns playable as German or Russian.

A comedic dating sim in which the player romances stick figures, including a baguette, through absurd dialogue and self-aware humor, with an anniversary edition adding new characters, developer commentary and deliberately unsettling jokes about dating and bread.

Players command a dark army of orcs, goblins, demons and zombies to conquer the kingdom for the wizard Vez'nan, building and upgrading towers, training heroes, and defeating bosses across 31 stages and seven realms in a strategic tower defense campaign.

Players build a pirate haven on a deserted island, constructing vertically on cliffs and hilltops while managing production chains and moving goods across chasms. Raiding nearby islands, equipping crews, and building ships to fight the Crown drive a city-building strategy experience.

Players build and manage an amusement park, controlling finances, shops, staff and guest needs across dozens of scenarios or in a free sandbox mode. The complete edition adds waterparks and animal habitats, plus a coaster cam for riding your own creations.

The player commands historically accurate armies of 11th-13th century Europe in turn-based tactical battles, leading named generals through set-piece historical scenarios and four campaigns, gaining experience and making strategic decisions between battles.

A tactical wargame simulating a hypothetical conflict in Syria between NATO and the Syrian Army. Players command US brigade combat teams in real-time or WeGo turn-based missions, facing conventional and irregular threats, with scenario editors and quick battles for replayability.

The player explores the vast magical world of Arukea as the Wanderer, following a story full of mystery and humor while using glitches, crafting, mini-games, and a class system called Guises. Combat is turn-based, with dungeons, puzzles, and character customization across many biomes.

Players run a construction company in an idyllic European town, taking on over seventy contracts to build and repair roads, houses, and bridges using more than fifty licensed vehicles and machines, expanding their fleet and business as jobs are completed.

Players build an empire across diverse ancient civilizations, crafting over a thousand recipes, recruiting NPCs, taming animals, and constructing fortresses. They fight land, air, and sea battles, compete in cross-server conflicts, and choose among many development paths. The tone is epic and strategic.

As a holy Cerim warrior on the plague-ridden isle of Sacra, players fight through visceral Souls-like combat, gather loot, craft gear, and build a home, alone or in seamless online co-op, in a hand-crafted world torn by plague, greed, and glory.

The player controls Mirai in a puzzle-based battle system, clearing falling blocks to build combos, trigger elemental powers, and defeat monsters, with real-time or optional turn-based modes, equipment, perks, and a job system shaping each encounter.

This supernatural horror visual novel follows protagonist Suzumu Susuhara and a cast of schoolgirls and staff caught in a tale of curses, sin, retribution, and penance. Written by Ryukishi07, it presents atmospheric backgrounds and hand-drawn characters in a story released outside Japan for the first time.

Between the World Wars, dhampir agent BloodRayne works for a secret society hunting supernatural threats. Across two connected missions she fights horrific creatures, Nazi soldiers and officers in a frenetic, bloody third-person shooter, searching for occult relics sought by a man serving the Third Reich.

Players control Rayne, a dhampir hunting her vampire siblings who seek to enslave humanity, fighting through fast-paced blade and gun combat with acrobatic moves, combos and supernatural powers in this enhanced edition of the action title.

Players command original Eldrador Creatures in turn-based tactical combat across Lava, Ice, Stone, and Jungle worlds, using special abilities to defeat rival factions and claim a Superweapon. Twenty playable creatures and dynamic environments with toppling walls and bridges shape each battle.

An isometric cRPG set in the war-torn fantasy world of Yerengal, where players uncover their birth legacy, recruit companions and pursue goals through sorcery, stealth, persuasion or force. Combat is real-time with pause, and a Greed mechanic ties choices to the world.

Players haul cargo across open highways to raise bribe money for Ma Jackson's tax-evasion case, choosing among four drivers with unique rigs. They trade goods, battle bikers, dodge rockfalls, outrun crooked cops and customize their 18-wheelers while exploring routes and hidden shortcuts.

As a Battlesister martyr, the player descends through six episodes of thirty levels in a hostile Citadel, gunning down cultists, drones, and mecha tanks with fourteen weapons and secondary fire, dodging projectiles and kicking foes into lava in a brutal old-school shooter.

A physics sandbox for players who enjoy digital toys, letting them create and control toys, define their own goals such as escaping, rescuing, or destroying, and share, download, and modify creations through Steam Workshop, with sample content available for those less skilled at building.

A history-driven turn-based strategy game set in World War II, following British and US campaigns across Europe, Africa, and Burma. Players manage armies, upgrade units, conduct reconnaissance, and make tactical and moral choices while encountering historical figures and battles.

Persona 5 Strikers follows the Phantom Thieves on a summer road trip across Japan, where a distorted reality emerges; players dynamically control the team in stylish action combat to reveal the truth and redeem imprisoned hearts in a new story.

A space factory-building game where the player automates production across an infinitely generated cosmos, designs movable space stations and battleships, builds megastructures like Dyson Spheres, and commands fleets against local aliens or plays pacifist mode.

Players fight in fast-paced one-on-one battles set in a heavy metal-inspired alternate future, following the final confrontation of a story twenty years in the making. New mechanics and a wall-breaking system aim to welcome newcomers while keeping depth for veterans.

Two childhood friends from opposing sides of a divided country meet alone on a serene beach during wartime, and the player makes choices through a dramatic narrative with multiple endings to decide whether they fight or make peace and how they escape being caught together.

Set in 1920 at the start of Prohibition, players build a criminal operation from nothing, running stills, speakeasies, gambling dens and smuggling routes, managing production chains, bribing police, growing a crew and eliminating rivals to rule the city.

In a dystopian 2084, the player is a neural detective who hacks into the minds of suspects and the dead to extract clues, reliving their fears and final moments while investigating a killer in a war-ravaged, cyber-plague-stricken city.

Players take on offroad vehicle modification contracts, installing upgraded parts like higher suspensions and snorkels within a budget, then test the builds by driving across perilous terrain, cliffs and muddy rivers in a single-player career campaign.

Fresh from prison, Kazuma Kiryu investigates his surrogate daughter's coma and her infant son, traveling from Kamurocho to a seaside Hiroshima town to uncover a yakuza secret, mixing gritty crime drama with explosive brawling and side activities.

As an emotionally dead, combat-substance-fueled grunt of the Cruelty Squad subsidiary, the player performs wetwork for a corporate conglomerate, sneaking or fighting through offices, suburbs, and secret compounds with varied weapons and multiple routes to kill or destroy targets.

Players join a high school literature club, writing poems and making choices to charm a crush in a dating-sim framing that gradually reveals psychological horror beneath the school romance. New side stories and unlockable art expand the experience.

An idle clicker RPG framed as a simulation program where the player pilots a violent space mech, defeating enemy ships with a single fire button. Players earn XP, spend skill points on upgrades, and chase big numbers through an endless loop of combat and progression.

Command the Blue Fox mercenary band through a war-torn fantasy world, issuing real-time tactical orders and managing skills, classes, and equipment to exploit enemy weaknesses in diorama-style battles that blend medieval and modern influences.

As a renowned Hunter, the player investigates supernatural murders in the strange town of Lunaris, uncovering a mystery involving witches, vampires, demons, and Lycans. This narrative visual novel offers six individual romances and two polyamorous pairings across eleven chapters with multiple endings.

In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by infected monsters, the player explores dungeons, scavenges supplies, and grows closer to five companions through dating, all under time deadlines that force choices between relationships, training, and combat.

A narrative RPG set in post-apocalyptic Western Australia where the player travels a desolated land, makes dialogue and quest decisions shaped by a philosophical Moral Compass, and develops a classless character through branching storylines and moral dilemmas.

Players carve out a life on the American frontier, battling lawmen, outlaw gangs and wild animals while building a camp, forming a posse with other players, and taking on bounties, hunting, fishing, trading and moonshining across a vast open world.

A visual novel following a photographer whose scent attracts succubi, leaving him with a harem of five accomplished women. When the succubus queen Yue appears from his past and spirits him away to her realm, he faces an ultimatum between her advances and escape.

After humanity's G-Bomb gambit devastates Earth, Lieutenant Tatsunami Hibiki treks to Seattle and takes command of a refugee garrison. Set in a dying, war-scarred world, the story follows his struggle to keep peace and defend survivors from renewed alien BETA attacks.

A remastered visual novel episode set after an alien invasion devastated Earth. Stranded on a carrier in the South Pacific, Lieutenant Will Collins conducts recon and meets survivor Lilia Kjellberg, whose clashing beliefs threaten the crew's survival as they struggle on a dying planet.

The player watches a pixelated fleet fight in real time, building an economy, upgrading ships, and collecting loot from destroyed enemies while balancing many resources. Progress unlocks a multi-layered prestige job system with distinct play styles and shared bonuses.

As the Tlatoani of Tenochtitlán, the player builds and terraforms a lake-bound city, performs rituals and sacrifices to keep divine favor, and leads a story campaign against the Moon Goddess, with sandbox and creative modes for unrestricted building.

In a 2280 cyberpunk world ruled by megacorporations, the player assembles a squad of heroes, builds 12-card decks, and fights turn-based card battles against corporate foes while gaining cybernetic augments and making moral choices in mini-stories.

As captain of a stolen ship awakened after a thousand years, players explore randomly generated planets, research technology, manage resources and crew, and conduct diplomacy and combat in a retro space strategy simulation.

After an apocalyptic event swallows Tokyo in chaos, the player navigates a broken city caught between gods and demons, making choices that shape rebirth or death in this punishing turn-based RPG remaster.

Elderand is a retro-inspired action platformer where players explore a twisted Lovecraftian world, fighting terrifying creatures and towering bosses with whips, swords, axes and magic. Metroidvania-style exploration, loot, crafting and RPG customization let players shape their character and uncover the darkness overtaking the land.

In a turn-based tactical RPG, players plan each step against enemies that move immediately after them, managing an Erosion meter, forging over a hundred weapons from chosen materials, and collecting souls for permanent upgrades while uncovering a dark world's truth through voiced story scenes.

Bowl as your favorite PBA pro in an officially licensed bowling game featuring 26 top professionals and TV commentary. Play online head-to-head, compete in tournaments, or build a career through over 100 events, choosing between authentic simulation physics or arcade-style play with over 150 balls to earn.

A free versus edition of the SpellForce 3 real-time strategy game, letting players test their RTS skills against AI opponents in skirmish battles or other human players in ranked and unranked 1-on-1 multiplayer matches. It also includes a single-player scenario map and randomly assigned factions of Orcs, Humans, and Elves.

Travis Touchdown, an all-American otaku, fights his way up the United Assassins Association rankings with a beam katana, cutting down legions of foes and rival killers while taking part-time jobs, training, and riding his motorbike through Santa Destroy.

Travis Touchdown returns with a beam katana to climb the assassin rankings, hacking and slashing through enemies in fast combat, switching between three playable characters, dual-wielding katanas, and earning money through 8-bit minigames.

A digital adaptation of the team-based card game Tichu, mixing poker-style sequences with bridge-like 2v2 partnerships, where players race to shed cards and score points, playing against bots or friends with voice chat, tutorials and replay tools.

This remastered cult classic first-person shooter bundles all original episodes and expansions plus a new episode, letting players blast through fast-paced levels with restored content, online and LAN multiplayer, a level editor and ludicrous gibs.

The player builds the Palace of Knossos in Bronze Age Crete, trading with Byblos, Troy and Mycenae, advancing agriculture, shipbuilding and architecture, decorating the throne room with Minoan frescoes, and defending against enemies and natural disasters across five palace stages.

Players lead the last survivors of a corrupted world, building fortresses brick by brick to withstand nightly waves of Horrors. They design modular defenses, manage resources and structural integrity, command units in battle, and explore for materials between sieges.

In a college town where broken artifacts grant special powers, the protagonist investigates parallel worlds to uncover a mastermind, aided by a justice-driven girl, in a supernatural mystery visual novel continuing an ongoing series.

Players help Flora, a former army leader, rebuild her forces and recover power artifacts to defeat the necromancer Baal contaminating the Pago lands. The tower defense game spans five acts and 26 missions, requiring gold, strategic tower placement, and spells.

Players build, gather, and defend against endless waves of Nightmares emerging from a living death fog in a procedurally generated world. Heroes, roguelite blessings and malices, and huge enemy swarms shape survival, campaign, and co-op modes as humanity holds the line.

A Metroidvania following Erza, a rising star of an empire in a swords-and-magic world, as she leads an exploration team through side-scrolling levels, fighting monsters and bosses. Players find secret passages, switch characters, and customize a cultivation system while uncovering the world's mysteries.

A space 4X strategy game in which the player commands a race expanding across a hostile, ever-changing galaxy, designing ships from hundreds of components, building planetary facilities, and pursuing research, intelligence, politics, treaties, and tactical or strategic combat to grow an empire.

Players race against the criminal organization SH1FT3R in a high-stakes tournament spanning the South Pacific to the Sahara, using spy gadgets, traps, and secret shortcuts to win. The arcade racer features 17 tracks, 13 racers, vehicle customization, and online or local multiplayer for the whole crew.

Isabella Song, a private detective and hacker, investigates crimes in a dark near-future city using drones, darknet searches, surveillance footage, blackmail, and interrogation. Each case weaves into a larger story, and the player's conclusions and morally difficult decisions carry consequences.

A clicker game about a mayonnaise jar, where the player taps the jar to progress through four wacky stories, unlock random facts and fifty achievements, and fill a 1950s-inspired collectible card album while competing on online click leaderboards.

As a bartender with one week left before a corporation shuts the bar down, the player mixes creepy cocktails for monster customers and befriends them while trying to do as much good as possible before time runs out.

Players lead a secret resistance against magic-wielding invaders posing as gods in a turn-based tactical strategy game, building bases across regions, managing and customizing a six-to-eight unit team, and teleporting into sabotage missions while a reactive campaign AI adapts.

An educational puzzle game where the player builds working computers from basic NAND gates, progressing through puzzles covering arithmetic, memory and full CPU architectures. A powerful simulator also lets players freely wire screens, timers, sound and network components and design their own assembly language.

A motorcycle racing simulation of the 2021 MotoGP season, where players ride across official tracks and classes, manage a racing career with staff and bike development, monitor fuel, brakes and tire wear, and customize riders and bikes.

A nameless militia soldier fights demons and enemy soldiers in a dark fantasy version of the Later Han Dynasty, mastering Chinese swordplay and Five Phases wizardry to awaken inner power and survive the chaos of the collapsing Three Kingdoms era.

A realistic sailing and foiling simulator puts players at the helm of high-tech racing catamarans and monohulls, trimming sails and adjusting foils to keep the boat flying fast without capsizing. Changing winds, currents and up to ten opponents feature in multiplayer in-shore regattas across recreated coastlines.

Players pursue a B.A.S.S. career from amateur events to the Bassmaster Classic, managing sponsors, equipping licensed gear and customizing their angler while fishing eight real-world venues, competing against pro anglers and other players in multiplayer modes and global leaderboards.

Players relive Clementine's journey across four seasons and bonus episodes of a choice-driven zombie apocalypse story, making dialogue decisions and quick-time actions that shape relationships and determine how her story ends, presented with enhanced black-and-white shading and behind-the-scenes extras.

Players collect cards and build decks to duel opponents in the digital version of the long-running Yu-Gi-Oh! trading card game. They compete in tournaments, learn through tutorials, and explore card lore in Solo Mode.

A sci-fi automation strategy game in which the player sends drones from a damaged ship to an unknown planet, building and automating facilities, managing resources and power, researching technology and programming unit behavior to survive and repair the vessel.

A dungeon exploration RPG set in a mysterious 99-floor labyrinth, where the player charts the depths, manages a party, uncovers events and hidden merchants, and fights monsters in real-time Active Time Battle combat using strategy and trial and error.

Players follow Denam through a civil war among three factions on the Valerian Isles, fighting tactical battles on three-dimensional battlefields. Choices alter the story and its endings, while unit-by-unit leveling and class, equipment and skill combinations drive progression.

Players run a tuning garage, disassembling and reassembling detailed cars, customizing them with parts and decals, then racing through the city at night in illegal street races to earn money and expand their own underground workshop.

A single-player deck-building roguelike with RPG elements set in a forsaken dark fantasy world where four cursed factions fight for survival. Players draft decks for three heroes, battle monsters in procedural dungeons, craft potions and weapons, and make branching choices that decide the world's fate.

Players design and run a casino resort skyscraper, placing gaming floors, hotels, restaurants, and staff areas while managing guest flow, morale, and staff pressure, watching a deep simulation react in real time to every layout choice.

Players command a 22-bug army of insects with distinct abilities, using military tactics in pause-to-plan real-time battles across a junk-strewn kitchen floor. The 56 missions deliver tongue-in-cheek humor and puns.

Players compete in official rally racing across 120 special stages and 52 teams, reliving historic championship moments in an anniversary mode. A career mode with livery editing, realistic physics, and online challenges lets drivers test their skills against the community.

The player runs a repair business restoring rusty World War II tanks and armored vehicles, using tools to de-rust, sandblast, paint, and fully disassemble them. Tanks can be customized, driven on a training ground, sold, or displayed in a museum, while perks, a parts shop, and contracts expand the garage in virtual reality.

Players build and automate a lunar colony, mining resources, running conveyor belts and drones, and unlocking research across three trees. They send rovers on expeditions, trade with Earth through contracts that sway its politics, and manage colonists' health, mood and skills through a story-driven campaign with multiple endings.

Players command World War II armies from six nations across 1939-1945, using simultaneous turn resolution to outmaneuver opponents with tanks, artillery, aircraft, and infantry. Scenarios range from small division clashes to sprawling army-level battles, with customizable historical formations and multiplayer coordination.

A visual novel sequel in which the dark witch Viola and her harem of girls open a maid café in the fantasy realm of Asaph. The player works as a maid, chooses which girl to dote on, and follows a new lighthearted chapter.

Hiroki, a man who discovered that famous celebrities are succubi, vacations with his harem at a private Okinawa beach house. Players follow the visual novel's summertime scenes, deepening bonds with each succubus through lighthearted daily interactions and romantic comedy.

Players lead historical civilizations in real-time strategy battles, building cities, managing resources, and commanding troops across land and sea through campaigns spanning centuries, with new civilizations, maps, and mod tools in this anniversary edition.

Players command a six-man special forces unit behind enemy lines in World War II, using real-time tactics to complete missions across Stalingrad, Central Europe and Normandy, with remastered HD visuals, improved controls and multiplayer deathmatch modes.

Command Czechoslovak Legion soldiers stranded in Siberia during the Russian Civil War, guiding them home aboard an armored train while managing scarce resources, morale and crew roles, and fighting real-time tactical battles inspired by historical events.

A space strategy simulation where the player commands a Krellan battlecruiser and its escorts, exploring star systems to conquer planets and destroy Alliance warships. Planetary invasions switch to a real-time ground combat mode controlling troops against defenders, with supply, boarding and prisoner management.

Players command Finland's outnumbered forces through the Winter War, Continuation War, and Lapland War, making tactical decisions about troops, captured equipment, and negotiations against a vastly larger Soviet enemy, with historical and alternate-history campaigns framed by cinematics about wartime leaders.

A truck simulator where the player hauls oversized cargo across an open world with dynamic weather, scouting routes in a spotting vehicle, dismantling obstacles and using cranes, while managing a company or working as an employee across roughly thirty missions.

Players defend their home for three minutes per round by placing units and playing cards against waves of monsters in a real-time blend of tower defense, deck building and roguelike systems. They combine heroes, upgrade cards with keywords, collect loot and choose rewards across twelve rounds. The tone is strategic and fast-paced.

A rugby simulation in which the player takes control of over 50 official clubs and national teams, competing in leagues and tournaments across single-player and multiplayer modes, and managing a custom team through a Career Mode with a deep tactical system.

A turn-based tactics game set in a dieselpunk world where the Black Empire and Blue League wage the Great War; players command units on grid-based maps, exploit terrain, upgrade troops, and fight boss battles across three story campaigns.

Lead a party through the oppressed Land of Vendir, exploring towns and dungeons while fighting turn-based battles with melee and spells. Customize characters across a large skill tree, gather loot, and make dialogue choices that steer a dark, choice-driven narrative toward multiple outcomes.

Players command a six-man elite WWII unit across more than ten missions, combining each specialist's skills to infiltrate enemy facilities through stealth, sabotage, and rescue operations in varied environments from Arctic plains to African deserts.

The player runs a lawn-care business in the British countryside, riding licensed mowers to complete mowing contracts across career, free, and challenge modes while managing headquarters, hiring employees, buying advertising, and balancing the books to grow the company.

In a medieval fantasy kingdom torn by civil war, the player commands rebel forces in turn-based tactical battles on grid maps, managing classes, mounts, and equipment. Choices about comrades and aid shape the fate of the kingdom and its characters.

Lead the survivors of a near-future apocalypse caused by alien arrival, choosing between the paths of the Voice and ZEPHON. Players manage cities, research unholy technologies, conduct diplomacy, and fight intense turn-based tactical battles across a ruined Earth while pursuing branching narrative quests.

An online RPG expansion where players create characters, follow goddess storylines involving Venus, Athena, and Olympus, recruit companions through quests, and design and upgrade their own homes with furniture and mounts.

Futuclass Education is a set of VR learning modules for chemistry and physics aimed at students aged 13 and up. Players hold molecules, shoot particles to build atoms, run a salts assembly line and solve an oxygen escape room, with lesson plans and a teacher portal tracking progress.

Players run a potion shop in a magical land, designing recipes, managing production lines and staff, setting prices, and marketing products to wizards and guards. They expand from a humble shop to a potion empire while handling VIP requests, faction fame and chaotic events.

Players study the traditional Japanese game of Shogi, learning piece movements, drops, promotion and formations at their own pace, then test themselves with over 60 Tsume Shogi puzzles and matches against AI opponents of adjustable difficulty across four regional leagues.

Players hit, pitch, throw and slide through arcade-style baseball matches featuring over 200 legendary former pros alongside fictional all-stars. Franchise and Pennant Race modes, expanded traits, Shuffle Draft and cross-platform online play add depth to the accessible sports gameplay.

Players build and actively manage a modern metropolis, focusing on complex production chains and a resource-based economy, balancing supply lines, trading, research, and laws to grow a city into a megacity of tens of millions of citizens across maps based on real regions.

A high-level wargame covering the 1942 eastern Front from Crimea to Stalingrad, where players command Axis or Soviet forces through strategic decisions rather than micromanagement. Scenarios are short and challenging, playable against AI, hot seat, or by email.

Players lead a squad of champions in turn-based tactical battles set in the Infinity universe, progressing through a campaign that unlocks new fighters and cosmetics. Matches revolve around action points, tactical cards, resource management, and ultimate abilities against AI or other players.

As a Dark Crusader, players journey through parallel realms of the living and the dead to stop the demon god Adyr's resurrection, mastering fast, challenging combat with hundreds of weapons and nine classes, alone or in online co-op.

Players command American, Ukrainian and Russian units at battalion scale and below in a fictional 2017 escalation between Russia and Ukraine, fighting tactical battles in a true 3D environment with realistic ballistics, fog of war, morale and electronic warfare, in real-time or turn-based modes.

A young alchemist named Sophie and a sentient book named Plachta journey to recover Plachta's lost memories by gathering materials, learning recipes, and synthesizing items, with new episodes, costumes, cauldrons, and quality-of-life features in this DX edition.

A young woman named Firis leaves her town to learn alchemy from Sophie, practicing her craft and gathering recommendation letters to pass a certification exam within a year, while exploring a wonder-filled world with new vehicles, quests, and fast-forwarded battles.

Twin novice alchemists Lydie and Suelle explore mysterious worlds inside paintings, gathering ingredients and fighting monsters to hone their alchemy and raise their atelier's rank in the kingdom, in a heart-warming everyday fantasy adventure.

A sci-fi body horror market tycoon where the player trades bodily organs across a desperate universe, managing a dynamic cargo hold, competing with rival traders and expanding profits while dark comedic storytelling unfolds.

Players lead a group of settlers to a new home, choosing a site based on nearby resources and shaping the land to build a thriving town. They manage housing, food, crime, education, trade, and seasonal disasters while unlocking development routes and surviving historical calamities.

An otome visual novel following Aya, a high school freshman newly moved to a small mountain town, as she meets six love interests and navigates slice-of-life romance, earning Friend or Sweet points through choices that steer her toward one of six routes with two endings each.

An art student named Ann becomes trapped in her school after breaking a rule, and with the security guard's help she navigates escape while uncovering the school's secrets. The RPG-maker-style horror game features chase scenes, death puzzles, animated cutscenes and multiple endings.

In a future where Earth's resources are gone, players command human forces against the Vexan swarm, building bases, developing technology and population, and managing armies from a god's-eye view while heroes with unique skill trees lead large-scale battles across varied maps.

A first-person shooter set in the year 2042 where players join large-scale multiplayer battles with class-based gameplay, vehicles and a cutting-edge arsenal, and can also create and share custom matches through the Battlefield Portal platform.

Players command German Imperial or Entente forces in the East African campaign of World War One, maneuvering troops across a turn-based map through seven scenarios and a full grand campaign. Event cards and asymmetric leadership and resources drive replayability in this lengthy strategy wargame.

In a zombie-overrun country, survivors hack zombies into obedient companions. The player explores varied landscapes, builds and upgrades a camp with traps and fortifications, and fends off aggressive locals, alone or with up to three friends in co-op.

Set in the Stargate SG-1 universe, players lead a team of specialists behind enemy lines across a story-driven campaign, using each character's unique abilities and synchronized tactical planning to stealthily defeat the Goa'uld threat.

A visual novel following Yaya and Aiyana as they search a dense forest for their missing childhood friend Koko, aided by a mysterious witch named Maia who demands embarrassing chores in return. The story centers on the trio's relationships, trust, and budding romance.

Players design, build, and run a medieval tavern, placing furniture, hiring staff and chefs, stocking drinks, and optimizing staff routes so guests are served before they leave. Expanding with rooms, events, and musicians grows the business in a cozy management sandbox.

Guide a handful of Vupfox survivors who crash on a mysterious island and cannot sail away. Build settlements, assign jobs, manage resources and research, then defend the colony from invaders using mazelike layouts and elemental gem towers across six hand-crafted islands.

A monster-collecting RPG where the player, as a Digidestined, explores a chaotic Digital World to restore order, raising two Digimon companions through feeding, training and Digivolving, fighting AI battles, and building up the town of Floatia.

An auto battler where eight players collect and arrange hero cards from a shared pool, forming lineups from 22 races and 13 classes. Matches unfold over tens of minutes as players adapt strategies, evolve units, and jockey for position to be the last one standing.

Players command RAF and Luftwaffe squadrons in simultaneous turn-based dogfights over the English Channel in 1940. Each turn is split into planning, simulation, and review phases, letting players plot maneuvers, watch physics-based outcomes, and scrub through the action to assess damage and pilot survival.

The player defends a fortified Stalingrad apartment building as Soviet forces, surviving a deck of cards representing German 6th Army assaults until the defenders are ordered to storm a key strongpoint. The tone is tense and historical, with multiple difficulty levels and high replayability.

The player is trapped in a strange cave and must climb out using only movement, jumping, and a pickaxe. This precision platformer features a fully connected map with no checkpoints, so all progress can be lost, and offers selectable and unlockable characters.

A strategy RPG where the player assembles squads from over 25 unit types using customizable Rooms, scouts battle conditions, and makes story-altering choices. The World Eaters return in a modern re-release of the 2007 original, with options to kidnap or fight townsfolk.

As Patron, the player builds and upgrades a settlement into a prosperous city, managing resource production chains, research, weather and seasons while balancing the competing social and political demands of individual citizens whose happiness depends on government decisions.

Greycoat, a soldier seeking redemption, leads a band of anthropomorphic animal companions through the Wilds in a narrative-driven tactical RPG. Players fight turn-based battles using positioning and environmental hazards, parley with foes mid-combat, and customize their party with runes across a linear campaign and procedurally generated world.

The player is a high school student who discovers that several classmates are magical girl superheroes. Across nine in-game days, the player befriends the girls, uncovers secrets, and navigates a threat from a skeletal villain, with multiple character paths and prom invitations at the end.

A first-person cinema management simulator where the player buys films, sets up projectors, stocks snacks, hires and assigns staff, expands and decorates theaters, and handles disruptions like piracy, robberies, sneaking kids, and smokers during screenings.

Players build and run a coffee shop, decorating the space, hiring and managing baristas, handling the supply chain, analyzing budgets, and advertising. Market research and a 3D coffee editor let them craft recipes to keep customers happy and grow a coffee empire.

Set in 2150, the player works for an asteroid-belt mining facility, hauling mineral-rich asteroids in a company ship. Ships are built and wired from node-based components, and radiation degrades systems over time, forcing creative rewiring and repair to survive and deliver payloads.

The player recruits, trades and delists players, fuses stars with coaches and gameplans, and guides a team through State Leagues to National League success, using a match engine based on Australian Rules Football analytics.

Players control Jacob Lee, an inmate in a maximum-security prison on Jupiter's moon Callisto, battling inmates transformed into monstrous creatures through a blend of shooting and close-quarters combat while scavenging gear and uncovering dark secrets to escape.

A reformed delinquent takes a job at a beachside café, growing close to two waitresses and his childhood friend while trouble threatens his new life. The visual novel follows his relationships through dialogue and story choices.

A top-down soccer simulation from the creators of Sensible Soccer, letting players compete in World Cup, International Challenge, or indoor league matches against the computer or a friend, with 29 teams and special kicks.

A real-time stealth strategy game set in a fantastical Caribbean during the Golden Age of Piracy, where players recruit an undead pirate crew with unique supernatural abilities and strike from the shadows to defeat the Inquisition.

A text-based idle RPG where players click action buttons to grow abilities, clear quests, battle monsters, and summon and strengthen creatures, with automated dungeons, offline bonuses, and multiple endings shaped by the player's choices.

Players control Carl Johnson returning to a crime-ridden fictional state in the early 1990s, working to rebuild his family and take control of the streets after being framed for murder, in an updated open-world action game with new lighting, textures and controls.

A management simulation where players build and run a zoo, importing and breeding animals, hiring staff, keeping visitors happy, and splicing DNA to create over 300,000 hybrid creatures while deciding whether to operate legally or cut corners.

A retired detective investigates the disappearance of a young girl in a 1950s-inspired neighbourhood, spying on suspicious neighbours from his window, breaking into their homes to gather evidence, and piecing together deductions himself as relationships fracture around the case.

Players form a fireteam of up to three marines and battle Xenomorphs across four campaigns on the planet LV-895, exploring ruins and caves in a third-person survival shooter. They choose classes, weapons and perks, and set up defensive positions to survive hordes of alien enemies.

Combat Mission Cold War simulates hypothetical 1979-1982 conflicts between US and Soviet forces around West Germany's Fulda Gap, plus early National Training Center exercises. Players command company-level units across 15 standalone scenarios and three campaigns, comparing equipment like M-60s and T-80s in a sandbox of tactical experimentation.

As demon queen Karin, build and expand a dungeon labyrinth with amenities to lure adventurers and extract their cash, recruit and upgrade demon squads, and use traps and bosses to defend your hoard across replayable runs.

The player builds modular castles from interlocking blocks on 3D hex maps to defend against waves of enemies in this tower-defense variant. Campaign, endless, and creative modes offer tech purchases, projectile physics, and dynamic pathfinding that reacts to the castle's construction and destruction.

An asymmetrical multiplayer shooter pitting a four-person Fireteam against a Predator. The Fireteam completes missions and escapes by chopper while the Predator stalks them with alien weaponry; players can take either side using human and alien arsenals.

Players lead the first human expedition to Mars, exploring the planet, exploiting local resources, and growing outposts into cities while keeping settlers' living standards high enough to retain their support, with the long-term goal of terraforming the world and spreading life across its surface.

Players race prestigious licensed cars across roads and tracks in career, Porsche Series, and Endurance Championship modes, managing fuel, tire wear, and pit stops. They also build and manage a club and garage, competing against rival clubs on leaderboards.

Learn Xiangqi, the ancient Chinese strategy game, through interactive training boards covering piece movements, checkmate conditions, and tactics. Practice with over 60 puzzles, play against varied AI opponents at adjustable difficulty, and progress through regional leagues to sharpen your strategic skills.

A short visual novel in which Trond, a sarcastic loner quarantined after leaving Italy's lockdown, meets other isolated souls and makes choices that branch the story toward more than eight different endings, asking who he will become when the quarantine ends.

Build and expand a horse ranch, feeding and caring for a herd, training horses in speed and jumping, breeding foals, competing in cross country and gymkhana events, buying and selling at auction, and befriending villagers while uncovering the town's secrets.

As a walrus lighthouse keeper, you shelter anthropomorphic travelers, meet their requests, trade with guilds, cook meals, and send expeditions while developing a hamlet on land, underwater, and in the air against extreme weather and natural disasters.

An idle RPG where players hunt for rare loot, craft and alter equipment, and grow a character through a vast skill tree of over 700 nodes. Progress continues even when time is short, culminating in challenges against mighty seraphim.

The player runs a railway station, assigning platforms, planning connections, and coordinating staff so trains depart on time amid breakdowns, sick passengers, and other disruptions. Expanding infrastructure and recruiting departments improves punctuality, satisfaction, and appeal, playable solo or in four-player co-op.

A group of documentary filmmakers accepts a mysterious invitation to a replica of a serial killer's Murder Castle, only to find themselves watched and manipulated by a killer. Players explore the hotel, solve tool-based puzzles, and make choices that determine which characters live or die, alone or with friends.

Players explore a dungeon that changes each playthrough, collecting jewel units to build a party of knights, matching symbols and colors to trigger abilities, equipping accessories and using gems in battle to defeat the Black Witch and free imprisoned friends. The tone is light fantasy strategy.

Players run a home brewery, mashing malts, boiling hops, and pitching yeast to create beer styles from wheats to stouts and IPAs. They design labels, enter competitions, fulfill job requests, and upgrade equipment to build a reputation, with a story-led mode and a relaxing sandbox creative mode.

Lab Rags is a 3D puzzle game set in an art-deco 1920s laboratory where players control a crash test dummy and use failed attempts to progress. By manipulating the properties of previous frames, players overcome dangerous traps, treating failure as a tool rather than an end. The tone is humorous and contemplative.

Players build a deck from a shared center row, recruit champions and actions, and fight opponents in card-game-style combat, leveling heroes across classes and taking on online PvP, co-op boss missions, or a scripted single-player campaign.

Players lead a team of subterranean adventurers into a monster-filled labyrinth called Yomi, navigating grid-based dungeon levels to find riches and escape. They build a party of six, fight turn-based battles, level up, and use the Switch Boost system to create doors and bridges.

A street racing game with detailed car part simulation, where the player strips and rebuilds vehicles in a 3D garage, races point-to-point through old Valo City, and climbs the ranks of local racing clubs.

Players build and manage a small 17th-century colony in the New World, gathering and refining resources, running production chains, and trading with England via ships. There is no combat; the challenge comes from food, shelter, economy, workers, weather, and settler needs across three historical-inspired scenarios.

As emperor and battle commander, the player leads one of six factions in a real-time blend of tactics and 4X strategy, managing orbiting planets, fleets, diplomacy, and economy while fighting for survival against extinction.

A virtual reality mountain biking game where the player rides handcrafted downhill and cross-country tracks through varied environments and lighting conditions, competing in free ride, time trial, and NPC races, with hot seat multiplayer for friends sharing one headset.

A turn-based strategy war game where players pick one of four factions, build card decks of heroes, units and tactics, explore a randomly generated post-apocalyptic map and fight AI opponents for resources and survival.

Players control nine teenage camp counselors on the last night of summer camp as a party turns into a night of horror, making life-or-death choices that shape a cinematic branching story where any character can survive or die.

A weekend spiritual retreat on a remote island turns to dread when a group chant opens The Gloom, a psychedelic dimension feeding on negative energy. Players explore in third person, fight prismatic creatures with spiritual weapons and crafted resources, and balance mind, body, and spirit while unraveling a 1970s cult's legacy.

Players climb a shifting tower in a deck-building roguelike, choosing a character, pet, and one of three clans, then capturing defeated enemies to add their abilities to a card deck. Random events, shops, artifacts, and a skill tree support repeated ascents through reshaped floors.

Players patch cables and manipulate inputs using modular synth-style components to solve over 40 puzzles, competing on leaderboards, customizing the interface, experimenting freely in sandbox mode and creating or sharing their own puzzles through Steam Workshop.

Players build 18-card decks and battle opponents in a free trading card game where both sides take turns simultaneously, playing creatures onto a 3x2 board and casting spells. Six lead characters, AI opponents, and a draft mode with custom cards support competitive play in a dystopian future setting.

After falling from the sky onto a dragon, the hero becomes ruler of Selphia and builds a new life by farming crops, raising monsters, fishing, cooking, and crafting while exploring trap-filled dungeons with swords and magic. Socializing with townsfolk, festivals, and romance round out the adventure.

A collection of three ninja action games where players fight heated battles as Ryu Hayabusa and four other playable characters, swapping between them mid-fight and unlocking costumes and modes. A Hero Mode assists low-health players with automatic guarding and evasion.
