A turn-based strategy game in the SpellForce world where the player inherits a wizard's tower, studies spells, summons minions, recruits heroes and apprentices, gathers resources, and battles rival mages to control sources of the Allfire and expand their floating domain.

As manafinder Lambda, players explore over 23 biomes of the wild world Aevi, fighting more than 120 beasts with varied weapons and elemental ores to gather manastones for an exiled community. Choices shape the settlement's fate and lead to one of two distinct final chapters.

Mercenaries Blaze is a fantasy tactical RPG about a corrupt kingdom and a fight for equality. Players command characters in turn-based battles on isometric 3D maps where facing, distance and elevation matter, spending skill points on abilities and job classes and unleashing unique Blaze exceed skills.

A high school graduate with no prospects joins forces with charismatic talking guns to fight an alien cartel invading Earth, traveling across the cosmos as a bounty hunter, collecting loot and meeting odd characters in a comedic adventure.

A social-based village management sim where you pair up townsfolk into couples, follow their lineages across generations, and balance production, trade, and housing to grow a settlement. Random events and visitors bring drama, and every playthrough is procedurally different.

As a vampire's loyal human servant, players must awaken a new vampire mistress who has shrunk to child size with no memories or magic. They balance her schedule to raise stats, hunt targets in RPG minigames, unlock jobs, and shape her personality across more than twenty endings.

A mapmaking application for tabletop RPGs in which the user picks a theme and draws rooms, and procedural algorithms automatically generate walls, floors, objects and lighting. Maps can be tweaked, randomized, printed, shared or exported to virtual tabletop software, with no generative AI used.

A text-based interactive romance novel set in a Parisian luxury brothel, where the player is a swordswoman dueling for the honor of the courtesans while navigating seduction, rivalries, and secrets among lovers including a rival duelist and a shy bartender.

Kratos, his vengeance against the Greek gods behind him, lives in the realm of Norse gods and monsters, where he must survive and teach his son Atreus to do the same. The over-the-shoulder action combat and journey through gritty forests, mountains and caves explore fatherhood and controlling rage.

Players pick from twelve drivers and race through vibrant 2.5D environments, drifting at high speed across a world tour of stages. Modes include a single-player championship, quick arcade races, time trials, and split-screen multiplayer for up to four, with customizable cars and an energetic soundtrack.

A visual novel following Iris, a Purifier who guides souls to the afterlife, as she meets half-immortal Magicians and uncovers the mystery of the MO worlds. Choices lead to good or bad endings in a story meant to make players laugh and cry.

Players explore seven continents of the world of Arkesia, fighting hordes of enemies and colossal bosses in fast-paced action combat while customizing classes and skills. The free-to-play RPG mixes MMO questing, raids, PvP duels, and life skills like crafting and sailing.

Three trapped souls journey through an ever-changing labyrinth, combining roguelike deckbuilding with chain-3 grid manipulation to battle nightmare enemies, collecting over 200 cards and chaining tiles to attack, defend, and gather resources across randomized runs.

As Steward, players lead a snowbound post-apocalyptic city through cascading crises, building districts, managing coal, oil, food, and heat, and balancing the conflicting ideologies of factions in the Council Hall across a multi-chapter campaign and a sandbox mode.

This fighting game continues the Persona 4 story as heroes battle an army of Shadows in the P-1 CLIMAX. It includes the original Arena story, a deep roster of Persona 3 favorites and Shadow versions with varied fighting styles, plus Japanese and English voice options.

Players design warheads, missiles and delivery systems, place them on a world map, and run large-scale nuclear conflict scenarios to estimate casualties, destruction and nuclear-winter effects using realistic blast, heat and radiation models.

A joke sumo wrestling game where players control unstable, self-willed characters and try to push opponents out of the circle or make them fall, playing against a friend on a shared keyboard or against AI, with up to four characters who keep toppling over and breaking objects after matches end.

A pirate roleplaying game set in the 17th-century Caribbean, where the player customizes a flag, develops skills and notoriety, raids colonies and convoys, and fights tactical turn-based naval battles on a hexagonal grid.

Players command large-scale modern warfare battles in the Baltic region, deploying over 300 realistic units across a narrative campaign, skirmishes, and online matches, while building custom army decks and designing scenarios with a visual scripting editor.

Players lead a faction on the desert planet Arrakis, balancing warfare, espionage, political influence, and spice economy in real-time 4X strategy while avoiding giant sandworms. The tone is tense and strategic sci-fi intrigue.

Players roam a seamless open-world wuxia sandbox as one of several origins, learning hundreds of martial arts, joining one of sixteen sects, and taking on city professions. They can build and manage sect industries, recruit companions, form relationships, and fight turn-free real-time battles across branching stories with multiple endings.

A hardcore, realistic FPV drone simulator with large dynamic environments where players fly, customize drones, and share maps and tracks with the community. Blackbox imports reproduce real drones, and an editor lets players build and import their own spots.

The player rides a dirt bike through indoor supercross races, building a career from Futures and Rookie classes up to Pro, managing rider fitness and injuries. It includes a compound for practice, a track editor for sharing custom courses, and online and split-screen multiplayer racing.

Players ride motocross bikes through the official MXGP and MX2 2021 season, building a career, signing with teams and sponsors, and racing over forty riders on championship tracks. They also build and share custom tracks, explore a playground, and compete online.

Players command the Grey Knights in turn-based tactical combat against Chaos forces spreading a cosmic plague, upgrading a base, researching arcane mysteries, and customizing champions across multiple worlds. The tone is dark, brutal sci-fi warfare.

As mystery novelist Haruka Kagami, the player investigates four murders spanning 1922, 1972, and 2022, watching live-action incident footage, assembling clues into hypotheses, and confronting killers to unravel a century-old family mystery.

A young swordsman training to become a royal soldier switches bodies with a mysterious girl after being attacked in the forest, and must navigate a story-driven RPG where his actions ripple through the minds of everyone involved. Players build skills through a skill tree and chain skills while exploring over 140 maps.

A turn-based strategy RPG set in a fantasy world of swords and magic where three nations clash after a revolution. The player commands a protagonist and 17 characters with unique weapons, skills, and class changes across map-based battles to advance a story of war and belief.

A hero-building strategy game set in a galactic marketplace where players collect exotic items and weapons, arrange them on a board, and unleash combos against creatures and rival players in asynchronous encounters while uncovering lore across repeated runs.

Players operate trains on the Tatehama Electric Railway by tilting a master controller to accelerate and brake, while also handling horns, buzzers, and viewpoint changes. As conductor they open doors, make announcements, and perform safety checks, then review a driving rating after each run.

Players build and run a laboratory where scientists capture zombies with freezing guns and cure them into docile human hybrids, managing power, workers, and resources while defending the facility from nightly zombie waves. The tone is hopeful and strategic, framing science and healing as the path to reclaiming a fallen world.

A third-person action-adventure in a war-torn region overrun by supernatural creatures, where players explore a semi-open world without maps or quest markers, fighting chimeras with melee weapons and a drone while unraveling the mystery of the calamity.

Alchemist Sophie searches a dream world for her lost companion Plachta, befriending new allies while exploring regions whose weather she can manipulate to open paths. She fights seamless turn-based team battles and crafts items through a panel-based synthesis puzzle system.

Players command a space empire in a persistent multiplayer strategy game, building economic, industrial and scientific infrastructure, researching technologies, hiring specialists, forming alliances and trading with allies while fighting other players to capture stars and achieve galactic domination over multi-week rounds.

Players join pop singer Cadence as she recruits musicians across a musical world to compete for stardom, while dark forces threaten the Harmonic Convergence. Battles are turn-based musical performances with rhythm-timed attacks, genre-shifting conditions, and mashup abilities, plus puzzles and customizable difficulty.

The player runs a pharmaceutical company for twenty years, hiring scientists to research treatments, optimizing factory production, analyzing news to forecast disease trends, launching awareness campaigns to boost demand, and hiring lawyers to defend unethical acts while weighing corporate greed against ethics.

Continuing a war against the Drogakan empire, players lead a band of female warriors, deploying heroines as units with unique combat skills. The strategy game adds equipment crafting, unit branching, base research across military, economy, and technology, gem upgrades, and siege battles with catapults and towers.

Players control a puppet crafted by Geppetto in the blood-soaked Belle Epoque city of Krat, fighting monstrous foes with combinable weapons and mechanical arms while deciding whether to lie or tell the truth to those they meet.

Players control Grave, a resurrected gunslinger anti-hero, mowing down hordes of enemies in stylish third-person shooter combat that blends gunplay with martial arts, across a dark futuristic South-East Asia, in a story of vengeance, love and loyalty.

In 1996 Scotland, Simon Ordell returns to fog-shrouded St. Amelia, exploring in first person, evading and fighting threats with melee weapons and firearms, sneaking past enemies, and solving narrative puzzles using a portable CRTV that tunes into unstable signals.

A Frankish knight journeys from Venice across the Middle East to Tang-era China seeking the Invincible Arts of War, drawn into power struggles and a dark lord's ambitions. Players fight turn-based battles, capture enemies in a fusion pot to craft items and monsters, and explore a historical-fantasy world.

A roguelike deckbuilder in which players assemble a team from twelve characters across four classes, combining over 700 cards with runes and talents against 90 enemies. Runs are procedurally generated across a dark fantasy steampunk continent, with story events, mini-games, camp quests, and character-specific backstories.

The player leads a caravan of Mka adventurers through the meteorological chaos of the Phithi, fighting pirates and monsters while enduring acid rain and storms. Each expedition explores lost ruins, rescues refugees, and plants a new tree city, passing memories and knowledge to future caravans.

Players run an airline in a multiplayer aviation simulation, buying real aircraft types and flying routes to real airports worldwide. They manage staff, schedule maintenance, set seat configurations, buy fuel and CO2 quotas, run marketing, and form alliances to grow profits.

Players build and upgrade decks of Warhammer 40,000 Citadel Miniatures cards, dueling other players in turn-based PvP battles and campaigns, choosing factions and Warlords while unlocking special rules and growing their collection to climb the leaderboard.

The player experiences the three original Game Boy SaGa titles in one collection, choosing classes such as human, mutant, monster, and robot, battling through diverse worlds, and progressing toward Paradise atop a tower, with added high-speed and screen-layout options.

Players build and manage a cozy dungeon for their creatures as the Absolute Evil and the Dark Elf Thalya, then send them into the Overworld to spread evil across lush lands. Traps and defenses protect the dungeon from Overworlders, with a comedic tone and a soothsayer framing the story.

As an early-1800s entrepreneur, the player grows a small railway company into a continental network, laying tracks, bridges, and tunnels, managing locomotives and freight, and outsmarting rivals across campaign, scenarios, free play, and co-op multiplayer.

Players guide four breeds of secretly intelligent sheep through seven worlds and 28 maze levels, choosing among four heroes and solving puzzles to herd the flock past Mr. Pear and his henchcows while collecting golden sheep.

After crash-landing on the shape-shifting planet Atropos, Selene fights through bullet-hell third-person combat, dying and restarting her journey each time. The procedural world and item combinations change every cycle as she explores a decaying ancient civilization and uncovers its mystery.

The player builds and manages a newspaper in 1930s New York, laying out the newsroom, hiring reporters and staff, and choosing editorial angles before each Sunday deadline. Decisions on coverage and tone affect readers, sales, and pressure from the Mayor, Mafia, Military and High Society.

A motorcycle racing game where players collect over 200 bikes and race on more than 35 tracks. Career mode has them climb the ranks against rivals, Endurance mode tests fuel and pit-stop strategy, and changing weather and physics demand skill in wet and dry conditions.

A strategy RPG where the player controls a hero, explores a procedurally generated overworld, builds up a town, and amasses an army. Overworld and town management are turn-based, while large battles play out in real time with spells and attack orders.

Players take the role of an assassin traveling over twenty living locations, using creativity, unlocked gear and strategic planning to eliminate targets across replayable missions that blend stealth, spy-thriller intrigue and rogue-like elements.

A standalone turn-based wargame covering the Tunisian campaign of 1942-1943, with weekly turns and scenarios from Kasserine Pass to the final push for Tunis. One player commands Axis land and air units, the other American, British and French forces.

Players build and manage a soccer team in this digital football game, signing players from clubs and national sides worldwide, developing their abilities, and competing in VS AI matches, online PvP divisions, and co-op friend matches while weekly data reflects real-world transfers.

Lloyd Bannings joins the Crossbell Police Department's new Special Support Section, handling odd jobs with his teammates while uncovering the criminal corruption and dark secrets beneath their vibrant city-state, using refined strategic turn-based combat.

Lloyd Bannings and the Special Support Section return to defend the city-state of Crossbell as tensions rise between two neighboring powers and shadowy organizations stir. Players progress through a story-driven RPG finale, using new combat features like Burst and Back Attack while importing save data from the previous game.

Rule a customizable fantasy realm in a blend of 4X strategy and turn-based tactical combat, exploring magical realms, evolving your faction through tomes of magic, and guiding your empire through battles, alliances, and storytelling events toward glory.

Players take the role of Luca, locked in a dark room with bloodied hands and forced by a demon to continue a gory ritual. Using an instant camera, they explore, photograph and develop images, interact with objects, and survive randomly changing events in a first-person psychological horror experience.

As a Paladin sworn to free the land from otherworldly invaders, the player uses cards, mana, recruitable followers and blessings to move, interact and fight in turn-based battles. Randomized maps and decks, unlimited undo during combat, and heavy planning make each scenario a slow, strategic puzzle.

Continuing the story of Clear, who sealed the dragon Bahamut within himself, players adventure through a fantasy RPG with 27 job classes, over 500 combinable skills, an SP-based action combat system, and a pet system.

Set in the Bronze Age Near East, players build a village near fertile land, balance food surplus against population and army growth, spend Knowledge Points on improvements, and pursue victory through conquest or a Wonder while raiding enemy farms.

A Victorian steampunk cRPG set in an open-world London docklands, where players control three intertwined characters and resolve situations through combat, persuasion, magic, or explosives, using a tarot card chance system and skill growth.

Players settle an interstellar homestead on a verdant exoplanet, piloting a customizable mech to plant and harvest alien crops, build a retro-futuristic farm, and explore the open world. They can craft mech parts, raise alien livestock, and invite up to three friends to cooperate.

Commanding Allied forces across North Africa and Italy in World War II, the player fights real-time tactical battles and guides a dynamic campaign map as a general. Four factions, battlegroups, destructible environments and terrain-based line of sight support solo campaigns, skirmishes and multiplayer.

Siffrin and their adventurer friends try to defeat an evil king, but a tragedy resets time, trapping Siffrin in a loop. Players repeat two days, equip memories, and fight turn-based battles to uncover the truth.

Two players cooperate online in first-person to solve puzzles and hunt passwords across a motel, racing a timer and surviving a rising toxic tide. Players drink and throw bottles, upgrade movement and chase achievements and speedrun records.

A 2D speedrunning game where players accelerate a spaceship toward the mouse cursor, drifting around corners to set fast times across official and workshop levels, with free, arcade, and competitive modes plus leaderboards and ship customization.

Set at the turn of the 20th century, players run a railroad corporation, laying tracks, deploying locomotives, managing finances and loans, growing cities, and lobbying government while competing to build a profitable rail network.

Players defend planets against star-like monstrosities called Apparitions using collectible cards in a deck-building roguelike. Cards can be fused and rewritten to create synergies, while procedurally generated star maps and permanent death push repeated runs across five themed planets with distinct strategies.

Frey Holland is transported from New York to the blighted land of Athia, where a sentient bracelet grants her magic. She explores open realms, battles corrupted creatures with customizable spells, and uses magic-enhanced parkour to uncover the mystery and find a way home.

As head of an international initiative, players build and manage an underground research base, recruit and train explorers called Gaters, and send them through portals to alien worlds. Missions involve studying lifeforms, negotiating with factions, and making life-or-death decisions while caring for the team.

A narrative adventure following single mother Louise on a late-1960s American road trip with her eight-year-old son Mitch, where dialogue and choices shape his Righteousness, Confidence, and Relations, leading to one of nine endings amid the era's social upheaval.

Players act as president of a railroad company, designing stations and laying rail, bus, and ferry lines to develop towns and boost tourism to hot springs, castles, and other attractions. The business simulation focuses on urban planning, advertising, and subsidiaries to grow the company and shape the town's future.

A Tokyo high schooler forced to transfer becomes a Phantom Thief, exploring the city, recruiting Personas, customizing a Thieves Den, and fighting to reform people with distorted desires, with alternate endings and a large bundle of downloadable content.

Players take the role of Great House leaders on Arrakis, blending deck-building and worker placement over ten rounds to gather resources, build influence with four factions, and win conflicts for control of the spice and the Imperium.

The player collects cubes, upgrades their drop rate, and attacks enemies to earn skill points for a 3D-like skill tree. Prestige resets progress for large boosts, helpers automate collection and combat, and periodic bosses and challenge modes test the player's growing power. It is a mouse-only incremental game.

A turn-based tactical soccer game where players flip cards to determine movement patterns, position their players, and kick the ball into the goal before time runs out, with every move consuming the clock.

Engineer Isaac Clarke boards the mining ship USG Ishimura to repair it and finds the crew slaughtered and his partner missing. Armed with engineering tools, he fights hostile Necromorphs and uncovers the mystery while battling his own crumbling sanity in this sci-fi horror remake.

A space city-builder and colony simulation where stranded humanoid Axonauts settle a moon and expand across a simulated planetary system. The player manages resources, builds production chains, and grows a multi-lunar society while balancing ecological challenges toward constructing a great wonder.

A local tabletop tool for game masters who project or display maps on a TV, letting them import animated backgrounds, videos, and images, apply fog of war, overlay grids, place tokens, and add ambient audio and particle effects to immerse players during in-person sessions.

Players uncover hexagons where each revealed tile shows how many neighboring tiles share its color, solving quests with the character Rubelard. The game includes online one-on-one multiplayer matches, level creation and sharing, and procedurally generated practice levels, presented as a competitive puzzle experience.

Starting with an empty plot and close family, the player builds a homestead in the Scottish Highlands, managing farming, livestock, crafting, and schedules across multiple generations. Family members marry, have children, and pass skills on as the clan survives harsh seasonal winters.

Players pilot a small plane using realistic dial-based instrumentation and VOR navigation, delivering mail bags to regional airports as quickly as possible while managing fuel, cargo, deteriorating weather, and mechanical emergencies across several US states and difficulty levels.

A classic real-time tactical wargame recreating the European campaign of World War II, from D-Day to the Battle of the Bulge. The player manages troops, places and moves units on a battlefield map, and outmaneuvers the enemy across five historically accurate scenarios.

Set in 1916, this strategy-action game has the player command British or German air forces, planning routes and battles on a tactical map before entering side-scrolling dogfights and bombing runs. It includes historical and fictional campaigns, factory management, and a campaign editor.

Players build a custom gladiator from dozens of races, craft weapons and develop skill trees, then fight brutal turn-based arena battles where limbs and heads can be severed. A single-player campaign follows the Automatons across Brandor, while online multiplayer lets players climb leaderboards against real opponents.

Players take the role of Camina Drummer aboard a scavenging ship in the Belt, exploring wrecked vessels in zero-g, managing a tense crew, and making dialogue choices whose consequences shape the fate of everyone aboard across five episodes.

A motorcycle racing simulation covering the 2022 MotoGP season, where players race official circuits, relive the 2009 championship through narrated chapters, learn in the Academy, manage a team and bike development, and customize riders and liveries.

A single-player roguelike deckbuilding expansion to GWENT set centuries before the Witcher era, following the young mage Alzur and his companion Lily on a quest to create a living weapon against monsters. Players fight one-round card battles, spend energy on spells, and face randomized runs with curses.

Players build teams of cute pets with unique abilities and battle other players in a chill free-to-play auto battler. Arena mode offers asynchronous matches without timers, while Versus mode pits eight players against each other in quick synchronous rounds.

Players raise, train, and battle unique monsters, choosing between doting care and intense training regimes. The DX collection adds online monster downloads and competitions, plus a music database that generates monsters from CD titles.

In 2330, players join Constellation as customizable space explorers, traveling across over a thousand planets, meeting factions, piloting and modifying ships in dogfights, and gathering resources to craft gear and build outposts.

As a samurai of one of four elemental houses, the player builds a card deck to defend the floating Celestial Islands from corrupting foes. Missions across vibrant 3D maps involve turn-based battles, treasures, shrines, and evolving playstyles through more than 200 illustrated cards.

Players relive the events of Terminator 2 through pixel-art arcade action, controlling Sarah Connor, the T-800, and John Connor across missions against the T-1000 and Skynet. The game mixes iconic film scenes with original scenarios, multiple endings, boss fights, and high-score chasing.

A digital adaptation of the deck-building board game where rival thieves sneak into a dragon's lair, grab valuable artifacts and escape before being roasted. Each careless move makes noise that draws the dragon's attention, and players acquire items, abilities and allies while competing against friends or online players.

After King Aurelius dies, Princess Elizabeth leads the Order of the Griffin against undead and rival factions. The player recruits and levels fighters for turn-based tactical battles, uses cover and flanking, explores for secrets, and develops a flying fortress base while travelling the world map.
A sandbox based on Conway's Game of Life where players click a grid to toggle cells, watch them evolve under simple rules, preview 3D stacked cells, and share creations through the workshop.

Players tinker at a cozy pixel-art workbench, soldering circuit boards, adding buttons, speakers, and screens, then coding gadgets in Lua to bring them to life. They can share creations, download and disassemble others' gadgets, and customize designs with paint and stickers.

Overlord Zetta, soul sealed in a tome after his Netherworld is destroyed, sets out to reclaim his body and conquer enemy lands in a strategy RPG. Players summon armies via the INVITE system, wield magic and weapons, and can explore Petta Mode's origin story.

A rookie hero trains in Bizarro Earth and dives into randomly generated, multi-leveled dungeons in a turn-based roguelike, gathering equipment, modifying his body on a grid, and customizing a home base with allies to grow strong enough to defeat Darkdeath Evilman and save the world.

Three protagonists explore the ominous Mt. Hikami, a mountain tied to gruesome incidents and water worship, using the Camera Obscura to repel vengeful ghosts and seal their powers. Shadow Reading reveals memories of the disappeared, leading players deeper into the mountain's mysteries.

Players become a bounty hunter wielding the Demon Gaze, an eye that controls demons, and explore the many labyrinths of the Misrid region, defeating android-like Demons to gain their abilities and summoning them in battle from the Dragon Inn headquarters.

Set in the early 1930s, players explore a cursed estate as an Egyptology student, fighting supernatural horrors with weapons and solving puzzles to destroy a mystical Egyptian water-clock, in a remastered first-person shooter with live-action video sequences.

Players manage a hockey franchise, choosing from leagues worldwide or historical NHL seasons, overseeing finances, strategies, staff, trades, drafts and scouting to build a championship dynasty, with new on-ice decisions and adjustable trade difficulty.

A rogue-lite card game where the player builds a party of heroes and fights through ten randomly generated levels of a demonic tower, combining cards to defeat demons and their king while chasing leaderboard scores.

You play a small witch running a magic shop in a town of dungeon masters, mixing resources in cauldrons and pounders to craft minion orders for customers with varying tempers, then expanding the store across forest, cave, and desert locations over days and nights.

Players command an army as a chosen general in the fantasy world of Aer, building forces from four races and over ten unit classes to defeat the Shadowlord's lieutenants across five continents. Turn-based battles, research upgrades, hidden heroes, and items drive the campaign, scenarios, and local multiplayer.

A turn-based hex strategy game set on the Pacific front of World War II, letting players command Allied or Axis land, air and naval forces through historical battles like Midway or a hypothetical Japanese victory, with customizable armies, campaign, scenario, battle generator and local multiplayer modes.

A real-time strategy game set on the alien world of Yavain, where four races struggle for power across 28 scenarios. Players command units, cast spells, form alliances, and train troops through combat and stealth to achieve victory.

A strategy game where the player controls covert agents and corrupted heroes in a fantasy world, using schemes, plots, and rituals to spread plague, summon volcanoes, and bring about the apocalypse while the forces of good, led by the Chosen One, try to stop them.

Players assemble legendary Spirits and defend against endless hordes of Hell in a tower defense game where Fire, Lightning, and Wind tiles are used to build mazes and trap enemies. Each level presents a different strategic challenge, and Hellement bonuses let players amplify their Spirits' strength.

Otaku assassin Travis Touchdown wields his beam katana through ten alien fighters to climb the Galactic Superhero Rankings and stop Prince FU from taking Earth. He explores an open world on his motorcycle, taking battle and volunteer missions to fund ranking fights.

A turn-based operational wargame recreating Germany's September 1939 invasion of Poland, where players command division-level units, air support, artillery and event cards across a 19-turn campaign, aiming to understand the campaign as an interactive history book.

On a remote island chain facing destruction, a hero and a girl who failed to become a maiden set sail to save the islanders in this card-based tabletop-style RPG, where every element is presented through cards in a melancholic tale.

As Aarya, the newest member of a magician council, players manage the Royal Order over sixty in-game weeks, balancing time, quests, and stats while handling political tensions among three kingdoms and a pirate threat, with romance and ten endings.

Zed, a boastful zombie, uses his Super Reincarnation ability to rise from the bottom of the Netherworld and challenge a God of Destruction, gathering colorful allies along the way. Battles are over-the-top tactical fights with special attacks, and customizable options like autoplay ease newcomers in.

A sci-fi tactical extraction game set in a fractured galaxy after the collapse of an empire. As a star hunter, the player commands a fleet, takes bounty contracts from rival factions, explores dangerous ruins for treasure, and upgrades a base while weighing risk against reward.

Players race hover cars around gravity-defying, twisting neon tracks in a retro 80s style, competing against friends in local couch PvP. Using a grapple hook to swing around corners and collecting momentum charges for boosts, they aim to beat rivals across three tracks in this easy-to-learn, hard-to-master racer.

Players manage a racing team, hiring drivers and engineers, designing and manufacturing cars, negotiating sponsorships, and making strategic decisions across seasons while watching races unfold in 3D or 2D views or simulating them.

A crafting RPG set in the magical world of Bandle City, where a shy yordle uses knitting magic to restore collapsed portals and reunite the islands. Players gather materials, craft items, farm and cook, build gadgets, and throw festivals for fellow yordles while befriending League of Legends champions.

Players take the driver's seat of Kyoto's Eizan railway, operating the master controller and brakes while full HD live-action footage of city and mountain scenery plays. The simulation includes guidebook material, multiple trains, and repeated runs along uphill and downhill lines.

Players drive heavy trucks and buses across off-road maps, delivering cargo to earn money for new vehicles and fuel. The focus is on soft-body physics simulating tire deformation, suspension and vehicle parts.

Players pick a protagonist in a theatrical tale and steer choices through interlocking stories, toggling behaviors to unlock new paths, all of which lead to bad endings. It is a short puzzle game with many illustrations and dozens of endings to discover.
A turn-based strategy game set in a parallel-universe 1978 world war, where players pick a country and use propaganda, sabotage, and bombardment to outlast rivals and become the sole survivor.

In the peaceful Outlands, the player places buildings, manages resources, and assigns work spots while settlers choose their own jobs and homes. A mission-based campaign follows eccentric town leaders, with Decrees trading happiness for efficiency, plus a sandbox mode for creative building.

A cycling simulation based on the 2022 Tour de France, letting the player create a rider or manage a team through official stages, build custom tours, and race online against others on weekly leaderboards, with optional race incidents and preparation systems.

Players guide Bronze Age empires through a streamlined turn-based 4X, expanding borders, founding cities in tactical spots and raising armies. Each turn offers one opportunity to choose, with random victory conditions, historical maps, 52 playable empires, and simultaneous-turn multiplayer.

Players explore a vast black-and-white dungeon in first person, customizing a character and party to reach the deepest levels. Combat runs in real time but can be paused to read enemy intentions and deploy skills arranged on a shared nine-panel formation grid.

A visual novel and social simulation set in a cavern-bound Victorian London where death is temporary and talking rats abound. As the doctor who treated the first murder victim, the player investigates the killing, pursues romance, earns money, and crafts stories and theories through dialogue and outfit choices.

As one of the last surviving Jedi Knights, the player controls Cal Kestis in a third-person action-adventure across the galaxy, fighting new and familiar threats while the Empire pushes him to the edges of known space five years after Fallen Order.

Control five heroes, each with unique dice, and fight through twenty levels of monsters toward a final boss in this tactical dice battle roguelike. Each turn plays like a mini-puzzle: reroll 3D dice, level up or gain items after fights, and chase ridiculous combos, with permadeath restarting the run after any lost battle.

A detailed wargame recreating the Eastern Front of World War II, letting players command German or Soviet forces across operational scenarios and full-map campaigns from Operation Barbarossa to the fall of Berlin, managing logistics, air power, and combat.

Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022 is a train simulation and world-building toolset where players drive locomotives across included routes and use the Surveyor 2.0 editor to construct, paint, clone, and share their own railway scenes with marquee selection and gizmo tools.

A first-person medieval simulation game where the player inherits an old forge, gathers wood, iron ore, and coal, crafts products by combining resources, sells them to customers and traders, and upgrades the forge to gain riches and recognition.

Players compete in tennis matches as professional players or a custom MyPLAYER, using timing-based shots and four playstyles across clay and grass courts. Career mode follows a rising pro through the Grand Slams, with local and online multiplayer.

A free city-building prologue where the player designs neighborhoods, manages over thirty resources without money, and balances quality of life against industrial productivity. Education unlocks advanced buildings, and cities grow organically based on surrounding conditions, with street-level observation of the result.

Play as Aiden, a young dragon awakened from slumber, taking revenge on humanity by fighting WWII ground forces, aircraft, and battleships with fire and flight. A story of carnage and righteous fury against machines of war.

Players choose one of eight protagonists with different origins and set out across the land of Mardias in a free-form scenario system, battling resurgent evil deities through turn-based combat with Glimmer and Combo mechanics, now remastered in HD with new characters and bosses.

A man living with a harem of succubi travels to a small European country after a princess invites his actress companion to teach her karuta. In this visual novel he befriends the princess and her maid, whose suspicious behavior draws attention.

Players land on Saturn's moon Titan and build an industrial factory, mining minerals, producing goods, and managing logistics while keeping workers supplied with air, food, and water. They defend against pirates and disasters, trade with settlers, and expand across procedurally generated worlds.

Set in 1860s Kyo amid inequality, players take up the sword and revolver of Sakamoto Ryoma to hunt his father's killer, clear his name from a framed murder, and restore his honor, in a historical adventure that ends the samurai era.

A high school student awakens a Persona and investigates the mysterious Dark Hour, climbing the tower of Tartarus to battle Shadows while living through a full school year and forging bonds with companions. The tone is dark and emotional.

A chess training program in which the player studies positions, follows AI-based hints toward sacrificial combinations, reviews visual evaluations of pawn structure and king safety, and practices calculation against a strengthened Fritz engine to improve their play.

A grid-based strategy RPG where the player moves armed units across tactical maps to defeat pirates, rebels, monsters, and imperial soldiers, following hero Zade through an epic war campaign with branching paths, recruitable allies, and turn-based battles.

An underwater survival city-builder set on the ocean floor after Earth's surface becomes a wasteland. The player constructs a multi-level base, gathers resources across biomes, researches technologies, and sends drones and submarines on expeditions while managing hazards from sea life.

A tactical submarine simulation puts players in command of advanced nuclear-powered submarines, managing sonar, radar, electronic warfare, and weapons in a detailed South China Sea setting. Realistic physics, acoustics, damage control, and clickable control stations emphasize authentic systems over arcade action.

A young boy retreats from a broken family into a nightmarish dreamworld built from his memories, where his trauma manifests as monsters. Players sneak past enemies, solve puzzles, and direct a dream spirit to reveal paths and threats while uncovering the truth to wake up.

A detective noir visual novel set in a sunless city where the National Police Agency's 13th Division investigates the sealed Cult Massacre case amid rumors of the Shining Union. Players follow Ruka Hiryu, a superpowered detective, through buddy-cop banter and a moody jazzy soundtrack.

Players build a party of catchable, upgradeable monsters to fight through randomized encounters and bosses in a fast-paced strategic auto-battler, managing team composition carefully since a single defeat ends the run, all while pursuing the Automon Champion title.

Players run a mountainside spa for capybaras and other animals, planting gardens and crafting soaps to fulfill visitor requests. Improving popularity unlocks furniture and expands the spa, while insects help manage tasks in a calm, cozy management experience.

Players fight in large-scale medieval multiplayer battles, from sword clashes and flaming arrows to castle sieges, on 64-player objective maps. Mounted combat, a subclass system, and varied weapons let players charge alongside friends across all platforms.

Players build a classless character in a 3D MMORPG set in a shattered mosaic world divided among four factions, choosing weapons and skill trees freely. They explore with friends, form parties with mercenaries and partners, and uncover mysteries behind the world's catastrophe.

Aura is summoned into the fantasy world of Roya and cursed by the Demon King, forcing her to hunt him while a second enemy corrupts her mind from within. Players explore a semi-open world, manage limited time and money, and fight puzzle-like boss battles, balancing corruption against progress across daily segments.

Set two thousand years after the stars fell, this classic RPG sends players across a monster-ridden world and over a dozen dungeons, building a party from eight classes that layer across four tiers, with fast turn-based battles and no equipment restrictions.

The player rules a crumbling empire, managing resources, supply convoys, and restless provinces while facing barbarian invasions and political intrigue among simulated senators, generals, and spies. Battles mix real-time strategy with timed turn-based decisions, and the goal is survival rather than expansion.

An off-road racing simulation where players drive buggies, quads, and rock bouncers across deserts, forests, mountains, and circuits. Players analyze courses, pick routes around obstacles, tune vehicles, and manage a team through a career mode, with online races for eight players.

An idle roguelike RPG where the player is a superhero who unlocks and combines over 99 superpowers, building synergies across procedurally generated runs, items, and enemies. Challenges require different playstyles to unlock new upgrades.

Players control Nor Vanek, an elite soldier joined by a magical fox companion, fighting gods and undead armies across the besieged lands of Kian. Combat blends melee, gunpowder, and magic with rapid mobility, while exploration and gear upgrades prepare for a showdown with the gods.

The player begins as a single cell in a primordial broth and evolves into a complex organism, managing energy production, growth, internal transport, and immune defense. The survival simulation emphasizes balancing cooperating subsystems and fending off viruses, bacteria, and parasites while expanding the organism chunk by chunk.

The player races licensed motorcycles, cars, trucks, quads and SSVs across an open desert world recreating official Dakar Rally stages, managing seasons, dynamic weather and a day-night cycle in single-player career or online multiplayer events.

Commanding the remnants of the US military against a machine network, the player leads an army across large strategic maps, making tactical decisions about unit placement, resources and equipment that carry consequences through a campaign, plus skirmish and multiplayer battles.

Players command fleets in fully 3D space combat, using megaliths and space phenomena as tactical terrain while a galactic story unfolds. The campaign is joined by a co-op roguelike-inspired War Games mode and competitive multiplayer battles against human opponents.

Players command US, UK, or German forces through turn-based campaigns and skirmishes set during the Normandy landings, managing units, armor facing, terrain cover, and crew members while leveling troops and assigning heroes between battles.

An RPG where the player creates a hero's child in the magic town of Kalmaruss, choosing parents, class, and appearance, then explores a randomly generated dungeon, befriends townsfolk, takes jobs, and pursues romance and marriage.

A turn-based strategy RPG where players choose one of six nations on the continent of Runersia, organize knights and monsters into troops, and fight hex-based battles to conquer enemy bases and unify the land across seasonal phases.

As Rook, the player leads a team of seven companions against corrupt ancient gods threatening the fantasy world of Thedas. The player explores diverse environments, befriends and romances companions, and battles darkspawn, demons, and dragons in a dramatic single-player RPG.
Players follow Lian Feng, a young man studying in 1920s Paris, through a long visual novel romance as he rebuilds himself after disillusionment and finds love amid the city's social ups and downs.

A turn-based strategy wargame recreating the 1941 Battle of Hong Kong, where players command either the outnumbered British and Commonwealth defenders or the attacking Japanese forces across 18 daily turns, moving air and land units and playing event cards.

This strategy wargame explores a hypothetical 1985 Cold War turning hot in Germany, with hardline Soviets striking first against NATO. Players command either the Warsaw Pact or NATO across scenarios and campaigns, from small engagements to a full month-long European war, with turns representing two days.

Players command American or Japanese forces in five Pacific island battles of World War II, from Tarawa to Iwo Jima, balancing infantry, tanks, planes and static defenses while playing strategy cards each turn to capture or hold territory.

Players design and test bridges using a custom physics engine, guiding vehicles to their destinations across an open-world campaign of over a hundred levels, with sandbox mode, community workshop levels, leaderboards, mods, and decorative customization.

Players command a party through highly strategic turn-based battles on varied terrain in a war-torn fantasy continent, making choices that shape the protagonist's conviction and story path, and voting with allies on decisions that determine the group's fate.

Dungeon Maker is a multiplayer tool for running tabletop fantasy role-playing online, letting hosts build multi-level maps with placeable items and random generators, link them through a world map, and control enemies and NPCs whose stats drive automatic hit and damage calculations.

Lead a noble family ruling a small medieval kingdom after an empire's collapse, managing skills, traits, and ambitions while feuds, assassinations, and invading armies threaten your line in a colony sim built around emergent stories.

A 3D racing game in which up to ten players pick one of four hovercraft and race directly against each other on tracks made by the developer or users, firing missiles, dropping landmines and using boosters, with some tracks used for ball-hitting sports.

Players choose from four hero classes to hunt dragon creatures and Dragon Lords in a world corrupted by dragon blood, fighting through battles to reach the endgame. Online co-op supports up to four players, who also develop a mountain refuge city and customize skills through the Ancestral Grid.

Players wake with no memory on a strange island and flirt, banter, and woo four Dead by Daylight Killers in a choice-driven dating sim, exploring locations, playing flirtatious minigames, and earning multiple endings ranging from true love to bitter loathing.

Players transform an alien landscape into a thriving industrial colony, harvesting resources and designing production lines with conveyor belts in a fully destructible world. They must balance settler needs for food, shelter, and medicine while defending against environmental threats and mysterious alien forces.

Prier and her brother Culotte, novice demon hunters of La Pucelle, fight demons and zombies while uncovering plots by a rival church with dark intentions, using isometric tactical combat, purifying defiled ground, and converting monsters to their side.

Play as Cornet, a young girl who can talk to puppets, in a strategy RPG where she pursues her dream of meeting her prince while facing the evil Marjorly. Musical interludes, anime-styled characters, and an isometric battle system with elemental affinities and puppet upgrades drive the adventure.

As a risen necromancer, the player drafts undead minions and casts spells in turn-based autobattler fights to reclaim a throne. Between battles, skulls earned in combat are spent in the castle on rituals, training and upgrades across roguelike runs.

A tactical RPG set in a fantasy world where players join Princess Kiera and the Wild Lynx Mercenaries. Battles unfold on quarter-view maps with height differences and positional support effects, while characters build a gauge to unleash unique Rebirth Exceed talents.

Photographer Max Caulfield discovers her friend Safi murdered and gains the power to shift between two parallel timelines, one where Safi still lives, as she pursues the killer across a winter campus and makes choices that shape both realities.

Deploy into an authentic Cold War military sandbox with realistic weapons, ballistics, and vehicles across vast islands. Fight other players or AI in multiplayer, co-op, and single-player modes, or create and curate custom missions, with extensive mod support from the in-game Workshop.

Players explore a demon-overrun post-apocalyptic Tokyo, recruiting and commanding over 270 demons in turn-based battles while choosing between two story paths that decide the fate of humanity amid angels and demons.

A management game set in the Wild West where the player runs a saloon, mixing drinks, cooking meals, hiring staff, customizing the bar, and handling fights, bets and shady opportunities while getting involved in the townsfolk's stories.

A strategy game about conquering ancient Gaul with Roman legions, combining turn-based campaign management of raising, supplying and moving armies with action-oriented real-time battles, and letting the player decide whether to pacify or plunder Gallic villages.

Players manage a rugby union club, handling training, staff, transfers, finances, and facilities while guiding the team through major tournaments using 2D and 3D match engines with real-time tactical decisions.

A digital card game adaptation of Cardfight!! Vanguard with over 1000 Standard-format cards, an original story following Yuki Ichidoji as she assembles a team, and ranked online or CPU battles plus a tutorial for newcomers.

An operational wargame recreating the Ardennes battles of December 1944 to January 1945 at battalion scale on a 1km hex map. Players command units through a 16-day campaign and smaller scenarios, managing weather, line of sight, supply, and march versus combat modes.

Journey through the Eye of the Beholder trilogy, first-person real-time Dungeons & Dragons role-playing adventures set in Waterdeep and beyond, where a party investigates evil lurking in sewers, temples and ancient ruins across three connected campaigns.

A collection of classic Gold Box Dungeons & Dragons role-playing games set in the Forgotten Realms, including Pool of Radiance and Curse of the Azure Bonds. Players create characters, explore cities and dungeons, and fight monsters in turn-based and real-time combat across multiple adventures.

A sandbox-only logic simulator where players draw color-coded circuits and write assembly programs, then run a high-performance tick-based simulation. With no tutorials or levels, players set their own goals to build and experiment with digital logic freely.

A throwback top-down football game with simple one-button kick controls that still allow passing, shooting, tackles, crosses and free kicks. The player manages squad selection and substitutions across 200 national and club teams, competing in quick matches, penalty shootouts, tournaments and full seasons with friends.

Players pilot customizable mechs in fast-paced, omni-directional battles across massive stages, using mobility on land and air to defeat enemies. Different parts change attacks, movement, and battle style, letting each mission be approached with a unique strategy against powerful bosses.

Players follow Joel, a weary smuggler, and Ellie, a 14-year-old, as they journey across a ravaged post-apocalyptic America after escaping a military quarantine zone. They sneak through abandoned cities, scavenge supplies, and fight infected and hostile survivors in a tense, emotional story.

An RPG told entirely through cards, following a girl who swears revenge on monsters and joins a mysterious boy on a journey. A game master narrates as the player moves avatars through card-represented towns and dungeons, battling and trapping defeated monsters as skills.

Heroes outside a time loop fight skirmishes by upgrading six-sided dice to bend probability, crafting combos and capturing enemies into their dice. Short scenarios, persistent relics, and unlockable modes build toward breaking the cycle and saving the universe.

Players create and customize up to six shinobi, strengthening them with skills, weapons and accessories as they level up. They take on events and missions and compete or team up with others in multiplayer modes like Clan Wars, Offline Arena and Live PVP.

Faye and her companions fight demons between worlds in a tactics RPG where players plan and rewind movements, chain combos and elemental attacks, and balance a university schedule and friendships on a mysterious island across a semester.

Reporter Brea Tena stumbles into the mysterious town of Ash Pines while chasing a career-defining story, in a prequel to Just Ignore Them. The stylized pixel-art adventure uses a text-based interface and branching paths through a dark, character-driven narrative.

A dungeon crawler where the player, one of the devil's sons, is sent on a quest through various places to help defend the realm. It offers save-anywhere convenience, an optional real-world clock, autosaves, and no permadeath or pay-to-win.

Players command the American Colonists in a real-time campaign for control of North America, building armies and navies, constructing military infrastructure, and fighting battles on a detailed 3D map down to battalion level. Delayed reporting and reconnaissance shape orders and strategy.

Three heavily armed soldiers fight to topple a tyranny, blasting through eight regions of relentless enemy armies on foot or in tanks, boats and buggies. The arcade-style run-and-gun mixes top-down and side-scrolling action with screen-filling bosses, destructible scenery and an 8-bit pixel presentation.

Expeditioners Gustave, Maelle and their companions set out to destroy the Paintress, whose painted number erases everyone past that age, exploring a Belle Époque-inspired fantasy world and fighting surreal foes in turn-based battles enhanced by real-time dodges, parries and counters.

Players manage a stable of boxers in a streamlined sports management simulation, recruiting fighters and staff, scheduling training and rest, advertising fights, and watching bouts in real time while following narrative story scenarios.

A train simulation package offering the latest Trainz release plus exclusive features, route-building tools, and a large library of routes, sessions and rolling stock. Players construct and drive railroads across historical and fictional lines, with multiplayer surveyor support and membership-based content access.

This collection of two classic Dark Sun RPGs sets the player's party of escaped slaves in the sun-scorched world of Athas, where they build and customize four characters, fight turn-based tactical battles, explore the wasteland, and oppose tyrannical sorcerer-kings.

Across three linked Dragonlance adventures, the player assembles a party of warriors, clerics, and thieves to battle dragons, draconians, and the Dark Queen's forces through intrigue and combat in the fantasy world of Krynn.

Players build and expand a stronghold in a Dungeons & Dragons world, competing against computer-controlled kingdoms to become Emperor through lawful prosperity, chaotic military conquest, or a neutral mix. Construction, farmland, population, troops, morale, and seasons must be managed, with optional automation and randomized scenarios.

A grid-based tactical combat RPG that gathers units and pilots from many anime series to battle mutual foes. Place units strategically, upgrade mechs and train pilots with mission rewards, and use the new Assist Link system to bring sidekick characters into battle across an epic crossover saga.

Players awaken decades late on a colony ship at the galaxy's edge and uncover a corporate conspiracy across the Halcyon colony. They build a crew, explore planets and stations, and shape a player-driven story through choices affecting character builds, companions, and endings.

Players ride high-powered motorcycles in the official Isle of Man Tourist Trophy races, competing in Superbike and Supersport classes across 32 circuits and over 200 km of roads, with career mode, online multiplayer, and a free-roaming open world of the island's roads.

In this science-fantasy MMORPG, players explore strange planets on a shared server, where reactive ecosystems let water flow, forests burn, and lava harden. They build settlements, master skill paths, and shape worlds through choices, cooperating with others to survive and thrive across the galaxy.

Players work as a paramedic on the West Coast of the United States, racing an ambulance to accident sites, diagnosing patients with instruments, and applying first aid before transporting them to hospital. Shifts span three districts and include catastrophic events requiring triage and moral decisions.

A free-to-play online strategy game where players build and defend a space colony of cute Starlings, train troops, attack rivals for loot and expand across a persistent galaxy. Tower defense, base building, alliances, PvP battles and leaderboards mix casual mechanics with competitive multiplayer conflict.

A semi-real-time tactical strategy game blending roguelite and sandbox building elements, set in a dream world where Gensokyo characters explore increasingly powerful enemies. Players place building cards on a grid, customize projectile attacks with talents and equipment, and face random events across hue-tinted levels.

An adventurer and his girlfriend Ria arrive in Kul Village, where a five-day contest against a rival adventurer will decide who holds the pact. The player manages stats, hinders the rival, and pursues branching endings in this adult role-playing game.

A tactical action RPG set in Gamindustri where the player controls goddess candidates fighting in real-time combo battles. The story follows Nepgear after a two-year sleep, exploring a world dominated by the rPhone and searching for the missing Neptune while customizing party members and taking side quests.

As a disembodied brain, the player builds and upgrades specialized turrets across bizarre vertical battlefields, mowing down waves of creeps with simulated projectiles while repositioning and using special abilities to defend against evolving enemies.

The player rides a motorcycle through forest, city and space stages, combining fast-paced racing with platforming, tricks, flips and wheelies to chain massive multipliers. A built-in level editor lets players create and share custom levels online and compete for world records, with customizable rides and characters.

Two remastered JRPGs follow heroes gathering the 108 Stars of Destiny amid rebellion and war, as a tyrant's empire crumbles and a border dispute reignites, with HD backgrounds, updated effects, auto-save, and fast-forward battles.

In the virtual world of Redo, built from people's regrets, the protagonist joins the Go-Home Club to escape back to painful reality, fighting turn-based battles where players preview future actions and chain combos, and where the virtuadoll χ's songs can turn the tide.

A turn-based strategy wargame recreating the Korean War, letting the player command forces through campaigns and shorter scenarios spanning the 1950 invasion, UN counter-offensive, Chinese intervention, and the static trench-like stalemate until the 1953 armistice.

A detailed strategy wargame covering the Spanish Civil War from July 1936 to April 1939, where players command Nationalist or Republican forces across weekly turns, managing industry, resources, cards, and historical units to control key cities and shape the conflict.

The player commands Cold War-era ground and air units across large European terrain maps, balancing command-and-control delays, weather, and doctrine. The wargame offers pausable real-time and turn-based play, with over a thousand detailed units and skirmish generation for varied battles.

Players command Greek, Norse, Egyptian, and Atlantean forces in a real-time strategy game, building domains, summoning mythological monsters, and calling down divine powers across a 50-mission campaign and multiplayer skirmishes on randomly generated maps, plus a hero-focused Arena of the Gods mode.

Players command either the Iron Hand or the Resistance in a modern real-time strategy game, building bases, managing resources, and fielding ground and air units with upgrades and superweapons. It offers ranked multiplayer, customizable skirmish matches, and a tutorial campaign set after a devastating world war.

Aliens invade Earth and monsters swarm in, and the player fights back by building card decks, battling various monsters, earning skill points and upgrading a skill tree to gain new cards. New teammates with different card colors and strategies join later in this card-battle RPG prologue.

Players take charge of a hockey franchise across dozens of leagues, including the NHL, overseeing finances, strategies, staff hires, trades, free agents, and drafts while managing injuries, team harmony, and college recruitment to build a championship dynasty.

In a fantasy world inspired by feudal Japan, the player hunts massive beasts infused with nature's power, using deadly weapons and ancient Karakuri technology to turn the tide. Hunts can be undertaken alone or in seamless co-op, with crafting and construction of devices central to overcoming the Kemono.

A hub for the Call of Duty experience spanning Modern Warfare 4, Black Ops 7, and the free-to-play Warzone combat arena, offering Battle Royale, Resurgence, and Black Ops Royale modes alongside in-game currency for obtaining new content.

A 3D tower defense game where players place towers on special ground tiles that grant effects, but each tile choice also empowers the next enemy wave with modifiers. Players earn stars to spend on a skill tree unlocking towers and spells, and face bosses and an endless mode.

Players control Enzo Favara, a man raised in forced labor who joins the Torrisi crime family in 1900s Sicily, fighting rival families through stealth takedowns, blade duels, and period firearms while traveling the island's countryside and cities in a cinematic third-person crime drama.

Playing Sherlock Holmes in 1882, the player investigates mysterious disappearances linked to a cult worshipping an Ancient God, crossing London, Switzerland and Louisiana. Clues and an insanity system drive a Lovecraftian mystery that tests Sherlock's reason.

An active auto battler where players build an army and cast spells while the battle unfolds automatically. Players choose between upgrading army strength or spell power, recruit from 25 unit types, and face 35 monster types across arena, forest, and cave maps.

Players compete in traditional Japanese riichi mahjong matches online, bonding with voiced anime characters who have distinct playing styles, using tutorials and hints to learn yaku combinations in a fair environment.

A rogue-lite blending real-time strategy, autobattler, and tower defense elements, where the player places cubes with unique abilities to fight enemies. Runs involve recruiting units, stacking perks, taking cursed risks, and experimenting with open-ended strategies across many classes and species.

A semi-idle RPG where the player assembles teams of up to three adventurers, sends them to clear dungeons automatically, and equips, salvages or upgrades the loot they find while unlocking classes, skills, crafting and endgame raids.

Players explore a post-apocalyptic Outback as evolved mammals, scavenging ruins, crafting tools, building settlements, recruiting followers, and repairing vehicles. Combat against hostile creatures uses tactical time-stops-when-you-move gameplay, with branching quests, a day/night cycle, and a choice between following the story or wandering freely.

A visual novel continuing Hiroki's story as he travels to a snowy European country with actress Hifumi and meets Princess Stephania, who falls for him. Players follow his romantic entanglements with a harem of succubi and the social fallout of his popularity.

Players command fleets in interstellar PvP battles, building and customizing a space station and warships while managing energy, minerals, crystals, and alloy. They recruit admirals, research upgrades, and forge alliances with other commanders to control galaxy sectors and dominate the universe.

As mayor of a supernatural medieval village beside a psychic hellmaw, the player recruits over 400 retired adventurers to plunder the dungeon for resources and unlock buried memories. Resources improve the town and citizens, while party composition and personal histories drive a roguelite loop about confronting trauma.

Players race a car through colorful, procedurally generated arcade tracks in a retro-inspired 3D endless racer, collecting power-ups and coins to unlock new vehicles while competing against rival drivers across varied environments with a day and night cycle.

A girl wakes in a dark wasteland with no memories and chases a mysterious white-haired woman, gaining double jump, float, and climb abilities as she platform-jumps through dangerous levels while avoiding wandering shadows to recover her past.

A turn-based strategy game set during the American Civil War, where the player manages armies, research, production and diplomacy for the Union or Confederacy across a vast hex map, recruiting volunteers, appointing generals and waging river and naval warfare.

In a collapsed Latvia overrun by the New Death virus, the player leads a team of survivors toward a final ferry to Iceland. Combat is turn-based and strategic, with trinkets, character progression, and written events that force moral choices while crossing zombie-infested territory.

Eight travelers from different regions of Solistia set out for their own reasons across a world of steam technology, sea routes, and shifting day and night. Players explore freely, use each character's unique Path Actions, and fight turn-based battles with the Break and Boost system.

Players enter a reborn Mortal Kombat universe crafted by Fire God Liu Kang, fighting through a single-player Invasions campaign with RPG progression and using Kameo fighters who assist with special moves, throws, and defensive breakers in fast fighting action.

As Manager, players command twelve Sinners through turn-based clashes in a dystopian metropolis, chaining colored skill icons and equipping Identities and E.G.O to exploit enemy weaknesses while uncovering a fully voiced story.

A narrative adventure about a professional diver named Stan who works the depths of the North Sea in an alternate 1979, coping with a life-changing loss. Players pilot his submarine and swim through caves, wrecks, and reefs, gathering materials to craft equipment while uncovering fragments of his tragic past.

A turn-based strategy RPG set in a Japanese gangster high school where three schools battle for dominance; the player follows Taiga Arashi through tactical battles featuring special attacks, knockback and combo systems on 2D pixel art over 3D stages.

Players lead a Viking settlement, chopping wood, farming, fishing, and mining while managing resources through harsh seasons and disasters. Villagers with distinct traits can be assigned jobs, traded with, and led into raids on foreign villages, while the settlement grows with families, heroes, and freely placed buildings.

Players control Lt. Hannah Stone of an elite Hong Kong police squad, chaining swordplay and gunfire into brutal combos, parries, and finishers against enemies in a neon cyberpunk conspiracy. The campaign mixes grim ultraviolence with odd minigames like ramen eating and karaoke.

A grand strategy game set in 1054 Europe, Africa and the Middle East, where the player rules a dynasty, manages authority, religion and population, and commands armies across more than two centuries of history.

The player builds a mafia empire in a randomly generated city, recruiting and upgrading gangsters, planning robberies and assassinations, extorting businesses, buying properties and bribing officials while eliminating rivals. Management of illegal rackets and resources drives progression through a retro pixel presentation.

Players enter the geopolitical conflict of the early 1980s Cold War in a single-player campaign, confronting historical figures and hard truths while battling across iconic global locales such as East Berlin, Vietnam, and Soviet KGB headquarters.

A first-person shooter set in World War II, with a single-player campaign spanning the Pacific, France, Stalingrad, and North Africa, plus large-scale multiplayer and a Zombies mode. Players fight through cinematic battles across a global front.

Players work through two retro-styled RPG campaigns tied to the Five Nights at Freddy's spinoff universe, exploring a large expanding map, fighting enemies, unlocking areas and abilities, and uncovering secrets and lore with new and classic characters.

A real-time strategy game set in the VRChat group Colorful Party, where players gather and collect club members and lead their clubs. It draws on the group's student council, dance, broadcasting and gaming clubs as its setting.

An ancient city-building simulation set in the Roman Empire, where the player acts as a governor founding settlements along imperial borders. Players grow cities, manage trade and taxes, keep citizens content, and rise through Roman offices while facing fire, corruption and unrest.

A drifting-focused racing game where the player picks from a roster of JDM, American, and European cars, tunes their ride, and competes on handcrafted tracks in offline modes or online lobbies of up to sixteen players. A points system and in-game radio round out the tire-burning experience.

A social deduction game where players sit on a Committee under a paranoid tyrannical dictator, running Commissariats, voting on proposals, completing or sabotaging tasks, and using notebooks and permits to unmask dissidents before the Purges claim victims.

As the Dungeon Keeper, the player lures loathsome creatures into a dungeon, keeps them in line, and pits them against the Forces of Good. The game combines dungeon management with building corridors, traps, spells, and demon armies, all delivered with dark humor.

Players create a Doneigad sage from the island of Teer Fradee who escapes foreign captors and explores the war-torn Old Continent, recruiting companions, using diplomacy, crafting and disguises, and making choices that shape the fate of the world.

Set in an alternate 1919 where the Great War drags on, players lead a nation on real-time world maps, managing economy, research, military and diplomacy against up to 101 players. Dieselpunk, Teslapunk and Steampunk mechs and Titan-class units decide the clash of man and machine.

Players are a wandering spirit summoned by Madame Marta to delve into a mysterious underground labyrinth teeming with enchanted monsters, commanding an army of customizable soul-infused puppet soldiers in dungeon-crawling adventures to unearth hidden Curios d'art.

As a sentient AI born in an illegal lab in a crumbling cyberpunk city, the player builds factories, labs, and housing while hacking and assembling machine constructs, exploring a branching narrative of factions and timelines to decide whether to save or exploit the city's people.

Players control one of six heroes in a turn-based roguelike RPG set in a castle overrun by elemental creatures, matching mana on a grid to cast spells and attacks. They also deactivate intruder alarms and use environmental hazards against enemies across randomly generated rooms.

A tactical RPG sequel in which children chase a hijacked tank aboard their former enemy's vessel, fighting turn-based battles along branching routes while choices shift Judgment Gauges and change how the story unfolds.

In a 2040 world of collapsed states, players command armies in a multiplayer 4X real-time strategy game, building and defending a headquarters, researching technologies, managing resources, and joining alliances for raids and territorial warfare with over 50 unit types and off-map support.

A turn-based horror RPG inspired by 90s survival horror, where the player levels up and upgrades weapons while exploring a mansion whose endless halls change each time, alongside a tank-controlled hubworld with pre-rendered backgrounds.

As Grand Admiral, players design and build a navy from pre-Dreadnoughts to aircraft carriers and missile cruisers, managing budgets, research, espionage, and construction across campaigns spanning 1890 to 1970. Monthly strategic turns lead to battles resolved in a realistic tactical naval system.

A grand strategic simulation of the Napoleonic Wars adapted from a board game, where players command armies and fleets as Napoleon or his rivals across monthly hex-based turns, fighting historical scenarios from 1796 to 1815 or a full campaign that may end at Waterloo.

Players race through challenges and missions, unlock cars, and explore user-made maps, while a World Editor lets them build cities and tracks to share with the community. Modes include taxi pickups, police chases, and limited health and gas runs, with leaderboards and asynchronous multiplayer against offline rivals.

Set in an alternative 1918–1945 interbellum era, players rule a rising city-state, building housing, industry, and logistics while managing over 90 production chains. They also raise land, sea, and air forces to forge alliances or conquer more than 100 regions, with city development determining military strength.

A zombie-apocalypse strategy game where the player commands one of three factions—armies, the infected, or survivors—through turn-based campaigns and real-time battles, with optional first-person aircraft support, each faction offering unique units, buildings, and tactical abilities.

A flight simulator offering realistic physics, live weather, volumetric clouds, and photometric lighting across a detailed world with over 20,000 3D airports and a roster of aircraft from airliners to fighters. Players fly and land in authentic conditions, whether aspiring pilots or aviation enthusiasts.

The player builds a character with hundreds of skills and off-hand options and fights through colossal hordes of enemies in a fast-paced action RPG. Loot, crafting, and seasonal leaderboards support endless build experimentation, blending traditional ARPG depth with the mob density of survivor-style roguelites.

Players form small parties and descend into an ancient underground citadel in first-person, fighting monsters and rival treasure hunters with melee weapons and timed spells while hunting hidden escape routes before the darkness claims their loot.

A visual novel prequel about university student Shouhei and his affectionate girlfriend Ranko in Tokyo, who join a gym together after Ranko worries about weight gained from his cooking. The story follows their early relationship and introduces more girls in a light-hearted, romantic slice-of-life tone.
A visual novel sequel in which Hiroki tours Tokyo with a princess, her maid, an e-girl, and an idol, visiting cafés and theme parks while a mysterious watcher stalks his harem.

A historical grand strategy game where players guide a nation through twelve technology eras, building improvements and managing a crafting-based economy with simultaneous turn resolution. Exploration of a living world and optimization of resources shape each civilization's legacy.

Players alternate between detective Doe, who gathers clues across the neo-futuristic city of Mato, and exorcist Gram, who battles demonic abominations inside Rifts. The turn-based RPG follows their investigation into anomalies and corruption while recruiting unlikely allies.

A single-player action RPG in which the player creates an Arisen and explores a deep fantasy world, choosing vocations and party setups while fighting diverse monsters. Customizable Pawns accompany the player, and other players' Pawns can be recruited through the network.
A short Halloween-themed visual novel in which Elle visits her father's grave, meets a mysterious girl named Lucia, and collects scribbles while having conversations about grief and death.

A turn-based roguelike where the player learns predictable enemy patterns, times movement to avoid damage, and loots limited inventory items to build synergies, fighting through a fantasy world to slay a god and save Ystilia from divine madness.

A disgraced defense attorney turned detective investigates a string of grisly murders in Tokyo's Kamurocho district, uncovering a deep crime network. The action-adventure legal thriller mixes cinematic combat in two battle styles with detective work and twists that keep players chasing answers.

Detective Takayuki Yagami goes undercover at a Yokohama high school to investigate bullying cases tied to a murder, gathering evidence with gadgets and tailing suspects while fighting in combo-heavy martial arts styles across Kamurocho and Ijincho.

Race in the official Monster Energy Supercross 2022 Championship with real bikes, riders, and tracks, guided by coach Jeremy McGrath through a career mode. Customize rider skills and bike setups, explore Supercross Park, and compete in Rhythm Attack elimination tournaments.

A cycling simulation where players create a rider, manage a team across a full season, and race the 21 official Tour de France 2023 stages. Tactics, rider ratings, and weekly online challenges determine success in races and world rankings.
