As Head of the Council in the kingdom of Ankist, the player weighs hundreds of dilemmas, listens to noble houses, and spends influence or corruption to sway votes, shaping resources, alliances, and the fate of a dynasty across generations toward a foretold uprising.

A bounty hunter who has already toppled a cartel faces a new conspiracy when a figure from the past puts a price on the player's sister's head. The player shoots, stabs and skateboards across alien worlds to take down an evil pharmaceutical conglomerate, aided by a comedic cast of alien characters.

Play as corrupted heroes of tales and legends fighting hordes of nightmarish creatures in nerve-racking top-down roguelike action, exploring enchanted maps, choosing talents, and building power over three days and nights, solo or in four-player co-op.

Two heroes, Ichiban Kasuga and Kazuma Kiryu, are drawn together by fate in a story spanning Japan and Hawaii. Players fight fast-paced turn-based RPG battles, customize party jobs and skills, and explore a large world full of quests and leisure activities.

A word-building puzzle game where the only resource is the letter i. Players chain factories that bend, rotate, reflect, and merge letters to construct the alphabet and whole words, discovering secret recipes, collecting stickers, and optimizing builds for high scores.

The player leads a colonial expedition into a dark continent for a holy empire, building a settlement, farming, crafting and trading while fighting mercenaries, orcs and elves, managing settlers' needs and expanding into the unknown.

Players take part in 90s Osaka-style illegal street racing, driving and tuning JDM cars with engine swaps, body kits, and suspension work. They race online in time attack and traffic-avoidance modes, drift, attend car meets, and escape high-speed police chases to build rating.

Players become Descendants fighting invaders to protect the Ingris continent in a third-person co-op action RPG shooter. They use unique characters, skills, and firearms to battle huge bosses, loot equipment, and grow stronger through missions.

A story-driven 2.5D pixel horror adventure about teenagers in a small town uncovering a generations-old secret as mysterious events intensify around a solar eclipse. Players explore, solve unconventional puzzles, use stealth, and make choices leading to six endings.

A motorsport racing simulation featuring GT3, GT4, hypercar, and touring car classes across iconic circuits like Monza, Spa, and Daytona. Players race in single- and multi-class events, compete in multiplayer and league racing, and chase leaderboard times in Time Trials with full crossplay.

Ork racers speed through war-torn maps in heavily armed vehicles, competing in team races and convoy battles while fighting for position. Players master movement, use vehicle abilities, and build custom tracks with a level editor and community workshop.

Players develop a character in a classic MMORPG world, taking on solo and party quests, hunting bosses, exploring dungeons, and competing in guild wars and ranked PvP. Eight classes, stat allocation, equipment refining, and crafting support long-term progression.

Players choose among six protagonists and travel from the Junction to 17 distinct worlds, building a personal branching story through choices while fighting strategic turn-based battles that use glimmers, formations, and united attacks, in a fantasy RPG spanning cultures from skyscraper forests to vampire realms.

The player leads a special-ops team of Allied commandos and French resistance fighters in World War II France, building a resistance network and striking German targets. Missions are turn-based tactical battles with a morale system, stealth ambushes, squad recruitment, and customization across a branching campaign.

A young hero searches a Wuxia world for a lost relic, building a deck of martial arts cards and discovering hidden combos. The player recruits teammates with distinct moves, faces events with life-or-death decisions, and grows stronger after each death thanks to a blessing.

The player creates a custom hero, chooses a class, and turns defeated enemies' souls into cards to build a deck. Battles are fought with mixed class abilities and RPG inventory elements, and after death the run restarts; choices also determine whether bosses are executed or spared and later aid the player.

Players defend a city from waves of besiegers by building walls, improving town buildings, recruiting soldiers, commanding a hero at chokepoints, and picking daybreak bonuses, while revising a card deck and earning gold to upgrade future runs, with co-op and level editing.

A real-time geopolitical strategy game where the player controls any nation, managing military forces, research, trade, diplomacy, espionage, and the economy through near-future campaigns or sandbox mode with custom victory conditions.

Players drive officially licensed buses through a simulated fictional city with traffic, day/night cycles, and weather, upgrading stops and unlocking routes to make districts more pedestrian-friendly. Up to four players can cooperate on routes, and runs can be relaxed or optimized in detail.

Players race through the 2023 MotoGP season across four championship classes, managing a career that includes bike development, team relationships and social media decisions. Dynamic weather and flag-to-flag bike changes add strategy, while neural aids and the Academy help players of all skill levels.

A full-scale Touhou fangame RPG with traditional five-character turn-based combat, where progress comes from reading enemy weaknesses and patterns and choosing the right party and skills rather than grinding levels. It offers dozens of hours of content and over a hundred with full collection.

A free standalone creation tool where players shape sky islands from geometric forms, decorate them with forests, caves and ruins, add enemies and puzzles, then share the results on Steam Workshop for the co-op survival game Lost Skies.

A cell evolution simulation where randomly generated cells compete for gas bubbles, evolve flagella, and form multicellular clusters over long simulated periods. Players observe emergent life in a physics-driven world and can share or download save sequences through Steam Workshop.

In the Golden Age of Piracy, players rebuild a pirate utopia after a mutiny, growing an outpost into a sprawling settlement. They manage production and trade, recruit captains, command fleets in real-time naval battles, and conduct diplomacy with rival crews and trading companies across the Caribbean.

Players pilot giant port cranes from a cockpit 60 meters up, loading containers onto ships under time limits, bad weather, and military supply challenges. Campaign and time-attack modes take place across ports inspired by real locations, with day/night cycles and dynamic weather recreating a beautiful yet harsh working world.

A horror-adventure visual novel set in late 20th-century Sumida, Tokyo, where an office worker and several others investigate the Seven Mysteries of Honjo and a Rite of Resurrection, uncovering clues through conversations and 360-degree backgrounds while deploying or risking curses in a twisting, multi-perspective story.

Players command World War I forces on the Western Front, alternating between turn-based grand strategy as Theatre Commander and real-time tactical battles as Field Commander, digging trenches, researching technologies like poison gas and tanks, and reshaping history. The tone is gritty and strategic.

Players lead a party of seven adventurers through the open world of Amberland in a classic first-person, grid-based RPG, fighting evil with turn-based combat and quick travel. The light, fairy-tale heroic tone carries main and side quests across a lore-rich world inspired by 90s role-playing games.

A short visual novel love story between time and space, in which the player, as time, moves forward, backward, or warps to save points to help space overcome loneliness. It offers a 6k-word story with three main endings, cute illustrations, and mild horror elements alongside sappy romance.

Players guide a small settlement from the Paleolithic to the Iron Age, managing turn-based days of building, gathering, crafting, farming, and animal husbandry on a procedurally generated hexagonal world map while defending against wild animals and nomads.

A grand strategy game set in the Bronze Age Fertile Crescent, where the player guides a state from chiefdom to empire, managing population-based economy, legitimacy, elites and diplomacy across fourteen start dates from 3400BC to 1450BC.

Players arrive at the aftermath of wacky scenarios and clean up messes such as broken glass, grime, and guts using mops and buckets, earning cash to upgrade their janitorial gear across six hand-crafted levels at their own pace.

In an era of interstellar colonization, the player leads a hero's army against alien invasions in real-time strategy battles, choosing one of four factions with unique units and commands. Randomly generated levels, tech choices, and over 100 alien enemies add roguelike variety across varied planets, playable offline.

Players create and customize a gladiator and fight fast-paced turn-based arena battles one-on-one or in teams, dodging traps, severing limbs and using runes, skills and classes against 24 champions, with switchable redux and classic graphics in this remade gladiator combat game.

A turn-based sci-fi roguelike where the player captains a starship, assembling a crew and loadout of weapons and modules, then fights card-driven battles across the galaxy while managing faction relationships, crew morale and resources over repeated runs.

Players command soldiers in turn-based WWII battles inspired by real events, managing six classes, traits, and base structures like hospitals and armories while forging alliances and facing elite SS units, interweaving historical newspaper reports with the personal story of Commander Martin.

A coming-of-age RPG set in a rural Japanese town in August 1983, where a newly earthbound teen befriends residents and battles the Kegai in turn-based fights shaped by his relationships. Each loop resets the month, letting players alter choices and actions to change destiny across multiple endings.

Players hunt deer across a season that shifts from late summer to midwinter, tracking bucks that react to weather and rut stage, earning experience to buy and upgrade firearms, scopes, camo, blinds, and calls.

An operational strategy game recreating the 1945 Battle of Okinawa, letting players command either US or Imperial Japanese forces. Players deploy infantry, tanks, planes, and static defenses, use cards each turn, and pursue objectives such as capturing the island or holding it while inflicting heavy casualties.

Players control a brother and sister exploring a terrifying island by boat and on foot to rescue their missing friends, solving environmental challenges and evading twisted monsters in a co-op horror adventure with a shared directed camera emphasizing tension and atmosphere.

Players use a recovered drone-engineering software to design custom combat drones from modular parts, program each component through a visual coding interface, and deploy them on missions. They can share custom levels and compete in asynchronous PvP battles and seasonal tournaments.

A stealth action game told in two parts: Solid Snake infiltrates a secret tanker pursuing a nuclear weapon, and Raiden infiltrates an offshore plant held by terrorists, using first-person aiming, holding up enemies, and dragging bodies.

A stealth action game set in a deep jungle, following Naked Snake's origin story as he recovers equipment, uses camouflage and face paint to deceive enemies, captures animals for food and stamina, and engages in close-quarters combat.

Players design and manage a railroad network across centuries, upgrading from steam locomotives to complex haulers while transporting passengers and cargo. They plan stations, research technologies, expand into new regions, and balance a dynamic economy across large maps.

A fantasy RPG where the player becomes a healer, leveling up across nine healing classes, collecting gear, recruiting companions, and defeating bosses through eighteen worlds and over 180 levels. A hard mode offers a tougher challenge for dedicated healers.

A casual city-building and dungeon-management crossover in which the player grows a Steambot town, manages resources and residents, and explores hand-crafted mines full of puzzles and dangers to recover technology that can help escape a dying planet.

The player manages a ten-story drilling station on a distant planet, organizing limited space and automating Draxen production to meet quotas set by a conglomerate. They hire and schedule workers, watch their health and morale, and build production lines to outpace rival stations.

Players hunt down their family's assassins in a revenge-driven Kung Fu brawler, fighting crowds of enemies with dodges, parries, and combos while a mysterious amulet revives them at the cost of aging with each death.

A dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a medieval world where the Ashen Hawk Brigade, a small band of five outcasts, resists the monstrous Mort armies. Players manage limited resources, coordinate attacks between members, and uncover each character's past through voiced story scenes.

Set in a war-torn medieval England, players gather resources, build castles, manage gold and raise armies to reunite the kingdom against villainous lords across siege and economic campaigns, in a remastered real-time strategy and city-building classic.

A tactical wargame depicting the Battle of Stalingrad from September to November 1942, playable as German or Soviet forces against AI or another player. Units at regiment to platoon scale must be activated to move and fight across scenarios covering city sectors and historical events.

Players collect cards, build decks, and duel friends or AI opponents across the fantasy multiverse of Magic: The Gathering, learning through tutorials and competing in formats like Draft and Brawl, with tournaments and esports qualifiers for ambitious competitors.

Players command a small mercenary company in a turn-based tactical RPG, fighting across a war-torn fantasy continent. Battles reward attacking from flanks and high ground, while characters level up, change classes, and learn skills, with choices shaping a multi-ending storyline.

Players command Claude and the Silver Eagles through 32 tactical battles on quarter-view maps, where positioning and terrain affect outcomes. Characters level up, spend skill points to unlock new classes and abilities, and face extra-difficult EX stages in a declining fantasy kingdom threatened by monsters.

A tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world where the player commands units on a quarter-view battle map, using positioning, terrain, and class changes to win. Characters learn skills, summon sprites and golems, and manage aggro levels across a war between two continents.

Players lead survivors of a cataclysmic disaster in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, driving a settlement bus to find habitable zones and establish multiple colonies. They build and expand settlements, research technologies, manage production and trade routes, and endure environmental threats like toxic rain and sandstorms.

One year after the first game, Jack returns in a post-apocalyptic cyberpunk future to fight a violent AI cult outside Dharma Tower. Players use katana combat, new skills, nonlinear levels with motorbike sections, and interactive boss fights while exploring the world and its lore.

An HD remaster collecting two RPGs set on a floating continent in the sky, where the player acts as a guardian spirit guiding a colorful cast against destiny, using a real-time card-based battle system of elemental magnus cards and combo attacks.

As a divine construct, players defend a magical world from four corrupted gods by placing and upgrading towers across handcrafted maps. Over 40 upgrades and tower synergies let players craft builds, balancing offense and defense against swarms of enemies through 25+ levels in diverse environments.

A standalone strategy wargame recreating the American Revolutionary War from 1775 to 1783 in two-week turns, where players manage finances, units, and cards covering reinforcements, diplomacy, and combat across a grand campaign and shorter historical scenarios.

The player raises hatched dragons and collects creatures that help with farming, crafting and combat, controls both the main character and the dragons, builds and upgrades farm buildings, and travels to a dragon home world to defeat corrupted monsters and restore the land.

Players take charge of a college football program, calling offensive and defensive plays through a simulation engine while recruiting high school and junior college players, developing athletes in the offseason, and leveling up their coach's skills. They manage facilities and boosters, meet athletic director expectations, and build a long-running dynasty.

A VR golf simulation developed with The R&A and DP World Tour, offering classic rounds, driving range, putting green, minigolf, and tournaments across real and fictional courses. Players use a high-precision physics engine to swing, analyze shots, and compete online.

As an apprentice witch whose magic is random, the player summons towers to defend a crystal from waves of enemies, choosing roguelike perks each wave and building strategies around six tower types and their abilities.

A remastered emulated version of the 1997 football simulation, letting players compete in the 97/98 international season, cups, friendlies, or practice with national teams and an All Star squad, supporting up to four-player local co-op.

Players pick a job and descend into a deadly dungeon, choosing rooms, equipment and skills in turn-based battles against terrible enemies, where fallen heroes become roaming dead for future runs and soulstones unlock special jobs.

As a navigator in a fog-fractured world of islands, the player builds settlements, runs visible production chains, trades with scattered tribes, and fights tactically to reunite Pagonia and find the Tower of Visions, alone or in four-player co-op.

A co-op first-person shooter where a four-player squad of commandos battles the Sludge God and relentless waves of infected across a wasteland, sharing ammo, reviving teammates and using guns, grenades, powers and vehicles to mow down the horde.

Players plan, build, and simulate miniature model railroad worlds on PC, laying thousands of tracks in various gauges, sculpting terrain, placing buildings and vehicles, and running automated railroad operations with signals and scripting. The tone is calm and creative, aimed at hobbyists who enjoy detailed construction and realistic simulation.

Playing as Dustin Binsley, the Trash Can Knight, the player explores a fantasy world of garbage across the five and a half Kingdoms of the Dump, fighting filthy foes in turn-based grid combat, platforming through dungeons and swapping characters with unique abilities to stop the toxic grimelin army.

In a world abandoned by gods and ravaged by nahuals, the player solves odd puzzles, plays minigames, fights everything from trash bags to spirits, and talks with strange characters, acting as an enabler in their stories toward an ambiguous ending.

A transfer student discovers a hidden hour between days, awakens a power, and fights otherworldly Shadows alongside friends while balancing daily life, school activities, and relationships in a modern Japanese setting.

Players command Space Corps or Bydo fleets in turn-based tactical battles across branching campaigns, deploying hundreds of ships and levels from two R-Type strategy titles plus a new post-game story, outmaneuvering an enemy that threatens humanity.

A top-down 2D train management game where the player lays tracks, buys trains and sets routes to move passengers and cargo between towns and factories. Board game-inspired resource tokens and track order systems drive optimization across endless, scenario and monthly challenge modes.

As editor of a newspaper in a troubled country, the player chooses to back or oppose a president sliding toward dictatorship, deciding headlines, managing journalists, laying out pages, organizing distribution, and balancing family finances toward multiple endings.

Eight friends return to an isolated mountain lodge where two of their group vanished a year earlier, and their retreat turns into a slasher nightmare. The player controls the group through a rebuilt third-person horror story, making choices that decide who survives.

As the cursed Psaro, recruit monsters from the wilds of Nadiria and combine them through synthesis to create stronger creatures, building a party from over 500 monsters. Explore seasonal environments, battle foes in turn-based fights, and take on quickfire contests while pursuing mastery of monsterkind.

Shiren and his talking ferret Koppa travel to Serpentcoil Island seeking a mysterious girl and pirate treasure, exploring ever-changing mystery dungeons where layouts, items and enemies differ each run, with online rescues when players fall.

A life simulation game that runs alongside your desktop, where you feed, care for, and watch cute pets while working or playing on your computer. You earn money to buy new looks and food, and play with physics-based interactions as your companion shares your daily routine.

Players automate a dungeon as a tower defense factory, building interconnected production lines that turn waves of mobs into resources. Enemy drops brew potions for upgrades, and resources buy new islands with fresh spawners, materials, and space to expand the base.

Players embody a Space Marine lieutenant and fight relentless Tyranid swarms and Chaos forces in fast-paced third-person action across far-flung planets. Solo and multiplayer modes include replayable PvE and PvP battles with seven classes, unlockable perks, and cosmetic customization.

Players take charge of a football club as manager, buying players, setting tactics, and playing fast-paced retro arcade matches across a full career spanning dozens of leagues and cups, with local multiplayer for up to four players.

Players guide Magnus, heir to a throne, on a quest to stop the freed Dragon of Chaos from devouring the world. He explores a semi-open world of forests, caves, towers, villages and deserts, fighting enemies and finding optional dungeons, bosses and items in a nostalgic 8-bit-style JRPG adventure.

A horde shooter where the player holds out against endless waves of cosmic creatures across overrun cities, gathering an absurd arsenal and exploring large maps for survivors and treasure in a roguelike tribute to 80s and 90s B-movies and horror comics.

A third-person action game retelling AMC's The Walking Dead, where players control Rick Grimes and other iconic characters, fighting walkers with melee and ranged weapons while making choice-driven decisions that reshape the story and manage scarce resources.
In a darkening world overrun by the undead, the player fights fast-paced battles, gathers equipment and magic, and searches maps for hidden items while trying to escape an island alive.

Players guide Alex, a maned wolf, and four friends on a tropical island vacation that turns into a turn-based battle against otherworldly creatures, while dating and bonding with companions and uncovering the island's mystery.

A 3D electronics sandbox where the player builds prototype circuits on a virtual workbench from a large catalogue of components, then tests them with scopes, code and hex editors, and visualisation tools. Built-in examples teach areas of modern electronics without the risk of real component failure.

Play scavenger Lukida on a war-ravaged desert planet, exploring the City of Delight and wastelands with friends while fighting turn-based battles aboard customizable Motorbots. Uncover buried secrets and grow your party to escape home.

A visual novel in which a 25-year-old librarian with magical blood enters contracts with handsome ayakashi spirits who protect her from demons in exchange for a forbidden romance. Players read main stories, sequels, and epilogues for three characters, with an added adventure feature.

Two decades after an adventuring party stopped a world-ending threat, the player travels the empire of Asterna and its islands, recruiting companions, mastering over twenty classes, and preparing freely for the returning Calamity through turn-based battles.

A visual novel set in the rural Teoswa countryside of China in late August, where city-raised Deng Ainyang returns for ancestral rites and meets a local girl, Deng Kangsui. Their accidental encounter grows into an intimate relationship, with touches of traditional Chinese culture.

Players create a customizable character and explore an alchemy world in a Japanese-style MMORPG, aided by a customizable partner who guides and fights alongside them, using simple command battles, mounts, stickers, and a solo mode for casual play.

As the organizer of a major football matchday, the player launches marketing campaigns, hires staff, prices tickets, zones the city, places fanzones and sponsors, and manages transit so rival fan groups arrive safely before kickoff.

A remastered turn-based RPG where a wizard and three homunculi explore dungeons surrounding a sealed-off city whose inhabitants have lost their memories. Players exploit elemental weaknesses and chain attacks, and use Anima Fusion to absorb defeated monsters' stats, skills, and appearances, with a story shaped by choices.

A samurai warrior on Tsushima Island fights back against a Mongol invasion in 13th-century Japan, setting aside his traditions to wage an unconventional war. The PC Director's Cut adds graphical options, ultrawide support, and Japanese lip sync to the open-world action adventure.

Princess Lilia escapes an insurrection and must complete quests for nobles, recruit NPCs and fight turn-based battles to retake her kingdom's throne. The old-school RPG follows her journey to gather supporters and return safely to Guilebern Castle.

A 4X strategy game set during the Age of Discovery and Renaissance, where players lead a European superpower to empire through colonization, labor allocation, market monopolies, and tactical battles. A class-based society and dynamic trait system shape citizens, soldiers, and agents as the empire grows.

Players assemble a party of heroes with unique ultimate abilities and position them tactically in semi-auto battles, exploring the dangerous world of Emalon to unlock new heroes and buffs. Choosing the right group composition and upgrades is key to defeating lurking evil.

Players defend and rebuild pandemic-ravaged Washington, D.C. as tactical agents, engaging in cover-based firefights, looting and crafting gear, teaming up in co-op missions, and taking on endgame PvP and world events.

Play as Fenyx on a quest to save the Greek gods from a dark curse, battling mythological beasts like Cyclops and Medusa with god-given powers in fast-paced aerial and melee combat while solving ancient puzzles and exploring a vast open world.

A physics-based battle simulator where unconventional gummy units fight across sandbox and mission modes; the player can spectate or take control of any unit in first or third person, using slow motion to enjoy ragdoll chaos and meme-worthy moments.

Players build tower mazes across 30 handcrafted maps in the Archipelago of Chaos, using terrain and special tiles to stop corrupted magical warriors and four primordial TITANS. They unlock and upgrade towers, manage a small farm-based economy, and adapt to map-specific rules in a stylized 3D tower defense adventure.

Players race karts as DreamWorks characters like Shrek and Po across twenty themed tracks, drifting and jumping through movie-inspired worlds, collecting Troll power-ups and hitting switches to open magical shortcuts in solo or multiplayer modes.

Players race arcade-style cars across surfaces like asphalt, dirt, ice and water, tackling jumps, loops and wall rides on player-created tracks. They climb leaderboards, collect medals and skins, and use track, skin and replay editors to build and share their own content.

A young Fencer named Fang travels with companions to find Furies and resurrect the Goddess, encountering two women whose songs heal or brainwash. Players fight in a tactical RPG battle system using terrain and objects, shape the world map to uncover secrets, and follow multiple story routes.

A story-driven roguelike deckbuilder in which Foam Gun and her planet-ship Baby Violence search space for a new human home. Players fuse cards into over a hundred combinations, overpopulate and destroy planets, and traverse randomly generated galaxies while fighting colossal enemies.

A classic real-time strategy collection featuring Red Alert and its Counterstrike and The Aftermath expansions. Players command Allied or Soviet forces across dozens of missions, deploying units and tactics to decide the fate of the conflict.

A casual match-3 game where players drag blocks together to gather food, industry and culture, growing a civilization through history while managing population and war. Historical heroes assist in tougher modes, and illustrations and music evoke historical change.

As young French noble Charles de Maure in the 1654 Caribbean, players pursue a 200-hour open-world adventure of quests, romance, and career choices, commanding and customizing ships, building a colony, exploring islands, caves, and pyramids, and engaging in treasure hunting and gambling.

Players build a Ghost from scratch and infiltrate enemy bases on a diverse island, piloting drones and choosing stealth or assault tactics, while looting, crafting, and customizing gear across campaign, PvP, and endgame content with persistent character progression.

A young girl named Tzap'lia, chosen as a sacrifice to the gods, flees into the Silicium Forest with her mother. Players build characters from over 200 abilities, position units tactically, and use runes in turn-based battles across a story mode and randomized rogue-lite runs.

A text-based racing management simulator that lets players run a team to championship glory in Owner Mode or watch AI simulate over a century of racing in Simulation Mode. Rosters, teams, and drivers can be customized and uploaded for prediction and experimentation.

As a dwarven leader, players reclaim monster-infested mines through tactical turn-based runs, unlocking dozens of warrior classes and swapping equipment to build teams. Limited turns, over fifty enemy types and a punishing Descent Mode test strategic thinking across procedurally varied descents.

Players control Nanoca Flanka, an amateur crafter-inventor sent to restore the decaying ocean city of Tristia within one year. By inventing items to sell to shops, she helps businesses prosper, opens new stores, and revives the town while raising the spirits of its townspeople.

A chess career simulator where players create a character and guide them from promising prodigy to seasoned professional, playing matches against AI opponents, solving puzzles, managing budgets and tournament fees, and developing real chess skills.

Two adventurers, swordswoman Ravilia and mage Tyris, return to their mining hometown of Elsinki to find it abandoned and must venture into dungeons for resources, enlist workers and investors, and rebuild the town while facing monsters and scheming rivals in classic RPG fashion.

Players lead Fuji and Pirilika through the demonic netherworld of Hinomoto in a tactical RPG, recruiting from over 40 character classes and using Jumbification, Hell Mode, and Item Reincarnation to win turn-based battles, with auto-battle and online ranked matches.

A business simulation where the player grows a small company into a global empire by building factories, farms, stores, and logistics networks, producing goods, negotiating contracts, and trading in a live player-driven marketplace across many industries.

The Phantom Thieves enter a bizarre realm ruled by a tyrannical military group and join a revolutionary named Erina to lead an uprising. Players assemble a squad of heroes and fight oppressive armies in turn-based tactical combat using Personas, weapons, and stylish team attacks.

After their colony ship crashes on a distant planet, a crew is hunted by an alien organism that mimics its prey. Players use stealth and improvised weapons, make branching choices, and can bring friends into couch co-op to survive and decide humanity's fate.

A strategic 2D auto battler where players equip fighters with items and artefacts, combine sets for bonuses, and position their team before battles play out automatically against AI opponents. Earning money each round, players build strength to be the last team standing.

Players use the effects of ten numbered cards to deduce an opponent's hidden cards in a strategic deduction duel, competing in real-time online matches against players worldwide to become the King of Logic.

A tennis simulation letting players compete across the full ATP and WTA calendar of 100 official tournaments against 150+ licensed pros, including all four Grand Slams, while managing a career season, creating a player, and reliving historic matches.

An old-school top-down racing game with split-screen multiplayer, six car classes and thirty tracks based on real venues, offering an arcade-simulation driving model, three AI difficulty levels, hot-lap ghost racing and leaderboards.

A life-sim RPG where the player flees a war-torn continent to settle in a medieval fantasy land, running a farm, crafting goods, trading between towns, and fighting bandits and werewolves in real-time combat while befriending townsfolk in a simulated open world.

A grand strategy game where the player leads humanity from Earth to dominance across the Solar System, colonizing planets and moons, developing technologies, customizing warships and commanding space fleets. In peacetime the player navigates interplanetary political intrigue and constructs great projects while managing competing ideologies.

As a young American starting work at a Tokyo factory in 1986, the player designs automated production lines, welding and drilling optimal solutions, while taking breaks to play a pachinko-themed solitaire minigame.

An anti-gravity racing game inspired by classic futuristic racers, featuring fourteen courses and eight ships with distinct handling. Players race through a campaign, unlock courses, and build tracks with an editor, all in a Y2K-inspired pixel art style.

A survival storybook mixing interactive fiction with turn-based strategy, where the player guides a small clan through the end times of a bronze-age world, managing gods, trade, disputes, and sacrifices while making choices whose consequences unfold over decades.

As Claire, the last remaining priest, players gather holy power to summon soldiers and strengthen a temple's starlight, fighting off an undead offensive to evacuate villagers in a character-based tower defense with story and endless modes.

On a hostile alien planet, the player builds a grid of mechs and weapons to survive twenty-minute onslaughts of thousands of enemies. Auto-battler synergies, roguelite permanent upgrades, and challenge modifiers drive repeated runs against varied foes and bosses.

Players build and manage a procedurally generated settlement, harvesting resources, refining goods, and running production chains while keeping citizens fed, employed, and safe. They trade with neighboring kingdoms, handle threats like fire, sickness, and crime, and can play alone or with friends in a relaxing builder with optional disasters.

Players assemble a four-member party from fantasy races and classes, then explore an open world filled with monsters, treasure, and quests, with freedom to help towns or focus on fishing, crafting, alchemy, and mining in a single-player RPG offering over 30 hours of play.

Players command an ant colony in a photorealistic third-person real-time strategy game, exploring the forest, conquering rival nests, upgrading outposts, and choosing legions and pheromone powers to win tactical battles, with co-op and ranked multiplayer modes.

A remake of the historical simulation set in the Three Kingdoms era, letting the player take the role of any officer. New Turning Points, Gems tied to status and reputation, and expanded events shape strategy as officers navigate war and political drama across China.

Apprentice detective Raidou Kuzunoha XIV, who moonlights as a Devil Summoner, investigates a young heiress's strange request and subsequent kidnapping across a fantastical 1930s capital and the demon-filled Dark Realm. Players use mind and summoned demons to unravel a conspiracy in this remastered supernatural action RPG.

After returning to find their lands ruined, players rebuild a kingdom while defending its gates each night from monster hordes. They recruit over 50 unique units, choose a guardian leader, manage resources and buildings, and push further each run to uncover the mystery of a repeating cycle.

Players compete against over 50 others in a massive multiplayer playground, switching between bike, skis, snowboard, and wingsuit across US national parks and urban streets. They join pick-up runs, trick competitions, and crew rides, unlocking cosmetics to show off their style.

A collectible card game where players build decks from legendary composers and musical pieces, then duel opponents online or through a single-player campaign tracing classical music history from Renaissance to Modernism.

Players lead a tribe of hunters in a grim fantasy world, placing actions on a timeline to outmaneuver monstrous foes, then salvaging resources to craft gear and expand a village beneath a protective tree. Permanent wounds and body modifications reshape each campaign.

Players run a medieval forge, managing the full production chain from distant mines and woodcutter camps through smelting and crafting to displaying and selling weapons, armor, tools, and jewelry, while hiring and training staff, designing the shop layout, and fulfilling kingdom orders.

An MMORPG set in a medieval fantasy world where players explore a vast open map with seasons and weather, engage in non-target PvP and PvE combat, pursue dozens of professions, craft equipment, trade with caravans, build homes and follow a story shaped by their choices.

A city-building simulation in which the player constructs a settlement on the back of a space whale traveling the galaxy, terraforming land, managing production chains and resources, and meeting other species while balancing the fragile ecosystem against the growing needs of the inhabitants.

A 3D hex map-making tool for tabletop RPG players to build world, regional, and city maps, customize tiles and objects, place character tokens, and export as 2D images, VTT files, or 3D-printable STL models.

A perfume shop owner dies in a car accident but returns to life, observed by an angel, a demon, and a fallen angel investigating the anomaly. The visual novel follows three romance routes with a perfume-blending minigame and many endings.

The player runs a farm across North American, Central European, or East Asian landscapes, growing crops, tending animals, practicing forestry, and managing business ventures. Dynamic weather, ground deformation, and over 400 authentic machines support solo or cooperative farming simulation.

Players command girls branded as witches in a ruined fantasy world, fighting through auto-battles and idle progression while collecting and strengthening characters. The story follows their persecution by a church and their quest to reclaim a shattered land, presented with Live2D animation and a vocal soundtrack.

The player defends a crystal holding a trapped friend from creatures spawned by touching a procedurally generated darkness, expanding territory, harvesting energy, and deploying defenders. Each run yields minerals for an upgrade tree, with enemies and player growing stronger over time.

As a father granted a daughter by the stars, the player raises a girl from age ten to eighteen over eight years, guiding her training and experiences toward varied possible futures, including her dream of becoming a princess, in a redrawn social simulation.

A sandbox business simulation where the player founds a Hollywood production company from the 1970s onward, developing screenplays, casting stars, budgeting films, building franchises, choosing distribution and release timing, and managing a back catalog and studio growth.

In a future where nations war over the Black Stone mineral, players command factions in a real-time 4X strategy game, expanding across a vast grid battlefield, building empires, choosing strategic cards, and deploying hero-piloted mecha in battles for up to 18 players.

A statistically accurate baseball simulator and tabletop board game companion. Players can simulate games, series, tournaments, and full seasons using real players from 1927 to 2022, or manually play with tabletop cards and enter results, with tools to customize libraries and build custom seasons.

A tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world ravaged by a disease that turns the dead into zombies. Players position characters on quarter-view maps with height differences, develop classes and skills, and use coordinated Advent attacks and special Soul Exceed moves.

A mobile revival of a classic Three Kingdoms online RPG, players raise soldiers, hunt bosses for loot, forge equipment, and command troops in massive nationwide wars while embodying famous historical generals across over a hundred maps in side-scrolling battles.

Players follow Kratos and Atreus across the Nine Realms of Norse mythology, battling gods and monsters with axe, blades, and shield while confronting prophecy and family. A roguelite-inspired Valhalla epilogue adds replayable combat challenges. The tone is epic and emotional.

Players command over 300 characters from Metal Slug's factions in a tower defense game, building decks and deploying units to destroy enemy bases. Battles unfold with easy-to-learn controls but require strategy, and online matches let players compete worldwide for the top title.

A digital pinball simulation offering over a hundred tables based on licensed franchises and classic machines, with realistic physics, 4K visuals, and a customizable 3D playroom where players unlock collectible items by playing.

A four-player local co-op arcade sports game starring nine Looney Tunes characters in basketball, soccer, golf and tennis matches across themed levels, using ACME power-ups and wacky obstacles to disrupt friends and family.

Players pilot a mech against alien Angels, building a deck of weapons and equipment while constructing city defenses and evacuating citizens. Buildings can be pushed, used as cover, or collapsed onto enemies in this roguelike defense game.

Players summon and collect hundreds of Champions in the dark fantasy realm of Teleria, leveling and gearing them for turn-based battles across a story campaign, dungeons, and competitive PvP modes, while joining clans to fight bosses together.

Players flip balls on horror-themed pinball tables featuring gory, sinister settings drawn from eldritch and slasher franchises. The platform offers a simulation of pinball physics with competitive scoring and purchasable tables, including one free table.

Players lead a Viking clan settling ninth-century Iceland, exploring the land and building a thriving settlement while carefully investing the single resource Heart to survive the ever-harsher winter toll, with no combat or raiding.

A deck-building roguelike where players pick one of three Zodiac heroes, build strategic decks, and gather constellation boons to battle twelve corrupted zodiac signs through randomly generated maps and special Chaos Chambers, restoring balance to the cosmos.

Players create a hero and battle through the dark world of Sanctuary, slaying demons in action-packed combat, exploring an open world, delving into dungeons, and collecting legendary loot. They progress through skill trees and seasonal content solo or with friends.

In a void where humanity's ideas materialize, players command a self-aware idea seeking to shape the world. This turn-based tactical roguelike has players gather creature squads, combine them into stronger forms, cast spells and exploit terrain across procedurally generated battles.

An add-on modding engine for Dwarf Fortress that bundles bugfixes, interface improvements, automation tools, blueprints, and modding building blocks, letting players and modders extend the game and gain more control over its systems.

A turn-based strategy and management game where the player builds a criminal gang into a city-wide empire, recruiting soldiers, middlemen and experts, capturing turf, running drug labs and smuggling rings, laundering money through legitimate businesses, and fighting rival gangs in online or hot-seat multiplayer for up to eight players.

Players lead a party of adventurers through a dark fantasy northern frontier, engaging in tactical turn-based combat with an ability card system. They manage resources, build and upgrade an outpost, and explore diverse biomes, alone or in online co-op.

Players push a King forward to deploy cards on the front lines, stockpiling Power to afford powerful units like the Queen and Cannon. They draft cards, upgrade their Ruler, and pick gambits to build synergies across four factions, battling 13 bosses in a roguelike campaign or facing others online.

Players drive iconic Monster Jam trucks in arcade off-road racing and freestyle stunt events, unlocking vehicles and liveries across a non-linear Showdown Tour. Races span stadiums and wild environments like Death Valley and Alaska, with tricks, boosts, and weather hazards adding chaos to the accessible driving experience.

A D&D strategy game where a computer Dungeon Master mediates play, letting the player build a kingdom into an empire through diplomacy, alliances and war against up to four of twenty computer opponents, commanding troops, sending heroes on quests and fighting real-time battles on a tactical overhead screen.

Players take up arms as champions defending a besieged bastion, fighting through real-time battles, transforming into Elysians, and hunting bosses to earn equipment and grow stronger in a fantasy action RPG.

Players team up in online dungeon runs set in a fantasy world, choosing from Tank, DPS, and Healer heroes and swapping freely between them. Cooperative strategy is needed to defeat bosses, collect loot, and climb through leagues, with endlessly scaling dungeons and seasonal resets.

A brutal 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible superhero universe, where players battle as fan-favorite characters in iconic locations using fast combos, defensive tactics, and Super moves across story, arcade, training, and multiplayer modes.

A turn-based RPG in the Monster Hunter world where the player, raised as a Monster Rider, hatches and raises monsters, bonds with them, and battles using Power, Speed, and Technical attacks while confronting the Black Blight threatening the world.

The final entry in a dungeon-crawling RPG trilogy follows Jack and the Blood Maidens, fairy-tale reincarnations, as they are scattered after escaping a living underground prison and must reunite. Players explore monster-filled dungeons and fight Marchen and Nightmares to reach the story's conclusion.

Players take the role of the Destined One in an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology, journeying through wondrous landscapes inspired by Journey to the West. They battle powerful foes using staff techniques, spells, and transformations while uncovering the stories behind each character.

Players draft an army of bizarre fighters such as soldiers, succubi, and mutants to battle fifty giant bosses occupying American cities. Troops deploy randomly on the battlefield, so victory depends on discovering synergies between recruits in snappy turn-based autobattles across a cross-country campaign.

A real-time tactics game set in the late World War II period, commanding Soviet or German forces in skirmish battles and a dynamic campaign across Eastern Europe. Players manage requisition points, morale, ammo, and line of sight, deploying over 90 units and choosing between victory-point and flag-control battle modes.

A rail simulation letting players learn to operate diesel, steam, and electric trains in a training center before driving detailed real-world routes, with free roam, scenario planning, livery design, and photo mode for creative play.

Commander Shepard recruits allies and fights the invading Reapers across the galaxy, making weighty choices, engaging in combat with new weapons and health regeneration, and managing diplomacy and crew relationships in this intergalactic action RPG.

Kidnapped by a cannibal in an isolated house, the player explores in first person, solves puzzles, collects notes, and hides from a killer who is always listening, piecing together a branching detective story while trying to escape before becoming dinner.

Players command armies as a warlord in the Glorantha setting, fighting Chaos hordes across 18 missions on grid-based maps using rune magic, action points, zones of control, and three distinct factions with varied heroes and creatures.

Players fight to topple Castillo's regime in a first-person open-world guerrilla shooter across the island nation of Yara, building improvised weapons, capturing bases, leading a rebellion with rebel groups, and playing the full campaign solo or in two-player co-op.

A retro-inspired open-world turn-based tile RPG in which the player, a Dreamless, travels, trades, sneaks, fights and sails across Caldera, exploring hand-designed lands and regenerating dungeons, learning the secrets of the Gods and possibly challenging the Archon.

A security guard named Yori is confronted by a thief in a bunny suit with superhuman abilities, drawing him into a story with several bunny girls who each have distinct powers and motives. The narrative follows Yori as he uncovers what the mysterious briefcase contains and who these women really are.

Players draft a team of characters with random traits, level them up, equip loot, and stack synergies to fight through randomized fog-covered maps. Characters auto-battle based on positioning while the player casts spells or reserves mana for passive bonuses, unlocking harder zones and boss evolutions in a tactical roguelike.

A combo-driven action game where Signy and her partner Mino chain moves to juggle and slam enemies, trading HP and tagging Mino in to keep chains alive. Players spend skill points on a tree and confront Auger, a reborn god of rock and magma.

A tactical co-op PvE first-person shooter where one to three players form a squad, planning and coordinating tactics to survive incursions into alien containment zones against the evolving Archæans, with dynamic variables, multiple operators, gadgets, mission types, and adjustable difficulty.

Players descend into a cursed labyrinth in a classic-style dungeon RPG, forming a party of allies from varied classes and races, facing deadly traps and powerful foes, and following a fully voiced dark story about a kingdom consumed by death.

Players defend a realm in a tower defense game, placing towers, recruiting armies, and casting spells against land, sea, and air enemies. Randomly generated hexagonal tiles let them reshape paths, while tech trees, wonders, and elemental reactions support varied strategies across standard and weekly challenge modes.

Players create a golfer and rise through an expanded career across major championship courses, competing in ranked, casual and cross-platform multiplayer matches. They customize their player, develop skill trees, design courses, and chase seasonal rewards and leaderboard standings in daily and weekly tournaments.

The player commands a ship in turn-based tactical battles, placing over a hundred items in an inventory grid, mining numbered tiles for energy, and using components to defeat enemies across three zones and an endless mode.

In a fallen empire ravaged by plague and war, players create a custom character and roam a sandbox world where factions fight, settlements rise or fall, and NPCs judge deeds by morality. Turn-based combat, stealth, and freeform roleplay support paths from hero to criminal.

A remastered collection of the first two Tony Hawk's Pro Skater games, rebuilt in HD. Players skate as legendary and new pro skaters, chaining trick combos across original modes, creating parks and skaters, and competing locally or online on leaderboards.

A multidirectional shooter in which six bizarre ex-convicts hunt a mutated supervillain across twelve blood-soaked levels on a deserted planet, using cannons, lasers, and bombs to blast through enemy hordes and morphing terrain.

As Manager, players recruit and fuse over a thousand Letalis arena warriors, exploring a non-linear world of dungeons and secrets while conquering Coliseums and defeating Caesars to claim the title of Caesar in a monster-collecting turn-based RPG.

The official game of the FIA World Endurance Championship lets players drive licensed Hypercars, LMP2 and LMGT3 machines around laser-scanned circuits including Le Mans. Players compete in ranked multiplayer, hosted servers, race weekends and asynchronous co-op, with VR support.

In a 2090 conflict over Huffman Island, the player commands Wanzers in tactical turn-based battles as pilots caught in a conspiracy after an ambush and a missing fiancée. Two campaigns, customizable machines and pilots, and a mature narrative drive the strategy RPG.

A time-travel experiment floods a research facility with a prehistoric lake, and agent Craig O'Dell must rescue the only scientist who understands the portal. This single-character turn-based RPG sends players through one interconnected dungeon with knives, guns, climbing, swimming, and life-or-death choices.

Players form a party in a tactical co-op RPG, using skill cards and turn order to outsmart enemies and defeat bosses across missions. Between battles they upgrade shops and bond with locals in the village of Arden, emphasizing shared game night fun.

A space strategy game where the player commands a multi-planetary force of seven races, managing resources, developing conquered planets with cities and factories, and fighting two-level battles in space and on planetary surfaces across many scenarios.

A remake of a Cold War stealth action game in which Naked Snake infiltrates Soviet territory to rescue a defecting scientist and eliminate his former mentor. The player sneaks through detailed jungles and swamps, managing injuries and survival, with modern or classic controls and extra modes.

Aloy ventures into a dangerous new frontier in a far-future post-apocalyptic world, fighting massive machines, meeting new tribes, and uncovering ancient secrets to stop another extinction, with the Burning Shores expansion included.

Players collect and grow over 1,000 monsters across five attributes, building rune-based strategies for turn-based battles, raids, and global PvP arenas while uncovering dark plots and competing in worldwide championships across the Sky Islands.

An auto-battler in which the player buys items of different shapes and rarities, arranges them inside a backpack to form powerful builds, and battles other players' setups across ranked, unranked, custom and lobby modes, choosing from seven classes with subclasses.

A free-to-play MMORPG set in the world of Solisium where players join guilds for large-scale PvP castle sieges and conquest battles, or tackle PvE raids, dungeons and world bosses. Players morph into creatures, combine dual weapons, and can also gather, fish, cook and customize housing.

Players lead a team of animal champions through a fantasy tournament that blends volleyball and dodgeball in turn-based tactical matches. Between games they train players, equip items, discover synergies and handle events, while a roguelike structure means any defeat restarts the run from scratch.

Players command a strike force of marines, mercenaries, and criminals in an isolated frontier system, training troops, choosing which distress calls to answer, and fighting turn-based tactical battles across branching operations. Relations with local factions shift based on decisions, shaping available support and favors.

Players drive Argentine racing cars on faithfully recreated circuits, competing in championships, time attacks and test days with realistic physics and handling, in an early access simulator aimed at motorsport fans.

A roguelike RPG where the player explores dungeons with shifting layouts to rescue Kogarashi, battling spirits with a cast of characters, soaking in hot springs to power up, and unlocking over fifteen costumes that alter abilities.

Players build an ecosystem of animal and plant cards on an expanding hexagonal grid, triggering combos while running an electoral campaign to become Mayor of Wild City. Roguelike deckbuilding runs mix tile placement, boss fights and protests that alter the rules.

Players lay habitat tiles and place wildlife tokens to build a balanced Pacific Northwest ecosystem, scoring points for contiguous habitats and species harmony. It offers solo scenarios, daily challenges, and pass-and-play modes, presenting a relaxing yet strategic nature-themed puzzle experience.

The player races to rescue cats from the evil Lord Vesh by fitting colored cat-family tiles into a personal rescue boat, managing resources, befriending mystical Oshax, and competing on seasonal leaderboards through challenges and rotating rule variants.

A digital adaptation of the Ark Nova board game in which players design a modern zoo, build enclosures, house animals, and support conservation projects, using action cards and a large deck of animal and specialist cards to earn appeal and reputation.

As Commander, the player leads survivors in a zombie-ravaged near-future world, building a shelter, exploring fog-filled areas, and fighting infected and rival factions. The game combines real-time strategy and tower defense battles with hero formations, troop training, alliances, and a limited-time Undead Bride event with themed rewards.

Players race and drift over 500 real-world cars across 30 living tracks with dynamic time-of-day and weather, honing skills in solo career tours and online multiplayer events while earning performance upgrades to build and tune their vehicles.

You defend against waves of enemies by managing a single upgradable tower, buying abilities and combining elements to find powerful builds. Holding out until the boss arrives and defeating it completes each level and unlocks new abilities.

A remastered RPG following Gustave, heir to a royal line, and Wil, an excavation worker, whose separate stories gradually merge into one history, with a History Choice system letting players experience events as various characters alongside strategic battles, duels and digger expeditions.

Leading a party of heroes against the Dark Sorcerer's forces, the player clears thirty handcrafted dungeon quests with turn-based tactical combat, traps, and magic, builds and trains up to ten heroes, and can play co-op or design custom quests.

A full remake of a non-linear RPG in which the player leads an empire against the returning Seven Heroes, choosing successive emperors from over 30 classes whose knowledge passes down through inheritance magic, while free-form scenarios and a timeline-based turn-based battle system shape the campaign.

Players take on the role of a racing team principal, building facilities, hiring drivers and staff, and managing pit strategy and car setup across endurance races to climb from GT4 to the Hypercar category. The setting is the modern motorsport world, presented as a detailed management simulation.

A first-person fantasy action RPG set on the mysterious island of the Living Lands, where an envoy of Aedyr investigates a nature-defying plague. Players mix swords, spells, guns and shields, explore varied ecosystems, and make choices that shape companions and the island's fate.

Players build decks from over 3,000 cards and duel opponents one-on-one in the Cardfight!! Vanguard card game, following an original story set in the anime's world. They can compete in ranked online fights, play against the CPU, and learn through a comprehensive tutorial.

An immigrant arrives in a steampunk city seeking a cure for a family disease, then rises through a corrupt society by crafting technopunk gear or mastering magic, recruiting companions, and fighting turn-based tactical battles while shaping a hero or villain.

Players manage characters in a modern city, guiding their work, housing, education and finances through a simulated inflation-driven economy. They handle multi-person households across generations, run businesses, invest in stocks and real estate, and pursue passions and influence.

A deckbuilding roguelite spin-off in which fortune teller Yohane is pulled through an old mirror into Reverse-Numazu, a mirrored world where magic works through cards. She builds decks from over 150 cards, summons friends, and explores shifting maps to save her friends.

Senua returns as a Celtic warrior experiencing psychosis, journeying through 10th century Viking Iceland on a brutal survival quest against tyranny, with visceral combat and cinematic immersion presented through her unique perspective.

Players lead a party of adventurers into burning mines to rescue kidnapped children and recover lost miners' remains, fighting demons through wilderness, hostile villages, and caverns in a retro first-person dungeon crawler RPG with turn-based combat, gathering experience and equipment along the way.

In a far-off galaxy, four former slave clans use Yedda genetic technology to alter their DNA and vie for domination after the empire's collapse. Players command a clan on large battle maps, stealing enemy genetic material to engineer and customize warriors with bio-technological weapons and attack formations.

Players inherit a grandfather's farm reduced to a lone island and must pay off a mounting debt using a deck of cards. Each card represents crops, animals, or structures; every few turns players choose new cards and buffs, generate items, sell them for cash, and reinvest to expand the farm efficiently.

A strategy and exploration game where the player infiltrates settlements to destroy all robots, locating weapons and tools and examining each situation to find non-head-on solutions, then activating the transporter once every robot is eliminated, with a map to track remaining enemies.

Players recruit a hero to lead an army and cast spells while units fight automatically, choosing each round whether to strengthen the hero, reinforce troops or boost spell power across multiple heroes, upgrades, maps and enemies.

The player solves handcrafted chess puzzles by moving and pushing their own pieces to capture every white piece on each level, using sokoban-style pushing and unique obstacles. The game offers 70 levels, infinite undos, and level skipping, presenting a contemplative, logic-focused puzzle experience.

Starting as a tourist in Japan, the player races over 550 real-world cars through Tokyo and rural landscapes, joins the Horizon Festival, builds a Valley Estate and garages, and cruises with friends at car meets to become a Horizon Legend.

Six months into a zombie apocalypse, the player builds a colony, trains an army, and fights the infected in this multiplayer RPG. Players gather scarce resources, research the mutating virus, recruit survivors with special abilities, form alliances, and shoot zombies with rifles and pistols.

A large puzzle game with over 300 hand-crafted levels whose many mechanics interact in surprising ways. Players learn rules through deliberate level design, with tutorials and accessibility options available, and optional bonus content that pushes concepts to wild extremes.

Players ride licensed snowmobiles through physics-driven deep powder on large open backcountry mountains, finding their own lines up steep climbs and across bowls. They can ride solo or online with proximity voice chat, record runs in replay mode, and download community-made maps and wraps.

Players take the role of a Formula One driver competing across the 2024 championship, building a career and racing with a new handling system while connecting with real teams and drivers. The tone is competitive and energetic, focused on motorsport mastery and legacy-building.

The player commands Union or Confederate forces at the Battle of Gettysburg, maneuvering unit markers on a hexagonal map in alternating turns. Combat resolves through die rolls modified by terrain, flanking, and limited artillery support, with historically accurate orders of battle and reinforcement timing.

A stealth action game set a decade after Snake Eater, following Snake as he leads a private military force amid Cold War conspiracies in Central America, undertaking solo infiltration missions, building up Mother Base and playing co-op or competitive multiplayer.

Players guide Solid Snake through stealth infiltration missions in a world where war has become a business, evading enemies to stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising. The story closes out the series' mysteries, and the collection includes screenplay and database extras.

Using a device built by space gnomes, the player packs interstellar items and recruits aliens to maximize earnings and pay off a mysterious debt. Fast roguelike runs involve inventory management, stacking combos and perks, unlocking devices, and battling space loan shark bosses across escalating difficulty levels.

Players build a medieval fantasy fortress and manage its economy in a real-time strategy game viewed from a sideways perspective, juggling land, sea, and sky layers to raise armies of soldiers, trolls, and dragons and lay siege to enemy castles.

A turn-based 4X strategy game where players control a Pretender God ruling a fantasy nation, aiming to defeat rivals and become the Pantokrator. Players choose their god type and dominion, manage huge armies, spells and magic items, and win by conquest, extinguishing enemy dominion or claiming Thrones of Ascension.

As Reimu, enter a book-world to find the missing Marisa, exploring dungeons in a tabletop-style RPG where dice rolls and branching choices shape the story toward multiple endings, with four Touhou heroines offering advice and special dice to collect.

Players control Marcus Fenix and Delta squad in a remastered third-person cover shooter, fighting the subterranean Locust that have ruined the planet. The campaign can be played solo or in online co-op, with additional PvP multiplayer modes and post-launch content included.

In a wasteland overrun by rogue AI, players lead a mercenary crew flying an airship across an open world, taking contracts and recruiting pilots. Battles are planned then resolved in animated anime-style sequences using a timeline system, while between missions pilots bond, train and cook, and Mechs are assembled from collected parts.

As a mercenary leader in the mineral-rich country of Iria, the player recruits and trains companions, fights grid-based tactical battles, and makes choices that shape the town and story amid rising tensions and riots.

A freelance journalist enters a quarantined Colorado mall crawling with zombies and has 72 hours before help arrives. Players fight through hordes with guns and household objects, rescue survivors, change clothes, and confront psychopaths while uncovering the truth behind the outbreak.

A roguelike tower defense game where the player lands on a planet and uses an orbiting ship to deliver buildings and provide fire support. Choose missions, place turrets and walls, manage resources, unlock upgrades, and collect artifacts to adapt to each enemy wave.

As a commander in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by a Lovecraftian flesh organism, players lead a military convoy and strike team, choosing equipment, crafting, researching, and managing resources. Combat blends real-time strategy with an optional turn-based pause mode across a branching campaign.

A real-time strategy game set in the Chains of Worlds, where the player commands Legates, transforms terrain for energy and defense, develops bases, and fights the hostile Scourge and rival factions across a centuries-spanning narrative campaign with online multiplayer.

Ellie and Abby's post-pandemic journey across the United States continues in a remastered action-adventure, now with a roguelike survival mode of randomized encounters and boss battles alongside the story campaign.

Players become a city lord of China, Rome, Egypt, or Persia, building structures, farming, summoning historical heroes, and combining units and formations in strategic battles. The game emphasizes civilization growth, missions, and fair competition without VIP privileges, with auto-fight options for easier progression.

Players control a poker-obsessed man who gains a hypnotic card on his 30th birthday and uses it to encounter five girls. The game is a deck-building card battler with a body-part mechanic, randomly generated maps, events, and battles against cute girls.

Players skate through remade parks from Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 and 4, completing two-minute runs and challenging goals, while creating custom skaters and parks and competing online with up to eight players.

A tactical World War II wargame set during the 1943 Sicilian campaign, letting players command American, Italian, and German forces in real-time or WeGo turn-based missions, campaigns, and custom quick battles with detailed 3D units.

Players build and upgrade a medieval city, raise armies and a dragon, and wage real-time multiplayer war against rival kingdoms to claim Excalibur's empty throne. Set in a fantasy Arthurian England, the game emphasizes alliance warfare, espionage, and strategy as players compete to become the one true king.

A retired conquistador living as a hermit in a cave discovers his beloved coffin has vanished and must solve inventive puzzles across four levels to find it, in a hand-drawn point-and-click adventure told through non-verbal animation and ambient sound.

Players explore a large open fantasy world solo or with up to four co-op partners, building customized characters, crafting gear, solving puzzles, and fighting enemies while quest choices reshape the world and its outcomes.

Players take part in a licensed baseball game featuring the 2026 MLB schedule, live cards and Hall of Fame legends. They choose quick, spotlight or full play, build and upgrade teams, compete in ranked tournaments and club battles, and face rivals worldwide in real-time matches.

Players form a co-op expedition of up to four into a cursed Lovecraftian jungle, signing contracts with a captain for gear and splitting loot while a madness system distorts perception and sows paranoia. They explore abandoned forts, recover logbooks, and venture deeper toward The Mound in search of treasure.

Players command a fantasy kingdom on hex-based maps, managing resources, diplomacy, armies, and heroes while exploring dungeons for magic items and artifacts, with an editor for generating infinite maps and scenarios.

At the dawn of the interstellar era, players lead a faction across a real-scale 3D star neighborhood, exploring, expanding, and conquering rivals. They command fleets, manage colonies and industry, balance economies, and advance through six technology trees toward interstellar dominance.

The official 2025 Supercross racing game, where the player competes on real-world-inspired tracks against professional riders, builds a career with rivalries and strategic choices, and races online with crossplay. Realistic physics and dynamic track evolution make each lap different.

A motorcycle racing game covering the 2024 MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3 and MotoE categories, letting players build a career, manage team transfers, customize bikes and helmets, and race online or in split-screen against friends.

On their last night together, three friends head to a final party, and a curated playlist pulls them into dreamlike reenactments of formative teenage memories, played through vignettes of skateboarding, flying, photography, baseball and fireworks, exploring adolescence and moving on.

A priestess must repay a crushing debt to keep her church and orphanage open, earning money through bar work, serving her faith, and exploring board-game-style dungeons with dice-driven movement and combat, while uncovering why a shady company holds her land's deed.

After defeating the Demon King, hero Astel is transformed into a girl and must adjust to a peaceful postwar world, making friends, working her first job, and exploring dungeons in a turn-based RPG with adjustable difficulty.

An RPG set in a world where adventuring is a common career, following a woman trying to find happiness and make money through quests, bounty hunting, and fishing, with a party of up to four talkative members and heavy writing.

Players explore a compact, interconnected open world as a warrior who seeks and possesses the forgotten Shells of eight lost warriors, using their abilities and upgrading melee and ranged weapons in stamina-free, tactical combat against enemies whose posture can be shattered for critical strikes.

As an Executor in a sanatorium for injured warriors who long to die in battle, the player pushes units of rival factions together to fight, pushes equipment onto creatures to strengthen them, and uses conveyors and buttons to solve puzzles, sending patients to Valhalla with unlimited undo.

A tactical wargame recreating the 1954 Battle of Dien Bien Phu at regiment-to-platoon scale, with turns covering hours or days. Players command either the French or Vietminh forces across a grand campaign and shorter scenarios, managing unit activation against AI or other players.

A tactical wargame recreating the 1937 Second Sino-Japanese battle for Shanghai, where the player commands Chinese or Japanese regiment-to-platoon units across a grand campaign and shorter scenarios, using a unit activation system against AI or other players.

Players choose a pirate captain and recruit crewmates with unique skills, then fight turn-based battles using Steel, Smoke, or Salt elemental mechanics. Managing savvy resources, combos, and a curse meter from cursed treasure shapes each run against Creeps on the board.

A tactical strategy game recreating the 153-133 BC conflict between Rome and the Celtiberians of Numantia, with two campaigns and playable sides. Players position, flank, and cover units in real-time battles, manage resources, complete in-battle missions, and make narrative decisions amid hand-drawn illustrations.

Facehand is a synergy-driven roguelike deckbuilder in which the player chains card abilities into wild combos. An ascending grade system adds new twists each run, while cards, relics, and runes unlock over time to enable game-breaking hands.

Players act as a lord in a multiplayer real-time strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms era, exploring an open world map, building a city, recruiting historical generals, and arranging troop formations to conquer territory alongside guilds.

A fantasy 4X turn-based strategy sequel where the player explores, expands and conquers an empire while resolving detailed tactical battles. It adds simulated naval combat with sea monsters, destructible terrain, water and weather magic, and larger procedurally varied worlds with more enemies.

Three players form a team of Nightfarers with two in-game days to explore the shifting land of Limveld and hunt a terrifying Nightlord. Each of eight heroes has a passive ability, skill and ultimate art that combine into team synergies against environmental threats and bosses.

Players travel the province of Cyrodiil and the planes of Oblivion, building a character from warrior to assassin or mage, mastering swordplay and magic, and following an epic quest to stop a Daedric invasion in this remastered open-world RPG.

Max and Chloe reunite at Caledon University as a deadly inferno threatens the campus within days; players control both characters, rewinding time to redo decisions and solve puzzles while racing to uncover culprits and decide who survives.

A young ninja prodigy fights through a near-future Tokyo overrun by miasma and cybernetic soldiers after an ancient enemy's resurrection, wielding transforming weapons and legacy techniques. The hack-and-slash action follows a fast, stylish combat campaign alongside the returning Ryu Hayabusa.

In the 25th century, humanity resettles in the Epsilon Eridani system and is drawn into an intergalactic conflict. Players command one of three races in real-time strategy battles across space, managing over 120 units and structures to crush alien empires and secure survival through conquest.

A real-time strategy game set in ancient China during the Three Kingdoms period, letting players command the kingdoms of Liu Bei, Sun Quan, or Cao Cao through three campaigns, developing technologies, managing cities and diplomacy, and raising armies to unify the nation.

Players race customized cars through the night highways of a sealed future Tokyo, battling rivals on recreated Shuto Expressway courses. Victory requires wearing down opponents' Spirit Points through strategy as much as speed, while tuning vehicles and unlocking perks across a skill tree.

Players manage an RPG character who fights automatically, even offline, while they craft equipment, optimize builds, and unlock a dozen subsystems such as a garden, a monster bestiary, and a card minigame to grow stronger against tougher enemies.

A blend of base building and tower defense in a chaotic fantasy setting where the player constructs automated fortresses, recruits legendary units, casts spells, and defends against relentless enemy waves across 30 handcrafted campaign missions or custom and randomly generated maps.

A samurai wielding the mystical Oni Gauntlet fights through bloodstained battlefields of Edo-period Kyoto, twisted by malevolent Malice. Players battle underworld monstrosities called Genma in intense swordplay action, absorbing their souls to gain power, while following Miyamoto Musashi's search for his reason to fight in a dark fantasy tale.

Players command Allied or German forces through the Normandy campaign of 1944, managing brigades and divisions across three-day turns in scenarios from D-Day to the breakout, balancing land, air, and naval support to hold or break the front.

Two new employees of a paranormal research firm are sent to a remote town for a long exorcism mission, where the player must protect his girlfriend from a predatory boss using cameras, calls and surveillance. Daytime exorcism and nighttime events branch into five hidden endings.

A grand real-time strategy game of global warfare where players command a continent-spanning faction, research technology across eras, conduct diplomacy, and deploy conventional armies or nuclear arsenals across several modes and a decades-spanning campaign.
