A remastered over-the-top action game in which cheerleader Juliet Starling, from a family of zombie hunters, fights through undead hordes at her high school using acrobatics, a chainsaw and a blaster, building combo streaks and battling bizarre boss enemies in a zany, gory adventure.

A digital adaptation of the Stratego board game in which two players command 40 hidden pieces aiming to capture the enemy flag. It offers ranked online matchmaking, bot opponents, a single-player campaign about a traitor, and social features across platforms.

As spriggan Van Arkride, players investigate a series of murders tied to a crimson beast in Calvard, fighting through field and command battles with new combo mechanics while uncovering a conspiracy in this story-driven RPG sequel.

Play as former outlaw John Marston tracking down the last members of the Van der Linde Gang across the American West, with the zombie-horror companion story Undead Nightmare included in this PC release of the open-world action adventure.

As Lord of Silver Heron Ridge, players build decks of cards to summon creatures and cast spells, battling monsters across regions to protect their kingdom. They choose classes like Mage, Priest, Ranger, or Warrior and trade cards with allies.

A tactical World War II wargame covering the Western Allied campaign from October 1944 to January 1945, centered on the Battle of the Bulge. Players command squads, vehicles, and teams at battalion scale in 3D, managing morale, fog of war, and realistic ballistics in real-time or turn-based modes.

In a flooded world ravaged by a disease, the player sails between floating isles as a Tidewalker, gathering resources and meeting factions while following the recorded choices of another player. Those echoes shape levels, characters and narrative options, and the player's own decisions are left for future players.

A hardcore action RPG set 800 years before Dungeon Fighter Online, following General Khazan on a path of revenge across the continent of Arad. Players master deep combat, respec skills freely, collect gear sets, and battle demanding bosses with distinct patterns in cel-shaded 3D.

Lead a band of five warriors across a harsh fantasy land corrupted by off-beat rhythm magic. Plan tactical turn-based battles on a grid, then execute attacks in time with a tribal drumbeat, growing stronger through roguelite runs with randomized encounters.

A turn-based tactical roguelike set in a cyberpunk hell where the player fights step by step to break a corporate time loop, building a killer with weapons, traps and stimulants, chaining kills for extra turns across shifting battlefields where mistakes are fatal.

Players race across the Hawaiian island of O'ahu in street, off-road and track events, working through themed playlists that celebrate car culture. They collect and customize legendary vehicles, compete in large multiplayer races and demolition battles, and climb leaderboards in challenge contests.

A collection of classic 1990s party-based RPGs set on the medieval isle of Gelnor. The player commands up to six adventurers of varied races and classes, exploring dungeons, solving puzzles, learning spells and battling monsters to defeat Dark Lords.

Take control of a country and shape its history turn by turn in a single-session world domination campaign, planning developments, conquests, and defenses simultaneously with all other nations on a globe view across scenarios spanning 2024, 2000, 1900, 1700, 1300, and 1 BC.

A chess training program where players face six AI characters mimicking typical club player personalities, from aggressive attackers to cautious cowards, with built-in tactical mistakes to exploit. It offers opening practice, stress-free assisted calculation training, tips, and reward cards for beautiful attacks and combinations.

The player is an ancient dragon in human guise, hunting undead across grim crypts, forests, and ruins while taking quests from people unaware of their true nature. Combat shifts between sword-and-flame fighting on the ground and fiery flight in dragon form.

A short free point-and-click adventure where Milo tries to recover a lost Christmas gift, solving hidden-object puzzles across hand-painted wintery interiors and snowy gardens over five brief chapters with a festive soundtrack.

A dark comedy monster tamer set in a dystopian world where the economy revolves around artificial copies of wild monsters. Players travel regions, build a team from 120 monsters, and fight turn-based 3v3 battles while deciding what kind of Champion to become.

Detective Neon dives into virtual dungeons overrun by characters from other games, battling through a 6x3 playfield in roguelike deckbuilding combat, recruiting over 300 character cards and singing Muse cards, and exploring story dungeons with online challenges and head-to-head battles.

Players tee off across courses with a cast of colorful characters, using a simple three-press shot system in single-player tournaments or against friends locally and online. Challenge mode, rule customization, and the playful Wacky Golf variant round out the arcade golf experience.

Adol Christin and the pirate Karja Balta sail the Obelia Gulf to save its people from immortal monsters called the Griegr. Players swap between the two heroes in action combat, use Mana powers to traverse dungeons, and explore by ship with naval battles and uncharted islands.

An isometric RPG where the player escapes a prison transport, crash-lands on a remote planet, builds a base, and ventures through space to unite abandoned worlds against a tyrannical mega-corporation, using combat or diplomacy shaped by character origin and skills.

A turn-based Wild West roguelike where the player moves and shoots on a hex grid, aligning revolver cylinder rotation to outwit enemies, and uses explosive barrels or hazards to win. Each run offers bullet upgrades and skills, randomly generated levels, and a final boss.

A turn-based, character-centric tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy version of Arthurian Avalon. The player commands the undead Roman Ninth Legion through 15 handcrafted missions, managing a party of heroes, using cover and flanking in tactical combat, rebuilding a colony, and making moral choices.

A hex-based WWII strategy game covering the Pacific theater from Pearl Harbor onward, letting the player command seven major powers across land and sea campaigns and five shorter scenarios from 1939 to 1945.

A turn-based strategy game played on an interactive 3D board resembling a tabletop wargame, where players pick missions across mountains, cities and fortresses, manage line of sight and fire, and organize pilots with distinct strengths to uncover enemy positions.

Command Napoleon's army or the allied forces of Wellington and Blucher at the Battle of Waterloo, maneuvering unit markers on a hexagonal map in alternating turns. Combat resolves through dice rolls modified by terrain and support, with historical orders of battle, reinforcements, and solo or online play.

A competitive auto-battler card game where the player acts as a General leading a Squad in head-to-head PvP matches. Shifting battle zones reshape each fight, rewarding card synergy, deployment choices, and anticipation of opponents' strategies in a post-cataclysm dieselpunk world.

A challenging survival RTS roguelite where players fuel a drill to descend deeper while defending against massive swarms of monsters, expanding their base, customizing units and buildings with weapons and upgrades, and unlocking meta progression after each defeat.

In a world smothered by toxic Smog, players build and optimize a city while assembling a deck of cards, rekindling ancient lighthouses to push back the haze region by region. Resource management, building placement, and card synergies drive a solo, board-game-like strategy experience.

A strategy game where the player builds up settlements and fights real-time battles, choosing among three factions with distinct looks and playstyles. It offers a story-driven campaign, a hardcore mode, and online skirmishes with up to eight players against others or AI.

A tower defense village builder where the player clicks trees for wood, clicks enemies to damage them, and clicks fog to reveal the map. Structures automate resource gathering, coins from each run buy towers and upgrades in a shop, and procedurally generated levels pit the village against progressively stronger enemies up to day 100.

The player becomes the center of a romance story in which eight women from different backgrounds vie for attention, and choices determine whether the protagonist stays a good man or gives in to temptation. Branching routes lead to multiple endings and collectible memories.

In 2053, an Interpol occult agent named Noah descends into the sunken city of R'lyeh to investigate missing miners, aided by an AI companion, solving puzzles and piecing together clues while resisting madness in a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure with branching choices.

A grand strategy wargame where the player leads any countryball nation on a fully playable world map, balancing turn-based expansion and diplomacy with real-time battles. Players manage armies, treaties, and alliances, unlock hidden nations, and can build custom campaigns in an in-game editor.

In a world overrun by dinosaurs, the player builds and defends a colony, breeds, tames, and rides dinos, upgrades heroes, and commands one of three factions to reclaim territory for humanity in a base-building survival RTS.

Players grow a kingdom from a humble village into a massive citadel by combining buildings, units, spells and positioning. They recruit armies, loot rival kings' decks, and survive endless waves or async multiplayer matches against eight rival kings to prove their kingdom outlasts all others.

A bar management RPG where players run a restaurant aiming to become the kingdom's top establishment, raising its rank through cooking contests and sales while exploring dungeons and battling monsters for ingredients, with characters leveling up by eating dishes rather than fighting.

Sheryl, an alchemist in a town on the rim of a vast chasm, explores the Abyss to gather ingredients, befriend its species, and uncover a conspiracy. She crafts weapons and items through alchemy and fights in top-down real-time combat with staff, bow, and magic.

A hyperdimensional football RPG set 25 years after the first Inazuma Eleven, following protagonist Destin Billows and rival Harper Evans. Players relive past matches, collect and train over 5,400 characters, build a dream team, customize an avatar, and socialize in a Bond Town, with anime cutscenes by MAPPA.

A strategy game where the player is a Sorcerer turned Elder who learns spells, builds cities and armies, binds regions to a Throne against a destructive Merge, and can ascend to godhood, with betrayal and shifting victories among up to 32 players.

Players fight in large-scale all-out warfare across iconic global locations, engaging in infantry combat, aerial dogfights, tank and naval battles, and environmental destruction, with class-based squad play and a sandbox Portal mode for creating custom game modes and rules.

As Queen Avyanna, rule a crumbling dark fantasy kingdom from the capital, recruiting and upgrading units across five factions, fighting grid-based turn-based battles, and making choices that shape faction reputation and the fate of the realm.

A deduction puzzle game framed as the last hour of a lost 90s JRPG, where the player collects manual pages, videos, and commentary to deduce how the game works and uncover its secret. The meta adventure blurs fact and fiction across several hours.

The player assembles a troupe of Good and Evil performers before each auto-battle, building synergies and combos, then spends gold to hire more and manage items. Players choose one of three leads, unlock passives, and push through ten difficulty levels in a theatrical setting.

Players join a lethal arcade racing tournament in a neon-lit futuristic world with 90s anime styling. Choosing among five drivers, they race and fight using the ECHO system's Boost, Strike, and Shield abilities, competing in team races and online or split-screen modes.

A motorcycle racing game where the player builds a career at a festival, collects over 250 bikes, and challenges legendary champions across road and off-road tracks. Arcade and simulation modes, a riding school, and online cross-play races support different skill levels.

As a Viking leader in the world of Midgard, the player explores, plunders, and develops a tribe, recruiting heroes from Norse myth and history. Players build and customize territory, form alliances with other online players, and fight real-time naval and land battles to conquer the map.

This History Edition revives the original Anno 1602 and its New Islands, New Adventure expansion, letting players build and manage island settlements across many scenarios. It adds updated 4K resolutions, expanded multiplayer, save compatibility, and quality-of-life features like borderless window mode and mouse-wheel zoom.

Players race Hot Wheels cars across four themed islands, completing events to defeat each island's Rush Master and claim their car. They collect over 150 vehicles, customize rides, build tracks with a Track Builder, and race in single-player, split-screen, or online multiplayer.

A roguelike where the player merges matching tiles on a board to trigger combat effects like sword swings, arrows, and shields, unlocking new tiles and artifacts across runs, exploring four regions and fighting dozens of enemies whose behaviors demand shifting strategies.

A roguelite RPG where the player gathers weapons and artifacts by day and fights the Demon King's minions by night, while a new boss hunts them every three days. Over 350 items enable varied builds and synergies against each monster's unique powers.

An exiled lowborn warrior descends into a demonic Japanese castle in a roguelike inspired by Angband and Nethack. Players manage fatigue, build stats and perks, and exploit elemental status effects against myth-based enemies with distinct weaknesses and counterplay.

A soldier named William is resurrected from a battlefield grave into a plague-ravaged alternate 19th-century Europe, wielding corrupting supernatural power. Players master parries, dashes, and finishers across varied weapons, growing stronger with each death while fighting plague-ridden abominations and uncovering the truth behind the resurrection.

As warriors of light in Luxendarc, the player journeys to close the Great Chasm and free the crystals from darkness, fighting strategic turn-based battles with Brave and Default commands and over 20 jobs, plus remastered graphics and new minigames.

A tower defense roguelite where the player shapes an eroding, growing map with terraforming tools, fortifies defenses against enemy waves each round, and spends rewards on towers, upgrades, and a customizable Home Tower while unlocking permanent perks across runs.

Leo awakens in a machine-filled land with one memory and sets out across dimensions to reclaim his past and stop a mechanical infection. Players explore over 150 diorama-style field areas, take quests, and fight turn-based battles by drawing enemies into skill trajectories.

A roguelike where anything that kills the player becomes playable on the next run. Set in Purgatory between Heaven and Hell, the player explores both realms, unlocks characters with unique skill trees and equipment slots, and combines abilities into deadly combos against demons and angels.

Players race along highways as members of a chaotic gang or as vigilantes pursuing them, using gas, brake, and turbo controls across 10 modes, 67 vehicles, and 383 races. The side-scrolling chase-camera perspective emphasizes speed, with cel-shaded vehicles and customizable visuals.

Command customizable ships in fast, tactical ship-to-ship battles across a richly realized Indian Ocean, forming fleets of up to twenty players to tackle world events, fortified settlements, pirate hunters, and mythical encounters amid dynamic weather and hostile factions.

A strategy role-playing game built in SRPG Studio with over thirty playable characters, featuring movement-and-attack battles, skill points and ultimate abilities, random level-up stat gains, branching quests, and multi-phase bosses across several story phases and side stories.

A roguelike turn-based RPG where players collect heroes from different dimensions, build a party of three, and combine their skills into combos to save the multiverse from Ragnarath's armies. The campaign unfolds through voice-acted comic-book cutscenes, with procedurally generated encounters and boss raids for replayability.

In 2102, after Alordesh's army declares independence, soldier Ash and his teammates infiltrate the chaotic underground to escape, uncovering a conspiracy behind the coup across three perspectives, with strategic turn-based combat and Wanzer customization.

A cozy roguelike deckbuilder where players choose a dog breed, collect trick cards, and compete in dog shows from park to stadium, building and decorating a pet resort to unlock perks, with procedurally generated competitions and hand-drawn animations.

A digital port of a board wargame covering the Eastern Front of World War II, where players command Axis or Soviet armies across hex maps. Card-driven events, scenarios, and an economic model simulate the four-year campaign.

Decktamer blends deck-building with monster catching in a turn-based roguelike set in a monster-filled abyss. Players tame enemies to add their cards to the deck, risk losing cards permanently when creatures die, and transfer abilities between creatures to create combos while descending toward the crater's heart.

A tactical RPG follows a party of companions venturing deeper into unknown regions, chaining their skills and linking three members' actions into coordinated turns. Height, knockbacks, terrain and objects shape combat, while Echoes and Memory Fragments reveal each character's hidden past.

A puzzle-platformer expanded from a game jam submission, where the player uses special light sources to affect the surrounding world. Players explore deeper into a facility, solving puzzles and uncovering its mysteries while something waits for them.

A real-time tactical strategy game set during the Seven Years' War where the player commands an army, manages supplies, and fights historical battles. Morale, stamina, terrain, and formation decide outcomes as regiments gain experience across a branching campaign.

Players run energy corporations in a turn-based worker placement game, sending Engineers to gather machinery, manage water, build structures, and produce energy while competing for limited shared action spaces. Unique CEOs and Executive Officers change strategies, and randomized objectives and technologies keep each session different, playable solo or online against others.

A fast-paced roguelike first-person shooter where players take on the role of Sanctum warriors battling through sin-themed levels full of traps, demons, and bizarre bosses, unlocking heroes and upgrading powers across chaotic runs.

An unlucky dog-brewer on a cozy island works to pay off debts by growing vegetables, breeding fish, and experimenting with unusual ingredients to craft beers tailored to the island's quirky residents, including farmer dogs, a human alcoholic, and a pig-pirate.

Players choose an alliance between two insect clans, each with distinct units and playstyles, then place them strategically in turn-based battles against the Fungomancer's blight. Between fights they explore a lush world to find equipment, altars, potions, and forges, building synergies to push back the corruption.

A strategy tower defense puzzler where you play the villain defending your lair from invading heroes using over 30 traps and minions. Includes 90 stages plus a roguelite mode with randomized runs, upgrades, and castle customization.

A free prologue to an isometric RPG where the player escapes a prison transport, crash-lands on the forsaken planet Maku, builds it into a base, and ventures into space to unite scattered worlds against a tyrannical mega-corporation through combat or diplomacy.

An HD-2D remake bundling the first two Dragon Quest adventures, following descendants of Erdrick as they travel Alefgard and neighboring kingdoms, fighting monsters in turn-based battles and gathering a party to defeat the Dragonlord and new evils.

An experimental thriller visual novel set in the 1960s Soviet Union, following lonely scientist and alchemist Anton Sidorov through a winding 160,000-word plot with over 300 CG images, 24 endings, and two selectable game modes.
Players build card decks from an evolving collection, battling opponents in ranked ladder matches and friend duels, upgrading cards mid-match through the Tox Shop to create combos and outplay rivals.

Cloud Strife and his companions leave the mako-powered city of Midgar and journey across a vast world, riding chocobos and fighting battles while Shinra drains the planet's lifestream and Sephiroth's schemes intertwine destinies. The reimagined RPG continues the remake trilogy with an epic, fate-driven story.

A turn-based RPG set in a parallel world where a new hero confronts a mysterious man and his lookalike followers, delving into randomly generated dungeon floors filled with monsters and traps, fighting bosses, and facing violent Death Ends.

A real-time tactical wargame set in World War II where players command American or German forces in historically accurate battles, deploying troops and armor while soldiers react dynamically to ability, stamina, and mental condition under heavy fire.

Players command WWII troops in real-time tactical battles, managing weary or green soldiers, allocating limited reinforcements and capturing territory that carries over between fights. They can design custom battles and fight across three fronts with historically modeled infantry and vehicles.

A real-time strategy game set on the Russian Front of World War II where the player commands Soviet or German squads through a four-year campaign, managing morale, ammunition, and veteran soldiers across battles from Operation Barbarossa to Berlin.

Command American or German troops in the December 1944 Battle of the Bulge, deploying battle groups on a strategic Ardennes map, launching air attacks amid random weather, and managing morale, fatigue and stress in real-time tactical combat.

A WWII real-time strategy game recreating the Allied campaign from Utah Beach to Cherbourg, with players commanding Allied or Axis forces. A strategic map moves battle groups between fights, while morale, line-of-sight, limited ammunition, and a scenario editor shape tactical engagements.

Two classic fantasy strategy games set in the land of Illuria, where eight empires wage war for supremacy using armies, heroes, monsters, dragons, quests, diplomacy, and magic across fixed and randomly generated worlds.

A boy spends summer break in the Japanese countryside with his aunt, exploring the town, catching bugs and fish, making friends, and battling collected bugs in turn-based RPG fights, all while a ticking clock limits how much he can do before summer ends.

An arena fighting game following Tanjiro Kamado through the Entertainment District, Swordsmith Village and Hashira Training arcs of the Demon Slayer anime in a single-player story mode. A versus mode offers over 40 characters, including the nine Hashira, with dual ultimates and gear for online and offline battles.

Players command squadrons in real-time tactical battles, deploying fighters and heavier units, timing mothership abilities, and gathering resources while pushing through procedurally generated missions in Voltari-controlled space. Roguelite runs offer upgrades, allies, and boss fights, with persistent progress across attempts.

In virtual reality, the player raises, grooms and trains a stable of horses with a mentor's help, breeds foals for new coats, explores a scenic ranch, and rides in story and multiplayer races including cross country events.

Players race across 37 tracks in 8 car categories, balancing arcade accessibility with simulation handling, and can build and share custom circuits through the Track Creator and Steam Workshop. A story mode follows a young driver's career, with split-screen multiplayer, a day-night cycle, and global leaderboards.

A strategy card game where the player commands units and spells as a Champion, deploying cards on a battlefield to destroy the enemy banner. Campaigns span enemy regions with encounters, mini-bosses, stores, and taverns, unlocking new Champions and promotion gems.

As Cpt J.F. Blake, lead a U.S. Special Forces rescue team into an Antarctic research outpost where a shape-shifting alien mimics the people it kills. Manage squad trust and fear while fighting monsters with firearms and flamethrowers across twenty levels in this remastered survival horror shooter.

The player solves Nurikabe logic puzzles by placing water tiles to form islands and a connected river, watching completed islands grow trees and structures in 3D scenery. Handcrafted and procedurally generated puzzles, daily challenges, and a level editor support relaxed play.

A chaotic shooting game starring Sakura Miko and 35P, where players slash, burn, and explode waves of enemies while powering up stats. Changing outfits alters play style, and enhancing companion abilities helps clear stages and chase high scores.

This application lets players design fantasy tabletop weapons, armor, and equipment by mixing and matching hand-drawn parts and colors, then naming items and assigning stats. Finished items can be downloaded as printable equipment cards or used with in-app dice rolls during tabletop sessions, remaining ruleset agnostic.

A real-time strategy game where the player leads block-based machines against an interdimensional threat, arranging blocks into patterns to construct buildings, spreading influence across a tile grid, and completing missions with varied objectives and endings.

Players assemble teams of Magical Girls from the Madoka Magica series and battle powerful Witches in 3D Labyrinths, reliving key memories of the characters. A girl who has lost everything wanders the Lighthouse, opening windows into their pasts to find her own lost remembrance.

Set in 1988 Japan, the player controls yakuza Kazuma Kiryu and cabaret manager Goro Majima through Tokyo and Osaka, brawling with three switchable fighting styles against enemies. Between fights, the player explores neon-lit districts full of arcades, discos and clubs, with added cutscenes and an online co-op mode.

An adventurer sails to an uncharted island and travels between its present and its thriving past to uncover its downfall. Players switch freely among 14 jobs, gathering, crafting, cooking and fighting, shape the island and town, explore an open world, and play with up to four friends.

The player builds an intergalactic starship by buying cargo from a trader and arranging the pieces in the ship's hold, where placement matters, sending pilots to clear space or command ships, then battles asynchronously against other players' creations in a roguelike autobattler.

A round-based strategy game blending base building with real-time hero combat, where the player constructs towers, walls and barracks, unlocks class synergies and faction perks, and fights alongside their army against escalating waves across campaign and randomized modes.

A turn-based JRPG fused with a true roguelike, where players send four heroes into a rift to battle the evil Extol, unlocking 27 classes, exploring 25 biomes and collecting randomized equipment across runs, with resources from failed attempts carrying over to strengthen the next party.

Players build a 20-card deck and battle hololive talents and their listeners in turn-based card fights, drawing cards each turn and gaining MP while low HP boosts attack power for reversals. Winning runs unlock new cards and routes in a roguelike structure with multiple playable characters and difficulty levels.

Players fight through the chaos of Emergence Day as Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago, battling the Locust Horde in a cover-based shooter campaign. The game also offers co-op wave survival and competitive multiplayer modes, all set in a darker, grittier world rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5.

Playing as Abraham Lincoln or Jefferson Davis in 1861, the player manages the American Civil War by appointing cabinet ministers, envoys and generals, moving armies across the map, and balancing military, political, diplomatic and economic concerns, with outcomes such as losing the 1864 election or winning foreign recognition.

Players take the role of the DOOM Slayer in a prequel set during a medieval war against Hell, wielding shotguns and a Shield Saw while fighting demon hordes across ruined castles, battlefields and hellscapes. The campaign is a single-player, cinematic dark fantasy and sci-fi shooter with grounded, vicious combat.

A sci-fi strategy game set 400 years after Earth's destruction, where the player commands fleets among ten warring factions, collects over 100 ships and pilots, customizes loadouts, and fights PvE campaigns, PvP arena battles, and exploration of the mysterious Abyss.

The player transforms a dead world into a thriving biosphere by growing flowers that supply, direct, and clone bees, and by setting up beehives to craft wax and honey. There are no enemies, grinding, or time pressure, only free rearrangement and an extensive research tree unlocking new life.

Players race miniature cars across numerous tracks in three vibrant locations, winning races to unlock upgrades and parts. They fine-tune each vehicle with extensive customization options, combining fast-paced racing action with a progression system that rewards continued personalization and improvement.

An action-adventure following Basim's rise from a defiant young thief to a Master Assassin in dense, vibrant Baghdad, where the player parkours through the city, gathers clues and contracts, and stealthily eliminates targets, with a new region and story content added.

Players command Time-Walker mechs defending salvage teams on a ruined Earth after the Grell war, deploying turrets and repositioning mechs mid-battle. Sending mechs back in time duplicates defenders to replay waves, while upgrades, pilots, and destructible battlefields support tactical tower defense against swarming enemies.

A girl reincarnates into her favorite otome game as the villainess Tiara Rose, whose engagement is broken off just as the crown prince of a neighboring kingdom proposes to her; players make choices that lead to alternate endings and bonus love stories.

Players take the role of Jubei Yagyu in feudal Japan, fighting through swordplay and a revenge-driven story alongside allies. This HD remaster adds improved controls, a gallery, soundtrack selection, Hell mode difficulty, and bonus mini-games.

Marona, a girl who speaks with Phantoms, sails the ocean world of Ivoire with her friend Apricot, recruiting spirits and binding them to objects to fight ghost ships in turn-based tactical battles on gridless maps.

Players develop a character in a persistent multiplayer world inspired by Slavic and Germanic myth, hunting beasts, foraging, farming, fishing, taming livestock, mining caves, and crafting to permanently shape the procedurally generated landscape and their own skills.

Players compete in first-person volleyball matches, spiking and digging with mouse-driven controls that mirror real arm and hand movements. Skill and timing decide every rally on an even playing field with no pay-to-win elements.

Players compete in realistic racing simulations with online leaderboards, hotlap and hotstint events, and timed races requiring strategic pitstops for tires and fuel. The early access build adds a refined slick tire model and force feedback improvements across a roster of GT cars.

Players race through the 2025 Formula One season and into the 2026 era with new teams, driver lineups, cars, and the Madrid circuit. Career and My Team modes let players design liveries and manage a team, while online co-op events pit squads against AI drivers.

Players live as a Tokyo high-school student by day and a Phantom Thief after school, infiltrating dungeons of the heart called Palaces, fighting Shadows in stylish turn-based combat, leveling Personas, and spending free time on friendships, clubs, and part-time work.

An amnesiac ex-yakuza becomes a pirate captain in a modern-day open-sea adventure, assembling a crew, upgrading his ship, and fighting real-time cannon battles and crew brawls while hunting lost memories and a legendary treasure across Pacific islands.

An officially licensed motorcycle racing game recreating the 2025 MotoGP season, where the player rides iconic bikes on real tracks, manages a career with turning points and rider market dynamics, trains in new disciplines, and races online in ranked cross-play.

Players lead one of five factions in fast-paced empire management at the edge of space, colonizing planets and battling rivals through auto-battles while controlling a flagship's weapons. Short turns demand careful resource allocation, with multiple victory paths, trade routes, heroes, and random events shaping each run.

A streamlined real-time strategy game where players defend a headquarters, build turrets and production buildings, and manage a simplified economy across short matches and a 25-mission campaign told from three factions' perspectives during a global war over a volatile energy source.

Build a vertical city in the boughs of a giant tree while defending it from a creeping fog that drives citizens mad, gathering resources, researching technologies, crafting light-powered weapons and sending scouts into ruins, with morally complex branching decisions shaping the story.

Control a single mech that walks, shoots, gathers resources, builds, and summons in a simplified RTS. Plan defenses before battle, then fight alien swarms through levels ending in unique boss fights, with local co-op letting one player command ground forces and another the skies.

The player battles bosses and monsters in a 3D fantasy MMO, collecting equipment, wings, artifacts, and diamonds, trading gear in an auction house, and upgrading VIP levels and angel companions for powerful skills.

A PvE card game where the player builds a 20-card deck and must defeat enemies within a single turn, since drawing cards costs card uses and a failed turn invites a lethal counterattack. Set in a pixel-art wasteland, it emphasizes deck synergy and suspenseful, fast battles.

Play as shinobi Naoe and samurai Yasuke in feudal Japan, switching between stealth infiltration and visceral melee combat across an open world shaped by seasons, weather, and environmental destruction.

Players guide a dwarf through a forgotten mine, optimizing limited daily expeditions to gather resources and construct buildings that synergize with freed heroes. Each night they defend the mine gate against waves of monsters sent by a cursed tower until sunrise.

Players control Captain Titus, an Ultramarine Space Marine, battling a massive Ork invasion on an Imperial forge world while a darker threat lurks. The game mixes ranged bolter fire with brutal close-combat chainsword strikes, plus 8v8 online multiplayer with class customization. The tone is intense, violent, and epic science-fantasy warfare.

Players command Cold War battalion-to-regimental forces on hex-based German battlefields, issuing orders in asynchronous WEGO turns and watching real-time engagements unfold over hours of in-game time, managing artillery, air support, weather, and morale to outmaneuver an opposing commander.

A first-person 3D puzzle game about packing possessions into containers at different stages of three characters' lives, where players arrange items of varied shapes and sizes under space and time limits while physics makes careless stacking topple and careful placement satisfying.

As a low-ranking employee in a number factory, the player launches a spherical friend down a plinko-style pegboard to meet ever-growing production quotas, combining over 50 items to boost output and keep space and time intact.

Terminal One is an airport building and light business tycoon game where the player constructs runways, terminals and amenities, manages fuel, baggage and immigration flow, and balances costs against sustainability goals to reach net zero carbon emissions.

Players create a customized character and socialize with people worldwide in a casual online world, hosting home parties and playing minigames together. They fish over 600 species, catch insects, dig fossils, and care for pets.

As the lone survivor of a deep-space mining vessel, the player builds a base, sets up harvesters and power networks, and deploys tanks and artillery to push back spreading plant-alien Calyx. A tech tree, research points, and skirmish options support varied strategies in this RTS and base builder.

Players ride motocross bikes through 400+ levels spanning beaches, city streets, and frozen lakes, performing combo stunts to earn levels and coins. Coins buy new bikes and over 100 customization items, while hidden collectibles reward exploration of each environment.

The player leads the remnants of humanity in a post-apocalyptic real-time strategy campaign, rebuilding settlements, managing resources and factories, advancing through technological eras, and commanding thousands of units against mechanical bugs on a global map.

Players take the role of Michael Myers stalking and terrorizing the residents of Haddonfield on Halloween night in 1978, or play as Heroes who arm themselves with household items, alert townsfolk and police, and rescue families in singleplayer story and 1v4 asymmetrical multiplayer matches.

Players race in third-person through licensed series and tracks, earning resources to build up their team with facilities, cars, and drivers. Weekly events, online multiplayer for up to 11 racers, and global time trials keep competition fresh. The tone is upbeat and competitive.

As Commander defending an empire from Artronid invasions, the player reshapes terrain tiles to create choke points and funnel enemies into artillery and traps. They choose factions, heroes, and post-wave upgrades, adapting defenses each wave across replayable battles with multiple difficulty levels and an endless mode.

A turn-based tower defense game focused on resource management, where players build a small village to support towers, cycle four action cards, explore a mist-covered map, and upgrade buildings to defend against slimes across a 15-stage campaign.

Players follow three criminals entangled with the criminal underworld, government, and entertainment industry, pulling off dangerous heists in the open city of Los Santos, with an online mode for up to 30 players.

The player commands medieval armies in large-scale historical battles, building castles and expanding a civilization while equipping troops with authentic weapons and armor. Strategy, resource gathering, and troop customization drive the campaign against rival empires.

As Alex Evans returning to Alderwood Island, the player rides horses across an open world, befriends characters, races competitively and investigates a mother's disappearance and a body in the woods, uncovering an occult conspiracy.

Players command unique ape units in turn-based grid battles, capturing labs to unlock new fighters and adapting tactics to terrain and weather across a story mode with missions and surprises, set in a colorful world blending 2D and 3D art.

Players lead elite warriors called Stillae in turn-based tactical battles against the forces of Stasis in a dying world drained of color. They manipulate turn order, terrain, and positioning, choose risky missions on a branching map, and grow stronger through a roguelite loop of repeated runs.

Sam returns eleven months after the original events to connect Australia to the Chiral Network, crossing a seamless open world of changing weather, natural disasters and Timefall. Players build infrastructure, fabricate weapons, sneak or fight Mech soldiers and otherworldly creatures, and share asynchronous help with other porters.

A turn-based strategy game with randomly generated maps where you command fantasy armies of soldiers and monsters, conquering over half of 64 areas, with automatic battles and deep troop organization and equipment.

A roguelite deckbuilder with no energy costs, where cards are sigils placed on a grid and positioned for adjacency, overlap and synergy combos, with modular card upgrades, three characters and battles against astral entities and Titans.

Players control ninja Ryu Hayabusa wielding the Dragon Sword in a remastered high-speed action game, fighting across the world with swords, shurikens and other weapons in violent combat featuring dismemberment, plus additional characters and a beginner-friendly assist mode.

As the goblin Styx, the player leads a crew from a zeppelin to hunt the dangerous resource Quartz amid a world sliding toward war between elves, humans, and orcs. Stealth, crafting, cloning, and mind-control powers are used across vast vertical open environments.

As a small dragon, the player builds and runs a snake ranch, gathering resources, constructing facilities, caring for varied snakes and collecting their scales. Snakes can be assigned to automate chores and sent on expeditions for rare materials, while weather, seasons and research unlock new options.

Players draft randomized cards in a looter-style card game, swiping to pick heroes, weapons, relics, quests, consumables, and upgrades, then combine them into unique heroes to battle other players' decks asynchronously. A world map hides lore and unlocks, while monthly seasons and leaderboards drive competition.

Three protagonists—Van Arkride, Rean Schwarzer, and Kevin Graham—follow intertwining story paths across the Calvard Republic as the Zemurian continent nears its prophesied end and humanity prepares its first space venture. Players explore locations, build bonds with allies, and fight in action field battles that switch into turn-based command battles.

An interactive mystery adventure in which a psychiatrist interrogates Sofia, a murder suspect with multiple personalities, through surveillance cameras, choosing keywords and gifts to draw out four hidden personalities and determine the fate of the case across multiple endings.

A roguelike deck-building tower defense game where players assemble an army of pawns, chain card combos and relics, and unlock heroes across multiple modes with scaling difficulty and daily challenges.

A roguelike deck-builder where the player places animal subject cards on a battlefield to march toward enemy bases, knowing any card that reaches the enemy is permanently lost. Two campaigns add environmental hazards, gunpowder weapons, bosses and quirky NPC encounters.

A real-time strategy roguelike where the player commands fantasy factions on a tabletop-style battlefield, using spear walls, archers, and terrain to win skirmishes, while recruiting units, finding gear, and unlocking upgrades across randomized campaigns.

An arcade car racer inspired by southern US daredevil driving, where players race AI opponents or a friend in split-screen across desert roads, junkyards, and country lanes. It offers 16 customizable vehicles, 12 tracks, tournaments, time trials, and a limited nitro booster.

Players enter VR arenas as gladiators, wielding a large arsenal of violent weapons against the champions and sons of the God of the Afterlife across heavenly realms. A physics-driven combat engine powers boss fights, traps, power-ups, endless mode, and custom battlefields.

As a winged Daeva in a vast fantasy world, the player fights and explores in three dimensions, chaining skills in aerial combat, running solo and group dungeons, customizing a character, and joining faction warfare and seasonal events across Atreia.

A third-person basketball game that borrows shooter-style aiming and character control, letting players pull off spin moves, crossovers and step-backs while locking onto the rim. Compete online in full-court 1v1 and 2v2 matches with seven characters and varied shot and pass types.

Players assemble a tower of items whose synergies multiply into exponential combos, then pit it against other players' towers in asynchronous PvP auto battles. Buying, combining, and leveling items plus unlockable perks and NPC encounters shape each run.

A strategy card game with roguelite elements where the player builds decks from over 300 cards, explores randomized dungeons across a multiverse, and makes choices that shape each run, salvaging loot from failures to improve meta progression.

PLATiNA :: LAB is a rhythm game where players hit notes falling down four or six lanes across more than 120 tracks at three difficulty levels, while building affinity with animated characters and following a Korean-voiced story about restoring an encrypted Data World.

Players form a squad of up to four Colonial Marines fighting swarming xenomorphs across hostile corners of the Aliens universe, coordinating class abilities, weapons, and gear while surviving escalating encounters and dedicated Horde waves.

Players guide any of hundreds of historical nations from the late Middle Ages to the Age of Revolution, managing diplomacy, economy, factions, and warfare in a deeply simulated living world. Decisions shape alternate histories, from dynastic politics to conquest and domestic unrest.

Defend a tower against waves of monsters by collecting and crafting over 100 weapons and upgrades, leveling a shop, and choosing devilish pacts that strengthen enemies in exchange for power across nine gates of hell.

A horde survival roguelike deckbuilder in which the player pilots one of four customizable robots, placing cards on a hex grid to chain explosive combos and hold back mutating viral swarms threatening the core systems.

Players command one of six world leaders in turn-based battles across tile-based maps, capturing structures to earn gold, summoning units, and calling in super weapons while weather shifts the battlefield. A story campaign and up to four-player local or online multiplayer support the over-the-top conquest.

Players perform martial-arts-inspired BODYCOMBAT workouts in VR, following coached sessions with punch and knee-strike moves across varied intensities and dreamlike environments. Dozens of workout plans target beginners through advanced users seeking fitness results at home.

A single-player 3D action RPG in which Davy, the weakest zombie, dives into a mysterious dungeon to defeat the King of Monsters and revive his frozen love, devouring elite monsters to steal their powers, swapping body parts, and transforming into eleven styles.

Players control EVE, who travels from an off-world colony to a ruined Earth to reclaim it from the Naytiba creatures. She fights fast combo-driven battles, upgrades weapons, faces bosses, and uncovers mysteries of humanity's past in a post-apocalyptic world.

An FPV drone simulator focused on realistic physics, a map replicating the developer's real flying spot, and multiplayer for up to 32 pilots with spectating, plus planned custom map building and Workshop support, aimed at pilots wanting to practice and compare against real flight.

Set in a corruption-ridden 1930s Chicago where meat is outlawed, players lead Eliot Ness and the Untouchables in real-time tactical infiltration missions, planning stealthy approaches, exploiting environments, and outsmarting guards with heightened senses to dismantle Al Capone's black-market empire.

Stranded aboard a demon billionaires' mega yacht, the player competes in a sadistic poker dice tournament, betting fingers and rigging dice with demonic abilities and charms while deciphering a codex to unlock multiple endings in this roguelike dice builder.

After being falsely accused and executed, Étrange von Rosenburg wakes in hell and sets out to conquer it, gathering over fifteen playable subordinates and fighting through fast-paced action RPG battles built around a revolving lane mechanic, with up to four-player multiplayer and comedic musical numbers.

A standalone extension set after RoboCop: Rogue City, where RoboCop storms OmniTower, a housing complex seized by heavily armed mercenaries. Players use firearms and brutal finishing moves against drones, turrets and elite troops, and can also control ED-209.

Players assemble a crew of unique raiders and fight fast, minimalist turn-based battles focused on positioning and ability synergy, upgrading their ship and collecting artifacts to improve loot runs across tactical puzzle maps.

This definitive edition packages the classic real-time strategy game set in the Warhammer 40,000 far future, with four campaigns, nine factions, and over 100 maps. Players command Space Marines, Orks, Eldar, Chaos, and Imperial Guard across battlefields in a blood-soaked war.

Players pilot drones in a realistic flight simulation, flying by line of sight, monitor, or FPV view across atmospheric maps. They complete photo, delivery, and collectable challenges, race time trials on leaderboards, and unlock and customize new drone models.

As chieftain of a tribe on an isolated island, the player builds a settlement, manages citizens' lives and relationships across generations, and commands tactical battles against monsters and rival tribes. Seasons, day-night cycles, trading, auctions and roguelike expeditions shape steady growth.

Starting from a small keep, players grow a medieval kingdom by constructing buildings, managing resources and troops, and forming alliances with other players, while fighting PvE bandits and waging PvP sieges to expand their empire across the continent.

Seize enemies' abilities, skills and followers before battles even begin, stripping foes of their power and building your own arsenal. Mix over 300 abilities across multiple protagonists and playstyles, fight more than 50 unique enemies, and unlock a mode where bosses battle each other.

Players join Task Force 141 in a globe-trotting modern conflict, deploying in a single-player campaign, multiplayer combat, and narrative-driven co-op Special Ops missions. The game spans small-scale tactical infiltration ops and highly classified missions fought alongside friends.

Captain Price and Task Force 141 pursue ultranationalist war criminal Vladimir Makarov across the globe in a first-person shooter campaign. The package also includes multiplayer with remastered classic maps and an open-world Zombies mode where squads fight undead hordes.

An arcade-style GT racing game where players speed through winding courses in varied locales, unlocking eight cars and upgrading them with prize money. Compete against AI or friends online, and advance through a championship mode against seven other drivers.

In a world linked by cyberbrains, a digital virus turns people into savage thugs, and as the sole unconnected Stranger the player fights through burning cities. Combat uses turn-based grid movement and flashy skills, with attribute shops, role builds, and boss fights.

Set in 2035, players lead David Mason's elite team through a co-op campaign in Avalon, then fight in large-scale multiplayer maps with an advanced movement system and a round-based Zombies mode in a shifting Dark Aether hellscape.

Players control Sator in turn-based tactical battles, collecting and restoring relics with unique powers and drawbacks, managing limited slots, and triggering synergies. Skill trees and unlockable rooms expand options across runs as they confront seven bosses and a morally complex, cursed world.

Each night the player runs a night market, placing six types of attractions to satisfy visitor demands and pay rent to demanding landlords, chaining synergies with charms, vouchers, and trucks across seeded journeys in a rubber hose-styled world.

Race formula cars on unique circuits from around the world in high-speed solo or split-screen multiplayer. Choose from 19 cars and 14 tracks, adjust difficulty and assist options, and compete in championships, quick races, and time attacks.

Players defend a backyard garden from waves of brain-hungry zombies by planting peashooters, sunflowers and other flora, now remastered in HD with new levels, fresh twists and fifteen years of franchise history to uncover.

Players dive deeper into a dungeon in this card-based roguelike, choosing cards and combining items to fight enemies and bosses while managing hunger. Each run is unique, with unlockable heroes, spells, traps, and a progression system built around instinctive decisions.

Players race over 40 licensed cars across 50 tracks in France and Japan, customizing paint, bodywork, rims and performance, while a story mode follows building a club in Japanese car culture and a new highway mode has players dodge traffic.

In a devastated future Earth, the player commands three factions—the Remnants, the Ascension, and the alien Hai-Genti—through real-time strategy missions, using faction-specific tactics, terraforming terrain, and leveling characters in a war for survival and supremacy.

A 4X MMO strategy game set in the Monsterverse where the player leads Titan Chasers on the Siren Isles, exploring biomes, recruiting elite units, building a stronghold, and fighting superspecies and rival factions in turn-based combat alongside Godzilla and Kong.

A first-person psychological horror game in which the player wakes on a subway at an abandoned station and must explore dark hallways, solve puzzles, and find clues while an entity stalks them. Multiple endings and hidden secrets reveal a larger story.

A dark samurai action RPG set in an alternate Warring States period, where the player explores an open field full of yokai and bandits, switching seamlessly between Samurai and Ninja combat styles while struggling against the ominous Crucible.

A yakuza member takes the blame for a murder and returns from prison a decade later into a brewing clan war in modern Japan. Players brawl through street fights using four switchable fighting styles and explore the nightlife district of Kamurocho between story missions.

Kazuma Kiryu is pulled back into clan warfare after the Tojo chairman's assassination, traveling to Sotenbori to broker peace with the rival Dragon of Kansai while brawling through street fights and enjoying karaoke, cabaret clubs, and other entertainment district activities.

A multiplayer hide-and-seek game where one player hunts while others disguise themselves as ordinary props across bunker, mall, and sky city maps. Props can reroll disguises, spawn clones, freeze the hunter, or blind them, while the hunter uses weapons and grenades to flush out suspicious objects.

Players lead one of six factions or design their own in hour-long turn-based 4X space strategy matches, expanding empires through space stations and colonization while fighting tactical one-unit-per-tile hex battles against an assertive AI amid randomized techs, maps and victory conditions.

Players command entire divisions in real-time World War II battles on the Western Front, drawing multi-step plans directly on the map while officers and companies execute orders autonomously. The game simulates logistics, supply lines, realistic chain of command, and massive battlefields modeled from real geographic data.

Seven Hearts is a hero-collection battle game where the player assembles teams from over 250 heroes across seven classes, upgrades gear and decks, and fights undead enemies and raid bosses while competing against other players in online PVP arenas and sieges.

In 14th-century Europe ravaged by plague, a young man turned Dawnwalker treads between day and night, choosing to fight for humanity or embrace vampiric powers to save his family while time-limited quests and choices shape a hand-crafted open world.

Players pick Athens or Sparta and build a character from four classes in a classic-style MMORPG set in ancient Greece. They fight in large faction battles, sieges and dungeons, while collecting pets and mounts, upgrading gear, crafting, trading and joining guilds.

Players join a global racing tournament, drifting and boosting through tracks across several continents while colliding with rivals, taking side missions, and uncovering a conspiracy involving rogue AI.

FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft investigates a mysterious death in an abandoned hotel, while seasoned agent Leon S. Kennedy confronts new bioterror outbreaks. Set partly in the ruined Raccoon City, the survival horror game combines combat, investigation, puzzles, and resource management, with switchable first- and third-person views.

Players follow a young James Bond as a recruit in MI6's training program who joins the revived Double 0 program, then teams with a reluctant mentor to expose a deep conspiracy and stop a coup at the heart of the State.

Playing as iconic survivors like Rick, Daryl, and Michonne, the player brawls through walker-infested tunnels and Savior strongholds in arcade-style combat, using combos, signature weapons, and finishers across a campaign reimagining the All Out War conflict.

A stickman beach volleyball game where players run and smash the ball on 3D beaches. It offers quick matches and tournament modes, selectable difficulty and points per game, and single or best-of series formats, with no career options, leveling, or multiplayer.

A pixel-art social online world where players create an avatar, dress up in outfits, build and decorate rooms with furniture, trade rare items, and join community events like quests, DJ sets, and treasure hunts while socializing with other players.

A fast-paced monster-catching autobattler where you capture over fifty Automons across ten elemental types, build a team, and watch auto-battles unfold while exploring a shared map with other players, fighting NPCs and bosses to be the last trainer standing.

Players command fleets in a compact 4X strategy game lasting one to two hours, managing resources, researching technologies, and building up to seventeen ship types. Victory requires eliminating all rival home worlds through tactical combat and exploration of a randomly generated galaxy.

Players take charge of a speedway racing club, signing riders, securing sponsors, upgrading facilities, and developing young talent while competing through faithfully recreated leagues, tracks, and clubs. The management sim is fully moddable, letting players build their own speedway universe and guide their team toward championship titles.

A card-and-board strategy RPG where players become Cepters, building 50-card decks and rolling dice to move across a map, summoning creatures to claim territory and collecting Magic Power. Battles against rivals combine creature stats, item cards, and land bonuses, with new rewind and save features.

A turn-based strategy game set in a hypothetical 1984 NATO-USSR conflict, where commanders play either side across two campaigns and skirmish maps. Players build forces, assign heroes, level units, and use HQ skills, with detailed armor, terrain cover, and a map editor.

Players travel a pixel-art Wild West frontier, meeting eccentric townsfolk and chess rivals and settling disputes on the board. Authored encounters use unusual armies, special tiles, and items like walls and TNT, while puzzle practice, themed challenges, and a sandbox mode round out the chess adventure.

Fritz Chess 20 is a chess training tool where the player faces a world-class engine and simulated historical players, configures opponent styles, and practices under time pressure with bullet training. It includes AI chat and voice commentary, new 3D graphics, and achievements for ambitious players.

Players sit behind the wheel in first-person VR for destructive arcade racing, trading paint, surviving crashes and demolition derby chaos across races, time trials, assault modes and online multiplayer, with first-person ejections when wrecks go badly.

This collection bundles stealth-action titles in which players infiltrate enemy installations undetected to complete missions, alongside screenplay and master books and a soundtrack, with Peace Walker supporting online play for up to six players.

Players take the role of Spanish conquerors, Englishmen, Native Americans, patriots, or settlers across six story campaigns spanning colonization of the East to the Wild West. Missions involve land and naval battles, elite units, technological progress, and unconventional tactics, with colorful settings across the American continent.

Players race through the official 2026 MotoGP championship with real riders, teams, and tracks, managing a career from rookie to legend through contracts, press conferences, and bike development, while training in alternate disciplines and competing online against large grids of riders.

Play as Caleb, an undead gunslinger risen from the grave to avenge himself on the demonic master Tchernobog, blasting through 42 blood-soaked levels with pitchforks, dynamite, and dark voodoo powers against cultists and hellish creatures, with remastered cutscenes, cut-content levels, and up to 8-player co-op.

Players place turrets on a 5x5 grid before each battle and watch them fight enemies across themed worlds such as a space station, pixel world and steel fortress. Turrets are unlocked through combat, and an auto-upgrade option allows idle play.

A real-time strategy game recreating the opening days of the war in Ukraine, from the assault near Kiev to the March 2022 peace talks. Players command squads and vehicles with module-based damage, cover systems, morale, logistics, and persistent units that gain experience between missions.

A remaster of an action RPG set in the fantasy realm of Ancaria, where seven heroes fight corruption fueled by T-Energy. Players explore an open world, complete hundreds of quests, clear dungeons, and grow characters through loot, leveling, and combat arts.

Players strengthen shelters and recruit heroes in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, exploring the map, gathering materials and raising armies. Simulation construction and alliance building support the goal of destroying zombie lords and saving humanity.

A turn-based strategy game where players produce, ship, and consume resources to supply castle guardians against monsters. Procedural maps, deck-building with artifacts and merchant cards, and multiple clans demand adapting tactics rather than memorized builds.

Players take on a demanding rally racing simulation across laser-scanned gravel and tarmac stages in Wales and Alsace, driving licensed cars with realistic physics while managing weather, surface grip, and car setups in offline and online modes.

Players control twin sisters trapped in an abandoned Japanese village, using a special camera to capture and repel vengeful spirits while exploring haunted locations. The remake rebuilds the visuals, audio, and combat systems, and adds a hand-holding mechanic that emphasizes the sisters' bond.

A cosmic horror idle game where the player commands a cult, clicking to sacrifice fragments of humanity and summon the Yellow King, unlocking fragmented tales of dread and prestiging through elder curses while black metal dirges play.

A cycling simulation of the 2026 Tour de France where the player races stages through changing weather, manages rider technique and equipment, and competes in new races like the Muscat Classic and Paris-Tours alongside a revamped team time trial.

An ex-yakuza named Kazuma Kiryu fights to protect those he loves across Okinawa and Tokyo in a remake with brutal brawling combat, while a separate story follows Yoshitaka Mine through the yakuza underworld with boxing-based fighting.

An action RPG following adventurer Adol and Norman warrior Karja, bound by Mana shackles, as they sail the Obelia Gulf with a gathered crew to battle the undying Griegr horde, featuring fast-paced combat, new Mana abilities, and a timed high-difficulty dungeon.

Playing as Marisa, the player collects items and skills to build a construct, then battles opponents across ten days of events and night-market duels to repay a debt to Reimu, with short runs, unlockable extra mode and save-file sharing.

An inventory-management battle royale where the player picks a martial arts sect, enters a shared world of 99 others, and builds overpowered item and skill combinations in a backpack grid. Fighting, shopping, and looting lead toward a final showdown at Mount Hua's peak.

Players race against the clock across over 30 puzzle-like arcade tracks, learning layouts, dodging obstacles and clearing massive jumps while unlocking vehicles with distinct handling to set the best times. The tone is challenging and drifty.

A next-generation MMORPG reviving the classic Ragnarok Online world, where players explore Midgard, take on quests and dungeons, join guilds for PvE raids and PvP wars, and build a player-driven economy through trading, crafting, and life skills.

Command drone swarms, mobile SAM units, and air defense systems in a real-time tactical strategy game, defending cities and infrastructure from strike drones while managing logistics, construction, and limited supplies across AI, sandbox, and multiplayer modes.

Players compete in 3D billiards matches, aiming shots with adjustable power and spin to sink balls against online opponents. They climb ranked divisions, earn coins, and unlock cues, tables, and avatars in turn-based 1v1 duels.

Overtrick is a trick-taking deckbuilder based on Bridge, where players pick trumps, follow suit, and win enough tricks to meet each hand's rising contract. Winning overtricks earns rewards and stronger special abilities, while opponents in 1920s high-society penthouses use abilities of their own to compete.

The player becomes the dragon Fafnir in a comedic isekai romance, surrounded by adoring heroines including a tsundere princess, an icy queen, and a villainess. Bite-sized chapters advance harem story scenes, while idle play and gacha pulls unlock characters and loot.

Players practice gerrymandering by drawing district maps that decide election outcomes, packing rival voters to win seats. A campaign follows Southern Democrats redistricting ten states in 1990, while a sandbox covers all 48 contiguous states with historical election results and census data, including majority-minority district requirements.

A strategic autobattler where players assemble heroes with randomized boosted stats and abilities, then stack upgrades to push them to absurd power levels. Players test customized teams against others in real-time or asynchronous online PvP matches with shifting upgrade pools.

Players grow an insect colony in this incremental strategy game, producing and combining foods to evolve the species. They balance worker production and delivery, spend limited Brain Matter and DNA points on upgrades and a genetics talent tree, and experiment with synergy-based strategies amid cute hand-drawn art.

Players fight head-to-head in 3D battles using holds, break gauges and fatal rushes, choosing from a roster of 29 characters across varied stages, and can pose characters for screenshots in a new Photo Mode.

The Fertile Crescent 2 is a story-driven RTS set during the Late Bronze Age Collapse, following survivors through a world of failing kingdoms and sea raiders. Players manage fragile food economies, build bases, and command Assyrian, Egyptian, Babylonian, or Hittite forces in tactical real-time battles.

Players build an efficient factory using belts, inserters, and assemblers to meet the demands of Boxes. Completing each Box lets them choose from three machine bundles, and after three Boxes they pick unique buffs to significantly improve their growing factory.

A minimalist strategy game where players spend short days exploring procedurally generated maps, mining resources, and building and upgrading turrets and walls, then defend against nightly waves of hostile creatures, repairing and adapting to survive until the final night.

An MMO blending real-time strategy and simulation management, where players command multiple troops across 3D terrain with collision physics. Battles emphasize positioning, high ground, chokepoints, and siege tactics, while commanders provide unique strategist skills and alliances coordinate large-scale warfare.

Players harvest blood, bones, and marrow from enemies to unlock forbidden powers and devastating combos on an expanding skill tree, building ability-card decks to punish the Ignoble. Each run races a timer to maximize the haul and survive relentless threats.

Players control Rose Belmont in 1499 Paris, wielding the Vampire Killer whip in fast-paced combat against monsters and legendary bosses, sealing defeated foes into tarot cards for spell powers. The game offers exploration of Gothic stages, equipment customization, and a dark conspiracy narrative.

A low-stress base-building game where you construct a settlement by day and defend it automatically at night, positioning buildings for production, recruiting units, and launching attacks to weaken a corrupt king's influence across a short campaign.

A rescue squad is sent to a remote mansion to investigate a biotechnical experiment gone wrong, trapping them among monsters, traps, and puzzles. Players choose between Chris Redfield and Jill Valentine, scavenging weapons and solving mysteries while surviving the mansion's horrors in this uncut, gory version.

A classic survival horror game where the player controls Leon Kennedy or Claire Redfield through a zombie-infested city, fighting mutant creatures and solving puzzles while managing limited resources in a tense, terrifying atmosphere.

Jill Valentine, survivor of the mansion disaster, tries to escape a zombie-infested Raccoon City while uncovering more of Umbrella's plot, relying on brute force and cunning against relentless mutations in this third-person survival horror adventure.

As agent Regina, you infiltrate an isolated island research facility to retrieve a scientist, only to find it overrun by prehistoric creatures. You fight and evade dinosaurs while uncovering the truth behind the Third Energy experiment in this survival horror action game.

A rescue team travels through an experimental time gate to a research city displaced in time, where they must survive encounters with dinosaurs while uncovering the consequences of unstable Third Energy. This re-release of the survival action game adds modern compatibility, difficulty options, and arena modes.

Play as a newly hatched dinosaur on a mysterious Jurassic island, joining teams, hunting and fighting over thirty species with mouse-driven attacks, managing stamina, and eating and drinking to grow and evolve while uncovering the island's secrets.

Players explore a massive open world car sandbox, customizing and tuning vehicles, joining car meets with crossplay players, and taking on drag, circuit, drift, and rally racing plus parking challenges and auto-life jobs like taxi driving and police patrol.

A 2D roguelike dice-builder in which the player crafts dice from swappable faces, runes, and bodies, drafts spells as one of several mages, and combines synergies to fight through the Archon's palace across four acts.

A real-time strategy war game set in the Warhammer Old World, where the player commands Commander Morgan Bernhardt's mercenary army of cavalry, infantry, archers, wizards, and monsters against the undead. A dynamic campaign lets players choose battles and manage an evolving army on 3D terrain.

As leader of the mercenary Grudgebringers, the player commands an army through over 40 real-time battles across the Warhammer world, choosing from more than 25 troop types. A campaign story links the battles as orcs and Chaos threaten the Empire, presented in 3D environments with mission briefings and animated interludes.

The player commands Eldar warriors in a turn-based campaign against the Tyranids and the Imperium, planning tactical battles across 24 missions and customizing armies with a glory point system. The setting is the Warhammer 40,000 galaxy, and the tone is grim and battle-focused.

Following a Chaos invasion, the player commands one of six Warhammer armies across three campaigns and skirmish battles, fighting epic-scale fights with over a hundred units. Heroes can be customized and honed, and enemy champions challenged to duels, in a dark age of constant war.

A cozy farming strategy game set in a small Ukrainian village transitioning from Soviet machinery to an independent countryside near the 2000s, where the player works fields, manages fuel, grain and market prices at their own pace, grows a farm and helps neighbours through contracts.

A cozy, story-driven puzzle game where players decode secret messages using ciphers, symbols, and visual tricks across 50+ levels, each introducing a new encoding technique. Three hint tiers adapt difficulty, and some puzzles require revisiting earlier levels or changing the game's UI theme to find clues.

A realistic speedway racing game in which the player rides brakeless motorcycles or manages a team through a season. Career and league modes, quick races, challenges and ranked multiplayer are supported, with bike setup, track analysis and financial decisions shaping results.

A gambler thrown into an industrial prison must fight machines using cards to trigger attacks, defenses, and combos, while unused cards form poker hands for bonuses. Players choose characters, navigate a procedurally generated map, and gather relics to climb back to the surface.

The player races top-down through glowing neon city circuits, drifting through corners and tuning fully 3D car liveries with colors, decals, and glow effects. Kawaii pit crews and garage customization frame short arcade races, with unlocks and lap-time mastery driving progression.

A management simulation putting the player in charge of a professional speedway club, handling squad building, rider development, transfer negotiations, contracts, sponsors, budgets and stadium expansion while planning long-term sporting and infrastructure strategy across a detailed 2026-season database.

The player builds a basketball career in a licensed NBA simulation, creating a MyPLAYER, competing against legends across five eras, and collecting NBA and WNBA stars for fantasy lineups. Players team up with friends in The City, dominate courts in The REC and Park, and chase Hall of Fame glory through single-player and multiplayer modes.

Playing as a mercenary named N.A., the player takes direct control of action combat in this Disgaea spinoff, mowing down monsters with seven weapon classes, grinding levels and equipment, recruiting demons, and gathering pudding for a dessert-loving princess in a light-hearted tale.

Command the flying fortress Arcadia in a tactical tower defense with roguelite structure, building an interconnected network of turrets, support modules and collectors. Enemies attack from all directions, and economy depends on territory control across ground and air missions.

A first-person shooter where war erupts as North Korea invades the Korean Peninsula. The campaign follows a young South Korean soldier on collapsing front lines and Captain Price waging a shadow war, while multiplayer offers large-scale vehicle and infantry combat and DMZ delivers extraction-style sandbox missions.

The player steers the Linerunner through bite-sized winding racetracks using a two-button control scheme, finding the right angle and timing to go fast and set records. Levels span three difficulty tiers with medals, online leaderboards, customization themes, and a synthwave soundtrack.

A kinetic visual novel about Iris, a gorgonian who develops a fear of sleeping after moving to the northern city of Stalva, as nightmares and memories haunt her rest and she struggles to improve her condition.

Players start with almost nothing and build a trucking company in an open-world driving game, delivering cargo across connected highways and backroads while competing with rival drivers, evading police and bandits, and managing finances, fleet expansion, and side races.

Players join an online multiplayer immortal-cultivation world, training, crafting, and cultivating to grow their character while cooperating with others to defeat the Herald of the End Times and prevent the world's destruction. Progression is idle-based, with cosmetics and support packages offering only flair or global bonuses.

Players train over fifteen skills, fight monsters in real-time combat, trade on a player-driven marketplace, and join clans in a free-to-play idle RPG with offline progress. Characters keep working while the tab is closed, and all content is accessible without paying.

Players climb a thousand-floor cultivation tower as a roguelite, falling and being reborn stronger each time while keeping their realm and arts. They face elemental combat, tribulations, rival climbers, sect politics, and a bond with an ancient sword spirit across many lives.

Players build a single gladiator who keeps training, running expeditions, and climbing the arena ladder while the game runs on its own clock between short sessions. They pick fighting styles, stats, and trade-off gear, face a persistent Nemesis, and work through 115 quests across ten acts.
